data.title: Senior Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Automation
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer - Automation builds and runs the Internal Hosting Portal, with a focus on its server side and workflow automation, that allows application teams across GSK to provision and manage Cloud resources in a self-service manner. The Hosting Portal is a custom-built web application using a modern tech stack based on TypeScript. The automation engineer sets the engineering standard within that platform, owns the portal's APIs, integrations and workflow orchestration, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through automated software deployment rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. The role also connects the Hosting Portal to the enterprise infrastructure-as-code platform, so that teams starting their cloud journey in the portal are onboarded to it and can discover its golden paths. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate the provisioning of foundational infrastructure resources through the portal's services, integrations and workflows, using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting services and workflows for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Why is this level of Education Required?

- Deep engineering credentials are needed because the role sets the engineering standard other engineers and partner teams build to, and that standard has to hold under code review rather than by assertion. 

Related Experience Required

- Typically 8-10 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with TypeScript (ES6+) and Node. js server-side development. 
 - Developed REST and GraphQL APIs based on Node. js (Express). 
 - Integrating with cloud provider and third-party APIs, with retries, idempotency and error handling for long-running operations. 
 - Designing and automating long-running, multi-step processes (retries, timeouts, compensation, human approval steps) using a workflow orchestration or durable-execution approach.

Company Description Infyntra Technologies is a technology firm focused on building resilient, mission‐critical software platforms, from rapid prototypes to enterprise-scale deployments. Team members work with modern technologies in an environment that values technical excellence, ownership, and long‐term impact. 
Role Description The Solution Architect role at Infyntra Technologies is a full-time, on-site position based in Bengaluru South. The Solution Architect will lead the technical design of cloud, AI, and digital platforms, translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable architectures. Daily responsibilities include collaborating with product and engineering teams, creating architectural blueprints and reference designs, guiding implementation teams through best practices, and performing design and code reviews to ensure quality. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you're energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U. S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. 

About Your Role

As a Principal Engineer, you will drive the team's technical direction and play a pivotal role in designing and architecting accounting software systems. This role involves mentoring team members, solving complex technical challenges, and delivering hands-on contributions as a full-stack leader. 

You will work closely with engineers and cross-functional partners across Product, Design, and Quality Assurance to expand system capabilities. Your leadership will be instrumental in achieving the team's objectives and advancing our technical vision.

 - Design and operate LLM-powered systems, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, evaluation infrastructure, guardrails, and model observability

Champion AI Native Development

Lead and Grow the Team

 - Partner with recruiting to build and grow the team

Collaborate Cross Functionally

AI Fluency

Qualifications

data.title: ADAS Architect - Simulation, Data & Verification Platform
data.description:
About The Team

You will join a focused team of domain experts building a greenfield, in-house L2+ ADAS software stack for Indian road conditions, covering four-wheelers and two-wheelers. The team designs and owns the complete architecture, algorithms, and tooling, from first principles through to deployment on automotive-grade ECUs. Engineers here shape foundational technical decisions, work directly with experts across perception, fusion, driving functions, motion control, and simulation, and see their work carried from concept to vehicle. 

Role purpose

The Simulation, Data & Verification Platform Architect defines and builds the engineering platform on which every ADAS algorithm in the organization is developed, verified, and released. This is not the integration or configuration of an existing framework: the role creates, from the ground up, a proprietary simulation engine and developer application, the automated verification and reporting system that runs on it, and the data platform that feeds both, from recorded vehicle data through labelling to cloud-scale execution. 

The platform is the primary evidence base for every function, before and after vehicles are available. Its correctness, determinism, and traceability directly determine the credibility of every result the organization reports. The role calls for a senior architect with deep software engineering skill, strong automotive domain understanding, and a record of building platforms that entire engineering teams depend on. 

Key Responsibilities

Simulation engine and developer application

- Architect and build a proprietary simulation engine that executes any algorithm component delivered as a host-agnostic C-API library, discovering the component's ports and configuration at run time rather than through hand-written integration. 
 - Define the execution model: closed-loop simulation, deterministic resimulation against recorded data, and pure replay as distinct, well-defined modes; multi-rate scheduling; and multi-component pipelines in which any stage can run live, stubbed, or injected from a recording. 
 - Design and build the interactive developer application: timeline and transport control, 2D/3D scene view, signal plots, port and message inspection, layer-based visualization contributed by each component as plug-ins, and side-by-side comparison of runs. 
 - Guarantee traceability: every value displayed or reported is traceable to the recording, message, build, and configuration that produced it, and the headless command-line interface produces answers identical to the GUI. 
 - Establish determinism as a measured property: bit-exact resimulation within and across processes, and tracked, explained differences across builds and machines. 
 - Provide process isolation, timeouts, and crash capture so that a failing component never takes down a run or a campaign. 
 - Integrate external simulators and scenario tools (e. g. , CarMaker, CARLA, esmini) through codecs and adapters, without coupling any algorithm component to a specific tool. 

Automated verification and reporting framework

- Design and build, from zero, the automated test framework that runs scenario campaigns on the simulation engine: scenario definitions with machine-checkable acceptance criteria, parameter sweeps, and NCAP-based and India-specific scenario libraries. 
 - Build automated reporting for every campaign: per-scenario verdicts with evidence, function KPIs, coverage against requirements, trend and regression tracking, and drill-down from any failed case to the exact moment in the recording. 
 - Implement regression gates in CI that block a change when a KPI, scenario outcome, or determinism check regresses. 
 - Link verification results to requirements so that traceability and coverage reports are generated automatically, never maintained by hand. 

Data platform: recordings, storage, labelling, and cloud execution

- Define the recording data model and formats (e. g. , MCAP, MDF4, rosbag), including embedded schemas and provenance (vehicle, sensor set, software build, configuration, and scenario identity). 
 - Architect storage and data management for large volumes of vehicle recordings: ingestion from test vehicles, indexing, metadata and search, retention, dataset versioning, and access control. 
 - Establish labelling and annotation pipelines for ground truth: tool selection or development, auto-labelling, quality control, annotation specifications, and management of external annotation vendors. 
 - Build scenario extraction and mining from recorded data, turning field drives into reusable, parameterized test scenarios. 
 - Architect cloud and cluster execution of resimulation and scenario campaigns at scale (thousands of runs), including job orchestration, containerization, cost control, and reproducibility of every run. 

Technical leadership

- Own the technical roadmap of the platform and make build-versus-buy decisions with clear justification. 
 - Set engineering standards for the platform: code quality, testing, documentation, and backward compatibility of interfaces. 
 - Work with algorithm, perception, test, and integration teams as internal customers, and with the ECU-in-the-Loop Test & Release Architect so that SIL, HIL, and vehicle results share one reporting system. 
 - Mentor engineers and, as the platform grows, build and lead the team around it. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree (PhD a plus) in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline. 
 - 7-15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years architecting simulation, SIL/HIL, data, or verification platforms for ADAS, autonomous driving, or robotics. 
 - Demonstrated design and delivery, from scratch, of a simulation or resimulation platform adopted as the primary development and regression tool of an engineering organization. 
 - Expert-level C++ (C++17) and Python: C ABIs, dynamic library loading, plug-in architectures, cross-language bindings, and performance-critical, multi-threaded code on Windows and Linux. 
 - Experience building desktop engineering applications with rich visualization (e. g. , Qt, Dear ImGui, OpenGL/Vulkan, or equivalent). 
 - Deep knowledge of recorded-data formats and large-scale handling of automotive sensor data (camera, radar, lidar, vehicle bus).

data.title: Manager - AWS Cloud Infrastructure
data.description:
About Cognizant Corporate

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth. 

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose - always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business. 

About The Role

We are seeking a Lead/Principal AWS Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the design, standardization, and operation of enterprise AWS infrastructure at scale. This is a technical leadership role responsible for landing zone and platform architecture, automation and governance frameworks, reliability and cost optimization, and for guiding engineering teams and engaging senior stakeholders and vendors. 

In This Role, You Will

- Lead the design and implementation of AWS landing zones, multi-account structures, and platform foundations using Control Tower, Organizations, and the Well-Architected Framework. 
 - Define and own infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and reusable Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred) modules consumed across teams. 
 - Architect and govern networking at scale - Transit Gateway, VPC design, VPN/Direct Connect, Route 53, PrivateLink, IPAM, and egress/SASE controls - within AWS service limits. 
 - Establish governance, security, and compliance frameworks - SCPs, IAM/identity models, KMS/Secrets Manager strategy, Config rules, tagging, and security baselines. 
 - Drive reliability engineering - multi-AZ/multi-region HA and DR design, backup strategy, capacity/quota planning, observability, and SLOs. 
 - Own cloud cost governance (FinOps) - optimisation strategy, budgeting, rightsizing, and chargeback/showback models. 
 - Lead end-to-end delivery of infrastructure programs and POCs, including orchestration/automation and migration/consolidation efforts. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring; conduct architecture and code reviews; raise engineering maturity. 
 - Engage senior stakeholders, security/architecture review boards, and vendors (e. g. , AWS, Zscaler) on design validation and roadmap. 
 - Evaluate emerging AWS services and define adoption recommendations and standards. 
 - Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for high-impact incidents, driving corrective/preventive actions. 

What You Must Have To Be Considered

- 6-10 years in cloud infrastructure, with deep hands-on AWS expertise at enterprise scale. 
 - Strong architecture experience across AWS compute, storage, networking, identity (IAM/Identity Center), and key managed services. 
 - Expert-level Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) - framework/module design, CI/CD, and policy-as-code. 
 - Proven experience with landing zones, multi-account governance, and Control Tower/Organizations design. 
 - Deep networking knowledge - hybrid connectivity, routing/BGP, segmentation, DNS, IPAM, and egress control; strong grasp of service limits and capacity planning. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud security, zero-trust principles, governance, and compliance frameworks. 
 - Experience leading delivery and mentoring engineers; strong stakeholder communication. 
 - Automation proficiency (Python/boto3, AWS CLI). 

These will help you succeed

- Multi-cloud exposure (Azure and/or GCP) and multi-cloud governance experience. 
 - Experience with containers (EKS/ECS), GitOps, and platform-engineering practices. 
 - Familiarity with egress/SASE tooling (e. g. , Zscaler) and large-scale IP remediation. 
 - Exposure to orchestration-based provisioning and account-vending automation. 

Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect - Professional, DevOps Engineer - Professional, or Advanced Networking - Specialty

Work Model

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Bangalore/Coimbatore. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. 

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You'll Need

About Truveta

Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values. 

This opportunity

Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early members, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. 

The Data Platform group in India owns parts of the pipeline that ingests, processes, stores, and serves healthcare data at a scale very few organizations operate at. Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve the same engineering rigor that has transformed other industries, and that is the work: correctness under volume, reliability under failure, and speed without cutting the corners that regulated health data does not allow anyone to cut. 

What You Will Do

- Define architecture across ingestion, processing, storage, serving, governance, and observability for the India-owned parts of the platform, aligned with Seattle. 
 - Set multi-platform technical strategy along with the sequencing that makes it achievable rather than aspirational. 
 - Remain hands-on where it counts: critical designs, prototypes, deep reviews, and the worst production problems. 
 - Resolve technical disagreements that span teams and write down the decision and it's reasoning so that it holds afterwards. 
 - Establish architecture governance that engineers experience as a useful framework. 
 - Raise the technical bar of the IDC through hiring, interview calibration, and mentoring of Senior and SDE3 engineers. 
 - Represent Truveta's engineering thinking to partners, candidates, and the wider technical community. 

Key Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10 to 16 or more years of professional software engineering experience, with eight considered exceptional candidates. 
 - Architecture ownership across multiple teams or platforms, with results that are demonstrably durable. 
 - Deep expertise in large-scale distributed data systems across the full lifecycle, from ingestion through serving. 
 - Continuing hands-on practice: you still write code and review designs in detail. This is an IC role, not a management role. 
 - Evidence of technical strategy that was adopted and executed, not only proposed. 
 - Sound judgment about build versus buy, migration risk, and technical debt at organization scale. 
 - Ability to influence senior engineering and product leadership across geographies and time zones. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Healthcare data, clinical informatics, or a comparably regulated domain. 
 - Experience as the most senior individual contributor at a site or within a platform organization. 
 - Track record of hiring and calibrating senior engineering talent. 
 - Prior work on privacy, security, or compliance architecture at scale.

Job Purpose: The Shift Engineer - Cluster - IPQA conducts in-process quality inspections during shifts, monitoring production processes and identifying quality deviations. This role records and analyzes quality data, assists in implementing corrective actions, provides training on in-process quality procedures, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process quality. 

- Key Responsibilities of Role

Safety

- Follow and promote safety guidelines during inspections and quality checks, contributing to a safe work environment. 

In-Process Inspections

- Conduct in-process quality inspections during assigned shifts to ensure compliance with quality standards at stages like texturing, anti-reflective coating (ARC) application, and metallization. Monitor critical process parameters and identify deviations from standards. 

Quality Monitoring

- Monitor production processes to identify quality issues, reporting findings to the Cluster Manager - IPQA. Assist in implementing corrective actions to address in-process quality deviations. 

Calibration & Validation

- Validation of test results and if required, calibration of AOI, Testers (IV curve measurements), weighing balance, & other measurement tool. 

Recipe Management

- Defect teaching to AOI and breakage camera

Benchmarking

- Benchmarking with competitor cells. 

Documentation

- Record in-process quality data and perform initial analysis to identify trends and issues. Report data and findings to the Cluster Manager - IPQA for further analysis and action. 

Compliance

- Ensure incoming materials comply with relevant industry standards and specifications. Stay updated on quality standards and inspection protocols specific to solar cell manufacturing. 

Training And Support

- Provide on-the-job training to production staff on in-process quality procedures and standards. Ensure consistent application of quality protocols across all shifts and production lines. 

Continuous Improvement

- Identify opportunities for process improvements and work with the IPQA team to implement changes. Participate in quality improvement projects and initiatives.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager- Data
data.description:
## ROLE SUMMARY

Are you a hands-on engineer who raises the bar for everyone around you?

Join us at FTSE Russell! We're establishing a team of engineers passionate about software craftsmanship, quality, and substantial impact. As a Senior Engineering Manager, you'll own the technical direction of the software that powers the indices trusted by financial institutions worldwide. 

We build primarily in Python, so that's our preference - but depth of engineering judgement matters more to us than the language on your CV. If you've led the design and delivery of serious systems in Java, C#, C, C++, Scala, Go, or Rust and you're motivated to lead in Python, we'd like to talk. At this level we expect you to become fluent quickly and to bring the cross-language perspective with you. 

This is a hands-on(60%) + People manager role (40%) - You'll still be writing and reviewing code every week. What changes at this level is scope: you own architecture and technical direction in a defined area, you mentor and grow the engineers around you, and you raise quality across the team through reuse, good design, and hands-on support. The systems handle serious volumes of financial data, so there's real depth in the data problems - but you're being hired as a software engineer who leads through code. 

If you're excited about building systems that matter and making the engineers around you better, we'd love to meet you. 

## WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

We're building the next-generation index data platform at FTSE Russell - and we want you to shape it with us: 

- Staying hands-on - designing and writing production code, primarily in Python with 10 +yrs of experience , and setting the standard for what good looks like through the code you ship
 - Owning technical direction and architecture for a defined area of the platform, and making the trade-offs explicit so the team can move fast with confidence
 - Leading design of software systems - services, APIs, shared libraries, and the interfaces between them - with resilience, performance, and reusability designed in
 - Driving engineering quality across the team: raising the bar in code review, reducing duplication through well-designed shared components, and championing testing, refactoring, and secure development practices
 - Mentoring and coaching engineers - pairing, reviewing, and growing capability so that good practice outlives any one project
 - Digging into design and risk trade-offs - failure modes, operational readiness, security, and cost - and resolving the blockers that slow the team down

## WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Essential - this is the bar: 

- A substantial track record of building and shipping software. Applications, services, platforms, or libraries you designed, built, ran in production, and evolved over years - not just pipelines and scripts

 - You are genuinely hands-on and intend to stay that way. Leading through code is the point of this role
 - Proven experience mentoring and levelling up other engineers - through code review, pairing, design guidance, and setting standards
 - Strong ownership of technical outcomes - you take responsibility for what production does, not just what merges
 - Deep experience with relational databases (e. g. Aurora PostgreSQL) - modelling, performance, and evolution under real load
 - Solid AWS experience and strong CI/CD, automation, and testing practice
 - Comfort with data-intensive systems - batch processing, ETL, schema evolution, and reasoning about correctness at volume

The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. The ideal candidate should have experience working in production-critical environments where system availability, quick incident resolution, effective monitoring, and preventive engineering are essential. 

Key Responsibilities1. Site Reliability and Production Operations

- Monitor production systems and maintain service availability, performance, and operational stability.

data.title: Software Development Engineer, Finance Technology
data.description:
Description

We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time. 

We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it - all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in. 

You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally. 

Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation - and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship. 

Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours. 

Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading. 

Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders - finance, tax, and accounts payable operations - to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up. 

Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release. 

Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step. 

Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room. 

Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture. 

Building with agentic AI

We are not experimenting with AI on the side - it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves - automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop - and you will have room to build them. 

Why this team

Payments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence - a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
 - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
 - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
 - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
 - Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
 - Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems
 - Experience with cloud computing or web services or related areas
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings

data.title: Software Engineer II — Backend (Kirana Club)
data.description:
About The Team

We're a small engineering team, so scope is wide and ownership is real. You'll ship to production in your first week, and every week after that. 

Every engineering role here is back-end-leaning fullstack. Most of your time goes into services, data models and APIs, but you own your work all the way to the screen - and the screen should look like someone cared. If frontend hasn't been your main thing, that gap is far smaller than it used to be. 

What we can't teach is taste: the sense of what a good interface feels like, and the instinct to notice when something is confusing, slow or ugly before a user has to tell you. 

Everyone here writes code with LLMs - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever works, on the paid tier, and we don't count tokens. Producing code is cheap now, so what we hire for is judgment, verification, specification and taste. One hard rule: you own every line you ship, whether you typed it or not. "The model wrote it" is not an explanation in code review, in a postmortem, or in a design discussion. 

About The Role

Join us in building technology for the next generation of retail commerce. You will work on real-world product and platform problems, partnering closely with product, business, and operations teams. 

What You'll Do

- Own backend features and systems end-to-end, from understanding the problem to production. 
 - Build reliable and scalable services, APIs, and data flows. 
 - Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, simplicity, scalability, and maintainability. 
 - Debug production issues and improve system reliability. 
 - Use AI tools to accelerate development while reviewing and validating the output. 
 - Work effectively in an environment with ambiguity and changing requirements

What We're Looking For

- 2. 5 - 4. 5 years of relevant backend engineering experience. 
 - Strong programming fundamentals and hands-on experience with Go or JavaScript
 - Experience building production backend services, APIs, and data-intensive applications. 
 - Strong understanding of databases, distributed systems, system design, and backend fundamentals. 
 - Good problem-solving, debugging, and ownership skills. 
 - Ability to understand product and business context, not just technical requirements. 
 - Experience using AI coding tools with the ability to critically evaluate their output. 

Good to Have

Experience in e-commerce, retail, B2B commerce, marketplaces, fintech, logistics, or other product-led companies.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Real-Time
data.description:
ABOUT US: 

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It's how we've contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services - and our open-access model - we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. 

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25, 000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG's ticker symbol is LSEG. 

OUR PEOPLE: 

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential. 

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder - which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. 

ROLE PROFILE: 

As a Software Engineer in LSEG's Real-Time Engineering organisation, you will work on a global low-latency market data platform that sends billions of price updates per-day around the globe. In this role, you will build APIs, telemetry pipelines and synthetic monitoring services that show how reliably and quickly market data reaches customers. You will work with experienced engineers to develop production software, measure performance and enable observability of a globally distributed platform. Prior market-data or observability experience is not required; we are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity and a willingness to learn. 

ROLE SUMMARY: 

You will work with experienced engineers to build the software and data stack that measures how our Real-Time application delivers data from hundreds of global exchanges to thousands of customers. You will help turn software signals and synthetic monitoring data into useful end-to-end insight across LSEG's Real-Time platform. 

You will contribute to software that brings together telemetry from individual applications and services, helping engineering and operations teams understand service health, performance and customer impact. 

This is a hands-on development role for an engineer at an early stage of their career who wants to build experience in mission-critical distributed systems, observability, cloud-native engineering and real-time financial technology. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and improve software components that aggregate, correlate and present data from over 30 global distribution sites. 
 - Develop applications and data-processing logic that help identify performance issues, service degradation and hotspots across distributed systems. 
 - Contribute to telemetry pipelines that ingest, transform and route metrics, logs and traces into a common observability layer. 
 - Deliver synthetic monitoring capabilities that measure the performance and experience of Real-Time services from locations around the world. 
 - Develop APIs, automation and configuration used to manage observability services and capabilities. 
 - Use Git, CI/CD and configuration-as-code practices to deploy and maintain software and observability assets consistently across environments. 
 - Work with engineering squads to add and improve instrumentation within applications across Development, Test, PPE and Production environments. 
 - Work alongside expert engineers to learn modern approaches to observability, distributed systems, cloud-native software and real-time data platforms. 
 - Contribute ideas and improvements as the Real-Time observability platform continues to evolve. 

Essential

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Hands-on software engineering experience, gained through employment, a graduate role, or open-source contribution. 
 - Ability to write and explain software in a performance-oriented languages such as Go, modern C++ or Rust. 
 - A good understanding of core software engineering concepts and an interest in building reliable, maintainable applications. 
 - Familiarity with APIs, Git and modern software development practices. 
 - An interest in one or more of the following areas: market data, observability, distributed systems, telemetry, data pipelines, real-time systems, performance engineering or cloud-native technology. 
 - Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving ability in complex engineering or academic domain. 
 - A willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and develop knowledge of complex systems. 
 - Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers across different teams. 

Desirable

You do not need experience in all of the areas below. Exposure to any of them would be useful: 

- Financial markets, market data or other real-time or latency-sensitive systems. 
 - Metrics, logging, distributed tracing or observability platforms. 
 - OpenTelemetry SDKs, collectors or telemetry standards. 
 - Kubernetes, containers or cloud platforms. 
 - Data-processing, event-streaming or telemetry-pipeline technologies. 
 - CI/CD, GitOps or configuration-as-code approaches. 
 - Synthetic monitoring, automated testing, probes or distributed agents. 

What You'll Get In Return

This role provides an opportunity to develop your engineering skills while working on technology operating at significant global scale. You will gain hands-on experience with distributed systems, cloud-native engineering and real-time financial data while working alongside experienced engineers who can support your development. You will apply that learning with the opportunity to work on systems that deliver financial information across global markets. 

Career Stage: 

Senior Associate

LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy. 

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions. 

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance. 

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you'll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what's next for our business and the global economy. 

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops. 

Join more than 26, 000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you'll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you. 

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone's race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. 

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it's used for, and how it's obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject. 

By clicking on "Apply", the process for submitting an application will begin. If you have any questions prior to clicking "Apply", please contact the recruiter. 

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice. 

LSEG. Make more possible.

data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‐throughput, hyper‐scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‐scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‐tolerant, in‐service‐upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‐shedding, throttling, and rate‐limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‐management plans. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

-Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

-Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

-Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations. 

Qualifications

Career Level - IC4

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‐management plans. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. .

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

About Lucidity

Lucidity helps enterprises save up to 40% of their cloud costs. Its AI Action Engine is a set of AI agents that deliver savings, not just recommend them. Most cloud cost tools stop at a dashboard. Our agents find waste that generic FinOps tools miss, work out which changes are safe for each workload, and make them in production with a human in the loop. Today Lucidity works with 100+ enterprises. We have identified more than $500M in savings and taken over 1. 5M autonomous actions on production infrastructure.

- Build AI agents that safely change live production infrastructure for large enterprises.

Know about our open Roles - Linkedin Lucidity Page

We're looking for a hands-on software engineer with strong coding skills and practical experience evaluating AI-powered systems. 

The engineer will design and build evaluation frameworks, automated tests, and developer tools that help us measure and improve the correctness, reliability, and safety of our AI-powered features. 

The engineer will work on challenges such as non-deterministic AI responses, hallucinations, agent behavior, tool execution, and regressions across models and prompts. The tools will be used by other engineers to evaluate AI features, help solve real cloud and AI reliability problems, and influence product quality from design to production. 

This is an AI-focused engineering role

What will the engineer do?

- Build reusable test frameworks, mocks, datasets and developer tools for APIs, backend services and cloud workflows.

 - Build test datasets and automated checks for factual accuracy, business rules, safety, output quality and consistency. 
 - Use deterministic checks where possible and rubric-based, model-based or human review where needed. 
 - Measure quality over repeated runs, detect regressions across prompts/models, and make failures easy to debug. 
 - Add evaluations and quality gates to CI/CD; improve observability and release confidence. 
 - Test reliability under retries, timeouts, partial failures and concurrency. 
 - Work with engineering and product teams to define what good software looks like and raise the quality bar. 

Must have

 - Strong coding in Python, Java or another general-purpose language; ability to design and maintain substantial code. 
 - Hands-on experience testing or evaluating AI/LLM applications in real projects. You have built or owned evaluation datasets, checks, pipelines or quality metrics - not just used chatbots or written prompts.

 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, story refinement, estimation, sprint planning, and retrospectives. 
 - Partner across Engineering, Architecture, Product Management, Testing, Release Management, and Application Support to deliver quality solutions. 

About You

===================================

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field preferred. 
 - 5+ years of experience of Java platform engineering experience, strong expertise in Spring Boot, REST or gRPC, distributed systems, Apache Ignite/Hazelcast, Kubernetes, high-volume transaction processing, and designing resilient cloud-native service orchestration platforms. data.title: Web and Native Mobile App Developer
data.description:
Experience: Junior / Early Career, 1 to 2 years

Primary stack: Swift and SwiftUI or Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, plus React and TypeScript for web

Reporting to: Engineering Manager / Mobile Lead

Location: Bengaluru (on-site)

About the role

We are building AM@DS, the platform powering the next generation tenant experience and operations system across Divyasree assets. Our web portals and mobile apps are used by tenant employees, technicians, supervisors, facility managers, and visitors inside real buildings. They need to feel quick, clear, reliable, and safe, even when the network is weak. 

This is an early-career, hands-on role for a developer with one to two years of experience who wants to grow into a strong product engineer across web and native mobile. You will work with experienced engineers, product, and design to build features end to end, from a responsive web screen to a native iOS or Android flow. Your primary mobile track may be Swift and SwiftUI or Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, depending on your strengths. 

Why this role exists

The same workflow, such as raising a service request, checking in a visitor, or closing a work order, lives on the web for admins and on a phone for people on the move. Each surface behaves differently. We need someone who cares about those details on both, learns quickly, and enjoys taking a feature all the way to the store and into users' hands. 

What you will work on

- Build and improve native mobile screens and reusable UI components for iOS and/or Android under the guidance of senior engineers. 
 - Build responsive web pages and components for tenant and admin portals using React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Support tenant and field workflows such as request creation, ticket updates, visitor journeys, QR scanning, and proof-of-work photo capture. 
 - Integrate web and mobile screens with REST APIs, and handle loading, empty, error, and retry states clearly. 
 - Implement sign-in and session handling, including token storage, refresh, and logout, using secure platform storage. 
 - Work with device capabilities including camera, files, push notifications, runtime permissions, local storage, and deep links. 
 - Help prepare, test, and publish releases through TestFlight, App Store Connect, and the Google Play Console. 
 - Write unit and UI tests, fix defects, take part in code reviews, and keep CI pipelines green. 
 - Observe how users interact with the product in real buildings and turn feedback into practical improvements. What we are looking for

- A degree or diploma in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent strong self-taught foundation. 
 - One to two years of hands-on experience in web and/or mobile app development, including internships, freelance, or professional work. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one native stack: Swift and SwiftUI for iOS, or Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android. 
 - Experience pushing at least one app to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store, or to TestFlight or a Play internal testing track, is strongly preferred. 
 - Solid understanding of mobile fundamentals: app and screen lifecycle, navigation, state management, and memory and battery awareness. 
 - Comfort with asynchronous programming, such as Swift async/await and Combine, or Kotlin Coroutines and Flow, and JavaScript Promises and async/await. 
 - Practical experience with local storage (SwiftData or Core Data, Room, DataStore or UserDefaults), runtime permissions, and REST API integration. 
 - Understanding of authentication basics, such as OAuth 2. 0 and OpenID Connect, JWT access and refresh tokens, and secure storage in Keychain or Keystore. 
 - Working knowledge of web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript, responsive layouts, and at least one framework such as React. 
 - At least one mobile project that you can demonstrate live and explain in depth. Academic, research, internship, freelance, personal, or professional projects all count. 
 - Basic CI/CD knowledge, such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitrise, or Fastlane, along with comfortable use of Git, branches, and pull requests. 
 - A learning mindset, careful debugging habits, and clear written and spoken communication. Skills and technologies

- iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit basics, async/await, Combine, URLSession, Keychain, SwiftData or Core Data, Xcode, Instruments. 
 - Android: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, ViewModel, Coroutines and Flow, Retrofit or Ktor, Room, DataStore, Hilt, Android Studio. 
 - Web: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React or Next. js, responsive design, browser DevTools, basic accessibility. 
 - APIs and data: REST and JSON, HTTP status codes and caching, pagination, basic GraphQL awareness, Postman. 
 - Auth and security: OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, JWT, biometric sign-in, secure storage, HTTPS, OWASP Mobile Top 10 awareness. 
 - Release and tooling: Git, GitHub or GitLab, CI pipelines, Fastlane, code signing and provisioning profiles, app versioning. 
 - Quality: XCTest, JUnit, Espresso or Compose UI tests, Jest or React Testing Library, crash reporting with Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry. Nice to have

- Exposure to both iOS and Android, or experience with Flutter or React Native alongside a native stack. 
 - Experience with push notifications (APNs, FCM), camera or QR features, background tasks, deep linking, or offline sync. 
 - Familiarity with Firebase, mobile analytics, feature flags, or basic backend work in Node. js, Python, or Kotlin. 
 - Basic knowledge of cloud services on AWS, Azure, or GCP, and of Docker. 
 - Interest in proptech, workplace technology, field-service tools, or operations-heavy products. What success looks like in the first six months

- You understand the web and mobile codebases, development workflow, and product context well enough to deliver small changes with decreasing support. 
 - You ship at least one meaningful user-facing feature on mobile and one on web to a test, pilot, or production environment. 
 - You have taken part in at least one full store release, from build and signing to review and rollout. 
 - Your work handles common states such as poor connectivity, denied permissions, expired sessions, retries, and errors without confusing the user. 
 - You contribute useful tests, documentation, bug fixes, and code-review improvements. How we work

We move fast, we ship, we read what users actually do, and we change course when the evidence tells us to. Early-career engineers here are supported, but they are also trusted with real work. We value curiosity, clear communication, thoughtful questions, code review, and steady improvement over hero mode. 

How to apply

Apply with a short note with a link to one mobile project and, if you have one, a web project or repository. Include a store link or test build if the app was published. Tell us what you built, which parts you personally owned, one challenge you faced, and what you learned. Skip the generic cover letter and show us how you think.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

About GE Vernova

GE Vernova is a purposeful global energy company dedicated to electrifying the world while accelerating the transition to a reliable, sustainable, and carbon-neutral energy grid. At our global HVDC Engineering Centre of Excellence in Stafford, you will join an international team working on game-changing, highly complex transmission projects that shape the future of energy. 

Job Summary

As a Lead Substation Automation Engineer, you will own the end-to-end technical delivery of digital control and protection systems for complex HVDC projects. Operating across New Product Introduction (NPI), requisition (ITO/OTR), and Product Care, you will combine hands-on engineering execution-from IEC 61850 configuration and schematic design to advanced debugging-with technical leadership, mentoring, and driving standardized global processes to ensure strict adherence to cost, schedule, and quality targets. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Design, Implementation and Integration

- Lead project designs and delivery in alignment with customer specifications and internal reference solutions.

data.description:
About Sibros Technologies

Who We Are

Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected PlatformTM that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros' platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond. 

Learn more at www. sibros. tech. 

Our Mission

Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices. 

Follow us on

LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram

About The Role

Job Title: Engineering Manager, Validation

Location: Pune, India (in office)

Experience: 8 to 12 years, including 2 to 4 years managing a validation or test team

Job Type: Full Time

As a Engineering Manager you will lead our Validation team in Pune, which validates every release of the Deep Connected Platform before it reaches customer vehicles: embedded firmware on telematics units and gateways, the cloud platform, and the bundled solutions we deliver to OEMs. You will own release quality from the branch cut to customer delivery. This is a player coach role for someone who wants to manage people and stay close to the technical work, with a strong firmware lean, since that is where most of our hardest problems sit. 

What you'll do

- Lead the Validation Team: Manage, coach, and grow validation engineers and squad leads, setting clear goals and providing regular feedback and career development. 
 - Own Release Validation: Validate every firmware release branch on our biweekly cadence and give a clear go or no go before a release ships to customers. 
 - Grow Test Automation: Expand automated regression on HIL benches, LabCar, and virtual vehicles, wired into CI/CD so each release cut is tested without manual steps. 
 - Drive V Model Validation: Build full V model traceability from customer and product requirements down to test cases and automated runs, define a clear Definition of Done for release validation, and keep validation compliant with Automotive SPICE (SYS. 5 system qualification testing and SWE. 6 software qualification testing). 
 - Lead Stress and Fault Testing: Run end to end black box validation, fault injection, negative scenarios, and multiday endurance and stress tests across virtual vehicles, HIL benches, and cloud interfaces, to catch edge case bugs before customer delivery. 
 - Adhere to Engineering Process Standards: Focus on and enforce compliance with industry engineering process standards, including Automotive SPICE V-model compliance (SYS. 5 System Integration and Integration Testing and SWE. 6 Software Qualification Testing), throughout the validation lifecycle. 
 - Raise Test Quality: Find gaps in test plans and run bug escape analysis so the same class of issue does not reach a customer twice. 
 - Support Customer Programs: Plan validation for OEM releases with Program Management and Solutions, and deliver test reports customers can trust. 
 - Partner Across Functions: Work closely with Firmware, Cloud, and Product teams on testability, triage, and fix verification. 
 - Scale with AI: Bring AI tools into test design, automation, reporting, and analysis, and help the team adopt them in daily work. 

What you should know

- Professional Experience: 8 to 12 years in validation, QA, or test engineering, including 2 to 4 years directly managing a team. 
 - Embedded Validation: Hands on experience validating firmware on real hardware (ECUs, telematics units, or IoT devices), with working knowledge of CAN and vehicle diagnostics (UDS). 
 - HIL and Automation: Experience setting up and running HIL rigs or test benches, and building Python test automation integrated into CI/CD (GitLab or similar). 
 - People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to manage, coach, and grow engineers, including performance conversations and hiring. 
 - Release Ownership: Track record of owning release sign off across several products or customer programs at once without dropping quality. 
 - Communication: Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable representing the team to engineers, program managers, and customers. 
 - On Site in Pune: Based in Pune and working from our office, close to the labs and test benches. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Cloud and API Testing: Experience testing SaaS platforms and REST APIs, to validate end to end from vehicle to cloud. 
 - OTA/Update Systems: Familiarity with over the air update systems or vehicle software management platforms. 
 - Standards Exposure: Familiarity with automotive process and safety standards (e. g. , ASPICE, ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434). 
 - AI in Testing: Experience using AI tools to speed up test design, automation, or analysis. 

What We Offer

- Competitive Compensation: A package inclusive of performance incentives. 
 - Growth Environment: A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and rapid career advancement. 
 - Learning & Development: Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities. 
 - Work-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and a culture that promotes balance. 
 - Comprehensive Benefits: Health insurance and wellness programs. 
 - Modern Policy: Flexible vacation and paid time off, you decide when you need a break. 
 - Team Culture: Regular team events, off-sites, and a budget for online courses, books, and conferences.

Minimum Qualifications: Bachelors in Computer Science, Engineering or similar

Location: Nariman Point, Mumbai

Timings: 10am - 7pm; Monday to Friday

Work Type: On-Site, 5 days a week

Company Description: 

PaisaSmart is the operating brand name for Elixir Equities Pvt. Ltd. (EEPL), a financial services firm with operations in Prop Trading, Stock Broking, Portfolio Management & Mutual Fund distribution, and over 20 years in wealth management under founders who are recognised industry leaders. 

Our mission is to build wealth for the next 100m Indians. PaisaSmart is how - a WhatsApp chatbot and an Android/iOS app that make investing simple for people who have never invested. 

We ship fast. We work under broker, RA, PMS and MFD licences, so we ship fast without being careless with other people's money - doing both is the actual job. 

Our values are humility, curiosity and passion. Socials: YT | Insta | LinkedIn. Try the product: message 8808990978 on WhatsApp. 

Application Process: 

- Apply on our site. Screening happens immediately by our AI agent, no waiting immediate pass/fail. 
 - One day of in-person interviews at our offices (you select a date & time) with the founder and team. 
 - If we like you we make a decision immediately and share an offer. 

What You'll Own: 

- The Chatbot and Agentic Backend: Some of the services behind our WhatsApp chatbot and our mobile app. Conversation state, tool calls, LLM integrations and the structured responses users see are yours to build and improve. 
 - Your Own Microservices: Two or three services, yours from design to production from the first month. You decide how they are built and you answer for how they run. 
 - The Data Layer: Schema and query design across ScyllaDB, PostgreSQL and Redis, including the concurrency problems that appear when several services write the same record. 
 - Production: You deploy your services to Kubernetes on AWS, and you read the logs, metrics and traces when they misbehave. 

How We Work: 

- Small team, highly collaborative but individual responsibilities. Growth isn't gated on tenure. If you can do the next job, you get it. 
 - You work directly with the founder. No layer in between, nobody to hide behind. No office politics, no blame games, direct visibility. 
 - High responsibility, high level of freedom, minimal guidance. Find a problem, design a solution, fix it. You own your work end to end, including when something goes wrong at 9pm. 
 - If you're right you're right. No hierarchy, no "do it cause the boss said so". Best argument wins, regardless of who made it. 
 - Everyone is expected to do 2-3 different tasks. With AI tooling enabling us to learn and do more than ever before come in with one core skillset and learn & apply 1-2 completely new skills with us. 

Who This Is For: 

- You teach yourself things nobody assigned you. 
 - The problem is clear, the solution isn't, and that excites you. 
 - You want real responsibility and opportunity to make an impact immediately. 

Who It Isn't For: 

- You want a defined ladder and a manager who assigns your work. 
 - You want remote or hybrid. This is on-site, five days, and we're not flexible. 
 - You'd rather specialise narrowly than learn new things. 

Requirements: 

Be strong on the backend fundamentals and show us evidence of curiosity on the rest - we'll teach you what's missing. 

- 1 - 3 years building Python backend services that ran in production with real users. 
 - Strong object-oriented design and typed Python. FastAPI and Pydantic, or equivalent. 
 - You have designed a schema in both a SQL and a NoSQL database and can explain why each fit. 
 - You have built something on LLM APIs or agent tooling - at work or on your own - and can explain where it broke. 
 - You have debugged a production issue from the logs to the fix. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD. Kubernetes is a plus. 
 - You have worked on a product your company shipped to its own users, not a client's project built to someone else's requirements. 

Compensation:

Our Professional Services team partners with customers worldwide to implement, extend, and optimize Guidewire's industry-leading cloud platform for P&C insurers.
