You will bring strong JavaScript automation skills, CI/CD experience, and a passion for robust engineering practices to reduce manual effort and accelerate releases. You will collaborate closely with developers, DevOps, and project teams, mentoring others and using automation and AI to cut implementation effort and time in line with Professional Services' transformation goals. 

Job Description

What you'll do

- Design, implement, and maintain scalable UI automation frameworks for Guidewire applications using TestCafe (hybrid, data‐driven, modular), JavaScript, JSON-based test data, and custom HTML reporting. 
 - Define and drive the automation strategy for Professional Services projects, aligning test coverage, quality goals, and execution priorities with PS's mission to reduce implementation effort. 
 - Develop, review, and optimize robust automation scripts (primarily JavaScript) that validate complex, Gherkin/BDD-style requirements, ensuring reusability, maintainability, and adherence to coding standards. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, TeamCity) so suites run reliably from the CI server, supporting faster, safer cloud releases for customer programs. 
 - Use tools such as Ignite to generate and refine Page Objects, and write custom JavaScript functions to cover sophisticated end‐to‐end and regression scenarios across web and API layers. 
 - Execute and debug automation runs, distinguish application defects from script issues, and proactively fix and refactor flaky tests to keep the automation suite stable over time. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers, architects, DevOps, and Professional Services project teams to plan test effort, estimate automation scope, and provide clear quality and defect insights using tools such as JIRA and test reporting frameworks. 
 - Mentor and up-skill junior QA engineers and partner teams on automation best practices, contributing to PS's broader AI- and automation-enabled methodology and knowledge sharing. 
 - At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI-empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes. 

Required

What you'll bring

- Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement. 
 - 7+ years of overall QA experience with at least 3 years leading automation initiatives or acting as a senior automation engineer on complex projects. 
 - Strong programming skills in JavaScript and experience building or extending test automation frameworks (UI and ideally API), including data-driven and modular architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one modern automation toolset such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or Appium, and willingness to primarily work with TestCafe for UI test automation. 
 - Practical experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, TeamCity, Azure DevOps) and working with Git/Bitbucket for version control and code review. 
 - Ability to interpret BDD/Gherkin-style requirements and translate them into robust, maintainable automated test suites. 
 - Experience with test reporting and defect tracking using tools such as JIRA and test reporting libraries, providing clear, actionable quality metrics. 
 - Strong collaboration, communication, and mentoring skills, with experience working in cross-functional, globally distributed teams. 

Preferred

- Experience in Professional Services, consulting, or customer-facing project delivery environments, ideally in a SaaS or cloud context. 
 - Exposure to P&C insurance or financial services domains, or a strong interest in developing deep insurance domain expertise as part of this role. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and running automation suites in containerized or cloud-native environments (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Background in performance, reliability, or non-functional testing in addition to functional automation. 
 - Experience contributing to test strategy, effort estimation, and quality risk assessment for large-scale programs. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Your Impact

We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will learn Guidewire's product ecosystem and Professional Services delivery model, deepen your understanding of P&C insurance workflows, and take ownership of the automation framework and strategy for one or more customer implementation projects. You'll streamline and stabilize our automated regression and end‐to‐end suites, integrate them into CI/CD, and help teams reduce manual testing effort while increasing coverage and confidence in each release. As you mature in the role, your work will directly support Professional Services' FY26 priorities-using AI and automation to reduce implementation effort and time, accelerate cloud adoption, and ensure every customer is successful and referenceable-contributing to Guidewire's broader mission to transform how the world's P&C insurers do business through secure, AI‐enabled cloud solutions. 

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire. 

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation. 

For more information, please visit www. guidewire. com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC. 

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position. 

Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. data.title: C++ | Low-Latency Trading Systems | Manager level | Mumbai
data.description:
Markets move in microseconds. We're building the systems that keep pace. 

We're hiring hands-on C++ engineers to join our Technology team and build low-latency software for a high-throughput trading environment. This is an engineering-first leadership role. You'll spend most of your time designing and writing performance-critical code, and the rest mentoring developers and driving delivery. 

Two levels open

- Assistant Manager | 6-8 years | ~85-90% hands-on coding, ~10-15% mentoring. Ideal for a strong systems engineer stepping into a first leadership role. 
 - Manager | 8-10 years | ~70-80% hands-on coding, ~20-30% leading a pod of 3-4 developers, reviews and sprint execution. 

What you'll do

- Write clean, ultra-fast systems code in Modern C++ (17/20) for market connectivity, market data normalization, pre-trade risk checks and execution routing
 - Apply low-latency principles: custom memory pools, object pools and placement new, with zero heap allocation on critical paths
 - Build high-speed IPC using shared memory and lock-free queues and ring buffers
 - Implement deterministic multi-threading with atomics and CPU thread affinity
 - Use template metaprogramming to build zero-overhead, compile-time abstractions
 - Build custom data structures, binary parsing and bitwise packing, and design MySQL schemas for transaction logs, reference data and audit trails
 - Implement exchange protocols (FIX, ITCH, OUCH, SBE), order lifecycles and matching-engine communication
 - Own modules end to end, run peer code reviews, and bring profiling and benchmarking (Valgrind, perf, gprof, Google Benchmark) into the workflow to catch regressions early. 

What we're looking for

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT or a quantitative discipline
 - Assistant Manager: 5-8 years of production C++ systems programming, with a track record of mentoring or feature ownership
 - Manager: 6+ years in systems-level development, including 2+ years as a team lead
 - Mastery of C++ and the STL, including pointers, manual memory management and RAII
 - Strong grasp of concurrency, lock-free design and avoiding race conditions, deadlocks and contention
 - Solid understanding of CPU cache hierarchies, mmap and branch prediction
 - Strong DSA fundamentals and MySQL indexing skills
 - Big plus: exposure to HFT infrastructure, proprietary trading, market data handlers, exchange gateways or core fintech systems. 

Why join us

- Work on microsecond-sensitive systems at the core of a leading trading platform
 - A role where you stay deeply technical while growing into leadership
 - Real ownership of modules and design decisions

Interested? Write to us at Rukmini@careerxperts. com

data.title: QA Manager
data.description:
Joining Arup

Arup's purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world. 

Our team (https: //dyna. oasys-software. com/) supports Arup's longstanding commitment to improve the world by developing market-leading tools that enable us and our clients to develop solutions tackling the most challenging engineering problems. Our Oasys LS-DYNA Environment software is used in the automotive, nuclear, aerospace and civil engineering communities. One of its primary uses is the modelling and testing of vehicle crashworthiness, but it is also used to simulate design-critical scenarios in aerospace, seismic, nuclear, geotechnical, structural, and product design applications. 

About The Role

Arup Digital Products (ADP) are seeking an experienced Senior QA Manager to lead our Quality Assurance team and drive excellence in software quality. You will be responsible for shaping QA strategy, building scalable testing frameworks, and ensuring our products meet the highest standards of reliability, performance, and usability. This role requires strong leadership, deep technical expertise, and a passion for process improvement in a fast-paced Agile environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop ADP's QA Strategy: In conjunction with other functional heads and senior engineers, develop and implement a comprehensive QA strategy aligned with the company's values and the team's product and engineering goals. 
 - Team Development: Responsible for growing our QA capabilities to support the wider Oasys LS-DYNA engineering team, which currently has over 60 developers. 
 - Team Leadership: Manage, mentor, and grow a high-performing QA team (covering manual and automated tests) able to support both desktop and web-based solutions. 
 - Test Automation Oversight: Guide the design, development, and maintenance of robust automated test frameworks for APIs, front-end, back-end, desktop and mobile[SV3] [DC4] platforms. 
 - Test Management Platform: Evaluate, introduce, and embed a dedicated test management platform to support structured test planning, traceability, and reporting across the QA team. 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, DevOps, Technical Specialist, Delivery and Development teams to ensure early and continuous quality involvement across the SDLC. 
 - Cross-regional Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues spread across different regions, including Europe, Asia, and North America. 
 - Release Quality Management: Own quality gates and sign-off for production releases. 
 - Metrics & Reporting: Define QA KPIs, track defect trends, test coverage, and provide insights to stakeholders on software quality. 
 - Risk Management: Proactively identify quality risks and drive timely mitigation plans. 
 - Process Optimisation: Establish and enforce best practices in testing, CI/CD integration, and quality gates. 
 - Tooling & Infrastructure: Evaluate and implement modern QA tools, frameworks, and test data management solutions. 
 - Wider Contribution: Engage with other duties as required, including supporting the customer facing Support Team, contributing to technical documentation, and engaging with clients and partners as needed to support testing activities. 

Is this role right for you?

- 8+ years of experience in software QA, with at least 3 years in a QA leadership role. 
 - Strong expertise in both manual and automated testing. 
 - Proven experience leading Agile/DevOps QA practices in modern SDLC environments. 
 - Experience with desktop application testing tools and frameworks, such as Google Test, pywinauto, pytest, or similar. 
 - Experience with web and API test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or similar. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jira, Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Docker) and cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure). 
 - Familiarity with performance, security, and accessibility testing (e. g. , OWASP testing guidelines, ISO 27001 compliance, WCAG accessibility standards). 
 - Experience with performance testing tools (e. g. k6, Locust). 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

Desirable Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - ISTQB or equivalent QA certification. 
 - Experience with engineering software. 
 - Experience with BDD frameworks like Cucumber. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML-driven testing tools or techniques. 

Reward And Benefits

We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm's financial performance

Different people, shared values

At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world. 

At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here. 

At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application. 

At Arup, we appreciate that everyone's circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role. 

To understand what to expect next, please visit https: //www. arup. com/careers/recruitment-process/

Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process. 

Recruitment Agencies - We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer Lead who is hands-on in engineering quality into the product lifecycle - building scalable automation, driving strong testing strategy, and partnering closely with engineering teams across the SDLC. This role is centered on writing and maintaining automation code, frameworks, and pipelines yourself, while also providing technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers on the team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.

Languages

- Fluent English (spoken and written). 

Experience And Skills

 - Strong experience managing testing across SAP and non-SAP systems in enterprise environments.

 - Proven background in test management activities

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Manager - Product Engineering

Experience-10-15 years

Leadership-3+ years

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Manager - Product Engineering to lead the design, development and production delivery of enterprise digital products. The role combines engineering leadership, architecture awareness, Agile delivery and people management. The candidate will translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions, establish engineering standards and ensure predictable, secure and high-quality releases. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end engineering execution from solution design and backlog refinement through development, testing, deployment and production support. 
 - Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, architects and business stakeholders to translate product goals into technical roadmaps, epics and release plans. 
 - Lead engineering teams across application development, APIs, integration, data, cloud, DevSecOps and quality engineering. 
 - Guide architecture and design decisions for modular applications, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven integration and cloud-native platforms. 
 - Establish coding, review, testing, documentation, security, observability and Definition of Done standards. 
 - Drive sprint planning, estimation, dependency management, release readiness and delivery-risk mitigation. 
 - Implement CI/CD, automated quality gates, Infrastructure as Code and repeatable deployment practices. 
 - Maintain a prioritized technical-debt backlog and drive modernization, refactoring, performance and reliability improvements. 
 - Conduct design and code reviews, mentor engineers, support recruitment and build team capability and accountability. 
 - Monitor delivery, quality and operational metrics and communicate engineering status, trade-offs and risks to leadership. 

Required Technical Skills

Capability

- Architecture
 - Engineering
 - Cloud
 - Containers
 - DevSecOps
 - Data and Integration
 - Quality and Operations
 - AI Enablement

Expected Expertise

- Microservices, modular architecture, APIs, event-driven integration and distributed systems
 - Java, C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or comparable enterprise technology stacks
 - Microsoft Azure preferred; AWS or Google Cloud experience beneficial
 - Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native deployment patterns
 - GitHub or Azure DevOps, CI/CD, SonarQube, security scanning and Terraform or equivalent IaC
 - SQL/NoSQL, data integration, messaging, API management and enterprise integration patterns
 - Unit/API/integration testing, observability, logs, metrics, traces, incident management and production support
 - AI-assisted development with GitHub Copilot or similar tools; awareness of GenAI product integration is preferred

Mandatory Qualifications

- 10+ years of software or product engineering experience, including 3+ years leading engineering teams. 
 - Proven delivery of enterprise applications or digital products from design through production rollout. 
 - Strong technical understanding of application architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, DevSecOps and software quality. 
 - Experience managing teams of approximately 8-20 engineers across one or more Agile squads. 
 - Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery, backlog planning, estimation, engineering metrics and release governance. 
 - Strong stakeholder communication, problem solving, mentoring and delivery-management skills. 

Good to Have

- Enterprise SaaS, platform engineering, legacy modernization or monolith-to-microservices transformation experience. 
 - Generative AI, RAG, agentic AI, data platforms or AI-enabled product engineering exposure. 
 - Experience in utilities, financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail or other regulated industries. 
 - Microsoft Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, SAFe, Scrum or engineering-leadership certifications. 

Success Measures

- Sprint and release predictability
 - Lead time for change
 - Deployment frequency
 - Escaped defects
 - Automated test coverage
 - Quality and security-gate compliance
 - Production availability and MTTR
 - Technical-debt reduction
 - Engineering productivity
 - Team capability and retention

Ideal Candidate

A product-minded engineering manager with hands-on technical credibility who can guide design decisions, improve engineering discipline, develop people and remain accountable for reliable product delivery. The candidate should balance customer value, delivery commitments, architecture health, security, quality and maintainability. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Principal Software Architect – Medical Devices (Linux / C++)
data.description:
We are seeking a hands-on Principal Software Architect / Technical Architect with 8+ years of experience to lead the software architecture and core technical development of this offline, Linux-based platform. Bridging high-performance systems engineering with structured software lifecycle and compliance practices, you will architect real-time, multithreaded C++ applications, drive hardware and SDK integration, and ensure software design, architecture, and verification artifacts align with IEC 62304 and FDA 510(k) expectations. Prior regulated medical device or surgical/imaging experience is a strong plus, though strong systems architects with the core technical stack are welcome. 

Key Responsibilities

- System & Software Architecture (Linux / C++ / Qt 6 / Python): Define, document, and own the end-to-end architecture for a 100% offline Linux system, ensuring deterministic performance, clean module boundaries across C++, Qt 6, and Python, and maintainable code. 
 - Real-Time & Multithreaded Engineering: Architect and develop low-latency, multithreaded C++ pipelines for real-time tracking/registration, spatial/imaging data processing, and responsive operator workflows. 
 - Camera SDK, Hardware & Offline Exchange Integration: Lead integration of external camera/tracking SDKs, sensor/hardware interfaces, AI segmentation model pipelines, and encrypted USB case-file transfer workflows. 
 - Software Lifecycle & Design Controls (IEC 62304): Author and maintain core technical design-control deliverables-including Software Requirements Specifications (SRS), Software Architecture Documents (SAD), and Detailed Design Specifications-aligned with IEC 62304 (Class B/C), ISO 13485, and FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR. 
 - SOUP, SBOM & Cybersecurity Architecture: Own the technical assessment of Software of Unknown Provenance (SOUP), third-party/camera SDKs, AI libraries, and Linux OS dependencies. Maintain Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) and implement threat modeling and offline security/integrity controls (such as AAMI TIR57) at the architectural level. 
 - Risk Management & V&V Alignment: Partner with Systems, QA, and Regulatory teams to translate risk mitigations (aligned with ISO 14971) into software architectural controls, establish end-to-end requirements-to-test traceability, and review unit, integration, and system-level V&V strategies. 
 - Technical Leadership & Code Governance: Conduct architectural and code reviews across C++, Qt 6, and Python codebases, enforcing coding standards, static analysis, and configuration/change control practices to keep engineering outputs audit- and submission-ready. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with proven leadership as a Software Architect, Technical Architect, or Principal Engineer. 
 - Core Tech Stack: Expert-level proficiency in modern C++ (C++14/17/20), strong fluency in Python (for tooling, integration, prototyping, or test harnesses), familiarity with Qt 6 or modern UI/application layers, and deep system-level experience developing on Linux (processes/IPC, threading, hardware/SDK integration, build systems). 
 - Concurrency & Real-Time Systems: Extensive hands-on experience designing multithreaded, concurrent, and real-time software architectures with strict latency and determinism requirements. 
 - Hardware / SDK Integration: Demonstrated track record integrating cameras, tracking/sensing SDKs, or electromechanical/robotic hardware within real-time or high-throughput systems. 
 - Lifecycle & Compliance Standards: Working knowledge of IEC 62304 software lifecycle processes, risk management, SOUP/SBOM management, and FDA 510(k) / QMSR technical documentation expectations (or readiness to apply them in a regulated build). 
 - Engineering Tooling: Experience with modern CI/CD, static analysis, and requirements traceability tools. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience taking at least one Class II or Class III medical device through FDA 510(k) clearance (specifically aligned with FDA's 2023 Premarket Software Documentation guidance). 
 - Prior domain experience in surgical navigation, medical robotics, image-guided systems, or medical imaging. 
 - Experience with AI/ML-enabled medical devices, Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP), or imaging/spatial pipelines (e. g. , segmentation workflows, CUDA, OpenCV, VTK/ITK). 
 - Familiarity with IEC 60601-1 (medical electrical equipment safety), IEC 62366-1 (usability engineering), and AAMI TIR45 (Agile in medical device development).

data.description:
Role Title: AVP, Solution Architect (L11)

Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organization Overview

Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards. 

The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills - A simple process that we all are used to on a day-to-day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year. 

Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be. 

Role Summary/Purpose

AVP, Solution Architect will be responsible for development and support of Web based digital applications and delivering high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate would be part of a major technology transformation team responsible for moving towards cloud platform in micro services architecture using Spring Frameworks, in memory data grid, micro-front ends, React JS, responsive design etc leveraging latest AI tools and capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end architecture and technical direction for full stack web applications (UI, APIs, services, and data), aligning solutions to business goals and enterprise standards. 
 - Translate business and non-functional requirements into target architecture, detailed solution designs (HLD/LLD), and delivery roadmaps. 
 - Define front-end and back-end architecture patterns: React application structure, state management, Micro-Frontend strategy (where applicable), and Java/Spring Boot service design (layering, APIs, integrations). 
 - Design secure and scalable integrations (REST/event-driven), including authentication/authorization patterns (SSO/OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), API gateways, and data flows. 
 - Establish architecture guardrails and engineering standards (coding practices, API standards, error handling, logging, observability, performance, accessibility) and ensure adoption through reviews and governance. 
 - Guide teams on performance, resiliency, availability, and operational readiness (SLOs/SLAs, monitoring/alerting, capacity planning, DR). 
 - Drive technical risk management: identify dependencies, highlight gaps early, and propose mitigation/migration strategies (modernization, refactoring, tech debt reduction). 
 - Collaborate with product and delivery leadership on estimation inputs, sequencing, and release planning; support teams through complex technical decisions and trade-offs. 
 - Mentor engineers across the stack (Synchrony and vendor), promoting reusable components, reference implementations, and consistent patterns. 
 - Communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs to stakeholders; document decisions using ADRs and maintain architecture artifacts.

data.title: Staff Compiler Performance Engineer
data.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM. 

We are looking for a Staff Compiler Performance Engineer to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap. 

You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams. 

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

- Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmap

- Lead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collector

- Make architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategy

- Lead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul products

- Mentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validation

- Represent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilers

What You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)

- 8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers

- Track record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in production

- Expert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebases

- Deep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code size

- Expert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture level

Nice to Have

- Recognized contributions to LLVM or another major compiler: code owner, maintainer or author of significant upstream work

- Deep experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, . NET RyuJIT or similar

- Experience working closely with runtime and GC teams on speculation, deoptimization and barrier design

The Legion application is a high-performance, data-driven Java enterprise application that implements sophisticated scheduling and optimization algorithms. It also provides the necessary endpoints for our Web and mobile frontend applications.

As a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer, you will be a member of the team responsible for the implementation and evolution of this application.  - Own the performance of what you build: diagnose slow queries, memory pressure, and large data imports/exports, and fix them at the root cause. 
 - Keep backend and UI behavior consistent - the API contract, validation, and what the user sees must agree. 
 - Write unit and integration tests, review peers' code, and hold a high bar on quality and maintainability. 
 - Write technical design documents for non-trivial changes and break them into incremental, shippable pieces.

The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It's proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. 

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. 

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3, 200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion's mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion's Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today's hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. 

For more information, visit https: //legion. co

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws. 

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion. co

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @legion. co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion. co

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. 

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant's location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay. 

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy ("Policy") describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. ("Legion", "we", "us" and "our") collects, uses, and discloses "personal information" as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California. 

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies. 

- Types of Personal Information We Handle

We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes: 

- Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts. 
 - Professional or employment-related information, including: 
 - Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver's licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references. 
 - Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships
 - Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information. 
 - Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history. 
 - Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application. 
 - How We Use Personal Information

We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers' business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions. 

- With Whom We Share Personal Information

We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable): 

- Internally: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process. 
 - Vendors: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable. 
 - Legal Compliance: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency. 
 - Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party. 
 - Business Transaction Purposes: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.

data.title: Software Engineer II - Product Data Gateway
data.description:
About The Role

At Abnormal AI, we are on a thrilling mission to safeguard the world's largest enterprises against a vast range of relentless email and collaboration application cyber security attacks. Our relentless pursuit involves crafting an exceptional suite of products that empowers customers to seamlessly visualize, expertly control, and fearlessly combat cyber-security threats. 

The Multi-Product Platform (MPP) organization owns the product platform that enables scalable product development, helping the business build and launch enterprise-grade products with a consistent customer experience. 

This is a chance to build the data backbone that every Abnormal product depends on. As a Software Engineer on MPP, you'll create the standardised data layer that becomes our single source of truth - the one governed path through which any system, agent, or interface can reach data from across every product, from a single record to cross-product aggregates, online or offline, in whatever shape it needs. It's a genuinely hard, high-leverage problem: the layer has to serve the entire platform at high throughput and low latency without ever becoming the bottleneck, while enforcing tenant isolation, authentication, and fine-grained access control so every team inherits strong security and reliability for free. You won't be maintaining someone else's system - you'll be defining the foundation every product is built on, where getting it right compounds across the whole company. 

If you're energized by 0→1 platform work, driving cross-team standards, and owning a system end-to-end, this role is built for you. 

What You'll Do

Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Design, build, and iterate on the APIs and services that make up the standardized data access layer. 
 - Drive adoption of API-gated data sources, so product teams expose their data once and every consuming surface can reuse it, instead of building one-off integrations. 
 - Design and implement standard labeling for data ownership, and build the validation logic that checks incoming requests against it. 
 - Own the reliability and stability of the components and features you build. 
 - Contribute to the team's architectural decisions, and write technical design documents for the areas you own. 
 - Participate in regular code and design reviews as well as the team-wide on-call rotation. 
 - Write code with testability, readability, edge cases, and errors in mind. 

Teamwork & Collaboration

- Communicate effectively in an asynchronous manner with team members to provide updates, discuss challenges, and propose solutions. 
 - Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams as they adopt the shared data layer. 
 - Take ownership of projects and act as a driver who adds instant adrenaline and drives positive impact when placed on projects and teams. 
 - Participate in team roadmap discussions. 
 - Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and participate in professional development activities. 

Must Have Skills

- Software Engineer with 4+ years of industry experience and strong software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Growth-oriented, looking to increase impact, responsibility, and ownership over time. 
 - Proven ability to own complex problems and multi-component features end-to-end, with a growing ability to collaborate and influence across teams. 
 - Strong experience writing production code in Python and/or Golang, and working with SQL and NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience with system design and building reliable, scalable applications with an emphasis on operational excellence. 
 - Detail-driven, and care about code quality, testing, and performance. 
 - Ability to make practical trade-offs - evaluating multiple approaches and selecting the one that best balances customer impact, system complexity, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Able to write technical design documents and contribute to design and architecture reviews. 
 - Strong understanding of service health, monitoring, fault tolerance, and incident response practices. 
 - Strong communication skills and proven ability to work autonomously and asynchronously with remote collaborators and stakeholders. 
 - Shares knowledge with teammates and helps establish team-level patterns and best practices. 

Nice to Have Skills

- Experience designing or building data access layers, APIs, or platforms that other engineering teams build on top of. 
 - Experience treating an internal platform as a product - building for other engineering teams as your customers. 
 - Familiarity with ChatGPT, Cursor, and other GenAI productivity tools. 
 - Big Data platform usage is a plus. 

A note on AI in our process: 

Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore. They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. 

Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here. If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here.

data.title: Software Engineer- l2, L3 forwarding, C/C ++, IOS XR 4 to 8 years
data.description:
Meet the team

Join Cisco's Service Provider Networking team, where software and forwarding hardware work together to move traffic across some of the world's largest networks. The team builds high-performance IOS XR forwarding capabilities, giving you the opportunity to solve real networking challenges and contribute to technology used by service providers globally. As a Software engineer, you will design, implement, test, and troubleshoot defined forwarding features, working closely with senior engineers and partner teams across software and hardware. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain production C/C++ software for IOS XR L2/L3 forwarding. 
 - Implement or enhance features in areas such as packet classification, route and label handling, ACLs, QoS, mirroring, OAM, tunnels, and slow path processing. 
 - Work with service provider technologies such as EVPN, VPLS, MPLS, Segment Routing, SRv6, IPv4, and IPv6, based on team priorities. 
 - Translate feature requirements into code, tests, and technical documentation. 
 - Investigate defects using logs, traces, packet captures, core files, and test results; implement fixes and verify them. 
 - Develop unit, integration, and regression tests, and use Python or other scripting to automate development and validation tasks. 
 - Collaborate with protocol, IOS XR platform, hardware/NPU, and system test teams through feature integration and defect resolution. 
 - Use approved AI tools regularly to assist with code exploration, implementation, test creation, debugging, and documentation; review and validate AI-generated output. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Suggested 4-7 years of relevant software development experience and a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong programming skills in C or C++, with experience contributing to production software. 
 - Scripting experience, preferably Perl, Python. 
 - Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, packet forwarding, and L2/L3 concepts. 
 - Familiarity with Linux/UNIX development, debugging, testing, source control, and code review. 
 - Practical use of AI tools in engineering work, with the ability to evaluate and verify their output. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Exposure to EVPN, VPLS, MPLS, Segment Routing, SRv6, QoS, ACLs, BFD, GRE, or related technologies. 
 - Familiarity with NPU/ASIC-based forwarding, hardware SDKs, performance analysis, or embedded system debugging. 
 - Experience with tools such as GDB, Valgrind, packet analyzers, or traffic generators. 

Success in the role

Success means delivering well-tested forwarding features and fixes, meeting agreed quality and performance targets, resolving defects effectively, and taking increasing ownership of a defined feature area. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

data.title: Lead AI QA Engineer
data.description:
Join our India Tech Hub - Be among the first hires!

Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world's most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty. 

About The Team And What We Will Build Together

We're looking for an Lead AI QA Engineer with 6+ years of experience who thrives on designing test strategies and evaluation harnesses for production-grade, agentic AI systems in addition to experience in ETL. You have strong Python skills, hands-on experience testing LLM-powered features (prompt regression, tool/function-call validation, RAG correctness, and structured-output schema checks), and working knowledge of evaluation frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith or Langfuse. You are comfortable writing solid SQL, automating tests with PyTest, exercising APIs through Postman or REST clients, and shipping test pipelines using Git, Docker and CI tooling like Jenkins or GitHub Actions. 

Kobie runs some of the largest loyalty programs in the world. We are building an internal agent platform on Dataiku that automates analyst workflows, surfaces insights from program data in Snowflake, and gives our teams an LLM-native way to work with complex loyalty logic. As an Lead AI QA Engineer on the India Tech Hub team, you will play a key role in protecting that platform - designing golden datasets, running LLM-as-judge and regression suites, and owning the quality bar for what goes to production. This is not a manual-only role: you will automate, build qa & automation strategies, roadmaps, instrument, monitor and partner closely with our U. S. AI & Innovation team and cross-functional partners across Engineering, Data, AI and Product. 

How You Will Make An Impact

- Design and build evaluation harnesses for agentic systems in Python - golden datasets, LLM-as-judge graders, multi-turn regression suites and trace-based assertions. In addition, develop framework to verify generated AI output. 
 - Author automated test suites for prompts, tools, structured outputs (Pydantic / JSON schema), retrieval pipelines (ETL Experience) and end-to-end agent workflows 
 - Validate guardrails around tool execution: auth scoping, input/output validation, PII and prompt-injection protections, and hallucination mitigation 
 - Wire evaluations into CI using Dataiku Evaluations, GitHub Actions or Jenkins so every change is graded against quality, safety and cost SLOs before it ships 
 - Build observability into testing by instrumenting traces with LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow or OpenTelemetry and triaging production drift back into the eval harness 
 - Own quality end-to-end - define release criteria, run pre-prod and shadow tests, and partner with engineering to root-cause and fix regressions quickly 
 - Partner with data engineers on Snowflake-backed retrieval testing patterns (Cortex Analyst and Cortex Search Services) and with platform teams on observability, security and cost 
 - Help shape internal QA standards for AI & Data engineering as the stack evolves, contributing to design reviews and sharing knowledge across the India and U. S. teams 
 - Participate in a collaborative DevOps environment, working closely with developers, AI engineers, Data Engineers, DBAs and product partners across environments

In your first 90 days

By the end of your first 90 days, you will have stood up at least one production-grade evaluation harness - golden dataset, LLM-as-judge graders and regression suite - wired into CI for an internal agent. You will have automated trace-based assertions running against staging traffic, a clear quality scorecard for at least one shipped agent, and a clear opinion about what our next testing investment should be. 

What You Need To Be Successful

- 3+ years of professional QA / SDET experience, with production experience automating tests for backend services or data pipelines 
 - 1+ years of hands-on experience testing LLM or AI features in production: prompt regression, tool / function-call validation, structured outputs and RAG correctness 
 - Working knowledge of evaluation frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse or comparable LLM-as-judge tooling 
 - Strong Python and PyTest skills; solid SQL skills and comfort with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) 
 - Fluency with Git, Docker, REST APIs and at least one CI tool (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or CircleCI) 
 - Solid understanding of data security and responsible AI practices, particularly in PCI-compliant or regulated environments 
 - Proven ability to work independently and within a team, managing priorities across concurrent projects and time zones 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
 - A bachelor's degree is not required - equivalent practical experience (including bootcamps, self-taught work, career changes or non-CS technical degrees) counts 
 - Bonus Skills: 
 - Hands-on experience with Dataiku DSS (Python / SQL recipes, scenarios, code environments, the dataiku and dataikuapi clients) or Dataiku Evaluations 
 - Experience with Dataiku LLM Mesh, Knowledge Banks, Prompt Studio, or Visual / Code Agents 
 - Experience with Snowflake, Snowpark, or Snowflake Cortex (Search, Analyst, Agents) 
 - Experience with red-teaming, prompt-injection testing or adversarial test generation for LLMs 
 - Familiarity with multi-agent patterns: supervisor / router, subagent / handoff, reflection, human-in-the-loop 
 - Experience with performance and load testing tools such as Locust, JMeter or k6 
 - ISTQB, AI Testing or comparable QA certification 
 - Experience in loyalty, martech, adtech or a comparable data-rich B2B domain

About Kobie

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We're always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. 

As a trusted partner to some of the world's most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special. 

We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard. 

Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie, through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities. 

To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. About Birdeye Inc. 

Birdeye builds AI coworkers for multi-location brands. Jay for marketing, Myna for operations, and Robin for customer experience orchestrate AI agents to win AI visibility, book appointments, and drive consistent CX at every location. They run on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3, 000+ integrations. BirdAI consolidates every signal, reasons with industry, brand and location context, and acts autonomously or with a human in the loop. 

Birdeye is trusted by the world's largest multi-location brands across healthcare, dental, restaurants, financial services, auto, retail, and property management. G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye. com. 

What You'll Own

Agents that log into real third-party sites (Facebook, GBP, CRMs) and take real actions on a customer's behalf, wherever no official API exists - a backend pipeline through to the approval UI a human clicks before anything goes live. 

What You'll Do

- Job-dispatch pipeline: dispatch/poll/stall-detection (by activity gaps, not elapsed time) and safe retries
 - 2FA/human-in-the-loop checkpoints: live browser handoff + auto-resume, built conservatively (we've shipped and fixed two real bugs here: a runaway auto-resume loop, a stale session retrying a dead login)
 - Credential handling: domain-locked secret injection, secrets never reach the LLM's own context or logs
 - An independent "judge" layer that verifies what an agent actually did, not what it claims - plus real cost/quality calls across models (cheapest model measured was also the most reliable; a flagship model got lost and cost 10-20x more)
 - REST API design (FastAPI/async Python) usable by both the UI and another agent calling it directly
 - New connectors: task instructions, judge criteria, guardrails (exact-text guarantees, draft-vs-commit gating)
 - The React/TypeScript "Command Center" UI: pending-action feed, job status, 2FA-resume flows
 - Debugging from actual traces/logs, not the agent's own summary

What You Bring

- Strong async Python (asyncio, polling/retry, race conditions) + FastAPI
 - Real React/TypeScript experience (async state, not static UI)
 - Hands-on CDP/Playwright/Puppeteer - know the difference between closing a browser and disconnecting a remote debug client
 - Production LLM-agent experience: task/prompt engineering + building verification layers that don't just trust the agent
 - Security mindset: understands credential custody (not just API keys), ToS risk of automating third-party logins, defaults to the safer design

data.title: Compiler Performance Engineer
data.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM. 

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator. 

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance. 

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

- Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler

- Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime

- Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64

- Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions

- Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

- 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering

- Strong C++ design and coding skills

- Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations

- Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

- Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8

- Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler

- Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

- Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals

- MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

data.title: Senior Compiler Performance Engineer
data.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM. 

We are looking for a Senior Compiler Performance Engineer to own major performance areas of Falcon. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. Your job is to push its generated code further, deciding which optimizations matter, designing them and delivering measurable speedups on real workloads. 

You will work in a distributed team of compiler experts, with direct influence on what Falcon optimizes next. 

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

- Own performance of Falcon for a set of workloads or an optimization area end to end: analysis, design, implementation, validation

- Design and implement new optimizations and improve existing ones in the middle end and back end: inlining heuristics, loop optimizations, vectorization, escape analysis, speculation and deoptimization, GC barrier and runtime call optimization

- Drive code generation quality on x86_64 and AArch64, including bringing Falcon to new hardware platforms

- Investigate complex performance issues reported by customers and turn findings into compiler improvements

- Review code, mentor engineers on the team and raise the bar for performance methodology

- Contribute to upstream LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

- 5+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers

- Strong C++ design and coding skills in large codebases

- Proven track record of delivering compiler optimizations with measurable performance impact

- Deep knowledge of compiler optimization theory and its practical tradeoffs: compile time, code size, correctness

- Strong performance analysis skills: profilers, hardware counters, reading and reasoning about generated assembly

Nice to Have

- Significant experience with LLVM optimization passes or code generation; LLVM commit access is a plus

- Experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, . NET RyuJIT or similar

- Deep knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

- Experience with JVM internals: garbage collection, deoptimization, profiling

- PhD in Computer Science or significant research experience in compilers

About the RoleDreamworld Solutions is looking for a QA Automation Engineer for Kerika, a task and project management SaaS platform (comparable to Trello, ClickUp and Asana) used by teams across 37 languages. 

We want someone who comes from a UI or full-stack development background, understands how web applications are built, and wants to build a career in QA and test automation. You will test features against the requirements and gradually build an automated test suite for the product.

3. Plan and write test cases, including edge cases, for web features. 

4. Build and maintain automated tests for the web application, starting with the most repeated flows such as login, boards and cards. 

5. Run regression tests before each release, and support the phased rollout from beta to full public release. 

6. Test APIs and check how the front end and the back end work together. 

7. Work with the Business Analyst, the designer and the developers, and give QA sign-off before a feature goes live. 

8. Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT and similar) in your daily work, for example to draft test cases and scenarios. 

What We Are Looking For• Up to 2 years of experience as a UI developer or full-stack developer. 

• Good knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and React or a similar front-end framework. 

• A clear interest in QA and testing, and the willingness to grow into test automation. 

• Basic understanding of test cases, bug reporting and the testing process. 

• Careful, detail-oriented and patient with repetitive checking. 

• Good written communication, since much of the work is written back-and-forth. 

• Comfortable using AI tools as part of the daily workflow. 

Good to Have• Experience with an automation tool such as Playwright, Cypress or Selenium. 

• Experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools. 

• Experience with Git and a bug tracker such as Jira. 

• Experience with multilingual products, or with task and project management tools. 

What Success Looks Like• Every shipped feature is tested against its PRD before release.
