About This Role

Full Stack Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President

Your team

You will join the Client Intelligence engineering organization within Aladdin Data, working at the intersection of data, artificial intelligence, and modern cloud technologies. The team builds scalable applications and platforms that enable intelligent client experiences and help drive commercial impact. 

Your role and impact

This is a backend-focused full-stack engineering role with significant hands-on technical ownership. You will design and build scalable applications and platforms, with a strong focus on Java and/or Python alongside modern frontend development using React and TypeScript/JavaScript. You will own complex engineering initiatives from architecture and implementation through production operation, while helping raise engineering standards and mentoring engineers across the team. 

Your responsibilities

Responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: 

- Design scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable architectures across backend services, APIs, data platforms, and user-facing applications, making informed trade-offs across performance, scalability, availability, maintainability, user experience, and cost. 
 - Remain hands-on in Java and/or Python, building distributed backend services, reusable APIs, components, and platform capabilities that support multiple products and use cases. 
 - Provide technical direction for modern web applications using React and TypeScript/JavaScript, owning capabilities across backend services, APIs, and frontend experiences. 
 - Build data- and artificial intelligence-enabled applications that integrate large language models, agents, enterprise data, APIs, retrieval systems, and efficient data access patterns into intuitive user experiences. 
 - Establish high engineering standards across code quality, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery, security, observability, performance, and operational resilience. 
 - Mentor engineers across backend and frontend technologies and lead architecture, design, and code reviews. 
 - Partner with product managers, designers, data scientists, artificial intelligence engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions. 

Your experience

- Demonstrated software engineering experience building enterprise-grade applications and platforms, with strong hands-on expertise in Java and/or Python. 
 - Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ownership of complex production systems, including troubleshooting and performance optimization. 
 - Full-stack development experience with React and TypeScript/JavaScript, including component-based design, state management, API integration, performance, and frontend testing. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and data-intensive application design, with experience working across modern data platforms and data-processing workflows. 
 - Experience designing and operating cloud-native applications with strong engineering fundamentals in object-oriented and domain-driven design, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery, observability, security, and performance engineering. 
 - Experience providing technical leadership through architecture, design and code reviews, mentoring engineers, and communicating technical decisions and trade-offs to engineering, product, and business stakeholders. 
 - Experience with artificial intelligence-enabled applications, large language model integration, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows, reusable platform capabilities, and financial services or client-facing technology platforms is beneficial. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

data.title: Engineering Technical Lead
data.description:
Engineering Lead

Payments platform engineering

Hands-on technical lead who owns architecture and system design, ships with the team, and scales systems under real load. This role reports directly to the CTO. Fintech or payments experience is preferred, not required. 

The role

You will lead a small engineering group while remaining the strongest technical voice in the room. Day to day is design reviews, production decisions, and code - not status meetings. You set the technical bar, unblock the team, and stay accountable for systems that have to stay up. You report to the CTO and are the CTO's counterpart on delivery, architecture, and engineering quality. 

What you will do

• Architecture. Design and evolve systems for high throughput and low latency. Own trade-offs on consistency, failure modes, and cost. 

• Hands-on first. Write and review code on the critical path. Diagrams are not a substitute for shipping. 

• System design. Lead design for new products and hard changes to existing ones. Drive data models, APIs, and service boundaries. 

• Team handling. Lead engineers: hiring input, mentoring, code quality, and delivery - without giving up technical depth. 

• Large-scale systems. Capacity, observability, incident response, and postmortems that change the design. 

• AI-native. Use coding agents, evaluation, and automation in the build and run path. Set standards so AI output is reviewed, tested, and owned. 

• Databases. Own schema design, indexing, partitioning, access patterns, and query performance under growth. 

Must have

• Experience. 10-13 years building production software, with recent ownership of systems at meaningful scale. 

• Data structures. Strong data structures and algorithms applied to real systems, not interview trivia. 

• Architecture and system design. Proven ownership of services, data flow, failure handling, and how a system evolves over time. 

• Databases. Relational depth, plus at least one other store, with evidence of designing for volume and correctness. 

• Hands-on first. You still write code and can debug production issues yourself. 

• Team handling. You have led engineers, raised the bar, and shipped through them without becoming a pure manager. 

• AI-native skills. Daily use of coding agents and LLM tooling in design, implementation, testing, and operations, with judgment on where they fail. 

• Large-scale systems. You have operated systems where load, failure, and data growth were real constraints. 

Preferred

• Fintech or payments. UPI, cards, payouts, ledgers, reconciliation, or settlement. Domain knowledge helps; engineering depth matters more. 

• Experience with incident-heavy, money-moving systems where correctness and auditability are non-negotiable.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Castrol is one of the world's leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company's commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol. 

Job Description

About the Team: 

The Manager - Engineering (Electrical & Instrumentation) reports to the Senior Manager - Engineering & Projects and provides functional leadership for plant instrumentation, automation, control systems and associated electrical systems. 

You will be accountable for PLC/SCADA reliability, filling-line controls, field instrumentation, calibration, interlocks, control panels and automation projects, while ensuring essential electrical power reliability and statutory compliance. 

You will work across Production, HSSE, Quality, IT/OT, Procurement, contractors and the Mechanical Engineering Manager to deliver safe, reliable and cost-effective operations. 

Key Tasks: 

Own reliability and lifecycle performance of PLCs, SCADA, HMIs, filling-line controls, industrial networks, safety interlocks and control panels. 

- Lead maintenance and troubleshooting of sensors, encoders, photoelectric and proximity devices, load cells, weighing systems, flow meters, transmitters, control valves, actuators, printers, labelers and vision interfaces. 
 - Plan preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance to improve asset availability, MTBF and MTTR. 
 - Ensure calibration, functional testing and traceability of instruments, weighing systems, alarms, trips and protective devices. 
 - Maintain controlled PLC/SCADA programs, backups, access controls, software revisions, I/O lists, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm/interlock lists, loop drawings and network architecture. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and defect elimination for recurring filling-line, PLC, instrumentation and control-system failures. 
 - Deliver E&I scope for CAPEX and minor projects from concept, specification and technical bid evaluation through FAT/SAT, commissioning, performance verification and handover. 
 - Drive automation, digitization, data acquisition, predictive maintenance and process-control improvements with measurable business value. 
 - Manage critical spares, obsolescence risks, AMCs, vendors, contractors and assigned expenditure within approved budgets. 
 - Coach engineers and technicians in PLC diagnostics, calibration, filling-line controls, safe isolation and structured troubleshooting. 
 - Ensure essential electrical systems including HT/LT distribution, MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, earthing and protection remain safe, reliable and compliant. 

Responsible for HSSE in Engineering (both people and equipment) activities and compliance to Castrol HSSE standards. 

The person with be responsible as Contractor Assurance Manager (CAM) to manage the contractors at site for HSSE & Legal requirements for contract. 

The person will be responsible for Castrol Engineering Standards specifically Integrity Management Standards application for Engineering activities at site. 

Experience Required: 

Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical & Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent recognized engineering qualification. 

- Preferably 8-10 years of instrumentation, automation, maintenance and project experience in manufacturing or process industries, including team and contractor responsibility. 
 - Strong knowledge of PLC programming, diagnostics, I/O systems, SCADA, HMI, industrial communication networks, control loops, alarms, trips and interlocks. 
 - Hands-on experience with filling-line automation, sensors, encoders, load cells, weighing/filling systems, control valves, actuators, printers and labellers. 
 - Knowledge of Allen-Bradley PLC and SCADA platforms is an added advantage. 
 - Experience in calibration, loop checking, FAT/SAT, commissioning, functional testing, performance testing and as-built documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, protection, earthing and electrical drawings. 
 - Understanding of OT lifecycle controls including backups, access control, change management, recovery planning and cybersecurity coordination. 
 - Good project management, contractor management, communication, planning and commercial-judgement skills; proficiency in MS Project and MS Office is desirable. 

Privacy

The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy. response@castrol. com. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e. g. , accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc. ). 

If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.

data.description:
We Are Teva

We're Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it's innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we're dedicated to addressing patients' needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together. 

Our Team, Your Impact

The Sr. Manager, MS&T External Manufacturing is a individual‐contributor leadership role within Teva Global ExM, responsible for driving all technical and manufacturing‐operations engagements with external partners, including Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs). The role provides strategic and hands‐on oversight to ensure product robustness, seamless technology transfer, scale‐up, and successful commercialization of externally manufactured products. 

This position leads a team of technical professionals in supporting complex root‐cause investigations, offering technical intelligence for deviations, technical complaints, OOS results, and CAPA activities. The Associate Director ensures that all external manufacturing processes consistently meet the highest standards of quality, operational excellence, and cGMP compliance, while maintaining products and processes in a validated state throughout their lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in manufacturing sciences, process engineering, and process optimization, combined with strong knowledge of cGMP, global regulatory expectations, and project management principles. Success in this role requires the ability to collaborate effectively across cross‐functional teams and influence external partners to achieve reliable supply, regulatory compliance, and continuous performance improvement. 

Thus, the role will provide stewardship by ensuring that both manufacturing operations at external suppliers and performance of Teva products are monitored & maintained in a validated state

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in manufacturing sciences, process optimization, and a thorough understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), Project Management, IR or MR OSD products experience and will be adept at managing cross-functional teams to drive successful outcomes with external partners

How You'll Spend Your Day

External Manufacturing Partner Management: 

- Establish and Maintain Relationships with CMO/ CDMO manufacturing organization: 
 - Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with CMO/ CDMO manufacturing organization to ensure successful product manufacturing, process development, and scale-up activities
 - Provide technical expertise and guidance to CMOs on process optimization, scale-up, and troubleshooting. 
 - Support transfer of new products or processes to external manufacturing sites
 - Monitor Performance: 
 - Assess the performance of external manufacturing partners, identify opportunities for improvement
 - Ongoing performance tracking for external manufacturing, including quality, cost, delivery, and efficiency. Ensure the alignment of external sites with Teva expectations
 - Communication and Escalation: 
 - Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day technical and operational issues related to external manufacturing. Escalate concerns to senior management when necessary. 
Process Development & Optimization

- Manufacturing Support: 
 - Oversee technical aspects of manufacturing processes to ensure they meet product specifications, regulatory standards, and Teva requirements
 - Optimize existing manufacturing processes for efficiency, robustness, and yield
 - Provide technical leadership in scale-up and transfer of new products from development to commercial manufacturing. 
 - Process Improvement: 
 - Continuously review and improve processes at external manufacturing sites to meet the Teva standards for product quality and operational efficiency
 - Introduce process improvements and ensure effective implementation at external sites
 - Evaluate and implement changes to improve robustness and scalability of manufacturing processes
 - Troubleshooting: 
 - Provide technical troubleshooting support for issues that arise at external manufacturing facilities. Lead cross-functional teams to address /resolve issues that impact production timelines
 - Lead investigations into deviations and work with CMOs to implement corrective actions
Quality And Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure Compliance: 
 - Ensure that all manufacturing activities at external sites are compliant with cGMP, ICH, FDA, EMA, and other applicable regulatory requirements. 
 - Audit and Inspection Support: 
 - Lead and/or support external manufacturing site audits, inspections, and regulatory submissions, ensuring that CMOs meet all quality standards and regulatory requirements. 
 - Deviation and CAPA Management: 
 - Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for manufacturing deviations, non-conformances, and other quality issues at external sites
 - Collaborate with external partners to implement CAPAs effectively
Technology Transfer And Scale-up

- Manage Technology Transfer: 
 - Lead the technology transfer process for new products or processes to external manufacturing sites, ensuring that the transfer is executed smoothly and within timelines
 - Manage Material transfer projects: 
 - Lead material transfer project s (Changes in API/ Excipient etc. ) and ensure timely completion
 - Scale-up Support: 
 - Oversee the scaling up of manufacturing processes, ensuring that commercial production is consistent with development batches in terms of product quality and process performance. 
Cross-functional Collaboration

- Cross-departmental Coordination: 
 - Work closely with internal teams such as Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Product Development to ensure seamless integration of manufacturing processes and that timelines are met. 
 - Project Management: 
 - Manage or contribute to cross-functional project teams, ensuring that all aspects of product commercialization and manufacturing at external sites are executed efficiently and on schedule
Reporting & Documentation

- Prepare technical reports, presentations, and documentation for both internal and external stakeholders. 
 - Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for external manufacturing operations, providing updates to senior leadership. 

Your Skills And Experience

- Master's Degree in Pharma, Science, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering 
 - 15+ years pharmaceutical manufacturing/validation/other related experience for US FDA approved sites
 - Strong experience in working with external manufacturing partners (CMOs, CDMOs, etc. )
 - Need to be experienced in Solid Oral Products Manufacturing and Technologies in Pharma Industry
 - 20 - 30% Local Or International (as applicable)

Also Good to Have

- Strong technical background with expertise in manufacturing processes, process development, and scale-up. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting & analytical skills. 
 - Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and build relationships with external partners. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with manufacturing management systems (e. g. , SAP, MES). 
 - Thorough familiarity with cGMPs, SOP's, relevant government regulations, and current industry standards. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you'll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging. 

That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You'll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community. 

Your growth matters too. You'll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship. 

Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together. 

Teva's Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment

Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to support you throughout the recruitment and selection process. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

data.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
About the role

We are building an AI personal assistant that lives in a mobile app and on smart glasses, 

helping busy people stay on top of their calls, messages, emails, tasks, meetings and day. 

We need a QA Engineer who owns the quality of the whole experience, from the app on

the phone to the hardware on the face. 

You will test as a user first and as an engineer second: manual testing from the user's

point of view, real-world testing of the assistant together with the hardware, and

automation so that every app or hardware change is tested without waiting on a person. 

- Location: Ahmedabad, India (on-site)
 - Employment: Full-time
 - Experience: 5+ years in QA, including hardware, IoT or wearable testing

How we want you to think

We are hiring someone who tests GINN the way its founder would: as a demanding daily

user who expects the product to just work, not as someone ticking off test cases. The

founder should be able to hand over quality and trust that nothing ships that the founder

would not be happy to use personally. 

- Own the outcome, not the checklist. Before asking "does it match the spec?", ask "would I trust this with my day?"
 - Judge every release against the promise. GINN is a personal assistant. A feature that works but adds friction, delay or confusion has failed. 
 - Live with the product. Carry the app and the hardware through a real workday: commute, meetings, noisy rooms, weak networks, low battery, back-to-back requests. 
 - Break it on purpose. Interrupt it mid-sentence, mumble, switch accents or languages, drop the connection mid-request, pair and unpair repeatedly, use it the way no one planned. 
 - Notice the small things. Response lag, awkward wording, wrong tone, battery drain, heat, comfort and fit of the hardware. Users feel these before they can name them. 
 - Treat trust and privacy as top severity. A personal assistant handles personal data. A wrong action, a leaked detail or an unwanted recording is a release blocker, always. 
 - Speak up. Block a release when it is not ready and say why. Flag gaps in the spec. Bring a suggested fix with every bug, not just the report. 

What you will do

Your work covers three areas, and the first two feed the third: what you learn by using the

product by hand decides what gets automated. 

1. Manual testing from the user's point of view

Test every feature end to end across the mobile app (Android and iOS), the website

and ordering flow, and the AI assistant, the way a first-time user and a daily power

user would. 

Explore beyond written test cases: odd inputs, interruptions, slow networks, denied

permissions, notifications arriving mid-task. 

Judge the experience, not only the function: speed, clarity, the tone of the assistant's

replies, and whether the user's task was actually completed. 

Write bug reports a developer can reproduce in minutes: steps, device, build, 

expected versus actual result, plus a screen recording or logs. 

2. Real-world testing of the assistant with the hardware

Test real use cases of the assistant on the glasses and app together: voice commands, 

calls, messages, reminders, note-taking and meeting recording, daily scheduling. 

Test in real conditions: walking, travelling, noisy rooms, weak connectivity, different

accents and speaking styles. 

Test pairing and reconnection, firmware updates, battery life, charging, heat, audio

and microphone quality, and comfort over a full day of wear. 

Compare units and firmware builds, and flag variation between hardware batches. 

3. Automation of app and hardware testing

Build and maintain automated suites for the Android and iOS apps, the website, 

backend APIs and the assistant's conversation flows. 

Connect them to our build pipeline so every app change and every firmware update

triggers tests automatically, with results the whole team can see. 

Set up hardware-in-the-loop tests: scripted device interactions such as simulated

voice input, connection drops and low-battery states, run against real glasses. 

Own the regression pack and the release checklist, and track pass rates and flaky

tests over time. 

Decide what to automate and what stays manual. Anything that needs human

judgement, such as how a reply feels, stays with you personally. 

Must Have

- You have tested real consumer products with both software and hardware, and you care more about the user's experience than about passing a test plan. 
 - 2+ years in QA, with at least 2 years testing hardware, IoT or wearable devices alongside a companion mobile app. 
 - Strong manual and exploratory testing skills: you find the bugs that scripted cases miss. 
 - Hands-on experience testing Android and iOS apps on real devices, across OS versions and screen sizes. 
 - Experience building test automation, for example with Appium, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar, in Python, JavaScript or Java. 
 - Working knowledge of API testing (Postman or similar) and of reading logs, network traces and crash reports. 
 - Experience with CI pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins, and with a bug tracker and sprint tool. 
 - Comfort testing Bluetooth pairing, audio and voice features, firmware updates and battery behaviour. 
 - Clear written and spoken English. You can explain a bug to a developer, a hardware vendor and a founder in the language each one needs. 
 - A product owner's attitude: you form an opinion on how the product should feel, and you defend it with evidence. 
 - Experience testing AI or LLM-based products: evaluating answer quality, hallucinations, latency and failure handling. 

Nice to have

- Experience with voice or speech features, including speech-to-text accuracy across accents and noise levels. 
 - Experience with smart glasses, earbuds, smartwatches or other wearables. 
 - Experience with e-commerce testing: checkout, payments, order tracking. 
 - Basic performance, security and privacy testing, such as permissions, data handling and recording consent. 
 - Experience working in an early-stage startup, where you set up the QA process yourself. 

How we hire

We pick the person who tests like a founder, so the process makes you do exactly that. 

1. Application. Send your CV and a short note on the worst bug you ever found in a

consumer product and how you found it. 

2. Intro call. A conversation about your experience with hardware, wearables and mobile

apps. 

3. Hands-on exercise. Test a real feature of our app with a device and write up what you

find: bugs, rough edges and what you would block a release for. 

4. Founder interview. Walk the founder through your findings and defend your calls on

severity and release readiness. 

5. Offer.

data.title: Robot programmer
data.description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration - and we want you to be part of it. You'll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21, 000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go. 

Position Summary

Experienced Robot Programmer to develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and support KUKA and FANUC robotic systems used in advanced manufacturing operations. 

This is a remote role, with the majority of programming, simulation, troubleshooting, and process development performed using digital manufacturing and offline programming tools. The position may require international travel for up to approximately 20% of working time to support manufacturing plants with process development, commissioning, prove-out, optimization, troubleshooting, and production ramp-up. 

The successful candidate will work closely with Manufacturing Engineering, CNC Programming, Automation and Controls, Maintenance, Production, Quality, equipment suppliers, and system integrators to deliver reliable, standardized, and production-ready robotic processes. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, modify, troubleshoot, and optimize programs for KUKA and FANUC industrial robots. 

Develop robotic applications for automated deburring cells, CNC machine automation, component/material handling, and automated production processes. 

Perform robot programming, simulation, testing, and validation offline wherever practical before deployment to production equipment. 

Use Visual Components and robot-specific programming/simulation environments to develop and validate robotic processes. 

Use Siemens Teamcenter, JT2Go, and Siemens NX CAD/CAM to work with engineering data, 3D models, manufacturing layouts, tooling, fixtures, and equipment configurations. 

Develop and validate robot paths, reach, accessibility, tool orientation, clearances, collision conditions, and automated sequences. 

Troubleshoot robot programs, alarms, I/O, PLC handshakes, interlocks, communication, sequencing, and machine-interface issues. 

Integrate robots with CNC machine tools, PLCs, pallet systems, grippers, fixtures, sensors, vision systems, and automation equipment. 

Optimize robot movements and sequences to improve safety, quality, cycle time, equipment utilization, reliability, and productivity. 

Develop standardized, maintainable robot programs with robust fault handling and recovery routines. Maintain program backups, revision control, documentation, and change traceability. 

Provide remote technical support and support commissioning, process qualification, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp-up. 

Capture lessons learned and incorporate improvements into standard programs and future applications. 

Required Qualifications

Degree, diploma, or equivalent technical experience in Robotics, Automation, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field. 

6+ years of relevant experience. 

Strong practical experience programming industrial robotic systems. 

Experience programming and troubleshooting primarily KUKA and secondarily FANUC robots and control systems. 

Working knowledge of KUKA KRL and FANUC robot programming. 

Experience with offline robot programming and simulation. 

Visual Components: Must have. 

Working knowledge of Siemens Teamcenter, JT2Go, and Siemens NX CAD/CAM. 

Strong understanding of robot coordinate systems, tooling, frames, motion programming, I/O, PLC interfaces, interlocks, and automated sequences. 

Experience integrating robots with PLC-controlled manufacturing equipment. 

Ability to understand 3D CAD models, manufacturing layouts, tooling, fixtures, and robotic-cell configurations. 

Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, remote-support, and communication skills. 

Willingness and ability to travel internationally for up to approximately 20% of working time. 

Preferred Experience

Robotic CNC machine tending and automated machining operations. High-mix, low-volume, complex, tight-tolerance, or high-value manufacturing. 

KUKA and FANUC offline programming/simulation environments. 

Siemens PLC-controlled automation and PROFINET. 

Robotic grippers, end-of-arm tooling, automated pallet handling, vision systems, and material handling. SAT, commissioning, and production ramp-up. 

Robot and machinery safety principles. Structured problem-solving methods such as 8D, 5-Why, or DMAIC. 

Key Behaviours

Technical Ownership: Takes responsibility from initial diagnosis through implementation and verification. 

Digital Manufacturing Mindset: Uses CAD, simulation, offline programming, and controlled engineering data before deployment wherever practical. 

Bias for Action: Responds quickly to production issues and moves solutions into implementation. 

Programming Discipline: Develops standardized, maintainable, documented, and robust robot programs. 

Practical Problem Solving: Uses robot data, engineering models, simulation, diagnostics, and onsite feedback to resolve root causes. 

Collaboration: Works effectively across manufacturing sites, engineering teams, OEMs, and system integrators. 

Continuous Improvement: Improves robot reliability, cycle time, process stability, standardization, and productivity. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful Robot Programmer can take a robotic application from engineering data and digital concept through offline programming, simulation, onsite prove-out, optimization, and stable production operation. 

The role is remote-first, not remote-only. Most development should be completed digitally and offline, with onsite time focused on activities where direct access to manufacturing equipment adds value. 

Understand the requirement. Develop digitally. Program and simulate offline. Validate. Deploy onsite when required. Prove out. Optimize. Standardize. Support production. 

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture. 

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

data.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Software Engineering Manager (Video Streaming)

Department: Technology

Reports to: CTO

Required experience: 8+ years

Location: Ahmedabad, India-Remote

Company Introduction

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We're a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don't take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace for the last 5 years (2021- 2025) with a rating of 4. 3 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor, and 4. 4 stars out of 5 on AmbitionBox. Our team members love our competitive benefits, including remote work options, comfortable work-life balance, paid time off (PTO), personal and family health insurance options, paid family leave, and development/training opportunities. 

Job Overview

Genea is looking for a Software Engineering Manager (Video Streaming) to lead the team building Genea Video, our cloud-native video solution built directly into the Genea security platform alongside access control and visitor management. Genea Video lets customers connect compatible RTSP cameras through the Genea Gateway (an on-site NVIDIA Jetson appliance that runs AI at the edge) or stream supported Axis cameras straight to the cloud. Customers can then watch live view and recorded playback, build camera walls, search across every camera with AI, and see the door and badge event behind every clip. You will own the engineering of this video streaming pipeline end to end, from camera ingest and edge processing to cloud storage, playback and search, and participate in the full SDLC from system analysis to testing and deployment. This hybrid engineering role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management, building high quality, high performance software alongside a great team. 

What you would do, day-to-day?

- Lead and grow the team building Genea Video, from camera ingest and edge processing to cloud storage, playback and search. 
 - Have a keen eye on code quality, with scalability, maintainability and readability in mind. 
 - Have a solution-oriented mindset and design high-load, low-latency video streaming systems that scale across thousands of cameras and locations. 
 - Estimate and delegate work across streaming, edge (Genea Gateway) and web/mobile client workstreams. 
 - Manage the people on a large engineering team to keep them aligned and focused on achieving the team's goals. 
 - Drive the design, strategy, and execution of video projects that support the Genea Video roadmap, including live view, recorded playback, camera walls, clip export and camera management. 
 - Lead the architecture of the video pipeline: RTSP ingest through the Genea Gateway, Axis Camera-to-Cloud streaming, transcoding, adaptive delivery, storage and retention. 
 - Oversee the daily activities and progress of multiple SCRUM teams working on Genea Video. 
 - Monitor, and continuously update, team metrics for engineering and operational excellence, including stream reliability, latency, uptime and cost per camera. Ensure a consistent, regular process for assessing goals and improving deliveries. 
 - Lead SCRUM teams through estimating engineering effort to build new features, such as AI-powered search and security automations, and to fix prior mistakes. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers and the Access Control and Visitor Management teams to link video to door and badge events and deliver one unified platform experience. 
 - Implement a data-driven approach to execution to drive transparency, and partner with DevOps and Support to keep video services reliable around the clock. 

What are we looking for?

- 8+ years of total experience and 3+ years of relevant work experience as team lead
 - Experience in microservice and event driven architecture. 
 - Proficient in backend technologies, preferably JavaScript, but we're open to other technologies such as Go, Python or C++. 
 - Hands-on experience with video streaming technologies and protocols such as RTSP, WebRTC, HLS/DASH and RTMP, and with video codecs such as H. 264 and H. 265. 
 - Experience building or managing media pipelines for live and recorded video: ingest, transcoding, adaptive bitrate delivery, recording, storage and retention (for example, with FFmpeg or GStreamer). 
 - Experience with edge computing and on-device AI/computer vision. Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson or similar embedded platforms is a plus. 
 - Understanding of IP camera ecosystems (RTSP, ONVIF, Axis) and VMS/NVR concepts, and of video security use cases such as video linked to access control events. 
 - Experience designing for low latency, high throughput and cost-efficient storage, with observability for stream health (uptime, latency, dropped frames). 
 - Proficient in frontend technologies, preferably React, but we're open to any other JavaScript-based frameworks like Angular, Vue, etc. Experience building browser-based video players and live view/playback interfaces is a plus. 
 - Proficient in database technologies like MongoDB or RDBMS (We use PostgreSQL)
 - Excellent understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC) with experience guiding teams through planning, development, and rollout using best in industry agile practices
 - Having experience in work estimation and delegation is preferable. 
 - Understanding of testing practices like writing unit/integration test cases
 - Strong Articulation skills - Ability to write/explain complex problems over email or call. 
 - Obsession for excellence - Should strive for being excellent at work in terms of quality and speed. 
 - Professionalism - Sincere, Integrity, Commitment, Ownership
 - Strategic thinker with the ability to formulate product and business strategies. 
 - Prior experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams of manager, senior engineers simultaneously working on multiple projects and technologies. 
 - Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills at high levels. 
 - Possess innate customer service skills including the ability to be empathetic, accurate, compassionate, responsive, resourceful, and conscientious. 
 - Strong relationship management, strategizing, project management, problem solving, and change management skills. 
 - Experience working with AWS is highly preferable. We work with AWS services like EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, RDS, SQS. 

Competencies

- Initiative - Volunteers readily; Undertakes self-development activities; Seeks increased responsibilities; Takes independent actions and calculated risks; Looks for and takes advantage of opportunities; Asks for and offers help when needed. 
 - Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans. 
 - Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality. 
 - Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed. 
 - Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information. 

Perks & Benefits

✨ Work Your Way: Enjoy a flexible working environment that suits your lifestyle. 

✨ Time Off: 24 days of PTO and 10 holidays to unwind and pursue your passions. 

✨ Comprehensive Leave Options: Including maternity, paternity, adoption, wedding, and bereavement leaves to support you during important life events. 

✨ Health & Safety First: Benefit from family health insurance and personal accident coverage beyond your CTC. 

✨ Top Workplace Honors: Celebrated as a Top Workplace from 2021 to 2025. 

✨ Balanced Workweek: Embrace a balanced life with our 5-day work schedule

data.title: Principal Engineer – AI Security Developer
data.description:
Overview

Connecting clients to markets - and talent to opportunity. 

With 5, 400+ employees and over 80, 000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets - focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. 

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. 

Business Segment Overview

Corporate: Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you'll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies. 

Position Purpose: At StoneX, defending a global financial services organization increasingly means building capabilities ourselves rather than waiting for the market to provide them. As a Principal Engineer - AI Security Developer , you'll serve as the senior technical authority for how StoneX applies AI to cybersecurity, setting the technical vision, architecture, and engineering standards for our AI security platform while personally building the hardest and highest-leverage parts of it. 

Your mission is to define how AI becomes a secure, scalable, and trusted capability across the security organization. You'll establish the reference architecture for GenAI applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) platforms, advanced analytics, shared services, and the guardrails and engineering patterns that allow multiple teams to build consistently and safely. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with enterprise-wide influence, not a role removed from the technology. You'll remain a hands-on engineer while shaping technical direction across multiple security and engineering teams. You'll make the difficult architectural decisions, build shared platform capabilities, prototype new approaches , solve the hardest technical problems, and raise the engineering bar for how AI capabilities are designed and delivered across StoneX. 

From Day 1 , you'll begin shaping the technical direction of StoneX's AI security capabilities while getting hands-on with the platform and the problems our teams are trying to solve. You'll work across security, engineering, infrastructure, data, risk, and other partners to identify where AI creates meaningful value, establish the architecture and standards teams can build upon, and help turn that direction into trusted production capabilities at scale. 

Responsibilities

Primary duties will include: 

- AI Security Strategy: Define and own the multi-year technical strategy and roadmap for AI-powered security capabilities, translating business and risk priorities into a sequenced engineering direction. 
 - Reference Architecture: Design and govern the target architecture for StoneX's AI security platform, including LLM services and orchestration, agent frameworks, RAG and knowledge pipelines, evaluation infrastructure, data access patterns, and integrations across the security environment. 
 - Platform Engineering: Architect and build shared platform capabilities including secure LLM services, agent runtimes, tool and connector frameworks, retrieval services, prompt and model management, and observability that allow teams to deliver AI solutions quickly, consistently, and securely. 
 - Hands-On Engineering: Remain deeply technical by personally designing and building complex and critical components, prototyping new approaches , and helping teams solve difficult engineering problems across the full stack. 
 - Technical Decision-Making: Lead evaluation of models, frameworks, vendors, and open-source technologies and make recommendations based on security, performance, cost, maintainability, and long-term strategic value. 
 - Portfolio Prioritization: Partner with security leadership to identify , size, and prioritize high-impact AI opportunities across detection, response, vulnerability management, identity, cloud, application security, and other security domains while challenging work that does not demonstrate meaningful value. 
 - Secure Integration: Establish patterns for integrating AI services and agentic workflows with security technologies including source-code repositories, threat models, cloud platforms, SIEM, SOAR, IAM, CMDB, and vulnerability management systems while enforcing appropriate least privilege, auditability, and human oversight. 
 - Production Excellence: Establish expectations for reliability, scalability, latency, monitoring, operational readiness, and cost management across production AI workloads. 
 - AI Security & Assurance: Serve as a technical authority on securing AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, model and supply-chain risk, agent tool misuse, adversarial manipulation, and other emerging threats. 
 - Evaluation & Quality: Establish how StoneX evaluates LLM and agent performance through benchmark datasets, automated evaluation pipelines, red teaming, regression testing, and measures of accuracy, hallucination, reliability, and analyst trust. 
 - Responsible AI: Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Data Governance, and Architecture to ensure AI capabilities meet regulatory, model risk management, privacy, and data residency expectations. 
 - Engineering Standards: Set and champion standards for AI engineering, including architecture, code quality, design review, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and production readiness. 
 - Technical Leadership: Influence technical direction across security, infrastructure, data, and application engineering teams, building consensus and resolving complex cross-team technical challenges without relying on direct authority. 
 - Developing Engineers: Mentor senior and staff-level engineers, strengthen AI engineering capability across the security organization, and help shape technical hiring standards and career development. 
 - Executive Advisory: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the CISO, security leadership, and executive stakeholders by clearly communicating technical strategy, trade-offs, risks, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Industry Leadership: Represent StoneX within the broader security and AI community through industry engagement, working groups, conferences, publications, or open-source contributions and bring relevant external thinking back into the organization. 

A typical week might include the following: 

- Spending at least four days in the office engaging directly with engineers, security teams, architects, and other stakeholders. 
 - Designing and building critical components of StoneX's AI security platform, particularly where the technical complexity or organizational leverage is highest. 
 - Working with security leadership and engineering teams to identify and prioritize AI use cases based on measurable security value, feasibility, and strategic importance. 
 - Leading architecture and design reviews for AI capabilities that span teams, security domains, or enterprise technologies. 
 - Evaluating emerging models, agent frameworks, development approaches, vendors, and open-source technologies against StoneX's security, performance, cost, and maintainability requirements. 
 - Prototyping new AI capabilities to validate difficult technical concepts before establishing reusable patterns that other engineers can build upon. 
 - Working with engineering teams to solve difficult integration, architecture, scalability, reliability, or security challenges. 
 - Reviewing production AI performance, evaluations, model behavior, observability, reliability, and cost to identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Threat modeling AI systems and ensuring appropriate protections exist around data access, agent actions, tool execution, model behavior, and other AI-specific risks. 
 - Mentoring engineers through architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and complex technical challenges. 
 - Advising security and executive leadership on AI strategy, technical trade-offs, emerging risks, and the practical implications of changes in AI technology. 

This job might be for you if: 

- You're a technical leader who still builds - you enjoy setting architecture and direction, but you still want to write production code and personally tackle the problems where your involvement creates the greatest leverage. 
 - You think beyond individual applications - you naturally look for the shared platforms, patterns, services, and standards that allow many teams to build better and faster. 
 - You're practical about AI - you can separate meaningful technological change from hype and focus teams on where AI can produce measurable security outcomes. 
 - You're comfortable making hard technical decisions - you can evaluate competing technologies and approaches, make a recommendation, explain the trade-offs, and stand behind the decision. 
 - You're security-minded by design - you treat AI as both a defensive capability and an attack surface and consider adversarial behavior from the beginning. 
 - You're a multiplier - you want the engineers and teams around you to become stronger because of the architecture, standards, mentorship, and technical guidance you provide. 
 - You lead through influence - you can establish technical direction and build alignment across teams and stakeholders even when they don't report to you. 
 - You're willing to challenge the premise - if a use case is vague, a vendor claim doesn't hold up, or AI isn't the right solution, you'll say so and redirect attention toward measurable value. 
 - You're continuously learning - you follow AI and security research closely, evaluate emerging technologies critically, and bring back what can genuinely improve StoneX's capabilities. 
 - You're a versatile communicator - you can explain complex AI concepts and strategic trade-offs to executive audiences while still being able to go deeply technical with engineers and researchers. 

Qualifications

To land this role you will need: 

- 12+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and operating production systems, including 5+ years focused on AI/ML, security engineering, or bot h, with experience across tools and frameworks such as DSPy , LiteLLM , Datadog, and Azure. 
 - Proven experience operating as a Principal, Staff, or equivalent senior technical leader with responsibility for architecture and technical direction spanning multiple teams or an organization. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting, deploying, and operating GenAI applications, RAG solutions, or AI agents in production at scale, including evaluation, monitoring, and cost management. 
 - Deep expertise with large language models, prompt and context engineering, embeddings and vector databases, agent frameworks and tool orchestration, and model evaluation techniques. 
 - Expert proficiency in Python and strong experience with at least one additional production language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, or C#. 
 - Full-stack technical credibility spanning back-end services and APIs, front-end interfaces, integrations, and data pipelines. 
 - Strong knowledge of distributed systems and cloud-native architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including experience scaling and containerizing workloads in Azure, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, technologies, and workflows including SIEM, SOAR, vulnerability management, IAM, cloud security, and application security. 
 - Strong working knowledge of AI-specific security risks and relevant frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATT&CK, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence senior technical stakeholders and executives and drive technical change across organizational boundaries. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical strategy, architecture, trade-offs, and risk across both deeply technical and executive audiences. 

What makes you stand out: 

- Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Experience with model risk management, responsible AI, AI governance, or similar regulatory and governance requirements. 
 - Industry contributions such as publications, conference presentations, patents, standards participation, or open-source leadership. 
 - Bachelor's or M aster's degree in Computer Science , Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience and non-traditional paths are welcomed. 

Working environment: 

- 4 days' work from office.

data.title: Senior Staff Digital Methodology Engineer - Design for Testability (DFT)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months. 

You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99. 5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences. 

At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
 - Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
 - Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149. 1, IEEE 1149. 6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
 - Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
 - Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
 - Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
 - Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
 - Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
 - Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
 - Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
 - Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
 - Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
 - Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 10+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
 - Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
 - Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
 - Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
 - Expertise deploying IEEE 1149. 1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149. 6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
 - Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
 - Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
 - Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
 - Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
 - Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
 - You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
 - You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
 - You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
 - You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
 - You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

We're all different -  and we love this about us.

data.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart. 

The Opportunity

Nutanix AHV builds on top of the open-source x86-KVM stack, with an emphasis on performance, scale, and reliability. The hyperconverged nature of our stack provides the phenomenal potential for optimizations cutting across various parts of our stack -- right from the kernel and ranging up to, but not limited by, the management layer. 

We are looking for original thinkers who won't hesitate to demand conventional thought in arriving at out-of-the-box solutions. 

We aim to work as closely aligned with the open-source community as possible. Our engineers are highly encouraged to participate in open-source community development. Any work you do will be preserved as open-source commit(s) for posterity!

A day in the life of an AHV hypervisor engineer: 

- Problems you'll solve: 
 - We've always believed in demanding the status quo and disrupting ourselves to provide the best in-class customer experience. A case in point: Nutanix is well known for providing a zero-touch upgrade experience for our customers. Within the hypervisor team, we are focussing on various ways to make this faster and more reliable -- by pushing the limits of VM live migrations towards speed and predictability, or rethinking why a hypervisor upgrade should need a reboot at all. 
About The Team

At Nutanix, you will have the opportunity to be part of the Hypervisor team, a dynamic group that is spread out geographically. Despite being in different locations, the team collaborates effectively and maintains a strong sense of camaraderie. Working with the Hypervisor team means being surrounded by talented people who are supportive, making it a great team to work with. This setup also provides exciting exposure to diverse perspectives and opportunities for personal and professional growth. 

You will report to a Senior Manager who is committed to supporting your development and ensuring your success within the organization. This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i. e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager. As for travel requirements, there are none, allowing you to focus on your projects without the need for frequent travel. 

Your Role

Role

You'll be managing a team of extremely talented engineers across a spectrum of geographies and experience. The most successful candidate for this role will be someone who can: 

- Constantly look for ways to improve the product, learning from customer questions and not limited to existing technologies. 
 - Devise solutions and back them up with solid research and numbers to prove their efficacy. 
 - Have the ability to convey ideas to a geographically diverse audience using excellent communication/writing skills. 
 - Participate in design discussions, often outside one's known comfort zone -- learning on the go. 
 - Proactively mentor junior members of the team, finding ways to fuel their intelligent curiosity and leverage their unique strengths. 
 - Not hesitate to help out with occasional customer escalations: Nutanix believes in putting customers first. While we have a huge, dedicated team to assist customers with any issues, there might be situations where engineering help might be sought to bail out a rare, unfortunate outage. 
 - Take pride in working with open-source communities to fold product improvements back into community projects. 

What You Will Bring

- The must-haves: 
 - Rock-solid OS/systems fundamentals drive design and implementation. 
 - Low-level coding and debugging experience with at least one hardware architecture, preferably x86. 
 - The ability to write and maintain enterprise-quality code. 
 - Deep reasoning and detailed skills, which provide top-down thinking to break down abstract concepts into actionable pieces. 
 - Proven feature delivery experience: should have 8+ years of hands-on experience of what it means to ship enterprise-quality code to customers. 
 - The good-to-haves: 
 - Knowledge of x86 virtualization and the KVM stack. 
 - Code contributions to the Linux kernel/virtualization stack is an added plus. 
Desired Qualification & Experience

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in computer science or equivalent. 
 - 12+ years of experience building enterprise-grade software, preferably some with guide experience.

About Turing: 

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Lead AI Evaluation Engineer (Science, Engineering Simulation & Design) with proven technical leadership skills to spearhead the authoring, review, and validation of "model-breaking, " simulation-based engineering design problems. Operating across major disciplines-including Physics, Electrical, Mechanical, Control Systems, Aerospace, Systems, and Robotics-you will lead a team of subject-matter experts to create complex, multi-constraint tasks where AI agents must interpret requirements, navigate trade-offs, configure open-source simulation tools, diagnose failures, and iterate toward valid solutions. You will oversee benchmark quality standards, analyze agent execution logs, expose systemic reasoning gaps, and guide the development of automated, objective graders to elevate frontier model performance. 

Job Requirements: 

- Team Leadership & Pod Management: Lead, mentor, and manage a pod of engineering SMEs-assigning tasks, tracking sprint deliverables, resolving technical blockers, and ensuring alignment with project milestones. 

- Peer Review & Quality Calibration: Conduct rigorous technical reviews and calibration sessions on team submissions, enforcing strict standards for physical plausibility, rubric objectivity, and reproducibility across all benchmarks. 

- Model-Breaking Problem Design: Author original, self-contained engineering design tasks with competing constraints, explicit optimization targets, validated reference solutions, and objective autograders. 

- Environment & Simulation Integration: Build, run, and validate problem environments using open-source simulation tools and custom Python test benches. 

- Trajectory Analysis & Failure Mode Taxonomy: Evaluate coding agent outputs and execution logs across repeated trials to identify systemic failure modes (e. g. , misinterpreting simulator feedback, premature design convergence, physically impossible geometries). 

- Difficulty Calibration & Benchmark Refinement: Iteratively refine problem difficulty based on empirical model performance data without introducing ambiguity or missing information. 

- Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for AI researchers and program leads, synthesizing failure insights and integrating high-rigor benchmarks into the model evaluation pipeline. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Education & Expertise: PhD in Physics, Electrical, Mechanical, or Aerospace Engineering (or a closely related discipline), with 5+ years of hands-on engineering design experience. 

- Proven Leadership Experience: Prior experience leading engineering teams, technical pods, or peer-review workflows, with a strong track record of mentoring contributors, calibrating quality standards, and driving deadline-oriented execution. 

- Simulation Tooling: Proficiency with at least one domain-relevant open-source simulation package (e. g. , ngspice, PySpice, OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, CalculiX, python-control, CadQuery, build123d, OpenModelica, Cantera, Gmsh) combined with strong Python scripting skills. 

- AI Evaluation & Failure Diagnostics: Hands-on experience with modern LLMs/coding agents and evaluation concepts (pass@k, failure-mode analysis, nondeterministic behavior), with the ability to audit trajectory logs and isolate core reasoning or tool-use failures. 

- Evaluation & QA Background: Prior experience in AI evaluation, technical content review, quality assurance, or a related analytical leadership role. 

- Domain Rigor & Precision: Uncompromising attention to physical plausibility, unit consistency, boundary conditions, convergence criteria, and technical documentation. 

- Availability & Commitment: Must have weekend on-call availability (part-time engagement is acceptable for weekend coverage) alongside core weekday overlap. 

- Technical Infrastructure: Personal desktop/laptop equipped with a stable, high-speed internet connection in a remote setup. 

Target Domains: 

- Electrical Engineering
 - Mechanical Engineering
 - Aerospace Engineering
 - Physics
