data.title: Manager- Quality
data.description:
ABOUT EURONICS

Euronics Industries Pvt. Ltd. is India's #1 washroom automation brand. Since 2002, we have built hand dryers, sensor taps, urinal sensors, soap dispensers, washroom panels and allied hygiene solutions trusted by 5, 00, 000+ customers. With a 2. 5 lakh sq ft manufacturing facility in Gurugram, 750+ SKUs and 70-80% of our products Made in India, our solutions are installed at landmark sites including the New Parliament Building, the Supreme Court of India and 18+ airports. 

ROLE PURPOSE

The Deputy Manager - Quality ensures every product leaving Euronics Industries and Techwork meets specification, certification and customer expectations. You will build one common, data-driven quality system across both entities, reduce the cost of poor quality, and keep ISO 9001 and BIS/ISI compliance audit-ready at all times. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Multi-Entity Quality Governance (Euronics + Techwork)

- Own and harmonise quality policies, SOPs, inspection standards and acceptance criteria across both entities. 
 - Run a single monthly Quality Review for both entities with shared KPIs, defect Pareto and action tracker. 
 - Allocate QC manpower and inspection capacity between entities based on production plans and risk. 

2. Quality Management System & Certifications

- Maintain the ISO 9001 QMS: document control, internal audits, management reviews and surveillance audit readiness. 
 - Ensure continuous compliance with BIS/ISI licence conditions, including product testing, marking and records. 
 - Support other product and green certifications held by the company and new certification projects. 
 - Act as the main point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies. 

3. Incoming, In-Process & Final Quality Control

- Define inspection plans, AQL sampling plans and checklists for bought-out parts, sub-assemblies and finished goods. 
 - Oversee incoming inspection of electrical, electronic, stainless steel, plastic and PVD-finished components. 
 - Drive in-process controls on assembly lines, including electrical safety, functional and endurance testing. 
 - Approve final product release (PDI) and block non-conforming lots. 

4. Supplier Quality Management

- Qualify new vendors through audits, PPAP / first article inspection and sample approval. 
 - Monitor supplier PPM and rating; run SCAR and development plans for poor performers. 
 - Coordinate quality checks for imported components with Purchase. 

5. Problem Solving, CAPA & Customer Complaints

- Lead root cause analysis using 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone and FMEA for internal defects, field failures and complaints. 
 - Close CAPA within agreed timelines and verify effectiveness. 
 - Partner with Service and Projects teams on site failure analysis and warranty return trends. 

6. Continuous Improvement & Cost of Poor Quality

- Track and reduce rework, scrap, rejections and warranty cost (COPQ). 
 - Deploy SPC, Poka-Yoke, 7 QC tools and Kaizen on critical processes. 
 - Support New Product Development with design reviews, DFMEA / PFMEA and pilot lot validation. 

7. Digital Quality & Reporting

- Move inspection records, NCRs and CAPA from paper to a digital system (dashboards, QMS software or ERP module). 
 - Publish a weekly quality MIS and a monthly dashboard for leadership. 
 - Identify automation opportunities: digital checklists, test-data capture and auto-alerts for repeat defects. 

8. Team Leadership & Calibration

- Lead, coach and evaluate QC engineers and inspectors across both entities; maintain a quality skill matrix. 
 - Train production operators on quality standards, first-time-right and defect awareness; drive 5S discipline. 
 - Maintain calibration schedule and traceability for all gauges, instruments and test equipment.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Manufacturing Technologies / Software Development Engineering (Apps)
data.description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. 

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That's where we come in. 

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. 

This isn't theoretical work. It's real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. 

We're looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. 

Join us and let's shape the future of data. 

Job Description

About the role

Western Digital runs process control systems that automate and coordinate equipment and process flow in its factories. This team develops and manages those systems for all Western Digital factories. They are low-latency, high-availability applications. A delay or defect can stop a production line, so correctness and reliability matter as much as features. 

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with ownership of control system software. You will own application components or services end to end, from design to production operation. You will write and debug code every day, make design decisions that have to hold up for years across many factories, and guide the engineers around you. 

What you will do

- Own control system components end to end. Take accountability for the correctness, latency, availability, and maintainability of the components you own, across all the factories that run them. 
 - Design for the long term. Choose architectures, data models, and technologies with the long term in mind: backward compatibility, upgradeability across sites, scalability, and the maintenance burden you leave the team. Record decisions and trade-offs in design documents, and revisit them as needs change. 
 - Build low-latency applications. Write production-quality, concurrent, high-performance code. Measure and tune latency and throughput, and design for predictable behavior under load and failure. 
 - Design messaging and integrations. Choose and implement messaging patterns between control applications, equipment interfaces, and other factory systems. Handle ordering, delivery guarantees, retries, and recovery. 
 - Manage data. Choose the right data store for each workload (relational, NoSQL, or time-series). Design schemas, indexes, and transactions, and tune performance using your knowledge of database internals. Plan data retention, migration, and consistency. 
 - Test rigorously. Define unit, integration, and failure-injection testing for your components. Set the quality bar for what is safe to release into a running factory. 
 - Deploy safely. Own build, packaging, and deployment pipelines. Roll out and roll back changes across factories with minimal or zero downtime, following change-management practices. 
 - Operate and debug what you build. Run your components against defined SLOs for latency and availability. Debug production problems across application code, databases, messaging, and infrastructure, using logs, metrics, traces, and profilers. Handle on-call response, find root causes, and fix recurring problems permanently. 
 - Partner with factory stakeholders. Work with factory automation, process, and operations engineers to turn their requirements into designs and drive delivery. 
 - Raise the engineering bar. Lead design and code reviews, find failure modes and systemic risks early, and coach junior and mid-level engineers, including by pairing on hard debugging problems. 
 - Use AI-assisted tools. Evaluate and use AI coding tools to improve development, testing, and documentation, and review their output with care. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 8+ years in software engineering, delivering production-grade systems. 
 - Strong hands-on coding and debugging skills. Proficiency in at least one systems or application language (for example C++, C#, Java, or Python), with strong computer science fundamentals. You can trace and fix performance, concurrency, and correctness problems in distributed or real-time systems. 
 - Experience designing and operating low-latency, high-availability applications, including concurrency, fault tolerance, and recovery. 
 - Experience with messaging and event-driven systems (message brokers, publish/subscribe, or event streaming), including delivery guarantees and failure handling. 
 - Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, including knowledge of internals and performance tuning (indexing, query plans, transactions, replication). 
 - Experience making and documenting long-term design decisions, with trade-offs in performance, reliability, cost, and maintainability. 
 - Experience with unit and integration testing, CI/CD, and deploying and operating applications in production, using containers or similar technology. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in manufacturing, semiconductor, or storage factory automation, or with equipment and process control systems. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, or deployment across many sites. 
 - Experience with time-series or real-time data stores. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development and agentic AI concepts. Technical skills

- Languages and debugging: C++, C#, Java, or Python. SQL. Debugging and profiling of concurrent and distributed systems. 
 - Messaging: Message brokers and event streaming (for example Kafka, RabbitMQ, or MQTT). 
 - Databases: Database internals, query optimization, and data modeling across SQL, NoSQL, and time-series systems. 
 - Testing and delivery: Unit, integration, and failure-injection testing, Git, CI/CD, containers. 
 - Observability and reliability: Metrics, logs, traces, alerting, high availability, and zero-downtime releases. 

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

WD thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company's growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex's customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights. 

The Global Merchant and Network Services Technology (GMNST) organization at American Express is responsible for modernizing the payments network to enable next-generation payments products. The team creates flexible merchant platforms to acquire, bill, pay, service and foster innovation, while enabling a payments ecosystem to connect and authenticate parties seamlessly and securely

As a Software Quality Engineer, you will join our Global Merchant and Network Services Technology team that has embarked on building a highly available and scalable distributed systems on the cloud to support the company's long-term strategy and vision. Your primary role includes driving execution across multiple Scrum teams, ensuring product backlog priorities are clearly defined, aligned to stakeholder needs, and delivered with high quality.

- Card Network Authorizations/Routing, Clearing and Settlement. 
 - ATM, Debit, Credit and Push Payment Transactions. 
 - Platform Engineering and Foundational Capabilities of distributed systems 
 - High Availability, Resiliency and Performance Engineering on Cloud

Responsibilities

- Define and drive the quality engineering strategy, architecture, standards, and roadmap for large-scale, distributed, mission-critical payment platforms. 
 - Provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams, influencing architecture, solution design, development practices, testing strategies, and production readiness. 
 - Architect, design, and develop scalable automation frameworks, platforms, tooling, and reusable quality engineering capabilities supporting functional, API, integration, system, regression, end-to-end, resiliency, and performance testing.

 - Define enterprise-grade testing approaches for distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, transactional platforms, and complex system integrations. 
 - Develop strategies for validating high-volume financial transactions, including authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and data integrity across distributed systems. 
 - Lead quality engineering efforts for high availability, resiliency, failover, disaster recovery, scalability, and performance of mission-critical platforms. 
 - Establish automated quality gates and integrate comprehensive testing capabilities into CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable and frequent software delivery. 
 - Define and evolve quality metrics, engineering scorecards, test coverage models, observability strategies, release readiness criteria, and production quality indicators. 
 - Leverage production telemetry, monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities to proactively identify quality risks and improve system reliability. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of complex production and pre-production issues spanning application, infrastructure, cloud, database, messaging, and integration layers. 
 - Identify systemic engineering and quality gaps and drive long-term solutions rather than point-in-time fixes. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, open-source frameworks, AI-assisted engineering capabilities, and industry practices to continuously evolve the organization's quality engineering capabilities. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, product management, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security, and operations teams to ensure successful delivery of highly scalable and resilient platforms. 
 - Provide technical mentorship and guidance to Quality Engineers and Software Engineers, raising engineering standards and strengthening quality engineering capabilities across teams. 
 - Influence engineering leaders and stakeholders across organizational boundaries and drive alignment on quality priorities, technical investments, risks, and remediation strategies. 
 - Lead quality engineering for complex, cross-functional initiatives involving globally distributed engineering teams and multiple dependent platforms. 
 - Champion a culture where quality, reliability, performance, and operational excellence are shared engineering responsibilities. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or related engineering disciplines, including significant experience providing technical leadership for complex software platforms. 
 - 5+ years of experience in Payments, Banking, FinTech, Financial Services, Card Networks, or other high-volume transactional environments strongly preferred. 
 - Deep understanding of payment processing concepts such as authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, ATM, debit, credit, and push-payment processing is highly desirable. 
 - Advanced programming skills in Java, Python, or comparable object-oriented programming languages, with demonstrated experience building production-quality automation frameworks, engineering tools, or test platforms. 
 - Proven experience architecting and implementing scalable automation frameworks and reusable testing capabilities for APIs, microservices, distributed systems, integration, and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with API and service testing technologies such as Rest Assured, Karate, Postman, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, including microservices, asynchronous/event-driven processing, messaging, APIs, databases, caching, and service-to-service integrations. 
 - Strong SQL and data engineering/testing skills, with demonstrated experience validating complex transactional workflows and high-volume financial datasets. 
 - Extensive experience designing automated testing strategies and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps and software delivery practices. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures and experience validating applications deployed on public or private cloud platforms. 
 - Demonstrated experience with reliability, resiliency, scalability, performance, failover, disaster recovery, and high-availability testing for mission-critical systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience supporting and troubleshooting high-volume, business-critical production systems with stringent availability and reliability requirements. 
 - Demonstrated ability to assess complex architectures, identify systemic quality and operational risks, and influence engineering teams toward effective technical solutions. 
 - Proven track record of leading quality engineering initiatives spanning multiple teams, platforms, and organizational boundaries. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile engineering practices and experience delivering large, complex, cross-functional technology initiatives. 
 - Exceptional analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and root cause analysis capabilities, with the ability to navigate complex distributed-system failures.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts and risks effectively to engineers, architects, product leaders, and senior technology stakeholders. 
 - Strong ownership mindset with a passion for engineering excellence, automation, operational reliability, continuous improvement, and customer-centric delivery. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline preferred. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. data.title: Senior Java Full Stack Lead
data.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change. 

By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses. 

From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters. 

Job Description

Overview

We are looking for a skilled and experienced Senior Java Full Stack Lead to join our development team. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in object-oriented programming, strong experience with the Spring Framework, and practical frontend experience with React JS. 

This role requires a collaborative mindset, a sharp eye for detail, and an interest in developing high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance, reusable Java applications. 
 - Develop and maintain responsive frontend components using React JS, JavaScript, and related technologies. 
 - Develop and optimize SQL queries for relational databases such as DB2 or Oracle. 
 - Work with messaging systems such as RabbitMQ. 
 - Develop scalable solutions using microservices architecture to ensure modularity, availability, and ease of deployment in distributed systems. 
 - Build and consume RESTful APIs to enable backend-to-frontend integration
 - Analyse requirements and propose effective technical solutions considering functional and non-functional requirements. 
 - Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support. 
 - Write automated unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito. 
 - Write and maintain documentation of software components and code. 
 - Conduct and participate in peer code reviews and design discussions. 
 - Ensure performance, security, and availability of applications. 
 - Identify and address technical risks and issues; propose and implement practical solutions. 
 - Conduct demos and facilitate acceptance discussions with Product Owners to validate deliverables. 
 - Maintain a proactive attitude toward learning and adopting new tools and frameworks. 

Qualifications

Required experience and skills

8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on delivery of backend or distributed systems; the technical lead should typically have 10+ years. 

Strong Java experience (Java 17 or later preferred) and production experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, service design, testing, and troubleshooting. 

Experience designing distributed systems and event-driven architectures, including Kafka or a compatible platform such as Amazon MSK. 

Experience deploying or operating containerised services on Kubernetes; AWS EKS experience is strongly preferred. 

Sound understanding of relational databases and SQL, data modelling, transactions, concurrency, schema evolution, and performance tuning. 

Experience with at least one document database and one Redis-compatible in-memory data platform; understanding of when to use each and their consistency and failure trade-offs. 

Practical knowledge of API and event versioning, idempotency, resiliency patterns, back-pressure, timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation. 

Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, source control, code review, and production support for business-critical services. 

Clear communication skills and the ability to explain design trade-offs and work effectively across teams. 

Preferred experience

Experience in payments, fintech, commerce, banking, provider integrations, or another regulated, business-critical domain. 

Familiarity with payment lifecycle concepts, provider routing, payment status handling, reconciliation, refunds or reversals, and operational exception flows. 

Experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS, Secrets Manager, KMS, IAM, CloudWatch, and managed messaging or networking services. 

Experience with Datadog and OpenTelemetry, including distributed tracing and service-level indicators. 

Infrastructure as code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation; Helm and GitOps-based Kubernetes delivery. 

Awareness of PCI DSS and secure handling of sensitive payment data. Direct compliance implementation experience is an advantage, not a substitute for sound engineering fundamentals. 

Technology environment

Core engineering environment: 
Java and Spring Boot; AWS EKS; Amazon MSK; Amazon DocumentDB with MongoDB compatibility; Amazon MemoryDB for Redis; Amazon RDS; Amazon S3; AWS Secrets Manager; and Datadog. The final service choices and versions will be confirmed during solution design. 

Candidates should be able to reason from workload needs and operating requirements rather than assume a particular service is right for every use case. 

Recommended stack additions and design clarifications

API edge and protection: 
identify whether Kong or Amazon API Gateway will own external API management, and include AWS WAF where public web APIs require managed edge protection. 

Async work and recovery: 
use MSK for domain event streams where replay and multiple consumers matter; consider SQS with dead-letter queues for isolated work queues and controlled redelivery. Define outbox/inbox and idempotency patterns across database and message boundaries. 

Security and audit: 
include AWS KMS, IAM roles for service accounts, CloudTrail, network segmentation, and a clear sensitive-data and tokenisation approach. Confirm applicable PCI DSS scope and market-specific obligations with the client security team. 

Platform delivery: 
include infrastructure as code, Helm, CI/CD or GitOps, automated security checks, environment promotion, and tested rollback procedures. 

Telemetry: 
standardise on OpenTelemetry-compatible instrumentation and consistent correlation IDs; use Datadog as the operational view, with CloudWatch retained where needed for AWS-native signals. 

Database fit: 
confirm DocumentDB API and feature compatibility against the application's MongoDB driver and required behaviors before locking the choice. Use MemoryDB when Redis-compatible in-memory data durability is required; if the primary need is an expendable low-latency cache, evaluate ElastiCache for Redis/Valkey. Specify the RDS engine and its purpose. 

Workflow orchestration: 
keep latency-sensitive payment processing paths lean. Consider a workflow engine for long-running or human-assisted exception flows only when the state, timeout, and recovery requirements justify it. 

Additional Information

At Endava, we're committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives-because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

data.title: RIS IMS Solution Architect - AI Validation & ERP Integration Sr Manager
data.description:
Overview

Lead solution architecture for AI Validation and ERP Integration across Integrated Managed Services (IMS), with a focus on mid-market clients. Own the technical solution from RFI/RFP/RFQ through transition and steady state, ensuring Generative and Agentic AI is securely integrated into ERP processes, validated before go-live and remains trustworthy in production. Requires 18+ years across ERP, integration, quality engineering and managed services, with recent hands-on AI validation experience. 

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end IMS architecture across ERP, integration, data, AI, security and service management; define target architecture, principles and guardrails. 

Assess application landscapes, technical debt and operational risk and create roadmaps aligned to client budgets, maturity and risk appetite. 

Design AI validation frameworks for SAP Joule, Oracle AI Agent Studio, Dynamics 365 Copilot, NetSuite AI and custom agents using Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, Vertex AI, Claude, Gemini or GPT. 

Apply risk-based validation including business rules, schema checks, grounding, ground-truth comparison, LLM-as-a-judge, confidence scoring and transaction reconciliation. 

Build golden datasets, scenario libraries, red-team tests and regression suites. Define risk-tiered autonomy, human approvals, escalation, fallback and rollback. 

Ensure traceability across source data, models, prompts, tool calls, validation, approvals and ERP transactions. Produce audit-ready evidence aligned to SOX, GxP, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001. 

Architect AI integrations with SAP S/4HANA/BTP, Oracle Fusion/EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Coupa using APIs, events, OData, batch and MCP. 

Apply least privilege, segregation of duties, transaction limits, reconciliation and recovery. Evaluate native ERP AI versus custom agents based on quality, control, cost and vendor lock-in. 

Design AI-enabled managed services covering incident triage, ticket routing, root-cause assistance, knowledge copilots and ERP exception handling. 

Define ITIL 4 operating models, SLAs and KPIs for accuracy, groundedness, automation, human overrides, latency and cost. Establish controls for hallucination, grounding failure, unauthorized actions and drift. 

Own technical responses for IMS pursuits, solution defence, due diligence and delivery handover. Develop staffing, location, licensing and AI-consumption models and support commercial constructs. 

Lead client workshops and apply Forward Deployment Engineering to test integration, AI quality, security, latency and cost. Develop reusable AI Validation CoE assets, templates and automated evaluation gates. 

Qualifications

18+ years in solution architecture, ERP, integration, quality engineering or managed services, including 10+ years delivering major ERP/integration solutions. 

Recent Generative/Agentic AI production experience involving evaluation, validation, human-in-the-loop or governance controls. 

Deep expertise in at least one ERP ecosystem: SAP S/4HANA/BTP, Oracle Fusion/Integration, Dynamics 365/Power Platform or NetSuite, plus working knowledge of another. 

Experience with ERP validation and regulated controls such as SOX or GxP. 

Proven ownership of RFI/RFP/RFQ pursuits, including estimation, staffing, pricing and solution defence. 

Experience across Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay or Order-to-Cash. 

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent experience. 

Preferred Skills

Agentic AI, RAG, MCP, guardrails, AI evaluation/observability, REST/OData, OAuth 2. 0, RBAC, Tricentis, Worksoft, SAP Cloud ALM, ITIL 4 and ServiceNow. Strong commercial acumen in estimation, TCO/ROI and outcome-based pricing. Relevant ERP, cloud, AI, ITIL or ISO/IEC 42001 certifications are advantageous.

data.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. 

The Lead DevOps Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership for the cloud platforms, delivery pipelines, and production operations supporting Claims Global Claims Operations and Claims AI solutions. This role owns the engineering standards and automation required to move services, data workloads, and AI/ML capabilities safely from development through production at enterprise scale. 

The ideal candidate is a senior DevOps and platform engineer who can design secure AWS infrastructure, build reusable CI/CD patterns, operate Kubernetes-based workloads, establish SRE practices, and lead engineers through complex releases and production events. The role requires strong judgment across speed, reliability, security, compliance, and cloud cost. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Cloud Platform & Infrastructure Engineering
 - Design, build, and operate secure, scalable, highly available AWS infrastructure for application, data, and AI/ML workloads
 - Create reusable Infrastructure-as-Code modules using Terraform and CloudFormation, with versioning, automated validation, policy controls, and documented consumption patterns
 - Engineer container platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS, including ingress, autoscaling, secrets, configuration, service networking, and workload isolation
 - Define environment strategy, account and network patterns, capacity models, backup and recovery controls, and production-readiness standards
 - Optimize platform performance, resilience, and cloud cost using measurable capacity, utilization, and unit-cost indicators
 - CI/CD, Release Engineering & Developer Enablement
 - Architect and maintain standardized CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and/or Jenkins for application, infrastructure, data, and AI/ML deployments
 - Implement automated build, test, security scan, artifact management, approval, deployment, and rollback controls across environments
 - Enable safe release patterns such as blue-green, canary, feature flags, progressive delivery, and automated rollback based on service health
 - Build paved-road templates, reusable actions, documentation, and self-service capabilities that improve developer productivity and reduce deployment variability
 - Partner with engineering teams to remove delivery bottlenecks and improve deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and recovery time
 - Reliability, Observability & Production Operations
 - Establish SRE practices including service-level indicators, service-level objectives, error budgets, operational readiness reviews, and reliability backlogs
 - Implement end-to-end observability across metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, pipelines, infrastructure, and business-critical workflows
 - Lead incident response, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for complex production issues; improve runbooks and operational automation
 - Eliminate recurring operational toil through automation, resilience testing, capacity planning, and failure-mode remediation
 - Own or influence on-call readiness, escalation paths, disaster recovery validation, and controlled production ramp-up
 - DevSecOps, Governance & Compliance
 - Embed security throughout the delivery lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, container and IaC scanning, secrets detection, and artifact provenance
 - Implement least-privilege IAM, secure secrets management, encryption, network controls, vulnerability remediation, and auditable deployment approvals
 - Partner with architecture, security, risk, and compliance teams to meet enterprise controls and healthcare data protection expectations, including HIPAA-aligned handling of protected health information
 - Apply policy-as-code and guardrails without creating unnecessary friction for engineering teams
 - AI/ML Platform Enablement
 - Enable reliable deployment and operation of AI/ML, GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI services, including model and prompt configuration, vector stores, evaluation gates, and runtime monitoring
 - Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to implement MLOps/LLMOps patterns for packaging, promotion, observability, rollback, and governance
 - Support secure integration of AWS services such as Amazon Bedrock, S3, Lambda, ECR, EKS, CloudWatch, IAM, and related data services
 - Technical Leadership & Collaboration
 - Lead platform design reviews, production-readiness reviews, release planning, and technical decision-making across multiple delivery teams
 - Mentor DevOps and software engineers, set coding and automation standards, and provide actionable design and code-review feedback
 - Communicate risks, trade-offs, dependencies, operational health, and remediation plans clearly to engineering, product, business, and leadership stakeholders
 - Coordinate across application, data, AI/ML, architecture, security, infrastructure, and support teams to deliver measurable outcomes
 - Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements. 
Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 10+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, SRE, or software infrastructure roles
 - 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience delivering production systems using core services such as EKS, EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, VPC, ECR, CloudWatch, and load balancing
 - 5+ years of experience building enterprise CI/CD and release automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or comparable platforms
 - 4+ years of Infrastructure-as-Code experience using Terraform; experience creating reusable modules, testing IaC, and managing remote state
 - 3+ years of hands-on Kubernetes and Docker experience in production, including deployment, scaling, networking, security, and troubleshooting
 - 2+ years leading technical designs, mentoring engineers, and coordinating delivery across multiple teams
 - Experience with observability platforms and practices covering metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards, and incident response
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps controls, cloud security, secrets management, IAM, vulnerability management, and compliance evidence
 - Solid scripting or programming capability in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Go, plus proficiency with Git and Linux

Preferred Qualifications

- AWS certification such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional or AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional
 - Certified Kubernetes Administrator or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer
 - Experience with Argo CD, Helm, GitOps, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog, or comparable platforms
 - Experience operating data platforms and distributed workloads using Spark, Glue, EMR, Redshift, Kafka, Databricks, or modern lakehouse technologies
 - Experience enabling MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, Amazon Bedrock, vector databases, RAG, semantic search, or AI evaluation and monitoring
 - Experience supporting claims, provider, eligibility, prior authorization, utilization management, or other healthcare workflows in a regulated environment
 - Experience with resilience engineering, chaos testing, disaster recovery exercises, FinOps, and platform-product operating models

Capability And Expected SG29 Proficiency

- AWS & cloud architecture - Designs production-grade infrastructure, networking, IAM, resilience, and cost controls
 - CI/CD & release engineering - Creates reusable enterprise pipelines and safe deployment patterns with measurable delivery outcomes
 - Kubernetes & containers - Operates secure EKS environments and troubleshoots workload, networking, scaling, and platform issues
 - Infrastructure as Code - Builds governed, tested, reusable Terraform modules and automated environment provisioning
 - SRE & observability - Defines SLOs, improves availability, leads incidents, and reduces recurring operational toil

 - Technical leadership - Leads cross-team designs and releases, mentors engineers, and communicates risks and trade-offs

Success Measures for the Role

data.title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer LAN
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's local area network and campus switching platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across local area network and campus switching to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Key Relationships/Customers

Business Stakeholders

- Internal GSK teams consuming the platform as customers of its self-service capability
 - Quality and compliance functions where the platform supports GxP activity

Tech Stakeholders

- Engineering Director as line manager and owner of the engineering roadmap
 - Platform Architect for reference architectures, patterns and standards
 - Product Owner for backlog order and acceptance of engineering-led items
 - Site Reliability Engineer and Reliability Engineering & Operations for SLOs, observability and incident prevention
 - Other Principal Engineers and platform engineers across the domain

Other

- Managed service partners contributing engineering capacity to the platform. 
 - Technology vendors during evaluation and proof of concept

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Why is this level of Education Required?

- Deep engineering credentials are needed because the role sets the engineering standard other engineers and partner teams build to, and that standard has to hold under code review rather than by assertion. 

Experience Required

- Overall 15 years typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 
 - Extensive experience engineering enterprise local area networks and campus switching services. 
 - Strong knowledge of routing, switching, segmentation, resilience and complex fault diagnosis. 
 - Evidence of applying standards and automation to improve deployment quality, reliability or supportability. 

Desirable Requirements

- Professional level enterprise networking certification, such as CCNP Enterprise or JNCIP Enterprise Routing and Switching. 
 - Experience with application programming interfaces, infrastructure as code or network assurance platforms. 
 - Experience supporting manufacturing, laboratory or operational technology networks. 

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

#AGTech

Skills

Automation Technology, Cisco Switching, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Network Engineering, Networks, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), SRE Observability, System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. data.title: AI Engineering
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

AI Engineering

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline.

You will primarily focus on Inline Quality Control and Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI), while working closely with our vendor partners, NPD, and Sourcing teams to ensure garments are produced as per SAADAA's defined quality standards. WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR?

- Manage Inline QC and PDI processes at vendor factories to ensure garments meet SAADAA's defined quality standards.

 - Work closely with NPD and Sourcing teams to ensure products are manufactured as per approved samples, specifications, and quality expectations. 
 - Review QC booklets and ensure all quality checkpoints and standards are clearly understood and followed by vendors. 
 - Conduct vendor capability audits to evaluate manufacturing, technical, and quality capabilities. 
 - Support vendor onboarding from a quality and capability perspective. 
 - Train and upskill vendor QC teams and factory teams on garment quality standards, inspection processes, workmanship, and common quality issues. 
 - Train and develop internal team members to strengthen their technical and quality capabilities. 
 - Analyse recurring quality issues, identify root causes, and work with vendors to implement sustainable improvements. 
 - Maintain quality inspection reports, defect analysis, vendor performance reports, and other quality-related MIS. 
 - Present quality analysis and improvement opportunities to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Track vendor quality performance and ensure timely closure of quality-related issues. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve quality processes, vendor capabilities, and overall garment quality. 

Who You Are

- 5+ years of experience in garment/apparel quality, preferably in vendor quality management. 
 - Strong technical understanding of garments and apparel manufacturing. 
 - Strong knowledge of garment construction, workmanship, measurements, and finishing standards. 
 - Hands-on experience in Inline QC and PDI/Final Inspection. 
 - Experience working directly with garment vendors and factory teams. 
 - Strong vendor management and relationship management skills. 
 - Experience in training and upskilling vendor QC and factory teams. 
 - Strong understanding of quality inspection processes and defect identification. 
 - Proficiency in MS Excel and ability to maintain and analyse quality reports. 
 - Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Highly organised, detail-oriented, and process-driven. 
 - Strong ownership and ability to independently drive quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Clear communication and ability to collaborate effectively with NPD, Sourcing, vendors, and internal teams. 
 - Curious to learn, improve processes, and continuously raise the quality standards of our products. 

WHY BE A PART OF सादा / SAADAA?

- Do you feel out of place in a world full of unnecessary complexities?
 - Do you find joy in little things?
 - Are you someone who naturally observes how things are made, improved, and optimised?
 - Do you believe life is simple - people just overcomplicate it?
 - Are you excited by the idea of learning something new every day?

If yes, this is the right place for you. We believe the world is overloaded with complexity. At सादा / SAADAA, we simplify - products, processes, thinking. Better basics are not just products; they are a way of life. 

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

- A team of empathetic and purpose-driven problem solvers.

 - Freedom to explore, experiment, fail, and grow.

data.title: Engineer II, Supplier Quality (PCB Commodity)
data.description:
Join our team and help shape the future of connectivity indoors and outdoors. Together, let's push the boundaries of technology and advance sustainable networks worldwide. 

How You'll Help Us Connect The World

As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for end-to-end supplier quality management, supplier development and technical quality ownership for RF and electronic commodities. The role involves supplier qualification, process audits, new product development, APQP/PPAP, quality issue resolution, supplier improvement and continuous monitoring of supplier performance. 

You Will Make An Impact By

- Managing complete supplier quality lifecycle from supplier selection and qualification to mass production; conducting supplier process, product and system audits; developing and implementing supplier Quality Improvement Plans. 
 - Monitoring supplier PPM, rejection, rework, FPY, COPQ and quality trends; driving supplier 8D, RCA, CAPA, 5-Why and Fishbone analysis; verifying corrective action implementation and effectiveness at supplier end. 
 - Handling supplier escalations and coordinating with Purchase, R&D, Manufacturing, IQC and Quality teams. 
 - Reviewing and approving supplier process/material changes and deviations; driving continuous improvement and cost-of-poor-quality reduction; supporting supplier development for new technologies and new products. 
 - Managing quality of RF antenna and PTFE/high-frequency PCB suppliers. 
 - Reviewing RF antenna construction, material, dimensional and assembly requirements. 
 - Handling PTFE PCB manufacturing quality including lamination, drilling, PTH/via, copper plating, PISM, etching, surface finish and routing. 
 - Reviewing microsection/cross-section reports and reliability test results. 
 - Managing supplier quality for RF cables, coaxial cables and RF connectors. 
 - Review cable construction, conductor, shielding, insulation and termination quality. 
 - Handling connector quality including terminal dimensions, plating, contact resistance, insertion/withdrawal force and mating performance; Conducting supplier audits for cable extrusion, crimping, assembly and connector manufacturing processes. 
 - Managing supplier quality for SMT, THT and PCBA assembly; Reviewing and controlling SMT process, solder paste printing, SPI, pick & place, reflow, AOI, X-Ray, wave soldering, THT assembly, cleaning, conformal coating and functional testing. 
 - Drive improvement of FPY, DPMO, solder defects and process capability. 
 - Handle defects such as solder bridging, insufficient solder, tombstoning, voiding, open/short, component damage and workmanship issues. 
 - Managing supplier quality for solder wire, solder paste and related soldering materials; reviewing material specifications, MSDS/COA, shelf life and storage requirements. 
 - Monitoring solder paste parameters such as viscosity, metal content, powder type and printability. 
 - Controlling soldering process parameters including reflow profile, TAL, peak temperature and wave soldering parameters. 
 - Managing supplier quality for DC motors / geared motors; reviewing motor construction, materials and manufacturing processes. Monitoring critical parameters like torque, speed, current, voltage, noise, vibration, efficiency, stall current / stall torque and endurance. 
 - Conducting supplier process audits covering armature, winding, magnet, commutator, brush, bearing, gear and motor assembly processes. 
 - Supporting motor performance and reliability failure analysis; driving supplier improvement for noise, vibration, torque variation and premature failure. 
 - Supporting NPI and supplier development activities; reviewing supplier APQP, PPAP, FAI, PFMEA, process flow, control plan and MSA; qualifying new suppliers and alternate sources. 

Required Qualifications For Consideration

- B. E. /BTech in Electronics / Mechanical or equivalent with at least 8 years of relevant working experience in Supplier Quality / SQE / SQA / Electronics Manufacturing / EMS. 
 - Commodity Experience - RF PCB manufacturing process / development expert. 
 - Strong framework in wet processes & special coating processes. 
 - Solid understanding of basic and advanced tools such as; Six Sigma, SPC, FMEA, Control Plans, Root Cause Analysis, DOE, Poke Yoke, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing etc. 
 - Working knowledge of IPC-A-600, IPC-A-610, IPC-6012, IPC-TM-650, IATF 16949 / ISO 9001, APQP/PPAP, PFMEA/Control Plan, SPC/MSA, 8D/RCA/CAPA. 

You Will Excite Us If You

- Are proficient in SAP, Minitab, Power BI. 
 - Have hands-on CAD experience interpreting technical drawings and analyzing simulation results. 
 - Demonstrate strong decision-making and interpersonal skills. 
 - Are assertive and have excellent communication skills 
 - Are willing to travel to supplier sites.

data.title: Software Engineer - Siemens Teamcenter PLM, 9-13 Yrs
data.description:
Meet the Team

Join our diverse and inclusive Supply Chain IT team, part of one of the world's leading Supply Chains. We deliver crucial services, tools, platforms, and data that power this top-tier operation. At Cisco, we prioritize innovation and continuous evolution, optimizing and automating business processes, employing cloud services, and developing ground breaking in-house solutions. You will be part of a dynamic, empowered, and collaborative team that values diverse perspectives and inclusive practices, passionate about building, supporting, and improving a seamless end-to-end Orchestrator system. We are committed to encouraging an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute outstanding ideas and experiences. 

Your Impact

In this role, you will bridge design engineering with world-class supply chain operations to accelerate time-to-market, ensure product compliance, and drive supply chain excellence through our PLM platform. Collaborating with dedicated engineers and business partners, you will lead the end-to-end IT solution architecture for Siemens Teamcenter (Active Workspace), with expertise in Item & BOM Management, Engineering Change Management, Advanced Classification, Vendor Collaboration, and other modules. You will drive innovation by exploring AI-driven capabilities, establish standards for Teamcenter configuration, and ensure scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with long-term PLM strategy. Your leadership will guide functional teams, manage cross-track dependencies, and optimize workflows using emerging technologies such as AI. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect scalable BMIDE data models, dynamic LOVs, naming rules, revision/versioning rules, and Deep Copy Rules (DCR), adhering strictly to out-of-the-box design principles. 
 - Expore and implement emerging capabilities such as AI-driven automated part classification, geometric deduplication, and digital thread traceability from requirements to manufacturing execution. 
 - Partner with business leadership to challenge, rationalize, and finalize business requirements, ensuring alignment with strategic goals. 
 - Establish principles for Teamcenter standardization, fit-to-standard approaches, configuration versus customization, and solution reuse. 
 - Evaluate sophisticated requirements to determine appropriate Teamcenter solutions, considering cross-module and cross-system impacts. 
 - Review and approve IT solutions, ensuring alignment across multiple project tracks and providing direction to functional leads and development teams on complex decisions. 
 - Identify cross-track dependencies, functional gaps, and risks, driving timely resolution to maintain project momentum. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 9-13 years of tactical experience in PLM implementations, including Siemens Teamcenter and Active Workspace
 - Validated expertise designing integrations between Teamcenter and ERP systems
 - Exceptional partner management skills with the ability to communicate architectural decisions to executive leadership and technical teams
 - Strong understanding of AI/GenAI opportunities in PLM and enterprise applications
 - Sophisticated knowledge of AI concepts and practical implementation experience, with strong security proficiency
 - Solid understanding of Agile and DevSecOps practices and toolsets

 - Siemens certifications (e. g. , Teamcenter Deployment Specialist or Solution Architect)
 - Experience with AI orchestration platforms and knowledge of vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or semantic search

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Position Overview

Autodesk is seeking a dynamic Vice President of Engineering to lead the global engineering organization responsible for the design and simulation capabilities of Autodesk Fusion. Fusion is used by designers and manufacturers worldwide to bring innovative products to life, and the engineering team behind it has built a trusted platform that customers rely on every day. 

This role will lead the next chapter of Fusion's engineering evolution. Over the next three years, you will guide the organization through a strategic transformation by embedding Artificial Intelligence (AI)-native development, cloud-native architecture, and continuous delivery into the engineering operating model while continuing to deliver the product roadmap our customers expect. The objective is to significantly accelerate product innovation and roadmap execution with AI as a key enabler. 

Based in Pune, India, this role leads a global engineering organization distributed across Asia, Europe, and North America. Reporting to the Vice President of Design, you will partner closely with Product Management, Experience Design, Architecture, and Go-to-Market leadership to shape the future of Autodesk Fusion.

 - Evolve engineering practices by enabling teams to leverage AI effectively while maintaining rigorous engineering standards, validation processes, and technical oversight
 - Build quality, reliability, and observability into the platform through automation, instrumentation, continuous verification, and production monitoring
 - Advance the platform architecture by promoting modular design, well-defined interfaces, strong abstraction boundaries, and loosely coupled systems
 - Enable independent engineering teams to deliver continuously across a portfolio of composable platform capabilities

Preferred Qualifications

 - Master of Business Administration (MBA) or another advanced business degree

- Demonstrates a compelling vision for the future of software engineering and successfully leads organizations through large-scale technology transformation
 - Combines deep technical expertise with strategic business acumen to make informed decisions that balance innovation, quality, scalability, and customer value

 - Builds high-performing global engineering organizations by developing talent, empowering leaders, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous learning
 - Drives architectural excellence by promoting modern engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, automation, and operational excellence
 - Influences executive stakeholders and builds strong partnerships across Product Management, Design, Sales, Marketing, and customer organizations
