data.description:
Business Unit: 

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details: 

Role purpose

The Automation Specialist builds and runs one automation capability for both the NOC and the SOC. The role turns repetitive monitoring, event handling, remediation and security response work into tested, documented and measurable automation, so the operation can scale without adding headcount at the same rate. 

The role sets the standards that all automation must follow, selects the right tool for each use case (SOAR, runbook automation, ITSM workflow or monitoring-tool logic) and makes sure NOC and SOC priorities are balanced fairly through one shared backlog. 

Job Details: 

Job Description

Automation Specialist, NOC/SOC

Observability and Automation team | Service Operations

Job title

Automation Specialist, NOC/SOC

Grade

P3

Department

Service Operations: Observability and Automation team, NOC/SOC

Reports to

NOC Manager

Dotted line to

SOC Manager

Location

India (Hyderabad)

Shift

Day shift or UK shift (IST hours as rostered); occasional out-of-hours support for critical incidents and changes

Direct reports

None

Scope

NOC and SOC automation for 4, scaling to the wider portfolio overtime

Role purpose

The Automation Specialist builds and runs one automation capability for both the NOC and the SOC. The role turns repetitive monitoring, event handling, remediation and security response work into tested, documented and measurable automation, so the operation can scale without adding headcount at the same rate. 

The role sets the standards that all automation must follow, selects the right tool for each use case (SOAR, runbook automation, ITSM workflow or monitoring-tool logic) and makes sure NOC and SOC priorities are balanced fairly through one shared backlog. 

Key responsibilities

Platform and strategy

- Represent CTS Service Operations (NOC and SOC) in the enterprise SOAR platform decision led by the CISO's office: supply CTS use cases, integration requirements (Splunk, CrowdStrike, Tenable, Imperva, Jira/ITSM, monitoring tools) and PCI DSS needs, and take part in the proof of concept. 
 - Plan and run the move of existing CTS automations from Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR (end of sale February 2026) to the enterprise platform selected, before the XSOAR contract ends; keep new XSOAR-specific build to the minimum in the meantime. 
 - Administer the CTS workspace on the enterprise platform: integrations, credentials and secrets, access control and health, keeping CTS (PCI DSS) data and workflows separate from other divisions, working with the enterprise platform owner. 
 - Design automation to be vendor-neutral where practical, keeping business logic portable between platforms. 
 - Choose the right tool for each use case: SOAR for security response and cross-tool orchestration; Ansible, Azure Automation, AWS Systems Manager, PowerShell or Python for infrastructure remediation; Jira/ITSM workflow for ticket handling; monitoring-tool logic for correlation and suppression. 

Automation standards and lifecycle

- Define and publish the automation framework: intake, use-case scoring (volume, time saved, risk), design template, coding standards and naming. 
 - Hold all automation code and playbooks in Git with peer review, non-production testing, change approval before production and a documented rollback. 
 - Where the platform is no-code or low-code, enable NOC and SOC analysts to build their own workflows within the standard, with review and approval before production. 
 - Require human approval steps for any destructive or customer-impacting action (for example host isolation, account disable, service restart in production). 
 - Monitor automation runs, alert on failures and keep audit logs of every automated action in line with PCI DSS retention requirements. 
 - Use least-privilege service accounts and managed secrets for every integration. 

NOC automation

- Work with the Monitoring and Observability Lead and monitoring engineers to reduce alert noise through enrichment, de-duplication, correlation and dependency-based suppression. 
 - Automate ticket creation in Jira/ITSM with context attached: configuration item, owner, contract, recent changes, related alerts and linked runbook. 
 - Build auto-remediation for the most frequent recurring events (for example service restarts, disk clean-up, tablespace or log growth, failovers), starting with the top 10 by volume. 
 - Link maintenance-mode suppression to approved changes, so planned work does not raise incidents. 
 - Automate routine checks such as backup job verification, certificate expiry and capacity thresholds. 

SOC automation

- Inventory existing Splunk alert actions and triggers and bring them under the automation standard. 
 - Build and maintain security playbooks with SOC Tier 2 and Tier 3, starting with phishing triage, malware/EDR detections (CrowdStrike Falcon), account compromise, malicious IP blocking (Palo Alto, Imperva) and critical vulnerability ticketing (Tenable). 
 - Automate enrichment of security alerts (asset, owner, threat intelligence, vulnerability status) to cut investigation time. 
 - Capture evidence automatically for PCI DSS requirements, including daily log review (10. 4. 1), response to logging failures (10. 7) and incident response (12. 10). 
 - Encode the PCI DSS 12. 10 incident response steps, including acquirer and payment brand notification timelines, as explicit, testable playbook steps; confirm time synchronisation (10. 6) is verified at the infrastructure layer rather than assumed from the platform. 

Integration

- Integrate monitoring and security tools with the automation platform and ITSM: Splunk, CrowdStrike, Tenable, Imperva, SolarWinds, AppDynamics, Site24x7, Azure Monitor, and AFCMS where APIs allow. 
 - Work with the SRE team (AWS CloudWatch) and L3 DB team (Oracle OEM) under the federated monitoring model to route their events and automate their use cases. 

Collaboration and prioritisation

- Run one shared automation backlog in Jira for NOC and SOC requests. 
 - Hold a monthly prioritisation meeting with the NOC Manager and SOC Manager and report against the agreed capacity split (initially about 60% NOC, 40% SOC). 
 - Work alongside the Monitoring and Observability Lead, who remains team lead and owns intake and allocation for monitoring work. 
 - Share playbooks and practices with SOAR users in other Cubic divisions through the enterprise platform owner. 

Documentation, training and reporting

- Document every production automation in Confluence: purpose, trigger, steps, approvals, owner, rollback and known limits, using the team's templates. 
 - Train NOC and SOC analysts on running, approving and troubleshooting automations. 
 - Publish a monthly automation value report covering the KPIs below. 

Expectations for the first six months

- By day 30: Inventory of current automations, scripts and Splunk triggers; baseline of alert volumes, MTTA and MTTR for in-scope contracts; shared Jira backlog live. 
 - By day 60: Automation framework and standards published and approved by NOC and SOC managers. 
 - By day 90: CTS use cases and requirements submitted to the enterprise SOAR proof of concept; XSOAR migration plan agreed; first 5 automations in production. 
 - By month 6: Top 10 NOC event automations and top 5 SOC playbooks in production; all existing Splunk triggers under the standard. 

Key performance indicators

Targets apply to contracts onboarded to the NOC/SOC and are measured against the baseline taken in the first 30 days. Targets will be reviewed annually. 

KPI

Target

How It Is Measured

Enterprise SOAR proof of concept input

CTS use cases and requirements submitted within 90 days, or by the POC start if sooner

XSOAR migration

100% of CTS production playbooks migrated or retired before the XSOAR contract end date

Automation register

Quarterly survey

Essential

Qualifications and experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or equivalent experience. 
 - 6+ years in IT operations, infrastructure or security engineering, including 3+ years building automation in production. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one SOAR platform (Tines, Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Microsoft Sentinel with Logic Apps, FortiSOAR, Rapid7 InsightConnect or similar), and comfortable working in both no-code builders and code. 
 - Strong Python; working knowledge of PowerShell or Bash. 
 - REST APIs, JSON and webhooks; integrating tools that do not share a native connector. 
 - Splunk searching (SPL), alerting and alert actions. 
 - At least one runbook automation tool: Ansible, Azure Automation or AWS Systems Manager. 
 - Git-based development, code review and testing practices. 
 - Jira or ITSM workflow automation. 
 - Working understanding of ITIL event, incident, change and problem management, and of security incident response. 
 - Clear written and spoken English for working with UK and US stakeholders. 

Desirable

- Tines, Cortex XSOAR or Rapid7 certification; Splunk certification. 
 - Experience migrating playbooks from one SOAR platform to another. 
 - Microsoft Sentinel, KQL and Azure Logic Apps. 
 - Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon, Tenable, Imperva, SolarWinds or AppDynamics APIs. 
 - AWS or Azure associate-level certification. 
 - Experience in a 24x7 NOC or SOC, or a multi-client managed service environment. 
 - Awareness of PCI DSS v4. 0 logging and incident response requirements. 
 - Exposure to transport, payments or OT device environments. 

Behaviours and competencies

- Neutral partner: balances NOC and SOC needs openly and transparently, using data rather than whoever is loudest.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Platform
data.description:
Location: Bangalore, India (hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 from home)

- Reports to: Head of Platform Engineering
 - Team: one Engineering and QA team, 3-6 direct reports

OVERVIEW: 

APEXX is an independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform. Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation. Our routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost. We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome. 

We're backed by Finch Capital and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds. We're looking for a Engineering Manager in Bangalore to help build and run the core of that platform. 

This role covers everything in orchestration - payment flows, routing, connectors, tokenisation, webhooks and reconciliation - and how we run the platform: reliability, on-call, CI/CD and shared engineering practices. We build it, we run it, and done means released, not dev-complete. 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: 

Hands-on engineering

- Write and review production code in Java and Spring Boot for a large part of your week, taking work that keeps you off the team's critical path. 
 - Guide design across payment flows, routing and cascading, acquirer, APM and BNPL connectors, tokenisation, webhooks and reconciliation, working with your senior engineers on technical design docs. 
 - Set the team's engineering standards, including how we use AI coding tools safely. 

Delivery and operations

- Own your team's delivery end to end: planning, estimation, release readiness and follow-through until work is released and stable. 
 - Run your team's on-call rota, lead incidents, and make sure blameless RCAs lead to changes that ship. 
 - Define and track SLOs and service dashboards for your team's services. 
 - Own your team's part of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls: code review before release, change control, patching timelines and secure-coding practice. 

People and team

- Lead, coach and grow a team of engineers and QA: regular 1: 1s, clear expectations, honest feedback, performance reviews and career conversations. 
 - Hire for the team: run interview loops, calibrate interviewers and onboard new joiners. 
 - Build a team where ownership is easy: clear responsibilities, documented decisions and time for improvement work. 

Across the business

- Work with Product, Business Analysis, Solutions, Support and InfoSec to turn merchant and partner needs into plans your team can commit to. 
 - Work with the technical teams at our acquirer and APM partners on certifications, changes and outages. 
 - Work closely with engineering colleagues in the UK, Portugal and India. 

ABOUT YOU: 

We hire for skills and evidence, not pedigree, and you don't need a specific degree. If you can show us most of the following, we'd like to hear from you. 

- Experience leading an engineering team, including performance conversations, career growth and hiring. 
 - Strong, current hands-on backend engineering in Java and Spring Boot (or a comparable JVM stack), and you still enjoy writing and reviewing code. 
 - You've run services in production: on-call, incident command, blameless postmortems and the follow-up that prevents repeats. 
 - A strong grasp of distributed-systems failure modes (retries, idempotency, timeouts, ambiguous states) and how they apply to money movement. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis and AWS, and with CI/CD and release practices such as feature flags, canary releases and rollback. 
 - Experience working inside regulated change control, or a willingness to learn it quickly. 
 - Clear written and spoken communication, including with non-engineers during incidents. 
 - You use AI coding tools productively, and you set sensible standards for how your team uses them. 

NICE TO HAVES: 

- Payments experience: card acquiring, 3DS2/SCA, network tokens, APMs and BNPL, settlement and reconciliation, or payment orchestration. 
 - Built or run acquirer, APM or BNPL connectors, or routing logic. 
 - Produced audit evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001 or PCI DSS. 
 - Managed QA engineers, or led a team split across the UK and India. 
 - Owned cloud cost for your team's services. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS: 

Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond. 

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX. 

💰 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognise your skills, experience, and the impact you make. 

🏖️ Generous Time Off : Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work. 

🌍 Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from eligible locations for up to 90 days per year, subject to our Work From Anywhere policy. *

❤️ Comprehensive Health Insurance: Your wellbeing matters. We provide comprehensive health insurance to help support you and your loved ones when it matters most. 

🛡️ Personal Accident Insurance: Additional protection and peace of mind with personal accident insurance coverage. 

👶 Enhanced Family Leave: Supporting you through life's biggest milestones with enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies. 

📈 Learning & Growth: We're invested in your development, with opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career at APEXX. 

Who We Are & Where We Are

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the UK & India, helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. For more than a decade, we've been building technology that enables merchants to connect to the world's payment ecosystem through a single, scalable integration. 

Our platform gives businesses access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods, and 10+ Buy Now, Pay Later providers, helping them optimise payment performance, improve acceptance rates, and expand into new markets with confidence. 

Trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2, we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable. 

As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX. 

To learn more about APEXX and experience the dynamics of being part of our team, feel free to check out the provided media channels below: 

LinkedIn: https: //www. linkedin. com/company/apexxglobal/

Instagram: https: //www. instagram. com/apexx. global/?hl=en

Main Website: https: //apexx. global/

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to encouraging equality, diversity, and inclusion among our employees and eliminating discrimination. 

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from Recruitment Agencies.

Director - AI Engineering

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. Our Generative AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products by composing powerful, safe and explainable AI capabilities such as agentic workflows, and shared services such as guardrails, observability and evals coupled with foundational model power of open-weight and proprietary frontier models. You are expected to integrate AI into your daily engineering workflows to improve development velocity, software quality, and efficiency while maintaining strong engineering fundamentals. Success in this role requires a continuous learning mindset, responsible use of AI tools, and a focus on delivering measurable business value while optimizing AI resource consumption and costs.

 - Security & Operational Readiness: Strengthen security controls, vulnerability remediation, production readiness, and operational governance.

Partner with the best

You'll architect, innovate and lead the implementation of advanced cloud infrastructure frameworks that streamline change management, continuous deployment, and microservice orchestration.

About Us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day. 

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

data.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely - even if they're daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love - driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together - lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. 

The Principal Full Stack AI - Base Management is a hands-on technical leader responsible for architecting, building, and shipping end-to-end, production-grade AI solutions. You will solve complex business problems using the right mix of AI paradigms-spanning Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent workflows, multimodal processing, and predictive/applied ML-wrapped in resilient, intuitive full-stack applications. Alongside direct solution delivery, you own the technical health and capability growth of our core delivery base, setting the architectural standards and production rigor that enable full-stack squads to consistently ship high-impact AI products. 

Key Responsibilities

- End-to-End Full-Stack & AI Solutioning
 - Complete Production Application Delivery: Architect and build full-stack AI applications end-to-end-owning responsive frontends, backend services, data pipelines, and model integration from initial design through live production scale. 
 - Pragmatic AI Architecture: Evaluate business problems and select the right technical approach-combining LLM reasoning, RAG pipelines, multi-step agentic workflows, fine-tuned task models, or classical predictive ML services rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all pattern. 
 - Data, Retrieval & Context Engineering: Design high-precision data ingestion, chunking, hybrid search (vector + keyword), reranking, and structured feature pipelines across enterprise databases and unstructured knowledge sources. 
 - Adaptive & Human-in-the-Loop UX: Build responsive web interfaces engineered for real-time token streaming (SSE/WebSockets), dynamic UI rendering, source citation traceability, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop review workflows. 
 - Production Hardening, Evaluation & FinOps
 - Enterprise-Grade Reliability: Transition AI solutions from proof-of-concept to hardened production systems with deterministic guardrails, graceful model fallbacks, strict latency budgets, rate limiting, and PII/security compliance. 
 - Automated Evaluation & Quality Gates: Implement continuous evaluation harnesses that benchmark task accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rates, model drift, and regression safety prior to every production release. 
 - Inference & Cost Optimization: Instrument end-to-end tracing and implement intelligent model routing, semantic/prompt caching, and context optimization to maximize responsiveness and minimize cost per transaction. 
 - Base Management & Technical Governance
 - Solution Architecture & Code Governance: Lead architecture reviews, define production-readiness checklists, and enforce clean code, testing, and API standards across the delivery base. 
 - Capability Building & Mentorship: Coach senior and mid-level full-stack specialists in end-to-end AI solutioning through hands-on pair architecture, design critiques, and internal technical workshops. 
 - Delivery Readiness & Hiring: Partner with technical and delivery leaders to assess skill gaps across the talent pool, structure onboarding ramp-up plans, and calibrate hiring rubrics. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience: 10+ years of software development experience, including 4+ years leading full-stack production architecture and 3+ years shipping live AI/ML and Generative AI solutions at scale. 
 - Frontend Mastery: Deep expertise in React, Next. js, and TypeScript, with strong command of asynchronous state management, real-time streaming protocols (SSE/WebSockets), and designing intuitive UX for probabilistic AI outputs. 
 - Backend & AI Solutioning: Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, AsyncIO) and/or Node. js/TypeScript, with hands-on experience across LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agentic orchestration (e. g. , LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom state machines), and serving predictive ML or multimodal models in production. 
 - Data & Search Systems: Production experience with PostgreSQL, vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, or Weaviate), hybrid retrieval, and scalable ETL/data-ingestion pipelines. 
 - Cloud & Production Operations: Hands-on experience deploying containerized workloads on AWS, GCP, or Azure (Kubernetes/ECS), CI/CD automation, and AI observability/evaluation suites (e. g. , Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, OpenTelemetry). 
 - Leadership: Proven track record of owning complex technical deliverables end-to-end, resolving production bottlenecks, and elevating execution across multiple full-stack squads. 

Where you'll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager. 

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

data.title: Founding AI Engineer-AI Agents
data.description:
About The Job

The Opportunity

A stealth AI startup in San Francisco, founded by HBS alumni, is building agents that handle complex, high-stakes paperwork for US families. They research what applies to each family, handle correspondence, and follow up over weeks. The product is running in test. You'll be the first engineering hire, working directly with the two co-founders to take it live. 

- You're a Fit If YouAre high agency. You don't wait for permission or perfect information. You see what needs doing and make it happen. 
 - Figure things out on your own. When something's unclear, you research, decide, build, and check in with what you did, not with a list of questions. 
 - Are comfortable in an unstructured environment: no detailed specs, no fixed processes, no one assigning your day
 - Have owned a product or major feature end to end, ideally as an early engineer at a startup
 - Ship fast, with small changes daily, and know when scrappy is good enough
 - Adapt easily when priorities shift mid-week. The product is early, and plans will change as users teach us things. 
 - Make product calls yourself and push back when you disagree, including with the founders
 - Keep the team updated on what shipped, what's blocked, and what needs a decision
 - What You'll Build

Features end to end, from agent logic to the screen a family uses

- Agents with tool calling, guardrails, evals and tracing
 - Long-running workflows that wait days for replies and survive restarts
 - Secure handling of sensitive personal data

Must-Haves: 5+ years of software engineering, with strong TypeScript across the stack (Node. js + React)

- Independent production ownership: you've designed, deployed and run features in production yourself, including monitoring, debugging live issues and fixing what breaks, with no separate DevOps or QA team to lean on
 - Built and shipped at least one LLM-powered feature or agent yourself: tool calling, structured/validated output, and handling model failures
 - PostgreSQL and relational data modelling
 - Background jobs, queues or workflow engines (e. g. Temporal, Inngest, Celery) that retry and survive failure
 - Deploying on AWS or Azure: CI/CD, environment setup, logging and alerting
 - Secure handling of sensitive data: access control, encryption, no secrets in code or logs
 - Automated testing as a habit, including tests for model-driven behaviour
 - Daily use of AI coding tools, with the judgement to review what they produce
 - Excellent English; comfortable on camera for daily stand-ups

Bonus: founding-engineer experience; Python, Go or Rust in production; agent frameworks (LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK); evals and observability for LLM systems; infrastructure as code (Terraform/Pulumi); document processing and OCR. 

Details

- Long-term engagement through Metric Tree Labs, dedicated to this client
 - IST hours: 2: 30-11: 30 p. m. or 7: 00 a. m. -4: 00 p. m. (finalised after the first few weeks)
 - Own laptop (16 GB+ RAM, disk encryption on)
 - Process: Technical task, founder intro call → 90-min technical session. Quick decisions. 
 - Start: Immediately on finalisation
 - To Apply

Send your CV, a link to something you've shipped (repo, live product or demo), and 2-3 lines on a time you solved a problem with no guidance and no one to ask: what you did, and how fast you got it live. 

Requirements added by the job poster

- 5+ years of Software Development experience

data.title: Software Engineering Manager
data.description:
Location: Bangalore, India (hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 from home) · Reports to: Head of Platform Engineering · Team: one Engineering and QA team, 3-6 direct reports

OVERVIEW: 

APEXX is an independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform. Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation. Our routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost. We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome. 

We're backed by Finch Capital and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds. We're looking for a Engineering Manager in Bangalore to help build and run the core of that platform. 

This role covers everything in orchestration - payment flows, routing, connectors, tokenisation, webhooks and reconciliation - and how we run the platform: reliability, on-call, CI/CD and shared engineering practices. We build it, we run it, and done means released, not dev-complete. 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: 

Hands-on engineering

- Write and review production code in Java and Spring Boot for a large part of your week, taking work that keeps you off the team's critical path. 
 - Guide design across payment flows, routing and cascading, acquirer, APM and BNPL connectors, tokenisation, webhooks and reconciliation, working with your senior engineers on technical design docs. 
 - Set the team's engineering standards, including how we use AI coding tools safely. Delivery and operations

- Own your team's delivery end to end: planning, estimation, release readiness and follow-through until work is released and stable. 
 - Run your team's on-call rota, lead incidents, and make sure blameless RCAs lead to changes that ship. 
 - Define and track SLOs and service dashboards for your team's services. 
 - Own your team's part of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls: code review before release, change control, patching timelines and secure-coding practice. People and team

- Lead, coach and grow a team of engineers and QA: regular 1: 1s, clear expectations, honest feedback, performance reviews and career conversations. 
 - Hire for the team: run interview loops, calibrate interviewers and onboard new joiners. 
 - Build a team where ownership is easy: clear responsibilities, documented decisions and time for improvement work. Across the business

- Work with Product, Business Analysis, Solutions, Support and InfoSec to turn merchant and partner needs into plans your team can commit to. 
 - Work with the technical teams at our acquirer and APM partners on certifications, changes and outages. 
 - Work closely with engineering colleagues in the UK, Portugal and India. 

ABOUT YOU: 

We hire for skills and evidence, not pedigree, and you don't need a specific degree. If you can show us most of the following, we'd like to hear from you. 

- Experience leading an engineering team, including performance conversations, career growth and hiring. 
 - Strong, current hands-on backend engineering in Java and Spring Boot (or a comparable JVM stack), and you still enjoy writing and reviewing code. 
 - You've run services in production: on-call, incident command, blameless postmortems and the follow-up that prevents repeats. 
 - A strong grasp of distributed-systems failure modes (retries, idempotency, timeouts, ambiguous states) and how they apply to money movement. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis and AWS, and with CI/CD and release practices such as feature flags, canary releases and rollback. 
 - Experience working inside regulated change control, or a willingness to learn it quickly. 
 - Clear written and spoken communication, including with non-engineers during incidents. 
 - You use AI coding tools productively, and you set sensible standards for how your team uses them. 

NICE TO HAVES: 

- Payments experience: card acquiring, 3DS2/SCA, network tokens, APMs and BNPL, settlement and reconciliation, or payment orchestration. 
 - Built or run acquirer, APM or BNPL connectors, or routing logic. 
 - Produced audit evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001 or PCI DSS. 
 - Managed QA engineers, or led a team split across the UK, Portugal & India. 
 - Owned cloud cost for your team's services. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS: 

Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond. 

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX. 

💰 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognise your skills, experience, and the impact you make. 

🏖️ Generous Time Off : Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work. 

🌍 Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from eligible locations for up to 90 days per year, subject to our Work From Anywhere policy. *

❤️ Comprehensive Health Insurance: Your wellbeing matters. We provide comprehensive health insurance to help support you and your loved ones when it matters most. 

🛡️ Personal Accident Insurance: Additional protection and peace of mind with personal accident insurance coverage. 

👶 Enhanced Family Leave: Supporting you through life's biggest milestones with enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies. 

📈 Learning & Growth: We're invested in your development, with opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career at APEXX. 

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the UK & India, helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. For more than a decade, we've been building technology that enables merchants to connect to the world's payment ecosystem through a single, scalable integration. 

Our platform gives businesses access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods, and 10+ Buy Now, Pay Later providers, helping them optimise payment performance, improve acceptance rates, and expand into new markets with confidence. 

Trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2, we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable. 

As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX. 

To learn more about APEXX and experience the dynamics of being part of our team, feel free to check out the provided media channels below: 

LinkedIn: https: //www. linkedin. com/company/apexxglobal/

Instagram: https: //www. instagram. com/apexx. global/?hl=en

Main Website: https: //apexx. global/

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to encouraging equality, diversity, and inclusion among our employees and eliminating discrimination. 

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from Recruitment Agencies.

data.title: Senior Executive, Quality Assurance
data.description:
Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

This role is responsible for defining and specifying the activities, processes, and standards required to fulfill quality requirements for manufactured materials, components, and products within a global pharmaceutical environment. The position builds and maintains the infrastructure and systems necessary to consistently ensure the timely delivery of quality-compliant products. It supports the auditing, monitoring, and evaluation of manufacturing processes and outputs against defined internal and regulatory standards. The role ensures efficient and effective workflows, procedures, policies, and inspection programs are in place and adhered to across manufacturing operations. It manages in-process product quality in coordination with vendors and contract manufacturers. The position facilitates communication with customers and vendors to resolve quality-related issues in a timely and compliant manner. It reports and troubleshoots manufacturing process deviations and defects identified in finished goods. The role contributes to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing defects, errors, and rework across manufacturing operations. It also supports the identification and development of outsourcing vendors and suppliers according to organizational quality standards. 

Essential Functions

- Define and specify quality activities, processes, and standards for manufactured materials, components, and products in compliance with regulatory requirements
 - Build and maintain quality infrastructure and systems to ensure timely delivery of compliant pharmaceutical products
 - Conduct audits and monitoring of manufacturing processes and outputs against internal and regulatory standards including 21 CFR Part 210 & 211 and GMP guidelines
 - Ensure efficient workflow, procedures, policies, and inspection programs are implemented and maintained across manufacturing operations
 - Manage in-process product quality in coordination with vendors and contract manufacturers to meet defined quality specifications
 - Communicate with customers and vendors to investigate and resolve quality-related issues in a timely manner

The Head of Engineering will own the end-to-end engineering strategy and delivery of the organisation's UAV, aerospace, aeronautical and defence systems portfolio. Reporting to the Executive Vice Chairman (Tech) and CEO, the role will convert customer, mission and business requirements into safe, reliable, certifiable and manufacturable products. 

The incumbent will lead multidisciplinary teams through systems engineering, architecture, requirements management, system modelling and simulation, aerodynamic design, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), propulsion, power systems, structures and composite engineering. 

The role carries technical accountability from concept and feasibility through detailed design, analysis, prototyping, subsystem integration, ground and flight testing, verification, validation, qualification, certification and production readiness. 

The leader will establish engineering governance, design standards, technical reviews, configuration control and programme discipline, balancing performance, safety, reliability, cost, schedule and manufacturability. Strong capability in technical documentation, certification evidence, compliance and cross-functional execution is essential, alongside working knowledge of

software and avionics. 

The role partners closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Programme Management, Flight Operations, customers, suppliers and certification stakeholders. It also builds engineering capability, develops technical leaders, resolves critical design challenges and represents the organisation's engineering thought leadership at industry forums. product competitiveness, scalability, innovation and strategic differentiation.

Engineering strategy & governance

schedule and manufacturability. 

Systems engineering, architecture & modelling

Lead stakeholder requirements capture, decomposition, allocation, traceability and change control; govern system/functional architecture, specifications, interfaces, modelling, simulation, trade studies and verification across airframe, propulsion, power, avionics, flight controls, navigation, communications, GCS and payloads. 

Aerodynamics, CFD & performance

Propulsion & power systems

Structures, materials & composites

manufacturing, repair and process qualification

Product development, integration & validation

Technical documentation, certification & compliance

relevant authorities as applicable. 

Manufacturing readiness & programme delivery

data.title: Sr Architect (Servicenow ITOM)
data.description:
Job Description: ServiceNow ITOM Architect

Company: Altera Health (A Harris Computer Business)

Location: India (Remote / Hybrid)

Function: AI & Automation - Engineering

About The Role

We are looking for a ServiceNow ITOM Expert to join our AI and Tools Automation team. You will own the design, implementation, and evolution of our IT Operations Management capabilities on ServiceNow - spanning Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB governance, and AI-powered auto-remediation workflows. You will be a technical authority who can work independently, integrate ITOM deeply with monitoring platforms like LogicMonitor, AppDynamics, SentryOne, and drive intelligent, self-healing IT operations across a complex healthcare IT environment. 

This is not a configuration role - we need someone who architects, engineers, and leads. 

Key Responsibilities

ITOM Architecture & Technical Leadership

- Own the end-to-end architecture and roadmap for ServiceNow ITOM capabilities - Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, and Health Log Analytics (HLA)
 - Define platform standards, integration patterns, and governance models for ITOM across the organization
 - Lead technical design reviews, contribute to architectural decisions, and represent ITOM in cross-functional planning
 - Independently investigate, debug, and resolve complex ITOM platform issues - from MID Server failures to CMDB reconciliation conflicts - without escalation
 - Identify opportunities to consolidate, automate, and modernize legacy monitoring and event workflows

Discovery & CMDB Governance

- Design and maintain ServiceNow Discovery patterns - horizontal, vertical, and cloud discovery across on-prem, Azure, and hybrid environments
 - Own CMDB health - deduplication, reconciliation rules, CI relationships, data certification, and lifecycle management
 - Build and enforce CMDB governance frameworks that ensure accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness
 - Manage Service Mapping - application service discovery, dependency mapping, and business service modeling aligned to healthcare IT operations
 - Design CI class structures, identification and reconciliation rules, and IRE (Identification and Reconciliation Engine) policies

Event Management & AIOps

- Architect and manage the Event Management pipeline - connector configuration, alert ingestion, event correlation rules, and suppression logic
 - Configure and tune Health Log Analytics (HLA) for log-based anomaly detection and noise reduction
 - Build intelligent alert correlation and deduplication rules to reduce alert fatigue and accelerate MTTR
 - Design event-to-incident promotion workflows with smart routing, priority assignment, and SLA alignment
 - Integrate LogicMonitor as a primary event source - mapping LM alert payloads to ServiceNow event schema, managing thresholds, and ensuring bidirectional status synchronization

Auto-Remediation & Intelligent Workflows

- Design and build auto-heal workflows that trigger automated remediation actions in response to ITOM events - owning the architectural principle that condition-determination logic belongs in the monitoring layer (LogicMonitor), with ServiceNow executing remediation based on clean, pre-evaluated signals
 - Build Flow Designer and Integration Hub workflows for automated incident response, CI status updates, and cross-platform orchestration
 - Develop spoke integrations and REST/MID-based connectors for third-party tools
 - Implement safety checks and precondition validations within remediation flows to prevent unintended actions in production environments
 - Continuously improve auto-remediation coverage and reliability through feedback loops with the monitoring team

MID Server & Integration Engineering

- Own MID Server architecture - deployment topology, cluster configuration, upgrades, health monitoring, and failover
 - Design and maintain integration architecture between ServiceNow and external platforms - LogicMonitor, Azure Monitor, Kubernetes, and other operational tools
 - Build and maintain REST, SOAP, and scripted integrations using Integration Hub, Scripted REST APIs, and Import Sets
 - Manage credentials, connection pooling, and secure credential storage using ServiceNow Credential Vault

AI-Augmented Engineering

- Actively use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) as a core part of the engineering workflow - for scripting, debugging, documentation, and solution design
 - Leverage AI to accelerate complex problem-solving - generating Business Rules, Flow Designer logic, Scripted REST endpoints, and Groovy/JavaScript-based scripts faster and with higher quality
 - Use AI to explore and prototype new ITOM automation patterns and self-healing use cases
 - Stay current with ServiceNow's native AI/ML capabilities - Predictive Intelligence, NLU, and Virtual Agent - and assess their applicability to the team's operational goals

Azure & Cloud Integration

- Deep understanding of Azure platform as it relates to ITOM - Azure Monitor, Azure Arc, Log Analytics Workspaces, Event Grid, and resource tagging models
 - Architect cloud discovery and service mapping for Azure-hosted workloads - VMs, AKS clusters, PaaS services, and resource groups
 - Integrate Azure-native alerting and telemetry into the ServiceNow Event Management pipeline
 - Understand Azure RBAC and Entra ID as they apply to MID Server service accounts, API integrations, and CMDB data sources

GitHub & Development Practices

- Operate confidently in GitHub - maintain ITOM configuration as code where possible, manage update sets through version control, and use GitHub Actions for deployment automation
 - Document integration designs, flow logic, and architectural decisions clearly and maintain them in source control
 - Apply software engineering discipline to ServiceNow scripting - clean code, peer review, and regression testing before deployment to production

Platform Governance & Mentorship

- Own the ITOM module's platform health - upgrades, deprecation planning, performance tuning, and licensing awareness
 - Define and enforce development standards for ITOM scripting, flow design, and integration work
 - Mentor developers (such as Kamalesh) working on ITOM-adjacent tasks and conduct structured code and configuration reviews
 - Contribute to organization-wide ITSM/ITOM alignment - ensuring CMDB, Event Management, and incident workflows operate as a cohesive system

Required Skills & Experience

- 10+ years of ServiceNow experience, with 4+ years specialized in ITOM - Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB
 - Expert-level knowledge of MID Server architecture, deployment, and troubleshooting
 - Deep proficiency in ServiceNow scripting - JavaScript, Business Rules, Script Includes, Scripted REST APIs, Scheduled Jobs
 - Strong command of Flow Designer and Integration Hub
 - Proven experience building event-driven auto-remediation workflows at production scale
 - Deep, hands-on Azure platform knowledge - Monitor, Arc, Log Analytics, Event Grid, Entra ID; able to architect cloud ITOM integrations independently
 - Experience integrating LogicMonitor or comparable monitoring platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, SCOM) with ServiceNow Event Management
 - GitHub proficiency - branching, PRs, Actions-based CI/CD, and managing ServiceNow config artifacts in source control
 - Strong independent debugging skills - able to own and resolve complex, multi-system issues without escalation
 - Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in day-to-day engineering - uses AI to solve problems, generate scripts, and prototype solutions
 - Excellent communication skills - can represent ITOM architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Good to Have

- Experience with Health Log Analytics (HLA) and log-based AIOps
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes / AKS monitoring and CMDB integration for containerized workloads
 - Knowledge of ServiceNow Predictive Intelligence and ML-based alert correlation
 - Exposure to ITSM modules (Incident, Change, Problem) and their integration touchpoints with ITOM
 - Familiarity with LogicMonitor platform internals - DataSources, alert payloads, Groovy scripting
 - Understanding of healthcare IT environments and compliance considerations
 - ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist - ITOM certification
 - Experience with Virtual Agent or NLU for ITOM self-service scenarios

Who You Are

- An ITOM engineer who treats the platform as a product - not a tool to configure, but a system to architect and own
 - Deeply self-sufficient - you debug across MID Servers, CMDB reconciliation logs, Flow Designer execution histories, and REST payloads without waiting to be unblocked
 - You use AI as a natural extension of your engineering toolkit - it makes you faster and sharper
 - You hold strong architectural opinions and can defend them clearly - including knowing where logic belongs (monitoring layer vs. remediation layer)
 - Comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving team where you are the ITOM domain authority
 - A collaborative mentor who raises the engineering bar across adjacent team members
 - You care about data quality in the CMDB the same way a data engineer cares about pipeline reliability

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Backend
data.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo. 

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it. 

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started. 

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible. 

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places. 

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works

This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. 

Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo

As a Principal Software Engineer, Backend for the Platform & Cloud Services team, you will be a technical cornerstone, helping fulfil Skylo's mission of making satellite connectivity available to all. This is a senior, hands-on Individual Contributor role for an architect-level engineer who is driven by technical excellence and has a passion for mentoring others. You will be a technical authority, responsible for driving the architecture, design, and implementation of our most critical product features and services. This is a technical leadership role, requiring both hands-on expertise and management skills

Your influence will extend across multiple functional groups, ensuring that our backend platform is scalable, resilient, and built to the highest standards. You will lead by example, setting the bar for engineering quality and guiding teams through complex technical challenges, elevating the skills of the entire team. 

How You Will Contribute

- Architect and Design: Lead the design and architecture of complex, large-scale, and distributed backend systems. You will take ownership of critical architecture decisions, design patterns, and infrastructure choices. 
 - Drive Technical Strategy: Define and steer the technical strategy for major components and product features, working closely with engineering leadership, product managers, and other key stakeholders. 
 - Lead Implementation: Own and lead the implementation of large-scale features, from initial design and prototyping through to testing and deployment. You will be hands-on, solving the most challenging technical problems. 
 - Champion Engineering Excellence: Drive a culture of high quality and continuous improvement through rigorous code and design reviews. You will champion best practices like clean code, scalable design, and DevOps maturity. 
 - Mentor and Advise: Act as a technical advisor and mentor to senior, mid-level, and junior engineers, promoting best practices and elevating the technical skills of the team. 
 - Ensure Quality and Security: Drive & Define component test scenarios, drive API test automation, and ensure high code coverage. You will implement and enforce security best practices throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Optimize and Scale: Identify performance bottlenecks and lead initiatives to optimize system performance, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Innovate and Evaluate: Evaluate and recommend emerging tools, technologies, and frameworks to keep our platform modern, efficient, and innovative. 

What We Look For

- Experience: 16+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on backend development and the architecture of distributed systems. 
 - Technical Leadership: A proven track record of technical leadership, including owning the design of major features, mentoring engineers, people management and successfully driving engineering-wide initiatives. 
 - Backend Expertise: Extensive experience with microservices architecture, API design (REST, gRPC), and API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI). Strong expertise in scalable data stores (SQL and NoSQL), caching systems (Redis, Memcached), and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Pub/Sub). Deep proficiency in one or more programming languages (e. g. , Java, Go, Python)
 - Cloud-Native Fluency: Solid understanding of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and building robust CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI). 
 - Quality and Observability: Strong knowledge of engineering best practices, including automated testing frameworks (e. g. , JUnit, TestNG). Experience with observability tools for monitoring, logging, and tracing (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, OpenTelemetry). 
 - Telecommunications domain experience is highly advantageous, complemented by a good understanding of 3GPP specifications related to EPC and 5G Core
 - Collaboration and Communication: Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence decisions through technical expertise. 
 - AI Augmented Development: Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of folding new ones into your workflow quickly
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 

What We Offer

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range of benefits such as: 

- Competitive compensation packages, including a stock option-based equity program. 
 - Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and a retirement plan. 
 - Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement. 
 - A generous time-off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad. 
 - A once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running the world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service. 
 - Access to a world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite, and network virtualization. 
 - An open, transparent, and inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic, and South Asia characteristics. 

EEO Statement

Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer, and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

You'll enjoy autonomy and ownership in your work, and be part of a team that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity. About Us: 

At Oracle, we are transforming healthcare by modernizing Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems to empower front-line healthcare professionals. Our mission is to enable them to focus more on patient care and less on administrative tasks, achieving peak efficiency with the support of generative AI and modernized applications. By leveraging the power of generative AI and state-of-the-art applications, we aim to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in healthcare delivery. Our approach to modernization includes investing in cutting-edge AI capabilities, advancing user experience, and offering open APIs that enable customers and third parties to develop innovative, integrated solutions. We are dedicated to creating a seamless and intuitive healthcare experience that benefits patients, providers, payers, and the entire healthcare ecosystem.

We advance healthcare and population-level health by making cutting-edge solutions practical and effective at the practitioner level. Our goal is to enable patients to receive care from anyone, anywhere, on any device by providing practitioners with comprehensive medical information. 

As a Principal Application Software Engineer on our team, you'll be responsible for and will lead efforts in designing and building scalable, distributed, and resilient software components and services to support health care platform, applications, and our end users. data.description:
Job Description

Lead Quality Engineer / QA Lead - Salesforce

The Role

We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer (Salesforce QA Lead) with 7+ years in software quality engineering (including 5+ years of Salesforce manual and automated testing and 2+ years leading a QA team) to own the end-to-end quality strategy and lead up to six QA analysts for a new Salesforce org. 

Responsibilities and Impact

Test Strategy & Leadership

- Program Test Strategy: Own the test strategy for the program across in-sprint testing, release regression, four UAT cycles, integration, performance, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Team Leadership: Lead a team of up to six QA analysts: plan work by sprint, review test cases, and coach the team. 
 - UAT Governance & Reporting: Define entry and exit criteria for each UAT cycle, and report quality and risk metrics to the program and leadership. 
 - Defect Triage: Run defect triage sessions with developers, business analysts, the ARM partner, and business testers. 
 - Audit & Test Data Compliance: Own test evidence that meets SOX audit requirements, along with test data management including data masking. Automation Testing

- Automated Regression Suite: Build and own the automated regression suite in Copado Robotic Testing for the core flows: lead to opportunity to ARM quote, cases, credits, and collections. 
 - CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated suites into the Copado pipeline as quality gates for every deployment. 
 - API Testing: Set up REST API testing for integrations using Postman or scripted frameworks. Data Migration & UAT

- Data Migration Validation: Plan validation for three trial loads and three coexistence rehearsals: reconcile record counts, field values, and relationships between Dynamics 365 and Salesforce. 
 - UAT Execution & Sign-Off: Prepare UAT scripts with business analysts, support business testers, and track formal sign-off. 
 - Integration & Localization Testing: Plan integration testing with the Dealer Portal, Oracle ERP, DocuSign, and the marketing platform, as well as localization testing in English and French. What We Are Looking For

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree (Bachelor of Science or equivalent four-year college/university degree) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Overall & Leadership Experience: 7+ years in software quality engineering, including 2+ years leading a QA team. 
 - Salesforce QA Experience: 5+ years of Salesforce manual and automated testing, including at least one full implementation and a data migration. 
 - Core QA Competencies: Risk-based test strategy, test automation (Copado Robotic Testing, REST API testing via Postman or scripted frameworks), SOX-compliant test evidence, test data masking, and running multiple UAT cycles with business users. 
 - Required Certification: Salesforce Certified Administrator. Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications: Copado Robotic Testing or Copado Administrator; ISTQB Advanced Test Manager or equivalent. 
 - Domain Experience: Experience testing Revenue Cloud, Agentforce Revenue Management (ARM), or CPQ (quote, contract, order, subscription) is a strong plus.

data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Staff Design Evaluation Engineer - Automotive Networking

Role Overview

Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Staff Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking team in Hyderabad, India. In this senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions. 

You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and lead comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs. 
 - Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation. 
 - Architect, develop, bring up, and maintain hardware and software evaluation platforms, test fixtures, reference systems, and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation. 
 - Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries. 
 - Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment. 
 - Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution.

data.description:
Date: Oct 31, 2026

Location: 

Pune, MH, IN

Company: Black & Veatch Family of Companies

We believe real value is powered by the unique skills and experiences of our professionals. The interchange of ideas from a diverse group of people gives our teams an expanded perspective and the ability to find better solutions for our clients. 

Req Id : 116879

Job Title : Senior Substation Automation Engineer - Grid Modernization (IEC 61850)

Business Unit sector : CPL-BVOPS-ENGR & DEV SVCS

Department: BVCPL BV OPS EDS INSTR & CONTR

Work Location : INPUNE

Opportunity Type : Staff

Relocation eligible : Yes

Full time/Part time : Full-Time

Contract Hire Only for this Project: No

Visa Sponsorship Available: No

Recruiter : Ashwini Dnyanoba Patil

Job Summary

Black & Veatch is expanding its Power SCADA team to support a strategic grid modernization initiative focused on IEC 61850‐based substation automation and virtual substation technologies. As a founding member of the Virtual Protection, Automation, and Control (vPAC) Alliance, Black & Veatch is collaborating with industry leaders to advance open, secure, and vendor‐agnostic digital substation solutions that replace traditional, hardware‐intensive architectures with virtualized, software‐defined platforms. Following successful pilot efforts, BV is now transitioning virtual substations into production environments. This role is being created to bring in experienced SCADA professionals who can help design, implement, standardize, and support production‐ready Power SCADA solutions that enable resilient, flexible, and future‐ready grid infrastructure

In this role, you may have the opportunity to: 

- Lead the transition of IEC 61850‐based digital and virtual substations from pilot to production, shaping real-world grid modernization outcomes. 
 - Design and standardize secure, vendor‐agnostic substation automation architectures that improve resilience, flexibility, and scalability. 
 - Serve as a technical leader and subject‐matter expert, influencing system architecture, best practices, and emerging standards. 
 - Collaborate with utilities, technology partners, and industry groups (including vPAC Alliance) to help define the future of protection, automation, and control

Key Responsibilities

IEC 61850 Engineering & Modeling

- Develop SCL engineering artifacts including ICD, CID, and SCD files, datasets, logical node mappings, reporting and control blocks, and GOOSE publications and subscriptions. 
 - Configure and validate MMS, GOOSE, and SV messaging for protection, automation, monitoring, and SCADA applications. 

Substation Networking & Time Synchronization

- Design and document station-bus and process-bus network architectures using PRP/HSR, VLANs, QoS, multicast management, and traffic segmentation practices. 
 - Design deterministic real-time networking paths for time-sensitive protection and automation applications, incorporating latency budgeting, PTP timing performance, and behaviors defined for substation-class devices meeting IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 environmental and EMC requirements. 
 - Diagnose and optimize real-time network behavior through traffic-capture analysis, timing-accuracy evaluation, and system-level tuning techniques for time-critical digital-substation workloads. 
 - Develop PTP-based time-synchronization architectures including grandmaster, boundary, and transparent clock configurations and incorporate timing considerations into the system design. 

Protection, Automation & SCADA Integration

- Integrate multi-vendor IEDs with protection settings and logic, coordinating measurements, controls, alarms, and event data with SCADA and HMI systems. 
 - Apply IEC 61850 data-modeling concepts to confirm interoperability across mixed fleets of protection and control devices. 

Cybersecurity & System Hardening

- Incorporate cybersecurity principles into system architecture, including authentication, role-based access control, network segmentation, secure communications, and device hardening. 
 - Apply cyber-informed engineering principles by identifying high-consequence functions and integrating protective measures directly into system architecture, embedding security decisions from the earliest stages of engineering rather than treating them as add-on controls. 

Virtualization of Substation Functions

- Develop and configure virtualized protection, HMI, gateway/RTU, and related substation applications on platforms including VMware ESXi with vCenter, vSAN, and NSX; Red Hat KVM or OpenShift Virtualization; and SEAPATH's real-time, high-availability hypervisor platform designed to run virtualized protection, automation, and control workloads with deterministic performance and PTP-synchronized operation on industrial servers meeting IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 criteria. 

Industry Engagement & Technical Leadership

- Contribute to, or develop toward contributing to, IEEE and IEC standards and collaborative initiatives related to IEC 61850, digital substations, time synchronization, and cybersecurity. 
 - Support participation in technical bodies and industry groups such as IEC, IEEE, CIGRE, ISA99, and vPAC Alliance workstreams. 
 - Support the advancement and practical application of virtualized protection, automation, and control concepts in alignment with the architectural direction established by the vPAC Alliance. 

Project Delivery & Collaboration

- Produce engineering documentation including network specifications, SCL models, timing plans, interface definitions, and system diagrams used across design, laboratory validation, and field implementation. 
 - Collaborate with project managers, technical leads, clients, and vendors to align designs with project goals, operational requirements, and industry best practices. 

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks for operational technology environments, including secure communications and system-hardening practices. 
 - Interest or participation in IEEE and IEC standards development related to IEC 61850, time synchronization, digital substations, and cybersecurity. 
 - Experience deploying or supporting virtualized protection, automation, and control applications on VMware ESXi/vCenter/vSAN/NSX, Red Hat KVM or OpenShift Virtualization, and SEAPATH's real-time, high-availability hypervisor platform for vPAC workloads. 
 - Experience deploying virtualized substation workloads on industrial servers certified to IEC 618503 and IEEE 1613 environmental and EMC requirements. 
 - Familiarity with vPAC architectural principles and emerging practices for hosting protection, automation, and control systems on virtualized platforms. 
 - Interest in or experience with virtualized protection, automation, and control concepts. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing or equivalent experience in Engineering work. 
 - Minimum of 11 years related work experience. 
 - All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations. 
 - Holds an active engineering registration or licensure to support engineer of record (EOR) requirements for BV projects in applicable countries, and supports where necessary. 

Certifications

- Holds an active engineering registration or licensure to support engineer of record (EOR) requirements for BV projects in applicable countries, and supports where necessary. 

Work Environment/Physical Demands

- This position would require working in a typical office environment. The position may entail prolonged periods of sitting and computer use, and the professional would ideally be able to maintain focus and attention to detail throughout the workday. The position may also be require physical tasks during site visits, including crouching, grasping, and standing/walking for extended periods of time. 
 - Hybrid or flexible work options may be offered after the first 90 days of employment based upon manager discretion, job performance and work assignments. 

Competencies

Salary Plan

017

Some careers shine brighter than others. 

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specalist

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world's most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do. 

The Opportunity

This role develops Python services that use AI to automate document-processing workflows. You'll integrate with Azure OpenAI through the approved Group AI Platform while meeting enterprise access, security and data-handling requirements. The work includes extracting and validating structured information from PDFs including trade confirmations. Success looks like reliable end-to-end workflows - from ingestion and OCR through to structured outputs that are validated and usable. You'll build services that handle uncertainty well rather than treating AI responses as automatically correct. You'll partner across product, data, cloud, security and business teams to deliver measurable outcomes. 

What you'll be doing

- Build and maintain Python APIs and services for AI-powered document processing 
 - Integrate with Azure OpenAI through the approved Group AI Platform including authentication request handling error handling and usage monitoring 
 - Develop PDF ingestion and OCR workflows then convert model responses into validated structured data 
 - Design prompts and schemas for reliable extraction then evaluate output quality across real documents 
 - Implement handling for uncertainty missing fields and conflicting values to avoid brittle downstream processing 
 - Establish human-review paths so AI output does not become authoritative when validation or confidence is insufficient 
 - Apply privacy security auditability and data-retention requirements across prompts outputs and logs 
 - Write automated tests troubleshoot production issues and contribute to deployment and operational support

What we're looking for

- Bring strong Python development experience including API development and maintainable service design 
 - Demonstrate hands-on integration with Azure OpenAI through an enterprise platform or API gateway 
 - Apply experience with LLM prompting structured outputs response validation and model evaluation 
 - Show experience working with PDFs and OCR or document-extraction workflows 
 - Use solid knowledge of REST APIs authentication error handling logging and automated testing 
 - Apply responsible AI practices including data protection hallucination risks and human oversight 
 - Demonstrate experience collaborating with product data cloud security and business teams to deliver outcomes

Building trusted AI document services

If you want to build AI-powered services that make document workflows faster and more reliable this role offers a clear runway. You'll work on real production integrations through the Group AI Platform with the controls needed in a regulated environment. The focus is on quality and validation - turning model outputs into structured data teams can rely on. If that's the kind of engineering you want to do we'd like to hear from you. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC.
