This Position reports to: 

Senior Engineering Manager

This role will be in Designing and execution DCS engineering activities in service projects with medium to high complexity, according to Standard work instructions, quality standards and safety guidelines. Deliver quality customer service to satisfy customers. 

The work model for the role is # LI - Hybrid. 

This role is contributing to the to the Energy Industries for INOPC based in Bangalore, India. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Lead medium to high complexity engineering and automation projects, ensuring successful delivery across all project phases. 
 - Analyze customer requirements, identify process gaps, and design effective solutions in collaboration with business and IT stakeholders. 
 - Develop project plans, effort estimates, and cost projections while ensuring quality deliverables are completed on time and within budget. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to project teams, supporting engineering, testing, installation, and commissioning activities. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams and customers to resolve technical issues, drive project execution, and ensure stakeholder satisfaction. 
 - Continuously improve project outcomes by recommending enhancements to products, processes, and customer service while staying updated with the latest trends in process automation and digital technologies. 

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- 8-12 years of experience in Process Automation, particularly within large Oil & Gas, Refinery, Petrochemical, Power, or Water projects. 
 - strong experience in Distributed Control Systems (DCS), including complex multi-system architectures, third-party integrations, retrofits, upgrades, commissioning, and lifecycle support activities. 
 - Hands-on expertise in industrial IT infrastructure, including virtualization (VMware/ESXi), server and client integration, Windows Administration, RAID configuration, Active Directory, domain management, and Group Policy administration. 
 - Solid knowledge of industrial networking and cybersecurity, including managed switches, routers, firewalls, system hardening, cybersecurity design, McAfee ePO, WSUS, and secure network architecture for automation systems. 
 - Proficiency in Process Automation applications and communication protocols, including MODBUS, OPC, HART, Profibus, and Foundation Fieldbus. Experience with ABB 800xA systems is essential, while exposure to legacy ABB platforms such as Advant, Safeguard, Infi90, or SCADAVantage will be an added advantage. 
 - Demonstrated leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with experience working in global and multicultural environments. Ability to mentor teams, leverage AI tools and agents, support alarm management solutions, and willingness to travel extensively, including offshore/onshore assignments and international relocations when required. 
 - Bachelor's Degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, or a related discipline. 

More About Us
ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations. 

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division's goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle. 

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www. abb. com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process. 

View current job openings and apply at: https: //careers. abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https: //global. abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

data.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY INFORMATION SECURITY

Job posting

AI and Automation Engineering Lead, Associate Director

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build. 

EY focuses on high ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. 

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust. 

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value. 

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI. 

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function. 

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people. 

Areas of focus

- AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output. 
 - Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes. 
 - Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time. 
 - Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it. 
 - AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program. 

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include: 

- Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems. 
 - Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces. 
 - Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take. 
 - Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them. 
 - Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue. 
 - Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data. 
 - Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved. 
 - Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program. 
 - Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others. 
 - Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality. 
 - Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums. 
 - Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on. 
 - Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual. 
 - Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations. 
 - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership. 
 - Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders. 
 - Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience. 
 - Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program. 
 - Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues. 
 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines. 
 - Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information. 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production. 
 - Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK. 
 - Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task. 
 - Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable. 
 - Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent. 
 - Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph. 
 - Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs. 
 - A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes. 
 - Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling. 
 - Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it. 
 - Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns. 
 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience. 
 - Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources. 
 - Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path. 
 - Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation. 
 - Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience. 
 - Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling. 
 - Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers. 
 - Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering. 

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used. 

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer: 

- Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

data.title: Core Infrastructure Engineer 2
data.description:
Job Description

Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under guidance. Applies basic scalability requirements, conducts performance/load testing, and configures resiliency features (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) to handle network variability. Builds telemetry, alerts, and runbook-driven procedures; delivers scoped features and fault-injection tests; and helps implement basic data replication and synchronization. Assists with on-call rotations, uses automation/IaC scripts to troubleshoot, and follows change, security, and compliance procedures (encryption, access controls, remediation plans) while escalating complex issues to senior engineers. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers. 

-Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers. 

-Implement scalability requirements for assigned components. 

-Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Execute performance and load testing, with guidance. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs. 

-Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures. 

-Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance. 

-Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implement test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance. 

-Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision. 

-Follow protocols to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Run basic automation scripts and tooling to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participate in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Assist in implementing basic security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Assist in the execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, under supervision. 

-Support the creation and updating of documentation to ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Assist in maintaining basic automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)). 

-Adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, under guidance

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborate within the team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. 

-Leverage a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance. 

-Actively listen and ask questions to enhance collaboration. 

-Build a basic understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs with guidance. 

Problem Solving: 

-Identify and address issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures. 

-Compile and review data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. 

Continuous Learning: 

-Seek opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. 

-Utilize feedback and training to improve skills. 

-Participate in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing. 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Implement updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed, with some guidance. 

-Contribute to ideation for future process improvements. 

Qualifications

You are an expert C coder with networking experience. You value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and are excited to learn. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- 3-5 years of experience with systems/application development
 - Proficient at programming in C/C++
 - Proficient with Linux
 - Prior development experience with network protocol implementation or network packet process
 - Experience in working on performance/scale testing. 
 - Bachelors in computer science and Engineering or related engineering fields

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience in CICD environments
 - Experience in working on simulating production environment & testing.

data.title: Team Member-Cell Quality
data.description:
Responsibilities

Quality Management & Assurance

- Ensure adherence to quality standards and specifications throughout the solar cell manufacturing process. 
 - Develop, implement, and monitor quality control plans, inspection methodologies, and testing procedures. 
 - Drive in-process quality checks and final product audits to ensure compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Lead quality improvement projects to reduce defects, enhance yield, and improve process capability. 

Process Monitoring & Control

- Analyze quality trends, process deviations, and manufacturing parameters to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Monitor key quality KPIs such as yield, defect density, scrap rates, reliability performance, and customer complaints. 
 - Collaborate with production and process engineering teams to establish robust process controls. 

Defect Analysis & Corrective Actions

- Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for quality failures, product non-conformities, and customer complaints. 
 - Implement CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions) to eliminate recurring quality issues. 
 - Utilize quality tools such as 8D, Fishbone Analysis, FMEA, SPC, Six Sigma, and Statistical Analysis techniques. 

Reliability & Product Performance

- Support reliability testing and validation activities to ensure product performance and long-term durability. 
 - Monitor cell efficiency trends and performance metrics to achieve quality and yield targets. 
 - Coordinate failure analysis activities with relevant stakeholders and laboratories. 

Supplier & Incoming Quality Management

- Review incoming material quality and collaborate with suppliers to resolve quality concerns. 
 - Conduct supplier performance assessments and quality improvement initiatives as required. 
 - Ensure compliance of raw materials with defined specifications and standards. 

Audits & Compliance

- Ensure adherence to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and other relevant quality management systems. 
 - Participate in internal, external, customer, and certification audits. 
 - Maintain quality documentation, SOPs, process records, and audit readiness. 

Stakeholder Management

- Work closely with Production, Process Engineering, Maintenance, Technology, and Supply Chain teams. 
 - Support product qualification, process transfers, and new technology implementation projects. 
 - Mentor and guide team members on quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement methodologies. 

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Prepare and present quality dashboards, reports, and performance reviews to management. 
 - Lead Kaizen initiatives focused on manufacturing excellence and operational efficiency. 
 - Drive a culture of quality awareness and continuous improvement across the manufacturing organization. 

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

- B. E. /B. Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Chemical, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - M. Tech/MBA in Operations, Quality, or Manufacturing Management will be an added advantage. 

Experience

- Minimum 4-6 years of experience in Solar Cell Manufacturing, Semiconductor, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Technology Manufacturing industries. 
 - Hands-on experience in solar cell manufacturing processes, defect reduction, yield improvement, and quality management systems.

data.title: Lead Agentic Security Engineer
data.description:
SECURITY ENGINEERING AT INVESTCLOUD

At InvestCloud, we are building an intelligent security response capability that determines what to fix first based on the actual risk to our clients and business, not a scanner's native severity. 

Traditional vulnerability management produces disconnected findings and long backlogs. It often misses whether vulnerable code is deployed, reachable by an attacker, connected to a critical service, capable of lateral movement, or already being exploited. We are solving that problem by combining threat intelligence, runtime and deployment evidence, configuration management data, attack path analysis, business criticality, and validation results. 

The platform will ingest findings from infrastructure, cloud, application, software supply chain, secrets, containers, infrastructure as code, and adversarial testing. It will reconcile them to a canonical asset and service model, deduplicate them into unique exposures, and rank the remediation actions that remove the most risk. 

The product is being built in Python on AWS with source-controlled connectors, deterministic policy code, an AI reasoning layer, human approval gates, complete audit evidence, and closed-loop validation. Large language models (LLMs) can correlate evidence, recommend remediation, and explain decisions. They do not calculate the authoritative priority score. 

This is not another scanner or dashboard. It is a security decision and remediation platform that must answer one question reliably: what is the single next action that will remove the most material risk, why is it first, who owns it, and how will we verify the risk is gone? Every engineer on this team will build production software, operate what they build, and own the product after the initial consultant implementation. 

THE ROLE

As our Agentic Security Engineer, you will serve as the principal software architect for the harness and own the AI reasoning layer that turns prioritized exposures into evidence-grounded remediation options, residual risk analysis, and clear explanations. 

You will ensure the product operates as a reliable system, not an AI demonstration. The deterministic policy engine owns the authoritative score. The LLM layer retrieves evidence, correlates likely root causes, evaluates mitigation choices, produces structured recommendations, and knows when to abstain or require a human. You will also set engineering standards across Python services, APIs, data contracts, the evaluation framework, observability, and the operator experience. 

What You Will Own

- Product Technical Architecture: Own the end-to-end software architecture for the Python and AWS product, including service boundaries, FastAPI and client APIs, the React or TypeScript operator interface, data contracts, Aurora PostgreSQL integration, security controls, performance, resilience, testability, and technical debt. Review and approve material design changes. 
 - AI Reasoning & Tool Orchestration: Build reliable, stateful workflows that retrieve evidence, call deterministic tools, correlate findings, identify root causes, compare remediation options, and return schema-validated recommendations with citations and confidence. 
 - Grounding, Retrieval & Provenance: Ground every output in current CMDB, threat intelligence, scanner evidence, code and deployment context, policy, and remediation history. Preserve source, observation time, freshness, model version, prompts, tool calls, and output evidence without inventing facts. 
 - Evaluation, Safety & Confidence: Create representative test sets and automated evaluations for accuracy, completeness, unsafe actions, hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, model drift, and confidence calibration. Implement fallback, abstention, and deterministic validation when evidence is weak. 
 - Human Oversight & Controlled Autonomy: Implement approval workflows, policy gate integration, exceptions, kill switches, audit capture, and separation of duties. Support an initial recommendation mode, then controlled automation only after actions are proven safe, reversible, and approved. 
 - Technical Leadership & Product Ownership: Set coding, testing, observability, documentation, and secure development standards for the team. Mentor engineers, challenge vendor assumptions, maintain provider independence, manage cost and latency, and lead the full handover from the consultant. 

What We Are Looking For

- 12+ years in software, AI, or security engineering, with principal-level evidence of architecture, delivery, and technical leadership. You must have shipped production AI or LLM systems and possess enough security depth to evaluate remediation safely. 
 - Expert production Python and backend engineering, including FastAPI, Pydantic or JSON Schema, asynchronous workflows, APIs, SQL or PostgreSQL, distributed systems, automated testing, CI/CD, and AWS. 
 - Production LLM and agentic workflow experience using Bedrock, Claude, OpenAI, LangGraph, or equivalent. You have built durable tools using systems with explicit state, retries, timeouts, validation, and failure recovery, not demos. 
 - Evaluation and AI security depth, including gold data sets, offline and online metrics, hallucination controls, prompt injection defenses, data isolation, model routing, observability, confidence calibration, and safe abstention. 
 - Retrieval and knowledge engineering across structured and unstructured data. You understand when relational queries, search, rules, or vector retrieval are appropriate and can preserve provenance and freshness. 
 - Security engineering depth across application, cloud, infrastructure, vulnerability intelligence, attack paths, remediation, and compensating controls. You can identify when an AI proposal is incomplete, unsafe, or simply wrong. 
 - A high ownership builder who maintains current expertise through self-directed work, uses AI to multiply output without lowering rigor, communicates complex designs concisely, mentors others, and collaborates without ego. 

CORE TOOLING & TECHNOLOGIES

Python

- FastAPI
 - Pydantic / JSON Schema
 - LangGraph or equivalent
 - AWS Bedrock
 - Claude / OpenAI
 - PostgreSQL / Aurora
 - RAG and search
 - REST / GraphQL
 - React / TypeScript familiarity
 - GitLab CI
 - pytest
 - OpenTelemetry / Datadog
 - Jira / JSM
 - AWS

WHY JOIN THIS TEAM

You will define whether this becomes a trustworthy security product or an impressive prototype. The role combines principal software architecture, applied AI, and security judgment at a level rarely available in one position. 

Your work will make the platform explainable, testable, provider-independent, and safe enough to support controlled automation over time.

data.description:
Company Description Amber Enterprises India Limited, part of Amber Group, is a diversified B2B solution provider operating across Consumer Durables, Electronics (EMS), and Railway Subsystems & Defense. Over three decades, the company has become a market leader in the Room Air Conditioner (RAC) industry, offering integrated HVAC manufacturing solutions to leading multinational and Indian brands. Amber manufactures key components such as heat exchangers, copper tubing, and plastic parts to ensure high quality and operational efficiency. Its Electronics division delivers advanced PCB and PCB assembly solutions across sectors including consumer durables, automotive, industrials, smart electronics, and aerospace. The Railway Subsystems and Defense division provides critical subsystem solutions and customized HVAC systems for applications such as rolling stock, telecom data centers, buses, and defense. 
Role Description The QA Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Faridabad, responsible for leading quality assurance activities across manufacturing operations. This role oversees the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of quality management systems, including inspection protocols, testing standards, and documentation for components and finished products. The QA Manager will manage quality teams, conduct audits, investigate non-conformities, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions to meet internal and customer quality requirements. The position collaborates closely with production, engineering, supply chain, and customer teams to ensure compliance with regulatory and industry standards and to support new product introduction. The QA Manager also monitors key quality metrics, prepares reports for leadership, and promotes a culture of quality, safety, and process discipline on the shop floor. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong quality management and assurance skills, including experience with quality control plans, inspection methods, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Candidates should possess expertise in quality standards and tools, such as ISO-based quality systems, statistical process control, root cause analysis (e. g. , 5 Why, Fishbone), and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) management. 
 - Candidates should possess manufacturing and engineering-related skills, including understanding of HVAC or electronics manufacturing processes, component quality requirements, and production workflows. 
 - Candidates should possess leadership and people management skills, including team supervision, performance coaching, cross-functional collaboration, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Candidates should possess strong analytical and documentation skills, including data analysis, report writing, preparation of SOPs, and maintenance of quality records. 
 - Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor's degree in engineering, quality management, or a related technical field; prior experience in QA roles within consumer durables, electronics, or similar manufacturing environments; and familiarity with safety and regulatory compliance will be beneficial.

data.title: Technical Lead - SDET
data.description:
Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India's growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. 

- About the role

TAC powers IoT connectivity and mobile connectivity services for customers around the world. It manages the full life of SIMs and eSIMs: provisioning, activation, subscription changes and termination. Customers use it to connect millions of devices and consumers. 

We are changing how we build and test TAC. AI is now part of how we design, code, test and deliver. We want quality to move at the same speed. 

This is a senior role. You will own quality for your area from test strategy to release sign-off. You will design how we test, not only run tests. You will use AI to test faster and better, and you will lead the team in doing the same. 

You work with limited supervision, make sound technical calls, and are trusted by the Senior Engineering Manager, architects and product owners on quality decisions. 

- Why this role exists
 - Our platform keeps growing: more GSMA specs, more customers, more devices, more cloud environments. 
 - Manual testing cannot keep up. We need strong automation that people trust. 
 - AI can cut the time spent on test design, test data, failure analysis and reporting. We need someone who can prove it and scale it. 
 - We need a senior voice on quality: someone who sets direction, guides others and holds the bar. 
 - Releases must stay safe. Every release needs clear evidence that it works, is secure and performs. 
 - Key responsibilities

3. 1 IVVQ and test ownership

- Plan and run integration, verification, validation and qualification (IVVQ) for every TAC release. 
 - Design test plans, traceability matrices and a clear regression strategy. 
 - Review requirements and user stories early. Flag gaps, risks and unclear points before development starts. 
 - Define entry and exit criteria for each stage of testing. 
 - Prepare test reports and release sign-off evidence. 
 - Follow the DDPS delivery process and its quality gates. Make sure evidence is ready on time. 
 - Support audits, co-assessments and engineering fundamentals reviews with clear test records. 

3. 2 IoT and mobile connectivity testing

- Test end-to-end connectivity services: SIM and eSIM activation, subscription changes, suspend and resume, and termination. 
 - Test IoT use cases: device onboarding, eSIM provisioning at scale, and profile switching between operators. 
 - Test integrations with mobile network operators (MNOs) and connectivity partners. 
 - Check data, SMS and roaming-related service behavior where it applies to TAC. 
 - Test bulk and batch operations across large device fleets. 
 - Check customer-facing APIs, order flows and error handling against specs and customer needs. 
 - Reproduce customer issues and build regression tests so they do not come back. 

3. 3 eSIM and GSMA domain testing

- Test TAC against GSMA specifications: SGP. 22 (consumer), and SGP. 31 and SGP. 32 (IoT). 
 - Test Remote SIM Provisioning flows end to end: profile download, enable, disable and delete. 
 - Test eIM operations and the roles of IPAd, IPAe, SM-DP+ and eUICC. 
 - Run tests with real SIM and eSIM cards, test profiles and test certificates. 
 - Check that test setups stay valid when external parts change, such as the GSMA test CI or certificates. 
 - Follow GSMA test specs (for example SGP. 23 and SGP. 33) as a guide for conformance coverage. 

3. 4 Test automation

- Build and maintain automation frameworks for API, UI, end-to-end and card-level tests. 
 - Keep the code clean, reusable and easy to review. Treat test code like product code. 
 - Make tests stable. Find and fix flaky tests quickly. 
 - Manage test data and test environments so tests are repeatable. 
 - Automate anything that is done twice. 

3. 5 AI-assisted testing and delivery

- Use AI tools to generate test cases, test data and automation code from requirements and specs. 
 - Use AI to analyze failures, group similar defects, find patterns and spot flaky tests. 
 - Use AI to draft test reports, release notes and defect summaries. Always check the facts. 
 - Review AI output with a critical eye. You own the final quality. 
 - Build small AI-assisted tools and workflows that save the team time. 
 - Try new AI testing ideas. Measure the gain (time saved, defects found, coverage) and share what works. 
 - Protect data. Know what can and cannot be shared with AI tools. 
 - Help the team build good prompting habits and safe AI practices. 

3. 6 Quality, security and performance

- Use SonarQube quality gates. Track code smells, bugs and coverage, and help fix them. 
 - Use Fortify for static security scans. Track findings to closure and retest fixes. 
 - Do basic security and API security testing, including authentication and authorization checks (OAuth, Keycloak). 
 - Run performance, load, stress, endurance and resilience tests, including large device and order volumes. 
 - Do performance engineering and benchmarking: set baselines, compare releases and report trends. 
 - Find bottlenecks and work with developers on fixes. Retest to confirm the gain. 

3. 7 Platform and delivery

- Integrate tests into CI/CD so every build gets fast feedback. 
 - Test on Kubernetes, using Docker images and Helm charts. 
 - Validate deliveries on GCP and AWS environments. 
 - Use Git for code, branching and code reviews. 
 - Test gateway, security and infrastructure components, for example Kong, APISIX and Keycloak. 
 - Check upgrade, rollback and deployment paths, not only features. 

3. 8 Agile ways of working and teamwork

- Take part in PI planning, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives in an Agile and SAFe setup. 
 - Triage defects, find root causes and work closely with developers, architects and product owners. 
 - Work with Product, Platform, DevOps and Blueprint teams on shared deliveries. 
 - Mentor junior testers. Raise the quality bar of the team. 
 - Update the Senior Engineering Manager on quality, risks and progress. Speak up early. 

3. 9 Senior-level ownership and leadership

- Own the test strategy for your area of TAC. Decide what to test, how deep, and with which tools. 
 - Design the architecture of our automation frameworks. Set standards for structure, reuse, naming and reviews. 
 - Lead release sign-off for your area. Take the go or no-go quality view and explain the risks clearly. 
 - Define and own the AI-in-testing roadmap: pick use cases, run pilots, measure gains and scale what works. 
 - Set quality gates and metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flakiness, performance trends) and report them to leadership. 
 - Influence requirements, architecture and design reviews from a testability and risk point of view. 
 - Lead technical triage for customer escalations and critical defects. Drive root cause and prevention. 
 - Estimate effort, plan capacity and raise risks early during PI and sprint planning. 
 - Coach and mentor testers and engineers. Review their work, grow their skills and build a strong bench. 
 - Take part in interviews and hiring, and help build the team's skills plan. 
 - Work across teams (Product, Platform, DevOps, Blueprint, other feature teams) and resolve quality dependencies. 
 - What we are looking for

4. 1 Must have

- Experience: 6+ years in QA, SDET or IVVQ roles, with strong automation work and 2+ years as owner or lead of a test area or framework. 
 - Framework design: Proven record of designing and growing automation frameworks, not only using them. 
 - Programming: Strong in Java or Python. Able to write clean, maintainable test code. 
 - Automation tools: Hands-on with tools such as Selenium, REST Assured, Postman, Cypress or Playwright. 
 - API testing: Solid skills in REST, JSON, OAuth and Keycloak basics. 
 - Connectivity: Understanding of IoT connectivity and mobile connectivity services (SIM lifecycle, subscriptions, MNO integration). 
 - eSIM: Good understanding of eSIM, eUICC and the Remote SIM Provisioning flow. 
 - GSMA: Working knowledge of SGP. 22 and SGP. 31 / SGP. 32. Understanding of IPAd, IPAe and eIM roles. 
 - CI/CD: Experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar. 
 - Containers: Hands-on with Docker as the container, Kubernetes as the orchestrator and Helm as the package manager. 
 - Cloud: Familiar with GCP or AWS as a platform. 
 - Source control: Git for repository management, branching and reviews. 
 - Quality and security tools: Experience with SonarQube and Fortify, or similar tools. 
 - Performance: Experience in performance testing, performance engineering and benchmarking. 
 - Process: Agile development experience. Good test design: test plans, traceability, coverage and regression strategy. 
 - Leadership: Experience mentoring others and influencing decisions without formal authority. 
 - Communication: Clear written and spoken communication, including reporting risks to senior stakeholders and customers. 

4. 2 AI skills we expect

- Daily use of AI assistants for coding and testing. 
 - Able to write clear prompts and review AI output with care. 
 - Understand AI limits: wrong answers, bias and data privacy. 
 - Comfort building AI-assisted test tools or workflows and driving their adoption across a team. 
 - Curiosity to learn new AI tools and test whether they really help. 

4. 3 Good to have

- Cellular basics: 4G/5G, LTE-M, NB-IoT, APN and roaming. 
 - Experience with a connectivity management platform (CMP) or an IoT platform. 
 - Experience with SGP. 21, SGP. 23 and SGP. 33 test specs. 
 - Knowledge of SM-DP+, SM-DS and eIM servers. 
 - Performance tools such as JMeter, Gatling or k6. 
 - Jira and Xray for test management. 
 - Experience with AI agents or LLM-based test generation. 
 - Security testing: OWASP, API security. 
 - Experience with API gateways such as Kong or APISIX. 
 - Telecom or IoT product background. 

4. 4 Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecom or a related field. 
 - How this role supports our AI transformation

We expect AI to become part of normal testing work. This table shows how we see it. 

Area

What AI Helps With, And What You Do

Test design

AI drafts test cases and edge cases from specs and requirements. You review, fix and approve them. 

Test data

AI helps create varied and realistic data. You check it is safe, valid and free of customer data. 

Automation code

AI helps write and refactor test scripts. You review for quality, readability and correctness. 

Failure analysis

AI groups failures and points to likely causes. You confirm the root cause with developers. 

Reporting

AI drafts reports and summaries. You check every fact before it is shared. 

Team enablement

You share prompts, tips and working examples so the whole team improves. 

Roadmap and governance

You pick the use cases, define safe-use rules, measure the gain and report it to leadership. 

At Thales, we're committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you'll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

CI/CD, Cloud and Non-Functional Quality

 - Strong experience testing modern web applications across multiple browsers and responsive interfaces.

 - Experience integrating automation with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent. 
 - Proficiency with Git-based version control, pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies. 
 - Experience with BDD and Gherkin, with sound judgment on where behavior-driven specifications add value.

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Designs comprehensive test plans for a functional area, selecting strategies to address technical unknowns and scalability. Manages test environments, executes validation for critical services, and performs risk-based regression. Investigates and reports defects, participates in post-incident reviews, and tracks quality metrics. Collaborates across teams to align test activities and improve tools and processes. Develops automation scripts, executes tests in Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and applies quality gate criteria at key checkpoints. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Test Design and Strategy: 

- Designs comprehensive test plans that align with quality goals of the function and product vision. 
 - Chooses strategies based on behavior to inform architecture and tooling initiatives. 
 - Evaluates coverage to account for technical unknowns and scalability across systems within own functional test area. 

Test Execution: 

- Manages test environments and ensures adequate data for testing. 
 - Executes validation tasks for critical service areas by following test plans, identifying defects, and escalating risks to support prioritization and service quality. 
 - Follows documentation for failures across components, working with others to implement corrections where needed. 
 - Performs risk-based regression to balance speed, risk, and automation coverage across products or services. 

Defect Tracking and Management: 

- Reproduces, diagnoses, and collaborates on customer-reported issues, ensuring timely resolution. 
 - Investigates and escalates defects across features. 
 - Owns reporting on test progress/defects, working with engineering to address root causes. 
 - Contributes to post-incident (post-mortem) reviews by gathering relevant data, documenting observations, and assisting in the identification of root causes; supports the drafting of findings and preventative actions for leadership review. 
 - Leads triage for components on root cause analysis to uncover recurring quality issues and drive improvements. 

Collaboration and Communication: 

- Assists with cross-functional quality initiatives by tracking test coverage against feature delivery, surfacing test concerns, and supporting coordination with partner teams on test activities. 
 - Works with cross-functional development team members to align on areas for testing. 
 - Influences the design and prioritizes testing and tooling. 
 - Develops and enhances test management and automation tools to improve automation and test processes. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Follows and applies established processes to improve consistency and reduce friction in engineering workflows within a defined feature or task area. 

Automation: 

- Participates in quality improvement efforts by sharing observations and documenting test execution gaps within the team. 
 - Implements automation scripts by following established patterns to support test coverage within a component or feature. 
 - Identifies and reports automation issues by executing tests and escalating failures or gaps to senior team members. 
 - Executes automated tests within Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) workflows and raise issues related to test failures or integration breaks. 

Risk Assessment: 

- Identifies quality risks early and collaborates to mitigate them. 
 - Applies quality gate criteria on checklist at key software development checkpoints by reviewing test results, static analysis outputs, and defect trends, soliciting approval for completion. 
 - Reviews test plans to ensure potential impact areas are accurately identified and addressed by Scrum teams, coordinating across functions to confirm adequate test coverage and risk mitigation. 

Test Tooling: 

- Develops and enhances test management and automation tools that increase efficiency and scalability. 

Additional Responsibilities (as needed): 

Performance Testing: 

- Tests non-functional requirements, including single-user performance, scalability, and responsiveness under dynamic workloads. 
 - Engages performance to support load testing, tooling, and system tuning for high-risk or complex scenarios. 
 - Incorporates user experience considerations into performance assessments to ensure acceptable response times and system usability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. 
 - Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. 
 - Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. 
 - Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. 
 - Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. 
 - Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. 
 - Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. 
 - Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. 
 - Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Job Description:

data.description:
Job Title - VTEX Commerce Architect - Manager - ACS Song

Management Level: Level 7-Manager

Location: Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai

Must have skills: VTEX, VTEX IO, FastStore, Store Framework, Headless Commerce, GraphQL, React/Next. js, Commerce Architecture

Good to have skills: Enterprise Integration, Cloud-Native Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, DevSecOps, Agile Delivery

Experience: 13 - 15 years of experience is required, including strong enterprise commerce architecture experience

Educational Qualification: Graduation in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced VTEX Commerce Architect with 13-15 years of overall technology experience and proven expertise in architecting enterprise-scale digital commerce solutions using VTEX. The candidate will own end-to-end solution architecture across VTEX Commerce Platform, VTEX IO, Store Framework, FastStore, headless storefronts, GraphQL APIs, integrations, security, performance, scalability, and operational readiness. 

The ideal candidate should combine hands-on VTEX platform knowledge with strong architectural thinking. The role requires translating complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions, evaluating native VTEX capabilities versus custom extensions, leading architecture governance, and guiding distributed engineering teams through design and delivery. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Own and drive the end-to-end architecture of enterprise digital commerce solutions built on the VTEX Commerce Platform. 
 - Define solution architecture covering catalog, pricing, promotions, search, cart, checkout, payments, orders, logistics, inventory, marketplace, sellers, and VTEX Master Data. 
 - Design modern storefront solutions using VTEX Store Framework, VTEX IO, FastStore, React, Next. js, and GraphQL. 
 - Lead the design of headless and composable commerce architectures, including presentation, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), commerce services, CMS, search, identity, and enterprise integration layers. 
 - Evaluate business requirements and determine when to use native VTEX capabilities, VTEX IO applications, custom services, middleware, or third-party products. 
 - Define GraphQL and REST API contracts, schema design, API aggregation, versioning, caching, rate limiting, security, and error-handling standards. 
 - Design integrations between VTEX and ERP, PIM/MDM, OMS, WMS, CRM, payment gateways, tax services, identity providers, search platforms, and marketplaces. 
 - Define synchronous, asynchronous, webhook, and event-driven integration patterns with appropriate retry, idempotency, dead-letter, reconciliation, and observability mechanisms. 
 - Establish non-functional requirements for performance, scalability, availability, reliability, accessibility, SEO, maintainability, security, privacy, and disaster recovery. 
 - Design storefront performance strategies using SSR, SSG/ISR, CDN, edge caching, browser caching, image optimization, and Core Web Vitals principles. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical risk assessments, production issue reviews, root-cause analysis, and long-term remediation planning. 
 - Create and maintain HLDs, LLDs, C4 diagrams, sequence diagrams, integration specifications, API specifications, data-flow diagrams, and Architecture Decision Records. 
 - Guide engineering teams during implementation and ensure adherence to architecture principles, coding standards, security controls, and operational requirements. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, client architects, security teams, infrastructure teams, and delivery leadership to align architecture with business objectives. 
 - Mentor technical leads, senior developers, and architects, while promoting engineering excellence and continuous learning.
