data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Senior Software Engineer

Overview

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Mastercard Payment Networks Technology team is looking for a Sr. Software Engineer to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. 

Role

- Independently translate business and system requirements into pragmatic designs, modular code, rapid AI proofs of concept (PoCs), minimum viable products (MVPs), and production-ready applications. 
 - Build AI-powered applications and backend services using hosted foundation-model APIs, SDKs, enterprise data, and reusable services; evaluate ideas quickly and recommend whether they should progress, pivot, or stop. 
 - Build end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, citations, and permission-aware responses. 
 - Build and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and servers that expose enterprise tools, prompts, resources, data, and services through standardized, governed, and auditable interfaces. 
 - Develop agentic workflows using tool calling, orchestration, state and memory patterns, structured outputs, guardrails, confidence controls, output validation, and human-in-the-loop approvals. 
 - Use Claude, GitHub Copilot, and comparable AI-assisted engineering tools hands-on to accelerate discovery, prototyping, coding, testing, documentation, and code review while protecting confidential information and validating generated output. 
 - Define engineering standards, evaluation criteria, and automated validation processes for AI-powered applications and developer productivity solutions, ensuring high quality, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational excellence. 
 - Productionize validated AI solutions using secure coding, automated testing, CI/CD, configuration management, observability, resilience, performance optimization, and rollback strategies. 
 - Embed security, privacy, compliance, Responsible AI, least-privilege access, role-based authorization, secrets management, data minimization, content safety, and auditability into solution design. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, architects, platform engineers, quality engineers, domain experts, and business stakeholders to resolve roadblocks and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced Agile environment. 

All About You

Must-have qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong software engineering experience delivering secure, reliable enterprise applications, APIs, backend services, or distributed systems, with the independence expected of a Senior Software Engineer. 
 - Hands-on experience building AI-enabled applications using modern programming languages, enterprise data, APIs, and AI-assisted development tools. 
 - Practical experience with LLM applications, RAG, agentic workflows, or similar applied AI patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI application frameworks, hosted model services, and relevant SDKs to build and integrate enterprise AI solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, distributed systems, automated testing, secure development, CI/CD, and production support practices. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in payments, high-volume transaction processing, or other highly available and regulated technology environments. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native platforms, observability, resiliency, and Responsible AI practices. 

Skills, Tools & Technologies

Must Have

- Core: Python or another modern programming language, experience with SQL and other relational or NoSQL databases, backend services and distributed systems for integrating enterprise data, AI capabilities, and resilient high-volume transaction workflows, strong debugging skills, Git, and automated testing. 
 - AI workflows and quality: LLM application development and RAG, with emphasis on prompts and agent workflows, and guardrails and evaluation logic. 
 - AI platforms and frameworks: Knowledge of Anthropic APIs, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent hosted-model services, and LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent SDKs. 

Good To Have

- Enterprise application engineering: REST/gRPC APIs, secure coding, and CI/CD practices that automate testing and evaluation and enable reliable AI application releases. 
 - Cloud-native reliability and operations: AWS or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, observability, security controls, and high-availability application design. 
 - Domain technology stack: C/C++, SQL, Unix/Linux, sockets, inter-process communication (IPC), shared memory, and microservices. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

We are looking for a Senior Data Quality SME / Solution Architect to lead Data Quality strategy, requirements translation, solution design, and delivery for enterprise client engagements. 

The ideal candidate will work directly with client stakeholders/client proxies, understand complex business and data requirements, translate them into actionable Data Quality rules, and guide a small team of Data Quality Engineers to deliver the solution.

Define and own the overall Data Quality and testing strategy across different data pipeline layers. 

Design appropriate rules covering validation, duplicate detection, reconciliation, checksum, pushdown and script-based testing. 

Determine the appropriate pipeline layer for each rule and avoid redundant or overlapping checks. 

Define rule parameters including thresholds, severity, exception handling and routing. 

Work closely with client engineering, data and business teams to understand data flows and quality requirements. 

Present, explain and defend Data Quality logic and results to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Act as the escalation point for complex Data Quality issues, job failures and platform-related problems.

Data Quality strategy and rule design

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer
data.description:
We are looking to engage an experienced Senior Platform Engineer to design and build this shared platform capability. 

This is a hands-on engineering role combining cloud platform engineering, workflow orchestration, automation and Python developer enablement. It is not a traditional infrastructure administration role and is not a pure application-development role. The successful candidate will work across Amazon Web Services, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service, Kubernetes, Argo Workflows, infrastructure automation, platform security, observability and delivery pipelines. 

The role will also create reusable Python libraries, workflow abstractions, examples and documentation that enable actuarial and other adopter teams to build their own governed workflows. The Platform Engineer will provide enablement, technical review and assurance rather than developing all adopter business logic. 

The initial delivery model is expected to include two cross-functional Platform Engineers. Each engineer should be capable of contributing across the end-to-end platform lifecycle, reducing key-person dependency and ensuring the platform remains supportable after initial delivery. 

Role Responsibilities

Platform Engineering

• Design and implement the platform on Amazon Web Services, using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service and standard Kubernetes interfaces. 

• Create cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, storage and security configuration through version-controlled Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform. 

• Implement Argo Workflows and related platform services for multi-step, parallel, recoverable and traceable workflow execution. 

• Configure workload classes, queues, priorities, quotas, compute pools, autoscaling and cost controls for analytical and batch workloads. 

• Integrate approved container registries, secrets management, object storage, monitoring, logging and enterprise service-management capabilities. 

• Build for high availability, controlled upgrades, disaster recovery, operational support and future portability. 

Developer Enablement

• Develop supported Python libraries, software development kits and abstractions that simplify workflow creation and hide unnecessary Kubernetes complexity. 

• Create representative workflow examples, templates and reference implementations for adopter teams. 

• Define clear workload contracts covering inputs, outputs, parameters, resource requirements, status, failure handling and retained artefacts. 

• Provide guidance and technical review to actuarial and other teams building workloads on the platform. 

• Produce concise developer documentation, onboarding material and troubleshooting guidance. 

Delivery Automation

• Create supported Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines for building, testing, scanning, signing and promoting container images and workflow assets. 

• Implement source-controlled platform configuration and automated reconciliation using Argo CD, Flux or an approved equivalent. 

• Ensure deployable artefacts are built once and the same approved version is promoted through development, test, user acceptance and production environments. 

• Implement traceability across source code, container images, workflow definitions, inputs, outputs and runtime versions. 

Security, Reliability & Operations

• Implement least-privilege identity, role-based access, network isolation, secure secret injection and policy enforcement before workload execution. 

• Build observability using metrics, logs, traces and audit records that support operations, security monitoring and workflow-level troubleshooting. 

• Develop backup, recovery, resilience and platform rebuild automation and evidence. 

• Create operational runbooks, support boundaries, lifecycle procedures and production-readiness evidence. 

• Work closely with Quality Assurance, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Cloud Shared Services and service-management teams. 

Stakeholder & Technology Engagement

• Work with actuarial developers and subject-matter experts who will build business workflows using the platform libraries, templates and patterns. 

• Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture on high-level design and contribute practical engineering detail to the low-level platform design. 

• Engage Cloud Shared Services on account, network, identity, security and cloud-governance dependencies. 

• Explain complex platform decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and constructively challenge weak assumptions. 

Skills & Experience

Essential

• Strong hands-on Amazon Web Services experience, including production use of Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service. 

• Deep practical knowledge of Kubernetes workload scheduling, networking, identity, storage, security and cluster operations. 

• Infrastructure as Code experience, with Terraform strongly preferred. 

• Experience implementing workflow orchestration using Argo Workflows or a closely comparable container-native workflow engine. 

• Strong Python development skills and experience creating reusable libraries, frameworks, software development kits or developer tooling. 

• Experience designing and implementing Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines and container software supply-chain controls. 

• Experience with GitOps practices and tools such as Argo CD or Flux. 

• Practical experience of container image design, versioning, vulnerability scanning and controlled promotion. 

• Experience implementing identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and least-privilege platform policies. 

• Experience implementing monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, backup and recovery for production services. 

• Ability to take a platform from design through build, test, production readiness and early-life support. 

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex platform concepts to non-specialists. 

Desirable

• Experience building an internal developer platform or multi-tenant analytical compute platform. 

• Knowledge of cloud batch scheduling, workload priority, autoscaling and cost optimisation. 

• Experience with Argo CD, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, enterprise logging platforms and policy-as-code tools. 

• Experience of Amazon Simple Storage Service, mounted storage patterns and traceable data or artefact pipelines. 

• Background supporting actuarial, pricing, modelling, optimisation, research or other compute-intensive workloads. 

• Experience operating in insurance, reinsurance, financial services or another regulated environment. 

• Familiarity with model reproducibility, dependency lineage, runtime baselines and controlled package upgrades.

data.title: Architect - Agentic NOC
data.description:
Born in India, Built for the World

Amagi is an Emmy®-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization-from live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication. 

Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers: 

9, 000+ channels across 300+ content distributors

500, 000+ hours of content processed

26 billion+ monetized ad impressions

We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN-and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate. 

Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us. 

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1, 000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. 

To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here. 

Work Mode : In-Office

Location : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)

Position overview

We are looking for an Architect to set the technical direction of our core backend and AI platform. You will define how we build, orchestrate and scale agentic AI systems on top of highly available, fault-tolerant distributed infrastructure, and make AI-first engineering the default way our teams work. 

You will own the platform architecture end to end: from target-state design and architecture RFCs through to reference implementations, evaluation strategy, rollout and production reliability at scale. You stay hands-on, building critical-path components and prototypes yourself. 

Our stack is built on Golang and AWS. Language is not a barrier: we care about deep computer science fundamentals, sound architectural judgement, data-driven decisions, and a track record of designing backend platforms that others build on. 

Core responsibilities

Agent platform architecture: Define the reference architecture for autonomous agents and multi-agent systems: execution loops, tool-calling (function calling) interfaces, structured outputs, agent-to-agent and agent-to-system protocols (including MCP), and integration with enterprise backends. 

Distributed systems design: Architect event-driven backends for asynchronous agent state, long-running and durable workflows (Temporal), context management, and memory/retrieval layers (vector and graph stores, hybrid search). Set the consistency, idempotency and failure-isolation models teams build against. 

Technical strategy and roadmap: Own a 12-18 month architecture roadmap aligned with product strategy. Make build-vs-buy and vendor decisions for LLM providers, agent frameworks, retrieval stores and eval tooling, with abstraction layers that avoid model lock-in. 

Cloud and multi-tenancy: Design cost-effective, secure, multi-tenant AWS architecture across EKS, RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL), SQS, Lambda, EventBridge and related primitives. Own tenant isolation, authn/authz and secrets handling for agent tools. 

Reliability, guardrails and cost: Set platform SLOs and the standards for guardrails, rate limiting, fallbacks, error handling and LLM cost controls across multi-step agent executions. Lead capacity planning, resilience testing and post-incident architectural fixes. 

Evaluation and quality: Define the agent evaluation strategy (offline evals, regression suites, production monitoring of agent quality) and make it part of every team's CI/CD. 

AI-first engineering: Set how teams use AI engineering tools (e. g. Cursor, Claude Code, custom LLM toolchains) for design, code generation, refactoring and testing, with the review and quality standards that go with them. 

Standards and governance: Own API design standards, service boundaries, data ownership and versioning. Run architecture reviews and the RFC/ADR process for cross-service changes. 

Technical leadership: Mentor senior engineers and tech leads, grow the next architects, and work with Engineering and Product leadership on scoping, sequencing and risk. 

Required qualifications

Experience: 10+ years of professional backend engineering, including 3+ years as an architect, principal or staff engineer owning the design of a multi-service platform. 

Agentic and AI systems: Has designed and shipped LLM-driven systems in production: agents, tool-calling, agentic execution loops, RAG pipelines or multi-agent orchestration, including their evaluation and guardrails. 

Distributed systems depth: Expert knowledge of distributed principles: consistency models, caching, message queues, state management, durable workflows, backpressure and fault isolation. Can reason through race conditions and failure modes at scale. 

Architecture track record: Has led at least one platform through significant scale or re-architecture, and can show the trade-offs made and their outcomes. 

Language mastery: Production-level mastery of at least one modern backend language (Golang, Python, Java, C++, Rust or TypeScript), and willingness to work primarily in Golang. 

Cloud infrastructure: Deep hands-on experience architecting on AWS (or GCP/Azure equivalents), including multi-tenant design, security and cost optimisation. 

Engineering rigour: High standards for clean architecture, automated testing (including agent eval frameworks), CI/CD and observability (metrics, tracing, logging). 

AI-first mindset: Uses AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily, and can define how a team adopts them well. 

Communication: Writes clear RFCs and design docs that others can decide from; influences across teams without direct authority. 

Good to have

Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (e. g. LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK) and LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Bedrock). 

Experience designing LLM observability, guardrail or evaluation platforms. 

Experience defining architecture across multiple teams or an org-wide technical strategy. 

Open-source contributions or public talks on distributed systems or AI infrastructure. 

Success in year one

A documented target architecture and roadmap for the agent platform, adopted by teams and stakeholders. 

Platform SLOs and LLM cost budgets defined, instrumented and met. 

Agent evals running in CI/CD for every production agent pipeline. 

A working RFC/ADR and architecture-review process teams use without being chased. 

At least one senior engineer grown into a tech-lead or architect-track role. 

Life at Amagi: 

Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day. 

Be Vulnerable, Be You. Authenticity is our baseline. 

Goodness Wins. We always lead with integrity. 

Have Fun with Challenges. We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks. 

Think Macro, Do Micro. We dream big but execute with relentless precision. 

A Place That Takes Care of You: 

We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack builds substantial, interactive features inside Onit's enterprise legal operations platform, spanning enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management, and contract lifecycle management. Working across a Ruby on Rails backend and a modern JavaScript frontend, this individual contributor delivers data-dense, accurate, and resilient user experiences that fit seamlessly into the workflows legal teams rely on every day. The role partners closely with design, product, and the architecture team, owning features end to end from API to interface, with a strong focus on edge cases, performance, accessibility, and test coverage. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build substantial, interactive features inside an existing enterprise product, without disrupting the workflows they sit within. 
 - Implement data visualisations (line charts, comparison tables, range indicators) where the visual encoding carries real meaning and small inaccuracies mislead users. 
 - Build filtering and comparison controls that update complex views in real time. 
 - Implement every state the feature can be in: loading, error, empty, and the cases where there is insufficient data to show a comparison at all. These matter as much as the primary path. 
 - Build and extend Ruby on Rails APIs, consume APIs built by the architecture team, and push back early when a contract does not serve the interface well. 
 - Work closely with design, matching intent precisely and raising discrepancies rather than approximating. 
 - Make sure features load asynchronously and never block or slow the workflows they are embedded in. 
 - Build for accessibility and cross-browser consistency. 
 - Instrument features so the team can measure how they are actually used. 
 - Write tests that cover behaviour, including the degraded cases. 

Required Skills

- 6+ years building production web applications, with significant frontend ownership and hands-on backend development. 
 - Strong backend experience with Ruby on Rails: building and modifying APIs, data models, and services, not only consuming them. 
 - Strong proficiency with a modern JavaScript framework (React, Angular, or Vue) and solid JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, including a real understanding of rendering and state management, not just framework APIs.

Staff Design Evaluation Engineer - Automotive Networking

Role Overview

Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Staff Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking team in Hyderabad, India. In this senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions. 

You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and lead comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs. 
 - Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation. 
 - Architect, develop, bring up, and maintain hardware and software evaluation platforms, test fixtures, reference systems, and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation. 
 - Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries. 
 - Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment. 
 - Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution. 
 - Evaluate Automotive Ethernet T1S and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability. 
 - Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation. 
 - Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in test architecture, automation, data quality, traceability, repeatability, and laboratory efficiency. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring, lead design and code reviews, and contribute to planning, estimation, and prioritisation activities. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - Typically seven or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role. 
 - Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs. 
 - Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software. 
 - Strong knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration. 
 - Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based decision-making. 
 - Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability. 
 - Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts, together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I2C, and UART. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership, collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

- Experience with automotive Ethernet technologies, including 10BASE-T1S, single-pair Ethernet, MAC-PHY devices, Physical Layer Collision Avoidance, or related in-vehicle networking solutions. 
 - Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards. 
 - Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection. 
 - Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host-side software with evaluation hardware. 
 - Experience with audio and video interfaces or data paths, including PDM and RGB8. 
 - Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, automated regression frameworks, requirements traceability, and issue-tracking systems. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical reviews, or coordinating evaluation activities across multiple sites or disciplines.

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer
data.description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1, 400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner. 

Role: 

As a Senior Quality Engineer - you will play a pivotal role in elevating our quality practices across customer-facing event management workflows, booking and registration experiences, operational administration, product integrations, and complex distributed systems. You will be an expert within our engineering organization, deeply understanding product behaviour, customer journeys, business rules, and the systems that support seamless conference and event experiences. This role will balance hands-on individual contributor responsibilities with leading, influencing, and coaching your peers. 

This individual contributor role is for someone who is passionate about seeing systems holistically, has a strong vision for product quality, and is eager to drive the highest standards of customer experience, functional correctness, usability, accessibility, reliability, performance, and release confidence. You will leverage your deep understanding of SaaS product behaviour, end-to-end workflows, integrations, environments, and customer operations to guide and influence our development process. 

You will not manage people. You will set the quality bar for your team, do the work to hold it, and coach the engineers, product managers and designers around you to share ownership of it. You will report to the Director of Quality and work day-to-day with your team's Engineering Manager, Product Manager and engineers, alongside Support and Implementation Services when payment issues reach customers. 

What You Will Own: 

- Own the end-to-end test strategy within your team's area, deciding how things get tested based on the risk each change carries. 
 - Design validation for payment flows including authorisation, capture, settlement, partial and full refunds, failed and retried transactions, chargebacks, idempotency, and reconciliation between our records and the provider's. 
 - Coach and support your team to make of quality everyone's responsibility, and provide hands on support via executing testing activities when required. 
 - Validate integrations with third party payment gateways and providers. 
 - Engage from discovery and refinement onward: challenge assumptions, surface missing scenarios, and make sure acceptance criteria are specific and testable before a story is picked up. 
 - Assess your team's current quality maturity honestly, build a plan to lift it over the next two to three quarters, and share what you learn with Senior QAs on other teams facing the same gaps. 
 - Coach engineers on testing principles, test design, and shared ownership of automated tests, the goal is a team that builds quality in, not a QA who inspects for it. 
 - Mentor mid-level QA engineers on risk assessment, automation, observability and shift left practice. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline health and deployment quality gates: test suite selection, environment readiness, pre and post deploy checks, and safe release strategies including feature flags and staged rollout. 
 - Own production defect triage for Payments: assess customer and financial impact, distinguish severity from priority, drive fixes at the right urgency, follow through to root cause & prevention, and provide regular updates on defect remediation. 
 - Represent Payments quality in incident reviews and, where needed, in conversations with Support and customer facing teams. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 5+ years of progressive software engineering or quality engineering with deep focus on quality in complex, distributed system environments 
 - Hands-on experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate customer needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and risk-based test scenarios that support high-quality product delivery. 
 - Proven track record advocating for quality and ability to influence technical direction through innovative, pragmatic, and evidence-based approaches. 
 - Hands-on experience working with web-based products, including front-end behaviour, API, service integration and functional end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience contributing to test automation frameworks and using and have a solid understanding of the testing pyramid. 
 - Practical experience working with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Build-kite, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection and environment readiness checks. 
 - Ability to translate customer needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and risk-based test scenarios in collaboration with cross functional teams. 
 - Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills across complex, multi system failures. 
 - Excellent technical communication, you influence engineers, product managers and business stakeholders through evidence and expertise rather than authority. 
 - Practical experience using AI in modern software development, with sound judgement about where it helps and where it does not. 
 - Genuine curiosity about product architecture, customer workflows, and the business impact of engineering decisions. 

Reasons to join our team: 

- Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years
 - Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
 - A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
 - Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions. 
 - Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

Machinify is a healthcare payment integrity company formed through the 2024-2025 merger of five industry-leading businesses: Apixio Payment Integrity (CPS/ClaimLogiq), Varis, Rawlings Company (Right Payer Solutions), legacy Machinify, and Performant Health. The company is in the midst of consolidating four distinct technology organizations onto a unified platform and operating model.

Machinify is hiring a VP, Head of Engineering to lead the company's India-based engineering organization. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for building and scaling a unified engineering team of 50-100 engineers in India, delivering against the global product roadmap, and serving as the senior technical and people leader for the India site. The role reports directly to the CTO and is a key partner in consolidating engineering practices across Machinify's four legacy entities onto a single technology and delivery model. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end delivery for the India engineering organization, partnering with global product, design, and engineering leadership to ship on the committed roadmap. 
 - Build, scale, and lead a high-performing engineering team in India, including hiring, org design, career development, and performance management.

 - Partner with the CTO and global engineering leaders on technical architecture decisions, particularly around integrating mixed cloud and on-premise infrastructure across entities. 

machinify. com

 - Manage engineering budget, vendor relationships, and resourcing for the India site.

Requirements

- 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ people. 
 - Proven experience building and scaling engineering teams in India, ideally within a global, multi-site organization. 
 - Experience operating in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, insurance, or similar) with exposure to compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, or equivalent.

data.title: Principal Firmware Engineer, High-Speed Ethernet
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Firmware Engineer to lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and validation of low-level firmware for high-speed Ethernet solutions, including Gigabit MAC/PCS/PHY-adjacent interfaces, PTP/gPTP timing, TSN features, DMA, QoS, and platform drivers. 

This role requires a technically strong engineer who can operate at both system and register level: define firmware architecture, develop production-quality drivers, diagnose hardware/software issues on silicon, guide firmware engineers, and collaborate closely with RTL, verification, silicon validation, applications, and customers. 

The successful candidate will own critical aspects of the Ethernet firmware stack from boot-time initialization through high-throughput data-path operation, time synchronization, traffic scheduling, error handling, diagnostics, and performance characterization. 

What You'll Achieve

Technical Architecture and Ownership

- Define firmware architecture for high-speed Ethernet subsystems supporting high speed gigabit Ethernet modes. 
 - Lead design of low-level drivers for Ethernet MAC, DMA, PCS, SerDes/PHY control interfaces, MDIO, interrupt controllers, clock/reset, and associated IP blocks. 
 - Define scalable driver state machines for initialization, configuration, link management, normal operation, diagnostics, fault recovery, and reset handling. 
 - Establish firmware interfaces and configuration models for Ethernet QoS, PTP, TSN, packet classification, DMA queues, and traffic scheduling. 
 - Identify hardware/software integration risks early and influence hardware architecture, register design, diagnostics, and verification requirements. 
 - Design firmware for high-throughput and low-latency operation for Gigabit Ethernet. 
 - Analyze and optimize CPU utilization, DMA bandwidth, memory bandwidth, interrupt load, cache behavior, and buffer utilization. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis for packet loss, descriptor corruption, DMA stalls, RX starvation, TX underflow, FIFO overflow, bus errors, and performance regressions. 
 - Ensure correct cache-coherency and memory-ordering behavior on Arm-based SoCs with coherent or non-coherent DMA. 

PTP / gPTP / Time Synchronization

- Develop and integrate firmware support for hardware timestamping and IEEE 1588 PTP / IEEE 802. 1AS gPTP. 
 - Configure and manage PTP clocks, timestamp units, clock adjustment, rollover handling, and TX/RX timestamp correlation. 
 - Support synchronization applications requiring deterministic timing and bounded timestamp latency. 
 - Develop diagnostics and performance characterization for time synchronization accuracy, offset, drift, jitter, timestamp loss, and synchronization recovery. 
 - Collaborate with system/software teams on PTP stack integration and time-domain requirements. 

TSN and Ethernet QoS

- Lead firmware enablement for relevant TSN and QoS capabilities
 - Define queue allocation, scheduling, buffer, and congestion-management policies for mixed traffic environments. 
 - Develop traffic test scenarios to validate latency, jitter, throughput, packet loss, fairness, and isolation under congested conditions. 

Bring-Up, Debug, and Validation

- Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware bring-up for Ethernet subsystems. 
 - Debug complex hardware/firmware interactions
 - Develop fault-injection and negative-test scenarios
 - Drive technical resolution of customer and field escalations. 

Leadership and Collaboration

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to firmware engineers. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, debug reviews, and design-for-testability discussions. 
 - Establish reusable driver frameworks, coding patterns, debug utilities, and test infrastructure. 
 - Work closely with RTL, design verification, validation, software, systems, security, safety, product, and customer engineering teams. 
 - Guide junior and senior engineers toward independent ownership of firmware subsystems. 
 - Communicate technical risks, design choices, trade-offs, and milestones clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, device-driver, networking, or semiconductor software development experience
 - Proven hands-on experience developing low-level drivers for Ethernet MAC, DMA, PHY/PCS control, networking accelerators, or comparable high-performance peripheral IP. 
 - Strong understanding of Ethernet fundamentals including Ethernet frame format; MAC and PHY operation; VLAN / IEEE 802. 1Q; QoS / 802. 1p; link negotiation and management; MDIO/MDC; flow control; multicast and filtering. 
 - Strong experience with DMA architectures
 - Strong understanding of embedded C/C++ and low-level programming concepts: 
 - Strong Arm SoC knowledge of Cortex-A, Cortex-R, Cortex-M; 
 - Experience with IEEE 1588 PTP, gPTP, hardware timestamping, or time synchronization systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to debug difficult system issues using hardware and software observability tools. 
 - Ability to lead technical design and influence teams across firmware, RTL, verification, and validation. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with 25GbE, 10GbE, 40GbE, 50GbE, or other high-speed Ethernet MAC/PCS/SerDes-based systems. 
 - Experience with TSN features including IEEE 802. 1Qav, 802. 1Qbv, 802. 1Qbu, 802. 1Qci, IEEE 802. 3br, and IEEE 802. 1AS. 
 - Experience with Ethernet MACsec / IEEE 802. 1AE, MKA, replay protection, secure association management, or secure networking. 
 - Experience with high-speed packet test equipment, traffic generators, packet analyzers, and performance benchmarking. 
 - Experience with FPGA prototyping, emulation, pre-silicon firmware development, or post-silicon validation. 

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

data.description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world. 

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team. 

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® CertificationTM. 

How You'll Make An Impact

At Cin7, we are transforming the way businesses manage inventory, sales, and operations to make it cheaper, faster, and easier for businesses all over the world to get their products into their customers' hands. 

We're looking for a highly experienced full stack Senior Software Engineer who works AI-natively and can help push Cin7's engineering practices forward. This role is primarily focused on . NET development across different types of projects, including applications built with . NET Framework, . NET, and ASP. NET MVC, with frontend technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. 

You'll operate as a senior technical advisor: designing and implementing high-quality . NET solutions, using AI tools and agents to accelerate your own development workflow, helping evaluate and build AI-powered capabilities into our product, mentoring other developers, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional software at a fast pace. 

This position requires that you reside in Ahmedabad or Pune, India. 

Applying for this role: Please apply through our careers page so your application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If you have a genuine connection to someone at Cin7 and they choose to refer you, that's welcome. Please don't send unsolicited connection requests or messages to employees asking for referrals, as this creates extra work for our team and may result in your application not being considered. 

What You'll Do

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Partner with product managers, designers, and developers to define requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions. 
 - Maintain, design, and develop high-performance code: Maintain and develop our cloud-based SaaS inventory management software using . NET technologies, ensuring solutions meet business needs and follow best practices in software design and development. 
 - Contribute to full-stack development: Work across application, database, and frontend layers when needed, including implementing API-driven features, writing and optimizing SQL queries, working with stored procedures and triggers, making UI updates, adjusting page layouts, working with forms, and applying styling using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 
 - Work AI-natively: Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) as a core part of your daily workflow - for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test writing, and code review - while maintaining full ownership and judgment over the resulting code. 
 - Help build AI-powered features: Contribute to designing and implementing AI/LLM-powered capabilities within Cin7's product (e. g. , integrating LLM APIs, working with retrieval or agentic workflows, evaluating model outputs for reliability), partnering with product on where AI can add real customer value. 
 - Lead development initiatives: Take ownership of complex, ambiguous features and modules end-to-end, providing technical leadership, architectural direction, and mentoring to other developers. 
 - Code reviews and quality assurance: Review code (human- and AI-generated) for consistency, quality, maintainability, performance, and adherence to coding standards, providing constructive feedback to peers. 
 - Optimize performance and reliability: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, scalability concerns, and technical challenges to ensure optimal system performance in a cloud SaaS environment. 
 - Champion testing and AI-assisted quality practices: Drive strong unit and integration testing practices, including using AI tools to help generate and maintain test coverage. 
 - Adopt new technologies: Continuously evaluate and integrate emerging tools, frameworks, and AI-driven practices to enhance the development process and product quality. 
 - Mentor and coach: Foster a culture of growth, quality, and effective AI-augmented development by providing guidance and technical mentorship to other developers, including how to use AI tools responsibly and effectively. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Minimum of 8+ years of hands-on software development experience, with deep specialization in . NET technologies, and a track record of senior/technical leadership on production systems. 
 - Demonstrated, hands-on fluency with AI coding tools and agentic development workflows (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) - not just occasional use, but genuine integration into daily engineering practice. 
 - Practical experience using AI-powered coding assistants as part of everyday software development. 
 - Expertise in integrating LLM APIs into an existing application. 
 - Experience designing and implementing production-grade AI-powered functionality involving RAG, agentic workflows, and model output evaluation. 
 - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to independently tackle and resolve complex, ambiguous technical challenges across backend, frontend, database, and application layers. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working in teams and mentoring others. 

Core Technical Skills

- Strong proficiency in C# and . NET technologies, including deep experience with . NET Framework, . NET, ASP. NET MVC, web applications, and APIs. 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns, with practical experience applying them to complex, real-world production systems. 
 - Extensive experience with relational databases, such as SQL Server, including writing and optimizing SQL queries, working with stored procedures, triggers, indexes, and troubleshooting database performance issues. 
 - Solid understanding of web fundamentals, including HTTP, REST APIs, request/response lifecycle, browser behavior, and client-server communication. 
 - Working knowledge of JavaScript, including DOM manipulation, event handling, form validation, asynchronous calls, and working with API responses. 
 - Solid understanding of HTML and CSS, including semantic markup, page structure, layout basics, responsive behavior, and styling existing UI components. 
 - Ability and willingness to work with existing frontend code when needed. 
 - Strong understanding of unit testing and integration testing principles, including how tests are written, structured, and maintained. 
 - Experience with version control systems, such as Git. 
 - Experience working in agile development environments. 

It's a Nice To Have If You Bring

- Experience working with LLM/AI APIs (e. g. , Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure AI/Azure OpenAI Service) in a production SaaS context. 
 - Experience working on cloud-based SaaS products, particularly on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Experience improving performance, scalability, and reliability of production systems. 
 - Familiarity with automated testing practices, CI/CD pipelines, and secure coding practices. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and shaping engineering best practices, including AI tool adoption. 

Why work at Cin7?

- We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth. 
 - You'll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you'll be growing your career and developing new skills. 
 - Hybrid work environment
 - Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
 - Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
 - A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing. 
 - Recruitment referral bonus
 - Work for a Great Place to Work®

Why CIN7?

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company. 

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock. 

We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. data.description:
Senior Video Software Engineer (C++/Rust) - Remote

Kake is a remote-first company and a people-first global community of senior engineers. Kake engineers are behind some of the world's most innovative products (Brands you've heard!), from Fortune 500 to fast-growing companies. We believe it's not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. Our community spans 45, 000+ engineers across 55+ countries; join a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive (and love eating kake!). 

We're looking for Senior Video Software Engineers with strong expertise in C++ and Rust, skilled in building low-latency, high-availability real-time video pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments. It's a great fit for people who enjoy working across the entire video processing stack, from image processing and encoding/decoding to transport, and solving complex technical challenges in mission-critical, high-performance environments. 

What you'll build and own

- Design, develop, and deploy distributed, low-latency video processing pipelines for cloud and on-premises environments. 
 - Develop and optimize real-time video processing solutions, including encoding, decoding, transport, and image enhancement workflows. 
 - Contribute to the deployment, monitoring, and operational support of mission-critical video services. 
 - Evaluate and implement emerging technologies and best practices to improve platform performance and scalability. 
 - Provide occasional on-call support for field operations, including evenings and weekends when necessary. 
 - Maintain clear technical documentation, including architecture diagrams and operational procedures. 
 - Participate in architecture, design, and product planning discussions. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams in an agile development environment. 

Core Requirements

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant hands-on work in both C++ and Rust. 
 - Deep understanding of video codecs, particularly HEVC, and streaming technologies such as MPEG-TS, SRT, HLS, and WebRTC. 
 - Experience with multimedia frameworks such as GStreamer, plus familiarity with SMPTE broadcast standards. 
 - Knowledge of NVIDIA GPU technologies, including CUDA and the NVIDIA Video Codec SDK. 
 - Strong understanding of video and image processing techniques, including demosaicing, denoising, color space conversion, and image enhancement. 
 - Strong knowledge of AWS (e. g. , S3, EC2) and experience working across Windows and Linux development environments. 
 - Solid software development practices, including version control, testing, and deployment processes. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment. 

Nice-to-Have

- Experience with Python and/or C#. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML techniques for video enhancement and image processing. 
 - Experience with messaging and event streaming technologies such as ZeroMQ or Apache Kafka. 
 - Experience integrating SDI output cards and APIs from vendors such as AJA or Blackmagic Design, and familiarity with broadcast tools such as vector scopes, RCPs, and CCUs. 
 - Background in sports technology, broadcasting, or streaming media environments. 
 - Availability to work aligned with the partner's time zone. 

Additional

- US Timezone Overlap: 6h-7h daily PST

Why Join Kake?

The icing on the Kake: 

- 💰 Competitive Pay in USD: Work globally, get paid globally. 
 - 🌎 Fully Remote: Simply put, we trust you. 
 - 💜 Better Me Fund: We invest in your personal growth and passions. 
 - 🎂 Compassion is Badass: Join a community that invests in social good. 

Ready for your piece of the Kake? Apply now!

Quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

data.title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Everyday Essentials Experiences
data.description:
Description

Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon - the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future. 

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase - and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day. 

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product - we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership. 

We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build - the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build, and own software end to end - working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations. 
 - Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems. 
 - Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide. 
 - Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them. 
 - Own operational excellence for what you build - monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience. 
 - Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent. 

A day in the life

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

About The Team

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on - and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers - a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
 - Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

You will design and expand automated testing strategies for complex data visualization features and a GPU-accelerated charting engine. Your work will help identify functional, performance, and cross-browser regressions before they reach customers. You will also transform manual performance checks into reliable, repeatable automated tests integrated into continuous integration workflows. Working closely with frontend engineers and quality specialists, you will influence testing practices, improve release confidence, and help scale quality engineering across the platform. This remote opportunity combines technical ownership, collaboration across time zones, and exposure to advanced data infrastructure technologies. 

Accountabilities

You will lead end-to-end test automation for data visualization and core application features, ensuring that new functionality, platform improvements, and chart migrations meet high standards of reliability and performance. 

- Own and maintain the end-to-end Playwright test suite covering panels, annotations, data sources, sharing, and plotting functionality. 
 - Ensure automated smoke tests and critical user journeys run on every pull request, establishing reliable quality gates for code merges and releases. 
 - Improve test stability, reduce flaky tests, and define clear criteria for blocking releases. 
 - Expand cross-browser test coverage to include Microsoft Edge and Firefox alongside Chrome, with particular attention to Windows environments. 
 - Automate frontend performance testing by converting existing browser and hardware performance studies into repeatable checks with frame-time and lag thresholds. 
 - Use telemetry simulation to reproduce realistic channel counts and data rates during performance testing. 
 - Introduce visual regression testing for charts and panels where it provides reliable and meaningful feedback. 
 - Develop parity tests to compare legacy chart views with their new-engine equivalents across time-series, scatter, histogram, FFT, and 3D visualizations. 
 - Identify testing gaps across the core application and build regression coverage for role-based and attribute-based access control (RBAC and ABAC), service accounts, folders, navigation, the home page, search, and the design system. 
 - Onboard and guide a Quality Engineer working in another time zone, coordinating overnight regression activities and reviewing test results. 
 - Collaborate with engineers before implementation and code merges by reviewing test plans, advocating for unit test coverage, and testing features ahead of release. 
 - Monitor and report quality metrics, including test pass rates, flaky test frequency, and performance trends, while communicating regressions promptly. 

Requirements

You bring substantial experience in QA automation or software development engineering in test (SDET), with a strong background in testing complex web applications. You are comfortable designing scalable automation frameworks, analyzing frontend performance, and collaborating with engineers to build quality into the development lifecycle. 

- 5+ years of experience in QA automation or SDET roles, including at least 2 years building UI test suites for complex web applications. 
 - Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript, with experience designing complete test suites involving fixtures, test data setup, tagging, parallelization, and flakiness management. 
 - Experience integrating end-to-end tests into continuous integration pipelines, ideally using GitHub Actions as a blocking gate for pull requests. 
 - Hands-on cross-browser testing experience with Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox across Windows and macOS. 
 - Practical frontend performance testing experience using browser developer tools, performance traces, frame-rate measurements, and rendering analysis. 
 - Ability to read and understand React code and write unit tests using Vitest or Jest. 
 - Experience testing authorization mechanisms, including RBAC and ABAC, as well as backend APIs. 
 - Familiarity with Go services and gRPC is an advantage. 
 - Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English (CEFR B2 or above), with the ability to participate in design reviews, prepare test plans and risk reports, and collaborate with and train teammates. 
 - Availability for at least 4 hours of daily working-time overlap with US Pacific time. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take ownership of testing strategy and communicate quality risks effectively. 

Nice To Have

- Experience testing data visualization, charting, WebGL, or applications that rely heavily on canvas rendering.

data.title: Principal Firmware Engineer, High-Speed Ethernet
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Firmware Engineer to lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and validation of low-level firmware for high-speed Ethernet solutions, including Gigabit MAC/PCS/PHY-adjacent interfaces, PTP/gPTP timing, TSN features, DMA, QoS, and platform drivers. 

This role requires a technically strong engineer who can operate at both system and register level: define firmware architecture, develop production-quality drivers, diagnose hardware/software issues on silicon, guide firmware engineers, and collaborate closely with RTL, verification, silicon validation, applications, and customers. 

The successful candidate will own critical aspects of the Ethernet firmware stack from boot-time initialization through high-throughput data-path operation, time synchronization, traffic scheduling, error handling, diagnostics, and performance characterization. 

What You'll Achieve

Technical Architecture and Ownership

- Define firmware architecture for high-speed Ethernet subsystems supporting high speed gigabit Ethernet modes. 
 - Lead design of low-level drivers for Ethernet MAC, DMA, PCS, SerDes/PHY control interfaces, MDIO, interrupt controllers, clock/reset, and associated IP blocks. 
 - Define scalable driver state machines for initialization, configuration, link management, normal operation, diagnostics, fault recovery, and reset handling. 
 - Establish firmware interfaces and configuration models for Ethernet QoS, PTP, TSN, packet classification, DMA queues, and traffic scheduling. 
 - Identify hardware/software integration risks early and influence hardware architecture, register design, diagnostics, and verification requirements. 
 - Design firmware for high-throughput and low-latency operation for Gigabit Ethernet. 
 - Analyze and optimize CPU utilization, DMA bandwidth, memory bandwidth, interrupt load, cache behavior, and buffer utilization. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis for packet loss, descriptor corruption, DMA stalls, RX starvation, TX underflow, FIFO overflow, bus errors, and performance regressions. 
 - Ensure correct cache-coherency and memory-ordering behavior on Arm-based SoCs with coherent or non-coherent DMA. 

PTP / gPTP / Time Synchronization

- Develop and integrate firmware support for hardware timestamping and IEEE 1588 PTP / IEEE 802. 1AS gPTP. 
 - Configure and manage PTP clocks, timestamp units, clock adjustment, rollover handling, and TX/RX timestamp correlation. 
 - Support synchronization applications requiring deterministic timing and bounded timestamp latency. 
 - Develop diagnostics and performance characterization for time synchronization accuracy, offset, drift, jitter, timestamp loss, and synchronization recovery. 
 - Collaborate with system/software teams on PTP stack integration and time-domain requirements. 

TSN and Ethernet QoS

- Lead firmware enablement for relevant TSN and QoS capabilities
 - Define queue allocation, scheduling, buffer, and congestion-management policies for mixed traffic environments. 
 - Develop traffic test scenarios to validate latency, jitter, throughput, packet loss, fairness, and isolation under congested conditions. 

Bring-Up, Debug, and Validation

- Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware bring-up for Ethernet subsystems. 
 - Debug complex hardware/firmware interactions
 - Develop fault-injection and negative-test scenarios
 - Drive technical resolution of customer and field escalations. 

Leadership and Collaboration

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to firmware engineers. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, debug reviews, and design-for-testability discussions. 
 - Establish reusable driver frameworks, coding patterns, debug utilities, and test infrastructure. 
 - Work closely with RTL, design verification, validation, software, systems, security, safety, product, and customer engineering teams. 
 - Guide junior and senior engineers toward independent ownership of firmware subsystems. 
 - Communicate technical risks, design choices, trade-offs, and milestones clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, device-driver, networking, or semiconductor software development experience
 - Proven hands-on experience developing low-level drivers for Ethernet MAC, DMA, PHY/PCS control, networking accelerators, or comparable high-performance peripheral IP. 
 - Strong understanding of Ethernet fundamentals including Ethernet frame format; MAC and PHY operation; VLAN / IEEE 802. 1Q; QoS / 802. 1p; link negotiation and management; MDIO/MDC; flow control; multicast and filtering. 
 - Strong experience with DMA architectures
 - Strong understanding of embedded C/C++ and low-level programming concepts: 
 - Strong Arm SoC knowledge of Cortex-A, Cortex-R, Cortex-M; 
 - Experience with IEEE 1588 PTP, gPTP, hardware timestamping, or time synchronization systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to debug difficult system issues using hardware and software observability tools. 
 - Ability to lead technical design and influence teams across firmware, RTL, verification, and validation. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with 25GbE, 10GbE, 40GbE, 50GbE, or other high-speed Ethernet MAC/PCS/SerDes-based systems. 
 - Experience with TSN features including IEEE 802. 1Qav, 802. 1Qbv, 802. 1Qbu, 802. 1Qci, IEEE 802. 3br, and IEEE 802. 1AS. 
 - Experience with Ethernet MACsec / IEEE 802. 1AE, MKA, replay protection, secure association management, or secure networking. 
 - Experience with high-speed packet test equipment, traffic generators, packet analyzers, and performance benchmarking. 
 - Experience with FPGA prototyping, emulation, pre-silicon firmware development, or post-silicon validation. 

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

We are looking for a Principal Formal Verification Engineer with 10+ years of experience to lead formal verification efforts for complex semiconductor and silicon designs. This role will be responsible for driving verification strategy, improving design quality, and mentoring engineers while working closely with design, architecture, and validation teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead formal verification activities for block-level and subsystem-level designs.

 - Develop and execute formal verification environments, assertions, properties, and checkers.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

 - Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals, RTL design, and verification concepts. 
 - Hands-on experience with formal verification tools and methodologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of SystemVerilog, assertions, and verification techniques. 
 - Experience verifying complex protocols, control logic, and SoC or subsystem-level designs. 
 - Good debugging and analytical problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience leading technical efforts or mentoring team members.

Preferred Qualifications
