data.title: L2 -Software Tester
data.description:
The Role

As a Software Tester, you ensure software is reliable and release-ready through manual and automated testing, defect identification, regression testing, and close collaboration with SDT. Your goal is simple: find problems before users do. 

What You Will Own - Your Responsibilities

- Test planning & execution - design and execute functional, integration, regression, and edge-case testing for new features and releases. 
 - Manual & exploratory testing - identify defects that automated tests may miss through structured and exploratory testing. 
 - Test automation - develop, maintain, and improve automated regression test cases and contribute to expanding automation coverage. 
 - Defect management - document defects clearly with severity, impact, evidence, and reproducible steps; track defects through closure. 
 - Release & regression validation - verify fixes and ensure new releases do not introduce regressions into existing functionality. 
 - SDT collaboration - work closely with developers to analyse root causes, clarify defects, validate fixes, and improve overall product quality. 

Non-Negotiable Metric

- DEFECTS CAUGHT BEFORE RELEASE
 - TARGET: ≥ 75%
 - At least 75% of identified defects must be caught during testing before production release, with strong regression coverage and accurate defect reporting maintained across assigned releases. 

The Fight: What You will Fight: 

- The bug that reaches production. 
 - Fight missed defects, weak test coverage, recurring issues, ineffective fixes, and release risks. Ensure every critical defect is properly fixed, validated, and prevented from returning. 

WHO THRIVES HERE : Three Traits We Cannot Teach

- You think beyond the test case - Find edge cases, risks, and unexpected failures. 
 - You own the defect - Follow through until the root cause is fixed and the solution is validated. 
 - You communicate with clarity and courage - Raise risks early, provide evidence, and challenge quality gaps. 

The Wws Perks

- Structured learning - Build skills in testing, automation, and MERN applications. 
 - Manual + automation exposure - Work across functional, API, regression, and automated testing. 
 - Engineering collaboration - Partner with SDT, WIT, and AIT throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Ownership & growth - Grow in test strategy, automation, defect analysis, and leadership. 
 - Quality-first culture - Help build reliable software and protect the user experience. 

Qualifications

- Experience - 2 years of professional experience in software testing / QA, with hands-on experience across manual and automated testing. 
 - Technical skills - strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, API, and exploratory testing; experience with test automation frameworks and defect-tracking tools. 
 - Engineering knowledge - working knowledge of web applications, REST APIs, databases, Git, CI/CD concepts, and software development lifecycle. 
 - Preferred exposure - experience testing JavaScript/MERN-stack applications and familiarity with automation scripting. 
 - Problem-solving - strong analytical ability, attention to detail, defect investigation skills, and clear technical communication. 

Contact us on jobs@wonderws. co / 9047477375

data.title: Lead Engineer- Full-Stack & Applied AI
data.description:
Lead Engineer - Full-Stack & Applied AI

Location: Delhi, India | Hybrid

Experience: 8+ years in software engineering

Reporting to: Technology Head, TolaData

About TolaData

TolaData helps organisations understand, manage and improve their impact. Our SaaS platform supports monitoring, evaluation and programme management, enabling teams to bring together data, track results and turn evidence into decisions. 

We serve organisations across international development, humanitarian programmes and the wider social impact sector. Our customers depend on reliable software that supports complex data, reporting and operational needs. 

As we continue to serve these customers, we are investing in frontend modernisation, applied AI and advanced analytics. We are looking for a Lead Engineer to translate this direction into production-ready capabilities and help establish an engineering team in India. 

Our mandate

You will lead technical delivery for the India engineering team and take ownership of an agreed area of TolaData's product development. You will be accountable for how work is designed, organised, implemented and delivered-and for the quality and maintainability of the resulting software. 

Reporting to Peter Odeny, Technology Head, you will turn product priorities into engineering plans, make day-to-day technical decisions and lead engineers through complex implementation challenges. You will work closely with product colleagues and the existing engineering team to balance customer needs, platform reliability and innovation. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will write and review production code, lead critical implementations and investigate difficult problems. As the team grows, your impact will increasingly include the clarity, judgement and delivery capability you develop in others. 

Your Core Priorities Will Be To

- 
 - Own delivery: Take complex requirements through technical design, coordinated implementation and successful production release. 
 - Lead engineering decisions: Establish sound architecture and implementation approaches within the wider technology direction. 
 - Build team capability: Help recruit the India team, establish its working practices and develop engineers who can own meaningful areas of the product. 
 - Deliver useful innovation: Bring applied AI and data capabilities into customer workflows while strengthening the existing platform. 
How Leadership Works In This Role

The Technology Head sets the overall technology direction and provides architectural oversight. Within agreed priorities and architectural principles, you will own implementation decisions, task breakdown, delegation, technical reviews and release readiness for your area. 

You will surface significant trade-offs early, recommend a course of action and coordinate decisions that affect other teams or shared platform components. You will work with product colleagues to agree scope, sequencing and acceptance criteria, making delivery risks and dependencies visible. 

The initial remit is technical leadership, delivery accountability, hiring and mentoring. Formal line-management responsibilities will be agreed with the Technology Head as the India team develops. 

Our existing platform and modernisation direction

Our existing frontend is primarily Angular. Our core backend uses Python, Django and Django REST Framework (DRF), alongside FastAPI for AI services. 

You will lead development across this established platform while helping shape its evolution. Our frontend modernisation direction includes exploring React and other modern JavaScript frameworks for new capabilities, selecting technologies according to product needs, maintainability, performance and integration requirements. 

We want newer modules to evolve within the wider application while preserving a consistent customer experience. You will help assess and evolve modular frontend approaches, including micro-frontends where appropriate. Strong frontend architectural judgement matters more than extensive experience with a particular micro-frontend framework. 

Our data and analytics direction brings together structured application data, unstructured content and Python-based analytical services that can support advanced analytics and AI-powered workflows. 

What You Will Lead And Own

Technical planning and delivery

- 
 - Take ownership of substantial features or an agreed product area, from requirements clarification through release and ongoing improvement. 
 - Translate complex requirements into technical designs, milestones and deliverable tasks, with clear ownership and acceptance criteria. 
 - Coordinate implementation across frontend, backend and data components, delegate effectively and resolve technical blockers. 
 - Make informed trade-offs between scope, speed, quality and technical debt; communicate their implications clearly. 
 - Lead critical parts of the implementation and stay close enough to the code to guide decisions and support the team. 
 - Own release readiness and follow delivered capabilities into production, using operational and customer feedback to improve them. 
Architecture and platform evolution

- 
 - Guide full-stack design across user interfaces, APIs, services, data models and integrations. 
 - Lead incremental improvements to the existing Angular and Django/DRF application while protecting customer workflows and data integrity. 
 - Evaluate React and other modern JavaScript frameworks for suitable new modules, defining how they integrate with the wider platform. 
 - Establish clear frontend integration patterns covering authentication, routing, shared components, state and dependencies. 
 - Design modular backend services and use microservices where independent deployment, scaling or ownership provides practical value. 
 - Document significant architectural decisions and align changes affecting the shared platform with the Technology Head and relevant engineers. 
Applied AI and data engineering

- 
 - Lead the engineering of AI-powered capabilities such as document intelligence, evidence-grounded search, analytical assistance and report generation. 
 - Select appropriate models, integration patterns and orchestration tools for LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows. 
 - Guide data pipelines spanning structured records and unstructured content, with appropriate validation, provenance and access controls. 
 - Develop a maintainable approach to running Python analytical scripts and models as versioned, tested and observable workloads. 
 - Connect analytical services to governed data sources while protecting transactional performance and supporting reliable background processing. 
 - Establish evaluation and monitoring practices covering output quality, groundedness, latency, cost and failure handling. 
 - Ensure permissions, tenant boundaries, human review and deterministic calculations are applied where required. 
The emphasis is on building and operating useful AI-powered applications. This is an applied engineering role, with strong full-stack foundations at its centre. 

Engineering standards and production quality

- 
 - Set and reinforce expectations for maintainable code, automated testing, technical documentation and constructive code review. 
 - Establish a shared definition of release readiness, including appropriate tests, security checks, monitoring and rollback arrangements. 
 - Strengthen CI/CD and delivery practices in collaboration with the wider engineering team. 
 - Prioritise technical debt and reliability improvements alongside product commitments. 
 - Lead technical investigation of issues within your area and ensure the team follows through on corrective actions. 
 - Build quality into everyday delivery and help engineers understand the reasoning behind the standards they apply. 
India team development

- 
 - Partner with the Technology Head to define capability gaps, hiring priorities and the shape of the India engineering team. 
 - Take an active role in technical assessment, recruitment and onboarding. 
 - Establish clear responsibilities and give engineers ownership appropriate to their experience. 
 - Coach engineers through design discussions, code reviews, feedback and collaborative problem-solving. 
 - Organise work so that delivery progresses through the team, with shared knowledge and manageable dependencies. 
 - Build effective collaboration with product colleagues and the wider TolaData engineering organisation. 
 - Be accountable for the technical quality and delivery outcomes of the work you lead. 
Deployment collaboration and future innovation

You will own application deployment readiness and collaborate with colleagues responsible for infrastructure and operations. You should understand cloud environments, containers, CI/CD, configuration and monitoring well enough to make sound application decisions and support production troubleshooting. The role does not require ownership of all infrastructure operations. 

As Product Priorities Develop, You Will Also Help Evaluate

- 
 - Reusable software packages and repeatable SaaS, private-cloud and on-premises deployment approaches. 
 - Customer-managed deployment requirements, including configuration, upgrades and supportability. 
 - Spatial intelligence, GIS and digital-twin opportunities with product and domain specialists. 
Your responsibility in these areas is to bring engineering judgement: assess feasibility, define focused experiments and recommend whether and how to proceed. Prior specialist expertise in every area is not expected. 

What You Bring

- 
 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on ownership of production web applications or SaaS platforms. 
 - Evidence of leading complex software delivery: defining an approach, organising implementation, guiding other engineers and taking responsibility for production outcomes. 
 - Strong architectural judgement and the ability to explain technical decisions in terms of product needs, delivery constraints and long-term maintainability. 
 - Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, with substantial experience in modern frontend frameworks or libraries such as Angular, React or Vue. 
 - The ability to work effectively with our existing Angular frontend and evaluate React or other modern JavaScript frameworks for future capabilities. 
 - Strong Python backend engineering skills, including practical experience with Django/DRF, API design, SQL and relational data modelling. 
 - Experience designing modular applications and services, with a clear understanding of integration boundaries and operational trade-offs. 
 - Practical experience taking AI or LLM capabilities beyond a prototype. Depth in RAG, agentic workflows, evaluation and monitoring is a strong differentiator. 
 - Experience with data processing, pipelines or background workloads, including validation and failure handling. 
 - A track record of improving engineering quality through testing, code review, CI/CD and maintainable design. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, Docker and deployment processes, sufficient to collaborate effectively on releases and production issues. 
 - An understanding of authentication, authorisation, tenant isolation and secure handling of customer data. 
 - The ability to delegate, give useful feedback, resolve ambiguity and keep a team focused on agreed outcomes. 
Additional Experience We Value

- 
 - Recruiting engineers or helping establish a new engineering team. 
 - Frontend modernisation across multiple frameworks, micro-frontends or shared design systems. 
 - FastAPI and production AI services. 
 - AI frameworks and SDKs such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or provider-native tooling. 
 - Document processing, vector search, analytical data stores or production Python analytics. 
 - Software packaging and customer-managed deployment. 
 - Geospatial applications, GIS, digital twins or simulation. 
 - Monitoring and evaluation, international development or other social impact domains. 
We value depth in full-stack engineering, leadership judgement and delivery ownership. You do not need experience with every technology listed. 

What Success Will Look Like

Specific scope and measures will be agreed with the Technology Head, based on product priorities, team capacity and an initial review of the platform. 

First month

- 
 - Establish a working understanding of the architecture, customer workflows and engineering practices. 
 - Deliver an initial production improvement and take ownership of the plan for a significant feature. 
 - Agree milestones, responsibilities, dependencies and acceptance criteria for that work. 
 - Identify priority engineering improvements and contribute to the India hiring plan. 
Within three months

- 
 - Lead at least one significant full-stack feature from agreed requirements to production, with appropriate testing, documentation and monitoring. 
 - Bring an agreed AI or analytics capability to a controlled release or pilot with explicit evaluation criteria. 
 - Establish a consistent planning, review and release process for the work you lead. 
 - Demonstrate an improvement in an agreed engineering measure, such as release reliability or defects escaping into production. 
 - Contribute to candidate assessment and onboarding as hiring progresses. 
Within six months

- 
 - Lead delivery across a defined product area, with engineers owning clear components and responsibilities. 
 - Demonstrate customer value from delivered capabilities through agreed measures such as adoption, processing time or reduced manual effort. 
 - Show sustained improvement in selected delivery and quality measures. 
 - Establish effective onboarding, technical review and knowledge-sharing practices for the India team. 
 - Enable engineers to deliver with increasing independence while maintaining clear accountability for outcomes. 
Why join TolaData

You will have the opportunity to lead a meaningful part of an established product's evolution and help build the team that delivers it. 

The role combines hands-on engineering with ownership of architecture, execution and team capability. You will work directly with TolaData's Technology Head and product colleagues to bring modern application development, applied AI and analytics to real customer problems. 

What To Include In Your Application

Please share your CV and brief examples of: 

- 
 - A complex feature or product area you led from requirements to production, including the decisions you owned, your hands-on contribution and the outcome. 
 - How you guided other engineers, delegated work or improved the team's delivery and engineering practices. 
 - An AI or data-driven capability you built, how you evaluated it and what you learned from deployment. 
Public portfolios, technical writing and open-source contributions are welcome where available. Please do not share confidential code or customer information.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Data Engineering
data.description:
Vestas is a major player in wind technology and a driving force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas' core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of wind turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!

Technology & Operations > Research & Development (R&D) > Data & Performance

The Data & Performance Competence Cluster Within Plant Software Solutions (PSS), Part Of Vestas Research & Development, Is Responsible For Developing Products And Services That Support Monitoring, Reliability, Data Intelligence, And Advanced Analytics Across Vestas' Global Renewable Energy Portfolio. Our Portfolio Includes Solutions And Offerings Related To: 

- Monitoring & Reliability Engineering
 - Data Products and Data Platforms
 - Flow & Load Modeling
 - AI Products and Solutions
 - Advanced Analytics and Performance Optimization

We are a highly skilled and diverse organization comprising Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Reliability Engineers, Condition Monitoring Specialists, and Flow & Load Modeling experts. Together, we develop high-quality software products that enable real-time monitoring and analysis of thousands of wind power plants worldwide. By leveraging one of the industry's largest renewable energy datasets, we build advanced data products, predictive models, AI-driven solutions, and digital services that improve asset performance, increase reliability, and ultimately contribute to reducing the cost of energy for our customers. 

About Plant Software Solutions (PSS): Plant Software Solutions (PSS) is on an exciting journey to innovate, develop, and deliver advanced software solutions for both Vestas wind turbines and customers worldwide. The organization operates globally with engineering and business presence across Denmark, Portugal, and India. 

The Opportunity: The Data & Performance Competence Cluster is seeking an experienced and visionary Engineering Manager - Data Engineering to oversee the development and execution of Vestas' R&D Data Engineering strategy. The ideal candidate will advance innovation through advanced data engineering approaches integrated with artificial intelligence, and data-driven decision-making across the Vestas value chain. This role combines technical leadership, people leadership, and strategic execution, ensuring the timely delivery of scalable data science products and solutions that create measurable business value for customers and stakeholders. 

The position is based in Bangalore, India, and reports directly to the Director, Data & Performance Competence Cluster. 

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled Engineering Manager - Data Engineering to handle the design, modernization, and operation of one of the largest renewable energy data platforms in the industry. This role will be responsible for managing large-scale cloud-based data ecosystems that process data from wind turbines, solar assets, SCADA systems, IoT devices, asset performance platforms, and enterprise applications. 

The chosen candidate will lead a team of highly skilled data engineers while guiding a strategic migration from legacy data platforms to a modern cloud-native architecture. This leader will contribute to AI, Machine Learning, predictive maintenance, operational analytics, energy forecasting, and digital transformation initiatives across global renewable energy operations. 

Responsibilities listed

People Leadership

- Act as the direct line manager for Data Engineers within the organization
 - Lead hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, compensation reviews, and succession planning
 - Build and develop a capable global Data Engineering organization of approximately 20-25 engineers
 - Encourage a culture of ownership, innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence

Data Platform Strategy & Delivery

- Own the design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise data platforms, data lakes, and data pipelines across both cloud and on-premises environments
 - Define and execute the Data Engineering roadmap aligned with business and R&D priorities
 - Guide modernization of enterprise data platforms and cloud-native architecture adoption on Azure
 - Own the design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of large-scale data platforms, data lakes, and data pipelines
 - Establish engineering standards, automation, observability, DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices
 - Ensure platform reliability, security, scalability, governance, and cost efficiency

AI & Analytics Enablement

- Build AI-ready data foundations supporting analytics, machine learning, predictive maintenance, forecasting, and operational intelligence use cases
 - Partner with Data Science, Analytics, and Product teams to accelerate delivery of data products and business value

Vendor & Financial Management

- Manage consulting partners and external vendors providing engineering capacity for short-term and long-term initiatives
 - Own supplier engagement lifecycle, including Statements of Work (SOW), resource onboarding, delivery oversight, and performance management
 - Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and HR functions throughout sourcing and contracting processes
 - Manage budgets/resources related to external consulting engagements

Stakeholder Management

- Partner with business, product, technology, and R&D leaders to define priorities and support value realization
 - Communicate technology strategy, delivery progress, risks, and outcomes to senior stakeholders
 - Act as a trusted advisor on data platform strategy, cloud modernization, and engineering best practices

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, or related discipline
 - 12-15+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platforms, or Analytics Engineering
 - Minimum 5 years managing capable engineering teams
 - Direct experience leading large cloud data transformation programs
 - Experience managing enterprise-scale data lakes and distributed data platforms
 - Exposure to Renewable Energy, Utilities, Manufacturing, Industrial IoT, Energy Technology, or Asset-Intensive industries

Competencies

Technical Competencies: 

- Oversee the strategy, architecture, and migration of large-scale enterprise data platforms to Azure cloud, enabling a modern, scalable, and AI-ready data ecosystem
 - Build and manage high-performance data platforms integrating IoT, SCADA, operational, and enterprise data to support renewable energy operations and business analytics
 - Hire, develop, and retain highly capable Data Engineers, building a culture of technical excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning
 - Implement modern engineering practices including DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and platform observability
 - Partner with business, product, and technology leaders to deliver data solutions that improve asset performance, predictive maintenance, energy forecasting, and operational decision-making
 - Own platform reliability, security, governance, scalability, and cloud cost optimization while delivering strategic transformation programs and business value

Leadership Competencies: 

- Build, lead, and scale a capable and collaborative Data Engineering organization (20-25+ engineers), including Engineers, Leads, Architects, having presence across Globe (Denmark, Portugal & India) while creating a collaborative culture of innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence
 - Develop and execute talent acquisition, workforce planning, succession planning, and capability-building strategies to attract, develop, and retain capable engineering talent
 - Direct large-scale cloud migration, data modernization, and digital transformation initiatives, partnering with global business, product, and technology stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes
 - Coach and mentor engineering leaders and team members, advancing career growth, leadership development, employee engagement, and quality delivery
 - Establish and monitor engineering KPIs, operational metrics, delivery performance, platform reliability, and value realization while effectively managing consultants and strategic partnerships
 - Guide executive leadership on technology strategy, transformation roadmaps, risks, and business impact, while serving as a trusted advisor on data and cloud strategy. 
 - Bring broad experience in Azure data platforms, cloud-native architectures, AI-ready data foundations, and renewable energy, industrial IoT, utility, or asset-intensive industries, combined with effective strategic thinking and execution excellence

What We Offer

We offer you the opportunity to support important work and to work in a multicultural and international Renewable company, where you have the possibility to improve your skills and develop professionally. 

- Opportunity to develop data engineering within a global renewable energy leader
 - Leadership responsibility for a strategic, business-critical data platform organization
 - Exposure to large-scale cloud, AI/ML, industrial IoT, and digital transformation initiatives
 - A multicultural, international work environment with global collaboration
 - Professional growth and leadership development opportunities within Vestas

Additional Information

Your primary workplace will be in Bangalore, India. 

Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th November 2026. 

BEWARE - RECRUITMENT FRAUD

It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, www. vestas. com/en/careers/job-openings. 

DEIB Statement

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future. 

About Vestas

Vestas is the energy industry's global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 173 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 29, 000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution - today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www. vestas. com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

Description

Amazon Business Operations is building a new software development team focused on commercial delivery experience. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead a team of engineers in Hyderabad, own the technical roadmap for these workstreams, and ship the software that enables Amazon to successfully deliver large commercial volume. You will stand up a team from scratch, define the architecture for services spanning reactive procurement, full truckload delivery, last mile driver intelligence, and real-time delivery risk scoring. You will partner with product, science, operations, and existing delivery tech teams to integrate with foundational systems while delivering net-new capabilities. If you want to build a team and a product area from the ground up with a clear commercial mandate and measurable customer impact, this role offers that opportunity.

 - Own the technical roadmap for bulk buying fulfillment and OTR delivery quality for AB customers. Translate the 3-year product vision into a sequenced engineering plan with clear milestones.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Privileged Access Management (PAM / IAM)
data.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. 

About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. 

  

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. 

Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior / Lead Software Engineer to drive the architectural evolution, security posture, and engineering execution of our core platform. In this role, you will lead the design of scalable microservices, integrate enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) frameworks, drive automated delivery pipelines, and champion cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- 
Architecture & Core Engineering: Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available microservices using C#, . NET Core, Go, and TypeScript via gRPC and the ABP framework. 

- 
Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and deploy enterprise-grade Privileged Access Management (PAM)/IDAM solutions (e. g. , CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault), enforcing Zero Trust principles, Least Privilege access, and SCIM protocol integrations. 

- 
Delivery & Test Engineering: Own end-to-end continuous delivery using Origin CI, Kargo, and WoK. Ensure platform resilience by implementing unit, functional, and Playwright E2E suites alongside Performance, Scalability, and Reliability (PSR) testing. 

- 
AI Adoption & Technical Leadership: Champion the BMAD framework to establish governance and structure for AI-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot). Mentor engineers, conduct RFC reviews, and build shared team skill libraries. 

- 
Multi-Platform & Full-Stack Development: Build cross-platform services and native desktop applications (macOS, Windows, Linux) supporting complex enterprise user workflows. 

- 
Observability & Operational Excellence: Implement robust telemetry, logging, and tracing across microservices to monitor system health, reduce latency, and ensure strict SLA/SLO compliance. 

- 
Technical Debt & Governance: Partner with Product, Design, and Infrastructure teams to manage technical debt, refactor legacy components, and establish standardized engineering best practices across Agile sprints. 

- 
Problem solving & Troubleshooting: Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn-around to resolve the incident.   

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

- 
Experience: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with proven leadership as a Lead Architect or Senior Staff Engineer in a modern product environment. 

- 
Backend Stack: Deep expertise in C#, . NET (ASP. NET Core / ABP Framework), Go, gRPC, and RESTful APIs. 

- 
Databases: Advanced proficiency with relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (DocumentDB) architectures. 

- 
Cloud & DevOps: Strong hands-on experience with AWS, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and custom CI/CD automation pipelines. 

- 
Testing: Proficiency with automated testing frameworks, specifically Playwright for E2E automation and dedicated load/stress testing tools. 

- 
Artificial Intelligence: Direct experience establishing spec-driven AI development workflows in production teams. 

Where you'll be working/Location: 

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. 

  

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.   

  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed. 

  

Language: 

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.   Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. 

  

Why JumpCloud?   

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You'll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We're out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You'll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.     

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to "Build Connections. " To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed. " - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.   Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.     

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

  

Scam Notice: 

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. 

  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud. com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud. com with the subject line "Scam Notice"  

  

#BI-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https: //jumpcloud. com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

data.description:
About InvoiceCloud: 

InvoiceCloud is a fast-growing fintech leader recognized with 20 major awards in 2025, including USA TODAY and Boston Globe Top Workplaces, multiple SaaS Awards wins for Best Solution for Finance and FinTech, and national customer service honors from Stevie and the Business Intelligence Group. Judges also highlighted our mission to reduce digital exclusion and restore simplicity and dignity to how people pay for essential services, as well as our leadership in AI maturity and responsible innovation. It's an award-winning, purpose-driven environment where top talent thrives. To learn more, visit InvoiceCloud. com. 

About InvoiceCloud

InvoiceCloud is the leading digital payments platform for utilities, insurance carriers, municipalities, and financial institutions. We enable billers to present bills digitally and collect payments across every channel - driving digital adoption, reducing costs, and improving the customer experience. With 3, 000+ billing organizations, 240M+ invoices, and $38B+ in annual payment volume, we're investing heavily in AI to transform from a best-in-class payments processor into a Billing Intelligence Platform. 

About The Role

We're building a shared AI platform that powers the next generation of our product portfolio - multi-agent orchestration, ML scoring infrastructure, and LLM-powered intelligence products. As Principal AI Engineer, you'll architect this platform, set the technical direction, and define the engineering standards that the organization builds against. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role - not a management position. You set architectural direction and write production code every day. You think in ADRs, trade-off matrices, and failure modes. You use Claude Code and AI accelerators to operate at 3-5x speed, and you teach the team to do the same. 

Your work directly shapes a growing AI product portfolio. The platform you architect becomes the shared foundation - every subsequent product launches faster because of the infrastructure decisions you make now. 

You'll be based in India, working hybrid (3 days in-office per week), and will report to the VP of Engineering / CTO. 

What You'll Do

Own AI Platform Architecture : 

- Design the full AI platform - multi-agent orchestration, ML inference infrastructure, LLM gateway, tool registry, and eval/observability stack
 - Write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) that the organization builds against
 - Make build-vs-buy decisions, evaluate emerging frameworks (A2A, MCP, Visa TAP), and define integration patterns
 - Design system-level concerns: auth gating, policy enforcement (OPA), API gateway patterns (Kong), and multi-tenant isolation
 - Define reference architectures for AI-enabled services across . NET 10 APIs, Python ML workloads, React frontends, AKS deployments, Kong gateway integration, and Azure DevOps delivery pipelines

Drive Product AI Strategy : 

- Partner with Product and CTO office to translate business objectives into AI technical strategy
 - Identify where AI creates differentiated value - predictive models, conversational agents, intelligent automation
 - Evaluate and de-risk emerging technologies. Present to executive leadership on AI capabilities, costs, and competitive positioning
 - Define the AI FinOps strategy: token metering, model routing for cost optimization, quota management, and budget forecasting
 - Establish clear platform decision rules for when AI capabilities should be implemented as . NET services, Python services, Azure ML pipelines, background jobs, or embedded product workflows

AI Safety, Governance And Responsible AI : 

- Define and enforce the Responsible AI framework - content safety guardrails, PII governance, bias testing, and audit trails
 - Ensure all AI systems meet PCI DSS, SOC 2, and emerging AI regulation requirements
 - Establish model validation and governance processes - transparency, explainability, and fairness are non-negotiable
 - Build the trust infrastructure that enables the organization to deploy AI confidently in regulated financial services
 - Champion ethical AI principles; ensure all agents and models comply with global financial regulations and internal compliance standards

Write Code - Everyday : 

- Write production code, review critical PRs, debug complex agent interactions, and prototype new capabilities
 - Lead by example - your code quality, testing discipline, and documentation set the standard
 - Use Claude Code and AI accelerators daily. Build custom skills, MCP integrations, and automation workflows

Mentor And Multiply The Team : 

- Raise the AI engineering bar across the organization. Run design reviews, pair on complex problems
 - Champion AI-accelerated development - train the team on Claude Code workflows, custom skills, and agentic tooling
 - Define engineering standards, evaluation criteria, and best practices that scale beyond your direct team

Must-Have Qualifications

- 10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years in AI/ML - you've architected and shipped production AI systems
 - System design mastery - multi-agent architectures, ML platforms, or large-scale inference systems
 - Azure + Microsoft AI stack deep expertise - Azure ML, AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, . NET agent frameworks
 - Python + . NET bilingual - Python for ML/data, . NET/C# for agent runtimes
 - LLM systems at production scale - prompt management, RAG, content safety, agentic workflows
 - AI-first development velocity - Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent at 3-5x speed
 - Deep experience architecting modern . NET cloud-native platforms - including API-first service design, distributed systems, Kubernetes deployment, gateway integration, and CI/CD governance

Nice-to-Have

- FinTech / Payments architecture - PCI DSS, SOC 2, regulated AI
 - Agentic Commerce & A2A - Google A2A, MCP, Visa TAP
 - Technical leadership track record - mentored teams, ADR processes, C-level presentations
 - Omnichannel & voice AI - web chat, voice, SMS, Azure Communication Services
 - ML platform engineering - model registries, feature stores, drift detection
 - Published or open-source contributions in AI/ML

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Mathematics, or a related technical field required. A Master's degree is preferred - but we value what you've built and the systems you've architected over credentials.

data.title: Senior Frontend Developer
data.description:
Who Are We?

Millipixels Interactive is where creativity, technology, strategy, and innovation come together to build meaningful digital experiences. We partner with startups, growing businesses, and enterprise brands to create everything from immersive digital products and marketing ecosystems to transformation-driven technology solutions. 

But beyond the work, we're a team that thrives on ideas, ownership, experimentation, and execution. We like people who take initiative, think beyond the obvious, and bring energy into everything they do. 

If you're someone who enjoys building, collaborating, and making a visible impact - you'll probably enjoy being here. 

About the role

We're hiring a Principal Software Engineer (Frontend) to set the technical direction for how we build the front end across a range of digital products. This is not a role where you're handed a spec and a deadline. You'll define the architecture, set the standards, and be the person teams turn to when the hard front-end questions come up: what to build, how to build it, and what to deliberately not build. You'll write code, and plenty of it where it matters most, but your real impact is multiplied through the engineers you mentor, the systems you design, and the practices you establish. 

What you'll actually be doing

- Setting the technical vision for the front end: You'll define architecture, standards, and long-term strategy across products, from rendering strategy and state management to design system governance. Not "yours to implement. " Yours to decide. 
 - Designing systems that scale: You'll architect modular, reusable front-end platforms and shared component libraries so that new products and features ship faster because of what came before. 
 - Owning performance, accessibility, and quality: You'll make Core Web Vitals, accessibility (WCAG), and reliability non-negotiable, and catch bottlenecks before users ever notice them. 
 - Turning complex designs into polished experiences: You'll partner with design to translate sophisticated UI/UX into responsive, pixel-perfect interfaces across every device and browser, and push back constructively when a better approach exists. 
 - Building with modern React and Next. js: You'll make the calls on rendering (SSR, SSG, ISR), routing, state management, and data fetching, and shape API contracts with backend teams so the front end stays fast, type-safe, and easy to maintain. 
 - Driving engineering excellence: You'll establish testing strategy, CI/CD best practices, and AWS-based deployment and hosting that keep delivery fast and safe, while paying down tech debt before it compounds. 
 - Raising the bar through mentorship and reviews: You'll coach senior and mid-level engineers, run design reviews, and lead code reviews that genuinely improve the codebase and grow the people behind it. 
 - Partnering across the business and looking ahead: You'll contribute to technical discovery and roadmap conversations, communicate trade-offs clearly, and track emerging trends, including AI-assisted development, to improve how we build. 

What you bring to the table

- 8+ years of hands-on frontend development experience, with a track record of owning architecture and technical direction for complex, production-scale applications
 - Hands-on Prebid. js experience: header bidding setup, bid adapters and modules, and custom auction logic, price granularity, and floors. 
 - Ad server and ad-stack integrations, such as Google Ad Manager (GPT), ad-unit setup, lazy loading, and ad refresh. 
 - Understanding how ads affect page performance, including ad latency, layout shift (CLS), viewability, and bid timeout tuning. 
 - Privacy and consent frameworks (IAB TCF, GDPR, CCPA), identity solutions, and ads. txt/sellers. json. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in ReactJS and Next. js, including hooks, rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR), and component-driven architecture
 - Strong command of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript, plus deep expertise in HTML5 and CSS3, with an eye for responsive, cross-browser, and accessible design
 - Proven experience with state management and data-fetching libraries (such as Zustand, Redux, or React Query) and a solid grasp of web performance optimization and Core Web Vitals
 - Experience building design systems and shared component libraries, with comfort in testing frameworks, Git, CI/CD, and AWS (S3, CloudFront, Amplify, Lambda, or similar)
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, lead technical reviews, and influence stakeholders with strong problem-solving and communication skills

Benefits of Working at Millipixels

- Flexible work, your way: Work where you do your best thinking. We measure outcomes, not hours at a desk. 
 - Life admin handled: Regular expert-led sessions on finance, tax, and healthcare, so the boring stuff doesn't eat into your weekends. 
 - Comprehensive Health Coverage: Company-paid health insurance of ₹500, 000, with options to extend to spouse. 
 - Generous paid leave: Properly switch off and recharge. We're in this for the long game, and so are you. 
 - Room to grow: Continuous learning and real development in a global team, with space to grow your career as fast as you grow the pipeline.

data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Role

The Monetization Platform team owns the systems behind how Rippling sells, contracts, bills, collects, and recognizes revenue across products and countries. 

This is the platform behind the Quote -> Contract -> Entitlement -> Subscription -> Usage -> Bill -> Revenue lifecycle. It supports a $1B+ sales base, manages entitlements, metering, and usage-based billing rules, and enables localized billing for new country launches. The team gives Rippling the foundation to launch new products, pricing models, and markets without rebuilding monetization logic each time. 

Our vision: "Let any team monetize any product, anywhere, without writing code. "

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the next generation platform. This is an Individual Contributor role for someone who can own broad, ambiguous, multi-team technical charters, influence technical direction without relying on formal authority, and stay close to the code. 

You will work on systems where errors are expensive: contracts, entitlement state, subscription state, usage meters, invoices, payments, taxes, revenue data, audit trails, and customer-facing billing experiences. You will define architecture, make hard tradeoffs, mentor technical leaders, and build a platform that lets Rippling monetize new products faster and with more confidence. 

What You Will Do

- System Design: Design scalable, reliable systems that handles contracting, subscription management, invoicing, billing and revenue recognition
 - Ownership & Impact: Own projects end-to-end, from design through production - with direct visibility into business outcomes
 - Engineering Excellence: Set the bar for code quality, testing practices, and technical documentation within your team
 - Mentorship: Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, best practices, and continuous learning within the team
 - Collaboration: Partner with Business stakeholders, Product, and Platform teams to translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions

What You Need To Have

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field. 
 - 6+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong proficiency in Java, Python, or similar programming languages. 
 - Proven experience in designing and developing scalable, distributed systems or SaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with reliability engineering, incident response, performance tuning, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams. 
 - Excellent ability to communicate complex technical ideas with clarity and precision in written and verbal modes. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 

The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, education, training, and business need. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy.

data.title: Software Engineer - Intermediate
data.description:
Equifax is transforming how global credit, data, and analytics platforms are engineered. Based in our Trivandrum Technology Hub and reporting to a Senior Software Engineer, the Software Engineer (Full Life Cycle) is Equifax's core individual contributor engineering role building, testing, deploying, and operating software and AI-native systems end-to-end with no separate QA handoff. Quality, security, compliance, and technical documentation are owned directly by you as the engineer writing the code, enforced through automated testing, quality gates, and AI-assisted validation embedded in the CI/CD pipeline. You will also apply Context Engineering practices building prompt workflows, integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and implementing hallucination guardrails in production applications. 

What You'll Do

- End-to-End Full Life Cycle Execution: Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate reliable, scalable microservices and cloud-native features end-to-end without downstream QA, SDET, or Technical Writing handoffs. 
 - Embedded Quality, Security & Compliance: Write comprehensive automated test suites (unit, integration, contract, and API tests) and enforce security, compliance, and code quality standards directly through CI/CD quality gates and AI-assisted validation. 
 - Applied AI & Context Engineering: Implement prompt engineering patterns, integrate RAG pipelines, manage knowledge base context payloads, and build hallucination-prevention guardrails into production services. 
 - Cloud-Native Development & Operations: Build and maintain containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), troubleshoot production issues, analyze root causes, and ensure high service availability. 
 - Technical Documentation & Agile Collaboration: Maintain clear, up-to-date technical documentation as code alongside your services and collaborate actively in sprint planning, code reviews, and retrospectives within a globally distributed engineering team. 

What Experience You Need

- Experience & Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) with 4-6 years of hands-on software engineering experience building production web applications or distributed microservices. 
 - Core Backend & Full-Stack Development: 3+ years of hands-on experience writing, debugging, and optimizing production code in Modern Java (JDK 17+), Spring Boot, and TypeScript/JavaScript. 
 - Cloud & Container Fundamentals: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying cloud-native applications on GCP (or AWS/Azure) utilizing Kubernetes (GKE/EKS) and Docker. 
 - Automated Testing & CI/CD Ownership: Demonstrated experience owning code quality end-to-end using automated testing frameworks (e. g. , JUnit, Mockito, WireMock, RestAssured) and working with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), Helm Charts, and Terraform. 
 - Context Engineering & LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating LLMs into software workflows specifically building or consuming RAG pipelines, structuring prompts/context windows, and validating AI outputs for accuracy and safety. 

What Could Set You Apart

- GCP Data & Messaging Ecosystem: Hands-on experience working with Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Bigtable, GCS, or Cloud Composer (Airflow). 
 - Frontend Web Development: Experience developing responsive UI components using Angular 
 - Database & Modern Build Tooling: Proficiency with relational/NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cloud SQL) and modern build/version control tools (Maven, Gradle, Git). 
 - Regulated Domain Experience: Prior experience building secure, compliant software within FinTech, banking, credit, or data-intensive enterprise environments.

R'Keon Life Sciences is an ophthalmic pharma company with over five decades of legacy in eye care. We work with third-party CDMO partners to manufacture our range of ophthalmic and sterile products, and we are strengthening the quality governance of those partnerships. 

About the role

We are looking for a sharp, hands-on Quality Assurance professional to lead quality oversight across our third-party CDMO partners. You will split your time between partner plants, where you audit and witness manufacturing, and our Noida office, where you review batch documentation and drive quality systems.

Qualifications

- M. Pharm (Pharmaceutics / QA) or M. Sc. (Microbiology) preferred

Experience

Skills and attributes

 - Sound understanding of cleanroom, WFI and HVAC systems

 - Firm and professional with partners, and able to work independently

What we offer

data.title: Vice President – Technology QA
data.description:
Title: Vice President - Technology QA

Department: Quality Assurance & Compliance

Position Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are strengthening our Quality Assurance & Compliance function within the Technology business unit and are seeking an accomplished Vice President - Technology QA to provide strategic leadership and executive oversight of Technology QA, Computer System Validation (CSV), technology compliance, and governance across the organization. 

The VP - Technology QA will be responsible for defining and driving the Technology QA strategy, ensuring that GxP-regulated technologies, infrastructure, applications, cloud platforms, third-party solutions, and emerging technologies are appropriately governed throughout their lifecycle. 

This is a senior leadership position requiring a strong combination of Technology QA expertise, GxP regulatory knowledge, technology understanding, risk management, and people leadership. The role will partner closely with Technology, Quality, Information Security, Pharmacovigilance, Operations, and other business functions to maintain a robust, scalable, and inspection-ready technology quality framework. 

The successful candidate will play a key role in evolving the organization's Quality Management System, strengthening risk-based quality practices, enabling technology transformation, and fostering a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

Technology QA Strategy & Leadership

- Define, implement, and continuously evolve the enterprise Technology QA strategy, operating model, and governance framework, aligned with organizational objectives and applicable regulatory expectations. 
 - Provide executive leadership and subject-matter expertise for Technology QA, Computer System Validation, Computer Software Assurance, and GxP technology compliance. 
 - Establish a scalable and risk-based Technology QA framework that enables business growth, digital transformation, and technology innovation while maintaining regulatory compliance. 
 - Act as the senior Quality partner to Technology leadership and other business functions on technology-related quality, compliance, and regulatory risk. 
 - Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Technology QA organization with appropriate capabilities, succession plans, and technical expertise. 

Quality Management System & Governance

- Provide strategic oversight of the Quality Management System as it relates to Technology and technology operations. 
 - Ensure Technology QA policies, SOPs, standards, procedures, and controls remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements and recognized industry practices. 
 - Establish clear governance across the lifecycle of GxP-regulated computerized systems, including implementation, validation, operation, change, periodic review, and retirement. 
 - Drive simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement of Technology QA processes while maintaining compliance and inspection readiness. 
 - Ensure quality governance is appropriately embedded within technology delivery methodologies and the system development lifecycle. 

GxP, CSV & Computer Software Assurance

- Provide executive oversight of the validation and assurance strategy for GxP-regulated computerized systems and applications. 
 - Ensure appropriate application of relevant regulatory requirements and industry guidance, including FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GAMP 5, GxP requirements, and Data Integrity principles. 
 - Champion risk-based validation and Computer Software Assurance approaches, ensuring assurance effort is proportionate to patient safety, product quality, data integrity, and regulatory risk. 
 - Oversee validation and qualification approaches for applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, SaaS solutions, and third-party technologies. 
 - Ensure validated systems remain in a compliant state throughout their operational lifecycle. 

Audit, Inspection & Regulatory Readiness

- Establish and oversee a risk-based internal Technology QA audit programme. 
 - Provide senior leadership for regulatory inspections, client audits, and third-party audits involving technology systems and technology quality processes. 
 - Ensure Technology functions maintain a continuous state of inspection readiness. 
 - Oversee supplier qualification, audit, and re-qualification programmes for technology vendors supporting regulated operations. 
 - Provide executive oversight of audit observations and remediation activities, ensuring sustainable corrective actions and appropriate management visibility. 

CAPA, Deviations & Quality Risk Management

- Provide governance and oversight of technology-related deviations, CAPAs, quality events, and compliance risks. 
 - Ensure significant Technology QA issues undergo appropriate root-cause analysis, risk assessment, and timely remediation. 
 - Monitor CAPA effectiveness and identify systemic or recurring quality issues requiring broader organizational action. 
 - Escalate significant compliance and technology-quality risks to senior leadership, together with appropriate mitigation and remediation strategies. 

Periodic Review & Lifecycle Management

- Establish governance for periodic reviews of GxP computerized systems and applications. 
 - Ensure reviews appropriately evaluate validation status, changes, incidents, deviations, access management, security considerations, data integrity, audit trails, backup/recovery, and continued system fitness. 
 - Ensure appropriate Quality oversight of major upgrades, migrations, integrations, and system retirement activities. 

Supplier & Third-Party Quality

- Define the quality oversight model for vendors providing GxP-relevant software, SaaS platforms, cloud services, infrastructure, and technology services. 
 - Ensure appropriate supplier qualification, risk assessment, audit, and periodic re-evaluation processes are maintained. 
 - Work with Technology, Procurement, Information Security, and business owners to ensure third-party solutions meet applicable quality and regulatory requirements. 

Data Integrity & Emerging Technology

- Provide leadership for technology-related Data Integrity governance in accordance with applicable regulatory expectations and ALCOA+ principles. 
 - Establish appropriate Quality governance for emerging technologies, including cloud computing, automation, artificial intelligence, and machine-learning-enabled solutions, where used within regulated business processes. 
 - Partner with Technology and business leaders to enable responsible innovation without compromising patient safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance. 

Quality Metrics & Executive Reporting

- Establish meaningful KPIs, KRIs, and management reporting for Technology QA and compliance. 
 - Monitor trends across validation, CAPAs, deviations, audit findings, periodic reviews, supplier quality, and other key compliance indicators. 
 - Provide clear and concise reporting to senior leadership on the overall health of the Technology QA programme, significant risks, and remediation priorities. 
 - Use quality intelligence and trend analysis to drive proactive continuous improvement. 

Stakeholder Leadership

- Develop strong partnerships with Technology, Quality Assurance, Information Security, Pharmacovigilance, Operations, and other business functions. 
 - Provide authoritative advice and guidance to senior stakeholders on Technology QA and regulatory compliance. 
 - Represent Technology QA during significant client engagements, inspections, audits, and strategic technology programmes. 
 - Promote a strong Quality culture and ensure teams understand their individual accountability for maintaining compliant technology environments. 

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Information Technology, or another relevant discipline. An advanced degree is desirable. 
 - Typically 15+ years of progressive experience within Technology QA, Computer System Validation, Quality Assurance, or technology compliance within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, pharmacovigilance, or broader life-sciences industry. 
 - Significant leadership experience, ideally including 5+ years leading senior teams or enterprise-level Technology QA/CSV functions. 
 - Demonstrable experience establishing or transforming Technology QA, CSV, or technology compliance frameworks within regulated environments. 
 - Deep practical knowledge of GxP requirements, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GAMP 5, and Data Integrity principles. 
 - Strong experience with computerized system lifecycle management, risk-based validation, and Computer Software Assurance methodologies. 
 - Demonstrable experience in CAPA governance, deviations, root-cause analysis, and quality risk management. 
 - Strong experience leading or supporting regulatory inspections, customer audits, internal audits, and technology supplier audits. 
 - Experience with qualification and oversight of third-party software, SaaS platforms, cloud technologies, and technology infrastructure. 
 - Strong technical understanding of modern enterprise technology environments and their associated quality and compliance risks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively with executive leadership and influence across a matrix organization. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience within Pharmacovigilance, drug safety, clinical, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated life-sciences environments. 
 - Experience developing governance for cloud-hosted and SaaS GxP applications. 
 - Knowledge of Computer Software Assurance and modern risk-based assurance methodologies. 
 - Understanding of AI/ML, automation, and emerging digital technologies and the associated regulatory and quality considerations. 
 - Experience supporting organizational growth, acquisition/integration, or large-scale technology transformation programmes. 

Leadership Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate: 

- Strategic Leadership: Ability to translate regulatory requirements and business objectives into a practical, scalable Technology QA strategy. 
 - Regulatory Judgement: Ability to interpret regulations and guidance and apply proportionate, risk-based Quality decisions. 
 - Executive Influence: Confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders, and communicate complex quality risks clearly. 
 - Technology Orientation: Strong understanding of modern technology environments and an ability to balance innovation with regulatory expectations. 
 - Risk-Based Decision Making: Ability to distinguish significant patient, regulatory, and data risks from lower-risk operational issues and prioritize accordingly. 
 - Change Leadership: Ability to lead Quality transformation and embed sustainable improvements across functions. 
 - People Leadership: Proven ability to build, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. 
 - Collaboration: Ability to create effective partnerships across Quality and Technology and establish shared accountability for compliance. 
 - Operational Excellence: Strong focus on measurable outcomes, continuous improvement, timely execution, and sustainable remediation. 

Success in the Role

Success will be demonstrated through: 

- A robust, scalable, and risk-based Technology QA governance framework. 
 - Sustained regulatory and inspection readiness across technology operations. 
 - Effective lifecycle management of GxP computerized systems. 
 - Timely and sustainable closure of audit findings, CAPAs, and quality risks. 
 - Strong compliance and Data Integrity performance. 
 - Improved visibility of Technology QA performance through meaningful KPIs and KRIs. 
 - Effective Quality oversight of vendors, SaaS platforms, and other third-party technologies. 
 - Successful enablement of technology innovation and transformation within an appropriate regulatory framework. 
 - Development of a strong Technology QA team and an organization-wide culture of Quality ownership.

data.title: Staff AI Automation Engineer
data.description:
What You'll Do

Role Summary

As Avalara scales its AI-first enterprise systems, workflows, and automation footprint, we must reimagine how work is automated, orchestrated, and continuously improved across every function. This role exists to establish and engineer an enterprise-grade AI automation and transformation ecosystem, with n8n as a core platform, enabling faster process transformation, intelligent workflow execution, and measurable gains in productivity, quality, and operational scale. 

This is a high-impact individual contributor role responsible for elevating automation standards, reducing manual work and process friction, and enabling AI-powered transformation across the organization. 

How This Role Elevates Avalara

This role strengthens Avalara's enterprise automation and transformation capability by establishing scalable, secure, and measurable AI orchestration standards across the organization. 

This AI Automation Engineer Will

- Improve operational efficiency and process quality by engineering resilient AI automation solutions and governed platform standards
 - Accelerate business transformation and reduce cycle time through reusable automation patterns, CI/CD enablement, and standardized development frameworks
 - Enhance employee and customer experience by removing manual bottlenecks, reducing process defects, and increasing AI workflow intelligence
 - Advance Avalara's AI-first execution model by embedding agentic automation, intelligent decisioning, and data-driven observability into enterprise workflows

Bar Raiser Expectations

Role

As a Bar Raiser, this role is expected to elevate the capability and execution rigor of the entire automation and transformation function, not simply contribute as a senior engineer. This includes: 

- Holding high standards for quality, ownership, reliability, and accountability
 - Using metrics (automation adoption, cycle-time reduction, SLAs, SLOs, MTTR, cost per workflow) to guide platform and architectural decisions
 - Simplifying complex business processes into scalable, governed, and maintainable automations
 - Mentoring engineers and contractors to raise automation maturity and talent density
 - Challenging technical assumptions constructively and driving measurable improvement
 - Leaving every platform, process, and engineering practice stronger than it was before

This role does not only build automation, it transforms how work is engineered, automated, governed, and scaled across Avalara. 

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

- Enterprise AI Automation Leadership
 - Own the enterprise-wide AI automation and transformation strategy with n8n as a core orchestration platform
 - Architect scalable, secure, and resilient automation solutions that eliminate manual effort, improve process quality, and reduce operational friction
 - Design hybrid patterns leveraging n8n/Boomi, APIs, event-driven systems, and AI agents to improve reuse, enable intelligent decisioning, and reduce time-to-value
 - Define patterns for embedding AI-driven workflows (LLMs, agents, and decision engines) into business processes across functions
 - Lead architecture reviews and drive best-in-class automation design standards, including AI-assisted design patterns and governance
Platform Ownership (n8n)

- Serve as a technical owner for n8n and AI workflow automation initiatives
 - Define environment strategy (dev/test/prod), CI/CD pipelines, and governance models to reduce deployment risk and increase release velocity
 - Enable AI-powered workflow capabilities within n8n (e. g. , agent orchestration, prompt management, model integrations, human-in-the-loop controls)

 - Incorporate AI-assisted monitoring, anomaly detection, and intelligent alerting to proactively detect failures, drift, and degraded workflow performance

Standards & Governance

- Establish enterprise automation development standards and best practices
 - Define exception-handling frameworks, retry strategies, naming conventions, security protocols, and approval patterns that reduce production defects

 - Introduce code review processes and quality gates that increase execution rigor, including AI workflow validation and evaluation standards

Technical Mentorship & Delivery Excellence

- Operate as a player-coach - hands-on while mentoring engineers
 - Guide contractor and external implementation teams to ensure quality and standards adherence
 - Lead technical design sessions, workflow reviews, and post-incident reviews
 - Mentor teams on designing, building, and operationalizing AI agents and autonomous workflows within business processes
 - Promote best practices for prompt engineering, agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop workflows, and responsible AI automation
 - Elevate automation engineering capability across the organization, including AI fluency and adoption

12-Month Success Signals

Within The First 12 Months, This Role Will Have

- Enabled AI-native automation capabilities, including production-grade AI agents integrated into core workflows
 - Improved automation reliability and reduced workflow failure rates and/or MTTR
 - Standardized automation patterns, including AI-enabled orchestration patterns, adopted across new transformation initiatives
 - Implemented measurable observability, including AI performance, business impact, and cost metrics
 - Delivered AI-driven automation use cases that reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, or shorten process cycle time across multiple functions
 - Raised execution standards across the automation team through mentorship, technical leadership, and AI capability development

What You'll Need To Be Successful

AI Expectations

As an AI-first company, Avalara expects this role to embed AI into how automation and transformation work is designed and executed. 

This Role Will

- Design and implement AI-enabled workflows and transformation patterns that materially improve speed, automation, and scale
 - Use AI tools to optimize development productivity, workflow diagnostics, process analysis, and root-cause investigation
 - Identify high-value AI automation opportunities tied to efficiency, reliability, employee experience, or customer impact
 - Apply AI responsibly with appropriate governance, security, and risk considerations
 - Elevate AI capability across the automation team by sharing best practices and driving measurable adoption

This role must demonstrate applied AI impact - not casual tool usage - and quantify improvements enabled by AI-driven automation and transformation. 

What You Bring

- B. S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (required)
 - 10+ years of experience in enterprise automation, workflow engineering, integration engineering, or platform architecture
 - Deep hands-on expertise in n8n or Boomi, including building and orchestrating AI-enabled workflows, agents, and cross-functional business automations
 - Experience designing API-first and event-driven architectures, including integration of AI/ML services and agent-based systems
 - Strong understanding of REST, webhooks, OAuth, JWT, and API security, along with secure integration of AI services and model endpoints
 - Experience implementing CI/CD for automation or integration platforms, including deployment and versioning strategies for AI workflows, prompts, and models
 - Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including AI/ML services (e. g. , Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and scalable model integration patterns
 - Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, and orchestration frameworks, and how they apply to enterprise automation
 - Experience with observability and monitoring, including AI-specific considerations (latency, cost, accuracy, drift)

Avalara is an AI-first Company
