data.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
data.description:
About SleekSky

SleekSky builds and runs software for clients who want to scale their technology without heavy overhead - dedicated teams, a startup-inspired culture, and a bias for agility, ownership, and continuous improvement. We combine professional depth with real room to learn, decide, and build things that last. 

The role

AI has changed how fast software gets built. Our engineers ship every day with AI assistants writing beside them, and testing has to move at the same speed without becoming the step everything waits for. We're hiring two QA Automation Engineers to make that happen, on a live US healthcare platform with real patients on the other end of it. 

Today most testing is still done by hand, one story at a time. An automated suite exists and a release gate is part-built, but neither yet runs reliably enough for anybody to lean on, the regression pass before each release takes about three days, and when something fails it usually lands on a developer first. 

You'll write and run the automation, own the environments, configuration and test data you test against, and take every failure first: find out whether it's the code, the configuration, the data or the environment, fix it yourself when it's yours to fix, and hand a developer a reproduction and a failing test when it isn't. Nobody will hand you a test plan or a column of tickets to move. 

What you'll own

- Automation that runs without you. A Playwright suite against our web applications and our API, run every night and before every release. When it goes red, you know why the same morning - and a test that can't fail gets fixed or deleted. 
 - The first look at every failure. An overnight run that went red, a release check that found something, a test environment that stopped working, a defect a support call turned up: it comes to you before it goes to a developer. A missing text message can turn out to be a test number on an opt-out list. You find out which. 
 - Environments, configuration and test data. Two pre-production environments, stand-in services for the text, email, laboratory and shipping providers, test accounts and seeded data. Real patient data never enters the test estate. 
 - What never reaches a screen. An API response, the row a scheduled job should have written, a reminder that must go out only once, a file delivered to a partner - checked directly, with API calls, SQL and logs. 
 - New work, tested as it lands. Against its acceptance criteria and around its edges, with an automated check left behind for anything worth keeping fixed. 
 - The release regression. From about three days of checking by hand to a suite that runs on its own. 

What you'll bring

- 2+ years in software testing, most of it writing automation that ran in a pipeline or on a schedule, with other people relying on the result. 
 - The habit of chasing a failure to its cause - logs, the database, the configuration, the commit that changed it - and a bug report a developer can act on without a single follow-up question. 
 - Test code engineers would accept in review. JavaScript/TypeScript and Playwright are our stack; Selenium, Cypress, WebdriverIO, Python or Java are fine if you're willing to move. 
 - API testing and SQL you can actually use. 
 - Comfort inside the pipeline and the environment: config files, environment variables, secrets, CI workflows, containers. 
 - Daily fluency with AI coding tools - Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor or similar - and the discipline to check that every generated test can fail. 

A plus, not a requirement: testing text messages, email or automated calls; mock servers; white-labelled or multi-tenant software; healthcare or another regulated field. No certification needed and no healthcare background: the domain takes weeks to learn. What we can't teach quickly is the instinct to go and find out. 

Who this isn't for: anyone who wants a test plan handed to them, who would rather report a problem than find its cause, who sees automation as somebody else's job, who needs a finished, stable environment before they can start, or who avoids AI tools - or trusts them without checking. 

Details: Remote, India · Full-time · Indian working hours with some overlap into the evening for colleagues in the Americas · Preference for candidates who can join within 30 days.

data.title: QA Executive, Subject Matter Expert
data.description:
Role at a glancePharmaSynapse is hiring one Junior Executive in Quality Assurance to work as the shop floor subject matter expert for our QA and AI engineering team. 

- Role: Junior Executive, QA (Subject Matter Expert)
 - Experience: 3 to 5 years in QA at GMP plants on oral solids (tablets and capsules) and injectables, at least 2 of them on the shop floor
 - Education: B. Pharm or M. Pharm (M. Sc considered with strong IPQA experience)
 - Location: On site at our office in Gota, Ahmedabad. Ahmedabad local candidates only
 - Working hours: Monday to Friday, 10 am to 7 pm
 - Reports to: Kinjal Patel, Co-founder and CEO
 - Type: Full time

About the rolePharmaSynapse builds AI software that prepares GMP documents for pharma plants. You will join Kinjal Patel, our Co-founder and CEO with 12 years in pharma QA, as the second QA expert on the team and work every day with our AI engineers. Your floor knowledge decides whether what we build holds up inside a real plant. 

What you will doYour main job is to help Kinjal and our AI engineers build and test the software, and these five kinds of work fill most of your week. 

- Create realistic dummy documents for testing, such as master formulas, BMRs, BPRs, equipment lists, in-process limits and process validation sampling plans, for oral solids and injectables, with no real company data. 
 - Test the software by running each flow end to end as a production or QA user would, from preparing a document through review and approval, and log every gap with clear steps to repeat it. 
 - Check each document the software produces against shop floor practice and GMP, and mark every error with the correct entry beside it. 
 - Suggest changes to steps, screens and terms so the software matches how production and QA actually work on the floor. 
 - Brainstorm with Kinjal and the engineers on new features, and explain how a batch runs from dispensing to packing to teammates who have never worked in a plant. 
What you must bringWe screen for floor experience first, because a documentation-only background cannot tell our engineers how a batch really behaves. 

- B. Pharm or M. Pharm, with at least 3 years in QA at GMP plants making oral solids and injectables, approved by USFDA, EU, MHRA, WHO or PIC/S. 
 - Shop floor experience on both oral solid (tablet and capsule) and injectable lines is a must, with at least 2 years as IPQA doing line clearance, in-process checks, sampling and AQL inspection on running batches. 
 - On injectables, hands-on floor exposure to aseptic area behaviour, media fill, environmental monitoring and 100% visual inspection. 
 - Hands-on work with executed BMRs and BPRs, covering real-time entries, GDP corrections, reconciliation and review before batch release. 
 - Time on process validation batches, executing the sampling plan (blend uniformity, stratified sampling, hold time studies) and compiling the PV data. 
 - Floor-level QMS work, such as raising deviations and incidents, handling change controls and following CAPA through to closure. 
 - Working knowledge of 21 CFR 211, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Chapter 4, Annex 1, Annex 11, Annex 15, WHO TRS and ALCOA+. 
 - Excellent spoken and written English, strong enough to explain a floor step clearly to engineers outside pharma, lead a brainstorming discussion and write test findings anyone on the team can follow. 
 - Fluent Gujarati or Hindi and comfort with Excel. 

Good to have
 - Floor time on other dosage forms, such as oral liquids, ophthalmics, or creams and ointments. 
 - Exposure to MFC and MPC preparation, finished product specifications, APQR compilation or CPV trending. 
 - Use of plant software such as an eQMS, LIMS, eBMR or SAP, or a part in a computer system validation exercise. 
 - Curiosity about AI tools, shown by something you have already tried, such as checking a document with ChatGPT or building an Excel template your team still uses. 

What you get
 - An on-site role at our Gota office in Ahmedabad, Monday to Friday from 10 am to 7 pm, with no rotating night shifts. 
 - Daily work with a QA founder and an AI architect, each with 12 years in their field. 
 - A clear path to Product Specialist and then Domain Lead as the product grows. 
 - Pay that respects your floor experience, discussed openly in the first call. 

How to apply
 - Email your CV to p. kinjal@pharmasynapse. ai with the subject line "Junior QA Executive, SME". In the same email, describe in five or six lines one line clearance you refused to sign and what you found on the line. We read that answer before we open the CV, so make it specific. We consider applications only from candidates who already live in Ahmedabad.

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
Company Description Truevet Animal Nutrition is an innovation-driven company focused on transforming cutting-edge research into practical, impactful solutions for the animal nutrition industry. In just five years, Truevet has served over 500 customers across more than eight countries by closely collaborating and listening to their needs. The company emphasizes functional, affordable, and high-quality products designed to deliver measurable value. Incorporated on September 26, 2014, Truevet is headquartered in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, India, and continues to expand its global footprint and customer base. 
Role Description The Quality Assurance Manager is a full-time hybrid role based in Jaipur, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. This position is responsible for overseeing quality systems and processes, ensuring that all products meet internal standards and regulatory requirements. Day-to-day tasks include developing and maintaining quality control protocols, conducting audits and inspections, reviewing test results, and coordinating corrective and preventive actions. The role involves close collaboration with production, R&D, regulatory, and supply chain teams to resolve quality issues, optimize processes, and support continuous improvement initiatives. The Quality Assurance Manager will also prepare documentation and reports, train team members on quality procedures, and contribute to risk assessments and compliance activities related to animal nutrition products. 
Qualifications

- Demonstrated expertise in quality assurance and quality control in food, feed, or animal nutrition, including familiarity with relevant standards and regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong skills in process improvement, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Ability to manage documentation, audits, and inspections, with attention to detail and strong organizational capabilities. 
 - Competence in data analysis and reporting, using quality metrics to drive decision-making and continuous improvement. 
 - Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional teams and external partners. 
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Food Technology, Veterinary Science, Animal Nutrition, Microbiology, Quality Management, or a related field. 
 - Experience in a manufacturing or laboratory environment, preferably within the animal nutrition or feed industry. 
 - Comfort with hybrid work arrangements and the ability to manage responsibilities both onsite in Jaipur and remotely.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

About Ads Engineering And Marketing Technology Development

Ads Engineering creates platforms, services, APIs, and experiences for sellers that drive advertising on eBay. The team covers campaign and advertising workflows, dashboards and reporting, public APIs, selling flows, and foundational systems that enable sellers and advertisers to grow their enterprises. 

MarTech Engineering develops the platforms and capabilities that drive customer marketing and lifecycle engagement throughout eBay. The team concentrates on customer marketing platforms, performance marketing, marketing implementation systems, and the technological foundations that support personalized, measurable, and scalable customer engagement. 

About The Team And The Role

The Ads Engineering and MarTech Engineering teams build extensive products, platforms, and workflows that support sellers in growing their businesses. They help advertisers meet clear objectives and guide customers to the right inventory when needed. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About The Team

As Stripe's user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe's portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible. 

What you'll do

You will manage a team of Associates. You will act in a player-coach capacity and are accountable for supporting associates in delivering against target set goals and mentoring in subject matter expertise. 

Responsibilities

- Ongoing management of the operational performance of your team to deliver KPIs
 - Manage capacity and scheduling, dividing and assigning work between team members
 - Ensuring your team has all the skills and resources needed to be successful in their role
 - Setting clear goals and expectations for individual and team performance
 - Foster a culture of continuous improvement to refine team processes and procedures
 - Support recruitment and hiring initiatives
 - Coach and mentor individuals for career progression via structured career development conversations
 - Provide continuous performance feedback and facilitate periodic formal performance reviews
 - Drive and own initiatives that make the team a warm and welcoming place to work
 - Implement process improvements that enhance team productivity, reduce manual effort, and improve user experience

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum Requirements

- 3+ years experience leading operations teams
 - Excellent interpersonal and communications skills
 - Exemplary planning and time management skills
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively with multiple, cross-functional stakeholders to achieve results
 - Previous experience mentoring others and are able to constructively provide feedback to others
 - Ability to motivate the team and keep them engaged in an otherwise structured process
 - Proven ability to be subject matter experts in the relevant line of business
 - Previous experience in a team lead or people management role
 - Prior experience in customer service or internal/external user-facing operations

Preferred Qualifications

- Uses data to set priorities, track progress, and spot trends before they become problems. Comfortable building or maintaining dashboards and interpreting operational metrics
 - Brings numbers into conversations naturally and grounding decisions in evidence and making tradeoffs visible, not just reporting what the data says

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. 

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally. 

We look forward to hearing from you. 

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out-and set you apart-especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. 

Apply now

In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Boiler & Turbine Control Excellence - Innovate and optimize PID loops for combustion, drum level, and feedwater control, ensuring seamless and highly efficient turbine performance with intelligent load-sharing strategies. 
 - Improve Steam Temperature Control - Implement new control strategies, such as spray attemperation and reheater tuning, to maintain efficient steam conditions, minimize thermal stress, and increase plant longevity. 
 - Advanced Combustion Optimization - Drive efficiency by fine-tuning air-fuel ratios, enhancing emissions control, and optimizing burner management systems for superior heat rate and flame stability. 
 - Improving Unit Rate & Load Optimization - Developing smart load demand control strategies, fine-tuning heat rate optimization, and improving turbine governor tuning to increase fuel efficiency and grid stability. 
 - Reliable Drum Level & Feedwater Control - Engineer multi-element drum level controls with adaptive tuning, ensuring outstanding stability under fluctuating load conditions while minimizing shrink and swell effects. 
 - Implement brand new MPC strategies to minimize process variability, improve system stability, and seamlessly integrate with advanced DCS/PLC systems. 
 - DCS Commissioning (Emerson Ovation) - Lead with expertise in configuring, programming, and commissioning DCS, optimizing plant performance, and ensuring smooth power plant operations. 
 - Innovative Fuzzy Logic & Advanced Control - Harness intelligent control solutions, integrating fuzzy logic with PID and MPC for unparalleled efficiency, adaptability, and process excellence. 
 - Data-Driven Process Optimization & Performance Enhancement - Analyze critical operational data to identify growth opportunities, drive efficiency, and collaborate with plant teams to ensure a future-ready power plant.

data.title: Senior Android Developer
data.description:
Role overviewWe are looking for a hands-on Senior Android Developer to own the maintenance, enhancement and release of established native Android applications. You will work primarily with an existing Kotlin and Java codebase, deliver new features, resolve production issues and progressively improve application reliability, performance and maintainability. The role requires independent execution and close collaboration with backend, design and QA teams. 

Key responsibilities1. Native Android development and architecture·              Develop and maintain production features using Kotlin, Java, Android SDK and Jetpack components; ensure correct Activity, Fragment and application lifecycle handling, including configuration changes and process recreation. 

·              Work within the existing MVVM architecture using ViewModel and LiveData; create reusable components and shared utilities, and improve legacy code incrementally without unnecessary rewrites. 

·              Translate Figma designs into responsive XML layouts using Material Design, ConstraintLayout, RecyclerView and View Binding; maintain existing Data Binding screens. Ensure accessibility and compatibility across supported devices and Android versions. 

2. API integration and application state·              Integrate REST APIs using Retrofit, OkHttp, RxJava and Gson; handle threading, subscription disposal, nullable fields, pagination, authentication, token refresh and error states. 

·              Implement reliable loading, empty, success and failure states; handle network interruptions, timeouts, retries and caching where appropriate. Coordinate API contracts with backend engineers. 

3. Third-party integrations and real-time features·              Integrate Google Maps SDK, Places, geocoding, Routes API, GPS and Android location services; manage runtime permissions and location accuracy. 

·              Implement payment gateway integrations (such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayU, Cashfree or PhonePe) and Google Play Billing for eligible in-app purchases and subscriptions; coordinate server-side payment verification and recovery flows. 

·              Integrate Google Sign-In, OAuth and SMS-based OTP services; maintain SDK compatibility and secure authentication flows. 

·              Use Firebase Cloud Messaging, Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, Realtime Database and Cloud Firestore as required. Implement notification channels, push notifications and deep links. 

·              Implement Socket. IO or WebSocket communication, including connection lifecycle, reconnection, event listener cleanup and data synchronization. 

4. Performance, quality and security·              Investigate crashes, ANRs, memory leaks and performance bottlenecks using Android Studio Profiler, Logcat, Crashlytics and Android Vitals; improve startup, rendering and resource usage. 

·              Write unit, integration and UI tests using JUnit, Mockito and Espresso or equivalent tools; collaborate with QA on regression coverage and verify fixes before release. 

·              Apply secure storage using Android Keystore-backed mechanisms where appropriate; protect credentials and sensitive data, avoid sensitive logging, and follow least-privilege permission practices. 

·              Perform root-cause analysis for production incidents, document fixes and implement preventive improvements. Review code for correctness, maintainability and security. 

5. Build, version control and release ownership·              Use Git and pull-request workflows (Bitbucket, GitHub or equivalent), including branching, reviews, merges and conflict resolution. 

·              Manage Gradle dependencies, build variants, product flavors, APK/AAB packaging, signing and keystores securely; troubleshoot build and dependency issues. 

·              Own Google Play Console release activities, internal testing, staged rollouts, versioning, target SDK compliance and post-release monitoring. Coordinate mitigation or hotfixes when releases cause regressions. 

6. Collaboration and delivery·              Clarify requirements, identify edge cases, estimate tasks realistically and communicate technical risks and dependencies early. 

·              Collaborate with designers, backend engineers and QA; maintain technical documentation, participate in code reviews and support knowledge transfer and mentoring. 

  

Required technical skillsLanguages and platform - Strong Kotlin and Java; Android SDK, Jetpack, Activities, Fragments and lifecycle management. 

Architecture and UI - MVVM, ViewModel, LiveData, XML, Material Design, ConstraintLayout, RecyclerView, View Binding and maintenance of Data Binding. 

Networking - REST, Retrofit, OkHttp, RxJava, Gson, JSON, authentication, asynchronous programming and error handling. 

Integrations - Hands-on experience with maps or location services, at least one payment gateway and third-party SDK integrations; understanding of Google Play Billing. 

Firebase and real-time - FCM, Crashlytics and practical experience with Socket. IO or WebSockets; familiarity with other Firebase services.

data.description:
Job Title - Lead, Product Validation & Lab Operations

Location: Leanwatts factory, Hyderabad, India

Work arrangement: On-site. 

About usAt Leanwatts, we develop and manufacture power electronic solutions for electric mobility and energy applications. Our Designed and Made in India approach focuses on reliable, high-performance products. 

What is this role about?Build and run the validation lab, lead the testing team, and own design verification and validation through certification. Start with portable EV chargers, on-board chargers (OBCs), and hybrid inverters, then build the test capability needed for future Leanwatts products. 

What you will do at Leanwatts
 - Own DVP and DVT: Translate product requirements, risks and applicable standards into a Design Verification Plan (DVP). Define methods, fixtures, sample sizes, hardware and firmware revisions, operating corners, acceptance limits and schedule. Keep coverage, results, deviations and retest status current through each design build. 
 - Run the lab and lead the team: Define bench, instrument, fixture and safety requirements; commission equipment and maintain SOPs, calibration and preventive maintenance. Own daily scheduling and test assignments, train the team, review setups before energisation, and resolve equipment or capacity bottlenecks. 
 - Lead hands-on testing: Cover electrical and functional performance (efficiency, power quality, modes and fault recovery), electrical safety (insulation, leakage, earthing and protection), mechanical (fitment, mounting, vibration and connector durability), thermal and environmental tests (derating, cycling, humidity and ingress), endurance and reliability, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance. 
 - Make test reports usable for release: Record exact sample serials, hardware and firmware, setup, instruments, conditions, raw data and pass/fail against limits. Reproduce failures with R&D, track corrective actions and verify fixes. Give R&D and Quality a clear summary of failed, untested or waived requirements before release. 
 - Own external testing and certification: Map applicable standards with R&D and Quality, select suitable accredited labs, and manage quotations, bookings, samples, submissions and schedules. Review agency reports for correct configuration and test scope; coordinate corrective actions, retests and closure, and retain reports and certificates by product revision. 

Must have requirements
 - Education: B. E. or B. Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Experience: At least 5 years of hands-on product validation or test engineering on chargers, inverters, converters, or comparable power electronics. 
 - Experience leading testers and running lab operations, including safe test setups, equipment selection, calibration and maintenance. Able to lead electrical, mechanical, environmental and reliability tests. 
 - Evidence of owning a DVP, producing traceable reports, closing test failures with design teams, and coordinating external testing or certification.

data.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. 

Job Description

- Evaluate the current technology landscape and recommend a forward-looking, short- and long-term technology strategic vision. 
 - Engage with senior technical leaders at the client site, becoming a trusted thought partner by understanding their challenges and providing strategic guidance. 
 - Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Proactively understand client needs and align them with Fractal's value propositions, proposing innovative and comprehensive solutions. 
 - Collaborate with offshore delivery teams and other multidisciplinary teams within Fractal to ensure seamless integration and delivery of solutions. 

Delivery Leadership (Added Focus)

- Act as a Delivery Lead when required, ensuring end-to-end ownership of solution execution, quality, timelines, and client satisfaction. 
 - Drive program-level governance, including planning, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication across workstreams. 
 - Step in to resolve complex technical and delivery challenges, guiding teams through ambiguity and ensuring timely resolution. 
 - Provide hands-on leadership during critical delivery phases, including architecture validation, performance optimization, and production issue resolution. 
 - Ensure alignment between solution architecture and delivery execution, balancing immediate delivery goals with long-term scalability and maintainability. 
 - Mentor and guide delivery teams, fostering strong engineering practices, accountability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Be willing to take a hands-on approach to understand complex contexts and underlying client requirements. 
 - Participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content, and new reference architectures. 
 - Provide technical architecture leadership and direction on projects, ensuring secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable platforms. 
 - Work with data engineers and data scientists to develop architectures and solutions. 
 - Assist in ensuring the smooth delivery of services, products, and solutions, while balancing immediate client needs with long-term technical strategy. 

Skills & Requirements

In-depth experience as an Architect with expertise in Google Cloud Platform and a passion for applying the latest technologies to solve complex business problems. An ideal candidate would have: 

- 12+ years of experience in Data Engineering and Cloud Native technologies (including Google Cloud Platforms), covering big data, analytics, and AI/ML domains. 
 - Extensive experience with GCP tools and technologies, including BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Data Flow, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, and Dataproc. 
 - Expertise in creating, deploying, configuring, and scaling applications on GCP serverless infrastructure. 
 - Strong knowledge and working experience in Data Engineering, Data Management, and Data Governance. 
 - Proven track record of delivering multiple end-to-end Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Analytics projects. 
 - Knowledge of general programming languages and frameworks, particularly Python and/or Java. 
 - Familiarity with general technology best practices and development lifecycles such as Agile and CI/CD, as well as DevOps and MLOps for more efficient data and machine learning pipelines. 
 - Ability to design and implement future-proof, complex global solutions using GCP services. 
 - Hands-on experience with foundational architectures, including microservices, event-driven systems, event streaming, and online machine learning systems. 
 - Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to adapt messages to various audiences and build consensus. 

Additional Delivery Expectations

- Proven ability to lead large-scale delivery programs or workstreams in complex, client-facing environments. 
 - Experience managing cross-functional teams across geographies, ensuring alignment and delivery excellence. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to dive deep into technical issues while maintaining a big-picture view. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in container technologies, specifically Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience or knowledge of DevOps on GCP. 
 - Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect Certification. 
 - Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and build strong, lasting relationships. 
 - Hands-on approach and willingness to delve into technical details to understand the full context of a problem and ensure the best solutions are provided. 
 - Experience with AWS, especially in the context of hybrid cloud setups.

data.title: Test Engineer
data.description:
Summary: 

We are seeking a Test/Quality Engineer to enhance our DevOps team by instilling a quality engineering mindset throughout the delivery process. This role emphasizes risk-based testing, failure scenario analysis, and automation in CI/CD to boost efficiency and reliability. 

Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement automated tests at various levels (unit, API/contract, integration, UI, end-to-end) to ensure reliability within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Integrate quality engineering practices into DevOps (shift-left and shift-right), focusing on proactive prevention. 
 - Conduct risk analysis and establish testing strategies based on potential business impact and user journey criticality. 
 - Develop and maintain quality gates in pipelines, including test execution and coverage thresholds. 
 - Enhance testability through collaboration with engineering teams on design principles. 
 - Set and monitor quality metrics such as defect escape rates and pipeline health. 
 - Facilitate continuous improvement of testing frameworks and automation. 
 - Conduct non-functional testing as necessary. 
 - Participate in the Test & Quality transformation roadmap and integrate AI opportunities in testing processes. 
 - Identify automation opportunities for efficiency improvements. 

Key Requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 5 years of experience in software quality engineering. 
 - Experience as a QA/Test Engineer in Agile/DevOps environments. 
 - Strong capability in risk-based testing and preventive quality practices. 
 - Hands-on automation experience with tools like Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. 
 - Understanding of DevSecOps practices. 
 - Proficient in one programming or scripting language for automation. 
 - Experience with CI/CD processes and automated test integration. 
 - Knowledgeable about defining quality gates and metrics. 
 - Familiarity with testing across the pyramid (unit to E2E). 
 - Experience with Agentic IDEs and 'Agent in the loop' workflows. 
 - Understanding of Design Tokens and automating visual validation processes. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience with specific CI/CD tools (e. g. , Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions). 
 - Expertise in automation of performance and security testing. 
 - Previous involvement in AI-driven testing initiatives. 

Other Details: 

This position offers opportunities for remote work and is geared towards fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement within the DevOps landscape.

Department: Quality Engineering

Location: Pune

Reports to: Sr. Manager, Quality Engineering

Employment type: Full Time

Role Summary

We are seeking an Associate Manager - Quality Engineering to lead a QE team in delivering reliable, secure, and high-quality software. This role combines people management, quality planning, and technical leadership across manual and automated testing. The Associate Manager will partner with Engineering, Product, and other stakeholders to identify delivery risks early, strengthen test coverage, and improve release confidence while developing the team's capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

People leadership and team development

- Lead day-to-day QE execution, set clear goals, allocate work, and balance capacity across delivery commitments. 
 - Conduct regular one-to-ones, provide actionable feedback, support performance reviews, and build individual development plans. 
 - Support hiring and onboarding; foster accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning. 

Quality planning and delivery

- Translate product requirements, architecture, and customer workflows into risk-based test plans and measurable coverage objectives. 
 - Coordinate functional, integration, API, end-to-end, regression, and exploratory testing across relevant environments. 
 - Review acceptance criteria and test readiness early; identify dependencies, environment gaps, and test-data needs. 
 - Communicate quality risks, coverage gaps, and release-readiness recommendations; escalate critical issues with clear mitigation options. 

Automation and engineering excellence

- Guide maintainable automation across appropriate test layers, prioritizing reliable coverage and fast, useful feedback. 
 - Partner with developers to integrate automated checks into CI/CD pipelines and improve testability throughout development. 
 - Improve test reliability by addressing flaky tests, execution bottlenecks, and environment instability. 
 - Coordinate performance, security, accessibility, and resilience testing with relevant specialists according to product risk. 

Collaboration and continuous improvement

- Partner with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Support to align quality priorities with customer outcomes and delivery plans. 
 - Facilitate defect triage and root-cause analysis; drive preventive actions for recurring defects and production escapes. 
 - Maintain clear quality reporting and use trends to improve processes, tooling, and team effectiveness. 
 - Promote practical quality standards, shared ownership of quality, and effective documentation without unnecessary process overhead. 
 - Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to improve engineering productivity and software quality. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with a quality-first mindset. 
 - Motivates team members to use AI tools effectively and deliver faster

Required Qualifications

- Typically 6-9 years of experience in software quality engineering or testing, including experience leading a team or a significant QE workstream. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach engineers, manage competing priorities, and deliver quality outcomes across releases. 
 - Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery, risk-based testing, and defect management. 
 - Hands-on experience with test automation and at least one programming or scripting language, with the ability to review test code and guide framework improvements. 
 - Experience testing APIs, integrations, and data-driven workflows; working knowledge of SQL, version control, and CI/CD concepts. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior people-management experience, including performance feedback, hiring, and career development. 
 - Experience with cloud-based SaaS products, distributed systems, and observability-led troubleshooting. 
 - Exposure to performance, security, accessibility, or resilience testing and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Experience scaling automation across teams and improving test-data or environment-management practices.

The role will focus on validating complex Fees & Expense Management workflows across Brokerage, Clearing, Exchange, Regulatory and other Market Infrastructure fees. The successful candidate will combine strong business understanding with hands-on testing, data validation and problem-solving skills. 

Experience in test automation, API testing, scripting and AI-assisted testing will be a strong advantage.

 - Experience with complex financial workflows, calculations and reconciliations

 - Ability to independently analyse requirements, identify risks and investigate complex defects

 - Hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium or equivalent automation frameworks

Experience : 4-5 years of relevant experience in software testing/quality assurance, preferably within Investment Banking, Capital Markets, or Financial Services.

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
Job Description

Carn Global Trade Private Limited is seeking a highly competent and technically proficient Quality Assurance Manager to oversee food safety, product quality, regulatory compliance and supplier qualification for its United Nations and international humanitarian supplies business. 

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all food and beverage products sourced from domestic and international manufacturers comply with United Nations Standards (UNSTD), applicable international food safety standards and client-specific technical requirements. 

The position requires extensive knowledge of food science, food processing, food chemistry, microbiology, analytical testing methodologies, laboratory operations and food safety management systems. 

Role & Responsibilities

1. Supplier Qualification & Compliance

- Evaluate, qualify and approve food and beverage manufacturers and suppliers across domestic and international markets. 
 - Conduct technical assessments of manufacturing facilities, production processes and food safety management systems. 
 - Review, verify, validate and maintain the following producer and supplier documentation: 

- Company Registration Certificate
 - ISO 22000: 2005/2018 Certificate, issued by an appropriately accredited certification body
 - HACCP Certificate
 - HACCP Plan & Hazard Analysis
 - Contaminant Control Plan
 - Prerequisite Programmes (PRP)
 - Operational Prerequisite Programmes (OPRP)
 - Pest Control Plan
 - Process Flow Diagram
 - Product Recall Procedure & Recall Team
 - Latest Internal Quality Audit Report
 - Latest External Quality Audit Report
 - Food Safety Management System (FSMS) Manual
 - BRCGS Certificate and Audit Reports, wherever available
 - Identify deficiencies in supplier documentation and coordinate corrective actions. 
 - Conduct periodic supplier audits, risk assessments and performance evaluations. 
 - Maintain an updated database of approved suppliers and manufacturing facilities. 

2. Product Qualification & Technical Compliance

- Study, interpret and implement United Nations Food Standards (UNSTD), including applicable revisions and product-specific requirements. 
 - Evaluate product formulations, ingredients, additives, nutritional composition, manufacturing processes and shelf-life parameters. 
 - Conduct detailed gap analyses between manufacturer specifications and United Nations requirements. 
 - Review, prepare and validate the following product documentation: 

- Product Technical Cards and Specifications on manufacturer's letterhead
 - Third-party Certificates of Analysis (COA) issued by ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratories
 - Product Packaging Photographs covering all sides
 - Primary and Secondary Packaging Artwork
 - Ensure compliance with applicable food labelling, packaging, allergen declaration, traceability and nutritional declaration requirements. 
 - Prepare comprehensive technical dossiers for product approval and submission to international clients. 
 - Coordinate with manufacturers for product reformulation and development wherever necessary to achieve technical compliance. 

3. Laboratory Testing & Analytical Assessment

- Independently determine appropriate laboratory testing requirements based on product specifications, regulatory requirements and food safety risks. 
 - Coordinate with domestic and international accredited food testing laboratories. 
 - Develop product-specific testing protocols covering: 

- Physical and physicochemical parameters
 - Chemical composition
 - Microbiological parameters
 - Nutritional analysis
 - Heavy metals
 - Pesticide residues
 - Mycotoxins and aflatoxins
 - Food additives and preservatives
 - Process contaminants, including acrylamide
 - Food authenticity and adulteration
 - Allergens
 - Shelf-life and stability
 - Possess a strong working understanding of analytical methodologies, including HPLC, GC-MS, LC-MS/MS, ICP-MS, spectrophotometry, titration and microbiological testing. 
 - Understand internationally recognised analytical methods prescribed by AOAC, ISO, AOCS, Codex Alimentarius and other relevant authorities. 
 - Verify laboratory accreditation scope, analytical methodology, Limit of Detection (LOD), Limit of Quantification (LOQ), measurement uncertainty and reporting units. 
 - Critically evaluate laboratory findings and determine product compliance independently. 
 - Investigate abnormal, inconsistent, inconclusive or non-compliant laboratory results. 
 - Engage in technical discussions with laboratory scientists and analytical experts to resolve discrepancies. 
 - Establish appropriate sampling, sample preparation, preservation, transportation and retesting procedures. 

4. Food Science & Product Development

- Apply comprehensive knowledge of food chemistry, food microbiology, food processing and preservation technologies. 
 - Understand the impact of raw materials, geographical origin, processing conditions and storage on finished product characteristics. 
 - Evaluate manufacturing processes across multiple food and beverage categories, including: 

- Fruit juices, nectars and concentrates
 - Biscuits and bakery products
 - Sauces, condiments and tomato-based products
 - Jams, marmalades and fruit preparations
 - Canned and frozen fruits and vegetables
 - Cereals, grains, pulses and legumes
 - Dairy and processed food products
 - Ready-to-eat and shelf-stable food products
 - Coordinate with manufacturers and their R&D teams to resolve technical challenges. 
 - Assess product authenticity, formulation integrity, ingredient functionality and potential adulteration risks. 

5. Quality Assurance & Shipment Compliance

- Establish and implement pre-production, in-process and pre-dispatch quality assurance protocols. 
 - Verify batch-specific quality documentation prior to shipment. 
 - Ensure compliance with packaging integrity, carton strength, batch coding, manufacturing and expiry dates, storage conditions and transportation requirements. 
 - Coordinate pre-shipment inspections and product sampling. 
 - Establish product traceability and batch-level documentation systems. 
 - Exercise technical approval and rejection authority for products that do not meet prescribed quality or regulatory requirements. 
 - Investigate customer complaints, product rejections and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). 
 - Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 

6. Regulatory Compliance & Documentation Management

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of international food safety regulations and standards, including: 

- United Nations Food Standards (UNSTD)
 - Codex Alimentarius
 - FSSAI regulations
 - ISO 22000
 - ISO/IEC 17025
 - HACCP
 - BRCGS
 - FSSC 22000
 - European Union food safety regulations
 - US FDA regulations
 - Monitor changes in applicable international standards and assess their impact on existing products and suppliers. 
 - Develop internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), compliance checklists and quality management protocols. 
 - Maintain centralised records of supplier certifications, laboratory reports, product approvals and compliance documentation. 
 - Coordinate directly with international clients, manufacturers, laboratories, inspection agencies and certification bodies on technical matters. 
 - Provide technical support to procurement, business development and supply chain teams. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, Food Chemistry, Food Microbiology or a closely related discipline. 
 - Candidates with postgraduate qualifications in Food Science or Food Technology will be preferred. 
 - Professional certifications in HACCP, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, BRCGS or Food Safety Auditing will be an added advantage. 

Professional Experience

- 5-10 years of relevant experience in the Food & Beverage industry. 
 - Demonstrated experience in food quality assurance, regulatory compliance, food manufacturing, product development or analytical food testing. 
 - Prior experience with food exports, international food safety regulations or institutional food procurement will be preferred. 
 - Experience working with accredited food testing laboratories such as Eurofins, Intertek, SGS, Bureau Veritas or equivalent organisations will be an added advantage. 
 - Experience in handling multiple food and beverage categories rather than being restricted to a single product category. 
 - Prior experience with United Nations, humanitarian organisations, international institutional buyers or government food supply contracts will be a significant advantage. 

Technical Competencies

- In-depth understanding of food chemistry, microbiology and food processing technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of laboratory operations, analytical instruments and food testing methodologies. 
 - Ability to independently interpret and critically assess laboratory reports. 
 - Strong understanding of international food safety management systems. 
 - Ability to identify technical inconsistencies, regulatory gaps and potential food safety risks. 
 - Understanding of food authenticity testing and adulteration detection. 
 - Proficiency in supplier audits, risk assessments, root cause analysis and corrective action management. 
 - Strong technical documentation and report-writing capabilities. 

Perks and Benefits

- Competitive remuneration commensurate with qualifications, technical expertise and experience. 
 - Opportunity to work within the United Nations and international humanitarian food supply ecosystem. 
 - Exposure to international food safety standards, global manufacturing practices and advanced analytical testing methodologies. 
 - Opportunities for domestic and international business travel. 
 - Direct interaction with international laboratories, food manufacturers and institutional clients. 
 - Opportunity to establish and lead the company's Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance function. 
 - Professional development and opportunities for specialised industry training and certifications. 
 - Performance-based career advancement opportunities. 
 - Opportunity to contribute to global humanitarian food supply programmes and international peacekeeping operations. 

Please send your CV to chetan@carn. global

About CIBC: 

CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we're proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do. 

About CIBC India: 

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you'll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you're driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you'll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you'll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you're ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity. 

What CIBC India Offers: 

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation. 

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program. 

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development. 

What You'll Be Doing (position summary): 

- The Sr. Manager, IT Quality Assurance leads quality engineering and software testing across multiple initiatives, projects, and workstreams within CIBC's technology organization, with primary alignment to Core Banking and Payments Technology and support across enterprise banking platforms. 
 - This role ensures delivery of high-quality solutions through robust test strategies, scalable automation frameworks, disciplined defect management, and risk-based testing. 
 - This offshore leadership role provides hands-on technical direction, influences enterprise testing strategy, strengthens automation maturity, and drives continuous improvement in quality processes, tooling, and standards. 
 - The incumbent leads people, manages vendors and delivery commitments, strengthens release readiness, and promotes AI-assisted testing to improve quality, accelerate delivery, and optimize cost. At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview. 

How You'll Succeed (responsibilities): 

Design and Development: 

- Develop and oversee end-to-end test strategies, plans, scripts, and documentation across functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing to ensure risk-based coverage. 
 - Build, enhance, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for enterprise applications, APIs, and integrated platforms to improve repeatability and coverage. 
 - Integrate automated test scripts with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and release confidence. 
 - Review business and technical requirements to ensure complete, traceable test coverage. 

Strategic Planning: 

- Define automation strategies, frameworks, and tools to improve testing efficiency, quality, and coverage. 
 - Lead the testing workstream across multiple projects and releases to align with scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations. 
 - Prepare testing estimates, timelines, and resource input for assigned initiatives to support planning and delivery. 
 - Provide quality assessments, release readiness recommendations, and risk-based insights to support informed decisions. 

Leadership Skills: 

- Lead a Quality Engineering team by setting context when assigning work so team members understand how their roles support business unit priorities and CIBC's goals. 
 - Manage employee performance through fair, accurate formal and informal feedback, and removal of obstacles, linking expectations to business priorities. 
 - Hire the right people in the right roles to align individual capability with job requirements and business needs. 
 - Create a positive, inclusive environment and champion CIBC's mission, vision, and values to function as an effective role model. 
 - Manage internal staff and external vendors to ensure timely completion of all test phases. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Promote best practices in automation design, coding standards, version control, execution governance, and reporting to raise automation maturity. 
 - Evaluate and implement tools, accelerators, and reusable components to improve automation reliability and speed to delivery. 
 - Adopt AI-assisted testing capabilities to improve quality, accelerate delivery, and optimize cost. 

Learning and Development: 

- Build team and individual capability through coaching, job shadowing, special projects, training, and stretch assignments to grow team performance. 
 - Coach and mentor team members in business domain knowledge, functional testing, automation, and non-functional testing to broaden skills. 

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS: 

- Internal: Partners with project managers, product owners, business analysts, architects, developers, and release teams to coordinate delivery and testing outcomes. 
 - Internal: Works with DevOps, platform engineering, and environment teams to strengthen automation integration and release efficiency. 
 - Internal: Manages relationships with enterprise leadership and stakeholders across multiple lines of business to align on quality and delivery. 

COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls. 
 - As a manager of people, this job must ensure all employees within the business unit comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls. 

JOB DIMENSIONS: 

- Hyderabad, India, working with North America-based teams in a globally distributed delivery model. 
 - Direct management of the Quality Engineering team within Core Banking and Payments Technology. 
 - Multiple concurrent testing projects and workstreams across enterprise applications, APIs, web, integration, automation, and non-functional testing. 

Experience: 10+ years of experience

Who You Are (skills/qualifications): 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 

Must Have Skills: 

- 10+ years of experience in a management role, with strong knowledge of the Testing Life Cycle, SDLC, and defect management for application testing and support. 
 - 5+ years of experience in automation or an equivalent technical role, with hands-on expertise in test automation tools. 
 - Experience leading a technology team, delivering results, and managing relationships with management enterprise wide. 
 - Experience testing enterprise-grade applications, APIs, web services, databases, and integrated systems. 
 - Experience managing internal teams, cross-functional stakeholders, and external vendors in a delivery environment. 
 - Hands-on expertise with test automation tools such as Selenium, Robot Framework, Python, Postman, Rest Assured, Cucumber, or similar. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA and HP ALM. 
 - Experience developing automation strategies, frameworks, and reusable assets. 
 - Experience integrating automated test scripts with DevOps tools and processes. 
 - Strong understanding of QE processes. 
 - Excellent organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong communication skills, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
 - Demonstrated leadership, coaching, and mentoring abilities. 
 - Ability to collaborate across teams and influence outcomes. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, delivery oversight, and risk management capabilities. 

Good to Have: 

- Salesforce application testing and test automation experience. 
 - Experience with Python, Java, and SQL database skills. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise automation and non-functional testing approaches. 
 - Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies and industry changes. 
 - Exposure to AI-enabled testing tools, intelligent automation accelerators, or predictive quality analytics.

data.title: Power Platform Dynamic 365 engineer
data.description:
Company Description Regent Campus D2 is an AI-driven digital campus platform that enables universities, colleges, schools, and training organizations to manage teaching, enrollment, and certification online at scale. Each institution operates in its own isolated environment with dedicated data, branding, and users, supported by features such as virtual classrooms, AI-assisted enrollment, blockchain-backed digital IDs, and secure content protection. The platform offers tools including automatic transcripts, AI flashcards, AI teaching assistants, live multi-language translation, and APIs with React-based integrations to existing systems. Built on zero-trust principles, institution data is kept isolated and is never used to train shared AI models, reinforcing privacy and trust. Regent Campus D2 is part of Regent Technology Holdings, headquartered in New York, with product and engineering teams based in Chennai, India

Job Description

Join our dynamic team at Regent College London as a Power Platform & Dynamics 365 Engineer (Integrations, ALM & Security), where you'll help evolve and harden our Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform services that support key Higher Education business processes (admissions, marketing, enrolment, student communications and student support). 

In this role you'll design and deliver solutions across Dataverse (model-driven apps), Canvas apps, Power Automate and Power Pages. You'll bring strong engineering capability in API integrations and pro-code extensibility (e. g. , plugins, JavaScript) and will help establish secure, reliable delivery practices across environments. 

This role is based remotely (India), joining a UK-based function and working primarily to the UK time zone. You'll be part of a small, dedicated team delivering both strategic initiatives and continuous improvements. 

The successful candidate will be a self-starter and strong individual contributor, comfortable owning work end-to-end without a dedicated QA team. You will also act as a technical multiplier by uplifting integration patterns, ALM/CI-CD, and security practices, and by mentoring other developers as they upskill. 

Specific Skills & Responsibities-

·              Design, build and enhance Dataverse-based solutions (model-driven apps, tables, forms, views and business logic) aligned to the CRM product roadmap. 

·              Support day-to-day Dynamics 365/Dataverse configuration including adding fields, modifying forms/views, business rules, security roles, and general entity/app administration as part of shared team responsibilities. 

·              Design and build targeted Canvas apps (and reusable components where appropriate) for business scenarios that are better served by task-focused, UX-first experiences, integrating with Dataverse and other services. 

·              Implement custom logic where required using C# (plugins and/or custom workflow activities), JavaScript/TypeScript, and platform extensibility patterns. 

·              Design, develop and support API-based integrations between Dynamics 365/Dataverse and enterprise systems (including the Student Records System where applicable) using REST APIs, OAuth2/Entra ID, custom connectors and/or Azure integration services. 

·              Create, enhance and refactor Power Automate flows using resilient engineering practices (error handling, retries, logging, idempotency where relevant, connection references and environment variables). 

·              Contribute to the migration from legacy ADX/portal capabilities to Power Pages, including page/templates, forms, security/permissions, and safe integration patterns back to Dataverse and other services. 

·              Maintain disciplined solution management and automated deployments across environments using Azure DevOps (Power Platform Build Tools/PAC CLI), including versioning, release notes and deployment runbooks. 

·              Improve the security posture of the platform through least-privilege role design, team/access model reviews, auditing, and Power Pages permission modelling; collaborate with platform/tenant administrators on governance controls. 

·              Perform thorough testing, create reusable test scripts/checklists, and participate in peer reviews to ensure quality, performance and reliability. 

·              Triage and resolve defects/incidents promptly, provide third-line support for integrations/automations, and proactively monitor and improve platform health. 

·              Work closely with the Head of Enterprise Applications & CRM, Project Manager, developers and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, propose options, communicate trade-offs and maintain clear technical documentation. 

Additional Duties

·              Contribute to consistent Agile ceremonies (refinement, planning, review and retrospectives) and support lightweight estimation and delivery forecasting for a small team. 

·              Help implement and document engineering standards (ALM, CI/CD, integration patterns, security reviews) and contribute to Centre of Excellence (CoE) practices where appropriate. 

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Experience & Personal Qualities

Essential

·              Full proficiency in English; confident communicating with UK-based stakeholders. Ability to work effectively as part of a small delivery team and collaborate across IT and business functions. 

·              3-5 years of experience delivering solutions on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Customer Engagement) and the Power Platform. 

·              Hands-on experience with Dataverse solution delivery (tables, forms, views, business rules/processes) in model-driven apps; able to contribute to Canvas apps where appropriate. 

·              Comfortable delivering both configuration-level enhancements (e. g. , fields, forms, views, business rules) and engineering-level work (integrations, ALM/CI/CD, security). 

·              Experience designing and building Power Apps Canvas apps (responsive design, components and Dataverse integration). 

·              Experience delivering Power Pages (or ADX Studio Portals), including external user journeys and permissions modelling. 

·              Experience building and supporting API integrations (REST, OAuth2/Entra ID app registrations) and using tools such as Postman. 

·              Experience with pro-code extensibility for Dataverse (e. g. , C# plugins/custom workflow activities) and/or client-side scripting (JavaScript). 

·              Strong Power Automate experience, including production-grade practices (error handling, monitoring and supportability). 

·              Experience working with Dev/UAT/Production environments and change/release management. 

·              Comfortable working independently without a dedicated QA team; able to plan, test and deliver end-to-end. 

·              Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with attention to security and data integrity. . 

Desirable

·              Experience with Azure integration services (e. g. , Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault). 

·              Experience implementing CI/CD for Power Platform using Azure DevOps pipelines (Power Platform Build Tools and/or PAC CLI). 

·              Experience with PCF controls and TypeScript. 

·              Experience in Higher Education or similarly regulated environments handling sensitive personal data. 

Technical Knowledge & Skill

Essential

·              Strong knowledge of Dataverse architecture, solution management (managed/unmanaged), and environment configuration (Dev/UAT/Prod). 

·              Strong knowledge of Dynamics 365 CE/model-driven app configuration. 

·              C#/. NET experience for Dataverse plugins and related development practices (source control, code review, debugging). 

·              JavaScript (and ideally TypeScript) for model-driven form scripting and client API usage. 

·              API integration design via authentication/authorisation (OAuth2), data mapping, error handling, retries, and monitoring/observability. 

·              Power Automate engineering: scalable flow design, connection references, environment variables and governance-aware connector use. 

·              ALM/CI-CD fundamentals with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub (build/release pipelines, approvals and deployment controls). 

·              Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery practices. 

Desirable

·              Power Pages (Liquid, basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript) and portal deployment practices. Canvas app development (formulas, responsive design, components, Dataverse integration). 

·              Power Platform CoE Starter Kit familiarity and platform monitoring approaches. 

·              Data export and reporting patterns (e. g. , datalake concepts, ETL, Power BI modelling fundamentals). 

·              Understanding of security best practices for external users and portals (least privilege, auditing, data protection). 

·              Azure administration familiarity relevant to integration delivery. 

Educational & Qualification

Essential·              Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent level experience/training. 

Desirable·              Microsoft Power Platform Developer certification (PL-400). 

·              Additional relevant Microsoft certifications (e. g. , PL-600, MB-230, AZ-204) or equivalent experience.

data.description:
Company Description Creators MindTM is a one-stop solutions provider for educators and creators, helping them build and grow their personal brands. The company offers a range of products and services, including mobile and desktop applications, studio setup support, digital marketing, and social media management. Its platform enables live classes, quizzes, notes, and an integrated e-commerce store to manage fees and content distribution. Creators MindTM also provides 24/7 support to address learner queries and ensure a smooth teaching experience. The focus is on delivering best-in-class content and tools that empower educators to reach and engage their audiences effectively. 
Role Description The Automation Engineer role at Creators MindTM is a full-time, on-site position based in Patna. The Automation Engineer will design, implement, and maintain automation systems that support the company's digital products and operational workflows. Daily responsibilities include configuring and integrating hardware and software for automated processes, monitoring system performance, and diagnosing and resolving technical issues. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve process control, enhance reliability, and optimize resource usage in studio setups and digital infrastructure. The Automation Engineer will also document system configurations, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure compliance with relevant safety and quality standards. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong skills in Automation and Process Control to design, implement, and optimize automated workflows. 
 - Candidates should possess foundational knowledge in Electrical Engineering to work with control systems, sensors, and related hardware. 
 - Candidates should possess skills in Troubleshooting to diagnose issues, perform root-cause analysis, and maintain system uptime. 
 - Candidates should possess familiarity with Robotics or related technologies to support advanced automation solutions. 
 - Relevant bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related field) or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, wiring diagrams, and system schematics. 
 - Experience with PLCs, SCADA systems, or other industrial control platforms is an advantage. 
 - Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively on-site in a fast-paced environment.
