data.title: Senior SDET Analyst
data.description:
Summary of This Role

Performs and participates in application development and testing to apply continuous quality and testability of code throughout the software development lifecycle. Builds quality within the software development process with automated testing suites providing a comprehensive view from code quality to functionality. Uses quality paradigms to provide real time quality with use of automation and frequent regression testing. Designs / develops and maintains automation frameworks and automation test suites and scripts with continuous integration, testing, deployment and delivery. Conducts performance, load, security and service virtualization testing. 

What Part Will You Play?

- Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Collaborates with peers to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Conducts impact analysis, evaluates and identifies affects to regression test suites, testability of code, and application performance to reduce negative influences on continuous testing. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies and designs testing suites for test driven development (TDD) and behavior driven development (BDD) to allow early and frequent testing as the software is developed. Identifies process improvement and continuous quality measures across the development lifecycle. 
 - Writes and executes application tests at the source code level to prevent hidden errors (i. e. , white box testing) within unit and component testing. Identifies and suggests improvements for code quality to improve deficiencies from functionality through structure of code for performance and maintainability. Builds, maintains and reviews mid-level unit and component test suites and conducts automated white box tests. Identifies improper coding and code quality issues. Integrates white box test suites with continuous integration (CI) tools. Programs and creates mid-level test cases using unit and component testing tools for code level testing. 
 - Develops moderately complex software tools, frameworks and utilities for validation / verification activities and end-to-end functional testing of software. Identifies and recommends tools and frameworks for testing and creates automated tools for generic use and maintainability. Writes moderately complex code that uses / exercises non-user interface (UI) components like application program interface's (API's), representational state transfer API (RESTful API), and web services similar to the end user to develop frameworks for testing. Integrates automated suites with continuous integration (CI) tools for frequent execution. 
 - Installs and uses moderately complex CI frameworks in continuous testing and continuous deployment / delivery. Builds, customizes, and deploys moderately complex test environments and test automation frameworks. Performs moderately complex scripting, data generation, and other methods to maintain automation infrastructure throughout the development. Integrates CI tools with other testing infrastructure and develops moderately complex reporting / metrics on CI. 
 - Develops test scripts, test data, and analyzes / interprets performance, load and security testing. Conducts testing, analysis and interprets results using service virtualization testing tools that emulates the behavior of necessary dependent system components that are unavailable or difficult-to-access. Identifies virtualization testing opportunities with approaches and designs to testing virtualized environments. Identifies performance testing opportunities with approaches and designs to test for application performance, load, security and service virtualization. Analyzes systems and database performance and responses during loads. Directs tests to avoid common application performance bottlenecks. Maintains and administers procedures, methodologies and/or application standards to include payment card industry and security related testing compliance using automation and built-in security tests during development. Applies virtualization concepts to identify tests and application scenarios impacted by virtualization. Incorporates performance, load and security testing into CI environments. 
 - Works with stakeholders, business, developers and test analysts to develop more intricate test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing. Develops and administers best practices to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Works with programming to create certain account conditions and execute special testing requirements for test validation. Demonstrates a broad knowledge of the multiple environments by evaluating, interpreting and communicating an understanding of the various components of systems and applications to leadership. 
 - Acts as a single point of contact for assigned moderately complex client projects with regard to test engineering activities. Coordinates the test activities assigned to the test team to include, reviewing of client test plans cases and scripts, prioritizing test execution when necessary and providing feedback to internal and external clients. 

What Are We Looking For in This Role?

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree; additional experience in lieu of degree will be considered. 
 - Typically Minimum 4 Years Relevant Exp - Professional experience with Software testing, coding, designing, and developing. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree
 - Typically Minimum 6 Years Relevant Exp - Experience developing automated testing strategies in a variety of environments and frameworks

What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?

- Skills / Knowledge - A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization; resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented, journey-level position. 
 - Job Complexity - Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. 
 - Supervision - Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. 
 - Software Development Life Cycle / Testing Methodologies - Agile - Scrum, Kanban, Test Driven Development, Behavior Driven Development, etc. 
 - Programming Languages - Java, C#, Perl, Python, Groovy, Oracle, SQL, etc. 
 - Testing tools - Application Lifecycle Management, Unit Testing, Security, Application Programming Interface, Mobile, Continuous Integration, Service Virtualization, etc.

data.title: Data Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President
data.description:
About This Role

Data Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President

Your team

The Aladdin BlackRock Data Office (BDO) builds trusted, scalable, and governed data products that advance the firm's enterprise data strategy. ClientIQ is a strategic initiative bringing together data, analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) to power next-generation client intelligence and engagement. 

The team builds modern data and technology capabilities powering our global sales organization, partnering across engineering teams, data governance, and client teams to deliver intuitive data solutions, actionable insights, and AI-powered workflows. 

Your role and impact

In this role, you will provide hands-on technical and architectural leadership for the data capabilities underpinning ClientIQ. You will define architecture, establish engineering standards, and work closely with teams from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery and adoption. 

A critical expectation is the ability to quickly learn and leverage BlackRock's internally developed Data Platform as a Service (dPaaS) capabilities. You will champion a reuse-first approach, leveraging and extending existing platform capabilities before building new solutions. 

You will lead data engineering across structured and semi-structured data, creating trusted, reusable, and AI-ready data products that power applications, analytics, generative AI (GenAI), and agentic experiences. 

Your Responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: 

- Define and evolve ClientIQ's target-state data architecture, leveraging internal dPaaS capabilities and applying a reuse-first approach across data products, models, application programming interfaces (APIs), metadata, and shared services. 
 - Provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery, partnering across platform, product, engineering, AI, governance, and business teams. 
 - Architect the ingestion, integration, and modeling of client, product, sales, marketing, servicing, interaction, behavioral, and external data into trusted and reusable data products. 
 - Lead engineering across batch and real-time processing, distributed systems, APIs, workflow orchestration, and event streaming. 
 - Design capabilities across structured and semi-structured data that support AI-ready architectures, including document processing, semantic search, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). 
 - Embed data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, observability, security, resilience, and performance into data products and production engineering practices. 
 - Build reusable data services that power applications, analytics, AI models, agents, and downstream platforms while improving interoperability, scalability, and speed to market. 

Your Experience

- Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data architecture, distributed systems, or large-scale software engineering, including delivery of scalable enterprise data platforms and data products. 
 - Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python, Java and/or Scala, Structured Query Language (SQL), Snowflake, and data build tool (DBT), with experience across distributed processing, batch and real-time pipelines, APIs, event streaming, and data orchestration using directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing. 
 - Experience developing production data solutions using Snowflake capabilities such as Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, semi-structured data, and role-based data access controls. 
 - Experience developing transactional database solutions using Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, complex SQL, stored procedures, database programming, query optimization, and performance tuning. 
 - Ability to rapidly learn and leverage internal platforms and dPaaS capabilities, applying strong architectural judgment to balance reuse, speed, scalability, reliability, security, cost, and maintainability. 
 - Experience with AI-ready data architectures and exposure to GenAI, machine learning, semantic technologies, document processing, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, RAG, and agentic architectures. 
 - Strong knowledge of data modeling, quality, metadata, lineage, governance, security, observability, resilience, performance, production engineering, Microsoft Azure, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, containerized environments, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and infrastructure automation. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

data.title: Housekeeping Executive
data.description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone's day. When you join our Hotels team, that's exactly what you'll do every time you come to work! You will oversee the daily operations of the executive floor and lounge, ensuring that VIP guests receive exceptional service. Your leadership will ensure a flawless experience for executive-level guests, from check-in to check-out. As a Housekeeping Executive, you're not just delivering personalized and luxury guest experiences - you're spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. 

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day: 

- Leadership & Team Management: Supervise and train the executive floor team to deliver personalized VIP service. Manage scheduling, task delegation, and performance reviews. 
 - Guest Experience: Ensure VIPs and club members receive tailored service and prompt resolution of concerns. Coordinate special requests and personalized amenities for high-profile guests. 
 - Operational Oversight: Oversee daily operations of the executive floor and lounge, ensuring cleanliness, readiness, and quality F&B service. Monitor inventory and manage procurement needs. 
 - Cross-Departmental Coordination: Liaise with housekeeping, F&B, and front office to fulfill guest preferences and ensure seamless service. 
 - Training & Development: Provide ongoing training and coaching to maintain luxury service standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Reporting & Administration: Prepare daily operational reports and track guest feedback. Maintain accurate records and ensure smooth lounge operations. 

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member: 

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact. 

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

- Proven background in hotel operations, ideally in a managerial or assistant managerial role with VIP or executive floor exposure. 
 - Strong team management skills with the ability to inspire service excellence. 
 - Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; able to handle high-profile guests with discretion and professionalism. 
 - Proficient in hotel PMS and familiar with luxury service standards. 
 - Calm under pressure, responsive to changing priorities and guest needs. 
 - Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus. 
 - Flexible to work nights, weekends, and holidays. 

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don't just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests-we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we've welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality. 

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World's Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we're setting new standards for the future of travel. 

Whether you're starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career-and help us make every stay a little more magical. 

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we're more than a great place to stay-we're a great place to work.

data.title: System Analyst
data.description:
Location Name: NR Trident Tech Park

Job Purpose

Bajaj Finserv Web is a critical component of the company's omnipresence strategy. You will be working with India's largest NBFC's web technology stack, encompassing over 40 business lines and 230+ features, with nearly 500 million traffic and managing over 30, 000 webpages. 

It is an integrated platform offering a portfolio of products covering payments, cards, wallets, loans, deposits, mutual funds, and loans on lifestyle products, ranging from consumer durables to home furnishings. 

The Software Development Manager (SDM) - Full Stack leads a single POD of 5-7 developers building the experience and services layer of this platform on Next. js, React and Node JS. Reporting to the Technical Architect - Frontend, the role converts approved architecture and design system standards into production-grade full stack implementations - server rendered and statically generated pages, shared components, BFF and API integration layers - and is accountable for the POD's delivery predictability, Core Web Vitals, code quality and compliance posture. The role is expected to remain hands-on, conduct code reviews, enforce engineering standards and SOPs, and continuously raise the productivity of the POD through automation and AI-assisted engineering. 

Duties And Responsibilities

- Innovation and Engineering Productivity
 - Execute POCs to validate frameworks, rendering approaches and migration paths with clear benchmarking on performance, cost and scalability before adoption. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering within the POD - code generation, review assistance, test generation and design-to-code workflows - with measurable impact on velocity and quality and with clear guardrails on data, IP and security. 
 - Support the migration of the existing CMS rendered estate to a composable Next. js frontend for the POD's scope, ensuring zero regression on organic traffic, analytics and compliance sensitive journeys. 
 - Leverage and sponsor innovation work through internal incubators and the external start-up network to introduce novel technical capabilities into the platform. |1. Core Development and Delivery
 - Own end-to-end delivery for the POD - sprint planning, estimation, build, code review, testing, release and post-release stabilisation - for all web and in-app surfaces in scope. 
 - Translate the solution design provided by the Technical Architect into implementable low-level designs, component specifications, API and data contracts, and task breakdowns for the POD. 
 - Remain hands-on for a meaningful share of the role (target 30-40%) on Next. js and React development with TypeScript, including App Router, React Server Components, SSR, SSG, ISR and streaming. 
 - Own the POD's Node JS services and BFF layer - route handlers, API aggregation, GraphQL and REST consumption, caching, resilience patterns, timeouts and error handling. 
 - Consume and contribute to the enterprise design system and shared component library, ensuring token, theming, versioning and Storybook discipline rather than local forks and one-off components. 
 - Implement integration with headless content sources (AEM headless or other CMS/DXP), commerce and backend services through the contract layer defined by the Architect. 
 - Own state management, data fetching and form and validation architecture within the POD's applications, keeping patterns consistent with the platform standard. 
 - Own edge and caching behaviour for the POD's routes in partnership with CDN teams - cache key design, revalidation, purge strategy and origin protection across Akamai and Cloudflare. 
 - Drive release readiness through build checklists, feature flag and progressive rollout plans, deployment runbooks, rollback plans and production hypercare for every deployment. 
 - Ensure the POD's digital assets continue to perform through peak sales season by designing for auto-scale, graceful degradation and resilient rendering across the Node / SSR tier, CDN and origin. 
 - Engineering Quality and Performance Governance
 - Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, peer review, merge and promotion discipline across the POD using Git, GitHub Actions or Jenkins, and monorepo and package governance conventions. 
 - Own quality gates - SonarQube, static analysis, code coverage, bundle size checks, Lighthouse CI budgets and automated security scanning - and hold the line on defect density and escaped defects. 
 - Own the POD's Core Web Vitals outcomes (LCP, INP, CLS) including bundle analysis and code splitting, image and font strategy, hydration cost, streaming and partial prerendering, with explicit optimisation for low-end Android devices, low bandwidth networks and in-app webviews. 
 - Ensure testing coverage across unit, component, contract and end-to-end layers using Jest, Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, along with visual regression, before any release is certified. 
 - Own SEO, GEO, structured data, render parity and accessibility (WCAG 2. 2 AA) as build-time concerns for the POD rather than post-release corrections. |
 - Maintain a visible technical debt and dependency upgrade register for the POD's codebase with an agreed remediation plan, including supply chain risk across the dependency tree. 
 - Establish frontend observability for the POD - real user monitoring, synthetic checks and error tracking through New Relic, Datadog and Lighthouse CI - and act on the telemetry. 
 - POD and Team Management
 - Technical Mentorship: Provide day to day technical guidance to 5-7 developers, run design and code walkthroughs, and build depth in the POD through structured learning paths and pair programming. 
 - Performance Management: Set clear, measurable goals for every team member, conduct regular one-on-ones and reviews, give constructive feedback, and close the appraisal cycle within timelines. 
 - Capacity and Resource Planning: Allocate work across the POD based on story complexity, skill fit and individual development needs, maintain sprint velocity and utilisation, and flag capacity risks to the Technical Architect early. 
 - Talent Acquisition and Retention: Participate in hiring panels, own the technical evaluation of candidates for the POD, and run structured onboarding and ramp-up plans for new joiners, byte hires and partner resources. 
 - Partner Management: Manage in-POD vendor and partner developers to the same standard of quality, hygiene and delivery discipline as internal engineers. 
 - Team Collaboration: Build a cohesive POD with strong communication into Product, Design, Content, QA and infrastructure teams, and maintain high engagement and morale. 
 - Compliance and Security
 - Data Privacy and Security: Ensure all development within the POD complies with applicable data privacy regulation, RBI and internal information security policy, including data localisation requirements for any cloud or AI service used. 
 - Secure SDLC: Enforce secure coding practices covering the OWASP Top 10, dependency and supply chain scanning, secrets management, and timely closure of VAPT and application security findings. 
 - Browser and Client Security: Ensure correct implementation of CSP, XSS and CSRF protection, secure token and session handling in the browser, and governance of third-party scripts and tags on the POD's surfaces. 
 - Audit Readiness: Maintain traceability from requirement to code to release - approvals, change records, test evidence and deployment records - so that internal audit and regulatory reviews can be served without rework. 
 - Incident Management: Own the POD's participation in production incident response, root cause analysis and preventive action tracking, ensuring minimal customer impact. 

Key Decisions / Dimensions

Following Decisions Are Taken By The Role

- Low-level design and component design decisions within the boundaries of the architecture and design system standards approved by the Technical Architect. 
 - Rendering mode selection per route - SSR, SSG, ISR or client rendering - within the strategy defined by the Architect. 
 - Implementation approach for BFF and API integration, state management, error handling and resilience patterns for the POD's scope. 
 - Sprint scope, story sequencing, estimation and allocation of work across the 5-7 developers in the POD. 
 - Code acceptance - approval or rejection of pull requests, and the performance and quality gates that block a release. 
 - Cache key, revalidation and purge configuration for the POD's routes, in partnership with infrastructure and CDN teams. 
 - Release go / no-go recommendation for the POD, including feature flag and progressive rollout decisions, and the build checklist for every deployment. 
 - Technical debt and dependency upgrade prioritisation within the POD's backlog. 
 - Onboarding and offloading of partner and internal resources based on POD delivery requirements. 
 - Escalation of architectural exceptions, cross-POD dependencies and risks to the Technical Architect. 

Major Challenges

- Holding Core Web Vitals and conversion outcomes while delivering rich personalisation and marketing-driven change at a high release cadence. 
 - Delivering consistent experience across low-end Android devices, low bandwidth networks, in-app webviews and desktop. 
 - Sustaining design system adoption and architectural consistency within the POD when timelines push teams toward local shortcuts. 
 - Delivering a continuous release cadence across 40+ business lines while holding quality, performance and compliance standards with a POD of 5-7 developers. 
 - Working across cross-functional teams - Product, Design, Content, Data, Marketing and infrastructure - where dependencies frequently sit outside the POD's direct control. 
 - Gaining and maintaining a deep understanding of new financial products and regulatory obligations in order to build business-driven, compliant solutions. 
 - Continuously evolving systems and technologies within minimum time to manage growing business volumes and peak season traffic. 
 - Constant upskilling of the POD, including byte hires and new joiners, without losing sprint velocity. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

b) Work Experience

- Core Requirement: 5-7 years of software development experience with a minimum of 3 years hands-on on React JS and Next. js with TypeScript, plus Node JS backend or BFF development, including at least 2 years leading a team of 5 or more developers. 
 - Primary Technical Expertise: Strong command of React (hooks, context, concurrent rendering, performance profiling) and Next. js (App Router, React Server Components, SSR / SSG / ISR, middleware, route handlers, caching and revalidation). 
 - Backend and Integration: Node JS service development, BFF patterns, REST and GraphQL API design and consumption, authentication and session handling, and integration with headless CMS or DXP platforms such as AEM headless, Sanity or Contentful. 
 - Core Frontend Skills: HTML5, CSS3 and modern CSS architecture (Tailwind, CSS Modules, CSS-in-JS), semantic markup, responsive and adaptive design, cross-browser and in-app webview behaviour. 
 - Engineering Foundations: State management and data fetching patterns (TanStack Query, Zustand, Redux, SWR), form and validation architecture, and monorepo and package management discipline. 
 - Design System: Experience building or contributing to a shared component library with design tokens, theming, Storybook, versioning and semantic release across multiple teams. 
 - Performance: Demonstrable track record on Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), bundle analysis and code splitting, image and font optimisation, hydration cost reduction, streaming and partial prerendering, and performance budgets enforced in CI. 
 - Edge and Delivery: Hands-on with CDN and edge platforms (Akamai, Cloudflare), caching and purge strategy, edge functions and workers, and hosting models such as OpenNext, containerised Node or serverless. 
 - Cloud and DevOps: Experience with AWS or Azure, CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), containerisation, preview environments, trunk based development and progressive delivery with feature flags. 
 - Quality Assurance: Testing strategy across unit, component, contract and end-to-end layers (Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress), visual regression, static analysis, SonarQube and automated code review practices. 
 - System Properties: Delivering solutions that account for SEO and GEO, structured data, accessibility (A, AA, AAA), monitoring and RUM (New Relic, Datadog, Lighthouse CI), scalability, security, performance and responsive architecture. 
 - AI Engineering Depth (mandatory): Must have built with AI rather than only consumed AI tools - for example LLM-based automation, agentic coding harnesses, evaluation pipelines or design-to-code workflows - and must be able to explain design choices, guardrails and measured outcomes. 
 - Ways of Working: Agile and Scaled Agile delivery, DevSecOps practices, and a continuous improvement mindset; experience with JIRA or Azure DevOps. 
 - Domain: BFSI, Fintech or Ecommerce experience is strongly preferred, with an understanding of security, risk and compliance management in a regulated delivery environment, and familiarity with the digital marketing, MarTech and analytics landscape. 
 - Leadership: Proven ability to mentor developers, run performance conversations, manage partner resources and drive delivery predictability within a POD. 

Skill Keywords

Next. js, React JS, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Node JS, Server-Side Rendering, React Server Components, SSG, ISR, Streaming, BFF, GraphQL, REST APIs, Headless CMS, AEM Headless, Sanity, Contentful, Design Systems, Component Libraries, Storybook, Monorepo, Tailwind, Core Web Vitals, Web Performance Optimisation, Accessibility (WCAG), SEO, GEO, CDN and Edge Computing (Akamai, Cloudflare), AWS, Azure, DevOps and CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Test Automation (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), SonarQube, Feature Flags, New Relic, Datadog, RUM, OWASP Top 10, CSP, Secure SDLC, Agile / Scrum, Team Leadership, Code Review, Technical Debt Management, AI-Assisted Engineering, GitHub Copilot, Agentic Coding.

data.title: FBS Agile dev Team Member I - Testing
data.description:
FBS - Farmer Business Services is part of Farmers operations with the purpose of building a global approach to identifying, recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent. By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today's competitive marketplace. 

We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in-helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results. 

Since we don't have a local legal entity, we've partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits. 

Requirements

Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Agile Dev Team Member I with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using basic coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with frequent support and guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member I with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements. Define and execute tests early, often, and at multiple levels. Based on business products, processes and system knowledge, provides basic level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems utilizing simple testing techniques and tools. The Agile Dev Team Member I will rarely work on more than one type of task and limited in to consistently pull the next highest priority work item. 

- Demonstrates understanding to customer needs by interpreting basic process or system solutions and providing input into system design. 
 - Effectively writes and refines user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria. 
 - Performs basic impact assessment relating people, processes and/or technology, and estimates user stories using relative sizing of story points. 
 - Partners with the Product Owner to confirm code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality
 - Demonstrates understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality. 

Agile Dev Team Member I with primarily a development discipline: 

- Demonstrates entry level developer skills with basic ability to code instructions for computer programs and limited ability to configure packaged software
 - Documents and implements programs according to standards and conventions with guidance from senior team members. Performs basic quality checks of program code, related objects and documentation
 - Delivers working code each sprint. Agile Dev Team Member I with primarily a testing discipline: Analyzes system and business requirements for testability. 
 - Identifies common errors that occur in standard application testing. Develops, documents, executes, and maintains test cases and test data. 
 - Reports status of test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system. Defines basic test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage. 
 - Analyzes test results and assists with trouble-shooting and root cause analysis. Utilizes basic testing tools and executes basic data creation tools. 
 - Demonstrates ability to read automation test results. Demonstrates understanding and applies concepts of Risk Based Testing. 
 - Demonstrates limited ability to write test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation. 
 - Supports application development, implementation, and user training activities, as required. 
 - Participates in key ceremonies to drive execution, improve flow and ensure transparency with guidance from a senior team member. 
 - Plans work via the preparation for and participation in Program Increment (PI) Planning and Sprint Planning, including the development and committing to Team PI Objectives and Sprint goals. 
 - Demonstrates working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos
 - Actively participates in the Sprint Retrospectives and Inspect & Adapt to timely discuss opportunities for improvement and are responsible for carrying out the execution of improvement stories. 
 - Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions. 
 - Demonstrates ongoing desire for continuous improvement and building knowledge in area of expertise. 
 - Actively seeks out development opportunities to develop T-shaped skills and become a cross-functional contributor. 
 - Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps. 
 - Offers innovative ideas within area of focus to improve processes. 
 - Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP). Can facilitate CoP sessions with guidance from leadership and/or peers

Benefits

Competitive compensation and benefits package: 

- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
 - Comprehensive benefits package
 - Career development and training opportunities
 - Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
 - Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
 - Private Health Insurance
 - Pension Plan
 - Paid Time Off
 - Training & Development

data.description:
About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. 

Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate distributed platform services and APIs using Java and Python, applied

against Kubernetes or equivalent cloud-native infrastructure. 

- Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous platform

problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term

durability before writing a line of code. 

- Flex into data engineering work when needed: contribute directly to Spark-based data pipelines and

processing jobs, working comfortably in GDF's data engineering codebase alongside platform work. 

- Build AI, GenAI, and agentic-powered platform capabilities: intelligent developer tooling, workflow

automation, agentic services, and AI-assisted operational tooling (monitoring, incident triage, capacity

planning). 

- Own platform reliability, scalability, and observability - service-level objectives, distributed tracing, 

alerting, and incident response for services you build, with a strong Operational Excellence /

Engineering Excellence discipline. 

- Guide architecture and system design decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and

enterprise integrations, with an explicit eye toward how platform choices affect downstream data

engineering workloads. 

- Partner with data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to ensure platform services expose the

right primitives for data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving paths. 

- Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and

production readiness reviews for a team building process from scratch. 

- As a Staff engineer, set technical direction and best practices within your team and technical domain

without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDF's broader platform

engineering standards. 

- Continuously evaluate emerging platform, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them

pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and

operating large-scale distributed platforms; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required -

comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code, not just directing others. Additional

experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 

- Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a

nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, 

proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not

bolted on afterward. 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or

equivalent practical experience. 

- Deep experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API

design, service contracts, and enterprise system integration - backed by strong system design, 

domain-oriented design (DDD), and low-level design (LLD) skills, with demonstrated ownership of

production code and the judgment to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost. 

- Deep understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or

equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 

- Strong exposure to Big Data / data engineering technologies - Spark required at a working level, with

familiarity in Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, or Kafka - enough to flex into data engineering work confidently, not

just integrate with it from a distance. 

- Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and

GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step

autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices

(feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 

- Strong knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, 

alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale systems. 

- Strong grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, 

authorization, data protection, and secure API design. 

- Proven ability to translate ambiguous technical/business problems into clear execution plans, 

particularly within a newly formed team without fully established process. 

- Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with high autonomy in a

0-to-1 environment. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

data.title: Specialist Software Engineer ( AI Architect , Developement )
data.description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. 

Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder (SPARK)

So, what's the role all about?

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. We are looking for the senior technical voice and hands-on builder at its core. 

As Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder, you will set the technical direction for SPARK and build alongside the team. You will advise on the tech stack, choose the patterns and tools we standardise on, and write the code for flagship prototypes yourself. You will also advise business and technology leaders on what is feasible, what is wise, and what to build next. 

This is a consultative and autonomous role. You are comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, making sound technical decisions with minimal supervision, and explaining your reasoning to engineers and executives alike. You will be the senior technical lead for the SPARK AI Architects & Builders. 

How will you make an impact?

You will own the technical architecture of SPARK and the quality of what it ships, from the first prototype to the enterprise-grade tool, working hands-on with the Technical AI Architect & Builder, the Business Analyst, and NiCE's platform, security, and architecture teams. 

Set Technical Direction

- Recommend and own the SPARK tech stack: models and providers, agent and orchestration frameworks, retrieval and vector storage, integration patterns, and developer tooling
 - Make build-versus-buy and platform-versus-custom decisions, and record them in clear architecture decision records
 - Define reference architectures and reusable patterns so every new idea starts from a paved path instead of a blank page
 - Track the fast-moving AI landscape and bring forward the models, tools, and protocols worth adopting
 - Ensure build allows tools to be migrated easily. 
 - Always ensure cost optimization is included into the design. 

Build Hands-On

- Design and build agentic AI solutions, including tool use, multi-step reasoning, memory, multi-agent coordination, and human-in-the-loop controls
 - Build RAG pipelines and integrations with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365, using APIs and MCP
 - Ensure solution design incorporates NiCE guidelines on Ethics, Risk, compliance
 - Review data and infrastructure readiness of the solutions
 - Write clean, tested, documented code that others can pick up and extend
 - Turn ideas into working prototypes quickly, and into demonstrable value for the business teams who proposed them

Take Prototypes to Enterprise Grade

- Define what enterprise-grade means for SPARK: security, access control, privacy, reliability, scalability, observability, and cost
 - Harden prototypes for global rollout, including CI/CD, automated tests, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, and rollback
 - Establish LLM evaluation practices: test sets, regression tests, hallucination checks, and quality dashboards
 - Work with Security, Legal, and Architecture teams to embed responsible AI and data protection requirements into every design

Advise and Lead

- Act as trusted technical adviser to business teams, the Project Manager, and senior leaders on feasibility, trade-offs, effort, and risk
 - Review designs and code, mentor the Technical AI Architect & Builder, and raise the engineering bar across the team
 - Work with minimal supervision, flag risks early, and make good decisions when requirements are still moving
 - Collaborate with NiCE's internal/ external AI platform and architecture teams so SPARK solutions fit the wider enterprise AI strategy

Have you got what it takes?

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (Master's preferred), or equivalent experience
 - 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years designing and delivering LLM-powered or agentic AI systems in production
 - Expert, hands-on skills in Python and/or TypeScript; you are still a developer who writes code every week
 - Deep experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent), tool-integration protocols such as MCP, and RAG architectures with vector databases
 - Strong working knowledge of LLM providers and APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, and open-source models), including prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation
 - Experience with at least one major cloud AI ecosystem (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and with REST API, event-driven, and microservice design
 - Strong grasp of security, privacy, and responsible AI practices for enterprise systems
 - Proven ability to work independently, advise stakeholders, and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to executives and non-technical colleagues
 - Fluency in English

You will have an advantage if you also have: 

- Experience in an AI centre of excellence, innovation lab, or internal incubator
 - Experience with Cognigy, NiCE CXone, or other CCaaS and conversational AI platforms, including voice AI
 - Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Atlassian, and Microsoft 365
 - Experience with LLMOps: evaluation frameworks, observability (OpenTelemetry), prompt registries, and cost governance
 - Experience fine-tuning or evaluating open-source models
 - Experience with workflow applications such as N8N or similar
 - Have developed market ready software applications
 - Fluency in foreign language; German would be a plus, for close collaboration with Forward Deployment Cognigy team in Germany. 

What's in it for you?

SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world. 

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere. 

Requisition ID: 11874

Reporting into: VP , Business Operations , Sales Ops

Role Type : Individual Contributor

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25, 000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. 

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8, 500 employees across 30+ countries. 

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

data.title: Quality Manager - Data & AI
data.description:
At Hilti, we are building data-driven products, advanced analytics, and AI solutions that support critical business decisions. We are looking for a Quality & Risk Manager, Data & AI to establish and continuously improve quality, governance, and risk management practices across our Data & Analytics ecosystem. 

This is not a traditional software QA or testing role. The position will serve as a strategic quality and risk partner to Data Science, Data Engineering, Architecture, Product, and business teams, ensuring that quality, trust, governance, compliance, and risk management are embedded throughout the lifecycle of data and AI products. 

The Quality & Risk Manager will establish and evolve frameworks for Quality Management, Data Governance, and Risk Management across data products, analytics solutions, data platforms, APIs, machine learning models, and AI applications. 

The role will help teams proactively identify and manage quality and operational risks, establish appropriate controls, define measurable quality expectations, and ensure that Data & AI solutions are designed with quality rather than inspected for quality after delivery. 

What You'll Do

Quality Management & Governance

- Establish and continuously improve the Quality Management framework for Data & Analytics. 
 - Define quality principles, standards, controls, quality gates, and assurance practices across the data product lifecycle. 
 - Embed quality considerations into architecture, design, development, release, and operational processes. 
 - Drive adoption of quality standards and promote a strong quality culture across Data & Analytics teams. 
 - Partner with teams to identify systemic quality issues, root causes, improvement opportunities, and preventive actions. 
 - Define and monitor meaningful Quality KPIs and provide transparent reporting on quality performance and trends. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of relevant experience across Quality Management, Risk Management, Data Quality, Data Governance, Software Quality, Data Engineering, Analytics, or related disciplines. 
 - Demonstrated experience establishing or improving quality, governance, or risk management frameworks, rather than only executing testing activities. 
 - Strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, including data pipelines, data warehouses/lakes, APIs, analytics platforms, and cloud environments. 
 - Experience applying risk-based approaches to quality and governance. 
 - Ability to work effectively with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Architects, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and senior leadership. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate complex technical risks into clear business impact. 
 - Strong communication, facilitation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Experience defining meaningful metrics, controls, KPIs, and management reporting. 

What's In It for You

- Experience working directly within Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or advanced analytics environments. 
 - Experience with Data Governance and Data Quality frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with AI governance, Responsible AI, and AI risk management principles. 
 - Knowledge of relevant management systems or frameworks such as ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO 31000, or NIST AI RMF. 
 - Experience with cloud data and analytics technologies, particularly Azure and/or AWS. 
 - Understanding of privacy, information security, regulatory, and compliance considerations applicable to data and AI products. 
 - Experience establishing or operating risk registers, control frameworks, quality gates, or governance boards. 

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34, 000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we're driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you'll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you'll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork. 

Commitment to Inclusion

At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

Job Description: Test Architect

Location: Mumbai, India (Preferred - Hybrid)

Experience: 10-11 Years

About Straive (LearningMate)

Straive (LearningMate) is a global technology company focused on helping education institutions and corporations build, manage, and deliver digital learning experiences. For over 20 years, we've been at the forefront of educational innovation, leveraging digital, cloud, and AI solutions to reshape how the world learns. 

Job Summary

We are looking for an enthusiastic, hands-on Test Architect with 10-11 years of experience to join our engineering leadership team in Mumbai. In this pivotal role, you will own the test automation architecture, lead the transition from manual to automated testing, establish portfolio-wide quality standards, and champion AI-first quality engineering across our product delivery pods. 

You will combine deep technical expertise in Playwright and Selenium with a proactive learning mindset and day-to-day, hands-on usage of AI tools and approaches to accelerate test design, code generation, and defect analysis. Exceptional communication skills are essential, as you will review existing architectures, recommend scalable improvements, track critical QA metrics across the portfolio, and partner closely with the broader QA competency to put standardized best practices in place. 

Key Responsibilities

- Automation Framework Design: Architect and deploy an enterprise-grade, multi-tier test automation framework across front-end single-page applications (React/TypeScript), microservices API gateways (Java/Node. js), and database pipelines. 
 - Manual-to-Automation QA Transformation: Drive the cultural and technical transition from manual test execution to an automated-first QA culture, establishing test design patterns, script standards, and automation coverage benchmarks across all delivery pods. 
 - AI-First Daily QA Execution: Actively integrate AI tools, generative coding co-pilots, and AI-driven testing engines into your day-to-day workflow to synthesize test scenarios, accelerate automation script development, self-heal brittle locators, and optimize regression sweeps. 
 - Test Architecture & Technical Reviews: Conduct deep-dive architectural reviews of test automation frameworks across web, API, and microservices layers. Identify bottlenecks, technical debt, and coverage gaps, and recommend scalable architectural improvements. 
 - Hands-On Automation Engineering: Maintain real, hands-on involvement in writing, refactoring, and optimizing core automation frameworks and proof-of-concepts using Playwright and Selenium (with TypeScript, JavaScript, or Java). 
 - QA Standards & Competency Alignment: Collaborate closely with the central QA competency to define, document, and institutionalize standardized testing frameworks, AI usage guidelines, coding patterns, and CI/CD quality gates across all project teams. 
 - Portfolio QA Metrics & Governance: Establish, track, and report on portfolio-wide QA metrics (such as automation coverage, defect leakage, test execution stability, and AI efficiency gains) to leadership and stakeholders to drive data-backed quality decisions. 
 - Continuous Innovation & Mentorship: Stay at the forefront of emerging AI testing methodologies and tools, fostering a culture of curiosity, continuous learning, and technical excellence across QA teams. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- Experience: 10-11 years of progressive experience in software quality assurance and test automation, with a proven track record operating in a Lead QA or Test Architect capacity. 
 - Core Automation Mastery: Real, hands-on coding and architectural expertise in both Playwright and Selenium WebDriver across modern web applications (such as React/TypeScript SPAs). 
 - Hands-On AI Testing Proficiency: Practical, daily experience using AI tools and approaches in software testing-such as generative coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor), AI-powered test case generation, visual AI testing, or LLM prompt/output validation. 
 - API, Database & CI/CD Integration: Strong experience architecting automated API test suites (RESTful services, Postman, RestAssured), validating database pipelines, and integrating automated regression suites into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins). 
 - Transformation & Metrics Governance: Demonstrated experience transitioning manual QA teams to automation-first workflows, defining KPIs, tracking portfolio-level quality metrics, and rolling out standardized QA processes across multiple Agile/Scrum teams. 

Mindset & Soft Skills: 

- Exceptional Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence engineering teams, present metrics to leadership, and mentor QA engineers. 
 - Growth & Learning Attitude: An enthusiastic, curious, and adaptable self-starter who actively experiments with new AI tools, frameworks, and modern engineering practices. 

Job Overview & Location Parameters

- Experience Range: 10-11 Years
 - Location: Mumbai preferred (Hybrid work model; open to exceptional remote candidates within India)
 - Key Focus Areas: Multi-Tier Automation Framework Design, Manual-to-Automation Transformation, Hands-On AI Testing Approaches, Architecture Reviews, Playwright & Selenium, QA Competency Standards, and Portfolio Metrics

 - A live dashboard tracking inbound and outbound pipeline performance. 
 - Demonstrable improvements in lead response time, qualified opportunities, and sales productivity. What You'll Get

data.description:
Company Description Deep Holistics is a science-driven health and wellness company that uses advanced diagnostics and technology to deliver hyper-personalized care. By integrating data from blood biomarkers, gut microbiome, genetic testing, and wearable devices, the team provides a comprehensive view of each person's health. This interconnected approach enables root-cause analysis and actionable recommendations to help individuals prevent, manage, and control health concerns while optimizing daily performance. Clients receive an in-depth health blueprint, tailored lifestyle and supplement guidance, continuous monitoring through smart devices and an app, and year-long access to a dedicated panel of health experts. Deep Holistics is committed to giving people greater agency over their health through data, insight, and long-term support. 

Role Description The Lab Quality & Operations Manager is a full-time, on-site position based in Bangalore Urban. We are looking for a Lab Operations & Projects Manager to lead the lab setup and day-to-day lab operations. You will coordinate between the lab consultants, the design and tech teams, and operations, and make sure projects are delivered on time and to quality standards. 

What you'll do?

- Act as the single point of contact for the Lab Project Consultant, the Signing Authority (Pathologist/MD) and the Operations team.   
 - Coordinate approvals and sign-offs for SOPs, method validations, reference ranges and report formats. 
 - Work with the design and tech teams to coordinate the build of the lab software (LIS)  
 - Gather and document lab workflow requirements and convert them into clear briefs for the tech team. 
 - Manage the middleware vendor, track integration progress and resolve issues. 
 - Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) with lab staff before every software release. 
 - Plan and manage the launch of new biomarkers and test panels, from evaluation and validation to go-live. 
 - Handle procurement of instruments, reagents and consumables in coordination with vendors and finance. 
 - Lead NABL (ISO 15189) accreditation preparation, documentation and audits, and maintain compliance after accreditation. 
 - Set up and maintain the quality system: SOPs, document control, training records, internal audits and CAPA. 
 - Track and report lab KPIs such as turnaround time (TAT), sample rejection rate, repeat rate, QC pass rate and cost per test. 
 - Coordinate with phlebotomy, operations and the physician team to make sure lab issues do not delay member reports or consults. 
 - Share weekly progress reports with the reporting manager and monthly reviews with leadership. 
What we're looking for?

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Medical Lab Technology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, MBBS, BDS or a related field. 
 - MBA or a degree in Hospital/Healthcare Management is preferred. 
 - 3-5 years of experience, with at least 2-3 years in a diagnostic lab, hospital or health-tech company. 
 - Proven experience managing projects with multiple stakeholders, consultants and vendors. 
 - Good understanding of clinical lab workflows, quality control and NABL requirements. 
 - Experience working with tech or product teams on software implementation (LIS/HIS preferred).

data.title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs. 

Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. 

Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks. 

Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant. 

Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment. 

Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity. 

Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams. 

Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams. 

5. Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function. 

Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services. 

Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows. 

Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms. 

Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation. 

Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services. 

Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management. 

6. Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication. 

The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities. 

Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis's product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

data.description:
Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
