Employment type: Full-time

Our client - an Artificial Intelligence (AI) focused IT Services company that helps Enterprises discover and implement Artificial Intelligence enabled solutions to improve business processes and supplant 'human effort with human intuition - is seeking to hire an experienced C3 Platform Engineer. 

Role overview

We are hiring a C3 Platform Engineer to keep our C3 AI platform deployments stable, performant and secure in production. You will own root cause analysis (RCA) for platform incidents, diagnose and resolve network issues across cloud and cluster layers, and run the Kubernetes infrastructure the platform depends on. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Root cause analysis and incident management

- Lead RCA for production incidents on the C3 platform, tracing failures across application, data, network and infrastructure layers. 
 - Write clear, blameless RCA reports with timelines, contributing factors and corrective actions, and track those actions to closure. 
 - Participate in an on-call rotation and act as escalation point for complex platform issues. 
 - Identify recurring failure patterns and drive permanent fixes rather than workarounds. Network troubleshooting

- Triage and resolve network issues affecting the platform, including DNS resolution, load balancer and ingress failures, TLS/certificate errors, latency and packet loss. 
 - Diagnose connectivity problems across VPCs/VNets, private endpoints, firewalls, security groups, NAT and VPN links. 
 - Debug Kubernetes networking: CNI behaviour, service discovery, network policies and pod-to-pod or pod-to-external traffic. 
 - Use tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, dig, curl, traceroute and mtr to isolate faults quickly. Kubernetes and platform operations

- Deploy, upgrade, scale and maintain Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS or GKE) hosting C3 platform services. 
 - Manage workloads with Helm, configure resource limits, autoscaling, and node pools for reliability and cost. 
 - Troubleshoot pod failures (CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, scheduling and storage issues) and cluster-level problems. 
 - Maintain the C3 platform environments, including configuration, upgrades, package deployments and environment health. Observability, automation and reliability

- Build and tune monitoring, logging and alerting (e. g. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog) to catch issues before users do. 
 - Automate infrastructure and operational tasks using Terraform, CI/CD pipelines and scripting. 
 - Define and track SLOs, and contribute to capacity planning and disaster recovery testing. 
 - Maintain runbooks and share knowledge with application, data science and support teams. 

Required Skills & Qualifications: 

- 4-8 years in platform, DevOps, SRE or cloud infrastructure engineering, with at least 2 years running production Kubernetes. 
 - Hands-on experience with the C3 AI platform (deployment, configuration, environment management or troubleshooting). 
 - Proven track record of leading RCA for production incidents and documenting findings. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, load balancing, routing, subnets and firewalls. 
 - Deep Kubernetes knowledge: kubectl, Helm, ingress controllers, services, network policies, RBAC, persistent storage. 
 - Experience with at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) and its networking services. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux administration and scripting in Bash or Python.

data.title: Performance Test Lead
data.description:
Summary: 

We are building a performance testing lab for our NDC APIs (airline shopping and ordering at scale). You will own how we test: production-based benchmarks, realistic workloads, automated load runs, and clear reporting to engineers and leadership. The role is tool-agnostic. Hands-on performance testing is a must; performance engineering (process dumps, profiling) is a plus. 

Key responsibilities: 

- Benchmarks and workloads: derive p95 / p99, throughput and error-rate benchmarks per airline from production data, scale them to the test environment, and model realistic workloads, including past-incident scenarios. 
 - Test execution: plan and run load, stress, soak and spike tests under repeatable, recorded conditions. 
 - Automation: build reusable, version-controlled scripts and a CI/CD pipeline that runs tests on demand and flags regressions against baselines. 
 - Virtualization and observability: decide which third parties to simulate; set up dashboards that correlate load with system behaviour and separate our time from third-party latency. 
 - Analysis: find bottlenecks with evidence, explain them plainly, and prove fixes by rerunning the same workload. 

Must-have skills: 

- Hands-on performance testing of high-volume APIs or distributed systems. 
 - Expert in at least one load tool (JMeter, k6 or similar): correlation, parameterization, distributed load. 
 - Workload modelling from production data; sound use of percentiles, throughput, concurrency and saturation. 
 - Correlating results with metrics, logs and traces to find where time is spent. 
 - Test data strategy and service virtualization for external dependencies. 
 - CI/CD integration and scripting (Python, Groovy, JavaScript or Bash); cloud experience, AWS preferred. 
 - Clear communication with engineers and senior leaders

Experience & Qualification: 

- 6-8 years minimum in performance testing, including 2+ years leading a workstream or mentoring. 
 - At least one performance improvement proven with before / after evidence at production scale. 
 - Degree in computer science, engineering or equivalent experience. 
 - Evidence-driven, builds for handover, and works well across Engineering, CloudOps, Product and vendors.

data.title: Senior Test Engineer - Advantest 93K
data.description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Senior Test Engineer with 5-10 years of hands-on experience in semiconductor testing using the Advantest V93000 (93K) ATE platform. The ideal candidate will be responsible for Digital, Analog & Mixed Signal test program development, validation, characterization, production support, and yield improvement for Digital, Analog & mixed-signal semiconductor devices. The role spans all phases of the test engineering lifecycle - from test plan development and hardware design through software development, silicon bring-up, debug, correlation, and sustaining support. 

The engineer will work within a high-performing global cross-functional team and will interface directly with design, characterization, product engineering, and customer teams. As an early member of Anora's expanding Bangalore center, this position offers career growth and visibility unmatched in larger organizations. 

  

Key ResponsibilitiesATE Test Program Development - Advantest 93K

•          Develop, debug, and maintain Digital, Analog & Mixed Signal production test programs on the Advantest V93000 platform. 

•          Design and implement test methodologies for digital devices such as microcontrollers (MCUs), microprocessors (MPUs), ASICs, SoCs, FPGAs, memory interfaces, and high-speed digital ICs using 93K test resources. 

•          Write test flows and Test Methods using the 93K test framework (C++/Java-based); manage revision control and participate in code reviews. 

•          Develop and validate test limits based on datasheet specifications and characterization data. 

•          Perform test time optimization using parallelism, concurrent testing, and time-domain multiplexing techniques

•          Perform device characterization, correlation, and production release activities. 

•          Develop and optimize test solutions to improve test coverage, reduce test time, and maximize production yield. 

•          Analyze test data and identify root causes of yield excursions and failures. 

•          Support NPI (New Product Introduction) activities from characterization through high-volume manufacturing. 

•          Develop and maintain hardware interface documentation, test specifications, and release packages. 

•          Troubleshoot ATE hardware, Digital, DC & Analog/Mixed signal instrumentation, load boards, and probe cards. 

•          Participate in GR&R, correlation studies, guard-banding, and test limit optimization. 

•          Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to test efficiency, quality, and manufacturing productivity. 

•          Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior test engineers. 

Mixed-Signal Test Engineering

•          Develop ATE-based test solutions for ADCs, DACs, LDOs, op-amps, comparators, and voltage references on 93K. 

○          ADC/DAC: SNR, SFDR, THD, DNL, INL, ENOB measurements using coherent and non-coherent DSP methods. 

○          LDO/PMIC: Load regulation, line regulation, PSRR, transient response, quiescent current. 

○          Op-Amp/Comparator: Offset voltage, CMRR, PSRR, slew rate, bandwidth, noise spectral density. 

•          Implement DSP-based signal analysis including FFT, windowing, and curve-fitting algorithms for analog characterization. 

•          Ensure measurement accuracy and guard-banding through careful noise floor analysis and DUT board design. 

Hardware - Load Board & Interface Design

•          Design, review, and debug DUT load boards (DIBs) for the Advantest 93K including analog signal routing, power planes, bypass/decoupling, and shielding. 

•          Define and validate analog/power interface circuits: current sense resistors, bulk capacitors, inductors, current mirrors. 

•          Perform load board schematic review and layout guideline definition in collaboration with PCB design teams. 

•          Characterize load board parasitic (trace inductance, capacitance) and apply compensation in the test plan. 

•          Set up and validate contactors, sockets, and probe cards; perform contact resistance and leakage checks. 

Test Correlation & Characterization

•          Perform ATE-to-bench correlation for all critical parameters; analyze and reduce correlation deltas. 

•          Support product characterization and process corner analysis (SS, TT, FF) across temperature and voltage. 

•          Execute guard-band analysis and set production test limits to balance yield and quality (DPPM targets). 

•          Analyze parametric distributions, generate SPC charts, and track yield trends over product lifetime. 

Sustaining & Yield Improvement

•          Investigate and resolve production yield excursions, test escapes, and outlier failures. 

•          Perform failure analysis in collaboration with design and product engineering teams. 

•          Drive continuous test time reduction and hardware cost optimization for high-volume production. 

•          Maintain test program and documentation changes through a formal ECO / change control process. 

Requirements & Skills•          Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering. 

•          5-10 years of semiconductor test engineering experience. 

•          Strong expertise in Advantest V93000 (93K) ATE platform. 

•          Experience with SmarTest development environment. 

•          Strong understanding of Digital, Analog and Mixed signal fundamentals and measurement techniques. 

•          Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. 

•          Ability to analyze large datasets and identify yield/performance trends. 

ATE Platform & Test Environment

•          Experience with Advantest instruments such as, FVI16, AVI64, PS1600/PS5000, DPS128/64/XPS256, etc. ). 

•          Programming experience in C/C++, Java, Python, or Perl. 

•          Familiarity with semiconductor characterization tools and data analysis software. 

•          Understanding of statistical process control (SPC), DOE, and yield enhancement methodologies. 

•          Experience with probe and final test environments. 

•          Knowledge of mixed-signal and high-speed digital testing is a plus. 

•          Version control using SVN/Git. 

Tools & Systems

•          Experience with EDA tools for schematic review (Allegro, Altium, or KiCad). 

•          Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, or equivalent tools for project tracking and documentation. 

•          Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing flow: wafer sort, final test, burn-in, and qualification (AEC-Q100 / JEDEC). 

Soft Skills & Attributes

•          Strong debugging and analytical mindset with systematic root-cause analysis approach. 

•          Clear written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional collaboration with global teams. 

•          Self-driven, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. 

•          Open-minded team player with a 'can-do' attitude and willingness to take ownership.

Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Subsidiary: 

PayPal

0

Category:

Job Description: 

CGI Advantage is a large enterprise product portfolio supporting complex government operations across Financials, HRM/Payroll, Procurement, Framework, Analytics and related capabilities. 

As we evolve our Product Engineering organization toward stronger end-to-end Build & Run accountability, we are looking for a Director - Product Engineering Capability to build and sustain the functional, domain and specialist capabilities required across the Advantage portfolio. 

The Director will be accountable for ensuring that Advantage has the right capability, in the right roles, at the right level of maturity, when the business needs it. The role will establish common capability standards, strengthen domain and functional depth, build leadership and specialist pipelines, reduce critical-person dependencies and enable scarce expertise to be leveraged effectively across products. 

This is not a traditional learning or training role. It is a senior Product Engineering leadership position working closely with Product Engineering Directors, Product Leaders and functional leaders to ensure that the organization has the capability required to deliver product outcomes today while building the skills required for the future. 

Your future duties and responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Capability Strategy & Workforce Readiness

- Define the capability strategy and operating model across critical Product Engineering roles including functional/product roles, business analysis, domain SMEs, solution architecture and specialist engineering disciplines. 
 - Translate product strategy, roadmap, modernization, SaaS, cloud and AI priorities into future capability requirements. 
 - Develop product- and portfolio-level capability maps identifying critical skills, capacity risks, succession gaps and future capability needs. 
 - Ensure persistent/core capabilities and shared specialist capabilities are appropriately identified and developed. 

Role & Competency Model

- Establish clear role charters, competency expectations and proficiency models for critical roles. 
 - Create consistent expectations across Product Lines while allowing appropriate domain specialization. 
 - Define career and progression pathways that build deep functional, domain and technical expertise. 

Talent Depth & Succession

- Build strong pipelines for critical roles and reduce dependence on individual experts. 
 - Drive succession and readiness planning for business-critical positions. 
 - Enable mobility of talent and specialist expertise across Product Lines. 
 - Partner with Engineering Directors and leadership on build/buy/borrow decisions for emerging capability requirements. 

Capability Excellence & Communities

- Establish and strengthen communities of practice and capability forums across Advantage. 
 - Drive common methods, standards, reusable patterns, templates, accelerators and knowledge assets. 
 - Promote adoption of leading engineering, solutioning, analysis and product practices across teams. 
 - Ensure lessons and capabilities developed in one Product Line can be effectively leveraged across the broader portfolio. 

Transformation & Future Skills

- Lead capability transformation required for the evolving Build & Run model. 
 - Accelerate skills in AI-assisted engineering, cloud/SaaS, automation, modern architecture, product engineering and data-driven delivery. 
 - Identify opportunities where capability improvements can materially improve quality, productivity, predictability and engineering effectiveness. 
 - Create mechanisms for rapidly developing and scaling new capabilities as technology and market needs evolve. 

Partnership with Product Engineering

- Partner closely with Product Engineering Directors to understand capability demand and delivery challenges. 
 - Ensure capability development remains grounded in real Product Engineering outcomes rather than becoming a centralized or theoretical function. 
 - Support product organizations with the right specialist capability while avoiding unnecessary organizational hand-offs or approval layers. 
 - Provide transparent visibility into capability health, gaps, risks and readiness. 

Capability Measurement

- Establish a capability health framework and measurable indicators. 
 - Track areas such as critical-role coverage, proficiency maturity, succession readiness, capability-gap closure, specialist availability, mobility and reduction in key-person dependencies. 
 - Demonstrate tangible impact of capability initiatives on engineering quality, productivity and organizational effectiveness. 

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Must to have skill: 

- Typically 18+ years of experience in enterprise product engineering, software/product organizations, technology consulting or equivalent environments. 
 - Significant leadership experience in a large, complex, multi-product engineering organization. 
 - Demonstrated experience building capabilities, practices, CoEs, engineering excellence organizations or cross-product competency models. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise software/product development across the lifecycle - product definition, architecture, analysis, engineering, quality and production support. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work across both functional / domain and technology disciplines. 
 - Experience developing senior specialists, architects, functional leaders, domain experts or engineering leaders. 
 - Strong track record influencing senior stakeholders in a matrix organization. 
 - Experience driving organizational transformation and establishing new operating models. 
 - Exposure to enterprise SaaS, cloud modernization, AI-enabled engineering and contemporary product-development practices strongly preferred. 
 - ERP, government solutions or large mission-critical enterprise-platform experience would be advantageous, but is not mandatory. 

Good to have skills: 

The successful candidate should be someone who: 

- thinks several years ahead about capability rather than simply responding to today's staffing needs; 
 - has enough credibility with Engineering Directors and architects to challenge them constructively; 
 - equally values functional / domain depth and engineering excellence; 
 - can create standards without creating bureaucracy; 
 - develops strong specialist leaders rather than centralizing expertise around themselves; 
 - is comfortable working through influence in a matrix; 
 - uses evidence and data to identify capability risks; 
 - understands that capability development must ultimately translate into better product outcomes. 

CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs. 

Together, as owners, let's turn meaningful insights into action. 

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you'll reach your full potential because. . . 

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That's why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company's strategy and direction. 

Your work creates value. You'll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. 

You'll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You'll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons. 

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals. 

Come join our team-one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Role Description

ob Description: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

Experience: 7+ Years

Role: Senior Site Reliability Engineer

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to own and improve the reliability of mission-critical, multi-region workloads running on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). 

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role focused on cloud infrastructure, platform reliability, automation, observability, incident management, CI/CD modernization, security, and resilience. 

The successful candidate will lead major incidents, define and manage Service Level Objectives (SLOs), modernize delivery pipelines, build comprehensive observability solutions, reduce operational toil through automation, and collaborate with engineering, product, application, and security teams to improve overall platform reliability. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

- Operate and troubleshoot multi-region Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) workloads. 
 - Manage node pools, Workload Identity, Istio, Anthos Service Mesh, ingress/egress, and Private Service Connect across multiple environments. 
 - Manage cloud projects, networking, IAM, and workload configurations using Terraform, Terragrunt, and Helm. 
 - Deliver infrastructure changes through pull-request workflows and automated deployment pipelines. 
 - Design secure, scalable, and reusable platform patterns for application teams. 

CI/CD & Delivery Automation

- Implement, extend, and troubleshoot GitHub Actions, reusable workflows, OIDC authentication, and ArgoCD GitOps deployment processes. 
 - Lead the modernization and migration of legacy Jenkins pipelines to secure CI/CD workflows. 
 - Implement appropriate quality and security gates within delivery pipelines. 
 - Champion engineering practices including trunk-based development, semantic versioning, canary releases, and blue-green deployments. 

Observability, SLOs & Incident Management

- Design and maintain APM, distributed tracing, infrastructure monitoring, log monitoring, synthetic monitoring, and SLO-based monitoring. 
 - Develop operational and executive dashboards using Datadog or equivalent observability platforms. 
 - Correlate telemetry and trace data across cloud logging and observability platforms. 
 - Act as Incident Commander for P1/P2 production incidents, coordinating technical investigation, rollback, traffic shifting, recovery, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Coordinate incident activities using platforms such as PagerDuty and ServiceNow. 
 - Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and blameless post-incident reviews. 
 - Define golden-signal SLIs and SLOs and monitor error-budget burn rates. 
 - Use error budgets to support release decisions and prioritize reliability improvements. 

Production Troubleshooting & Software Engineering

- Use BigQuery and large-scale log analytics to reconstruct transaction timelines, analyze data discrepancies, and assess business impact. 
 - Troubleshoot Java and Spring Boot microservices in production environments. 
 - Analyze JVM thread dumps, garbage collection, concurrency issues, and application performance problems. 
 - Partner with development teams to identify and implement code-level fixes. 
 - Reduce operational toil through automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Go. 
 - Build automation for activities such as certificate rotation, cleanup, audit evidence collection, and operational tooling. 

Security, Governance & Resilience

- Work within regulated environments governed by standards such as PCI DSS and SOC 2. 
 - Support remediation of application and infrastructure security findings using tools such as Fortify, Nexus IQ, SonarQube, and Qualys. 
 - Implement Zero Trust and least-privilege IAM principles. 
 - Support controlled change-management processes and Production Readiness Reviews. 
 - Ensure new services have appropriate monitoring, runbooks, operational procedures, and capacity planning before production launch. 
 - Design and validate multi-region failover and disaster-recovery strategies. 
 - Define and validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO). 
 - Participate in periodic disaster-recovery testing and resilience exercises. 
 - Monitor cloud utilization and optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, capacity, and reliability. 

Technical Leadership

- Translate platform and reliability risks into clear business impact for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote strong Site Reliability Engineering practices. 
 - Lead a blameless postmortem culture focused on learning and continuous improvement. 
 - Maintain high-quality technical documentation, operational runbooks, and engineering work items. 
 - Apply AI-assisted engineering tools, including AI-driven root-cause analysis and log analysis, to improve operational efficiency and incident response. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Production Engineering. 
 - At least 3 years of experience supporting high-availability, production-grade systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Deep experience with Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Kubernetes, service mesh, Workload Identity, and private networking. 
 - Strong Infrastructure as Code expertise using Terraform, Terragrunt, and Helm. 
 - Production experience with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD. 
 - Experience modernizing or migrating legacy CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong observability experience using Datadog or comparable platforms, including distributed tracing and SLO implementation. 
 - Proven experience managing or coordinating major production incidents and Root Cause Analysis. 
 - Strong programming and scripting capabilities in Python, along with at least one of Bash, PowerShell, or Go. 
 - Experience working in regulated or security-sensitive environments. 
 - Strong understanding of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management, reliability engineering, and production readiness. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical risks to both engineering teams and leadership. 

Preferred Skills

- Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) certification. 
 - Production-level troubleshooting experience with Java and Spring Boot, including JVM-level debugging. 
 - Hands-on experience with BigQuery, including large-scale log analysis and cloud billing data. 
 - Experience with FinOps and cloud cost optimization. 
 - Experience designing and testing multi-region disaster-recovery solutions. 
 - Experience leading Jenkins-to-GitHub Actions migrations. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools for incident investigation, automation, root-cause analysis, or log analysis. 
 - ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent service-management experience. 
 - Additional language proficiency may be advantageous depending on business requirements.

data.title: Staff Quality Engineer (Remote)
data.description:
- Role Title: Staff Quality Engineer (Remote)
 - Role Type: Full-time
 - Location: Remote

The Role

You'll design and build an intelligent, highly automated quality engineering system where AI agents help generate tests, execute regression suites, investigate failures, and continuously improve test coverage. 

You'll own the technical foundations that allow our engineering team to ship quickly and confidently without scaling QA headcount alongside product complexity. 

We're looking for a Staff-level engineer with deep test automation expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, and a track record of building systems that make quality an integrated, automated part of software development. 

What You'll Do

1. Build agentic QA systems: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for test generation, automated regression testing, failure analysis, and intelligent bug triage. 

2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows. 

3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 

4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues. 

5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk. 

6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing. 

7. Establish quality observability: Create clear visibility into test reliability, regression trends, release readiness, and overall product quality. 

8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish testing standards, and drive a culture where quality is owned across the engineering organization. 

What We're Looking For

1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or Test Automation Architecture. 

2. Strong hands-on programming skills and experience building production-grade test automation frameworks. 

3. Extensive experience automating web applications, APIs, and complex end-to-end workflows. 

4. Expertise with modern testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent technologies. 

5. Strong understanding of CI/CD, integration testing, contract testing, regression strategies, and test infrastructure. 

6. Proven experience designing scalable testing systems rather than exclusively writing or maintaining individual test cases. 

7. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents extensively and have practical experience applying AI to test generation, automation, debugging, or quality workflows. 

8. Strong systems thinking, including the ability to identify bottlenecks and design automation that removes repetitive QA work. 

9. Experience establishing engineering quality standards and mentoring developers or QA engineers. 

10. Ability to independently own quality engineering architecture while remaining deeply hands-on. 

Nice to have

1. You've built AI-powered testing systems or agentic QA workflows used in real development environments. 

2. You've significantly reduced manual regression testing through intelligent automation. 

3. You've designed testing infrastructure that supports rapid product iteration with a small engineering team. 

4. You've worked on testing AI-powered products, including nondeterministic behaviors, model evaluations, or agentic workflows. 

5. You think about quality as an engineering platform rather than a separate phase of software delivery. 

6. You can move comfortably between writing automation code, investigating complex failures, and designing company-wide quality systems. 

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $180, 000 -$250, 000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce. 

micro1 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to support@micro1. ai. 

Our hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making. 

What You'll Do

1. Build agentic QA systems: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for test generation, automated regression testing, failure analysis, and intelligent bug triage. 

2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows. 

3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 

4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues. 

5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk. 

6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced AWS Data Engineer Lead to drive the design and delivery of robust, scalable data engineering solutions on AWS. You'll lead a team building high-performance data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and analytics platforms, while championing engineering excellence and cloud-native best practices. 

Key Responsibilities

data.description:
Principal Engineer

Exp : 12-14 Years

Location : Remote

About your role

As a Principal Engineer or Senior Techical Lead for Reporting, you'll lead the squad that builds the backbone of Juniper Square's financial and web reporting. You'll help set the private-markets standard for customizable, actionable reporting-letting users pull any data, from anywhere, place it anywhere, in any format, and generate insights that drive decisions. We integrate diverse data sources to deliver intuitive, dynamic reporting experiences. 

This is a critical, hands-on role for a player-coach who improves systems, automates reporting workflows, enjoys working with financial data, and boosts operational efficiency. You'll own technical direction and architecture, solve complex problems alongside your engineers, and provide strong mentorship while actively coding and contributing to design. 

What you'll do

- AI-Native Culture & Velocity: Champion and embed AI-native development practices and tools (e. g. , Cursor, Augment) to achieve significant productivity gains, fostering a "startup-mode" culture of rapid iteration, high velocity, and quality, including guiding the effective use of AI code generation. 
 - Technical Ownership & Architecture: Take ownership over the team's architecture, actively participating in design reviews and driving the long-term technical vision. Identify and promote software best practices to improve team effectiveness. 
 - Individual Coding Contribution: Take ownership of team code, and actively participate in coding, testing and delivering roadmap projects. 
 - Workflow Automation & AI Integration: Lead the team in designing and implementing robust workflow automation solutions. Identify opportunities to leverage AI and modern tooling to increase the efficiency and scalability of internal systems. 
 - Execution & Project Management: Effectively manage the team's short-term roadmap (spanning the next two quarters), actively identifying risks and creating clear mitigation strategies to ensure successful project delivery. 
 - Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering their technical and professional growth. Ensure high quality in team deliverables through guidance and hands-on code reviews. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with cross-functional business stakeholders (such as Product, Customer support and other eng teams) to understand their needs and deliver impactful solutions. Handle most cross-team conflicts and decisions autonomously. 
 - Operational Excellence: Take ownership of monitoring, diagnosing, and resolving production issues within the team's services. Establish and promote strong operational practices for the services your team owns. 
 - Hiring & Team Building: Partner with recruiting to build and grow the team. Own the final hiring decision and be responsible for the team-level organizational design to accomplish team goals. 
 - Technical Leadership & Execution: Provide strong technical leadership for one or more AI squads, guiding architectural decisions, driving the execution of AI projects from vision to delivery, and actively contributing hands-on ("vibe-coding") to prototype, unblock complex challenges, and set technical standards. Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 
 - 12-14 years of experience demonstrating a trajectory of increasing technical leadership, architectural responsibility, and mentorship. 
 - Proven experience in software engineering with significant hands-on technical contributions, including experience in system design, architecture, and leading technical initiatives. 
 - Demonstrable product focus and a keen understanding of how technology can solve customer problems and drive business outcomes. 
 - Highly self-driven, with a proactive approach to leadership, technical problem-solving, and initiative execution. 
 - Experience or strong interest in workflow automation, systems integration, and leveraging AI/ML tools to improve internal processes. 
 - Experience working in agile development environments and familiarity with practices that promote rapid iteration and velocity. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and align them on product goals. 
 - A strong "player-coach" mindset, with a proven ability and willingness to be hands-on with code, design, and architecture when necessary to lead by example and unblock your team. 
 - Enthusiasm for adopting and driving the use of AI-native development tools and methodologies (e. g. , Cursor, Augment, Lovable. ai). 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead teams effectively in a fast-paced, innovative environment. 
 - Deep understanding of service-oriented architecture, modern software development practices, and developing scalable, reliable systems. 
 - Prior experience in a formal engineering management role is a plus, but strong experience as a Tech Lead or a similar role with significant technical leadership, architectural responsibility, and mentorship responsibilities is highly valued.

data.title: Senior SDET (Python, Playwright, pytest)
data.description:
Senior SDET (Python, Playwright, pytest)

THE ROLE

Own test automation and quality for Securly Flex, a market-leading EdTech product. Securly Flex is the #1 flexible scheduling software for K-12 schools. It builds time into the school day for intervention and enrichment, and serves as the scheduling engine behind schools' MTSS and RTI programs. Its Autoassign feature uses thousands of data points each night to build the next day's flex period rosters, so students are assigned where they're needed most based on teacher priorities and student needs. 

This is a senior engineering role, not a QA role. You will own and scale our Python-based test platform (pytest and Playwright for Python), write the framework code yourself, and define what "ready to release" means for Flex. You'll use AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot as an everyday part of how you build and scale coverage. 

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid - 2-3 days onsite)

Experience: 6-12 years

Reports to: Director of Quality Engineering

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own and evolve the framework. Extend and improve the Flex automation framework in Python (pytest and Playwright): fixtures, reusable libraries, test data utilities, parallel execution (pytest-xdist), and reporting that the whole team builds on. 
 - Test complex scheduling logic. Automate placement logic, capacity limits, sign-up cutoffs, permissions, and concurrent registrations, at both the API and UI layers. 
 - Gate every release. Set the CI/CD quality bar and enforce it in the pipeline, so regressions don't reach production. 
 - Lead with AI-assisted engineering. Use Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot and Playwright MCP to generate scenarios, build faster, and triage failures, and help the team adopt them well. 
 - Set performance baselines. Measure peak-load moments, such as thousands of students signing up in the same minute, and define what counts as a performance regression. 
 - Cover web, mobile, and integrations. Own end-to-end coverage across student, teacher, and admin workflows, the mobile app, SIS roster imports and attendance exports, single sign-on, and notifications. 
 - Shape architecture and mentor. Partner with a Distinguished Engineer on testability decisions, and mentor engineers on test design. 

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS

Must-Have

- Python and Playwright - strong, production experience writing automation in Python with pytest and Playwright. You understand fixtures and their scopes, test isolation, and modern Playwright practices (role-based locators, auto-waiting assertions, tracing). Strong TypeScript or Java Playwright engineers who are ready to work in Python will also be considered. 
 - Test framework architecture - you've designed automation frameworks that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts. 
 - API and business-rule automation - REST and contract testing, plus testing business rules (placement, capacity, eligibility, state transitions), not just UI flows. 
 - CI/CD quality gates - you've defined what blocks a release, not just written the tests that check it. 
 - Strong programming - clean, production-quality Python written from scratch, including data structures and logic. You catch edge cases and API contract details, and your test code is held to the same standard as product code. 
 - Education and experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 6-12 years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience. Strongly Preferred

- AI coding tools - hands-on use of Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Playwright MCP to build tests, generate scenarios, or triage failures. 
 - Performance and concurrency testing - k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust, including burst traffic and race conditions. 
 - Security and access-control testing - role-based permissions and multi-tenant data isolation. Nice to Have

- Mobile automation - Appium, Maestro, or Detox for iOS and Android. 
 - Integration testing - SIS imports and exports, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notifications. 
 - K-12 EdTech domain - familiarity with school schedules and how districts manage student data. 

WHO YOU ARE

- You test the edge cases, not just the happy path. 
 - You've built and scaled automation frameworks, ideally in Python with pytest, and other engineers have built on what you designed. 
 - You use AI coding tools as a real part of how you work, and you hold their output to a high bar. 
 - You're hands-on at a senior level. You still write the framework code and raise the bar for everyone after you. 
 - You own your area end to end and resolve ambiguity instead of waiting for a perfect spec. 

ABOUT SECURLY

Tech Giant Scale. EdTech Innovation. Unmatched Student Impact. 

Securly processes over 1. 1 billion requests per day and 54 TB of data daily, protecting more than 20 million students across 20, 000+ schools globally. Since pioneering the first cloud-based web filter for K-12 in 2013, Securly has built one of the most trusted, high-scale platforms for student safety, wellness, and engagement. 

We are proud to be consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work, named a Top 40 Most Used EdTech platform, and included on the GSV 150 list as one of the most transformational growth companies in digital learning and workforce skills. 

BENEFITS

- Comprehensive Health Insurance (employee, parents, spouse, children)
 - Accidental & Term Life Insurance
 - Learning & Development reimbursement
 - Paid Time Off
 - Public Holidays (10+ per year)
 - Retirement Benefits (EPF & gratuity)
 - Parental Leave (as per statutory norms)

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Securly is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion, fairness, and respect. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. 

#LI-REMOTE #LI-DO1

data.title: AI DevOps Engineer – Platform & Infrastructure
data.description:
Hiring for PULS Group - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1, 700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure. 

About the Role

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code. 

What you'll do

- Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
 - Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
 - Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
 - Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
 - Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
 - Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
 - Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

What you bring

- 4-6+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering on production, customer-facing systems
 - Hands-on Azure: Container Apps or AKS, Azure Monitor, Key Vault and Entra ID
 - Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform that you wrote and maintained across environments
 - CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with security scanning and automated quality gates
 - Has operated PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar in production: backups, replication and performance tuning
 - Has designed monitoring and alerting and handled real incidents in live operations
 - Works AI-natively: uses Claude Code or Codex daily. Expect live pairing with a coding agent in the interview
 - English at C1 level and comfort working with colleagues in Munich and 21 markets

Nice to have

- Kubernetes depth, global CDN strategies and China deployments
 - Operating LLM/RAG workloads (Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry)
 - FinOps and cloud cost control; WAF/DDoS and hardening in production

But the real power behind Resilinc? Our people. We're a fully remote, mission-led team making sure life-saving products and critical goods get where they're needed, fast. We offer the chance to do meaningful work in a collaborative, empowering culture-where you can be an agent of change. Join us to tackle critical global challenges through high-impact work that matters. 

Check out this blog to learn more about how we are impacting the world's most critical supply chains. Global Supply Chain Risks 2026: Act Faster | TEC

Resilinc | Innovation with Purpose. Intelligence with Impact. 

About The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Staff Engineer to build and grow the core platform behind our multi-tenant SaaS product on Azure. You'll work in the Architecture team and turn platform designs into production-ready microservices, shared services, and AI agent features. You'll also fix security issues in code (CVEs, pentest findings, and FedRAMP findings) within agreed timelines. The role involves working closely with application, security, DevOps, and product teams. 

What You Will Do

Core platform development: 

- Design, build, and maintain cloud-native microservices and shared platform services on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). These include identity (OAuth 2. 0 and SAML SSO), email, file management, task management, multi-tenancy, and configuration
 - Build secure, versioned, well-documented REST/gRPC APIs with databases and event-driven integrations using Kafka, Redis and Azure services
 - Improve the performance, scalability, reliability, and cost of platform services
 - Build out the designs and patterns agreed within the Architecture team, and share feedback from hands-on implementation

AI agents: 

- Build and integrate AI agents and LLM features (tool calling, RAG, multi-step workflows) using Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and LangChain/LangGraph
 - Build shared platform components for AI: prompt and model management, guardrails, evaluation, and secure data access

Security and compliance remediation: 

- Fix CVEs reported by the security team in application code and dependencies, within the agreed timeline
 - Fix pentest and OWASP Top 10 findings from the security team and external assessors, and work with them to confirm the fixes
 - Fix FedRAMP / NIST 800-53 findings in code and help close out POA&M items
 - Build libraries and patterns that are secure by default (authentication and authorization, secrets handling, encryption, input validation, audit logging), so product teams meet compliance requirements without extra work

Collaboration and engineering excellence: 

- Work across application, security, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver platform changes with minimal disruption
 - Take part in code reviews, technical documentation, and engineering standards
 - Mentor engineers on using the platform and on secure coding practices

What You Will Bring

- 8+ years of software engineering experience, mostly building Microservices and Platform
 - Strong proficiency in Python/FastAPI stack. Additional experience with Java / Spring Boot
 - Hands-on experience with AKS, PostgreSQL, Azure KeyVault
 - Solid understanding of microservice patterns: API design, async messaging with Kafka, caching with Redis, resiliency, and multi-tenancy
 - Proven experience fixing CVEs and pentest findings in code, including dependency upgrades, OWASP Top 10 fixes, and secure coding
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/AKS (deploying and debugging services), and CI/CD with GitHub Actions
 - Strong debugging, communication, and collaboration skills

What Will Make You Stand Out

- Experience building AI agent or LLM features with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and LangChain/LangGraph (RAG, vector search)
 - Experience with OAuth 2. 0 and SAML SSO
 - Exposure to FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, or SOC 2 remediation
 - Experience with Apache Spark and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch
 - Familiarity with Helm or Terraform

Why You Will Love It Here

- Take real ownership of the core platform behind Resilinc's Agentic AI and SaaS, with influence on our products and technical direction
 - Work flexibly from anywhere in a fully remote, global team, with opportunities to connect in person

What's in it for you?

At Resilinc, we're fully remote, with plenty of opportunities to connect in person. We provide a culture where ownership, purpose, technical growth and a voice in shaping impactful technology are at our core. Oh, and the perks? Full-stack benefits for health, wealth and wellbeing to keep you thriving. Check in with your talent acquisition contact for a location-specific FAQ. 

Curious to know more about us? Dive in at www. resilinc. ai

More great news! Resilinc is backed by Vista Equity Partners

data.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and highly technical DevOps Engineer (IC4) to join Oracle's Cloud Enablement Team (CET). This role focuses on designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-scale automation solutions that support application deployments, infrastructure management, production operations, and service reliability across Oracle Cloud environments. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Oracle Linux Automation Manager (OLAM), Windows Server, Linux, CI/CD pipelines, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Responsibilities include developing reusable automation frameworks, automating application installations, upgrades, patching, password rotation, configuration management, and rollback procedures. The engineer will also modernize legacy automation, implement automated testing and validation, and improve deployment consistency and operational efficiency. 

The position requires advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to investigate complex issues involving application services, automation jobs, infrastructure, databases, networking, and load balancers. The engineer will collaborate with Development, QA, Cloud Operations, SRE, and other engineering teams to support production applications, resolve incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term reliability improvements. 

As an IC4 engineer, the successful candidate is expected to independently own complex technical initiatives, provide technical guidance, mentor other engineers, and drive continuous improvements in automation, security, monitoring, and operational processes. Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications, implementing Infrastructure as Code, and using AI-assisted tools for automation development and troubleshooting is highly desirable. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities - DevOps Engineer IC4 (Cloud Enablement & Automation)

Capacity Ingestion and Management

- Designs, architects, implements, and maintains reliable, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure and automation services supporting enterprise SaaS applications. 
 - Forecasts infrastructure capacity requirements, monitors resource utilization, and recommends improvements to optimize performance, reliability, and operational costs. 
 - Collaborates with Development, QA, Cloud Operations, SRE, and Infrastructure teams to design and maintain environments that support application installations, upgrades, migrations, and production operations. 
 - Develops and maintains infrastructure provisioning and configuration automation using Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), PowerShell, Python, Ansible/OLAM, and related technologies. 
 - Evaluates and prototypes new automation approaches, infrastructure configurations, and deployment solutions to improve operational scalability and efficiency. 
 - Supports infrastructure lifecycle activities, including server provisioning, capacity expansion, operating system upgrades, cloud migrations, and decommissioning. 

Incident and Service Lifecycle Management

- Maintains and optimizes application services, infrastructure, and automation platforms to ensure availability, reliability, security, and operational performance. 
 - Performs complex incident investigation, technical analysis, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis across Windows/Linux servers, application services, automation jobs, databases, and networking components. 
 - Designs, develops, and maintains automation supporting application installations, in-place upgrades (IPUs), migrations, patching, configuration updates, password rotation, and rollback procedures. 
 - Supports enterprise application lifecycle operations, including Oracle Client upgrades, security patching, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, backup, and recovery. 
 - Monitors infrastructure and application health using OpenSearch, OCI Monitoring, OCI Logging, OCI Log Analytics, and related observability tools. 
 - Develops operational reporting, dashboards, and automated validation processes to identify performance issues, automation failures, and service reliability risks. 
 - Supports scheduled maintenance, customer-facing deployments, environment provisioning, and infrastructure decommissioning activities while minimizing service disruption. 

Automation

- Designs, develops, implements, and maintains production-grade automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, and Oracle Linux Automation Manager (OLAM). 
 - Develops reusable automation frameworks, Ansible playbooks, roles, job templates, dynamic inventories, and scripts to support application and infrastructure operations across multiple environments. 
 - Automates application installations, upgrades, patching, password rotation, configuration management, deployment validation, and rollback procedures. 
 - Implements automated testing, error handling, logging, exception management, and recovery mechanisms to improve automation quality and reliability. 
 - Modernizes legacy automation by migrating existing Chef, BladeLogic, and other configuration management solutions to PowerShell, Ansible/OLAM, and standardized automation frameworks. 
 - Develops automated tests using PowerShell Pester or equivalent testing frameworks to validate scripts, application configurations, and infrastructure changes. 
 - Continuously identifies opportunities to reduce manual operational effort, improve deployment consistency, shorten maintenance windows, and reduce operational errors. 
 - Maintains CI/CD pipelines, source code repositories, and automation workflows using Git, GitLab, OCI DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms. 

Technical Communication and Guidance

- Communicates infrastructure changes, application deployment requirements, automation designs, security considerations, operational risks, and service impacts to technical teams and stakeholders. 
 - Collaborates with Development, QA, Cloud Operations, SRE, Security, and other engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver reliable automation solutions. 
 - Develops and maintains technical documentation, automation design specifications, operational runbooks, release procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-sharing materials. 
 - Provides technical guidance on PowerShell, Python, Ansible/OLAM, OCI infrastructure, application lifecycle automation, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Proactively identifies potential impacts of infrastructure changes, application upgrades, and automation enhancements, communicating risks and mitigation strategies. 
 - Mentors engineers, performs code and automation reviews, and promotes consistent engineering standards and operational best practices across globally distributed teams. 

Troubleshooting and Resolution

- Serves as a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure, application deployment, automation, networking, and production support issues. 
 - Investigates and resolves failures involving Ansible/OLAM jobs, PowerShell scripts, application upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure services. 
 - Diagnoses technical issues across Windows/Linux operating systems, Oracle databases, application services, DNS, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, and network connectivity. 
 - Participates in on-call rotations and supports critical customer-facing incidents, scheduled maintenance, and production deployments. 
 - Performs root cause analysis (RCA), documents incidents, and implements corrective and preventive actions to minimize recurring failures. 
 - Develops automation and troubleshooting improvements to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR), supporting established service level objectives (SLOs). 
 - Collaborates with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve complex technical dependencies and minimize customer impact. 

Innovation and Improvement

- Evaluates emerging automation, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and SRE technologies to improve application reliability, operational efficiency, and scalability. 
 - Identifies and implements improvements to automation frameworks, deployment processes, monitoring capabilities, and infrastructure management. 
 - Drives modernization of legacy automation platforms by adopting reusable PowerShell functions, Ansible playbooks, automated validation, and standardized source code management. 
 - Evaluates approved AI-assisted tools to improve automation development, code analysis, log investigation, incident triage, and troubleshooting efficiency. 
 - Analyzes operational metrics, automation failures, deployment performance, and infrastructure utilization to recommend improvements. 
 - Develops solutions that reduce manual intervention, improve deployment success rates, strengthen security compliance, and optimize infrastructure costs. 
 - Maintains current knowledge of DevOps, cloud automation, SRE, and security best practices, sharing recommendations and technical insights across engineering teams. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution

- Independently manages and executes moderately complex to complex DevOps automation and infrastructure initiatives, ensuring technical requirements, timelines, and deliverables are met. 
 - Plans and coordinates application upgrades, automation releases, infrastructure changes, and production maintenance activities across multiple teams and environments. 
 - Identifies technical dependencies, prioritizes competing operational requirements, and proactively addresses risks that could impact customer-facing services. 
 - Provides technical oversight, reviews implementation plans, and ensures appropriate testing, validation, and rollback procedures are established. 

Collaboration & Partnership

- Collaborates across Development, QA, Cloud Operations, SRE, Security, Infrastructure, and Product Engineering teams to deliver reliable and scalable automation solutions. 
 - Works closely with global engineering teams to support application lifecycle activities, infrastructure modernization, security improvements, and production operations. 
 - Understands business and customer requirements and translates them into practical technical solutions that improve operational efficiency and service reliability. 
 - Promotes knowledge sharing, constructive collaboration, and consistent automation practices across teams. 

Problem Solving

- Independently investigates and resolves complex technical problems involving automation frameworks, application services, operating systems, infrastructure, databases, and networking. 
 - Analyzes system logs, automation job failures, performance metrics, and configuration dependencies to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions. 
 - Evaluates technical alternatives, anticipates operational risks, and recommends solutions that improve reliability, maintainability, and scalability. 
 - Documents troubleshooting procedures, lessons learned, and reusable solutions to improve future operational response. 

Continuous Learning

- Maintains advanced technical knowledge of PowerShell, Python, Ansible/OLAM, Windows/Linux administration, OCI, CI/CD, and enterprise application lifecycle automation. 
 - Stays current with developments in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, automation testing, security, and AI-assisted engineering tools. 
 - Proactively develops new technical skills and applies emerging technologies to improve operational processes. 
 - Coaches and mentors engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and troubleshooting support. 

Continuous Improvement

- Identifies and implements improvements to automation processes, operational workflows, application deployment procedures, and infrastructure management. 
 - Develops reusable automation libraries, standardized Ansible playbooks, PowerShell modules, testing frameworks, and operational documentation. 
 - Continuously evaluates opportunities to reduce deployment times, improve automation reliability, minimize incidents, and reduce manual operational effort. 
 - Establishes measurable improvements in automation execution, deployment success rates, incident resolution, maintenance efficiency, and infrastructure utilization. 
 - Encourages feedback from engineering and operations teams to improve automation quality, maintainability, and adoption. 

Performance and Development

- Demonstrates strong technical ownership, accountability, independent problem-solving, and consistent execution across complex engineering assignments. 
 - Provides technical leadership in automation design, operational troubleshooting, infrastructure improvements, and application lifecycle management. 
 - Mentors junior engineers and contributes to the development of technical capabilities across the Cloud Enablement Team. 
 - Participates in candidate interviews, technical assessments, and hiring recommendations to support team growth and capability development. 
 - Promotes engineering excellence, continuous learning, automation standards, and operational reliability across the organization. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Lapmaster Wolters is a global leader in high-precision machine tools, with over 200 years of history. Their machines lap, polish and grind surfaces to extreme flatness for 20+ industries worldwide. The company has 600+ employees and revenue above €250 million.

Overview

Microsoft is building the future of AI-powered work, and the Agent 365 team is at the centre of it. We're looking for a passionate Senior Software Engineer to help design, build and scale the platform that lets organisations deploy, manage and secure AI agents across the Microsoft Cloud. 

In this role you'll work on large-scale, cloud-native systems that use big data, machine learning, natural language processing and search technologies to give customers intelligent, secure and reliable agent experiences. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, security experts and engineering teams around the world to turn complex customer needs into high-quality solutions on Azure, Microsoft Entra and Microsoft 365. 

Security and trust are at the core of what we build. You'll bring a security-first mindset, apply practices such as threat analysis and penetration testing, and help keep our services resilient and compliant. We value engineers who are curious, take ownership, engage directly with customers and enjoy solving hard problems in a fast-moving, collaborative environment. 

If you're excited by cloud and AI and want to shape how millions of people and organisations work with intelligent agents, we'd love to hear from you.

Champion innovation in monitoring, distributed tracing, and logging strategies to provide deep visibility into system behavior. Continuously evaluate and integrate emerging technologies to improve observability maturity and reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and resolve (MTTR)

 - Incident Response: Actively participate in incident response, troubleshooting, and post-mortem analysis to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences

 - Collaboration: Work closely with other SREs, engineers, and stakeholders across time zones to align on goals, strategies, and ensure smooth project execution
 - Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, performance, and operational efficiency, and implement changes as needed
 - AI Driven Operations: Leverage AI-powered tools and platforms to enhance observability, incident response, and operational efficiency
 - Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Required Qualifications

- Full-time bachelor's degree or higher is required
