data.title: Principal QA Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Embrace Software acquires mission-critical businesses and helps them thrive for the long term. With 17+ acquisitions across healthcare, industrial, financial services, education, legal, and public sector, our portfolio runs inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We don't flip companies; we keep them, invest in them, and rebuild them around AI, while our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into the same markets. Named to the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies and an 8x Top Workplaces award winner, Embrace brings together top talent from around the world to build lasting products, own real outcomes, and grow with a company that plays the long game. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

Embrace Technology Group is our shared engineering, cloud, security, AI and quality function. It builds core capabilities once and makes them available to every portfolio company. As Principal QA Engineer, you will own the quality engineering practice across our portfolio. You will define the test strategy, build the reference automation framework, set the quality gates and metrics, and make sure test evidence stands up to regulated customers and auditors. 

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. QA engineers across portfolio companies work with you on a dotted line for standards, tooling and practice. You lead through the quality of the standard, working code and measured results. In your first year, you will write framework code, review test code and solve the hardest automation problems yourself. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality engineering strategy and standards

- Define and maintain the portfolio quality engineering strategy: test policy, risk-based test approach, test levels, and the expected balance across unit, service/API, integration, UI and end-to-end testing. 
 - Publish and maintain the quality engineering standard: test design conventions, definition of done for testing, defect severity and priority taxonomy, entry/exit criteria and release readiness criteria. 
 - Keep the standard as a versioned body of practice, with documented exceptions that each carry an owner and an expiry date. 
 - Build a quality engineering maturity model, assess each portfolio company against it, and agree a sequenced improvement plan with each company's technology leader. 2. Test architecture and reference automation framework

- Design and own the reference test automation architecture across web, API, mobile, desktop and data layers. 
 - Build and maintain the reference implementation, starter kits and templates so teams can adopt automation in days. 
 - Define the approach to contract testing, service virtualization and integration testing for products with heavy external integrations. 
 - Define the testing approach for legacy and mixed technology estates, including characterization tests that protect existing behavior before modernization, re-platforming or consolidation. 
 - Define the standard for data migration and reconciliation testing in modernization and consolidation programs. 
 - Stay hands-on: write and review framework code, review test code across the portfolio, and solve the hardest automation problems directly. 3. Toolchain, CI/CD and test environments

- Select and govern the QA toolchain (automation frameworks, test management, browser and device infrastructure, accessibility and performance tools, reporting), with a reference stack and approved alternatives where needed. 
 - Identify and recommend license and contract consolidation across companies where it reduces cost or duplication. 
 - Define CI/CD quality gates with the DevSecOps engineer who implements them, and set standards for test parallelization, execution time and flaky test management. 
 - Define test environment standards with the cloud platform team, including on-demand and ephemeral environments where supported. 4. Test data management

- Set the portfolio standard for synthetic data generation, masking and subsetting. 
 - Ensure, with the Security, Risk & Compliance lead, that production PHI, personal data, student records and financial data are not used in non-production environments without approved controls. 5. Non-functional and specialist testing

- Accessibility: Define the testing standard against WCAG 2. 1/2. 2 AA and Section 508, combining automated, manual and assistive technology testing. Own the evidence behind Accessibility Conformance Reports. 
 - Performance: Define the performance and load testing approach, baselines and release regression checks. Scope a dedicated performance engineering role when contractual latency or scale commitments require one. 
 - Security: Include dynamic security testing and security regression cases in test suites, within the scope set by the security function. 
 - Production signals: Use escaped defects, incident data, synthetic monitoring and observability data to decide where to focus testing effort. 6. Regulated quality evidence and traceability

- Define the requirements-to-test traceability standard so every release produces auditable evidence: what was tested, against which requirement, on which build, with what result and by whom. 
 - Align test and release evidence with SOC 2 change management, HIPAA and government and education buyer requirements, working with the security function. 
 - Define the validation approach and evidence package where a product or contract requires formal software validation. 
 - Support customer audits, buyer quality reviews and procurement questionnaires with test evidence. 7. Quality engineering for AI

- With the AI function, define how AI features are evaluated before and after release: evaluation datasets, acceptance thresholds, regression testing of model and prompt changes, non-deterministic output and human review for high-consequence workflows. 
 - Evaluate AI-assisted test generation, maintenance and agent-driven exploratory testing; adopt them where they measurably improve coverage or cycle time, and document where they are not yet reliable. 
 - Define test and acceptance requirements for code written by AI coding agents. 8. Quality metrics, reporting and release readiness

- Define and publish portfolio quality metrics: escaped defects by severity, automated regression coverage of critical workflows, regression cycle time, flaky test rate, change failure rate and time to detect defects. 
 - Maintain a portfolio quality dashboard and issue a quarterly quality report that non-technical executives can act on. 
 - Define release readiness criteria and the evidence needed to meet them, and advise company leadership on release risk. 9. Practice leadership and capability development

- Lead the portfolio QA community of practice through regular standards reviews, technical sessions and shared learning. 
 - Set the hiring bar for QA roles (role profiles, levels, interview loops, technical assessments) and take part in QA hiring decisions. 
 - Define the onboarding program for new QA engineers, the skills matrix for the discipline, and a growth path from manual testing to automation and SDET. 
 - Provide written input to the performance reviews of dotted-line QA engineers, and agree development plans with their line managers. 10. Acquisitions and delivery engagements

- Assess the quality engineering maturity of newly acquired companies and define the quality workstream of their integration plans. 
 - Set the quality approach for the Technology Group's embedded delivery engagements, and feed reusable test assets and lessons back into the reference framework. 

Requirements

- 12+ years in software quality engineering, test engineering or SDET roles, including 4+ years setting test strategy and automation architecture across multiple teams or products. 
 - A test automation framework you designed and built from scratch that multiple teams adopted, and the ability to explain its design trade-offs. 
 - Strong current coding skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or a similar language. 
 - Depth in Playwright, Selenium or Cypress for UI testing, and REST Assured, Postman or Karate for API testing. Working knowledge of contract testing (e. g. , Pact) and Appium. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab or Jenkins), including quality gates, parallel execution and flaky test management. 
 - Applied risk-based test strategy and formal test design techniques on complex products. 
 - Test data management in environments with regulated or sensitive data. 
 - Testing in a regulated domain (healthcare, government, financial services or education), including requirements traceability and audit-ready evidence. 
 - Experience standardizing tooling and practice across teams with different tech stacks, including legacy . NET or Java applications and SQL Server databases. 
 - Proven ability to lead a quality practice across teams that report elsewhere, through influence rather than line authority. 
 - Experience defining quality metrics and reporting them to senior leadership. 
 - Experience hiring and developing QA engineers, including role profiles and interview loops. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, including writing standards engineers follow. Nice to have

- Evaluating AI/LLM features: evaluation datasets, acceptance thresholds and testing non-deterministic output. 
 - Production use of AI-assisted test generation or agent-driven testing tools. 
 - Accessibility testing against WCAG 2. 1/2. 2 AA and Section 508, including assistive technology testing and Accessibility Conformance Reports. 
 - Performance testing with k6, JMeter, Gatling or similar. 
 - Formal software validation (computer system validation, IEC 62304 or 21 CFR Part 11). 
 - Data migration and reconciliation testing in modernization programs. 
 - Security testing collaboration using OWASP ZAP or Burp Suite. 
 - Experience in private-equity-backed, multi-entity or acquisitive companies, including post-acquisition integration. 
 - ISTQB Advanced or Expert Level certification (considered alongside proven delivery, not as a substitute). 

Benefits

- Competitive salary commensurate with experience. 
 - Opportunities for career advancement and professional development. 
 - Experience collaborating with a diverse, global team within a remote work setting.

data.title: Principal SOC Performance Verification Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft's expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft's "Intelligent Cloud" mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission. 

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantages to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more. 

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the Verification & Validation team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for experienced engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure. 

We are looking for a Principal SOC Performance Verification Engineer to join the team. 

#SCHIE #CSME

Responsibilities

The candidate for this position will be expected and able to complete the following responsibilities: 

- Establish yourself as an integral member of a pre-silicon SoC verification team, owning aspects of performance verification, and aligning with architecture, design, firmware, and emulation. 
 - Become knowledgeable on the overall SoC architecture, including tradeoffs that effect power and performance. 
 - Develop verification strategy, test plans, requirements, environments, tools, and methodologies. 
 - Apply your knowledge of performance verification principles and techniques and your judgement to write test plans and implement them by developing tests, test generators, test benches, checkers, coverage, and other verification collateral. 
 - Run tests, correlate results with architecture, debug failures to root cause, recommend fixes. 
 - Apply your growth mindset to learn and adapt in a complex and dynamic environment. 
 - Engage with partners to drive continuous improvement to the architecture, design, and verification plans/collateral, and to methodology to prevent, reduce, and/or find bugs sooner, more easily, or more reliably. 
 - Mentor and coach team members 
 - Apply your One Microsoft mentality to collaborate with and influence architects, logic designers, post-silicon validators, other verification engineers, and IP and tool providers. 
 - Embody our culture and values. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- 14+ years of pre-silicon SOC or subsystem or IP verification experience. 
 - Candidate must have at least a bachelor's or master's degree in electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related degree 
 - 8+ years of verification experience working on CPU/Fabric/DDR/IO designs verification, with 6+ years of performance verification experience

Preferred Qualifications

- 14+ years of experience as part of a CPU, SoC and/or IP development team focusing on performance
 - Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following: 
 - Performance verification
 - ARM architecture
 - CPU architecture
 - Memory Controller/PHY IPs, DDR protocols
 - Coherent and non-coherent fabric IPs and protocols 
 - PCIe/CXL Controller/PHY IPs and protocols
 - ACE lite or CHI bus protocols
 - Working knowledge of C/C++
 - Experience with emulation, constraints, and implications on performance verification
 - Proficient communication, collaboration and teamwork skills and ability to contribute to diverse and inclusive teams. 
Screening Requirements

- Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 
 - This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U. S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their US. residency or other protected status (e. g. , under 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate's citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

data.title: Head of Enterprise Server Platforms
data.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you've got big plans - so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people's lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us. 

Head of Enterprise Server Platforms

We are looking for an experienced technology leader to join the Enterprise Technology Platforms (ETP) Leadership Team as Head of Enterprise Server Platforms, based at MGCC in Bengaluru. 

In this global role, you will lead our Windows and Linux server platform capabilities, with responsibility for their strategy, engineering, lifecycle, security, resilience and operational performance. You will shape the future direction of these critical enterprise platforms while ensuring they continue to provide secure, stable and reliable foundations for our business applications and services. 

Windows and Linux remain distinct technologies requiring deep specialist expertise, but they share many common priorities around lifecycle management, security and hardening, automation, governance and operational excellence. A key part of your role will be bringing these capabilities closer together, establishing common engineering principles and ways of working while continuing to strengthen the expertise within each technology. 

As a member of the ETP Leadership Team, you will also contribute to the broader ETP strategy, transformation agenda and organisational priorities. 

Your Role

- Define and execute the global Enterprise Server Platforms strategy and roadmap across Windows and Linux. 
 - Lead and develop a global organisation of Windows and Linux engineering and operations professionals, building a strong culture of accountability, collaboration and technical excellence. 
 - Drive platform modernisation, standardisation and simplification, proactively managing lifecycle, technical debt and technology risk. 
 - Strengthen security through consistent approaches to hardening, patching, vulnerability remediation and configuration management. 
 - Champion an automation-first engineering approach, increasing the use of orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and self-service. 
 - Ensure the availability, resilience, recoverability and operational readiness of server platforms supporting critical business services. 
 - Establish consistent global engineering standards, governance and documentation while preserving the specialist capabilities required for Windows and Linux. 
 - Lead strategic technology partner relationships and ensure alignment between our suppliers, investments and technology roadmap. 
 - Provide senior leadership during major platform incidents and ensure lessons learned translate into sustainable improvements. 
 - Work closely with colleagues across ETP, Cyber Security, Architecture and application teams to ensure an integrated approach to our technology landscape. 
 - Contribute actively to the ETP Leadership Team, helping shape our wider technology strategy, organisation and priorities and providing Senior Leaderhip across ETP at MGCC. 

Who You Are

You are an experienced technology and people leader with a strong background in enterprise infrastructure, server platforms or platform engineering in a large and globally distributed environment. 

You Will Bring

- More than 15+ years of experience and strong knowledge of enterprise Windows Server and Linux environments, together with the technical credibility to lead experienced engineering teams across both disciplines. 
 - At least 7 years of significant experience leading and developing global technical teams and building high-performing engineering organisations. 
 - Experience shaping technology strategies and roadmaps and leading major platform transformation and lifecycle programmes. 
 - Strong understanding of infrastructure security, hardening, vulnerability management, availability, resilience and operational risk. 
 - Experience driving automation, standardisation, configuration management and Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Strong commercial awareness and experience managing strategic suppliers and technology partners. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to operate effectively from detailed technical discussions through to senior leadership conversations. 
 - A collaborative leadership style and a proven ability to lead through change, develop talent and bring teams together around a common strategy and purpose. 

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to lead a newly established global platform organisation and shape the future of two of our most important enterprise technology capabilities. 

You will have the opportunity to bring together strong Windows and Linux engineering communities, define how our server platforms evolve, accelerate automation and standardisation, strengthen security and resilience, and develop the skills and capabilities we will need for the future. 

Based at MGCC in Bengaluru, you will combine global technology accountability, people leadership and strategic influence as part of the ETP Leadership Team. 

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

These can also be equipped with electronic components in order to optimize them functionally for individual services. data.title: Team Lead, Reporting & Analytics
data.description:
As the world's leading provider of AI-powered solutions for social impact, Blackbaud is looking for a Team Lead, Reporting & Analytics to help Customer Success leaders make faster, more informed decisions. In this player-coach role, you will lead a team of 4-6 analysts while dedicating at least 25% of your time to high-impact analytics, reporting, and data-modeling initiatives. By connecting customer health, product adoption, retention, and financial performance data, you will build a trusted, scalable reporting function that expands what is possible for purpose-driven people and organizations. 

What You'll Do

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of analysts through regular one-to-one meetings, performance conversations, skill-building plans, and meaningful growth opportunities. 
 - Own the team's roadmap, reporting intake model, and prioritization process, ensuring resources are focused on the work that creates the greatest value. 
 - Partner with Customer Success, Product, Finance, and Sales Operations leaders to define and maintain metrics for retention, churn, net and gross revenue retention, customer health, product adoption, and onboarding time-to-value. 
 - Establish trusted data-governance practices, including documented metric definitions, data-quality checks, and a consistent source of truth. 
 - Deliver dashboards and actionable recommendations that make insights easier to access, understand, and use across the business. 
 - Advance automation and AI-assisted analytics to reduce manual effort, accelerate reporting, and create more scalable workflows. 
 - Personally build priority analyses, dashboards, and data models while setting strong technical standards for SQL, business intelligence development, documentation, and review. 

What You'll Bring

- 6-8 years of experience in a software-as-a-service environment, with a focus on Customer Success reporting, product analytics, and operational or financial reporting. 
 - At least two years of experience leading, managing, or formally mentoring analysts or other team members. 
 - Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience with a business intelligence or data-visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or preferably Qlik. 
 - Experience working with a modern data warehouse or lakehouse, such as Snowflake or preferably Databricks, and building scalable, self-service reporting supported by strong data governance. 
 - Experience defining performance measures and analytics frameworks and presenting technical findings and recommendations to senior leaders and non-technical audiences. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, or build workflows. Experience with Pendo, Heap, Mixpanel, Gainsight, Salesforce, nonprofit software, or Blackbaud solutions such as Raiser's Edge NXT is valued. 
 - Expected working hours are 1: 00 PM-10: 00 PM IST, with occasional flexibility to support collaboration during U. S. East Coast business hours. Participation in after-hours support rotations and select holiday coverage may also be required based on business needs. 

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube

Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‐driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our Intelligence for Good® vision, we're building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world. 

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

data.title: Lead II - Software Engineering
data.description:
Role Description

Role: Senior Backend Developer As a Senior Backend Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining server-side applications and backend services using Python. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration with cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS) and ensure that the applications are scalable, resilient, and optimized for performance. In this role, you'll leverage AWS services (including AWS Glue and other managed services) and focus on Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using AWS CDK to automate infrastructure provisioning. You will also play a key role in ensuring the security, availability, and reliability of the backend systems while mentoring junior engineers and helping to shape the future of our architecture. Key Responsibilities: 

- Backend Development: Build and maintain scalable, high-performance, and secure backend applications using Python. 
 - AWS Architecture: Work with a variety of AWS services (including AWS Glue, S3, Lambda, EC2, RDS, and more) to design robust, scalable architectures. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize AWS CDK (Cloud Development Kit) to manage cloud infrastructure and automate provisioning of resources. 
 - Data Pipelines: Develop and manage data pipelines using AWS Glue for ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, ensuring data is properly ingested, transformed, and available for analytics. 
 - CI/CD: Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines to ensure rapid deployment of new features, bug fixes, and updates with minimal downtime. 
 - API Design: Build and expose RESTful APIs for seamless communication between services and with front-end components. 
 - Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, frontend engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable, well-tested software features. 
 - Security and Performance: Implement best practices for securing applications and ensure optimal performance through code optimizations, profiling, and monitoring. 
 - Mentorship: Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and help foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Skills & Qualifications: 
 - Must-Have: o 5+ years of backend development experience with expertise in Python. o Strong experience with AWS services, including AWS Glue, Lambda, S3, EC2, RDS, and other AWS tools. o Proven experience in designing and managing data pipelines, particularly using AWS Glue. o Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using AWS CDK or similar frameworks (e. g. , Terraform). o Strong knowledge of CI/CD processes and tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline). o Deep understanding of RESTful API design and experience working with APIs. o Familiarity with cloud security best practices (e. g. , IAM, encryption, secure networking). o Strong debugging, performance tuning, and troubleshooting skills in distributed cloud environments. o Solid understanding of version control systems, particularly Git. o Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. 
 - Nice-to-Have: o Experience with AWS Glue, specifically in designing complex ETL pipelines. o Familiarity with event-driven architectures (e. g. , using SNS, SQS, Kinesis). o Familiarity with containerization technologies (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes). o Experience with NoSQL databases like DynamoDB or MongoDB. o Prior exposure to serverless architectures, using services like AWS Lambda. o Understanding of data warehousing solutions and integration with AWS data lakes. 

Skills

AWS, Python, AWS Glue, CI/CD

 - Generic Knowledge
 - Lifecycle Management: Full knowledge of Requirements Collection, Analysis, Design, Development, and Testing. 
 - Operational Monitoring: Knowledge of how complex systems are monitored and maintained in a banking environment. 

Methodology: Continuous improvement approaches (LEAN). 

Specific Qualifications

- Experience: At least 5 years of experience in IT analysis and development, with a strong emphasis on Java and SQL (PostgreSQL). 
 - RPA Experience: At least 3 years of experience in RPA development (preferably Blueprism). 
 - Education: Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Management Engineering, or a similar field. 
 - Certifications:

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking a Performance Tester to define and deliver performance and non-functional testing (NFT) strategies across telecom technology environments, including Cloud, CRM and Middleware domains. The role involves performance test planning, scripting, execution, analysis and reporting, alongside collaboration with product owners, developers, IT Operations and multiple vendors. 

You will drive testing efficiency, automation, reusable test assets and continuous improvement while ensuring high-quality test deliverables, effective risk management and adherence to agreed testing standards. 

What You'll Do

- Define and implement the QA vision, performance testing strategy and appropriate testing approaches across Cloud, CRM and Middleware environments 
 - Develop and maintain the NFT test strategy, updating it in line with changes to project risks, schedules and testing processes 
 - Work with business stakeholders to gather requirements and establish performance testing scenarios and scripts 
 - Plan, execute and coordinate performance tests, analyse results and communicate findings to technical and business stakeholders 
 - Collaborate with product owners and developers to define performance-testing requirements and acceptance criteria 
 - Define testing metrics, practices, processes, reporting mechanisms and tools 
 - Drive increased levels of test automation and identify opportunities for continuous improvement 
 - Develop reusable performance testing assets, including scripts and input data sets 
 - Work with application teams to investigate and resolve performance issues 
 - Ensure test deliverables meet agreed quality standards and defect management processes 
 - Recommend testing best practices and incorporate lessons learnt into future delivery 
 - Provide input into resource planning and recruitment activities supporting the test roadmap 
 - Mentor team members and support knowledge development across relevant technologies 
 - Develop effort estimates and budgets for performance testing projects 
 - Communicate project risks and issues to Test Leads, Test Managers and relevant stakeholders 
 - Provide regular and ad-hoc testing status reports in line with agreed milestones and service levels

Who You Are

- Experience testing custom services using load-generation tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter and SoapUI across multiple protocols, including Web HTTP and Siebel 
 - Hands-on experience in performance test scripting and test execution 
 - Experience working within CI/CD environments, cloud infrastructure and cloud-based applications 
 - Ability to analyse non-functional requirements (NFRs) and conduct volumetric analysis 
 - Working knowledge of C, Java, VB macros, SQL and shell scripting for script customisation and test automation 
 - Understanding of Java/JVM architecture, including garbage collection, class loading and thread-dump analysis 
 - Knowledge of database performance analysis, including Oracle and SQL Server 
 - Experience using application monitoring and profiling/APM tools such as HP Diagnostics, CA Wily, Dynatrace or AppDynamics 
 - Ability to analyse server and application metrics and identify performance bottlenecks 
 - Ability to communicate performance test findings clearly in both technical and business language 
 - Knowledge of supporting diagnostic tools such as Fiddler, Firebug, HAR and Lighthouse is advantageous 
 - Understanding of relevant industry standards and certifications, including ISO 9000 
 - Experience with defect management processes and delivery of testing artefacts in accordance with agreed standards 
 - Ability to estimate performance-testing effort and contribute to project budgeting and resource planning 
 - Strong collaboration skills for working with product owners, developers, IT Operations, testing teams and multiple vendors

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

- Opportunity to work across performance testing within complex telecom technology environments spanning Cloud, CRM and Middleware 
 - Exposure to CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, application performance monitoring and enterprise performance engineering 
 - Opportunity to influence performance-testing strategy, automation, standards and continuous improvement 
 - Collaboration with product owners, developers, IT Operations and multi-vendor teams across technology programmes 
 - Opportunity to mentor colleagues and contribute to testing capability development

What Skills You Will Learn

- Advanced performance engineering and non-functional testing practices across telecom technology platforms 
 - Performance analysis across Cloud, CRM and Middleware environments 
 - Greater expertise in CI/CD-integrated performance testing and automation 
 - Application and infrastructure monitoring using enterprise APM technologies 
 - Test asset reusability, volumetric modelling and performance test optimisation 
 - Stakeholder communication, effort estimation, resource planning and performance-testing governance

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background. 

Join Us

At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this. 

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together. 

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.

In this role, you will build and enhance Native Android applications, with a strong focus on delivering reliable, scalable, and high-performing mobile experiences. You will drive the development of offline-first capabilities that work seamlessly across varying network conditions while ensuring performance, reliability, and device compatibility. 

You will also contribute to web frontend development and collaborate with Backend, Product, QA, Architecture, and UX teams to deliver integrated mobile and web solutions that meet business and customer needs.

Job Title: Head of Data Science, India GSC

- We are looking for a principal-level developer who still wants to build and cares deeply about design. You will develop the user experience, APIs and supporting services for an internal platform that helps people across Asset Management understand the data behind business processes and improve its quality. Based in the Data and Analytics Office, you will work closely with business users and collaborate with data, AI and Technology colleagues to turn ideas into useful software. Technology leads production deployment and ongoing service operation, so you will build in partnership with them to the standards required for a secure, scalable and supported product. 

In This Role, You Will

This role suits you if you: 

- build complete web applications with modern TypeScript front ends (whether Angular, React or Vue) and Python services behind them, deployed through pipelines to the cloud; 
 - have shipped applications to production that people use, and can show the results; 
 - care about design as much as code, and simplifying things is your instinct; 
 - are comfortable developing within a business-led data team while collaborating closely with Technology to bring applications into production; 
 - have a history of building and launching things, at work or in your own time, and a portfolio that shows it. 
 - It is unlikely to suit you if your recent role has been mainly architecture or oversight rather than hands-on coding, if you have not built Python back-end services, or if you have worked on only one side of the stack. Experience beyond the core profile is welcome, but it cannot replace it. 

Build data applications end to end

- Design and build the platform from interface to data layer, including TypeScript front ends (Angular or React), Python services and APIs (FastAPI ), and the data access, integration and transformation code behind them. 
 - Translate loosely defined business and user needs into pragmatic designs and working software, iterating with users from prototype to pilot and, with Technology, into supported production services. 
 - Architect for scale and change with clean service boundaries, performance under real load, and code that stays easy to extend as the platform grows. 
 - Work with Technology colleagues on cloud deployment (Google Cloud), automated CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and the requirements for a secure and supported production service. 
 - Build reusable components, API patterns and templates that make each subsequent platform capability faster to deliver. 

Design Experiences People Want To Use

- Own UX and UI end to end. Understand business users' needs, sketch and test flows, and take designs from wireframe to polished interface without depending on a separate design team. 
 - Simplify relentlessly, turning business processes, metadata, ownership, lineage, data-quality rules and exceptions into clear, intuitive views, and personalise experiences to each user's role and needs. 
 - Design iteratively, using usage analytics and user feedback to measure engagement and refine what works. 
 - Establish a design system and front-end patterns, built to accessibility standards (WCAG 2. 2 AA). 

Work with data , technology and AI colleagues

- Work with Data Architecture and Governance and Data Product Owners so platform capabilities reflect agreed data models, definitions, ownership and controls. 
 - Partner closely with Technology architects, engineers and service colleagues on solution design, integration, security, deployment and support. Technology will lead production readiness, controlled release and ongoing service operation. 
 - Bring the work of data scientists and AI specialists into the platform where it adds value, with appropriate APIs, guardrails and telemetry. 

Lead agentic development practice

- Build day to day with GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, working in a spec-first way. Agree the plan, let agents implement in small increments, then review, test and refine. 
 - Set up and maintain the team's AI development workflow, including repository instruction files (for example CLAUDE. md, AGENTS. md or Copilot custom instructions), reusable agent skills, custom agents and subagents, and MCP connections to approved tools. 3 PUBLIC 
 - Build guardrails into the workflow, such as hooks and CI checks that enforce tests, linting and security scanning on AI generated code, and make sure no confidential data leaves approved boundaries. 
 - Mentor colleagues in using these tools with judgement, including recognising when an agent's output should not be trusted. 

Engineer to production standard

- Work within the bank's software development lifecycle, including version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, security scanning, clear API specifications (OpenAPI) and documentation. 
 - Design for enterprise requirements from the outset, including authentication and authorisation , auditability, resilience and supportability, and meet data protection, information security and AI risk requirements. 
 - Agree engineering standards, interfaces and production requirements with Technology colleagues so capabilities developed within the Data and Analytics Office can be deployed and supported through Technology-led processes. 
 - Set development standards and reference patterns for colleagues contributing to application development, lead design and code reviews, and mentor others to deliver to a consistent standard. 

To Be Successful You Will

- You should be able to evidence all of the following, through your portfolio and from roles in the last few years. 
 - A track record of shipping web applications to production that real users adopted, with evidence of usage or engagement. 
 - Experience at senior, staff, principal or lead level while remaining an active developer, with most of your recent time spent designing and writing code. 
 - Expert TypeScript front-end development in at least one modern component framework (we use Angular and React; Vue is also relevant), with the depth to move comfortably between them, including state management, component design, testing 
 - and performance. 
 - Production experience building and securing Python APIs, ideally with FastAPI (Flask or Django also relevant), including Pydantic validation, asynchronous programming and API design. 
 - Strong UX and UI design ability, shown through interfaces that make complex workflows or data simple to use, and the ability to design and prototype your own interfaces. 
 - Well-architected, scalable code with sound application design, performance tuning and code that others can maintain. 
 - Advanced SQL, data modelling and experience integrating multiple data sources and APIs into a coherent application. 
 - Hands-on cloud experience (Google Cloud, Azure or AWS), including Docker, deploying through CI/CD pipelines, and running applications in production. 
 - Engineering discipline covering Git, code review, automated testing (for example pytest, Playwright or framework test tools) and secure coding, including OAuth 2. 0 and OpenID Connect. 
 - Hands-on use of agentic coding tools (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor) beyond autocomplete, including planning work for agents, giving them the right context through instruction files, skills or custom agents, and reviewing and testing what they produce. 
 - A working understanding of metadata, data lineage, data quality and semantic layers, and why they matter to users. 
 - Experience collaborating across business-led data teams and Technology to move software from rapid development into secure, supported production services. 
 - Clear written and spoken English, and confidence working with senior stakeholders across time zones. 
 - Exceptional design for data applications. You make dense, complex information feel simple and obvious, and your interfaces are as polished as they are useful. 
 - Iterative, evidence-led design. You test with users, instrument usage and refine designs based on how people actually behave. 
 - Personalisation. You have built experiences that adapt to a user's role, preferences or behaviour. 
 - Code built to last. You have designed applications that scaled in users, data and features without being rewritten.

 - Also useful, but not essential - graph and relationship visualisation (for example React Flow, Cytoscape. js or D3), knowledge graphs, data catalogue or lineage tools, building LLM-enabled applications, Google Cloud specifically, and experience in financial services or another regulated environment.

data.description:
Principal Production Engineer

Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India

JOB OVERVIEW

Are you passionate about automation, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and reliability engineering? As a Principal Production Engineer at Legion, you will build and operate a secure, highly scalable, and cost-effective AWS/Kubernetes-based cloud platform. You will work across infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and production reliability. Simply put, the SRE team ensures Legion's platform is reliable, scalable, and continuously improving for our customers. 

This role includes participation in an on-call rotation. 

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

- Serve as subject matter expert for the entire production infrastructure stack and software build pipelines. 
 - Work independently on initiatives to improve security, stability, and responsiveness of Legion's applications. 
 - Train and mentor other members of the team. 
 - Collaborate across teams to share knowledge and best practices widely within the Legion organization. 
 - Support and operate Legion's AWS-based cloud platform and Kubernetes (EKS) environments. 
 - Leverage GenAI tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate infrastructure development, automation, and auto-remediation of common production issues. 
 - Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform. 
 - Develop automation and internal tooling using Go or Python. 
 - Improve CI/CD pipelines to increase deployment safety and velocity. 
 - Define and improve monitoring, alerting, and observability systems. 
 - Respond to production incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and implement systemic improvements. 
 - Develop and automate operational runbooks and remediation workflows. 
 - Support production deployments, including during off-hours as needed. 

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or SaaS production operations. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience operating large scale production workloads in AWS. 
 - Strong experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices. 
 - 5+ years of experience with containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS preferred); familiarity with Helm. 
 - Proficiency in Go or Python (or similar programming language). 
 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD systems (Git-based workflows, Argo, Jenkins or similar). 
 - Strong Linux/Unix systems experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

- Experience with observability tools such as Datadog, CloudWatch, ELK stack, Prometheus, or similar. 
 - Experience managing AWS RDS and/or Aurora MySQL including slow query analysis, replication, and upgrade operations. 
 - Experience implementing SLIs/SLOs and reliability best practices. 
 - Experience working effectively with remote, distributed teams. 
 - Experience with supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audits. 
 - AWS certification preferred. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. 

We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant's location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. 

Benefits include, but are not limited to: 

- Health Benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
 - Parental Leave 
 - Equity 
 - Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
 - Monthly Lunch on Legion

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry's most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It's proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. 

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. 

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3, 200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion's mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion's Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today's hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. 

For more information, visit https: //legion. co

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws. 

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion. co

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @legion. co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion. co

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. 

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant's location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay. 

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy ("Policy") describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. ("Legion", "we", "us" and "our") collects, uses, and discloses "personal information" as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California. 

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies. 

- Types of Personal Information We Handle

We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes: 

- Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts. 
 - Professional or employment-related information, including: 
 - Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver's licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references. 
 - Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships
 - Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information. 
 - Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history. 
 - Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application. 
 - How We Use Personal Information

We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers' business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions. 

- With Whom We Share Personal Information

We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable): 

- Internally: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process. 
 - Vendors: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable. 
 - Legal Compliance: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency. 
 - Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party. 
 - Business Transaction Purposes: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger. 
 - How to Contact Us About this Policy - If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact privacy@legion. co.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
data.description:
Overview

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to drive resiliency and engineering maturity for the Copilot Backend across Microsoft Government Clouds, including GCC-M, GCC-H, and DoD. 

The Copilot backend, powered by the Sydney orchestration platform, sits at the heart of the Copilot request pipeline, coordinating identity, orchestration, grounding, model and downstream-service calls, safety and compliance processing, persistence, and response delivery. 

Deploying this platform into Government Clouds is significantly more complex than progressing the same capabilities through the Worldwide environment. Each Government Cloud is effectively a distinct deployment environment with its own infrastructure boundaries, security controls, data-residency requirements, identity configuration, certificates, service endpoints, telemetry and compliance validation. A Worldwide approval cannot simply be assumed to cover Government Clouds, and security and threat-model validation may need to be completed independently for GCC-M, GCC-H, and DoD. 

Sydney also depends on several downstream services to complete an end-to-end Copilot request. Government Cloud readiness therefore requires more than deploying Sydney itself. Authentication and app registrations, dedicated endpoints, certificates, environment-specific configuration, routing and isolation, downstream-service readiness, telemetry, monitors, and capacity all need to function correctly within each cloud boundary. 

In this role, you will own the engineering work required to make this entire pipeline robust and repeatable. You will design and implement mechanisms that allow Copilot capabilities proven in Worldwide to safely progress through Government Clouds, replacing fragile and manual processes with reliable engineering systems for deployment, certification, validation, monitoring, rollback, and live-site operations. 

You Will

- Design and implement resilient deployment and certification pipelines for Copilot Backend capabilities across GCC-M, GCC-H, and DoD. 
 - Build cloud-aware automation for configuration, flight progression, validation, telemetry, alerting, and release health while respecting Government Cloud security and compliance boundaries. 
 - Identify and eliminate parity gaps between Worldwide and Government Clouds, including problems involving dependencies, identity, certificates, routing, capacity, monitoring, and operational readiness. 
 - Partner with feature and platform teams to establish a repeatable path from Worldwide release to Government Cloud production, rather than solving each Government Cloud deployment as a one-off engineering exercise. 
 - Bring Government Cloud environments toward the same engineering maturity as Worldwide by extending telemetry, alerts, live-site practices, and incident-response capabilities across the deployment rings. 
 - Design for failure: define health gates, rollback mechanisms, dependency validation, and observability so that failures are detected early and releases can progress safely. 
 - Work closely with security and compliance stakeholders to ensure engineering solutions satisfy cloud-specific compliance requirements without sacrificing deployment velocity. 

What makes this role challenging

This is not simply a deployment role. The core engineering challenge is to build a Government Cloud release and resiliency platform that makes compliance a property of the pipeline rather than a recurring manual obstacle. 

Today, progressing capabilities through Government Clouds can involve cloud-specific dependencies, configurations, certification, telemetry and operational steps. The opportunity for this position is to turn those requirements into a robust engineering system where a capability can move from Worldwide through GCC-M, GCC-H and DoD with clear readiness signals, automated validation, strong observability and predictable failure handling. 

Success in this role means that Government Cloud reliability and feature availability no longer depend on heroic manual effort. Instead, Copilot Backend has a secure, compliant, observable and repeatable pipeline for safely shipping and operating capabilities across every supported cloud. 

Responsibilities

- Own Government Cloud resiliency for Copilot Backend. 
 - Build a robust WW-to-Gov deployment pipeline. 
 - Engineer compliance into the release process. 
 - Drive reliability and operational parity with Worldwide. 
 - Improve certification and release validation. 
 - Own end-to-end dependency readiness. 
 - Design for failures and safe recovery. 
 - Eliminate cloud-specific toil. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
 - OR equivalent experience. 
Preferred Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering and solid technical skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Solid software engineering experience building and operating large-scale distributed backend services. 
 - Solid understanding of cloud architecture, deployment systems, service reliability, observability, and incident management. 
 - Experience designing automated CI/CD, validation, release-gating, and rollback mechanisms for production services. 
 - Ability to diagnose complex failures spanning services, infrastructure, networking, authentication, configuration, and downstream dependencies. 
 - Experience operating services in security- or compliance-sensitive environments; Government Cloud experience is a plus but not required. 
 - Solid engineering judgment with the ability to turn ambiguous reliability problems into simple, scalable, and durable platform solutions. 
 - Proven ability to drive technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and influence architecture and engineering practices without direct ownership of every dependency. 

#CAP #Copilot

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration-enabling users to create better APIs, faster. 

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman. com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 

P. S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. 

About The Team

Product Trust team ensures Postman is a safe and trusted platform for our customers. This team is responsible for building security features within the Postman ecosystem - from deciding what the product should look like to building and delivering it. Product Trust independently deliver solutions to address the security, compliance and governance needs of our customers. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptional Engineering Leader to build the next generation of our security offerings in the Postman product. You'll be accountable for strategy, technical roadmap and architecture of the platform. You should work with the team members and be involved in their professional growth path with best alignment for organization goals. You'll work with multiple teams within Postman overseeing and contributing to delivery and owning critical KPIs such as availability and uptime. 

The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with attention to detail and a relentless drive for quality. They should be comfortable being very hands on and at the same being able to uplevel and provide high level guidance for others to execute. They should also be strong communicators who can influence other leaders. Finally, they should have strong industry knowledge and bring best practices from the broader industry to the Postman's security and trust offerings. 

What You'll Do

- Engineering and Technical LeadershipProvide technical leadership for the architecture and help the teams build highly secure, scalable, reliable and performant systems that can cater to the needs of hundreds of millions of developersWork with Staff and principle engineers to to identify and review key technical designs to ensure consistency with architecture and support for the businessLead the team to deliver on multiple projects in collaboration with key stakeholdersBuild an operational center of excellence with effective observability, considerations for scale and performance and focus on quality
 - Prioritization and RoadmapPartner with other engineering leaders within the org and product leaders within the companyHelp the teams prioritize work and create a balanced roadmap
 - CollaborationWork closely with senior leadership to drive org design, set and execute the roadmap and influence the strategyCollaborate with cross functional teams to align on goals, drive engineering initiatives, and create broad organizational impactRegularly communicate progress, challenges, and strategic initiatives with senior leadership, providing updates on the team's success and security posture. 
 - People ManagementHave regular 1: 1s with team members, understand what motivates and challenges them and craft a professional growth path keeping in best alignment with organization goals. Provide regular feedback, coaching and support for team members to create maximum impact. Build a high performance and cohesive team. 

About You

- 10+ years of experience developing complex, distributed software applications at Postman's scale. Proficient with one or more programming languages (Javascript, NodeJS, Java)
 - 3 years of experience in leading, mentoring, and managing a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and fostering career development. 
 - Strong experience with security offerings such as vault store, token scanning, cryptography etc. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects with a meaningful impact on the business
 - Exceptional problem solving, design, and analytical skills
 - Demonstrated experience designing highly scalable systems

If you're a leader with a strong passion for scaling engineering, eager to lead platform development, and ready to address the challenges of secure, high-performance infrastructure? Step into the role of Engineering Manager at Postman and play a pivotal part in shaping the future of API development for millions of developers and agents worldwide!

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. 

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.
