data.title: Supervisor, Global Sample Solutions
data.description:
Position Summary

The Supervisor, Global Sample Solutions is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the day-to-day activities of the Global Sample Solutions Site Outreach team. The role ensures timely resolution of sample discrepancies, effective site outreach, accurate data investigations and discrepancy resolution. 

The Supervisor provides operational guidance, training, workload prioritization, and escalation support to Global Sample Solutions Specialists. This position monitors key performance indicators (KPIs), turnaround time (TAT), quality, and backlog aging while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence. 

Essential Functions Of The Job

Team Leadership & Operational Oversight

- Lead, mentor, and support Global Sample Solutions Specialists responsible for site outreach, discrepancy resolution, and study support activities. 
 - This role will provide direct supervisory oversight for assigned team members. 
 - Coordinate daily workload assignments and priorities to ensure timely follow-up and closure of open discrepancies. 
 - Monitor team productivity, quality, KPIs, service-level expectations, and backlog aging; communicate risks and recovery plans to leadership. 
 - Serve as the primary escalation point for complex discrepancy investigations, customer communication challenges, and cross-functional operational issues. 
 - Provide onboarding, role-specific training, coaching, and ongoing development for team members. 
 - Conduct routine workload and quality reviews and identify opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and compliance. 
 - Partner with leadership to support resource planning, workload forecasting, and operational readiness. 
 - Role requires flexibility to support global time zones, including overlap with U. S. business hours as business needs require. 

Customer/Site Outreach, Discrepancy Tracking & Resolution

- Maintain global oversight of unresolved discrepancies identified by internal sample management teams for incoming and outgoing shipments. 
 - Ensure adherence to project-specific communication plans, established outreach timelines, documentation standards, and escalation procedures. 
 - Liaise with sites, sponsors, CROs, clients, and internal teams to obtain missing information and facilitate timely discrepancy resolution. 
 - Review complex or high-impact discrepancies and guide the team on appropriate resolution actions. 
 - Ensure resolution actions are clearly documented and communicated to meet customer and business deliverables for TAT. 
 - Monitor first, second, and final outreach activities, including shipment tracking information and response status, to ensure appropriate follow-up. 
 - Monitor discrepancy aging and trends and implement recovery or corrective action plans when performance is at risk. 
 - Provide oversight for study close-out activities, including data review, outstanding query resolution, reconciliation support, and sample disposition follow-up. 
 - Independently prioritizes daily workload, resolves routine operational issues, and escalates high-impact risks to leadership. 

Database Troubleshooting & Data Resolution Support

- Provide oversight for unresolved sample data requests, reconciliation queries, and database-related discrepancies. 
 - Coordinate with internal stakeholders to investigate, document, and implement approved corrections for data modifications or errors. 
 - Support reconciliation between source documentation, sample inventory systems, clinical databases, EDC systems, and client-provided data, as applicable. 
 - Ensure sufficient documentation and audit trails are maintained for data corrections and resolution activities. 
 - Escalate system or process issues that may affect data integrity, operational timelines, or customer deliverables. 

Quality Control & Compliance

- Ensure team activities comply with company SOPs, study-specific requirements, documented procedures, and applicable quality standards. 
 - Oversee or perform quality control reviews of outreach documentation, discrepancy resolution records, and data updates. 
 - Review quality findings and coordinate corrective actions, retraining, or process updates as needed. 
 - Maintain audit-ready documentation and support internal audits, client audits, and regulatory inspections, as required. 
 - Demonstrate behavior consistent with company values and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's degree in life sciences, clinical research, healthcare administration, business, or a related field preferred. 
 - An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered. 

Experience

- Six or more years of relevant experience in sample management, clinical trial operations, laboratory operations, data management, project coordination, or a related environment preferred. 
 - Two or more years of experience leading people, projects, workflows, or operational initiatives preferred. 
 - Experience with customer- or site-facing communications, discrepancy management, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Experience working with biospecimen inventory systems, clinical databases, reconciliation activities, or operational reporting tools preferred. 

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong leadership, coaching, workload management, and team development skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to manage sensitive or escalated customer interactions professionally. 
 - Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving capabilities with consistent attention to detail. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities, changing deadlines, and global stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear actions. 
 - Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, reporting tools, and operational dashboards. 
 - Strong knowledge of data integrity, documentation, and quality principles. 
 - Ability to work effectively across global teams and time zones.

Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients. 

About Leggett & Platt:

The company serves customers across industries through its expertise in bedding, furniture, flooring, specialty products, and comfort technologies. Driven by a mindset of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, Leggett & Platt has spent more than 140 years creating solutions that support everyday comfort and help people live and work better. 

Leggett & Platt, Incorporated is seeking to hire a Software Systems Architect to engineer new solutions across a range of software and firmware projects and systems, and to organize and coordinate design, development, integration, and testing of separate components of those systems. What you'll do: 

- Interface with project stakeholders and managers to determine project requirements and establish a software architecture design to accomplish the goals and requirements, and use understanding of existing systems and corporate needs to extrapolate and plan for potential future extensions and requirements

Minimum qualifications: 

- B. S. Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
 - Experience with a range of programming languages and an understanding of their relative strengths and weaknesses (including C, C#, C++, Python, JavaScript/Node. JS, SQL, Rust)
 - Experience with a range of software technologies, frameworks, operating systems, libraries, and platforms (such as bare-metal, embedded OS, PC, mobile, and cloud SaaS/PaaS) and an understanding of their strengths and weaknesses
 - Experience with developing software systems that include and integrate multiple platforms developed both internally and externally, including embedded firmware, microcontrollers, hardware drivers, PC software, user interfaces, mobile applications, libraries, devices, web technologies, and infrastructure
 - Understanding of optimized data structures, data storage, databases, communication protocols, serialization, RPCs and APIs, and other software interoperation primitives and best practices
 - Understanding of modern software design principals, tools for CI/CD, automated testing, linting, software review and release best practices, etc. 
 - Understanding of best practices in source code management and tracking of software projects, and related processes and tools such as Agile, DevOps, Git, CI/CD

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Understanding of computer architecture and optimization techniques
 - Demonstrated experience working with stakeholders and other engineers across multiple disciplines, and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
 - Experience with cloud services on AWS and Azure
 - Experience with embedded development on multiple platforms and architectures (including x86, ARM, RISC, MIPS, 8051, XC32) and cross-platform and cross-architecture portability
 - Knowledge of PCB design fundamentals and selection of embedded components
 - 8+ years software and firmware design and development experienceIf you enjoy breaking down complex problems into smaller tasks and finding optimized solutions, this might be the perfect opportunity for you. We encourage a culture of innovation, support internal growth and value continuous improvement. We are seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to bring value and growth to our strong electrical engineering team. 

Who we are and what we offer: 

Our comprehensive benefits package includes: management incentive bonus, medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, stock plans, tuition reimbursement, employee discounts and more. Since 1883, Leggett & Platt (NYSE: LEG) has been creating a wide variety of innovative products that can be found in most homes, offices, and automobiles. Today our growing company consists of more than 23, 000 employee-partners in 120 manufacturing facilities located in 19 countries. We're not just hiring, we're building a better company.

Description

Join a team building the future of automated compliance in the product space. Your work will directly affect how safely and efficiently Amazon serves customers and partners around the world. You will lead a team of engineers who design and build software that works across use cases, products and geographies. Your team will build scalable distributed systems for compliance workflows that are highly available, low latency and built for quality at every layer. 

You will own a suite of tools that power automated, scalable compliance and verification processing, so that Amazon shoppers and sellers get a frictionless and trustworthy experience. You will work in an Agile environment and partner with product management and cross-functional teams to iterate quickly and raise the bar for end users. We want someone with strong technical, project and people skills, a can-do attitude and a focus on delivering high-quality software. 

Key job responsibilities

Lead, hire and grow a team of software engineers that builds highly secure, scalable and fault-tolerant distributed systems for compliance and verification, using cloud computing technologies

Own the full development lifecycle and deliver complex, cross-team projects from start to launch

Build a long-term strategy for the team's compliance platforms and turn it into an achievable roadmap, working with product managers and security engineers

Make sound design decisions on product features and technology choices, and guide engineers on architecture, scalability and security

Scope and justify resource and budget needs to senior leaders and finance partners

Set and promote best practices for software development, documentation and code quality

Manage prioritization, feature planning, stakeholder communication and tracking of commitments

Drive operational excellence and security through monitoring and running production services

Is technically credible enough to lead a team of strong software engineers and make the right design and technology decisions

Understands the systems development life cycle and its methodologies (agile, waterfall, iterative)

Has built and managed teams that deliver scalable, extensible distributed systems for complex business problems

Focuses consistently on operational excellence and system security

Has experience with open source technologies, object-oriented design and agile development

Your day is a mix of people leadership and technical depth. You will set priorities with product and business stakeholders, review designs for your team's most critical features, and coach engineers through trade-offs in architecture, scalability and security. You will run sprint planning and project reviews, unblock dependencies with partner teams, and keep a close eye on operational health. You will also spend time hiring, mentoring and developing your engineers' careers, and give leadership clear updates on progress, risks and product direction.

Our team builds and operates software systems that directly impact how Amazon serves its customers. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and a genuine commitment to each other's growth.  - Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Kake is a remote-first company and a people-first global community of senior engineers. Kake engineers are behind some of the world's most innovative products (Brands you've heard!), from Fortune 500 to fast-growing companies. We believe it's not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. Our community spans 45, 000+ engineers across 55+ countries; join a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive (and love eating kake!). 

We're looking for Senior Fullstack Engineers specializing in Ruby on Rails, skilled in delivering elegant, performant, and maintainable web applications for fast-paced, consumer-facing products. It's a great fit for people who enjoy owning features end-to-end with a "doer" mentality, keeping the full product vision in mind, and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to ship high-quality code at speed. 

What you'll build and own

- Build and ship production features end-to-end across Ruby on Rails backends and TypeScript/React frontends, owning your work from implementation through deployment.

 - Migrate legacy components to a modern, rebranded UI while ensuring high design-to-dev fidelity.

 - Write clean, well-tested code with a strong focus on performance, maintainability, and code quality. 
 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders in agile teams, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term product goals. 

Core Requirements

- 5+ years of professional experience in fullstack development, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade software.

 - Demonstrated experience executing website rebrandings and migrating legacy components to a modern UI with high design-to-dev fidelity. 
 - Proven ability to orchestrate complex backend payment flows, including the integration of third-party payment processing systems. 
 - Strong understanding of API design and the long-tail technical work associated with data transfers. 
 - Excellent understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management, and performance optimization. 
 - Solid experience with unit testing, strong product sense, and a high-agency "doer" mentality with the ability to own features end-to-end. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment. 

Nice-to-Have

data.title: Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst, Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC)
data.description:
Description

The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate- Quality Analyst is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies. 

Key job responsibilities

Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include: 

- Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets. 
 - Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities. 
 - Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc. ). 
 - Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
 - Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
 - Expertise in research - finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner. 
 - Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis. 
 - Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations. 
 - Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

Skills

- Proficiency in verbal & written communication in English
 - Good working knowledge of MS Office, MS Outlook; MS Excel. Proficiency is an advantage. 
 - Strong attention to details. 
 - Ability to analyze and identify patterns in large data sets. 
 - Decision making aptitudes based on given guidelines and in ambiguous contexts. 
 - Must be comfortable working with large data sets. 
 - Very good knowledge and experience in internet navigation and research - finding specific information about products in a timely manner. 

About The Team

Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being "the world's most customer centric company. " Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners' needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas. 

The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon's product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon's worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
 - Speak, write, and read fluently in English
 - Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
 - Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage
 - 1+ years of data-driven business operations processes experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
 - Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
 - Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management / FMCG company / Corporate role
 - Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
 - Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
 - Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. data.title: Architect/ Senior Architect-Backend
data.description:
Who We Are

Simpplr is the AI-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. Powered by a proprietary EX Knowledge Graph, Simpplr synthesizes signals and context across connected systems to deliver personalized information and actions. The platform serves as a digital hub supporting communications, engagement, employee services, and work. With low-code extensibility and enterprise-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1, 000 organizations - including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna - trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr. com. 

Architect /Sr Architect

Location-Gurgaon

The Opportunity

Simpplr is looking for a Backend Architect to design and build scalable systems that power our next generation of intelligent, AI-enabled products. 

In this role, you will be responsible for architecting AI platforms and backend systems, working across microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data models and graph databases. You will partner closely with engineering, product and AI teams to build reliable systems that can represent complex relationships between people, content, entities and enterprise data. 

This is a hands-on architecture role for someone who has strong backend engineering fundamentals and has practical experience designing or building Knowledge Graphs using graph databases such as Neo4j. 

You will design systems that connect four perspectives of an enterprise: 

- Company Graph: People, teams, roles, permissions, applications, and organizational relationships. 
 - Knowledge Graph: The entities, concepts, facts, and relationships found in enterprise content. 
 - Business Event Graph: Actions, state changes, and events over time. 
 - Telemetry Graph: How agents, workflows, tools, and services execute and perform. 

These graphs share identities and provide context for enterprise search, RAG, and intelligent agents. This role calls for someone who can move from business questions to sound data models, APIs, and production systems-and who enjoys building and reviewing the implementation. 

What You'll Do

- Define the architecture and technical direction. 
 - Design scalable and highly available backend architectures, microservices and distributed systems. 
 - Design Knowledge Graph data models, entity relationships, ontologies and graph schemas. 
 - Design APIs and services that enable applications to consume and interact with data. 
 - Work on entity modeling, relationship modeling, entity resolution and graph traversal. 
 - Design data ingestion and transformation pipelines to build and continuously update the Knowledge Graph from multiple enterprise data sources. 
 - Define approaches for graph data quality, consistency, scalability and performance optimization. 
 - Architect integrations across enterprise systems, APIs and data platforms. 
 - Design and review HLD/LLD, system architecture, API contracts and technical specifications. 
 - Work with AWS services and cloud-native technologies to build scalable and resilient platforms. 
 - Collaborate with AI/ML and product teams to make Knowledge Graph capabilities consumable by search, RAG and intelligent/AI-powered applications. 
 - Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design discussions and mentoring of senior engineers. 
 - Identify technical risks, scalability bottlenecks and architectural improvements across the platform. 

What We're Looking For

- 12+ years of experience in backend engineering and software architecture, with significant experience designing large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Java, Python, Go or similar backend technologies. 
 - Proven experience designing microservices, distributed systems and API-driven architectures. 
 - Strong experience with AWS and cloud-native architecture. 
 - Hands-on experience with Knowledge Graphs and graph databases, preferably Neo4j. 
 - Experience designing data ingestion pipelines that transform structured/unstructured enterprise data into graph models. 
 - Strong understanding of relational , NoSQL databases, data modeling and distributed data systems. 
 - Experience designing highly scalable and fault-tolerant backend platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, event-driven architecture, messaging and asynchronous processing. 
 - Experience with system design, architecture patterns, scalability, performance and reliability. 
 - Ability to translate complex business and data requirements into scalable technical architecture. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with AWS, including designing secure, highly available, and cost-conscious production systems. 

Good to Have

- Experience building systems for enterprise search, semantic search, RAG or AI-powered applications. 
 - Understanding of ontologies, taxonomy, entity resolution and semantic relationships. 
 - Experience integrating Knowledge Graphs with LLM/RAG or Agentic AI systems. 
 - Experience with technologies such as Kafka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Spark or similar data platforms. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads. 
 - Exposure to data governance, security, tenant isolation and enterprise SaaS architecture. 
 - Experience working in a B2B SaaS / enterprise product environment. 
 - DevOps skills: Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation, monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting. 

Your Voice, Unfiltered

We value the real you. To ensure a fair and authentic experience for everyone, we ask that you do not use AI tools (such as real-time answer generators, transcription apps, or note-taking bots) during your interview

Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We're excited to meet the person behind the resume!

If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e. g. , live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience. 

Simpplr's Hub-Hybrid-Remote Model

At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub-Hybrid-Remote model. This model is role-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want. 

- Hub - 100% work from Simpplr office. Role requires Simpplifier to be in the office full-time. 
 - Hybrid - Hybrid work from home and office. Role dictates the ability to work from home, plus benefit from in-person collaboration on a regular basis. 
 - Remote - 100% remote. Role can be done anywhere within your country of hire, as long as the requirements of the role are met.

We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead teams delivering enterprise applications, APIs, cloud-native integrations and modernization initiatives across business platforms. Integration strategy: Drive scalable integration approaches using REST APIs, SOAP services, middleware, event-driven messaging, webhooks, batch/file interfaces and reusable abstraction layers. 

Enterprise and SaaS integrations: Lead integrations involving enterprise and SaaS platforms, including master data, business processes, security, reconciliation, auditability, retries, error handling and system-of-record boundaries. 

Business platforms: Support business-system integrations, ensuring consistent API contracts, data ownership, synchronization, observability and operational support models.

Quality and DevOps: Establish CI/CD quality gates, automated unit/integration/regression testing, release readiness, observability, incident learning, production support and measurable reliability improvements.

Experience with OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, JWT, authentication, authorization, secrets management, throttling and rate limiting. 

Strong SQL, relational database, data modeling, query optimization, data migration and reconciliation experience. 

Demonstrated ability to manage roadmaps, staffing, dependencies, delivery risks, production issues and executive stakeholder communication. 

Experience with Agile delivery, GitHub/GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability and production operations. 

Experience establishing engineering standards, coaching engineers, handling performance and development conversations, and building succession plans. 

Practical experience using GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot or GenAI tools responsibly within the engineering lifecycle. 

Excellent Communication, Influencing, Prioritization And Cross-functional Leadership Skills. Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of Azure Integration Services, including API Management, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid and Key Vault, with equivalent AWS services considered valuable. 

Cloud, Agile, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce or engineering leadership certifications. 

Experience leading distributed or hybrid teams and collaborating with global architecture and engineering organizations. 

Exposure to FinOps, vendor management, capacity planning and budget accountability.

The Job

Booking. com Insurance protects a trip and the experience around it. The business is growing a global set of insurance products with industry partners, and the post-booking experience is where customers see their cover, their policy details, and what to do when something changes. 

As a Backend Software Engineer II on the Insurance Post-Booking team in Bengaluru, you will build and run backend services for Booking. com Insurance. Your main focus is the insurance experience on Android, iOS, and web, including post-booking journeys such as policy details and confirmation. Much of this work is in Kotlin and Spring Boot on AWS. You are part of the wider Insurance engineering group and will contribute to other insurance services when that work is needed. You will partner with mobile and web engineers, product, and other insurance teams. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, and operate the GraphQL APIs behind insurance post-booking experiences. 
 - Integrate with insurance and platform services, and keep a stable contract for Android, iOS, and web. 
 - Own the service in production: latency, errors, SLOs, observability, and safe releases. 
 - Shape the service design as new post-booking journeys are added, keeping changes incremental and reversible. 
 - Raise quality through testing, simpler design, and technical-debt work, and support less experienced engineers. 
 - Turn requests from product and partner teams into a clear technical plan. 

What You Will Bring

- 5 or more years building backend services on the JVM, in Kotlin or Java. 
 - Practical experience with Spring Boot and with designing APIs. GraphQL is a core part of this service. 
 - Experience running a service in production, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, monitoring, and SLOs. 
 - Experience with AWS or a similar cloud, and with containers. 
 - Working knowledge of relational databases and of handling customer data carefully. 
 - Clear written and spoken communication with teams in other time zones.

data.title: Test Lead RP
data.description:
About The Role

Resmed is transforming its global Supply Chain planning and procurement capabilities to improve decision-making, responsiveness, resilience and continuity of patient supply. 

We are looking for a Test Lead - Planning & Procurement to own the quality engineering and test assurance capability across the technology landscape supporting demand planning, supply planning, Integrated Business Planning (IBP) and procurement. 

This is a quality leadership role spanning o9 Solutions, Oracle, planning and procurement data, integrations, analytics and enabling technologies. You will define and deliver the Planning & Procurement domain test approach, aligned with the Supply Chain portfolio test strategy and risk-based testing framework, align domain test capacity and priorities, lead internal and partner test engineers, and provide objective release-readiness assurance to the Technical Product Owners and Business Partner. 

Importantly, this role is broader than test execution or test automation alone. You will be accountable for how quality is planned, evidenced and continuously improved across the end-to-end business capability, including where platforms, data and integrations connect. 

What You'll Do

Quality Engineering Strategy & Leadership

- Own the Planning & Procurement quality engineering approach and improvement roadmap, aligned with the Supply Chain portfolio test strategy, standards and governance framework. 
 - Translate product roadmaps, business outcomes, solution risk and regulatory obligations into proportionate test approaches and quality gates. 
 - Lead, coach and align internal, contingent and partner test engineers, creating clear priorities, ownership, delivery expectations and development pathways. 
 - Establish a consistent domain operating rhythm for test demand, capacity, progress, risks, decisions and outcomes across concurrent initiatives and production changes, integrated with portfolio reporting and governance. 

Risk-Based Test Planning & Assurance

- Apply the portfolio risk-based testing framework to define domain test strategies covering functional, integration, data, regression, performance, security, validation and business-readiness testing as appropriate. 
 - Ensure test depth and evidence are proportionate to business criticality, patient and product risk, supply-continuity impact, change complexity and failure modes. 
 - Define change-specific test entry and exit criteria, traceability expectations, defect thresholds and evidence requirements within portfolio minimum standards, and assure compliance. 
 - Independently assess test coverage, results, residual risk and unresolved defects, and provide clear release-readiness recommendations. 

End-to-End Planning & Procurement Quality

- Assure critical end-to-end scenarios across o9, Oracle, upstream and downstream systems, enterprise data, integrations, master data and analytics. 
 - Protect business-critical planning and procurement processes through reusable scenario libraries and regression coverage across platform and release boundaries. 
 - Ensure reconciliation, data quality, lineage, controls and exception handling are appropriately tested, including full and incremental data loads. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders to ensure testing reflects real operational use, planning decisions and justified regional or regulatory variation. 

Test Delivery, Capacity & Partner Management

- Own the detailed Planning & Procurement test plans and test backlog across product releases, projects, defects, upgrades, technical debt and service improvements, aligned with the integrated portfolio test roadmap. 
 - Plan, allocate and sequence Planning & Procurement test capacity within agreed product and portfolio priorities and capacity constraints, escalating material resource conflicts and capability gaps through portfolio test governance. 
 - Hold managed service providers, system integrators and contingent resources accountable for test quality, productivity, evidence, knowledge transfer and delivery commitments. 
 - Provide transparent reporting on coverage, execution, defects, blockers, capacity, residual risk and readiness, escalating where quality or delivery is at risk. 

Regression, Automation & Tooling

- Own the Planning & Procurement regression and automation implementation roadmap, aligned with portfolio automation principles and investment priorities, including what should be automated, why, when and how benefits will be measured. 
 - Prioritize automation based on repeatability, business criticality, risk reduction, execution frequency, maintenance cost and return on investment. 
 - Guide the design of maintainable automation frameworks, reusable test data and continuous testing integrated with delivery and release pipelines. 
 - Ensure automation assets are governed, versioned, supportable and maintained as products and processes evolve. 

Defect Management & Release Quality

- Lead domain defect triage and quality forums, ensuring defects are clearly evidenced, appropriately prioritized and driven through verification and closure; escalate material, systemic or cross-domain defects through portfolio test governance. 
 - Identify systemic quality issues and recurring failure patterns, and work with Technical Product Owners, Technical Leads, Architecture and vendors on prevention and remediation. 
 - Provide an evidence-based Planning & Procurement quality recommendation for release decisions and, where applicable, provide the domain test assurance input into the consolidated portfolio test readiness assessment, while the Technical Product Owner retains product and release accountability. 
 - Support hypercare and production issue analysis by confirming test gaps, regression impact and the adequacy of corrective action. 

Compliance, Validation & Audit Readiness

- Partner with Quality, Regulatory and validation teams to apply computer software assurance and risk-based validation principles. 
 - Ensure test plans, traceability, evidence, approvals and defect records meet change-control, data-integrity and audit requirements. 
 - Maintain the validated state of relevant systems and ensure changes made under delivery or production pressure remain appropriately controlled. 
 - Support supplier controls and audits relating to test services delivered by technology partners. 

Capability Building & Continuous Improvement

- Build and retain Resmed knowledge of Planning and Procurement processes, systems, integrations, test risks and reusable quality assets. 
 - Define practical metrics that show quality and risk, not only test activity, and use them to improve decision-making and delivery performance. 
 - Coach product, engineering, analysis and business teams to build quality in early through testable requirements, acceptance criteria and design reviews. 
 - Champion consistent standards, reuse, evidence-based decisions and continuous improvement across the quality engineering practice. 

What You Bring

- Extensive experience leading enterprise testing, quality engineering or test assurance across complex applications, systems and integrations. 
 - Demonstrated people leadership experience, including the ability to direct blended teams of permanent employees, contingent workers, system integrators and managed service providers. 
 - Strong practical knowledge of risk-based testing, test strategy, test design, defect management, traceability, quality gates and release assurance. 
 - Experience coordinating functional, integration, system integration, user acceptance, regression and automation testing. 
 - Experience establishing consistent testing processes, governance standards and repeatable ways of working. 
 - Strong resource and capacity planning skills across multiple projects or product releases. 
 - Demonstrated experience building maintainable regression and automation capabilities. 
 - Experience working in Agile, product or complex enterprise delivery environments across discovery, design, build, integration, validation, deployment and hypercare. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, influencing, communication and decision-making skills. 
 - The ability to remain sufficiently hands-on to review testing approaches, challenge coverage, assess evidence and guide technical delivery. 
 - A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations or a related discipline. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with o9 Solutions and Oracle ERP supply chain capabilities. 
 - Knowledge of demand planning, constrained supply planning, scenario modelling, allocation, procurement, source-to-pay and exception-based planning. 
 - Experience validating APIs, batch and event-driven integrations, cloud data platforms, data pipelines and analytical consumption. 
 - Experience with modern test management, automation, performance and CI/CD tooling. Examples may include Jira/Xray or Azure DevOps, Playwright or Selenium, API test tools, JMeter and pipeline-based execution. 
 - ISTQB Advanced Test Manager, Agile Test Leadership, quality engineering, supply chain or relevant professional certification. 
 - Experience building quality engineering capability and reusable assets across multiple products, releases or business units. 
 - Experience in regulated manufacturing, medical devices, life sciences or another quality-controlled environment. 

Why Join Resmed

This is an opportunity to shape and lead the quality capability supporting global, business-critical planning and procurement technology. You will work across supply chain, product leadership, engineering, data, quality and enterprise technology, helping ensure that platforms, data and integrations operate as one reliable end-to-end ecosystem. 

The processes, capability and release confidence you establish will contribute to a more resilient supply chain and help maintain the availability of Resmed products for the people who need them. 

Joining Resmed means building a career that is challenging, supportive and purposeful. We aim to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where people can contribute their ideas, develop their capabilities and do meaningful work. 

Joining us is more than saying "yes" to making the world a healthier place. It's discovering a career that's challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

Job Description

We are hiring an Extensions Lead with 10+ years of overall experience and an Extensions Architect with 15+ years of overall experience. Both roles require hands-on capability in AI driven delivery, Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VBS), Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle APEX, and applied AI. 

Responsibilities

Extensions Architect

Shape Oracle Fusion extension architectures and guide AI-driven delivery. 

About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS)

Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes. 

Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value. 

Why join CSS?

- Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem. 
 - Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver. 
 - Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio. 
 - Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment. 
 - Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning. 

AI Studio

The AI Studio helps customers turn AI opportunities into working solutions using embedded AI in Oracle applications, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI services, and Oracle database capabilities. The team identifies valuable use cases, develops and evaluates prototypes, and supports integration, adoption, and scale. Work can include AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence, and intelligent automation, with attention to security, governance, and measurable business value. Join the Studio to combine Oracle expertise with practical AI engineering and help customers embed intelligence into everyday work. 

Role Overview

As Extensions Architect, you will define end-to-end architectures for Oracle Fusion SaaS extensions, integrations, and applications with AI capabilities. You will connect customer outcomes with platform decisions, establish reusable patterns, and guide complex solutions from discovery through production. This hands-on role combines deep expertise in Oracle Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX with practical AI architecture and leadership of AI-assisted engineering. Working with business and technology stakeholders, delivery teams, other Studios, and Product Development, you will define solution boundaries, nonfunctional requirements, roadmaps, and architectural tradeoffs. You will validate critical designs through prototypes and reviews, guide consistent implementation, and shape technical proposals and estimates. The role suits an experienced architect who can influence senior customer stakeholders, mentor technical leads and engineers, and balance security, operational needs, cost, and performance while demonstrating customer value and measurable delivery improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead architecture discovery with business and technology stakeholders to define target architectures, solution boundaries, nonfunctional requirements, delivery roadmaps, and measures of business value. 
 - Select Fusion configuration, Redwood and VBS extensions, APEX applications, OIC integrations, and OCI services, documenting tradeoffs in maintainability, security, cost, performance, and resilience. 
 - Design end-to-end application, integration, API, and data flows across Oracle Fusion ERP, SCM, HCM, and external systems using supported interfaces and patterns that accommodate SaaS updates. 
 - Establish repeatable AI-assisted practices across analysis, development, testing, review, documentation, and delivery automation to improve engineering consistency and productivity. 
 - Architect assistants, RAG solutions, and agent workflows, defining model and service selection, knowledge access, tool invocation, orchestration, evaluation, and human approval for consequential actions. 
 - Own cross-cutting architecture for identity, authorization, data isolation, secrets, auditability, performance, availability, disaster recovery, observability, and AI cost and latency controls to meet operational needs. 
 - Validate high-risk assumptions through hands-on prototypes and code reviews; lead architecture reviews and resolve complex design issues to guide implementation and production readiness. 
 - Create reference architectures and reusable accelerators, set engineering and AI evaluation standards, and mentor Leads and engineers to support consistent adoption across engagements. 
 - Shape presales solutions, estimates, assumptions, and technical proposals; present architecture and value to customer leaders, collaborate across Studios and Product Development, and contribute technical thought leadership. 

Skills - Mandatory

Education

- Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, MCA, or equivalent practical experience. 

Experience

- 15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial responsibility for enterprise application and integration architecture. A record of owning architecture across multiple Oracle extension projects through production delivery is required. 

Oracle Products

- Visual Builder Studio: Deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VBS), Visual Builder, Redwood extensibility, Oracle JET, JavaScript or TypeScript, and extension lifecycle management. Ability to define modular UI patterns, service contracts, repositories, and CI/CD standards. 
 - Oracle Integration Cloud: Deep expertise in OIC architecture, adapters, orchestration, REST and SOAP APIs, asynchronous and event-based integration, bulk processing, security, monitoring, and recovery. Ability to design for idempotency, throughput, API limits, and operational support. 
 - Oracle APEX: Strong hands-on expertise and architectural judgment in APEX, Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, ORDS, data modeling, application security, performance, and deployment. Ability to explain when APEX or VBS is appropriate and how each connects to Fusion and OCI. 

Technical Skills

- AI driven delivery: Demonstrated leadership in applying AI assistants and agents across the software lifecycle. Ability to define context and prompt practices, automated workflows, human review, quality gates, and measurement of productivity, rework, defects, and business value. 
 - AI architecture and knowledge: Practical experience architecting solutions using large language models, embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, tool use, agent orchestration, and OCI Generative AI or comparable services. Strong understanding of model evaluation, grounding, prompt injection defenses, data boundaries, human oversight, latency, and cost tradeoffs. 
 - Enterprise architecture and influence: Strong knowledge of Fusion extensibility and APIs, OCI architecture, SSO, OAuth, RBAC, data security, API management, and DevOps. Ability to define nonfunctional requirements, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, estimate complex work, and communicate with technical teams and senior customer stakeholders. 

Good to Have

- Experience with Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, MCP, agent interoperability, Python, or agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain. 
 - Relevant Oracle architecture or AI certifications; experience shaping service offerings, reusable intellectual property, or technical publications. 

Self Assessment Questions

Before applying, please consider the following questions: 

- Do I have at least 15 years of overall IT experience, substantial enterprise application and integration architecture responsibility, and a record of owning architecture across multiple Oracle extension projects through production? 
 - Can I demonstrate deep hands-on expertise in VBS, Visual Builder, Redwood extensibility, Oracle JET, JavaScript or TypeScript, and extension lifecycle standards? 
 - Can I design OIC architectures covering adapters, orchestration, REST and SOAP APIs, asynchronous and event-based integration, bulk processing, idempotency, throughput, API limits, and recovery? 
 - Can I demonstrate hands-on APEX and Oracle Database expertise and explain architectural choices between APEX and VBS for Fusion and OCI solutions? 
 - Can I demonstrate leadership of measurable AI-assisted delivery and practical architecture experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation, human oversight, and AI safeguards?

- Zero-to-one builds and system evolutionBuild new systems and products from scratch, from first design to production rollout.

Pay down tech debt strategically, knowing when to refactor, when to rebuild and when to leave it alone.

Build core business logic, APIs and data pipelines, and design relational database schemas for integrity, security and fast retrieval. 

Own features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring. 

- Performance and user experience at scaleMake our apps fast, from API response times and database query optimisation to mobile app performance and front-end rendering.

Prototype quickly, measure honestly, and take AI from hackathon idea to production-grade feature. 

Lead AI-assisted development in engineering: AI coding tools, automated testing and code review. 

- Technical influence and standardsBuild agreement on architecture decisions through clear thinking and strong communication, not authority. 

Explain complex trade-offs simply to engineers, product managers and leadership alike. 

Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions and pairing, and raise the technical bar across the team. 

Work closely with Product and Design to turn ideas into well-built products and shape the technical roadmap.

Solid system design: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design (REST/GraphQL) and caching strategies. 

Strong engineering fundamentals: CI/CD, automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), code quality and secure coding practices (OWASP). 

- AI expertise (must-have)Hands-on experience building AI-native architecture, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and AI APIs. Daily use of AI tools in your own engineering workflow. 

A forward-looking view of where AI is heading, and how to architect for it. 

- Who you areGeeky and curious: you read engineering blogs for fun, try every new tool, and are always learning. 

A builder at heart: you'd rather ship than talk about shipping. 

An influencer, not a manager: you lead through expertise and earn trust through good decisions. 

A clear communicator: you make complex ideas simple and trade-offs obvious. 

Experimental and resilient: you try bold ideas, learn quickly from what doesn't work, and see things through to completion. 

Why leaders choose RockED

Architect at the source: shape the technical foundation of a platform used across the US automotive industry. 

An AI-first playground: leadership backing to experiment with and ship AI features, plus regular AI hackathons.   

A real seat at the table: work directly with RockED's founders and US leadership. Your voice shapes company strategy, not just engineering execution.

data.title: Senior Data Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

NTT DATA is seeking a highly experienced Senior Data Engineer / Technical Lead for a large-scale banking data modernization program involving migration of approximately 2 PB of historical data from Cloudera Hadoop/Hive to Apache Iceberg. 

The role requires a strong hands-on engineer who can lead the engineering team while continuing to design, develop, troubleshoot and optimize the solution. The candidate will own technical execution of the migration framework, Spark/PySpark engineering, Iceberg implementation, data modelling/schema mapping, Cyber/TaaS integration, migration controls, reconciliation, performance tuning and technical delivery of migration waves. 

This is not a coordination-only Technical Lead role. The candidate is expected to contribute to code, conduct design/code reviews, troubleshoot complex production issues and mentor Data Engineers. 

Experience

10+ years of Data Engineering experience, including: 

- 5+ years hands-on Apache Spark/PySpark. 
 - Strong Hadoop/Hive experience. 
 - Experience leading Data Engineering teams. 
 - Large-scale data migration/data modernization experience. 
 - Strong data modelling and source-to-target mapping experience. 

Key Responsibilities

Multi-hundred-TB/PB-scale migration experience is strongly preferred. 

Technical Leadership

- Lead a team of Data Engineers through assessment, development, migration, validation and production execution. 
 - Translate architecture and migration standards into detailed engineering designs and reusable implementation patterns. 
 - Own technical estimates, engineering backlog, work allocation and technical delivery. 
 - Conduct design and code reviews and enforce engineering standards. 
 - Mentor Data Engineers and provide hands-on technical guidance. 
 - Act as the primary engineering escalation point for complex migration and production issues. 
 - Partner with Data Architect, Technical PM, security, infrastructure and PNC technical teams. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and ensure fixes are incorporated into reusable framework patterns rather than implemented as one-off solutions. 

Hadoop-to-Iceberg Migration

- Lead technical execution of approximately 2 PB of Hadoop/Hive historical-data migration to Apache Iceberg. 
 - Harden and extend the reusable, configuration-driven migration framework developed during the POC. 
 - Analyze Hive/HDFS metadata, tables, partitions, file layouts and migration complexity. 
 - Implement migration strategies including bulk/CTAS, partition-wise and chunk-wise processing. 
 - Design execution approaches for small, medium, large and very-large tables. 
 - Optimize parallel migration across tables and partitions. 
 - Implement checkpointing, restart/recovery, idempotency and safe retries. 
 - Lead technical execution and troubleshooting of migration waves. 

Data Modelling & Schema Engineering

- Analyze existing Hive data models and translate them into approved Apache Iceberg physical models. 
 - Develop and review conceptual/logical/physical data models where required, with primary emphasis on physical modelling for migration. 
 - Perform source-to-target data mapping and schema/data-type mapping. 
 - Define and implement table structures consistent with approved Iceberg standards. 
 - Analyze: 
 - entities and relationships, 
 - primary/foreign-key relationships, 
 - data types, 
 - partition keys, 
 - business keys, 
 - reference/cross-reference structures. 
 - Identify schema incompatibilities and recommend remediation. 
 - Work with the Data Architect on partitioning, file-layout and model-design decisions. 
 - Ensure migrated models preserve required business relationships and downstream compatibility. 
 - Support future Bronze/Silver/Gold modelling requirements where applicable. 

Important: enterprise modelling standards remain owned by the Data Architect; the Senior DE/Technical Lead is responsible for detailed modelling and implementation within those standards. 

Spark/PySpark Engineering & Performance

- Develop and review production-grade Python/PySpark components. 
 - Tune Spark jobs for PB-scale migration. 
 - Diagnose Spark stages, executors, shuffle, skew, memory and I/O bottlenecks. 
 - Optimize table/partition/chunk parallelism. 
 - Tune workloads to meet migration-throughput objectives. 
 - Identify bottlenecks across: 

Hadoop Read → Spark → TaaS/Tokenization → Iceberg Write → Reconciliation

- Coordinate technical remediation with infrastructure/storage/network teams where bottlenecks are outside the migration framework. 

Apache Iceberg Engineering

- Implement approved Iceberg table standards. 
 - Develop/configure Iceberg tables and Spark→Iceberg processing. 
 - Implement: 
 - partitioning, 
 - schema evolution, 
 - snapshots, 
 - file sizing, 
 - compaction, 
 - metadata maintenance, 
 - small-file remediation. 
 - Troubleshoot Iceberg catalog/write/commit issues. 
 - Optimize Iceberg table performance and storage characteristics. 

Cyber-3 / Tokenization

- Implement PNC-approved TaaS/Protegrity tokenization and retokenization patterns. 
 - Integrate tokenization into Spark migration pipelines. 
 - Implement batching, retry, timeout and recovery handling. 
 - Troubleshoot tokenization failures/performance bottlenecks. 
 - Measure impact of tokenization on end-to-end migration throughput. 
 - Support Cyber/tokenization validation based on PNC-defined rules. 

Migration Controls & Reconciliation

- Lead implementation of PNC Data Movement Controls, including: 
 - checkpointing, 
 - idempotency, 
 - control totals, 
 - restart/recovery, 
 - retry, 
 - audit logging, 
 - exception handling. 
 - Build reusable source-to-target reconciliation capabilities covering: 
 - row counts, 
 - schema validation, 
 - partition completeness, 
 - control totals, 
 - aggregates, 
 - hash/checksum where appropriate, 
 - null/duplicate validation, 
 - tokenization validation. 
 - Isolate discrepancies at table/partition level. 
 - Enable selective reprocessing rather than full-table reruns. 
 - Produce technical evidence required for migration acceptance. 

Mandatory Skills

Strong hands-on expertise in: 

- Python
 - PySpark
 - Apache Spark / Spark SQL
 - Hadoop / HDFS
 - Hive / HiveQL / Hive Metastore
 - SQL
 - Apache Iceberg
 - Data modelling
 - Source-to-target mapping
 - Parquet
 - Linux
 - Git
 - Large-volume ETL/data migration
 - Data validation/reconciliation
 - Spark performance tuning
 - Distributed-system troubleshooting. 

Data Modelling

Strong experience with: 

- logical and physical data modelling, 
 - source-to-target mapping, 
 - schema/data-type mapping, 
 - entity relationships, 
 - keys and referential relationships, 
 - dimensional/relational modelling concepts, 
 - large-scale analytical data models. 

Technical Leadership

Demonstrated experience: 

- leading Data Engineering teams, 
 - technical estimation/planning, 
 - detailed solution design, 
 - code/design reviews, 
 - mentoring engineers, 
 - production troubleshooting, 
 - root-cause analysis, 
 - communicating technical issues with architects/customer teams. 

Preferred Skills

- Apache Polaris/Nessie/Glue. 
 - OpenShift/Kubernetes/Spark Operator. 
 - S3-compatible object storage. 
 - NetApp StorageGRID/ONTAP. 
 - TaaS/Protegrity or equivalent tokenization technology. 
 - Trino. 
 - PostgreSQL. 
 - Control-M/Airflow. 
 - CI/CD for Spark/Python applications. 
 - Banking/financial-services experience. 
 - PB-scale data migration. 
 - Bronze/Silver/Gold modelling and implementation. 
 - HiveQL→Spark SQL modernization.

Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

How You'll Make An Impact

At Cin7, we are transforming the way businesses manage inventory, sales, and operations to make it cheaper, faster, and easier for businesses all over the world to get their products into their customers' hands. 

We're looking for a highly experienced full stack Senior Software Engineer who works AI-natively and can help push Cin7's engineering practices forward. This role is primarily focused on . NET development across different types of projects, including applications built with . NET Framework, . NET, and ASP. NET MVC, with frontend technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. 

You'll operate as a senior technical advisor: designing and implementing high-quality . NET solutions, using AI tools and agents to accelerate your own development workflow, helping evaluate and build AI-powered capabilities into our product, mentoring other developers, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional software at a fast pace. 

This position requires that you reside in Ahmedabad or Pune, India. 

Applying for this role: Please apply through our careers page so your application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If you have a genuine connection to someone at Cin7 and they choose to refer you, that's welcome. Please don't send unsolicited connection requests or messages to employees asking for referrals, as this creates extra work for our team and may result in your application not being considered. 

What You'll Do

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Partner with product managers, designers, and developers to define requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions. 
 - Maintain, design, and develop high-performance code: Maintain and develop our cloud-based SaaS inventory management software using . NET technologies, ensuring solutions meet business needs and follow best practices in software design and development.

 - Mentor and coach: Foster a culture of growth, quality, and effective AI-augmented development by providing guidance and technical mentorship to other developers, including how to use AI tools responsibly and effectively.

 - Demonstrated, hands-on fluency with AI coding tools and agentic development workflows (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) - not just occasional use, but genuine integration into daily engineering practice. 
 - Practical experience using AI-powered coding assistants as part of everyday software development. 
 - Expertise in integrating LLM APIs into an existing application. 
 - Experience designing and implementing production-grade AI-powered functionality involving RAG, agentic workflows, and model output evaluation. 
 - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to independently tackle and resolve complex, ambiguous technical challenges across backend, frontend, database, and application layers. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working in teams and mentoring others. 

Core Technical Skills

- Strong proficiency in C# and . NET technologies, including deep experience with . NET Framework, . NET, ASP. NET MVC, web applications, and APIs. 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns, with practical experience applying them to complex, real-world production systems. 
 - Extensive experience with relational databases, such as SQL Server, including writing and optimizing SQL queries, working with stored procedures, triggers, indexes, and troubleshooting database performance issues. 
 - Solid understanding of web fundamentals, including HTTP, REST APIs, request/response lifecycle, browser behavior, and client-server communication.

It's a Nice To Have If You Bring

 - Experience improving performance, scalability, and reliability of production systems.

 - Experience mentoring engineers and shaping engineering best practices, including AI tool adoption. 

Why work at Cin7?

Why CIN7?

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. data.title: Software Test Engineer Network Access & Security
data.description:
Company Description

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista's award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. 

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation. 

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do. 

Job Description

We are looking for a skilled Quality Assurance Engineer specialising in Network Access Control (NAC) and network security to join our engineering team. In this role, you will own test methodologies, design comprehensive test plans, and push our software and hardware to their limits to ensure enterprise-grade reliability and security. 

Who You'll Work With

You will collaborate closely with a tight-knit engineering group. You will partner with Software Developers and Architects from the earliest functional specification and design review stages to embed quality and customer-centric thinking directly into the product. Alongside top-tier Linux Platform Engineers, you will work in a high-velocity environment designed to accelerate development cycles without compromising stability. You will also team up with Cross-Functional QA and Automation Peers to align your hands-on exploratory testing insights with developer-led test automation frameworks. 

What You'll Do

- Work with the developers on your team in creating their plans for automated tests to complement the exploratory testing that you perform. 
 - Participate in functional specification and software design reviews held by your team and provide customer centric input. 
 - Work in a highly productive environment alongside top engineers on the Linux platform, cutting typical development cycles by an order of magnitude with a laser focus towards quality. 
 - Use every means possible to find the bugs in the software and/or hardware being developed by your team
 - Write test plans to validate Arista features and products. 
 - Design test network topologies to validate the functionality, performance, stability and scalability of features and products. 
 - Execute test plans to verify all aspects of the product. Identify defects and validate resolution. 
 - Work as an agile member of a combined development and test team, running in short cycles to develop functional software in quick iterations. 

Qualifications

- 5-7 years of experience in networking, with a focus on network access and security. Strong candidates with fewer years will be considered. 
 - Proven ability to develop test methodologies, write test plans, and execute structured test campaigns across functional, regression, and integration testing. 
 - Strong knowledge of network access protocols and technologies: 802. 1X, RADIUS, TACACS+, AAA, NAC, VLANs, IP routing, TCP/IP, L2/L3 protocols, and Wi-Fi. 
 - Hands-on experience configuring wired switches and wireless access points from multiple vendors (Cisco, Aruba, Juniper/Mist) for network access use cases. 
 - Experience with EAP methods (EAP-TLS, PEAP/MSCHAPv2, EAP-TEAP) and certificate-based authentication. 
 - Familiarity with identity providers such as Okta, Azure Active Directory, OneLogin, or LDAP/Active Directory environments is a plus. 
 - Experience testing cloud-native SaaS applications is a plus. 
 - Experience with MDM/EDR platforms (JAMF, Intune, CrowdStrike) and their integration with NAC solutions is a plus. 
 - Prior experience with AAA or NAC products is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with automation frameworks and scripting (Python, Go, or similar) for test automation is a plus. 
 - Experience with troubleshooting packet captures (Wireshark) and RADIUS debug logs is a plus. 

Additional Information

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. 

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. 

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. 

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. 

Technologies You'll Use

Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to: Accelerate debugging and failure triagingGenerate high-quality test scenariosDetect flaky patterns or regression risksImprove log analysis and root-cause identificationEnhance developer and QA productivity

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

As a Senior AI QA & Automation Engineer, you will lead automation-first quality engineering for cloud-native and AI-powered solutions. This role requires 5-8 years of experience and strong hands-on capability in Python, Playwright automation, cloud platforms, AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and LLM testing. 

You will design scalable test and evaluation frameworks that validate conventional applications as well as RAG, conversational AI, copilot, and agentic workflows for functional correctness, task success, grounding, safe tool use, policy compliance, reliability, and release readiness. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Define and own automation-first quality strategies for web, API, microservices, cloud-native, GenAI, RAG, LLM, and Agentic AI solutions. 
 - Design and develop scalable Python-based automation frameworks using Playwright and PyTest for UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Define AI quality dimensions, scoring rubrics, acceptance thresholds, and representative evaluation datasets with product, business, and engineering SMEs. 
 - Build automated evaluation harnesses covering task success, grounding, hallucination, retrieval relevance, tool selection and execution, policy compliance, response format, consistency, and regression. 
 - Write deterministic tests for tools, APIs, integrations, permissions, memory, state management, workflow control, and agent orchestration. 
 - Validate AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems, including RAG applications, copilots, conversational AI, and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Use human evaluation and LLM-as-judge approaches with appropriate calibration, sampling, bias controls, traceability, and periodic human review. 
 - Execute adversarial and failure-mode testing covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, unsafe actions, data leakage, PII exposure, harmful content, tool misuse, and security vulnerabilities. 
 - Integrate automated tests and AI evaluations into CI/CD pipelines as release gates, with quality dashboards, trace evidence, and actionable reporting. 
 - Translate production defects, model failures, and AI incidents into repeatable regression cases and continuously improve evaluation datasets and automated suites. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, Business SMEs, Developers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Architects, and DevOps teams to define acceptance criteria and drive resolution. 
 - Provide technical leadership, review framework design and test coverage, mentor team members, and communicate delivery risks and quality outcomes to stakeholders. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

Mandatory skills and experience

- 5-8 years of Quality Engineering experience with a strong automation engineering background; this is an automation-focused role. 
 - Advanced Python programming with hands-on experience building reusable automation and evaluation frameworks using PyTest. 
 - Hands-on Playwright automation experience for modern web applications; experience validating APIs and end-to-end business workflows is required. 
 - Practical cloud experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, including testing cloud-native services and integrating test execution into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector retrieval, and Agentic AI architectures. 
 - Hands-on LLM and AI application testing, including grounding, hallucination, retrieval relevance, task completion, tool use, response quality, safety, bias, and compliance evaluation. 
 - Experience designing evaluation datasets, scoring rubrics, thresholds, automated evaluation harnesses, and regression suites for probabilistic AI systems. 
 - Experience with adversarial AI testing techniques such as prompt injection, jailbreak, unsafe action, data leakage, PII protection, and failure-mode testing. 
 - Working knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, Git, CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins, and Agile engineering practices. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, stakeholder communication, and technical leadership skills. 

Good to have

- Hands-on exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse, and LangSmith for orchestration, observability, tracing, and evaluation. 
 - Experience with DeepEval, RAGAS, MLflow, Garak, LLM-as-judge, MCP, Playwright MCP, or other AI evaluation and agent-testing tools. 
 - Exposure to GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cline, Roo, or similar AI-assisted engineering tools. 
 - Understanding of Responsible AI controls, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, guardrails, model validation, bias testing, drift testing, metamorphic testing, and back-to-back testing. 
 - Experience with SQL, Postman, Docker or containerized execution, observability platforms, and test reporting dashboards. 

What We Offer You

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. You will perform hardware and software design of the various hydro Control system packages for one or more projects, on own DCS or on 3rd party control solutions. 

Job Description

Role & Responsibilities

- Work on power plant control system design deliverables, networking and cybersecurity solutions involving PLC, IO devices, Server configuration and deployment, network architectures, switch configuration and trouble shooting.
