 - Perform interlocking design, wiring principles, etc. testing of control panels at GE Vernova workshop or supplier premises, support FAT, etc. 
 - Implement secure design practices in system design and software programming. 
 - Day-to-day activities include, but not limited to -
 - Perform contract analysis, concept design, reverse engineering, prepare work-statement document. 
 - Document technical data generated for the assigned project. 
 - Review supplier documents (IO list, P&ID, Minfex data of partners) and prepare/update IO list. 
 - Create supplier technical specification for BTS or BTP DCS solution, coordinate with suppliers & do technical follow up. 
 - Prepare/update Logic programs, HMI mimics views as per P&ID and standard faceplates. 
 - Prepare and update OMM document.

data.description:
We're Civica and we make software that helps deliver critical services for citizens all around the world. From local to state government, to education, to health and care, over 5, 000 public bodies across the globe use our software to help provide critical services to over 100 million citizens.   

Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.   

As a company, we're passionate about what we do and the citizens we help to serve. If you too would like to help champion the use of technology in public services, to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve growth in your career whilst making a real difference to people and communities.   

Why you'll love this role as a SOC Team Leader at Civica

If you're passionate about cyber security, thrive on solving complex threats, and enjoy developing high-performing teams, this is the perfect opportunity for you. As our SOC Team Lead, you'll combine hands-on technical expertise with leadership responsibility, playing a pivotal role in protecting our customers and business. 

In this role, you'll lead from the front, acting as the senior technical authority for incident response, guiding Security Analysts through complex investigations, and driving operational excellence across the SOC. You'll have the opportunity to mentor and develop junior analysts, shape security processes, and continuously elevate the capability of the team. 

Unlike purely managerial positions, you'll remain deeply involved in the technical work, dedicating part of your time to Level III SOC Analyst responsibilities. This means you'll be actively investigating sophisticated threats, responding to critical incidents, and working with cutting-edge security technologies alongside your team. 

You'll enjoy a collaborative environment where your expertise is valued, your leadership makes a visible impact, and your contributions directly strengthen our security posture while helping others grow their careers in cyber security. 

Your key responsibilities include: 

- Lead, coach, and support a team of SOC Analysts to deliver high-quality security operations. 
 - Act as the senior escalation point for complex security incidents and investigations. 
 - Ensure operational excellence through quality reviews, feedback, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive analyst capability development through mentoring and knowledge sharing. 
 - Maintain and enhance SOC processes, procedures, and incident response playbooks. 
 - Lead proactive threat hunting and support the assessment of emerging threats and vulnerabilities. 
 - Collaborate with internal security teams and business stakeholders to support effective threat management and remediation. 
 - Contribute to SOC operations by performing Level III Analyst responsibilities alongside the team. 

Requirements

What you will need to be successful in this role

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment, with demonstrated experience in incident response. 
 - Proven experience in a senior or lead analyst role, with a passion for mentoring others. 
 - Deep technical expertise with core security technologies, including SIEM (e. g. , Elastic SIEM, Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar), EDR, and network security tools. 
 - Strong understanding of incident response methodologies, cyber kill chain, and frameworks like the MITRE ATT&CK® framework. 
 - Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform calmly under pressure. 
 - Strong communication skills, capable of clearly explaining complex technical issues to team members. 
Nice to Haves: 

- Professional cybersecurity certifications such as GIAC (GCIH, GCFA), CISSP, OSCP etc. 
 - Experience with scripting or automation (e. g. , Python, PowerShell) to improve SOC efficiency. 
 - Experience working in a Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) environment. 
 - Experience with security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) platforms. 
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity standards related to incident response, such as NIST SP800-61r1, SP800-61r2, SANS PICERL, etc. 
 - Exposure and good working knowledge supporting LANs/WLANs 
 - Experience in operationalizing and developing SOC specific processes (procedures, work instructions, etc. ). 
 - Previous experience with raw log file review, data correlation, and analysis, as well as with network security tools, network traffic analysers, firewall logs, network flows, intrusion detection systems, system logs, memory dumps, vulnerability management, SOAR platforms, SIEM, especially Elastic SIEM, and other Enterprise / Open Source equivalents. 
 - Previous experience in malware investigations, incident response, and threat hunting

Benefits

Why you'll love working with us. 

We know that when our people are happy, they will work better and have greater work satisfaction. Here's what you can expect: 

We're all different -  and we love this about us. 

We provide an inclusive, safe, and welcoming environment to all Civicans  - there are heaps of opportunities to enable you to grow and be your best.     

Giving culture -  we encourage you to "give back" with benefits such as our Days of Difference leave where you can volunteer for a charity of your choice. 

Flexible Work - we have comprehensive flexibility options including part-time work, adjusted hours, staggered shifts, and hybrid or remote working, supporting work-life balance based on individual needs. 

Apply for this job  - Become part of something special Do you see yourself in this role? If so, then we would love to hear from you.

data.title: Senior AI Engineering Manager
data.description:
Senior AI Engineering Manager

Location: Gurugram, Haryana

Work Model: Hybrid - 3 days from office, 2 days remote

Experience: 15-25 Years

Employment Type: Permanent

Role Type: Technical Leadership

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineering Manager to lead the architecture, engineering and deployment of advanced AI solutions across enterprise platforms. 

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI and large-scale AI engineering. The role requires a combination of strong technical leadership, architectural depth and experience driving AI solutions from concept to enterprise-scale production. 

Candidates with experience working in established and reputed product-based companies are mandatory. The successful candidate should have a strong engineering background and the ability to lead technical teams while remaining closely involved in architecture, design and critical engineering decisions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive the technical strategy and roadmap for enterprise AI and Generative AI initiatives. 
 - Lead the architecture, design and development of scalable AI/ML platforms and production-grade AI applications. 
 - Drive the development of LLM-based solutions, RAG architectures, Agentic AI and multi-agent systems. 
 - Oversee the design and implementation of multimodal AI solutions involving text, images, documents and other data modalities. 
 - Lead engineering initiatives involving model training, fine-tuning, inference optimisation and model serving. 
 - Drive the adoption of frameworks and technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen and MCP. 
 - Guide teams in building scalable model-serving infrastructure using vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, Hugging Face TGI or equivalent technologies. 
 - Oversee GPU infrastructure utilisation, distributed AI workloads, latency optimisation and performance engineering. 
 - Establish engineering standards for AI development, model evaluation, experimentation, monitoring and MLOps. 
 - Drive AI solutions from proof of concept to secure, reliable and scalable production deployment. 
 - Collaborate with product, enterprise architecture, engineering and business stakeholders to translate business needs into AI solutions. 
 - Provide technical direction, mentorship and engineering leadership to AI/ML teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and drive innovation, engineering excellence and continuous improvement. 

Required Technical Skills

AI / Machine Learning

- Strong foundation in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Deep Learning. 
 - Experience designing and deploying large-scale production AI/ML systems. 
 - Understanding of neural networks, model training, fine-tuning, optimisation and inference. Generative AI / LLMs

- Extensive hands-on experience with LLMs and Generative AI applications. 
 - Strong expertise in RAG architecture, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search. 
 - Experience architecting Agentic AI applications, multi-agent orchestration and tool-calling workflows. 
 - Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI workflow orchestration. 
 - Exposure to multimodal AI systems and applications. AI Engineering & Frameworks

- Strong Python programming and software engineering expertise. 
 - Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Strong experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow. 
 - Understanding of APIs, microservices, asynchronous programming, concurrency and distributed systems. Model Deployment & Infrastructure

- Experience with model serving, inference optimisation and production AI infrastructure. 
 - Knowledge of vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, Hugging Face TGI or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience with GPU-accelerated infrastructure, preferably NVIDIA A100/H100. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Docker and cloud-native architecture. 
 - Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or equivalent. 
 - Understanding of model monitoring, evaluation, scalability and performance optimisation. 

Education & Experience

- 15-25 years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering or related technology domains. 
 - Significant experience leading AI/ML engineering teams and delivering enterprise-scale AI solutions. 
 - Strong recent experience in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and Agentic AI. 
 - Demonstrated experience taking complex AI solutions from experimentation and POC to production. 
 - Experience defining AI engineering architecture, technical standards and platform roadmaps. 
 - B. Tech / B. E. or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a relevant technical discipline is mandatory. 
 - Strong experience working with established and reputed product-based companies is mandatory. 

What We Are Looking For

- A technically strong AI engineering leader with deep architectural and engineering expertise. 
 - Ability to lead complex AI engineering programmes and guide teams towards scalable production solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of both foundational AI/ML and modern Generative AI technologies. 
 - Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive technical decisions. 
 - Someone who combines strategic thinking with practical engineering depth. 
 - Strong communication, problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Additional Preferences

- Immediate joiners or candidates serving short notice periods are strongly preferred. 
 - Candidates available to work in a hybrid model from Gurugram. 
 - Experience building AI products or platforms in reputed product-based organisations. 
 - Experience with large-scale GPU infrastructure and enterprise AI platforms is an advantage. Interested candidates meeting the above criteria are requested to share their updated resumes. 

Please connect to discuss this opportunity.

Supervisor will collaborate closely with other departments to integrate new technologies into existing systems and to support the company's strategic goals.

• Identify emerging trends and technologies in the field of wastewater treatment and assess their potential impact on the company's products and services. 

• Oversee the development of pilot projects and the scaling up of successful prototypes.

• Plan and manage R&D projects, including budgeting, resource allocation, and timeline management. 

• Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and meet the defined objectives and quality standards. 

• Coordinate with other departments such as engineering, production, and sales to ensure smooth project execution and technology transfer.

• Conduct performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback to team members.

• Collaborate with external partners, including academic institutions, research organizations, and industry experts, to leverage external knowledge and resources. 

• Communicate research findings, project updates, and technical information to internal stakeholders and senior management.

• Implement and maintain quality assurance protocols to ensure the reliability and accuracy of research data.

• Maintain detailed and accurate records of research activities and project progress. 

• Report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to R&D activities.

• Advanced degree (Masters) in Environmental Science, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related field.

• Strong leadership and project management skills. 

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. 

• Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 

• Knowledge of industry regulations and standards. 

• Local candidate would be preferred.

This position is crucial for driving innovation and maintaining Bio Petro Clean competitive edge in the wastewater treatment industry. The R&D Supervisor will play a key role in developing cutting-edge technologies that address current and future environmental challenges

- Role Title: Staff Quality Engineer (Remote)
 - Role Type: Full-time
 - Location: Remote

The Role

You'll design and build an intelligent, highly automated quality engineering system where AI agents help generate tests, execute regression suites, investigate failures, and continuously improve test coverage. 

You'll own the technical foundations that allow our engineering team to ship quickly and confidently without scaling QA headcount alongside product complexity. 

We're looking for a Staff-level engineer with deep test automation expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, and a track record of building systems that make quality an integrated, automated part of software development. 

What You'll Do

1. Build agentic QA systems: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for test generation, automated regression testing, failure analysis, and intelligent bug triage. 

2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows. 

3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 

4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues. 

5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk. 

6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing. 

7. Establish quality observability: Create clear visibility into test reliability, regression trends, release readiness, and overall product quality. 

8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish testing standards, and drive a culture where quality is owned across the engineering organization. 

What We're Looking For

1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or Test Automation Architecture. 

2. Strong hands-on programming skills and experience building production-grade test automation frameworks. 

3. Extensive experience automating web applications, APIs, and complex end-to-end workflows. 

4. Expertise with modern testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent technologies. 

5. Strong understanding of CI/CD, integration testing, contract testing, regression strategies, and test infrastructure. 

6. Proven experience designing scalable testing systems rather than exclusively writing or maintaining individual test cases. 

7. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents extensively and have practical experience applying AI to test generation, automation, debugging, or quality workflows. 

8. Strong systems thinking, including the ability to identify bottlenecks and design automation that removes repetitive QA work. 

9. Experience establishing engineering quality standards and mentoring developers or QA engineers. 

10. Ability to independently own quality engineering architecture while remaining deeply hands-on. 

Nice to have

1. You've built AI-powered testing systems or agentic QA workflows used in real development environments. 

2. You've significantly reduced manual regression testing through intelligent automation. 

3. You've designed testing infrastructure that supports rapid product iteration with a small engineering team. 

4. You've worked on testing AI-powered products, including nondeterministic behaviors, model evaluations, or agentic workflows. 

5. You think about quality as an engineering platform rather than a separate phase of software delivery. 

6. You can move comfortably between writing automation code, investigating complex failures, and designing company-wide quality systems. 

What You'll Do

1. Build agentic QA systems: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for test generation, automated regression testing, failure analysis, and intelligent bug triage. 

2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows. 

3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 

4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues. 

5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk. 

6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing.

data.title: Vice President of Engineering
data.description:
Role description: This role is with one of our portfolio companies. 

We are hiring a VP of Engineering for one of our portfolio companies. This is the top engineering leadership role within the organization. In this position, you will oversee the entire technical function, establish the engineering culture, and make the hard calls that separate companies that scale from those that stall. 

This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance or inherits a clean system. You will walk into technical debt, ambiguity, and high expectations - and be expected to thrive. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Engineering Strategy - Define and execute the technical roadmap aligned with business priorities; make deliberate decisions on what to build, what to defer, and what to deprecate
 - Technical Debt - Audit the existing architecture, prioritize remediation without halting product velocity, and establish a sustainable path forward
 - Culture & Process - Build engineering practices from a low-maturity baseline, including hiring standards, delivery cadences, incident response protocols, and code quality benchmarks. 
 - Team Leadership - Lead and grow a mid-sized engineering team; building a strong leadership layer beneath you. 
 - Stakeholder Communication - Be the technical voice to the Founder, business teams, and external stakeholders; translate complexity into clarity
 - Hands-on Architecture - Stay close enough to the system to challenge decisions, review critical architecture, and prevent the team from making expensive mistakes
 - Familiarity with fast-paced, rapidly iterating, design-forward, and product-focused companies. 
 - A "roll-up-your-sleeves" entrepreneurial attitude, along with a team player mentality and a proven record of leading and mentoring employees. 

What We're Looking For: 

Non-negotiables

- Master's or PhD degree in Engineering or Technology. 
 - 12+ years of engineering experience with at least 3-4 years in a senior engineering leadership role
 - Proven 0-to-scale journey - you've stayed long enough at a high-growth company to see your decisions play out and own the outcomes
 - Fintech experience - current or past; payment domain knowledge is a significant advantage
 - Demonstrated experience managing technical debt in a live, revenue-generating system
 - Strong first-principles thinking - you can tell the difference between tech debt that needs urgent attention and noise
 - Exceptional communication - board-ready, team-inspiring, and cross-functional
 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. 

Strong Differentiators

- Hands-on experience with payment infrastructure
 - Experience in a compliance-heavy, regulated environment
 - Proven ability to build or significantly upgrade engineering hiring practices and performance culture. 

What This Role Is Not

- A title upgrade for someone who wants to manage without getting their hands dirty
 - A fit for candidates who have only operated in large, well-resourced engineering orgs
 - A greenfield build - you will inherit a system and a team, not start from scratch

Note: We will check the fitment for multiple roles across our portfolios.

data.title: Oracle EPM Planning Engineering Lead
data.description:
Job Description (Job Advert Content)

Enterprise Functions Engineering

Enterprise Functions Engineering drives the strategy, delivery and support of LSEG's enterprise platforms across Finance, Risk and other corporate functions. Our mission is to simplify and standardise business processes, strengthen operational resilience and controls, accelerate digital transformation and enable data-driven decision-making through innovative technology solutions. 

Role Summary

As Manager, Oracle EPM Planning Engineering Lead, you will lead the design, development, delivery and ongoing operation of enterprise planning solutions on Oracle EPM Cloud. This is a hands-on engineering leadership role with primary accountability for Oracle Planning, including Project Planning and Workforce Planning, together with Narrative Reporting and associated data integrations. 

You will combine deep technical capability with team leadership, driving solution architecture, detailed design and development while ensuring programmes, projects, enhancements and production services are delivered predictably and operate reliably. You will partner with Finance, FP&A, HR, Project Finance, Enterprise Functions, Architecture, Data, Operations, Risk and Control stakeholders to deliver scalable and well-controlled planning capabilities within the engineering governance framework of a large global enterprise. 

What We're Looking For

- An experienced Oracle EPM Cloud engineering lead with strong hands-on expertise in Planning application design, configuration, calculation logic, Groovy development, data integration, reporting and operational support. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering Project Planning and Workforce Planning solutions that support complex enterprise planning, forecasting and reporting processes. 
 - Strong experience with Oracle Narrative Reporting and the integration of planning outputs into management and statutory reporting processes. 
 - A leader who remains technically hands-on and can guide a multidisciplinary engineering team across design, development, testing, deployment, continuous improvement and stable operations. 
 - Experience operating within the architecture, security, change, risk, governance and control frameworks of a large enterprise, ideally in financial services or another regulated environment. 
 - A strong collaborator who can translate complex finance, workforce and project planning requirements into robust, supportable engineering solutions. 

Major Responsibilities / Accountabilities

- Lead the Oracle EPM Planning engineering capability, with end-to-end accountability for solution design, development, delivery and operations. 
 - Own the technical direction, engineering standards and roadmap for Oracle EPM Cloud Planning, ensuring alignment with finance transformation priorities, enterprise architecture and platform strategy. 
 - Remain hands-on in application and solution design, including dimensions, metadata, forms, dashboards, business rules, calculation scripts, Groovy rules, approvals, security, data maps, Smart Push, reporting and automation. 
 - Lead the design and development of Project Planning and Workforce Planning capabilities, including driver-based models, project cost and resource forecasting, workforce demand, headcount, compensation and scenario planning. 
 - Oversee the design and delivery of Narrative Reporting solutions that connect planning outcomes with management commentary, report packs and controlled reporting processes. 
 - Lead programmes, projects and enhancements from discovery and requirements through architecture, design, build, testing, deployment, transition and benefits realisation. 
 - Plan team capacity, prioritise the engineering backlog, manage dependencies and ensure predictable delivery against agreed scope, timelines, quality and control requirements. 
 - Establish and maintain stable operations, including service monitoring, incident and problem management, release management, planning-cycle readiness, month-end and year-end support, disaster recovery, capacity management and vendor support. 
 - Partner with Finance, FP&A, HR, Project Finance and process owners to translate business requirements into scalable planning models, calculations, workflows and reporting solutions. 
 - Design and oversee reliable data integrations between Oracle EPM Cloud and ERP, HR, project accounting, data platforms and upstream or downstream reporting systems, with appropriate reconciliation, lineage, scheduling, monitoring and exception handling. 
 - Implement effective controls over data, calculations, interfaces, access, change and production operations, with clear evidence to support audit and compliance requirements. 
 - Ensure solutions comply with enterprise engineering governance, including architecture review, secure engineering standards, SDLC controls, testing, segregation of duties, change management and operational acceptance. 
 - Identify and deliver appropriate native Oracle EPM AI capabilities and non-native AI use cases across planning, forecasting, workforce, project planning and narrative reporting processes, aligned with enterprise architecture, data, security, model risk and responsible AI controls. 
 - Lead supplier and implementation partner engagement, including delivery oversight, quality assurance, knowledge transfer and adherence to contractual outcomes. 
 - Develop team capability through coaching, technical leadership, reusable patterns, documentation, engineering standards and succession planning. 
 - Drive continuous improvement through automation, performance optimisation, release adoption, simplification, technical debt reduction and improved observability. 

Key Relationships

The role will partner closely with Group Finance, FP&A, HR and Workforce Planning, Project Finance, Finance Transformation, Enterprise Functions process owners, Enterprise Architecture, Data and Integration Engineering, Cyber Security, Risk and Controls, Service Management, Change and Release Management, and external vendors or implementation partners. The role will also work across the wider Oracle EPM and Finance Engineering landscape to ensure consistent architecture, data, control and operational standards. 

Essential Skills

Technical / Professional Skills & Competencies

- Typically 10+ years of experience delivering or supporting Oracle EPM, enterprise planning, budgeting, forecasting or performance management solutions, including relevant engineering leadership experience. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with Oracle EPM Cloud Planning, including application design, dimensions, metadata, forms, dashboards, business rules, approvals, security, reporting, automation and performance optimisation. 
 - Strong hands-on development experience using Groovy within Oracle EPM Cloud to create dynamic rules, validations, calculations, integrations and process automation. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering Project Planning solutions, including project costs, resources, revenue, capital expenditure, funding, scenario modelling and integration with ERP or project accounting systems. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering Workforce Planning solutions, including headcount, compensation, workforce movements, demand and capacity planning, scenario analysis and integration with HR or payroll platforms. 
 - Strong experience with Oracle Narrative Reporting, report packages, disclosure or management reporting, commentary workflows and integration with Oracle EPM Cloud data. 
 - Strong understanding of planning, budgeting, forecasting, scenario modelling, management reporting and associated finance processes. 
 - Experience leading teams delivering concurrent programmes, projects, enhancements and production operations. 
 - Strong understanding of the full engineering lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, solution design, development, configuration management, testing, deployment, release, support and continuous improvement. 
 - Experience designing and operating integrations between Oracle EPM Cloud and ERP platforms such as Oracle ERP Cloud or SAP, together with HR, project, enterprise data and upstream or downstream reporting systems. 
 - Practical experience with Oracle EPM Data Integration, Data Management, REST APIs, EPM Automate, integration agents, file-based interfaces and enterprise integration tooling. 
 - Strong data analysis and reconciliation capability, with practical knowledge of SQL, data transformation, control totals, lineage, traceability and issue investigation. 
 - Demonstrable experience of enterprise governance and controls, including architecture governance, secure engineering, access management, segregation of duties, change management, IT general controls, audit evidence, resilience and disaster recovery. 
 - Strong service management and operational leadership skills, including incident, problem, change, release, capacity, availability and vendor management. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain planning models and technical decisions to finance, engineering, risk and senior leadership audiences. 
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Engineering or a related discipline. 

Desired Skills

- Experience deploying native Oracle EPM Cloud AI capabilities and integrating non-native AI solutions to improve forecasting, scenario modelling, anomaly detection, data quality, commentary generation, reporting and operational processes, with appropriate governance, security, explainability and human oversight. 
 - Oracle EPM Cloud Planning, Narrative Reporting, Data Integration or related Oracle certification. 
 - Experience with Oracle EPM Cloud Financial Consolidation and Close (FCC), including an understanding of how planning, forecasting and consolidation processes integrate across the finance landscape. 
 - Knowledge of Workday Adaptive Planning, including its planning, forecasting, workforce planning, reporting and integration capabilities, and an understanding of how it compares or coexists with Oracle EPM Cloud Planning. 
 - Experience with Account Reconciliation, Enterprise Data Management or other Oracle EPM Cloud products. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, enterprise data platforms, APIs, integration tooling and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Power BI or equivalent reporting and visualisation platforms. 
 - Experience leading solutions in global financial services or a complex multinational and regulated organisation. 
 - Professional finance qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA. 

Leadership Expectations

- Set clear engineering direction, standards and accountabilities while remaining sufficiently hands-on to provide credible technical leadership and challenge. 
 - Create an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing team environment focused on delivery quality, operational excellence and continuous learning. 
 - Balance delivery pace with sustainable engineering, control effectiveness, resilience and long-term platform maintainability. 
 - Own issues through to resolution, communicate risks transparently and escalate early when delivery, control or operational outcomes are at risk. 
 - Build strong partnerships across Finance, HR and Technology, promoting shared ownership of data quality, model design, controls and business outcomes. 

Education / Certifications

- Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Oracle EPM Cloud Planning, Narrative Reporting, Data Integration, FCC or related Oracle certifications are advantageous. 
 - Professional finance qualifications such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA are desirable but not essential. 
 - IT service management, cloud, architecture, security, Agile or programme delivery certifications are beneficial.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer – Data Platform (Python/Ruby, AWS, Redshift)
data.description:
About the role

ListenFirst collects social and entertainment data from platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X and LinkedIn, then turns it into analytics for brands and media companies. You will own the backend that does this: the ingestion layer that collects the data, and the ETL pipeline that loads it into our Redshift data warehouse every day. 

This is a hands-on role on a mature, production system. You will keep it running, fix data issues fast, and modernise it step by step. 

What you will do

- Ingestion: Build and maintain collectors for social platform APIs (Facebook Graph, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and others). Handle API version changes, rate limits, auth and pagination. 
 - ETL: Own the extract-transform step that turns JSON ingest events into warehouse rows. Add new tables, fields and transformations through config, code and tests. 
 - Data warehouse: Write and tune Redshift SQL: migrations, views, incremental loads, COPY from S3, compression encodings, WLM and query performance. 
 - AWS operations: Run the pipeline on AWS: S3, SQS (priority queues), Kinesis Firehose, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, SNS and EC2 workers. Reprocess data, scale workers and recover failed runs. 
 - Data issues: Investigate data gaps and wrong counts raised by Support and Client teams. Find the root cause, fix it and backfill. 
 - Modernisation: Upgrade old libraries (e. g. AWS SDK v2 to v3), add tests where they are missing, move secrets out of code, and improve monitoring and alerts. 
 - Cost: Help reduce infra cost (Redshift, EC2) without losing data coverage. 
 - Team: Write clear docs and runbooks. Review code. Use AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) in daily work. 

Must have

- 4-5 years of backend or data engineering experience on production systems. 
 - Strong in Ruby, or strong in Python/Go and willing to work mainly in Ruby. Our ETL and ingestion code is mostly Ruby. 
 - Strong SQL. Hands-on with a columnar warehouse: Amazon Redshift preferred (Snowflake / BigQuery also fine). 
 - Built data pipelines that move large volumes: batch loads, incremental loads, deduplication, backfills. 
 - Hands-on AWS: S3, SQS, EC2, IAM, CloudWatch. Kinesis or DynamoDB is a plus. 
 - Integrated third-party REST APIs: OAuth, rate limits, retries, schema changes. 
 - Comfortable on Linux: SSH, bash, cron, logs, process management. 
 - Debugs production issues end to end, from a client complaint down to the raw record. 
 - Git, code reviews, writing tests (RSpec, pytest or similar). 

Good to have

- Experience with social media platform APIs (Meta Graph API, TikTok, YouTube Data API). 
 - Redshift tuning: dist/sort keys, encodings, WLM, RA3 / Serverless. 
 - Go or C++ for performance-critical tools. 
 - Kafka, Athena, Jenkins or GitHub Actions, Capistrano. 
 - Experience modernising a legacy codebase safely. 

How we will judge success

- First 30 days: Set up locally, understand the ingest → ET → Redshift flow, fix first data issue. 
 - By 90 days: Own daily ETL runs and recovery. Ship at least one new collector or ETL table end to end. 
 - By 6 months: Measurable gains in reliability, test coverage or cost. Become the go-to person for pipeline issues. 

Interview focus

- SQL round: write and optimise warehouse queries; explain an incremental load. 
 - Pipeline design: design ingestion for a new social platform API, including failures and backfills. 
 - Debugging round: find why a metric dropped, using logs, S3 files and SQL. 
 - Code review: review a short Ruby or Python ETL change.

data.title: Senior Manager / DGM, Technical Services, Consumables
data.description:
Introduction

We are looking for a Senior Manager / DGM - Technical Service, Product Development & Quality Assurance to join our Technical Service / Quality function at the Ahmedabad Foundry in the Consumables business area. In this role, you will lead technical service, product development and quality assurance from customer technical requirements and casting development through process qualification, serial-production quality and customer technical support. 

You will report to India Foundry Head, and the role location is Ahmedabad, India, with an onsite working model. 

Team you will belong to

You will lead engineers and specialists responsible for product development, process and metallurgy, quality assurance, quality control and technical and customer support. The team focuses on developing robust casting processes, assuring product and process quality, resolving customer and manufacturing issues and continuously improving quality, yield, reliability, productivity, cost and technical capability. 

Team members are based in Vadodara, Ahmedabad & Outside India. The team works across Production, Manufacturing/Process Engineering, Pattern Shop/Tooling, Maintenance, Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE), Supply Chain and Procurement, Sales, Customer Service, global engineering and technology teams, suppliers, customers and external laboratories and inspection agencies. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the technical evaluation, manufacturability review and risk assessment of new casting enquiries. Develop casting methodology, tooling concepts, moulding and core-making parameters, gating and feeding systems, melting and metallurgy parameters, heat-treatment cycles, finishing methods and inspection requirements; use casting simulation and engineering analysis where applicable. 
 - Lead prototype and sample development, trial pouring, testing and process validation through customer technical approval. Lead or support customer-specific Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) requirements where applicable, including process flows, Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), control and inspection plans, product specifications, process parameters and acceptance criteria, and hand over products to serial production after process stability is demonstrated. 
 - Act as the senior technical authority for foundry products and casting-process issues in Ahmedabad. Support customers, Sales and Production on casting design, metallurgy, material selection, tolerances, technical feasibility, complex requirements and chronic defects, using structured problem-solving methods including 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa/Fishbone, Pareto analysis and statistical techniques. 
 - Own and continually improve the Ahmedabad Foundry Quality Management System, ensuring applicable customer and ISO 9001 requirements are implemented. Plan and support internal, customer and certification audits, close non-conformities and strengthen process controls, reaction plans, calibration, inspection, Statistical Process Control (SPC), process capability and quality performance across the foundry process. 
 - Own the technical response to major customer quality complaints, from immediate containment and evidence-based root-cause analysis through corrective and preventive actions, effectiveness verification and lessons learned. Monitor customer complaints, rejection performance, complaint closure, repeat issues, customer claims and audit findings to strengthen customer confidence. 
 - Govern metallurgical, laboratory and non-destructive testing (NDT) controls, including chemical composition, heat treatment, mechanical and hardness testing, metallography and applicable ultrasonic, magnetic particle, penetrant and radiographic testing. Ensure personnel qualifications, traceability and process controls meet applicable customer or international requirements and lead investigations of metallurgical failures. 
 - Develop and lead the foundry's annual technical and quality improvement roadmap, targeting scrap, repair and rework, first-pass and casting yield, process capability, energy and material optimization, development lead time, customer quality and cost. Apply Lean, Six Sigma, SPC, design of experiments and structured problem-solving where appropriate, and identify opportunities in automation, digital quality records, advanced inspection and process monitoring. 
 - Lead engineers and specialists across the functions, set individual and departmental Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), manage technical and quality priorities and risks, develop competency matrices and succession plans, coach the team and establish technical training plans. Exercise delegated technical and quality authority over production or dispatch holds, process changes, inspections, validation, dispositions and escalation of nonconforming products, and recommend capability investments. 

What You'll Bring

- Deep expertise gained in a heavy engineering or ferrous foundry environment, with strong experience spanning technical or product development and quality, significant hands-on exposure to casting development and foundry problem-solving and experience in customer-facing technical or quality roles. 
 - Strong technical knowledge of ferrous metallurgy and casting technology, including melting and metallurgical control, moulding and core-making, gating and feeding systems, heat treatment and casting-defect analysis. 
 - Practical knowledge of NDT and destructive testing, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), engineering drawings, APQP/PPAP, PFMEA, control plans, SPC and process capability, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, 8D/root-cause analysis and Lean/Six Sigma methodology. 
 - Proven leadership experience guiding engineers and cross-functional improvement projects, with the ability to set direction, establish performance measures, build technical capability and develop future technical leadership. 
 - Ability to work across customers, engineering, sales, quality, foundry operations, suppliers and other stakeholders, translating technical requirements into clear manufacturing and quality specifications and supporting evidence-based technical decisions. 
 - A B. E. /B. Tech in Metallurgy, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering or an equivalent qualification. 

Nice to have

- A master's degree in Metallurgy, Materials or Manufacturing. 

What's In It For You

At Metso, you will combine meaningful work with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact in a supportive and inclusive environment. You'll be part of a global team where collaboration, wellbeing, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. 

We support your growth and wellbeing by offering: 

- Purpose-led work: Contribute to enabling sustainable modern life and transforming the industry. 
 - Wellbeing: Access to wellbeing programs, occupational healthcare, and supportive services. 
 - Rewards: Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives. 
 - Growth: Learning pathways, mentoring, internal mobility, and global collaboration opportunities. 
 - Culture: A caring, collaborative, and inclusive workplace committed to helping you thrive. 

Get in touch

Want to rise above the possible with us? Click "Apply now" to submit your application or share your profiles at amit. prajapati@metso. com

We recognize that highly capable candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification. You may be exactly the right candidate for the role.

data.title: ServiceNow QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
BETSOL is a cloud-first digital transformation and data management company offering products and IT services to enterprises in over 40 countries. BETSOL team holds several engineering patents, is recognized with industry awards, and BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average. 

BETSOL's open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda. com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and best-in-class performance. 

BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL. com) builds and supports end-to-end enterprise solutions, reducing time-to-market for its customers. 

BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore, India. 

We take pride in being an employee-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities. 

Learn more at betsol. com

Job Description

BETSOL's team designs and runs software license tracking on ServiceNow SAM Professional. For each software publisher brought into scope, the team analyses contracts, models entitlements and consumption, and delivers a custom publisher view and dashboard that shows licenses owned, licenses consumed and the resulting compliance position. The publishers we work with span SaaS and enterprise software, each with its own license metrics, SKUs and data sources. 

We are looking for a QA engineer who can test ServiceNow SAM implementation end to end and keep growing the test automation. You will validate the calculations behind every license number, to prove that dashboards match the underlying report data, and turn repeatable checks into automated scripts so that releases move from development to UAT to production quickly. You will work closely with ServiceNow developers, business analysts and project managers, and with business stakeholders during UAT. 

Key responsibilities

Testing SAM publisher implementations

- Review publisher analysis and stories, then write test scenarios and test cases that trace back to the agreed requirements and expected dashboard output. 
 - Validate entitlement and consumption logic: rights owned, rights consumed, rights available and rights needed, license metrics (for example User Subscription versus Resource Consumption) and custom SKUs created for usage that standard SKUs do not cover. 
 - Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not. 
 - Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts. 
 - Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line). 
 - Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances. 

Building and running test automation

- Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines. 
 - Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight. 
 - Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks. 
 - Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers. 

Quality process and reporting

- Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current. 
 - Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT. 
 - Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment. 
 - Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience. 
 - Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance. 
 - Practical test automation experience, ideally with ServiceNow ATF, and enough JavaScript to read and write server-side scripts and GlideRecord queries. 
 - Strong data validation skills: comfortable reconciling numbers across tables, reports and spreadsheets, and explaining where a figure comes from. 
 - Experience writing structured test cases and sign-off reports, and using Jira and a test management tool such as Zephyr. 
 - Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to walk stakeholders through test results and to discuss your own past work in depth. 

Preferred Qualifications

- ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); a Certified Implementation Specialist in Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM) is a strong plus. 
 - Exposure to software licensing models for SaaS and enterprise publishers (named user, subscription, resource or consumption based). 
 - Experience testing REST API integrations and vendor usage exports. 
 - Familiarity with Agile delivery and ALM tools such as Jira.

This is your chance to change the path of your career and guide multiple teams to success at one of the world's leading financial institutions. 

As a Manager of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Employee Platforms Team, you lead multiple teams and manage day-to-day implementation activities by identifying and escalating issues and ensuring your team's work adheres to compliance standards, business requirements, and tactical best practices. 

Job Responsibilities

- Provides guidance to immediate team of software engineers on daily tasks and activities
 - Sets the overall guidance and expectations for team output, practices, and collaboration
 - Leads team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices and SDLC/TLM automation to improve delivery speed, quality, and operational outcomes, while setting expectations for human validation, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and consistent use of reusable patterns across teams. 
 - Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives. 
 - Anticipates dependencies with other teams to deliver products and applications in line with business requirements
 - Manages stakeholder relationships and the team's work in accordance with compliance standards, service level agreements, and business requirements

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience. In addition, demonstrated coaching and mentoring 
 - Experience leading technology projects
 - Experience managing technologists
 - Experience leading responsible adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and delivery tools across engineering teams, including defining ways of working (review/validation expectations), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of data. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, resiliency/security implications, and governance expectations; ability to coach engineers on compliant and effective usage. 
 - Hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
 - JAVA and AWS is mandatory requirement. 
 - Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle
 - Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- In-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and their IT systems
 - Good to Have Kamunda

data.description:
Job Description

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives. 

Job Responsibilities

- Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
 - Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
 - Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e. g. , code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness. 
 - Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. 
 - Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
 - Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
 - Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience. 
 - Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
 - Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
 - Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e. g. , for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 
 - Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, GraphQL, and microservices. Solid frontend engineering experience with React. 
 - Hands-on proficiency with JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend build tooling such as Vite, Webpack, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with micro frontend architecture, modular frontend design, shared components, and frontend integration patterns. 
 - Experience building component-based, responsive, accessible, and maintainable user interfaces
 - Experience with automated testing and quality engineering practices, including tools and frameworks such as JUnit, Playwright, React Testing Library, smoke testing, integration testing, or similar. 
 - Experience to AWS or similar cloud platforms and cloud-native design patterns. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. 

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Familiarity with modern front-end technologies
 - Experience in payments, financial services, or high-volume transaction platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud technologies

data.title: Head – Marine & Ports Design | Chennai
data.description:
Assystem provides engineering, project management and digital services to optimise the performance and safety of critical infrastructure throughout its lifecycle. 

The company first came to India having acquired Stup Consultants Pvt Ltd in 2021 and L&TIEL in 2024. The company combines its globally recognised expertise in complex project management, with deep-rooted local experience cross full spectrum of infrastructure - from energy, transportation and urban development to water. Today, Assystem has a strong community of 1, 500+ multidiscipline engineering experts connected across 8 offices in India. 

The Assystem Group is one of the world's leading independent nuclear engineering companies, ranked among the top three globally, with 60 years of experience in complex and highly regulated environments. With 8, 000 experts across 13 countries, Assystem supports the development of low-carbon energy. 

For company profile, please visit the website : - www. assystemstup. com

Provide strategic and operational leadership for the detailed design & engineering of port and marine infrastructure projects. The role will be accountable for end-to-end engineering delivery, business profitability (P&L ownership), and client satisfaction.

- Ensure compliance with HSE norms, quality standards, and statutory regulations.

- Education: B. E. /B. Tech in Civil/Structural/Marine; M. Tech/M. E. in Port/Marine Engineering preferred.

We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people's ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

data.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employees roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

About the Role We are looking for a Lead DevOps Engineer with deep expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and serverless architectures. You will be responsible for designing, automating, and optimizing our cloud infrastructure while leading DevOps best practices. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll collaborate with developers, QA, and architects to build scalable, secure, and cost-efficient systems that enable faster delivery. 

Responsibilities

- Design and implement serverless and event-driven architectures on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge). 
 - Lead and enforce Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation. 
 - Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable deployments. 
 - Develop automation scripts and tools in Python, Bash, or Go for operations and deployment tasks. 
 - Ensure cloud security best practices across IAM, secrets management, and compliance standards. 
 - Establish and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting for highly available systems. 
 - Partner with developers and architects to improve system reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers, setting DevOps standards across the organization. 
 - Participate in on-call rotations, leading troubleshooting and resolution of critical issues. 

Qualifications

Required: 

- 8+ years of experience in AWS cloud environments with proven serverless expertise. 
 - Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Bash, or Go). 
 - Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation). 
 - Deep knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows. 
 - Strong experience with containers (Docker, ECS, EKS/Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with monitoring/observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch). 
 - Solid understanding of networking and security concepts in cloud environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and influence cloud/DevOps architecture. 

Preferred

- Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA). 
 - Knowledge of cost optimization and FinOps practices in AWS. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read ourDiversity & Inclusion Statement.

Job Description

Reporting to the Supplier Quality Manager, the Supplier Quality Analyst (SQA) executes activities aiming to ensure that all supplied components within their portfolio of suppliers are ready to use when reaching internal or external customers. The SQA is the primary quality contact for assigned suppliers and is responsible for supplier qualification, audits, performance monitoring, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Qualify and audit new and existing suppliers to Husky standards. 
 - Monitor supplier performance and drive improvement actions. 
 - Manage supplier part qualification activities. 
 - Support containment actions, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation. 
 - Participate in Andon and Clinic activities related to supplier quality issues. 
 - Conduct quality risk assessments for localization and dual-sourcing initiatives. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Supply Chain Quality Management System. 

Critical Capabilities

- Strong knowledge of quality systems, supplier quality management, and auditing. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills using structured methodologies (8D, 5 Why, RCA). 
 - Ability to influence suppliers and drive corrective actions to closure. 
 - Understanding of manufacturing, assembly, and logistics processes. 
 - Strong analytical, project management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Willingness to travel domestically as required. 

Education, Experience & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Quality Engineering. 
 - Knowledge of machining, casting, fabrication, and assembly processes is an asset. 
 - Ability to read engineering drawings and interpret GD&T. 
 - Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and SPC. 
 - Experience with ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. 
 - Fluent in written and spoken English. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.description:
Hiring for PULS Group - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1, 700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure. 

About the Role

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code. 

What you'll do

- Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
 - Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
 - Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
 - Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
 - Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
 - Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
 - Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

What you bring

- 4-6+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering on production, customer-facing systems
 - Hands-on Azure: Container Apps or AKS, Azure Monitor, Key Vault and Entra ID
 - Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform that you wrote and maintained across environments
 - CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with security scanning and automated quality gates
 - Has operated PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar in production: backups, replication and performance tuning
 - Has designed monitoring and alerting and handled real incidents in live operations
 - Works AI-natively: uses Claude Code or Codex daily. Expect live pairing with a coding agent in the interview
 - English at C1 level and comfort working with colleagues in Munich and 21 markets

Nice to have

- Kubernetes depth, global CDN strategies and China deployments
 - Operating LLM/RAG workloads (Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry)
 - FinOps and cloud cost control; WAF/DDoS and hardening in production

data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‐throughput, hyper‐scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‐scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‐tolerant, in‐service‐upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‐shedding, throttling, and rate‐limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‐management plans. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

-Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

-Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

-Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options.
