data.title: Sr. QA Consultant, Amazon Connect / Contact Center QA
data.description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture: 

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions-integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more-to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies. 

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we've earned the distinction of being Salesforce's #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space. 

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you'll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you're ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you. 

NeuraFlash is a leading cloud consulting and AI solutions company specializing in Salesforce, AWS, and AI-powered customer experience solutions. Our Quality Assurance practice goes beyond traditional software testing-we combine quality engineering, automation, cloud technologies, and consulting expertise to help clients deliver reliable, scalable, and intelligent solutions. 

We are looking for an AWS Amazon Connect QA Consultant / Sr. QA Consultant to support complex cloud contact center implementations involving Amazon Connect, IVR/self-service, omnichannel communications, Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, APIs, and conversational/Generative AI. 

This role is ideal for a QA professional with strong hands-on contact center and telephony testing experience who can independently understand complex business flows, translate technical design artifacts into comprehensive test scenarios, coordinate across multiple stakeholders, and drive testing through release readiness. 

Key Responsibilities

Amazon Connect, IVR & Telephony Testing

- Design and execute functional, integration, regression and UAT test scenarios for Amazon Connect contact centers and complex IVRs. 
 - Translate Lucidchart/Visio IVR flow diagrams and requirements into detailed test scripts, ensuring complete branch/path coverage. 
 - Test DTMF, speech/ASR, Amazon Lex, self-service journeys, authentication, ANI lookup, error/timeout handling, transfer, escalation and callback scenarios. 
 - Validate routing profiles, queues, skills, priorities, agent states, hold/transfer/whisper flows, quick connects and supervisor functionality. 
 - Test telephony fundamentals including PSTN/DID/toll-free, IVR, ACD, WebRTC, SIP, call recording and transcription. 
 - Validate Amazon Connect Agent and Supervisor workspaces and use the Amazon Connect Endpoint Test Utility where applicable. 

AWS, API & Salesforce Integration Testing

- Test integrations across AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Amazon Lex, Contact Flows, Contact Lens and CloudWatch using the AWS Console and Amazon Connect Admin workspace. 
 - Perform end-to-end API testing across Amazon Connect, Salesforce and third-party systems using Postman, SoapUI, REST-assured or similar tools. 
 - Validate REST/SOAP requests and responses, schemas, data mapping, authentication, error handling, timeouts and fallback scenarios. 
 - Test Salesforce Service Cloud Voice (SCV) integrations including CTI controls, Omni-Channel, screen pops, Voice Call records, agent states and real-time transcription. 

Chat, AI & Omnichannel Testing

- Test Amazon Connect Chat and omnichannel customer journeys. 
 - Validate conversational and Generative AI experiences using Amazon Q in Connect, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex, Salesforce Agentforce or similar platforms. 
 - Test intent recognition, conversational flows, context, knowledge grounding, agent assist, generated responses, escalation/handoff and fallback scenarios. 
 - Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, relevance, hallucinations and appropriate guardrails. 

Test Data, Coordination & Delivery

- Source, prepare and map test data to individual test scenarios and maintain clear scenario-to-data traceability. 
 - Coordinate with clients, business teams, developers, architects and multiple vendors to understand E2E business processes and dependencies. 
 - Lead defect triage and track issues through closure with clear evidence, logs, recordings and reproduction steps. 
 - Prepare test execution reports, quality metrics, test evidence and release/go-no-go recommendations. 

Automation & Performance Testing

- Experience with IVR automation tools such as Cyara, Empirix Hammer, Bespoken, Operata or similar. 
 - Support API, voice and chat test automation and CI/CD-based continuous testing. 
 - Experience planning and executing load/performance testing using JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad or equivalent tools is desirable. 

Must-Have Skills & Experience

- 5+ years of overall QA/testing experience, including 3+ years in contact center, CTI, IVR, telephony or cloud contact center platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on Amazon Connect testing experience, preferably with complex IVR and self-service implementations. 
 - Proven ability to read Lucidchart/Visio IVR designs and independently convert them into comprehensive functional test scripts. 
 - Strong understanding of IVR, ACD/routing, DTMF, ASR, PSTN, DID/toll-free, call recording and transcription. 
 - Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect Admin workspace and AWS Console, including Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Lex and Contact Flows. 
 - Experience testing Amazon Connect Agent/Supervisor workspace and Chat. 
 - Experience with Amazon Q in Connect, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex or other conversational/Generative AI platforms. 
 - Strong API and integration testing experience using Postman, SoapUI, REST-assured or equivalent. 
 - Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud Voice / CTI / Omni-Channel is highly desirable. 
 - Strong test planning, test case design, regression testing, defect management and release readiness experience. 
 - Experience with Jira, qTest, QMetry, TestRail, Zephyr or equivalent test management tools. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience with Cyara, Empirix Hammer or other IVR automation tools. 
 - Load, performance and/or security testing experience. 
 - Experience validating Generative AI quality, hallucinations, grounding and guardrails. 
 - Salesforce SOQL/reporting, Amazon Connect metrics, Contact Lens and CloudWatch experience. 
 - Multi-language IVR/chat testing. 
 - Experience with Genesys, Cisco, Avaya, Twilio or other contact center platforms. 

What You'll Bring

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a quality engineering mindset. 
 - Ability to work independently in complex, multi-vendor consulting environments. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to identify gaps in requirements, test data, integrations and E2E business processes. 
 - Ability to clearly communicate quality risks and provide data-driven release readiness recommendations. 

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. 

What's it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

- Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we're focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team. 
 - Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients. 
 - Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn't possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
 - Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it's a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small. 
 - Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don't forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

data.title: Solution Architect | Shopify + eComm IRC307837
data.description:
Description

This organization operates within the dynamic retail sector, specializing in consumer-facing products and services. It leverages advanced digital platforms to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences to a broad customer base. The company focuses on integrating innovative technologies to enhance customer engagement and streamline online purchasing journeys. Its market position is defined by a commitment to quality offerings and a robust digital infrastructure that supports scalable operations. The enterprise continuously evolves its technological capabilities to meet changing consumer demands and maintain a competitive edge in the digital marketplace. 

Requirements

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Hands-on eCommerce Solution Architect to lead the architecture, design, development, and implementation of enterprise Retail and eCommerce solutions. 

The candidate must have 15+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 12+ years of hands-on eCommerce technology experience, with proven experience delivering production projects on Shopify and at least one additional eCommerce platform, such as VTEX, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), commercetools, or SAP Commerce Cloud. 

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in eCommerce architecture, headless commerce, API-led integrations, and retail ecosystem systems, including Payment Gateways, OMS, ERP, PIM, WMS, Loyalty, and CRM. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can drive architecture decisions, develop proof of concepts, review implementations, mentor engineering teams, and ensure scalable, secure, and reliable solutions across the full software development lifecycle. 

Required Skills: 

- Demonstrated expert-level proficiency and extensive hands-on experience with Shopify Plus, including deep knowledge of Liquid templating language and platform customization capabilities. 
 - Mandatory expertise in the retail and e-commerce domain, with a proven track record of architecting and delivering successful digital commerce solutions. 
 - Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential for articulating complex architectural concepts to diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Advanced understanding and practical application of Clean Architecture and Layered Architectures principles in designing robust and maintainable software systems. 
 - Strong advanced knowledge of database design, optimization, and management, ensuring high performance and scalability for critical e-commerce data. 
 - Proven advanced capability in solution architecture, including the ability to translate business requirements into comprehensive technical designs and system blueprints. 
 - Advanced proficiency in HTML, with a strong ability to develop and optimize front-end structures for responsive and user-friendly e-commerce interfaces. 
 - Advanced expertise in JavaScript, including modern frameworks and libraries, for building dynamic and interactive web applications within the e-commerce ecosystem. 
 - Advanced experience with CRM systems, demonstrating the ability to integrate and leverage customer relationship management platforms to enhance business processes. 

Preferred Skills: 

Job responsibilities

Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance Retail and eCommerce solutions. 

Translate business requirements into robust, maintainable solution architectures aligned with business objectives. 

Define architecture standards, design principles, integration patterns, and technology guidelines. 

Create High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), solution architecture diagrams, API specifications, and integration documentation. 

Design commerce solutions using Shopify and at least one additional enterprise eCommerce platform. 

Evaluate native platform capabilities, third-party applications, extensions, and custom development requirements. 

Design headless, composable, and omnichannel commerce architectures where appropriate. 

Lead platform replatforming, modernization, migration, and phased implementation initiatives. 

Define non-functional requirements covering performance, scalability, availability, security, and operational resilience. 

eCommerce Platform Expertise

Demonstrate hands-on implementation and architecture experience with Shopify, including Shopify Plus where applicable. 

Design and implement Shopify integrations using Admin GraphQL APIs, Storefront API, REST APIs where applicable, webhooks, metafields, metaobjects, themes, app extensions, and Shopify Markets. 

Have substantial implementation experience with at least one additional eCommerce platform, such as VTEX, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), commercetools, or SAP Commerce Cloud. 

Understand platform-specific capabilities, extensibility models, APIs, integration patterns, and architectural trade-offs. 

Lead technical assessments and recommend appropriate platform capabilities, native integrations, third-party applications, or custom solutions. 

Drive implementation strategies for multi-brand, multi-market, multi-currency, and omnichannel commerce solutions. 

Development & Integration Architecture

Remain hands-on by developing proof of concepts, validating architectural approaches, and contributing to complex technical implementations. 

Design and implement API-led integrations using GraphQL, REST, webhooks, and event-driven communication patterns. 

Architect middleware, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), microservices, and integration orchestration layers using Node. js, . NET, Java, or equivalent technologies. 

Design secure, scalable integrations between eCommerce platforms and enterprise retail systems, including: 

Payment Gateways: Payment authorization, capture, refunds, tokenization, fraud prevention, split payments, and PCI DSS considerations. 

Order Management Systems (OMS): Order orchestration, status synchronization, order allocation, cancellations, returns, refunds, and fulfillment. 

Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP): Product, pricing, order, inventory, financial, and fulfillment data synchronization. 

Product Information Management (PIM) and Digital Asset Management (DAM): Product catalog, attributes, taxonomy, media assets, localization, and enrichment. 

Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Inventory Systems: Stock synchronization, reservations, availability, fulfillment, and multi-location inventory. 

Loyalty and CRM Platforms: Customer profiles, membership, points, rewards, promotions, subscriptions, and customer engagement. 

CDP and MarTech Platforms: Customer data, consent, segmentation, personalization, marketing automation, analytics, and event tracking. 

Tax, Shipping, Search, and Marketplace Systems: Tax calculation, carrier integrations, delivery estimates, product feeds, marketplace orders, and search capabilities. 

Define integration contracts, data mappings, transformation rules, error handling, retry mechanisms, idempotency, reconciliation, and rate-limiting strategies. 

Ensure reliable data synchronization across products, prices, inventory, customers, orders, payments, and fulfillment systems. 

Drive code quality through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical coaching, and implementation guidance. 

Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide architectural recommendations for reliability, performance, and scalability improvements. 

Mentorship & Team Collaboration

Mentor Solution Architects, Technical Leads, and Software Engineers across multiple delivery teams. 

Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, UX/UI, QA, DevOps, Security, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders. 

Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical discussions, and proof-of-concept development. 

Establish reusable architecture patterns, integration frameworks, reference implementations, and engineering standards. 

Guide teams in implementing modern software engineering practices, automated testing, CI/CD, and secure development. 

Collaborate with clients and third-party vendors to resolve integration dependencies and align technical implementation with business objectives. 

Support technical presales, solution estimation, architecture assessments, and proposal development where required. 

Scalability, Security & Performance

Design highly available, scalable, resilient, and secure eCommerce architectures. 

Define performance and scalability strategies for storefronts, commerce APIs, middleware, and downstream integrations. 

Establish observability strategies covering logging, metrics, distributed tracing, monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards. 

Define security practices for authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, API protection, and secure integrations. 

Understand payment security, tokenization boundaries, and PCI DSS implications. 

Define and validate non-functional requirements, including latency, throughput, availability, disaster recovery, and platform API rate limits. 

Drive technical debt reduction, architecture modernization, operational optimization, and continuous improvement. 

What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. 

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment - or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. 

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master), Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. 

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. 

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world's largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we've been at the forefront of the digital revolution - helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

State Management: - Proficiency with Redux and Redux-Toolkit. - Familiarity with Context API and when to use it vs. Redux. - Understanding of state management patterns and when to apply them. Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies' growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We're scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.

Jefferies' Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum-cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting. 

Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores.

The Global Equities Data & Analytics team is seeking a Tech Lead in Pune to lead technology delivery, development and production support for the Global Equities Data & Analytics Platform. 

The platform provides real-time and historical market data and analytics services to more than 10 global trading desks, including Cash Equities, Listed and OTC Derivatives, Electronic Trading, Algo Trading, Index Rebalance, ETFs, Delta One, Central Risk Book and Securities Finance.

 - Write and maintain technical documentation, runbooks and support guides. 
 - Bring critical thinking and new ideas to improve platform design, analytics and operational processes. 

Required Qualifications

- 6+ years of experience working with large financial datasets, including market data, order/execution data, positions data and/or reference data. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on KDB+/Q experience. 
 - Strong experience working in Unix/Linux environments. 
 - Strong programming experience in Python, preferably with cloud data technologies such as Iceberg and Parquet. 
 - Java experience is preferred. 
 - Experience designing and supporting real-time and historical data platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of large-scale financial database design and data management. 
 - Experience building scalable, efficient and high-quality software solutions. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with global developers, QA teams, production support teams and business stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced front-office technology environment. 
 - Ability to learn new technologies and business domains quickly. 
 - Experience with Agile delivery methodologies. 

Highly Valued Skills

- Capital markets experience across Equities, Derivatives, ETFs, Index, Delta One, Algo Trading or Electronic Trading. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS. 
 - Experience with high-performance messaging, in-memory databases and distributed systems. 
 - Proven delivery track record in a global financial services technology environment. 
 - Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead end-to-end delivery. 
 - Ability to mentor team members and promote engineering best practices. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capability. 
 - Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills. 

About Us

Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments. 

At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. Summary

Position Summary

Specialist Manager - Duty Officer

Do you have a sharp eye for detail and a passion for turning good work into great work? In the US India Deloitte Security Operations Center (DSOC) within the Deloitte Office of Security, we need a player-coach on our watch floor to ensure the quality and accuracy of our intelligence products. As a Duty Officer, you will manage and mentor a team of physical security Intelligence Analysts, serving as the final quality control checkpoint for the actionable information to keep Deloitte's people and assets safe. You will be a key part of an innovative team where precision and collaboration are paramount. 

Work you'll do

The Duty Officer will manage a team of Intelligence Analysts on a specific shift, acting as the primary editor of their work. You will lead service quality assurance for this team. The Duty Officer will also play a critical role in the shift handoff process by compiling, verifying, and signing off on intelligence reports, ensuring a seamless transfer of knowledge and situational awareness between shifts. 

- Manage daily responsibilities, tasking, and performance of Intelligence Analysts on an assigned shift 
 - Review, edit, and provide final quality control sign off for all intelligence products created by the team, including situation reports and daily summaries 
 - Ensure operational continuity between shifts by overseeing and signing off on all intelligence outputs and handoff documentation 
 - Act as a subject matter expert, providing guidance and on-the-job training to mentor and develop junior analysts 
 - Assist the Watch Commander to deliver high-priority alerts and messages during emerging events 
 - Perform hands-on intelligence analysis duties to support the team during peak operational tempos as needed 
 - Triage and validate incoming information and alerts, ensuring proper escalation according to established procedures 
 - Manage the development and refinement of analytical standards and reporting templates, and reinforce analytic tradecraft standards (structured analytic techniques, source evaluation, confidence language) through peer review 
 - Ensure all case details and analyst actions are accurately documented in the incident case management system 
 - Serve as an escalation point for analysts, providing initial guidance on complex or unusual incidents requiring analysis and documentation 
 - Monitor and provide analytical info to EP upon request for US and Client executives when traveling within India

 - Coordinate and facilitate shift-level training exercises and drills to validate readiness, ensure compliance with DSOC procedures, and identify areas for operational improvement

The team

The Office of Security team supports the protection of Deloitte people, workplaces, operations, and assets across US India offices. Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. Johnson & Johnson is seeking an IT Product Lead Engineer - HR Digital Front Door to be in India. In this role, you will set and enforce front-end standards, guide architectural decisions (e. g. , micro-frontends, shared libraries, design systems), and work directly with engineers through design and code reviews to continuously improve quality, performance, and accessibility (WCAG). 

Within Corporate Business Technology, you will own the technical lifecycle of the Digital Front Door front-end platform - from concept through delivery, optimization, and framework upgrade while coordinating dependencies across squads. You will also serve as a key technical point of contact for security, privacy, compliance, accessibility, and platform governance to ensure solutions align to enterprise standards and risk requirements. 

You should bring strong experience in product and software delivery, front-end architecture (Angular/TypeScript), and complex integrations in an enterprise environment. Success in this role requires comfort leading across squads through influence, making sound architectural tradeoffs, and partnering closely with Product Managers, UX, and engineering stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions that improve employees' day-to-day lives.

Architecture & Technical Leadership

 - Participate in and lead code reviews, design reviews, and technical enablement. 
 - Guide teams in implementing scalable, testable, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in performance, accessibility (WCAG), reliability, and user experience. 

Platform & Lifecycle Ownership

- Own the full technical lifecycle of the J&J's employee Digital Front Door front‐end platform, from concept through delivery, optimization, and retirement. 
 - Manage dependencies across multiple squads and coordinate technical alignment. 
 - Monitor platform health, technical debt, and reusability across teams. 
 - Lead adoption of new technologies, framework upgrades (e. g. , Angular major versions), and front‐end innovations. 

Collaboration & Product Partnership

 - Collaborate closely with UX, API, backend, cloud, and enterprise platform teams to deliver cohesive user experiences. 

Governance & Risk

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

VM Essentials (VME) is a next-generation virtualization platform that enables customers to provision and manage KVM-based HVM and VMware ESXi virtual machines through a single, intuitive management interface.

 - Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable. 
 - Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.

Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. 
 - Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
 - Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 

Hands On experience with Performance Engineering is important. 

- 5+ years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, . NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.

data.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Designs and architects infrastructure and service to ensure reliability and functionality. Forecasts demands and responds to capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop reliable and scalable infrastructures. Exercises judgment when performing data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting. Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation. Communicates comprehensive information about services and proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of changes. Provides comprehensive support for technology and documents incidents. Conducts advanced experiments with new tools and develops and maintains advanced knowledge of site reliability trends. 

Responsibilities

Mandatory

- 5+ years of hands-on experience across software development, site reliability engineering, monitoring, and automation, with demonstrated ownership of production platforms. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and experience developing backend services, REST APIs, integrations, and event-driven workflows. 
 - Proven experience building monitoring and observability solutions that collect and analyze alerts, metrics, logs, and service context. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into applications for incident analysis, contextual recommendations, and operational decision support. 
 - Ability to develop reusable agents that combine live monitoring data, historical incidents, and previous remediation actions to recommend next steps. 
 - Experience implementing alert correlation, deduplication, enrichment, and prioritization to reduce noise and improve incident detection. 
 - Strong experience developing automated remediation workflows with approval controls, execution validation, audit trails, and recovery safeguards. 
 - Experience integrating monitoring platforms with incident management systems, knowledge repositories, and notification or escalation services. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, Linux, networking, databases, and application performance, with the ability to translate failure patterns into platform capabilities. 
 - Experience applying software engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, version control, and secure development. 
 - Ability to evaluate platform reliability and AI output quality, measure operational outcomes, and improve capabilities using engineer feedback. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with monitoring teams, service owners, and engineers to onboard services and define requirements. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience with agentic AI frameworks, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector databases. 
 - Knowledge of anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and predictive techniques for identifying recurring alarm patterns. 
 - Experience building centralized notification services, automated escalation calls, and incident communication workflows. 
 - Familiarity with OCI, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible. 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as OCI Observability, Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent tools. 
 - Exposure to Oracle Database and Exadata monitoring, performance diagnostics, and remediation automation. 
 - Experience using AI coding assistants to improve operational scripts and validate proposed changes. 
 - Knowledge of SLOs, error budgets, and incident metrics such as detection time, recovery time, and recurrence rate. 

Key Responsibilities

Capacity Ingestion and Management: 

- Designs and architects infrastructure and/or service according to terms for reliability and functionality. 
 - Forecasts demands for infrastructure and responds to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads and identifying resource gaps. 
 - Collaborates with the software development team to develop infrastructures, ensuring features are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements. 
 - Proactively identifies opportunities for prototyping and drives prototyping initiatives (e. g. , testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches. 

Incident and Service Lifecycle Management: 

- Exercises judgment when performing data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability. 
 - Takes proactive steps to monitor services, maintain up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and document their condition. 
 - Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e. g. , software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery). 
 - Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data. 
 - May perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services. 
 - May experiment with new approaches for and performs decommissioning (e. g. , shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed. 

Automation: 

- Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits to enhance operational efficiency. 
 - Develops and implements design, automation tools, or scripts to provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects within infrastructures. 
 - Conducts testing on moderately complex automations to ensure they perform tasks correctly and produce expected results. 

Technical Communication and Guidance: 

- Writes release notes and/or communicates comprehensive information about the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology with customers and immediate and related teams. 
 - Proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact across team operations. 
 - Serves as a resource to team members on what information to communicate and how to communicate. 

Troubleshooting and Resolution: 

- Provides comprehensive operational support for technology, serving as a key escalation point for incidents and moderately complex issues arising within Oracle services. 
 - Drives and actively participates in on-call shifts to address issues. 
 - Executes the resolution of technical issues spanning multiple services, applying advanced investigation and debugging techniques to achieve SLOs (service level objectives). 
 - Documents incidents according to reporting methods and performs root cause analyses, capturing essential information for analysis and future reference. 
 - Performs post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence. 

Innovation and Improvement: 

- Conducts advanced experiments and evaluations of cutting-edge tools and technologies to optimize infrastructure performance and reliability, taking proactive steps to adhere to security standards. 
 - Identifies and seeks opportunities to execute improvements for performance bottlenecks and deployments, ensuring efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability. 
 - Develops and maintains advanced knowledge of site reliability trends, sharing valuable insights and information with senior team members, management, and beyond to promote innovative building, testing, deploying, and running services. 
 - Performs moderately complex analyses and provides clear data on production to drive business development decisions (e. g. , design changes). 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Experience Working In a Saas Product Company. 

Experience with Context, Router 5, Styled Components.

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer's partner on the inside

Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it. 

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve

Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build Each Other Up

Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

data.title: Senior Application Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the application software development lifecycle. Utilizes working knowledge to develop new application features and enhancements following design specifications, and develops documents to clarify application design and code. Leads code reviews in designated application areas to help drive improvements. Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex application issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality, integration, and service-to-service interactions. Designs and develops application software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined application architecture. Collaborates within and beyond the immediate team to understand customer use cases and align application solutions. May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding application-related issues, independently. Collaborates with the team to establish and follow application development practices, secure coding standards, and code quality. Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for application systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Application Software Development: 

- Drives medium features and quality improvements with measurable performance and reliability outcomes. 
 - Provides global production support for critical issues with minimal guidance; improves playbooks/alerts. 
 - Troubleshoots and debugs non-routine issues spanning application layers and common OCI services; proposes fixes. 
 - Partners with QA to define test strategy (unit/integration) for features; ensures consistency across modules. 
 - Considers trade-offs in existing architecture; proposes moderate design improvements. 
 - Translates ambiguous requirements into scalable designs and implementation plans. 
 - Defines and stabilizes API contracts and dependencies for the application area. 
 - Recommends build priorities within the team using data from incidents, telemetry, and customer feedback. 
 - Systematically incorporates external feedback (forums, live-site reports) into backlog refinement. 
 - Mentors junior engineers; coordinates cross-functionally on feature delivery. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up-to-date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead customer-focused system testing and solution validation for Service Provider and Cloud networking solutions. The role will drive test strategy, automation, quality, scalability, and deployment readiness while collaborating with customers, Field Engineering, Product Development, and other cross-functional teams. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and manage a team responsible for customer-focused network system testing, solution validation, automation, and certification. 
 - Provide technical direction for feature, scale, migration, performance, interoperability, and end-to-end solution testing. 
 - Work closely with customers, Field Engineers, Sales Engineers, Product Development, and Product Management teams to understand deployment architectures and define validation strategies. 
 - Review complex customer network architectures, topologies, requirements, and deployment scenarios and ensure appropriate test coverage. 
 - Drive the development and execution of comprehensive system-level and solution-level test strategies and plans. 
 - Guide teams in building and maintaining lab environments that replicate large-scale customer deployments. 
 - Provide technical leadership for the validation and troubleshooting of routers, switches, Junos/EVO platforms, and Service Provider network solutions. 
 - Drive adoption and improvement of Python, Robot Framework, and other test automation frameworks to increase automation coverage and reduce validation cycle time. 
 - Ensure effective utilization of network traffic generation and performance testing platforms such as Ixia and Spirent. 
 - Review test results, product defects, performance bottlenecks, scalability limitations, and reliability issues, and drive them to closure with engineering teams. 
 - Lead technical escalations and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex customer and product issues. 
 - Identify gaps in product functionality, test coverage, automation, and customer deployment readiness. 
 - Establish appropriate quality metrics and ensure timely communication of testing status, risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans to stakeholders. 
 - Participate in customer design workshops, technical reviews, solution discussions, and critical customer engagements. 
 - Partner with engineering leadership to continuously improve validation methodologies, automation frameworks, lab utilization, and engineering productivity. 
 - Recruit, coach, mentor, and develop engineers while building strong technical capabilities within the team. 
 - Manage priorities, resource allocation, project commitments, and execution across multiple customer and engineering programs. 
 - Foster collaboration across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams. 
 - Drive the adoption of AI-driven automation, AI agents, and AI-powered testing tools to accelerate validation, improve coverage, enhance defect detection, and increase overall engineering productivity. 

What You Need To Bring

 - Safety and Regulatory Compliance: Contributes to the identification of internal and external regulations in cooperation with country organizations and development of processes to meet these requirements. Ensure that product safety activities are in line with internal and external regulations.

data.title: Performance Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Be part of something bigger. Decode the future. 

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living. 

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together. 

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home. 

All About The Role

As Performance Engineer, you will report directly to the Platform Engineering and SRE Engineering Manager. 

The Performance Engineer will be part of our Cloud Native organization, will work closely with our Product teams in eCommerce, Digital Marketing and other Consumer solutions and be involved in the full Software Lifecycle. We already have a solid, modern Engineering foundation and want to continuously improve in a dynamic, iterative manner. 

You'll own how we prove that our consumer platforms perform at scale: from understanding how customers really use our systems, through designing realistic load and performance tests, to finding bottlenecks and seeing the fixes through. This is both a creative and a detail-oriented role in a very multicultural environment. We want you to be bursting with opinions and passionate about sharing, as well as executing them in a collaborative way. 

About The CDI Experience Organization

The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end-users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI. 

At CDI XO, Electrolux Group's Consumer Direct Interaction Organization, we are transforming everyday life through digital innovation. 

Our engineers help design and build solutions, big and small, to enable a range of highly connected Consumer Market solutions in a modern distributed landscape. Our new team members will be working at the cutting edge of Cloud Native technology and patterns. We strive to develop, build, deploy and run intelligently. 

What You'll Do

- Gather and analyse performance requirements and architectural dependencies with product teams, architects and business stakeholders. 
 - Build workload models from production evidence (observability data, gateway logs, real user monitoring) so that tests reflect how customers actually use our platforms. 
 - Design, develop, execute and monitor the full range of performance tests: load, stress, soak, spike and scalability, at both API and client side. 
 - Create and maintain performance testing frameworks, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines so performance is checked continuously, not just before a release. 
 - Automate manual and repetitive performance testing activities, and treat test scripts, configuration and dashboards as code (no point and click). 
 - Analyse application, infrastructure and database performance issues, find complex bottlenecks, and drive tuning initiatives through to completion. 

Work across a stack that includes: 

- Observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, and Azure Monitor. 
 - Enterprise SaaS and PaaS systems in the eCommerce, Finance and Logistics arenas. 
 - Cloud-native architectures on Microsoft Azure, including Kubernetes and microservices. 
 - Build performance dashboards, prepare reports and give clear, evidence-based updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Manage test environments and test data, and make the gaps between test and production environments visible. 
 - Work with SRE colleagues to tie performance targets to SLOs and SLIs, and use test results to protect Error Budgets. 
 - Identify risks and issues early, and give actionable recommendations. 
 - Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps teams and business stakeholders to choose the right design solutions and make sure performance objectives are met. 
 - Mentor engineers in performance engineering practices, and stay current with tools and industry trends. 

But. . . the most important thing is that you are genuinely passionate about performance engineering and continuous improvement. 

Who Are You

- 5 to 8 years of experience in performance testing and engineering. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on experience with Apache JMeter. 
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience with BlazeMeter. 
 - Strong monitoring experience with Dynatrace and Datadog. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Proficiency in scripting with Java, Python and/or JavaScript. 
 - Strong experience automating performance testing, with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 
 - Good knowledge of SQL and databases such as PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience with client-side performance testing and performance monitoring dashboards. 
 - Proven ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and give optimisation recommendations. 
 - Knowledge of Kubernetes, microservices and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including requirement gathering, stakeholder management and sprint-based delivery. 
 - Experience working with customers to understand deployment architectures and use cases. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills; self-driven, flexible and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Computer Science/Software Engineering related degree. 
 - Fluent English, written and spoken. 

Desirable Qualifications And Experience

- Knowledge of AWS. 
 - Heap dump and thread dump analysis. 
 - Experience with Git. 
 - Experience with SAP systems, particularly SAP Commerce Cloud. 
 - Strong understanding of Datadog RUM. 

Where you'll be

This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India. Immediate joiners are preferred. 

Benefits Highlights

- Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
 - Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services
 - Family-friendly benefits
 - Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

IND Staff Software Engineer - GCC011

We're determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals - and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. 

Job Description: QA Automation Engineer

AI-First Quality Engineering & Test Automation

Location

Hyderabad, India

Employment Type

Full-Time

Experience Level

8+ Years

Organization

Claims & Operations IT, Customer Communications Solutions (CCS)

Role Focus

QA automation, Playwright, TypeScript/JavaScript, API automation, CI/CD quality gates, and AI-first quality engineering

AI Experience

Practical AI/LLM experience required. Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS AI services, Azure AI, OpenAI-based platforms, GitHub Copilot, or similar enterprise-approved tools accepted

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled QA Automation Engineer to join our Enterprise Customer Communications Solutions team in Hyderabad, India. This role is ideal for a quality engineer who combines strong test automation fundamentals with an AI-first engineering mindset and practical experience using AI-enabled tools to improve test design, automation development, defect prevention, test intelligence, and release confidence. 

In this role, you will design, build, and maintain reliable automated tests across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end layers; embed quality checks into CI/CD pipelines; and partner closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Architecture teams to prevent defects earlier in the SDLC. 

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience applying AI/LLM capabilities to quality engineering activities. Experience may include Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS AI services, Azure AI, OpenAI-based platforms, GitHub Copilot, agentic testing tools, or other enterprise-approved AI platforms. The candidate should be comfortable using AI to accelerate test case generation, automation development, test data strategy, failure triage, log analysis, defect clustering, documentation, and continuous improvement while following responsible AI and enterprise data protection practices. 

Mandatory AI-First QA Expectations

- Demonstrated AI-first mindset and practical AI/LLM experience applied to QA, test automation, or software engineering productivity. 
 - Ability to use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate testing while validating AI-generated test cases, code, summaries, and recommendations. 
 - Experience may be with Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS AI services, Azure AI, OpenAI-based platforms, GitHub Copilot, or similar enterprise-approved AI platforms. 
 - Candidate should understand the difference between basic prompt usage and disciplined AI-assisted quality engineering. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation Development

- Develop and maintain automated test suites for critical business journeys, including smoke, regression, integration, end-to-end, and release readiness testing. 
 - Create maintainable UI automation using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript, including reusable fixtures, selectors, page abstractions, shared utilities, and scalable framework patterns. 
 - Build and enhance API automation, including request validation, response assertions, data setup/teardown, service-level validation, and basic contract testing where applicable. 
 - Partner with engineers to analyze test failures, triage defects, identify root causes, and prevent recurring regressions. 
 - Design automation that supports fast feedback, repeatability, maintainability, and high confidence in production releases. 

AI-First Quality Engineering

- Apply AI-assisted testing practices across the QA lifecycle, including test design, test case generation, automation scaffolding, script refactoring, documentation, defect analysis, test data analysis, and failure triage. 
 - Use approved AI/LLM platforms and tools to accelerate quality engineering outcomes while validating AI-generated outputs before use. 
 - Leverage AI capabilities to summarize logs, traces, screenshots, execution reports, and defect patterns to reduce manual analysis effort. 
 - Explore AI-driven approaches for flaky test detection, failure clustering, automated root cause suggestions, test coverage analysis, and release risk insights. 
 - Contribute to proofs of concept that improve test intelligence, automation resiliency, QA productivity, or release confidence. 
 - Follow responsible AI, security, privacy, and enterprise data-handling guidelines when using AI-enabled testing tools. 

Framework & CI/CD Integration

- Contribute to and continuously improve the Playwright automation framework, including structure, utilities, reporting, execution patterns, and coding standards. 
 - Implement scalable execution capabilities such as parallelization, environment orchestration, cross-browser coverage, and reliable test data management. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for pull request validation, scheduled regression runs, release validation, and quality gates. 
 - Improve automation reporting so engineering teams can quickly understand failures, trends, risks, and release readiness. 
 - Partner with DevOps to ensure automated tests are stable, observable, and aligned with deployment workflows. 

Quality Governance, Metrics & Release Confidence

- Define automation scope for critical business journeys and ensure appropriate coverage for new and changed features. 
 - Track and report quality metrics such as automation pass rate, stability, flakiness, defect leakage, failure patterns, and release readiness. 
 - Use AI-assisted analysis where appropriate to identify trends, recurring failures, quality risks, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Communicate test status, release risks, and quality recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner. 
 - Support continuous improvement of QA practices, automation standards, and quality engineering maturity. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in test automation for web, API, and/or enterprise applications. 
 - Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks. 
 - Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript. 
 - Hands-on experience with Playwright or comparable modern UI automation frameworks. 
 - Experience building and maintaining API automation. 
 - Deep experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Practical experience using AI/LLM-based tools to improve QA or software engineering productivity. 
 - Demonstrated AI-first mindset, including the ability to identify where AI can improve test authoring, defect analysis, automation maintenance, test intelligence, and QA efficiency. 
 - Experience with at least one AI platform or AI-enabled engineering ecosystem, such as Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS AI services, Azure AI, OpenAI-based services, GitHub Copilot, or other approved enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of responsible AI usage, including validation of AI-generated outputs, protection of sensitive data, and adherence to enterprise governance standards. 
 - Experience making framework-level or architecture-level automation decisions in complex environments. 
 - Strong background in Agile, DevOps, continuous testing, and shift-left quality practices. 
 - Experience supporting cloud-native, microservices, API-driven, or distributed systems. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to influence quality outcomes through pragmatic decision-making and partnership with engineering teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, AWS SageMaker, Azure AI, OpenAI-based platforms, or similar enterprise AI services. 
 - Experience applying AI to test case generation, automation code generation, defect triage, log summarization, root cause analysis, or test coverage analysis. 
 - Familiarity with agent-based testing concepts, AI orchestration patterns, MCP, or similar integration approaches. 
 - Experience with test intelligence platforms, observability tools, analytics dashboards, or automated quality reporting. 
 - Experience in enterprise-scale or regulated environments. 
 - Prior experience driving quality transformation, automation modernization, or QA productivity improvement initiatives. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Cloud, testing, automation, AI, or quality engineering certifications. 

Hiring Manager Screening Guidance

This role should target candidates who can clearly explain how they have used AI in real QA or engineering work. Strong candidates should be able to discuss how they used AI tools to accelerate test authoring or automation development, how they validated AI-generated test cases or code, how they used AI to summarize logs or failures, how they protected sensitive data, and how they integrated automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 

A weaker candidate may only describe basic prompt usage or generic AI familiarity. A stronger candidate will demonstrate hands-on experience applying AI in the SDLC, especially in test automation, failure analysis, quality insights, and engineering productivity. 

Short Position Summary For Recruiters

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer in Hyderabad with 8+ years of experience who has strong Playwright, TypeScript/JavaScript, API automation, and CI/CD experience, plus a demonstrated AI-first mindset. The candidate should have practical experience using AI/LLM tools or platforms such as Google Vertex AI, Gemini, AWS AI services, Azure AI, OpenAI-based platforms, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to improve test automation, quality engineering, failure analysis, and software delivery productivity.

Meet the Team / Who You'll Work With

The Cisco IOS XR Routing Test Team ensures the reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency of Cisco's carrier-grade routing platforms. We work closely with software developers, architects, product managers, and customer-facing teams to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end validation across platforms, Optics, Layer 0, Layer 1 optical, routing, subscriber-management, and network-service technologies for service providers, hyperscalers, Optical and web-scale customers operating some of the world's largest and most demanding networks. Exciting career opportunities open for enthusiastic and experienced Software professionals in India

Our team values technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

Cisco provides you an excellent opportunity to take your career aspirations forward. You will bring your unique talents to the group that works on Cisco's routing technology, which large enterprises now consider to be the transport medium of choice for critically important networks. In your role as a Software Test Engineer, you will own the quality validation of IOS XR routing - Platform infra, Optics, Layer 0, Layer 1 capabilities. You will design test strategies, develop automation, validate complex customer scenarios, investigate system-level failures, and provide data-driven release recommendations. 

Your work will help ensure that Cisco delivers stable, scalable, and production-ready networking solutions. You will also mentor junior engineers, improve test frameworks, and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate engineering and solving workflows. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement functional, system, regression, scale, performance, interoperability, resiliency, and high-availability tests for IOS XR routing - Platform Infra/Optics, L0/L1 test features. 
 - Develop reusable and scalable test automation using Python and frameworks such as pyATS, Genie, or equivalent tools. 
 - Build and maintain physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud-based test environments using Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, clustering technologies, VMware, OpenStack, and network simulation platforms. 
 - Solve complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system-resource data.
