 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, version control, and regression testing. 
 - Use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for test generation, automation development, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation. 
 - Apply foundational knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, MCPs, reusable AI skills, prompt and context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams, review test designs and automation code, mentor junior engineers, and communicate product-quality risks and release readiness. 
 - Work on Network automation, algorithmic thinking and Analytics applications derived from customer use cases
 - Strong in Software engineering test methodology and process knowledge

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field. 
 - Eight or more years of experience in software engineering, network product testing, test automation, or quality engineering. 
 - Experience configuring and solving Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Advanced Python programming skills for test automation, scripting, API interaction, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience developing system, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability test scenarios. 
 - Strong Linux or Unix skills and experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud, containerization, virtualization, and clustering technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, and OpenStack. 
 - Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools. 
 - Basic understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP, reusable skills, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Strong knowledge of software development life cycle. 
 - Strong analytical, solving, communication, and multi-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Deep understanding of customer deployments, operations and the ability to translate brown field/green field deployments into test strategy with high efficacy
 - Quick learner with an open mind to "grey box" testing, bringing in strategic on-the-box, off-the-box views that reflect the state of IOS-XR systems. 
 - Experience in test engineering concepts and methodologies including test planning, test case design, test execution and test automation
 - Excellent experience in Layer-0, Layer-1 traffic generators and analysers (e. g. Viavi, Agilent, Spirent, IXIA, etc. )
 - Strong written, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills
 - Results oriented with a high degree of accountability, dedication and responsibility
 - Industry certification such as CCNA/CCNP/CCIE/JCNA/JCIE will be a huge plus

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing Optical and routing capabilities on Cisco IOS XR platforms such as Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700 and NCS1K
 - Experience with traffic generators and subscriber-simulation tools such as IXIA or Spirent or Viavi or JDSU. 
 - Strong knowledge of Layer 0 , Layer 1 testing along with platform & optics test skills. 
 - Experience with Datapath, model-driven telemetry, and network programmability. 
 - Familiarity with scale and performance characterization. 

Expectations

The successful candidate will operate as an experienced individual contributor who can independently own a significant routing or BNG feature area, develop production-quality automation, lead complex technical investigations, identify product and test risks, and provide evidence-based release recommendations. 

The engineer is also expected to influence test strategy, improve engineering practices, mentor junior team members, and use AI-assisted tools responsibly while maintaining security, accuracy, and engineering accountability. 

Why Cisco

At Cisco, you will work on technologies that power some of the world's largest networks. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, solve complex technical problems, and contribute to products with global impact. 

Cisco provides an inclusive environment, opportunities for continuous learning, and the ability to grow across networking, cloud, automation, and AI technologies. 

#WeAreCisco

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

data.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - 3, 000 Tideans globally
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Team

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain. 

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve. 

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service. 

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement. 

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both. 

About The Role

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide. 

As Director of Engineering you will

- Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale. 
 - Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design. 
 - Partner with Product and Design leadership on one shared plan, jointly owning delivery and outcomes, including members activated through real sales and purchases, engagement and recurring revenue. 
 - Scale the Tide Business Pages and Tide Online Network into a trusted, high-traffic marketplace, including search, listings, member-to-member leads, chat and buyer requests. 
 - Build the partner integration platform behind our website, gift card, business supply and logistics partners, enabling new partners and offers to be onboarded quickly and safely. 
 - Work with Payments, Acquiring, Credit, Insurance and Wealth to embed payments, credit, insurance and rewards into commerce journeys at the point of need. 
 - Build trust into the marketplace in partnership with Ongoing Monitoring and Risk, from verified seller status to initial and ongoing monitoring of listings and member-to-member communication. 
 - Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security. 
 - Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it. 
 - Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated. 

What We Are Looking For

- Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders. 
 - Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus. 
 - Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes. 
 - Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale. 
 - Strong product and design partnership instincts. 
 - Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets. 
 - Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality. 
 - Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus. 

Our Tech Stack

- Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
 - Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
 - Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
 - Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
 - Claude for agentic ways of working

What You'll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

- Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options. 
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office. 
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

About Acceldata

At Acceldata, we are redefining how enterprises manage, observe, and optimize their data platforms. Our mission is to deliver a unified enterprise-grade data observability and modernization platform that integrates seamlessly across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. 

The Acceldata Open Data Platform (ODP) brings together the best of the modern data ecosystem, including technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Trino, Kafka, NiFi, MLFlow, Pinot and more, to help organisations run complex analytical workloads at scale while maintaining flexibility and avoiding vendor lock-in. 

Product Link : https: //www. acceldata. io/open-data-platform

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a minimum of 7 years of experience in distributed systems or data platform development. In this role, you will design, build, and scale components of the Acceldata Open Data Platform (ODP), contributing to open-source technologies and solving real-world challenges in large-scale data infrastructure. 

This is a full-time, on-site position with 5 days working from Bangalore office

Why Join Us

At Acceldata, you won't just be writing code; you'll be shaping the foundation of modern data platforms used by some of the world's largest enterprises. You'll work alongside seasoned engineers and open-source contributors who are passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges at scale. Every project you take on will directly impact how a data platform is managed, observed, and optimised across hybrid and cloud ecosystems. 

This is your chance to build technology that truly matters, software that drives mission-critical pipelines, scales to petabytes, and influences the open-source community at large. We move fast, value creativity, and reward innovation. If you're looking for a place where your ideas can become real systems and your work can be seen, used, and respected across the data ecosystem - Acceldata is where you belong. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and implementation of complex features for the Open Source Data Platform. 
 - Architect scalable and robust solutions, ensuring high performance and reliability. 
 - Mentor and guide junior software engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth. 
 - Drive technical discussions and provide expertise in technology selection and best practices. 
 - Contribute to the strategic direction of the Open Source Data Platform project. 
 - Perform thorough code reviews, ensuring code quality, maintainability, and adherence to standards. 
 - Work across diverse environments: Bare Metals, VM, and Kubernetes. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

- Mandatory Linux proficiency for automation and efficient use of Linux shortcuts for troubleshooting. 
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud environments. 
 - Ability to manage threads and debug issues related to deadlocks or memory leaks. 
 - Strong comprehension of garbage collection tuning and management challenges. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with advanced Java, Scala, or Python, developed and prepared project build models associated with Maven, Gradle, or SBT. 
 - Experienced in Github & Nexus management and its use cases. 
 - Profound understanding of software engineering, database concepts, virtualisation and architectural patterns. 
 - Comprehensive knowledge and a history of significant contributions to past projects. 
 - Past experience of mentoring junior engineers in handling critical issues or tasks. 
 - Proven capability in fixing bugs and developing new features within complex software systems. 
 - Experience working with Big data stack or its ecosystem components, utilizing appropriate frameworks for application development. 
 - Demonstrated fluency in English communication. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, presenting technical accomplishments and strategic insights. 
 - Strong capacity for collaboration with internal teams, external contributors, and the broader open-source community. 

Desired Skills (Bonus)

- Demonstrated history of contributions or a committer role in Apache projects (e. g. , bug fixes, feature development, documentation). 
 - Proficiency in identifying performance bottlenecks within big data applications and frameworks. 
 - Experience with the migration of applications, Hadoop-based distributions, or data streaming platforms. 
 - Familiarity with distributed systems and architectural patterns optimised for scalable data processing. 

₹1 - ₹1 a year

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering in the IAM department. Identity has become the new security perimeter, and in this role, you will develop workflows and application integrations in collaboration with the broader IAM team, Product Management, and Business teams. You will be responsible for the design and development of enterprise-grade Identity Management Products for Zscaler, helping organizations worldwide harness speed and agility with a cloud-first strategy. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Design and develop enterprise-grade Identity Management Products for Zscaler
 - Participate in the design and implementation of core product functionality and key technical initiatives
 - Mentor junior engineers with software development best practices
 - Help maintain our positive culture as a collaborative and supportive teammate
 - Collaborate across teams to deliver projects from inception to production

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing dynamic environments as opportunities to construct meaningful solutions. 
 - You act like an owner. You operate with a strong sense of ownership, bringing passion for the mission, high integrity, and the capability to navigate between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. 
 - You are a proactive problem-solver. You run toward challenges and remain laser-focused on finding solutions that deliver high-impact outcomes. 
 - You build high-trust collaboration. You prioritize team success, welcome feedback, and practice clear, respectful candor to establish strong partnerships. 
 - You maintain a continuous growth mindset. You actively seek feedback and development opportunities to grow as a partner, teammate, and purpose-driven leader. 

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
 - 8+ years of hands-on experience in application architecture and development
 - Expert-level technical knowledge of Enterprise Java, OOP, OOA, systems architecture, RESTful APIs, and related frameworks such as Hibernate and Spring
 - Strong knowledge of Identity and Access Management protocols, specifically SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect
 - Experience developing enterprise-grade Security or Networking products

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
 - Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container infrastructure
 - Experience with Java reactive programming

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. 

Benefits

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: 

- Various health plans
 - Time off plans for vacation and sick time
 - Parental leave options
 - Retirement options
 - Education reimbursement
 - In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here. 

By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines. 

Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. See more information by clicking on the Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal link. 

Pay Transparency

Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules. 

Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, ML
data.description:
About The Team

Merchants are the supply side of Uber Eats and Delivery. Merchant ML helps them join the platform, stay reliable, and grow. We build models and GenAI systems across three areas: 

- Merchant intelligence and acquisition: lead scoring, merchant data scraping and enrichment, attribute-confidence models, and LLM-based decision systems. 
 - Merchant experience and operations: AI copilots for merchants and support agents, voice AI for automated verification such as bank and payment profile changes, and compliance automation during onboarding. 
 - Marketplace and merchant optimization: promotion and offer quality scoring, offer ranking, combos and bundles, and personalization. Reliability signals such as auto-pausing unreliable stores also feed into this work. 

The role

You will set the ML technical direction for Merchant and own the highest-impact, most ambiguous problems. You will ship production ML and GenAI systems that move merchant growth, reliability, and efficiency. You will also raise the engineering and modeling bar for the whole team. 

What You'll Do

- Own the end-to-end ML strategy for a major Merchant problem space. This covers problem framing, modeling, offline and online evaluation, launch, and long-term iteration. 
 - Design and ship production models such as ranking, scoring, classification, forecasting, and causal and uplift models. Use them to drive measurable business outcomes, and validate them through A/B tests and experimentation. 
 - Lead the architecture of LLM and agentic systems for merchants and operators. This includes retrieval, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, latency and cost management, and human-in-the-loop design. 
 - Build and evolve shared ML foundations for Merchant: feature pipelines, model serving and endpoints, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring for drift and quality, on Michelangelo and Uber's data and ML platform. 
 - Partner with Product, Design, Ops, Data Science, and Engineering to turn ambiguous merchant problems into a clear roadmap with defined success metrics. 
 - Write and review technical designs (ERDs and design docs). Set standards for model quality, reproducibility, and responsible AI. 
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and scientists. Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hiring. 
 - Influence cross-org technical strategy by working with Marketplace, Fulfillment, Payments, Trust and Safety, and ML Platform teams. 

Required

What you'll bring

- 12+ years of industry experience building and shipping ML systems at scale (or an advanced degree plus 8+ years). 
 - A track record of leading multi-quarter, multi-team ML initiatives with clear business impact. 
 - Strong foundations in machine learning, statistics, and experimentation, including causal inference and A/B testing. 
 - Hands-on experience across the ML lifecycle: data and feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring in production. 
 - Proficiency in Python and at least one of Go, Java, or Scala. Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or XGBoost, and with Spark, Hive, or Presto. 
 - Strong systems judgment: low-latency serving, batch and streaming pipelines, and cost and reliability trade-offs. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to influence without authority. 

Preferred

- Experience with LLMs and GenAI in production: fine-tuning, RAG, agents, evaluation, and safety. 
 - Experience in marketplace, ranking, recommendation, or promotion and pricing optimization. 
 - Experience with entity resolution, information extraction, web or data scraping, or knowledge graphs. 
 - Experience with voice and conversational AI, or merchant and enterprise tooling. 
 - Experience in fraud, risk, or compliance ML. 
 - Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in ML. 
 - MS or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or a related field. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you. 

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. 

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. 

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Marketplace
data.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. 

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. 

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. 

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. 

As a Staff engineer you will work on Singularity Marketplace - multi-tenant, event-driven platform that enables third-party integration applications to safely deploy, execute, and stream data across our AI SIEM ecosystem. You'll help build the next version of the Marketplace Catalog - the front door for every third-party integration our customers discover, evaluate, and install. You'll have the opportunity to build products using cutting-edge AI-native development practices that accelerate velocity while maintaining enterprise security standards. You'll be re-thinking how partners publish and version their applications, how customers browse and trust what they find, and the APIs and services that make discovery fast and reliable at scale. You'll integrate AI throughout the development lifecycle - augmenting design, code generation, testing, and security practices to increase velocity while maintaining the highest standards of code quality and security. 

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include: 

- Design, build, test, document, deploy, and operate large-scale applications, primarily in Go and partially in Java. 
 - Architect high-volume, low-latency services capable of processing millions of events per second. 
 - Translate business and functional requirements into robust, scalable, operable solutions that work well within the overall data architecture. 
 - Participate and collaborate with cross-functional teams in the organization to understand the business requirements and to deliver solutions that can scale. 
 - Improve system reliability and data integrity through observability, performance analysis, capacity planning, and operational excellence. 
 - Understand & maintain existing codebase by regular re-factoring and applying requested fixes and features. 
 - Evaluate and adopt technologies that help solve challenges associated with scale, reliability, and large volumes of data. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering workflows thoughtfully to accelerate development without compromising quality or security. 
 - Establish and promote engineering practices that improve code quality, security, testing, and delivery velocity. 
 - Lead technical discussions and design reviews, provide high-quality code reviews, and mentor other engineers. 

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have: 

- Strong proficiency in at least one high-level programming language, preferably Go and/or Java, with the ability and interest to work across both. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, microservices, concurrency, and data processing. 
 - Comfort with AI-native development practices - leveraging AI tools and workflows to enhance code quality, security, and development velocity. 
 - You care about delivering customer value and want to hear directly from your customers on how to improve and evolve your applications. 
 - A collaborative approach to development through design discussions, code reviews, and cross-functional partnership. 
 - Familiarity with AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Postgres, Redis, and Kafka (big advantage)
 - Ability to swiftly delve into new products and comprehend their inner workings
 - Proven capacity to collaborate effectively with both local and remote teams across various time zones
 - Excellent communication skills, as you'll regularly liaise with product and other engineering teams
 - A huge plus would be previous experience in developing security-related products

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. 

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family: 

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
 - Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Competitive leave benefits
 - Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- 
 - Medical and insurance benefits
 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Global home office allowance
 - Internet allowance
 - LinkedIn Learning license
 - Social Connect program
 - Food allowance (Bangalore office)
 - Meal vouchers (Sodexo)

Wellness & Lifestyle

- Health & wellness benefit

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U. S. based roles. 

To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure.

data.title: Principal, AI - Software Engineering (Open)
data.description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv. 

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. 

Job Title

Principal, AI - Software Engineering (Open)

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer to architect and build a next-generation enterprise data platform from the ground up. This is a hands-on platform engineering leadership role for someone who has built and scaled data platforms in production, migrated organisations off legacy data infrastructure, and delivered the data foundation that powers AI solutions, real-time pipelines, governed data products, and B2B data distribution at enterprise scale. You will set the technical direction, define engineering standards, make critical build-versus-buy decisions, and deliver a platform that the business can depend on for reliability, quality, and long-term extensibility. The tech stack is AWS and open-source. You will be expected to bring strong opinions, deep hands-on ability, and the influence to raise the engineering bar across the team. 

What You Will Do

- Architect and build a modern enterprise data platform from scratch on AWS and open-source technologies, designing for scale, resilience, and long-term maintainability from day one. 
 - Lead the migration of legacy data infrastructure to the new platform, defining the migration strategy, sequencing, cutover approach, and rollback plan with minimal disruption to production consumers. 
 - Design a lakehouse architecture combining open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi) on AWS S3 with a governed analytical consumption layer, enabling both raw storage and curated data product delivery. 
 - Build configurable, metadata-driven ingestion frameworks capable of onboarding new data sources rapidly without bespoke engineering per source, supporting batch, micro-batch, and real-time patterns. 
 - Design and deliver real-time and streaming data pipelines using Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, AWS Kinesis, or equivalent, with low-latency SLA guarantees and exactly-once processing semantics. 
 - Define golden pipeline standards: reusable, auditable, idempotent pipeline patterns that serve as the reference implementation for all data flows across the platform. 
 - Embed data quality, data contracts, and automated validation as first-class engineering requirements in every pipeline, not as an afterthought, using frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, or equivalent. 
 - Build the data governance layer covering lineage tracking, metadata management, data classification, access control, and policy enforcement using open-source tooling such as OpenMetadata, Apache Atlas, or equivalent. 
 - Design platform observability end to end: pipeline health monitoring, data SLA tracking, anomaly detection, alerting, cost dashboards, and runbooks so the platform can be operated reliably and transparently at scale. 
 - Implement platform resilience patterns including dead-letter queues, retry and backfill mechanisms, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation to meet enterprise SLA commitments under failure conditions. 
 - Own cost management across the platform: compute right-sizing, storage tiering, query optimisation, and governance guardrails that prevent cost sprawl as data volumes and consumer count grow. 
 - Design and deliver integrations with upstream source systems including REST APIs, CDC streams, event buses, and file-based feeds, as well as downstream B2B consumers requiring secure, scalable data distribution. 
 - Build the data foundation that AI and ML workloads depend on: feature engineering pipelines, curated training datasets, data quality pipelines for model inputs, and LLM-ready data products. 
 - Lead technical evaluation and selection of open-source tools and AWS managed services, making build-versus-buy decisions grounded in engineering trade-offs, total cost of ownership, and long-term platform strategy. 
 - Define and enforce engineering standards across the platform: coding conventions, automated testing, CI/CD for data pipelines, infrastructure as code using Terraform or AWS CDK, and security-by-design practices. 
 - Mentor and uplift senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, pair engineering, technical documentation, and architecture forums. 

What You Will Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data platforms, including greenfield builds and migrations from legacy systems. 
 - Deep proficiency in Python and SQL with strong experience writing production-grade data engineering code across ingestion, transformation, and delivery layers. 
 - Strong expertise across AWS data and compute services including S3, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, MSK, EMR, Athena, IAM, and VPC networking for data workloads. 
 - Hands-on experience with the open-source data stack: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Airflow or Prefect, dbt, and open table formats such as Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi. 
 - Proven experience designing lakehouse architectures that separate scalable open storage from governed analytical consumption. 
 - Experience building configurable, metadata-driven ingestion frameworks and reusable golden pipeline patterns at scale across multiple source systems. 
 - Deep understanding of data quality frameworks, data contracts, schema evolution, and automated validation in production pipelines. 
 - Experience with streaming and real-time architectures including stateful stream processing, event-time semantics, and SLA-bound delivery guarantees. 
 - Experience designing and implementing data governance solutions covering lineage, metadata cataloguing, classification, masking, and access control. 
 - Experience building platform observability: pipeline monitoring, SLA assurance, cost governance dashboards, alerting, and incident response for data infrastructure. 
 - Strong experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or AWS CDK), GitOps, and CI/CD for data pipeline delivery. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead architecture decisions, influence engineering direction across teams without formal authority, and own complex outcomes from design through production. 

What Would Be Great To Have

- Experience building data foundations for AI and ML solutions: feature stores, training dataset pipelines, model monitoring data feeds, and data quality assurance for AI outputs. 
 - Experience applying GenAI or LLM-assisted practices to data engineering: code generation, automated documentation, data quality rule inference, or intelligent root cause analysis. 
 - Experience with B2B data distribution: secure data sharing APIs, Delta Sharing protocol, partner data exchange patterns, and fine-grained access control for external consumers. 
 - Experience with open-source data governance platforms such as OpenMetadata, Apache Atlas, or DataHub. 
 - Background in financial services, payments, banking, healthcare, or another regulated industry with compliance, audit, and data security requirements. 
 - Experience designing self-serve data platform capabilities that reduce central team dependency and enable downstream consumers to access certified data products independently. 
 - Active contributions to open-source data engineering projects or engagement with the broader data platform community. 

Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please

- Apply using your legal name
 - Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). 

Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. 

Note To Agencies

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions. 

Warning About Fake Job Posts

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

data.title: Tech S and T-Resilience and Reliability Engineer-Senior-GDSF02
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)

Description

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability & reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops

A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance. 

An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability & automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources

Responsibilities

- Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
 - Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
 - Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e. g. , Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
 - Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
 - Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra & Operations - FinOps
 - Critical Situation management
 - SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
 - Data Analytics & System trend analysis

Typical Skills And Background

- 7+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
 - Hands-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
 - Hands-on experience in at least one CI-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc. )
 - Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc. ) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc. )
 - Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
 - Experience in Observability - APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc. ), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
 - Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
 - Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc. 
 - Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
 - Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot & Cloud native architectures
 - Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
 - Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
 - Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
 - Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis
 - Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs & models
 - Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
 - Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc. 
 - AI/ML & Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Solution Specialist - Senior Full Stack Developer
data.description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we're passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet. 

Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We're a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you're looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you're in the right place. 

About You And This Role

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer to design, build, and support enterprise applications that enable global business operations. 

You will work across the full software development lifecycle, owning features end-to-end from design through deployment and support. This includes building and modernizing applications, developing API-driven integrations, and improving performance, scalability, and reliability over time. 

In this role, you will contribute to technical design, implement automated solutions, and partner with product, architecture, and business teams to deliver secure, maintainable, and scalable platforms. 

Responsibilities

- Own and deliver features with end-to-end ownership (design, development, testing, deployment). 
 - Design, build, and modernize applications using Angular, . NET, and Azure. 
 - Develop and integrate APIs and backend services. 
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines and automation to improve delivery quality and speed . 
 - Lead production support and root cause analysis, implementing durable fixes. 
 - Mentor junior developers and contribute to development standards and best practices. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) 
 - 5+ years of relevant full stack software development experience. 
 - Experience delivering enterprise-grade applications, including technical design, API development, and production support. 
 - Experience working on large-scale or globally used applications. 
 - Experience with API-driven or modular application design. 
 - Experience improving application performance, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Familiarity with modern development practices. 

Your Skills

- Front End: Angular (React or similar frameworks a plus), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS 
 - Back End: C#, . NET Core, REST APIs 
 - Cloud: Azure (App Services, Functions, Logic Apps, Azure SQL) 
 - DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps 
 - Database: SQL Server

Additional notes

- Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality code 
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging skills 
 - Experience working in Agile teams 
 - Ability to mentor junior developers 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills across global teams 
 - You will contribute to the development and support of scalable digital platforms that drive business outcomes and support global operations. 
 - The ability to accommodate a flexible schedule aligned with international time zones is essential. 

Benefits - What Dow Offers You

We invest in you.

data.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. 

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. 

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. 

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. 

As a Staff (tech-lead level) engineer you will work on Singularity Marketplace - multi-tenant, event-driven platform that enables third-party integration applications to safely deploy, execute, and stream data across our AI SIEM ecosystem. We are looking for a pragmatic platform architect who understands the messy, real-world realities of third-party vendor APIs; that context is what separates sound platform decisions from theoretical ones. However, this is fundamentally an infrastructure and core platform role. Your primary goal isn't to build individual connectors, but to design the API contracts, runtime abstractions, isolation mechanisms, and microservices that enable dozens of teams and third parties to build connectors safely at petabyte scale. 

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include: 

Integration & Product Responsibilities: 

- Collaborate closely with Product Managers and engineering teams to define requirements for integrating third-party vendors with the SentinelOne platform, establishing the Singularity Marketplace / Operations Center as the central hub in the security team's toolkit 
 - Explore products from various cybersecurity vendors and widely used industry tools to determine how to ingest and correlate their data 
 - Incorporate third-party data into the SentinelOne platform so customers can correlate information across vendors, surface insights, and respond quickly to threats
 - Provide security research context on how 3rd-party data maps to the Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) and how it's used for triage, investigation, and response
 - Follow internal processes for communicating schema and API changes to maintain OCSF parity across the platform

Platform Engineering Responsibilities : 

- Develop and extend the Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot) integrations platform that gives customers an interactive UI for onboarding third-party products and vendors
 - Design and maintain event-driven microservices communicating over Apache Kafka that process entity activities, XDR alerts, and external triggers at scale
 - Own core infrastructure across the entire request lifecycle, spanning edge/ingress gateways, API routing layers, and high-performance relational databases (PostgreSQL/Aurora RDS) while enforcing secure JWT/OAuth authentication and shared security libraries. 
 - Participate in on-call, incident response, and troubleshooting for a multi-region, multi-cluster production platform (Kafka lag, reconciliation failures, DB connection exhaustion, ingress routing issues, etc. ) 
 - Contribute to GitOps-driven CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Helm, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) for building, testing, and deploying services and functions across environments

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have: 

- Modern Java/Kotlin Ecosystem: Deep hands-on expertise in Java/Kotlin, and Spring Boot, paired with strong system design fundamentals. (Knowledge of Go or Rust is a plus)
 - Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Apache Kafka or equivalent), including topics, consumer groups, and streaming pipelines
 - Ability to research and reverse-engineer APIs from documentation and technical specifications, and model them into structured data schemas 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership experience - shaping engineering best practices and driving their adoption across a team 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and containerized deployments, including Helm charts, ingress controllers (e. g. , Traefik), and operator/reconciler patterns
 - Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP)
 - Experience developing integration or contract tests (e. g. , pytest) and working within CI/CD pipelines
 - Big Advantage would be any of: Familiarity with serverless/FaaS platforms (e. g. , AWS Lambda); Experience building data-intensive systems (ingestion, transformation, normalization, validation) and integrating complex third-party APIs; Practical engineering experience building production software utilizing LLMs or AI agents, with an emphasis on evaluation frameworks, testing, guardrails, and data pipeline integration; and Experience operating distributed, multi-region production systems (debugging Kafka consumer lag, ingress/routing issues, connection pool exhaustion, reconciliation failures)

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. 

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family: 

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
 - Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Competitive leave benefits
 - Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- 
 - Medical and insurance benefits
 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Global home office allowance
 - Internet allowance
 - LinkedIn Learning license
 - Social Connect program
 - Food allowance (Bangalore office)
 - Meal vouchers (Sodexo)

Wellness & Lifestyle

- Health & wellness benefit

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U. S. based roles.

data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – QA
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - QA will help shape and evolve the organisation's quality engineering platform, enabling teams to build, test, deploy and operate software faster, more securely, and more reliably. The QA role will set the testing and quality standards helping to build test automation that can be adopted across platform and application teams. They will also mentor the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the test automation as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality strategy and architecture

- Define the platform quality engineering strategy, test pyramid and quality gates for all cloud platform products. 
 - Set standards for testing infrastructure-as-code: static analysis, policy-as-code, unit, integration and end-to-end tests for Terraform modules. 
 - Design ephemeral test environments that provision, validate and tear down platform stacks on every change. 

Continuous verification and automation

- Build shift-left quality into CI/CD: automated gates for security, compliance, cost and drift before merge and release. 
 - Establish contract and compatibility testing so module and API changes never break consuming business teams. 
 - Lead resilience and chaos testing for platforms. 
 - Drive performance and scale testing for self-service provisioning paths. 

GxP and computerised system assurance

- Modernise qualification from document-heavy validation to risk-based, automated Assurance. 
 - Generate qualification evidence (IQ/OQ traceability, test results, approvals) directly from pipelines. 
 - Partner with Quality, GRC and the CISO office to keep evidence audit-ready for GxP, SOX and data integrity requirements. 

Images, supply chain and security quality

- Own test frameworks for VM, OS, database and container image bakeries: CIS benchmarks, vulnerability thresholds, SBOM and signing checks. 
 - Integrate CNAPP and code scanning findings (e. g. Wiz, GitHub Advanced Security) into release gates with clear SLAs. 

AI and agentic platform quality

- Define evaluation frameworks for platform AI agents: accuracy, safety & guardrail 
 - Test agent-generated artifacts for correctness, policy compliance and blast radius before execution. 

Engineering leadership

- Set quality metrics and SLOs, report them to platform and security leadership, and drive corrective actions. 
 - Mentor engineers across platform teams; grow a quality-engineering community of practice. 
 - Evaluate and select tooling; make build-vs-buy recommendations. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 15+ years in software or platform engineering, with 3+ years leading quality or test engineering for tenant platforms at enterprise scale. 
 - Deep hands-on Terraform experience 
 - Strong policy-as-code skills around OPA/Rego 
 - Production experience on Azure and GCP; working knowledge of Kubernetes and GitOps 
 - Built CI/CD quality gates in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar. 
 - Proficient in at least one of Python, Go or TypeScript for test frameworks and tooling. 
 - Experience in a regulated industry (life sciences, pharma, finance or healthcare), including GxP or equivalent validation. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing LLM-based or agentic systems 
 - Familiarity with software supply chain standards: SLSA, SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), Sigstore/cosign. 
 - Chaos engineering tools such as Azure Chaos Studio, LitmusChaos or Gremlin. 
 - Experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Azure Arc or hybrid estates. 
 - Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, ISTQB Advanced or CKA. 

Leadership behaviors and ways of working

- Quality as an engineering discipline: builds automation and paved roads, not manual sign-off queues. 
 - Risk-based judgement: scales testing rigour to patient, product and data-integrity impact. 
 - Influence without authority: aligns platform, security, Quality and GRC stakeholders on shared standards. 
 - Hands-on credibility: writes and reviews code, and can debug a failing pipeline alongside the team. 
 - Clear communicator: turns quality data into decisions for senior leadership and auditors alike. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Scripting, Serverless Computing, Software Frameworks, Software Testing, System Monitors, Test Automation, UI Automation Testing, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

data.description:
About Sirion

Sirion is the world's leading AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. Global enterprises use Sirion to author, negotiate, manage, and extract value from their contracts, using generative AI for extraction, conversational search, and AI-assisted negotiation. With more than 7 million contracts and close to $800B in contract value under management, Sirion is recognized as a leader by Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters. 

Power the Future of AI & Why This Role Matters

We are looking for an AI Automation Engineer with 4-6 years of Python development experience and hands-on experience building AI-powered and agentic automation solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong Python backend skills with practical knowledge of LLMs, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, and workflow orchestration. 

As part of Sirion's Automation team, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent automations in which AI agents reason over contracts and business data, call APIs and tools, and execute multi-step processes end-to-end, with appropriate human-in-the-loop controls. 

How You'll Make an Impact

- Design, develop, and deploy agentic AI automations that use LLMs, tool/function calling, memory, and multi-step reasoning to automate business processes end-to-end. 
 - Build agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar. 
 - Build AI agents that interact with APIs, databases, documents, web applications, and external tools. 
 - Design and implement RAG-based solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. 
 - Integrate OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other LLM APIs into production systems, including prompt engineering and structured outputs. 
 - Develop scalable backend services and APIs in Python using FastAPI, Flask, or Django REST Framework. 
 - Build human-in-the-loop checkpoints, guardrails, and error-handling/retry logic so automations run reliably in production. 
 - Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows where required. 
 - Evaluate agent quality, accuracy, latency, and cost; monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize automations in production. 
 - Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis. 
 - Deploy and maintain solutions using Docker and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, testable, production-ready Python code. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and translate requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Stay current with developments in Generative AI and Agentic AI. 

Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table

Python & Backend Development

- 4-6 years of professional experience in Python development. 
 - Strong understanding of OOP, data structures, exception handling, and concurrency (asyncio/threading). 
 - Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Django REST Framework. 
 - Strong experience developing and consuming REST APIs. 
 - Good understanding of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL); MongoDB/Redis experience preferred. 

Agentic AI / GenAI

- Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications beyond proofs of concept. 
 - Understanding of agentic AI architecture, including planning, tool use, memory, and autonomous multi-step workflows. 
 - Experience with one or more agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen. 
 - Experience with tool/function calling and integrating external APIs and tools with LLMs. 
 - Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. 
 - Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent. 
 - Good understanding of prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs. 
 - Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI tool integrations. 
 - Experience building multi-agent systems. 

Cloud & DevOps

- Experience with Docker and containerized applications. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. 
 - Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with logging, monitoring, debugging, and production deployments. 

Education & Soft Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong communication and documentation skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience with RPA or workflow automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or n8n. 
 - Experience with document AI: extracting and processing data from PDFs, contracts, or other unstructured documents. 
 - Exposure to Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with task and message queues such as Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes. 
 - Experience working with open-source/local LLMs and Hugging Face models. 
 - Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, and cost optimization. 
 - Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. 

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is strong in Python backend development and has built real AI/agentic automation solutions, not just theoretical knowledge of Generative AI. Candidates should be able to demonstrate projects that combine LLMs + tools/APIs + orchestration + backend services, preferably deployed in production. 

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law, and we provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. These principles apply across all of our employment practices. 

Excited About This Opportunity?

We'd love to hear from you! Apply through the Sirion Careers page and follow the steps listed there.
