data.description:
Description

The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development. 

Key job responsibilities

Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include: 

- Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets. 
 - Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities. 
 - Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc. ). 
 - Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
 - Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
 - Expertise in research - finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner. 
 - Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis. 
 - Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations. 
 - Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About The Team

Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being "the world's most customer centric company. " Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners' needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas. 

The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon's product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon's worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
 - 1+ years of logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration experience
 - Knowledge of Excel at a basic level (e. g. , UX navigation, math & logical functions, lookup functions, etc. )
 - Speak, write, and read fluently in English
 - Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
 - Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis

Preferred Qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
 - Bachelor's degree in logistics, transporation, supply chain, or business
 - Licensed customs broker
 - Experience in international logistics, cross-border transportation and supply chain, or U. S. Customs rules and regulations
 - Experience in customs

Role Description

Role Summary We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Embedded Test Automation Expert to join our engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of robust automated test frameworks for embedded software and hardware platforms. You will bridge the gap between firmware development and quality assurance, ensuring that our embedded systems meet the highest standards of reliability, performance, and functional compliance. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in embedded systems architecture, hands-on experience with hardware debugging interfaces (JTAG, GDB), strong Python automation capabilities, and integrating automated test suites into modern CI/CD pipelines. Key Responsibilities Framework Development: Design, build, and scale automated test frameworks tailored for hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), software-in-the-loop (SIL), and board-level validation. Test Planning & Execution: Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and automated test suites covering both functional (e. g. , driver logic, communication protocols) and non-functional requirements (e. g. , performance, memory footprint, stability, power consumption). CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated embedded test suites into continuous integration and delivery pipelines (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable automated nightly builds, regression testing, and instant feedback loops. Architecture Engagement: Collaborate closely with firmware and hardware teams to understand architectural specifications, schematics, and system design, enabling high-coverage test cases early in the development lifecycle. Agile Practices: Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Utilize advanced hardware and software debugging tools (e. g. , GDB, JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) to isolate and troubleshoot complex issues across firmware-hardware interfaces. Defect Management: Document, track, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps, trace logs, and proposed mitigations using issue-tracking systems (e. g. , Jira). Metric Reporting: Define, track, and report test automation metrics (e. g. , pass/fail rates, code coverage, test execution time, stability) to engineering leadership. Required Qualifications & Experience Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience). Embedded Testing Background: 6+ years of professional experience in embedded software verification, board bring-up testing, and embedded test automation. Python Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python for scripting, test orchestration, and developing modular test frameworks (e. g. , pytest, Robot Framework). Debugging Tools: Hands-on experience with embedded debugging and instrumentation tools such as GDB, OpenOCD, JTAG/SWD probes (e. g. , J-Link, ST-Link), logic analyzers, and digital oscilloscopes. CI/CD & DevOps: Practical experience integrating automated test environments and physical target hardware into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions). Protocols: Strong familiarity with embedded communication protocols and buses (e. g. , UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, BLE, or Ethernet/TCP-IP). Methodology: Demonstrated experience working in Agile/Scrum environments using version control systems (e. g. , Git). Core Competencies Analytical Thinking: Strong diagnostic and root-cause analysis mindset, capable of isolating complex hardware vs. software faults. Attention to Detail: Keen eye for edge cases, race conditions, memory leaks, and subtle timing discrepancies. Communication & Teamwork: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate technical details clearly across cross-functional teams. 

Skills

CAN, CI/CD, Embedded Test Automation, Test Automation, Git, GitLab CI, HIL Testing, Hardware Development, Integration Testing, Jenkins, Scrum

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700, 000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster. 

At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you're not just building the future - you're an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact. 

A Day in the Life

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help shape the next generation of our enterprise SaaS platform. 

You'll combine deep hands-on engineering with technical leadership, helping teams design scalable systems, modernize our platform and solve complex engineering challenges. 

You'll work across backend, frontend, cloud and AI technologies while defining technical direction and staying close to the engineering work. 

A key part of this role will be driving the adoption of AI-native software engineering practices, including AI-PDLC (AI-enabled Product Development Lifecycle) and Spec-Driven Development, using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding and agentic development tools. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, designing systems at scale, influencing architecture, establishing modern engineering practices and mentoring experienced engineers. 

Here's a Breakdown Of What You'll Do

- Define and evolve the technical architecture of our SaaS platform and create high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD) for complex systems. 
 - Translate business and product requirements into scalable technical designs, implementation plans and engineering deliverables. 
 - Establish and drive Spec-Driven Development, using structured requirements, architecture specifications, API contracts, data models and acceptance criteria to guide development. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-PDLC, integrating AI across requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, code review, deployment and operations. 
 - Establish AI-assisted development workflows using Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and similar AI coding agents, while maintaining engineering quality, security and architectural consistency. 
 - Design secure, scalable and reliable distributed, microservices and event-driven systems. 
 - Build and evolve backend services and APIs primarily using Node. js/TypeScript and Python, while remaining open to other modern technology stacks. 
 - Contribute to frontend architecture and applications using React, Angular or similar technologies. 
 - Design cloud-native solutions across AWS, Azure, GCP or other major cloud platforms. 
 - Lead platform modernization initiatives and improve scalability, performance, reliability and maintainability. 
 - Use Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK or similar technologies to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Promote strong engineering practices around CI/CD, testing, observability, security and automation. 
 - Establish practices for AI-assisted code generation, automated testing, AI-assisted code review, code quality validation and continuous evaluation of AI-generated implementations. 
 - Define appropriate guardrails, engineering standards and human-in-the-loop practices for the responsible use of AI coding agents. 
 - Help integrate AI capabilities into our products while considering security, observability, governance and responsible use. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and influence technical decisions across multiple teams. 

What You'll Bring

- 12+ years of experience building and delivering production software. 
 - Strong experience designing and building large-scale SaaS or cloud-based applications. 
 - Strong hands-on backend experience with Node. js/TypeScript and/or Python, with the ability to work across other technology stacks when required. 
 - Strong experience with system design, including both HLD and LLD, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, scalability and reliability. 
 - Experience designing and building APIs, backend services and data-intensive applications. 
 - Experience building modern frontend applications using React, Angular or similar frameworks. 
 - Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK or similar technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of databases, SQL and performance optimization. 
 - Experience with Docker, CI/CD, observability and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI coding agents. 
 - Experience applying Spec-Driven Development or similar specification-first engineering approaches, using structured requirements, architecture specifications, implementation plans and acceptance criteria to drive development. 
 - Understanding of AI-PDLC and experience integrating AI into multiple stages of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience building or integrating AI-powered applications, with an understanding of AI security, observability or governance. 
 - A track record of making architectural decisions, influencing engineering teams and solving complex technical problems. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration and mentoring skills. 

It Would Be Great If You Have

- Experience building enterprise SaaS, multi-tenant or highly distributed platforms. 
 - Experience working across multiple cloud platforms or leading cloud modernization initiatives. 
 - Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience working with LLMs, RAG or other AI application patterns. 
 - Experience scaling AI-native engineering practices, including AI-PDLC, Spec-Driven Development and AI-assisted development workflows across teams. 
 - Experience working in security, compliance or regulated environments. 

Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients. We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs. (among others) Diversity is important to us. Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding. 

Diligent created the modern governance movement. Our world-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability - to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place. 

Headquartered in New York, Diligent has offices in Washington D. C. , London, Galway, Budapest, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Munich, Singapore and Sydney. To foster strong collaboration and connection, this role will follow a hybrid work model. If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to work onsite at least 50% of the time. We believe that in-person engagement helps drive innovation, teamwork, and a strong sense of community.

Who You Are

Our Values

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. data.title: Software Development Manager, Everyday Essentials Experiences
data.description:
Description

Lead an AI first engineering team in Bengaluru that builds the shopping and advertising experiences for Amazon's $100B+ Everyday Essentials business. You'll use brand signals to help hundreds of millions of customers find the products they trust, and to give the world's largest consumer brands new ways to grow with Amazon. 

Everyday Essentials covers the household staples, grocery, beauty, and health and personal care products customers reorder most. Our team builds the experiences that help customers choose with confidence and complete their baskets. We also build the advertising and monetization products that let brands reach those customers in useful, relevant ways. As a Software Development Manager, you'll build and grow a team of software engineers and own these systems from end to end. You'll work with scientists, product managers and designers in India and the US, and your team's ideas will reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

Key job responsibilities

Build, hire, mentor and grow a high performing team of software engineers in Bengaluru

Lead an AI first engineering culture where your team uses generative AI tools and agents across design, coding, testing, code review and operations to ship faster with higher quality

Set clear standards for how AI is used in development, measure its impact on velocity and quality, and keep your team learning the latest tools and practices

Own the architecture, delivery and operation of shopping and advertising systems that use brand signals to improve customer and business outcomes

Partner with scientists to build AI powered experiences, such as ranking, recommendations and ad relevance, that match customers with the right products and brands

Work with product, science and design partners to define a roadmap that balances customer experience, brand value and EE profitability

Turn ambiguous business problems into simple, scalable solutions, and measure their impact on customers, ad revenue and business economics

Drive operational excellence across availability, latency, security and cost

Communicate strategy, progress and risks clearly to senior leadership and partners in other locations

A day in the life

Most days start with a customer or brand problem: how to help someone find a better everyday essentials product, how to help them fill their basket faster, or how to give a brand a more relevant way to reach the right shopper. You dig into the data with your team, look at a design together, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before anyone writes code. By the afternoon you might be reviewing a prototype your engineers built with AI tools in a day, working through a tradeoff between customer experience and ad revenue, or helping the team get to the root cause of a production issue. In the evening you might connect with partners in the US. So much here is new that your team won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your team's work reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

About The Team

We build the shopping and advertising experiences for Amazon's Everyday Essentials business: the household staples, grocery, beauty, and health and personal care products customers reorder most. We use brand signals to help customers choose products they trust and fill their baskets faster. We also build the advertising and monetization products that help the world's largest consumer brands reach the right shoppers and grow with Amazon. Our goal is to make shopping for essentials effortless for customers, valuable for brands and more profitable for Amazon. We're a small, fast moving, AI first team that works closely with scientists, product managers and designers in Bengaluru and the US. Teams here own open ended problems from end to end, and good ideas reach hundreds of millions of shoppers quickly. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
 - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our Team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high-quality, outcome-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team (GTM), you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology. 

Picture Yourself At Pega

Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role, you'll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about. At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide. 

Experience: 5 - 9years

Title: Senior Software Engineer - Edge Platfrom

Location: Chennai

About Us

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global technology company leading how the world connects, interacts, and transacts with business. Our assisted and self-service solutions and comprehensive support services address the needs of hospitality and retail sectors in more than 40+ countries. 

Role Overview

Join our market-leading, innovative Edge platform team at NCR Voyix. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be an integral part of the Edge team, designing and developing complex distributed platform capabilities primarily using Go and Kubernetes. You will own technical problems end-to-end, contribute significantly to architecture and design, perform code and design reviews, troubleshoot complex platform issues, and collaborate with QA, SRE, Architecture, and other engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and production-ready solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own complex features and technical problems from design through development, testing, release, and production readiness. 
 - Design and develop scalable, reliable, and maintainable platform services using Go. 
 - Design, troubleshoot, and optimize applications and platform services running on Kubernetes. 
 - Drive or significantly contribute to technical design and architecture discussions. 
 - Perform high-quality code and design reviews and help maintain engineering standards. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues across application, Kubernetes, Linux, networking, and cloud layers. 
 - Collaborate with QA, SRE, Architecture, and internal stakeholders on quality, scalability, reliability, and release readiness. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement across the team. 

Core Skills

- Proficiency in Go: Very strong hands-on production development experience with Go, including concurrency, goroutines, channels, interfaces, error handling, testing, performance optimization, and service/API design. Ability to design efficient, scalable, reliable, and maintainable distributed services. 
 - Kubernetes & Containerization: Strong hands-on expertise with Kubernetes and containers, including workloads, Services, DaemonSets, configuration, storage, networking, RBAC, scheduling, resource management, cluster lifecycle, upgrades, scaling, and complex troubleshooting. Strong understanding of Kubernetes architecture and cloud-native design principles. 
 - Strong development and design skills: Strong understanding of software architecture, clean code, SOLID principles, automated testing, debugging, performance, scalability, reliability, and backward compatibility. 
 - Git / CI/CD: Strong experience with Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, and automated build, test, and release workflows. 
 - Linux OS: Strong working knowledge of Linux, including Bash scripting, processes, filesystems, networking, system services, installation, and troubleshooting. Deeper system/kernel knowledge is beneficial. 
 - Cloud computing: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including familiarity with GKE, IAM, networking, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Logging/Monitoring. 
 - Technical Leadership: Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical discussions, performing design reviews, and driving solutions across multiple teams. 
 - Additional technologies: Familiarity with Service Mesh/Linkerd, CouchDB, OpenTelemetry (OTEL), Grafana, Helm, GCP Cloud Logging, KCC, kubeadm, or GraphQL is beneficial. 

Basic Qualifications

- Degree in a numerate, Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline.

 - Excellent programming skills with substantial hands-on Go development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise designing and troubleshooting Kubernetes-based applications and services. 
 - Strong grounding in Computer Science and distributed-system fundamentals. 
 - Demonstrated experience owning complex technical problems and contributing to software/system design.

data.description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Ahmedabad/GiftCity

Description

Trading Technologies is looking for a highly skilled and technically creative Senior Penetration Tester to join our internal Offensive Security (Offsec) team. Reporting directly to the Offensive Security Manager, you will be the technical tip of the spear in proactively identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities across our entire technology estate. 

In this senior technical role, you will lead complex, full-stack security assessments ranging from modern web applications and complex APIs to cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and deep-dive Active Directory environments. Beyond breaking things, you will partner closely with our engineering teams to ensure vulnerabilities are understood and effectively remediated, while also serving as a technical mentor to the broader security team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Comprehensive Penetration Testing: Lead and execute advanced, end-to-end penetration tests across TT's entire technology ecosystem, including complex web applications, microservices, REST/WebSocket APIs, internal network infrastructure, and thick-client trading applications. 
 - Cloud & DevOps Security: Conduct targeted assessments against our cloud infrastructure (e. g. , AWS, GCP) and containerized environments. Actively test and identify misconfigurations or vulnerabilities within our CI/CD pipelines to secure our software supply chain. 
 - Infrastructure & Active Directory: Execute internal network penetration tests, including advanced Active Directory abuse and exploitation (e. g. , Kerberoasting, lateral movement, privilege escalation) to identify internal structural weaknesses. 
 - Actionable Reporting: Produce comprehensive, high-quality technical reports that clearly articulate vulnerabilities, demonstrate business impact via proof-of-concepts (PoCs), and provide realistic, actionable remediation guidance for engineering teams. 
 - Remediation Support: Partner with the Offensive Security Manager and Engineering teams to validate fixes, provide technical clarity on vulnerabilities, and participate in threat modeling or architectural reviews as a subject matter expert. 
 - Tooling & Automation: Develop custom scripts, exploits, or automation tools to streamline internal penetration testing methodologies and improve the efficiency of the Offsec team. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Serve as a technical leader within the team, mentoring junior/mid-level testers, sharing cutting-edge research, and elevating the team's overall technical proficiency. 

Essential Qualifications

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

- Extensive Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, offensive security, or red teaming. 
 - Application & API Expertise: Deep understanding of modern web application and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, CWEs), authentication protocols (OAuth, SAML), and testing methodologies. 
 - Infrastructure Mastery: Proven experience with network penetration testing, bypassing network segmentation, and conducting complex Active Directory exploitation (using tools like BloodHound, Impacket, Mimikatz, etc. ). 
 - Cloud & CI/CD Proficiency: Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and experience finding security flaws in DevOps pipelines (GitLab, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc. ). 
 - Tooling & Scripting: Expert-level proficiency with industry-standard offensive tools (e. g. , Burp Suite Pro, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, Nmap). Strong programming/scripting abilities in Python, Bash, Go, or PowerShell to write custom tooling or modify exploits. 
 - Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate highly technical findings into clear, business-focused risks for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Desirable Qualifications: 

- Industry Certifications: Highly regarded offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, CRTO, GXPN, or equivalent. 
 - FinTech Experience: Previous experience testing high-frequency trading platforms, financial technology, or heavily regulated environments. 
 - Community Involvement: A track record of independent vulnerability research, published CVEs, active bug bounty participation, or speaking engagements at security conferences (DEFCON, Black Hat, BSides). 

Benefits

Competitive Benefits & Perks in India We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. 

- Health & Financial Security: 
 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 - Time Off & Flexibility: 
 - Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. 
 - 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days. 
 - One dedicated day per year for volunteering. 
 - Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development. 
 - An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years. 
 - Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. 
 - Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

 - Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. 
 - Milestone anniversary bonuses. 
 - Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: 
 - Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. 
 - Our Culture: 
 - Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion. Trading Technologies (www. tradingtechnologies. com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market-leading technology for the end-to-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers "multi-X" solutions, with "X" representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies' clients.

data.description:
About Chargebee

Chargebee is a subscription billing and revenue management platform powering some of the fastest-growing brands around the world today, including Calendly, Hopin, Pret-a-Manger, Freshworks, Okta, Study. com and others. Thousands of SaaS and subscription-first businesses process over billions of dollars in revenue every year through the Chargebee platform. 

Headquartered in San Francisco, USA, our 500+ team members work remotely throughout the world, including India, the Netherlands, Paris, Spain, Australia, and the USA. 

Chargebee has raised over $480 million in capital and is funded by Accel, Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Steadview Capital, and Sapphire Ventures. And we're on a mission to push the boundaries of subscription revenue operations. Not just ours, but every customer and prospective business on a recurring revenue model. 

Our team builds high-quality and innovative software to enable our customers to grow their revenues powered by the state-of-the-art subscription management platform. 

Position Summary: 

Chargebee is looking for an inspirational Engineering leader to drive the Next Generation for it's Billing team to create a revolutionary subscriptions experience for its customers. This role requires a blend of strong technical expertise, exceptional system design skills, and a passion for leading and mentoring engineering teams. 

As an Engineering Manager, you will oversee the development and delivery of key product features, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful execution of innovative, customer-focused solutions. Your role will involve both strategic leadership and hands-on technical contributions to ensure the team delivers scalable, high-quality products that meet business objectives. 

Key Responsibilities: The key responsibilities include: 

- As Engineering Manager of Billing Team, you will build, inspire, and grow talented engineering teams that are responsible for designing and building end-to-end product capabilities for Chargebee's Subscription Management Platform. 
 - We are building a best-in-class experience for our customers. You will be leading the engineering efforts in building a zero to one product and platform, guiding it from initial concept to production and beyond. 
 - You will be responsible for managing product milestones, deployment cycles & delivery of the overall Subscriptions and Invoicing workflows through the various Marketplaces and Mobile platforms. 
 - You will work with product management, GTM and engineering teams to influence key decisions on architecture and roadmap by identifying opportunities for innovation. 
 - Lead by example through hands-on coding when necessary, and inspire your team with your technical expertise. 
 - Directly responsible for the career advancement of the engineers at various stages of their career growth. 

Qualification: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 12+ years of proven experience leading large teams including managers in remote and distributed product engineering setup, ideally in a zero to one product/platform. 
 - Proven experience designing and building scalable systems from the ground up, with deep expertise in system design, architecture, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Strong hands-on technical skills with the ability to contribute to code. 
 - Demonstrated success building culture of innovation, ownership, accountability, and customer focus
 - Ability to apply object-oriented and functional programming styles to solve real world problems. 
 - Accomplished practitioner of Agile and DevOps practices with experience guiding teams through planning, development, rollout and migration. 
 - Good communication and presentation skills with ability to interact with different cross-functional teams of varying levels. 
 - Ability to learn new tools and paradigms in engineering, especially in backend technologies and AI, intellectually curious and continuously striving to learn. 

Skills: 

- Solid experience in managing B2C and B2B enterprise grade distributed backend systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of Java, SQL and NoSQL databases and an understanding of JavaScript frameworks like Vue, React or Angular. 
 - Experience with building global scale cloud-native systems and modern tech stack: AWS, Spring Boot Framework, RESTful API, and container-based applications. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and industry best practices
 - Experience creating/supporting production software/systems and a proven track record of identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks in production. 
 - Experience building Mobile applications would be an added advantage. 

What makes us who we are: 

- We are Globally Local: With a diverse team across four continents, and customers in over 60 countries, you get to work closely with a global perspective right from your own neighborhood. 
 - We value Curiosity: We believe the next great idea might just be around the corner. Perhaps it's that random thought you had ten minutes ago. We believe in creating an ecosystem that fosters a desire to seek out hard questions, figure out answers to them, and foster a continuous learning environment. 
 - Customer! Customer! Customer!: Everything we do is driven towards enabling our customers' growth. This means no matter what you do, you will always be adding real value to a real business problem. It's a lot of responsibility, but also a lot of fun. 

If you resonate with Chargebee, have a monstrous appetite for curiosity, and an insatiable urge to learn and build new things, we're waiting for you!

We value people from all backgrounds and are dedicated to hiring and employing a diverse and inclusive workplace. 

Come be a part of the Chargebee tribe!

Azure Cloud / DepOps Support & Integration Engineer

Having opened Australia's first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APJ region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning. . . 

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground. 

A Snapshot

This role should be positioned primarily as an Azure Cloud and DevOps support role, with secondary responsibility for integration coding. The ideal candidate is strong in Azure operations, DevOps pipelines, automation, monitoring, incident resolution, and production support, while also being capable of working on APIs and integration-related development when required. 

You will work within the Integration Practice, collaborating with solution architects, product owners, and application/data teams to ship secure, scalable, observable integrations, fast. 

Your Day to Day

Build & DevOps (Engineering at Scale)

- Manage, support, and troubleshoot Azure cloud environments. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools. 
 - Support production systems, incidents, deployments, and environment issues. 
 - Work with Azure services such as App Services, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, API Management, and Entra ID. 
 - Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and operational dashboards. 
 - Automate infrastructure and operational tasks using scripts, IaC, or DevOps tooling. 
 - Support integration platforms, APIs, and data flows between systems. 
 - Perform root cause analysis and improve system reliability. 
 - Collaborate with developers, architects, vendors, and business teams to resolve issues. 
 - Ensure cloud environments follow security, governance, and operational best practices

Architecture & Solution Design

- Own end‐to‐end integration architecture for features and platforms (E2E flows, domain boundaries, data contracts, and runtime topologies). 
 - Design API-first solutions (REST/GraphQL/SOAP), event-driven integrations, and streaming patterns using best-fit services (e. g. , Azure API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid; or equivalent on AWS/GCP). 
 - Select patterns and standards (synchronous vs. async, choreography vs. orchestration, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, DLQs, exactly-once/at-least-once). 
 - Embed security by design (OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, key rotation, secret management, data protection at rest/in transit). 

Integration Engineering (TypeScript-first)

- Build integration services, adapters, and APIs-primarily in TypeScript/Node. js-using modern patterns and robust error handling, resilience, and observability. 
 - Implement data transformation (JSON, XML, Avro), mapping, validation, and schema governance; ensure performance, reliability, and scalability. 

AI‐Assisted & Agentic Engineering

- Use AI coding agents to accelerate delivery (code generation, test scaffolding, PR suggestions, refactors, documentation). 
 - Apply agentic frameworks such as LangChain (or similar) for developer tooling, automation, and integration observability/ops augmentation where appropriate. 
 - Contribute patterns for responsible AI use (guardrails, review flows, IP protection, secret hygiene). 

Stakeholder Engagement (Forward‐Deployed)

- Work directly with stakeholders to refine requirements, run technical workshops, and translate business needs into architecture and executable backlogs. 
 - Produce high‐quality technical artefacts (diagrams, ADRs, sequence diagrams, API specs/Contracts, runbooks). 
 - Mentor engineers, conduct peer reviews, and uplift engineering standards across teams. 

Reliability, Security, and Operations

- Build observable services (structured logging, metrics, traces-e. g. , OpenTelemetry), dashboards, and alerts. 
 - Lead incident response and RCA; drive corrective and preventative actions. 
 - Ensure compliance with enterprise security, data privacy, and audit requirements. 

Requirements

Essential: 

- 5+ years in software/integration engineering, with extensive hands-on DevOps and technical architecture experience. 
 - Proven delivery on Azure and familiarity with AWS and/or GCP equivalents. 
 - Expert in CI/CD pipeline engineering (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions; or CodePipeline/Cloud Build): multi-stage pipelines, approvals, environments, secrets, quality gates, artifact promotion, and progressive delivery. 
 - Strong TypeScript/Node. js engineering, including test automation (unit, integration, contract testing with Pact or equivalent), performance testing, and secure coding practices. 
 - Deep knowledge of Git (branching strategies, PR workflows), Docker, API design (REST/GraphQL/SOAP), and data formats (JSON, XML). 
 - Hands-on with event-driven architectures and messaging (Azure Service Bus/Event Grid, Kafka, or SNS/SQS). 
 - Proficient with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Bicep) and configuration management. 
 - Solid understanding of API Management (Azure APIM, Kong, Apigee, or equivalent), observability (logs/metrics/traces), and SRE practices (SLIs/SLOs, error budgets). 
 - Comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders (product, domain SMEs, vendors) and operating as a forward‐deployed engineer. 
 - Strong problem-solving, debugging, and performance tuning skills across distributed systems. 
 - Experience working in Agile and hybrid environments; excellent written and verbal communication. 

Desirable

- Knowledge of serverless integration patterns (Azure Functions/Lambda) and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS/GKE). 
 - Security expertise: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, JWT, WAF, secrets management (Key Vault/Secrets Manager), certificate lifecycle. 
 - Exposure to ERP/CRM/HRIS/data platforms (e. g. , SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, Databricks).

 - Global or APAC program experience; certifications in Azure/AWS/GCP or integration platforms. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you're helping scale our region's digital future, we'll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) | Enterprise Data Platforms

Role Overview

The Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) organization is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and standardized enterprise data platform capabilities across multi-cloud environments. This role is a platform engineering and operations position (Officer level) focused on: 

- Platform enablement and standardization
 - Cloud infrastructure and data platform operations
 - Governance, risk, and compliance alignment
 - Automation and operational excellence

The position emphasizes run-based ownership, platform lifecycle management, and cross-functional collaboration, and is not a software development role. 

Core Responsibilities

- Platform Engineering & Operations
 - Own end-to-end operational management of enterprise data platforms across Azure and AWS
 - Ensure high availability, resiliency, and performance of cloud-based data platforms
 - Drive standardization of platform configurations, deployment patterns, and operational controls
 - Support platform lifecycle activities: provisioning, onboarding, upgrades, patching, and decommissioning
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation
 - Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform
 - Develop reusable platform modules and templates for consistent deployments
 - Automate operational workflows using: 
 - Azure CLI / AWS CLI
 - Bash / PowerShell scripting
 - Python (where applicable)

 - CI/CD & Platform Delivery
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) for: 
 - Infrastructure provisioning
 - Environment promotion
 - Platform configuration management
 - Enable controlled, auditable, and repeatable deployments
 - Ensure segregation of duties and compliance alignment in deployment workflows
 - Governance, Security & Compliance
 - Enforce enterprise-wide security controls and governance frameworks, including: 
 - RBAC (Role-Based Access Control)

 - Key management (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS)
 - Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements

 - Operational playbooks
 - Architecture and configuration documentation
 - Standardize onboarding guides and platform usage patterns
 - Ensure operational transparency and knowledge sharing across teams
 - Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Partner with: 
 - Architecture teams
 - Security & Risk
 - Application and Data Engineering teams
 - Cloud platform providers and vendors
 - Act as a platform SME, enabling adoption across enterprise teams
 - Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap discussions

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in cloud platform engineering / data platform operations
 - Strong hands-on experience with: 
 - Microsoft Azure and/or AWS
 - Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
 - Azure DevOps (CI/CD pipelines)
 - Strong scripting and automation expertise: 
 - Bash / PowerShell / Python / REST APIs
 - Solid understanding of: 
 - Cloud data platforms (e. g. , Snowflake, Databricks ecosystems)
 - Networking, security, and cloud architecture patterns
 - Proven experience in: 
 - Production support environments (L2/L3 support)
 - Incident management and RCA processes
 - Strong knowledge of: 
 - RBAC, IAM, encryption, governance, compliance frameworks
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Financial Services / regulated environments (e. g. , FFIEC, SOC2, etc. )
 - Exposure to multi-tenant or shared enterprise platform models
 - Experience supporting SaaS-based data platforms
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Snowflake ecosystem
 - Data governance tooling
 - Observability and monitoring frameworks
 - Experience working in customer-facing or consulting roles
 - Awareness of AI/ML-driven automation and platform efficiencies
 - Experience in platform onboarding, enablement, and adoption programs

Leadership & Behavioural Competencies

- Strong ownership mindset with accountability for platform stability and outcomes
 - Ability to operate effectively in a controlled, process-driven enterprise environment
 - Strong collaboration and influencing skills across global teams
 - High attention to documentation quality, audit readiness, and governance alignment
 - Continuous focus on automation, efficiency, and operational improvement

Success Measures

- Consistent achievement of SLA/SLO targets for platform uptime and reliability
 - Measurable reduction in: 
 - Manual operational tasks
 - Sev-1 and critical incidents
 - Improved platform onboarding time and user adoption
 - Enhanced automation coverage and operational efficiency
 - Demonstrable cloud cost optimization and governance adherence
 - Strong audit outcomes with minimal compliance gaps

Additional Notes

This role is part of the Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) organization

Core Focus Areas Include: 

Platform enablement

Governance and controls

Operational excellence

Position Summary

Level: Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation or equivalent

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will lead functional validation and quality assurance for enterprise-scale Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud solutions as part of the Pharma commercial CRM transformation projects. You will define the test approach, lead test planning and execution across environments and releases, and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective test coverage, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key quality metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions. Work you'll do:

 - End-to-end ownership of functional validation for modules; lead story grooming, requirement walkthroughs and acceptance criteria definition with onshore/client teams. 
 - Validate commercial CRM processes on Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud (e. g. , HCP/HCO management, call reporting, samples, events, approved email, territory alignment) against how they operated in Veeva CRM; call out functional gaps and process deviations.

- 6 - 10 years of hands-on experience with Salesforce implementations, testing 
 - A Bachelor degree 
 - 6+ years of consulting experience in Functional Validation/ Testing with exposure to Salesforce applications and integrations to various mobile apps 
 - Proven experience leading QA/testing teams in Salesforce project delivery 
 - Strong knowledge related to Profiles, roles, security, workflows, validation rules, custom objects, reports, and dashboards is must 
 - Experience in documenting and analysing processes, procedures, and/or policies. 
 - Salesforce. com Administrator Certification (ADM201 or higher) is preferred 
 - Good knowledge of test management processes and tools (for eg: Jira, Azure DevOps) 
 - Good Knowledge of Agile implementations and contributing on the QA activities in a sprint 
 - Ability to define, understand or conduct cross-browser and usability testing. 
 - Hands on experience on performing functional/Non-Functional testing of web applications. 
 - Exposure to Automation or Performance testing or any programming language at least for few months/years 
 - Good knowledge of tools and methods used in Salesforce testing like Workbench, Integration testing using Postman/Soap API's and Migrations testing across various loads 
 - Experience in life sciences/pharmaceutical domain & Veeva CRM, including testing/validating Veeva CRM or Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud implementations 
 - Hands-on experience validating Veeva CRM functionality covering: Sample management, order management, and field inventory workflows. 
 - Working knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial processes (HCP/HCO account management, call reporting, sample management, events, approved email, territory management) and field force enablement, with the ability to build test scenarios from them 
 - Good communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills; should be a great team player 
 - Be passionate about design and digital customer domain and provide feedback on these applications

Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 

- Project experience on Life science and Health clients (Commercial, Patient experience, Med Tech, Provider and/or Payer) 
 - Familiarity with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud / Industries commercial capabilities 
 - Familiarity with developer/engineering tools, technical knowledge around build installation, and technology trends 
 - Exposure to Testing types like Accessibility Testing, Migration Testing 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD tools is preferred (for eg: Jenkins) 
 - Knowledge of Low Code No Code automation tools (for eg: Copado Robotics Testing) and Salesforce test automation tools (for eg: Provar, Selenium, Tosca) 
 - Veeva CRM certification 
 - Exposure to Veeva CRM configuration/administration to understand and validate business rules, data model and user access 
 - Exposure to Veeva Vault or related Veeva ecosystem tools 
 - Veeva CRM Events Management - event creation, approval, and lifecycle management. 
 - MyInsights dashboard & KPI validation, CLM, Approved email and template management 
 - Advanced knowledge of commercial Life Sciences business processes and the ability to translate them into end-to-end test scenarios, including field force effectiveness, territory management, HCP/HCO engagement tracking, and multi-channel commercial operations 
 - Experience validating data migration and integrations (e. g. , MuleSoft-based) between CRM, master data and downstream systems 
 - Awareness of pharma compliance and validation practices (e. g. , audit-ready test documentation, computer system validation, GxP, data privacy)

data.title: SENIOR MANAGER, SRE & PLATFORM ENGINEERING
data.description:
About Armor Defense Inc

At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we're looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team. 

Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor. 

Learn more at: https: //www. armor. com

Summary

Reporting to the V. P. of Engineering, the Senior Manager, SRE & Platform Engineering provides technical leadership and people management for Armor's SRE and infrastructure engineering team. This role is responsible for the reliability, performance, and operational excellence of Armor's production systems, including enterprise cloud (Armor Enterprise Cloud), managed security services (Armor Agent, WAF, firewalls), and the infrastructure underpinning Armor MDR. The Senior Manager sets technical direction, develops engineering talent, and owns key operational processes like incident response, on-call rotations, and infrastructure automation. This is a hands-on leadership role that balances people management with deep technical expertise. 

Work Schedule & Shift Requirements

- Hybrid work arrangement based in Pune, India, with mandatory in-office attendance Monday through Thursday (four days per week). 
 - Flexibility to work assigned shifts based on operational and business requirements, including required overlap with US working hours for collaboration with US-based teams and stakeholders. 
 - Lead and participate in on-call coverage, incident escalations, and after-hours coordination as required to support production operations. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)

- Provide technical leadership and people management for the SRE and infrastructure engineering team, including goal setting, performance management, career development, and hiring
 - Own production reliability for Armor Enterprise Cloud, Armor Agent, and MDR infrastructure; lead incident response, blameless postmortems, and operational reviews
 - Establish and maintain SLIs/SLOs for critical services; use them to drive automation roadmap and engineering prioritization
 - Own monitoring and observability strategy; implement actionable dashboards and meaningful alerts
 - Drive infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD automation, and operational tooling to reduce manual toil
 - Partner with the VP of Engineering on infrastructure strategy, architecture, and cost optimization initiatives
 - Manage infrastructure provisioning, capacity planning, and vendor relationships for private cloud (VMware/Proxmox), public cloud (AWS, GCP), and hardware refresh cycles
 - Ensure infrastructure meets security and compliance requirements (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2)
 - Collaborate with product engineering on deployments, shared services, and operational handoffs
 - Evangelize SRE culture and DevOps best practices across engineering

WHY ARMOR

Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role - we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story. 

ARMOR CORE VALUES

- Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges. 
 - Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency + honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances. 
 - Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection. 
 - Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes. 
 - Follow-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.

data.title: Group Lead - Infra & Heavy Civil
data.description:
Job Information

Number of Positions

1

Department Name

Infra & Heavy Civil Engineering

Industry

Engineering

Experience Required

15+

Qualification

- M. E. or M. Tech in Civil, Structural, Transportation, or Infrastructure Engineering

City

Pune City

State/Province

Maharashtra

Zip/Postal Code

411001

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

- Operational Scale and P&L Ownership: Own Infrastructure BU performance, including gross margins, billable utilisation, project profitability, capacity planning, resource forecasting, productivity, and scalable deployment of civil modellers, structural detailers, engineers, coordinators, and project managers. 
 - Global Client Delivery and Escalation: Act as the senior delivery and technical interface for enterprise infrastructure clients across North America markets; manage scope, milestones, change orders, RFIs, escalations, SLA adherence, and client satisfaction. 
 - Multidisciplinary Delivery Leadership: Orchestrate end-to-end delivery across highways, bridges, drainage, rail alignments, utilities, grading, site civil, and airport airside and landside works, ensuring seamless coordination between geometry, structures, surfaces, profiles, utilities, and documentation packages. 
 - Technical Quality and Design Gatekeeping: Lead technical reviews for horizontal and vertical alignments, corridor models, terrain surfaces, bridge structural detailing, rebar and pre-stressing details, hydraulic drainage simulations, rail profiles, utility coordination, and airport grading plans. 
 - International Codes and Standards Compliance: Ensure all deliverables comply with applicable standards such as AASHTO, FHWA, UK DMRB, Eurocodes, Austroads, FAA airport design guidance, ISO 9001, ISO 19650, and client-specific CAD, BIM, and documentation protocols. 
 - Digital Delivery Standardisation: Standardise SOPs, templates, libraries, quality checklists, parametric modelling workflows, automation practices, and BIM coordination methods across Civil 3D, Bentley OpenRoads Designer, MicroStation, OpenBridge, Revit Structure, InfraWorks, HEC-RAS, StormCAD, and related tools. 
 - Quality, Risk and Governance: Establish robust QA/QC gates, delivery dashboards, peer-review systems, issue logs, risk reviews, lessons-learned repositories, and first-time-right quality controls for major infrastructure programmes. 
 - Talent Development and Capability Building: Partner with Talent Acquisition and internal leaders to hire, retain, mentor, and upskill engineering talent through structured workshops in grading, cut-and-fill analysis, corridor modelling, bridge detailing, drainage modelling, utility coordination, BIM coordination, and dynamic CAD automation. 
 - Commercial and Strategic Growth: Support account expansion, proposal inputs, delivery solutioning, offshore operating models, capability presentations, and strategic growth initiatives for global infrastructure clients. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications and Experience

- M. E. or M. Tech in Civil, Structural, Transportation, or Infrastructure Engineering. 
 - 15+ years of heavy civil engineering delivery and design experience, including significant exposure to highways, bridges, drainage, rail, aviation, utilities, grading, and multidisciplinary BIM/model coordination. 
 - At least 10+ years of leadership experience managing offshore, distributed, or large-scale engineering teams for global infrastructure clients. 
 - Strong hands-on command of civil design and modelling workflows, with expert-level familiarity across Autodesk Civil 3D, Bentley OpenRoads, MicroStation, Revit Structure, OpenBridge, InfraWorks, HEC-RAS, StormCAD, or similar platforms. 
 - Deep knowledge of international standards, including AASHTO, FHWA, UK DMRB, Eurocodes, Austroads, FAA airport design guidance, ISO 9001, ISO 19650, and client-specific digital delivery requirements. 
 - Proven ability to manage P&L, productivity metrics, utilisation targets, resource planning, quality governance, stakeholder communication, technical reviews, and enterprise client relationships. 
 - Strategic, metrics-driven, technically rigorous leader with strong executive communication, cross-cultural management capability, problem-solving orientation, and a passion for developing high-performing civil engineering teams.

data.title: Manager - Quality
data.description:
We're seeking a quality professional to drive excellence across our manufacturing operations. If you're passionate about process improvement, problem-solving, and ensuring product safety, this role offers the opportunity to make a measurable impact on customer satisfaction and operational performance. 

What will you do?

- Drive root cause analysis and corrective action initiatives to minimize quality risks in manufacturing processes
 - Execute process audits and champion quality culture to strengthen compliance and continuous improvement
 - Oversee change management for new manufacturing lines and process changes with rigorous quality oversight
 - Collaborate with procurement and operations teams to address supplier quality issues and implement solutions

What are the key skills we are looking for?

- Quality Strategy - expert level; developing site-level quality roadmaps that align with business objectives
 - Problem Solving - advanced level; resolving complex manufacturing quality issues using structured methodologies
 - Process Auditing - advanced level; conducting thorough assessments to ensure compliance and identify improvement opportunities
 - PFMEA - advanced level; identifying and mitigating potential failure modes in manufacturing processes
 - Quality in Manufacturing and Distribution - advanced level; ensuring product integrity throughout the production lifecycle
 - Quality Management Systems - advanced level; maintaining and improving QMS frameworks to meet regulatory standards
 - Root Cause Analysis - intermediate level; investigating quality events to prevent recurrence
 - Process Control - intermediate level; monitoring and optimizing manufacturing parameters for consistent quality

What qualifications will make you successful?

- Strong technical mindset with the ability to apply conceptual knowledge to solve difficult quality challenges
 - Effective influencing skills to drive change and build quality culture across teams
 - Independent work style with sound judgment in adherence to policies and compliance standards
 - Collaborative approach to partnering with procurement, operations, and engineering stakeholders

What's in it for me?

- Meaningful work where your expertise directly impacts product safety and customer loyalty
 - Opportunities to lead improvement projects and contribute to quality strategy development
 - Collaborative culture that values technical excellence and continuous learning
 - Exposure to advanced quality tools and cross-functional manufacturing initiatives

Bring your quality expertise to a team that's committed to excellence - apply today!

data.title: Senior Emulation Engineer
data.description:
About Axiado Corporation

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we're a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we're extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. 

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We're small enough that every person's work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company's future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let's talk. 

Job Description

The Senior Emulation Engineer position is your opportunity to join one of the industry's leading companies in platform security management and ransomware detection for cloud datacenters, 5G infrastructure and disaggregated compute ecosystems. We are looking for an emulation engineer to run and debug system-level workloads on Synopsys ZeBu emulation platforms and to own the integration and bring-up of transactors (XTORs) that connect the emulated SoC to real and virtual interfaces. Your focus is what happens once the design is running: getting the interfaces alive, executing firmware, OS, and use-case validation, triaging failures, and finding issues before silicon. This role is critical for validating the interoperability of our design with commercial AI servers, and for bridging the gap between hardware and software, as well as supporting SW development. 

Key Responsibilities

Runtime validation

- Execute and debug system-level tests, firmware, and software workloads on ZeBu emulation models
 - Bring up and validate secure boot flows (ROM, bootloader, Linux/RTOS) and platform security features such as root of trust, attestation, and firmware update on the emulated SoC
 - Develop and run use-case scenarios covering platform security management, ransomware detection workloads, and datacenter/5G traffic patterns
 - Triage failures and isolate root cause across RTL, firmware, driver, testbench, XTOR, and emulation environment; produce clear, reproducible bug reports
 - Use ZeBu runtime debug capabilities (waveform capture, triggers, memory/register access, checkpoint/restore, force/release) to debug efficiently at speed
 - Run and manage long-running regressions and soak tests; track pass rates, failure trends, and run-to-run stability
 - Perform power-aware and performance validation runs: activity capture, bandwidth/latency profiling, and use-case benchmarking

XTOR integration and bring-up

- Integrate and configure ZeBu transactors and speed adapters (PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, NVMe, DDR/LPDDR, I2C/I3C/SMBus, SPI, UART, JTAG, etc. ) at the testbench and runtime level
 - Bring up XTOR-to-DUT links from first connectivity through link training, enumeration, and stable data traffic; resolve protocol-level and configuration issues
 - Develop host-side software and drivers that control XTORs (C/C++, Python, SystemVerilog DPI, ZeBu API), including connections to real devices, virtual peripherals, or hybrid platforms
 - Debug XTOR-related failures using protocol analyzers, waveforms, and logs; determine whether the issue lies in the DUT, the XTOR, clocking/speed-adapter configuration, or the host
 - Tune XTOR configuration for throughput, latency, and emulation-frequency compatibility
 - Maintain XTOR configuration, version control, and documentation across model releases
 - Configure host servers, boot environments to interact with the emulated design
 - Integrate, develop and debug transactors, bridges and protocol adapters as needed
 - Debug and root-cause embedded HW, SW and test failures in emulation
 - Collaborate with RTL, DV and SW teams to resolve system level bugs

Qualifications

- BS or MS degrees or higher in EE, CE or related fields
 - 7+ years of hands-on experience in prototyping, emulation, SOC design and validation
 - Self-driven, good problem solving and communication skills
 - Hands-on experience running and debugging designs on Synopsys ZeBu (or comparable emulators such as Palladium or Veloce), including runtime control (NGTB or C based), waveform capture, and checkpoint/restore
 - Experience integrating and debugging high-speed and low-speed interfaces
 - Familiarity with embedded software bring-up and bootloader/kernel interactions
 - Proficiency with scripting languages (Python, Perl, TCL) for automation
 - Preferred qualifications include: experience in design verification, hardware/software co-simulation, Linux device drivers, bare-metal FW or boot loaders

Additional Information

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. 

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are. 

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

data.description:

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we're a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we're extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. 

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. Job Description

Axiado is a top-tier manufacturer of TCU (Trusted Control/Compute Unit) solutions. We are hiring a Senior QA Engineer - Performance & Reliability to lead the performance characterization and reliability validation of our Secure TCU System, ensuring it meets rigorous data center standards. 

In this role, you will own the test design, execution, and deep-dive analysis for performance and reliability, working closely with development teams to identify bottlenecks and resolve complex system-level issues. 

Key Responsibilities

Performance & Reliability Strategy

- Test Design & Execution: Design and execute comprehensive test plans for performance benchmarking, stress testing, longevity/endurance testing, and thermal/power characterization of TCU/BMC systems. 
 - Workload Analysis: Analyze system behavior under various heavy workloads to identify performance bottlenecks in throughput, latency, and resource utilization (CPU, Memory, PCIe). 
 - Reliability Validation: Conduct Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) prediction, long-duration stability tests, and error injection campaigns to validate system robustness. 

Deep Dive & Issue Resolution

- Root Cause Analysis: Lead the deep-dive investigation of performance degradation and reliability failures. Use advanced debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, firmware traces) to isolate issues.

 - Infrastructure Enhancement: Develop and maintain automated performance testing frameworks and reporting dashboards to track regression and trends over time. 

Reporting & Leadership

- Reporting: Generate detailed performance assessment reports and reliability analysis metrics for stakeholders. 
 - Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers on performance testing methodologies and system debugging techniques. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in embedded system testing, with a strong focus on performance verification and reliability engineering. 
 - System Knowledge: Deep understanding of TCU, BMC, HMC, RoT (Root of Trust), Secure Boot, TPM, HSM, PCIe (Gen4/5), DDR memory, and networking protocols. 
 - Performance Tools: Proficiency with performance profiling tools, traffic generators, and standard benchmarks (e. g. , SPEC, IOzone, iperf). Experience with thermal and power measurement tools. 
 - Programming: Strong scripting skills in Python for test automation and data analysis; familiarity with C/C++ for code analysis is a plus. 
 - Operating Systems: Strong Linux/Unix skills, including kernel tuning, system monitoring, and log analysis. 
 - Tools: Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) and version control (Git). 
 - Education: BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

Ways to Stand Out

- Experience with AI-driven log analysis or anomaly detection tools to predict reliability issues. 
 - Background in validation of high-speed interfaces (PCIe, CXL) and memory subsystems (DDR5/LPDDR5). 
 - Experience with data center server architecture and thermal management. 
 - Knowledge of industry reliability standards (e. g. , Telcordia, JEDEC). 

Note: We do not expect candidates to meet every single requirement. A strong core of these skills with a problem-solving mindset is what we value most. 

Additional Information

ServiceChannel Managers are the drivers of technology and team excellence, turning ideas into impactful solutions.
