- Lead multiple teams and tech leads; set org-level goals, structure and operating cadence, and be accountable for the combined delivery, quality and reliability outcomes. 
 - Set multi-year technical vision and architecture direction for the product area; establish architecture governance, design reviews and engineering standards across teams. 
 - Represent engineering to senior and executive leadership; communicate status, risks, trade-offs and strategy clearly, and influence cross-organization priorities and dependencies. 
 - Drive organization-wide engineering excellence: quality, security, reliability, cost efficiency and developer-experience programs with measurable targets. 
 - Lead complex cross-team and cross-region programs, resolve conflicts and escalations, and foster a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous improvement. 
 - Own commitments and delivery outcomes for the team(s), ensuring predictable and high-quality execution. 
 - Define and drive the technical strategy and roadmap for the . NET back end and React front end, including architecture, modernization and technical-debt management.

 - Mentor and coach team members, supporting their professional growth and fostering a collaborative, productive environment. 
 - Monitor delivery and service-health metrics (velocity, quality, reliability, performance, cost) and take corrective action when needed.

 - Drive observability and operational excellence: logging, monitoring, alerting, SLOs, incident management, postmortems and root-cause analysis.

Qualifications

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail. 
 - Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills; excellent communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams. 

Required Technical Skills

- Proven experience developing robust APIs using Microsoft . NET C#, ASP. NET MVC and . NET Core / modern . NET. 
 - Strong expertise in Entity Framework and LINQ for efficient data access and manipulation. 
 - Proficiency in front-end development with React. js and TypeScript, with a solid understanding of modern JavaScript frameworks and state management. 
 - Hands-on experience with SQL Server, including performance tuning and query optimization. 
 - Solid understanding of the SDLC and familiarity with JIRA, GitHub and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong grasp of modern software design principles, coding best practices and scalable architecture patterns (REST API design, microservices, event-driven systems). 
 - Proficient in unit testing and a sound understanding of test automation frameworks and principles. 
 - Knowledge of application security best practices (authentication/authorization, OAuth/SSO, OWASP). 

Preferred Skills & Experience

- Practical experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, including deployment and monitoring. 
 - Experience with Azure services such as Functions, Service Bus, Storage Accounts and App Services. 
 - Experience with MongoDB. 
 - Familiarity with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash) for logging and analytics.

Hands-on architect for embeddable web components - code that renders securely inside third-party sites and mobile apps you don't control. You'll set the standards and prove out the hardest embedding problems in code yourself. 

What You'll Be Doing

 - Architect secure embedding: cross-origin messaging, sandboxing, CSP, cookie/storage constraints, PII isolation, auth across origins. 
 - Define the rendering strategy: SSR, streaming, hydration, and a client footprint that doesn't degrade the host page. 
 - Ship to web (iframe/WebView) and mobile (React Native, native bridge) from one shared component source. 
 - Set standards for performance, accessibility, security, resilience, and observability.

 - Deep iframe and WebView expertise: secure cross-, sandboxing, CSP. 
 - TypeScript and React, hands-on SSR (Next. js or equivalent) - hydration, streaming, caching, and performance/SEO trade-offs. 
 - React Native and native WebView bridging. 
 - Security and privacy in embedded contexts: PII isolation, auth across origins, compliance-sensitive design.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Software Engineering Manager - IBOR

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Product Development is a major part of SimCorp, where software engineering teams work relentlessly towards producing world class solutions. Engineering Managers are leading these teams, and they are key to our success. We are growing and evolving Investment Book of Record (IBOR), a key element in the long standing success of SimCorp and in particular we are expanding the Transactions area to meet increasing client demand and deliver more outcomes. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

▪ First and foremost, you are going to hire and onboard software engineers in Hyderabad, build and nurture engineering teams, thereby be the driver in our quest to scale up our engineering capacity. 

▪ You are the leader of 1-2 teams of Software Engineers with responsibility for growing and upskilling your team through 1: 1s, feedback, mentoring, coaching, and goal setting

▪ You have responsibility for both the short-term deliverables in the sprints and the long-term improvements of your team(s)

▪ You are responsible for fostering a healthy working environment for your teams

▪ You work closely with your peers in both Engineering Management and Product Management to understand and refine the customer outcomes that you and your teams are responsible for delivering

▪ You collaborate with other leaders to deliver cross area initiatives, and to ensure knowledge sharing and consistency where needed

▪ You understand and define relevant engineering metrics to gain insight into your team's performance and to help drive improvement

▪ You are responsible for the planning and the delivery of the outcomes of your teams

What We Value

- Experience with engineer recruitment and building engineering teams
 - Overall 10+ years of experience, including: 

- 5+ years of software engineering experience. Especially into . Net Technologies
 - 0-5 years of (people, process, technical) leadership experience. 

- Knowledge and experience with AI, with the purpose of improving efficiency
 - Experience from a workplace that produces financial software, uses investment management software, has a global workforce, and distributed teams
 - Personal accountability and initiative. When something is unclear, you dig in rather than waiting for someone to hand you an answer. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and you follow through. 
 - Stakeholder management and collaboration across borders. 

Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days. 

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world's largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At Marriott Tech Accelerator center (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. data.title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization. 

You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities. 

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

Responsibilities

We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data. 

As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will

- Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
 - Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
 - Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
 - Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
 - Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. 

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. 

Qualifications

Required

- 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
 - You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
 - You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost. 
 - Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
 - Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
 - Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
 - Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
 - A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
 - Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

- Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
 - Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
 - Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
 - Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
 - Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
 - Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
 - Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits . 

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. 

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh . 

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

Job Title: C++ DEVELOPER - APEX - GLOBAL MARKETS IT

Department: GLOBAL MARKETS IT

About Business Line/Function

The Global Markets business of BNP Paribas helps its corporate and institutional clients leverage capital markets across the globe for their financing, risk management and investment needs. This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis & Project Management, Development & Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore & Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT workload, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it. 

APEX Team (GM IT Booking, PnL, Reg, Ref) currently consists of its Dev Team spread across Mumbai, Bengaluru, London, Lisbon and New York. We support a Repo booking system called Apex provided by FIS. data.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

About Northern Trust And Omnium

Northern Trust provides innovative financial services and guidance to corporations, institutions, affluent families, and individuals globally. With more than 130 years of financial experience and nearly 20, 000 partners, we serve some of the world's most sophisticated clients through leading technology and exceptional service. 

The Omnium technology organization develops and supports mission-critical financial platforms serving complex investment and asset servicing needs. Omnium supports capabilities across areas including pricing, accounting, trading, financial instrument processing, and regulatory functions. The platform combines internally developed technology with best-in-class partner solutions while maintaining an integrated system of record that provides transparency, control, and operational efficiency. 

The technologists building and supporting Omnium are thought leaders who work directly with the people who use our software every day. We value engineering ownership, pragmatic innovation, collaboration, continuous learning, and high-quality delivery. Our engineers are expected to understand the business problems they are solving, take ownership of their solutions, and continuously improve the resiliency, performance, security, and maintainability of the platform. 

Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior . NET Backend Developer to join the Omnium engineering team and contribute to the continued modernization and enhancement of our platform. 

The successful candidate will bring 10+ years of software engineering experience with strong hands-on expertise in C# and . NET backend development. The individual will work on a large and complex codebase supporting critical pricing, accounting, regulatory, and financial-processing capabilities. 

The role will involve both functional development and technical modernization, including enhancements to existing services, development of new backend capabilities, framework and dependency upgrades, performance improvements, security remediation, and improvements to the overall maintainability and resiliency of the platform. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role requiring the ability to independently own complex technical initiatives from analysis and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. The candidate should be comfortable working with minimal technical supervision while collaborating effectively with cross-functional engineering, architecture, product, and business teams. 

Overall Experience: 10+ years

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience developing enterprise applications and backend services. 
 - 5+ years of strong hands-on development experience using C# and modern . NET / . NET Core. 
 - Strong experience designing, building, enhancing, and maintaining backend services, REST APIs, and enterprise applications. 
 - Strong understanding of ASP. NET Core, including RESTful API development, dependency injection, configuration, middleware, authentication, and authorization. 
 - Experience with . NET technologies and frameworks such as ASP. NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and Microsoft authentication and security libraries. 
 - Strong experience with SQL Server and T-SQL, including relational data modeling, query development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience working with large, mature enterprise codebases, including modernization and enhancement of existing applications. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, SOLID principles, design patterns, asynchronous programming, concurrency, error handling, and application resiliency. 
 - Experience designing and developing secure, scalable, performant, maintainable, and testable production applications. 
 - Strong experience with unit testing, debugging, code reviews, source control, automated builds, and CI/CD-based software delivery. 
 - Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex technical problems and drive solutions through completion. 
 - Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into well-designed technical solutions. 
 - Experience collaborating effectively across engineering, architecture, product, infrastructure, and business teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain backend services and APIs using C# and modern . NET technologies. 
 - Enhance and modernize existing Omnium applications supporting pricing, accounting, regulatory, and related financial-processing capabilities. 
 - Develop new backend capabilities and extend existing applications to support evolving business and client requirements. 
 - Take ownership of complex technical changes from initial analysis and solution design through implementation and production deployment. 
 - Develop reusable backend components, services, and libraries that improve engineering consistency and accelerate future development. 
 - Produce secure, efficient, maintainable, well-documented, and well-tested code consistent with enterprise engineering standards. 
 - Modernize legacy components and dependencies, including . NET framework and runtime upgrades and remediation of technical debt. 
 - Identify and address performance, scalability, reliability, security, and resiliency issues across backend applications and services. 
 - Troubleshoot complex application and production issues and perform effective root-cause analysis. 
 - Participate actively in solution design, technical discussions, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement of engineering practices. 
 - Work closely with other Omnium and enterprise technology teams on cross-application dependencies and strategic technology initiatives. 
 - Contribute to improvements in automated testing, CI/CD, observability, application monitoring, and overall software delivery quality. 
 - Participate in production support and ensure applications meet appropriate operational, resiliency, and service-level expectations. 
 - Proactively identify opportunities to simplify the technology landscape, reduce technical debt, and improve engineering efficiency. 

Financial Services

- Experience working within financial services, capital markets, asset servicing, investment accounting, pricing, or trading platforms. 
 - Experience developing systems supporting high-volume or complex financial transactions. 
 - Understanding of financial instruments, pricing, accounting, or regulatory processing is advantageous. 

Azure and Cloud

- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, particularly building, deploying, or supporting enterprise applications and backend services in Azure. 
 - Familiarity with Azure technologies such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Key Vault, API Management, and Azure Monitor/Application Insights. 
 - Experience with cloud-native and containerized application development, including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Familiarity with cloud architecture principles involving scalability, resiliency, security, observability, and automated deployment. 
 - Experience with messaging or event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka or Azure messaging services. 

AI and Generative AI

- Exposure to Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Large Language Model technologies is a plus. 
 - Experience integrating enterprise applications with LLMs, AI APIs, or AI-enabled services is advantageous. 
 - Familiarity with Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, or similar enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Understanding of how AI capabilities can be securely integrated into existing enterprise applications and engineering workflows. 
 - Familiarity with AI engineering concepts such as prompt engineering, evaluation, observability, security, responsible AI, and production integration is desirable. 
 - Interest in identifying practical opportunities to apply AI to improve software engineering, operational processes, or financial-services workflows. 

Additional Technology

- Experience with application observability, telemetry, logging, and production monitoring. 
 - Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Exposure to Go or Node. js development is a plus. 

Professional Skills

- Highly motivated, self-directed, and accountable for delivering results. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. 
 - Demonstrates the ability to investigate beyond the immediate symptoms of a problem and identify underlying technical or process issues. 
 - Able to understand complex technical and business concepts quickly. 
 - Detail-oriented while maintaining an understanding of broader architectural and business impacts. 
 - Comfortable working in a complex technology environment with changing priorities and multiple concurrent deliverables. 
 - Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex assignments and drive them through completion. 
 - Proactively identifies opportunities to improve engineering quality, operational efficiency, platform stability, and maintainability. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Able to communicate complex technical concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and organizational boundaries. 
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership, accountability, engineering discipline, and commitment to quality. 

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

data.title: METALLURGY -ENGINEER
data.description:
Sansera Engineering is an engineering-led integrated manufacturer of forged complex and high-precision components for the automotive, non-Automotive and Aerospace sectors. With a rich legacy spanning over three decades, Sansera Engineering is committed to delivering quality products to its global clientele. As we continue to expand our operations and workforce, As we continue to expand our operations and workforce, we are seeking talented and dedicated individuals to join our team. 

Job Description - Engineer (heat Treatment)

- PRIME FUNCTION

To manage and monitor metallurgical laboratory activities related to in-house and outsourced Heat Treatment and BOP components, ensuring timely inspection, process compliance, equipment calibration and accurate documentation. Responsible for effective utilization of resources, team management, quality assurance and continuous improvement of laboratory operations to achieve departmental objectives in line with organizational requirements. 

- JOB DESCRIPTION / RESPONSIBILITIES
 - Productivity and Laboratory Management Manage all metallurgical laboratory activities related to in-house and outsourced Heat Treatment and BOP components. Ensure timely inspection and testing of materials as per defined requirements. Monitor departmental objectives and conduct periodic performance reviews. Ensure the availability of laboratory equipment, spares and consumables, along with timely calibration of inspection equipment. Identify operational bottlenecks and implement appropriate contingency measures. Ensure optimum utilization of available manpower and resources to achieve departmental productivity targets. 
 - Quality Management Monitor and review daily non-conformances and customer complaints, ensuring appropriate corrective and preventive actions. Ensure daily updation and maintenance of relevant departmental data in SAP. Implement and maintain compliance with TS, EMS and OHSAS management systems. Maintain proper inspection records, reports and departmental documentation. Ensure adherence to applicable quality standards, procedures and inspection requirements. 
 - Cost Management Monitor and control laboratory inspection costs to achieve departmental cost objectives. Plan manpower and departmental activities effectively to minimize overtime. Identify and eliminate process waste and non-value-added activities. Ensure optimum utilization of laboratory resources, equipment and consumables to maintain operational efficiency. 
 - Delivery and Coordination Ensure timely inspection and release of materials to avoid production delays. Coordinate with Production, Machine Shop, PPC and Materials departments to ensure smooth material flow and uninterrupted production activities. Coordinate with HR for departmental manpower requirements and ensure inspection activities are completed as per the production schedule. 
 - Safety and Compliance Ensure the availability of necessary safety resources and maintain a safe and healthy working environment within the department. Ensure the safety of personnel, equipment and machinery. Conduct periodic checks to identify workplace hazards and ensure implementation of appropriate safeguards. Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, environmental and occupational health and safety requirements. 
 - People Management and Continuous Improvement Guide, counsel and mentor team members to improve departmental performance and maintain discipline, teamwork and a healthy working environment. Conduct performance appraisals, target setting and periodic performance reviews. Identify training needs (TNA) and coordinate employee development programmes. Maintain and update departmental skill matrices and ensure effective implementation of on-the-job training (OJT). Prepare and update Job Descriptions and departmental organizational charts. Guide new employees on laboratory activities during their induction programme. Promote continuous improvement initiatives such as 5S, Kaizen, QCC, Suggestions, Poka-Yoke and other improvement projects. Ensure effective shop-floor layout, housekeeping and employee participation in improvement activities. 
 - AUTHORITY

Authorized to take necessary decisions and initiate corrective actions related to identified non-conformances. Responsible for authorization of in-process inspection and process control reports. Authorized to conduct performance appraisals of departmental team members, review and approve departmental work instructions, and raise material indents for departmental requirements. Authorized to conduct trials and approve laboratory consumables. Can recommend manpower increase or reduction based on production requirements and is authorized to stop production whenever necessary to address quality or process-related concerns. Also empowered to exercise other necessary authorities to discharge assigned duties and responsibilities effectively. 

- JOB SPECIFICATION / COMPETENCY

Educational Qualification: Minimum Diploma or Graduation in Metallurgy. 

Experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Heat Treatment processes and Metallurgical Laboratory activities. 

Technical Competencies: Knowledge of Heat Treatment processes, metallurgical laboratory inspection activities, laboratory equipment and calibration requirements. Understanding of quality management systems, inspection documentation and process compliance. Working knowledge of SAP and departmental data management, along with an understanding of TS, EMS and OHSAS requirements. 

Behavioural Competencies: Good people management, team leadership, communication and coordination skills. Ability to plan and organize departmental activities, solve problems, take decisions and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Ability to effectively manage manpower and achieve departmental objectives. 

- PERFORMANCE MEASURES (KPI - KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS)

Performance will be measured based on timely inspection and checking of materials, effective control of consumables costs, compliance with TS, EMS and OHSAS requirements, monitoring and reduction of customer complaints and non-conformances, achievement of departmental 5S scores, participation in QCC and SGA activities, implementation of Kaizens, improvements and employee suggestions, on-time delivery of inspected materials, prevention of workplace accidents and effective training and development of departmental team members. 

- PERFORMANCE ACCOUNTABILITY

The incumbent will be accountable for ensuring effective management of metallurgical laboratory operations, timely inspection and release of materials, achievement of departmental productivity, quality, cost and delivery targets, compliance with applicable quality and safety requirements, optimum utilization of manpower and laboratory resources, and continuous improvement in departmental processes and employee capabilities.

data.title: Senior Supervisor, Quality and Reliability Engineering
data.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today's needs and tomorrow's next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape. 

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. 

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

Mandatory Responsibilities

People Management & Team Leadership

- Lead and manage engineers, technicians, contractors, and/or lab support personnel. 
 - Drive resource allocation across qualification and reliability activities. 
 - Establish clear priorities and execution ownership. 
 - Monitor team workload, utilization, and productivity. 
 - Coach, mentor, and develop technical and operational capabilities within the team. 
 - Conduct performance discussions, goal setting, and career development planning. 

Lab Operations & Execution

- Own day-to-day operation of Reliability & Qualification Labs. 
 - Ensure uninterrupted execution of qualification, characterization, and reliability activities. 
 - Drive lab utilization, scheduling, and execution prioritization across programs. 
 - Monitor execution bottlenecks and proactively escalate risks impacting project milestones. 

Qualification Planning & Tracking

- Create and maintain qualification execution plans. 
 - Ensure sample availability, test readiness, resource availability, and schedule adherence. 
 - Coordinate qualification priorities across multiple programs and stakeholders. 
 - Track qualification deliverables and closure. 

Equipment & Infrastructure Management

- Manage lab equipment availability, uptime, and utilization. 
 - Own calibration planning and compliance for all reliability equipment. 
 - Drive preventive maintenance and service schedules. 
 - Ensure lab readiness for new qualification requirements. 

Inventory & Asset Management

- Manage consumables, sockets, fixtures, boards, adapters, and spare parts inventory. 
 - Monitor inventory levels and prevent qualification delays due to shortages. 
 - Maintain asset records and equipment tracking. 

Automation & Test Infrastructure

- Support automation execution and issue resolution. 
 - Coordinate automation setup, deployment, validation, and maintenance. 
 - Work with development teams to resolve infrastructure and automation blockers. 
 - Ensure test automation readiness for qualification programs. 

Lab IT & System Support

- Coordinate resolution of lab network, system, server, storage, and software issues. 
 - Drive closure of IT tickets impacting qualification execution. 
 - Manage access permissions, licenses, and infrastructure dependencies. 
 - Maintain operational continuity of data collection and reporting systems. 

Resource Allocation & Capacity Management

- Plan technician and engineer assignments. 
 - Optimize resource utilization across projects. 
 - Support capacity forecasting for upcoming qualification demand. 
 - Identify staffing and infrastructure gaps. 

Program Risk Management

- Highlight risks that can impact qualification schedules. 
 - Develop mitigation plans for equipment, resource, infrastructure, or execution constraints. 
 - Provide regular execution health and readiness status to management. 
 - Escalate critical blockers with recommended actions. 

Lab Compliance & Audit Readiness

- Ensure compliance with ISO/IATF, ESD, safety, and internal quality requirements. 
 - Maintain calibration, maintenance, and execution records. 
 - Support internal and external audits. 

Process Standardization

- Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
 - Drive continuous improvement of lab workflows. 
 - Implement best practices for execution consistency. 

Metrics & Reporting

- Publish lab KPIs such as: 
 - Equipment utilization
 - Qualification throughput
 - On-time execution
 - Calibration compliance
 - Automation coverage
 - Resource loading
 - Provide management dashboards and status reports. 
Training & Team Development

- Train engineers and technicians on lab processes and equipment. 
 - Develop operational knowledge continuity. 
 - Act as technical focal point for lab operations. 

Good-to-Have Responsibilities

Budget & Financial Planning

- Support annual lab budget planning. 
 - Track lab operational expenses. 
 - Forecast capital equipment requirements. 
 - Optimize spending through resource sharing and efficiency improvements. 

Procurement & Vendor Management

- Drive procurement of equipment, spares, consumables, and software licenses. 
 - Coordinate with suppliers for maintenance, calibration, and repairs. 
 - Support vendor qualification and service agreements. 

Additional Information

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. data.description:
About Us: 

Marriott International Inc. , headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine-seat A&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 9, 000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories. 

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world's largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At Marriott Tech Accelerator center (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. At Marriott Tech Accelerator, we are a team of passionate engineering minds dedicated to creating and building cutting-edge solutions that streamline operations and elevate guest experiences. 

Marriott Tech Accelerator center is fully owned and operated by ANSR. All associates at Marriott Tech Accelerator will be ANSR employees, delivering services exclusively to ANSR's client, Marriott International. 

Role Title: Principal Engineer

Position Summary: The Principal Engineer, Integrations is a hands-on technical leader focused on designing, developing, deploying and supporting enterprise integrations that connect SaaS legal technology platforms, enterprise web applications and domain services. The role requires strong engineering expertise in APIs, microservices, adapters and secure data exchange across legal, procurement, ERP, CRM and other enterprise systems. The portfolio includes cloud-based legal solutions, sell-side contract lifecycle management (CLM), legal request management, integrations, analytics, automation and related capabilities. The ideal candidate brings substantial hands-on experience delivering and supporting complex enterprise integrations, backed by strong full-stack development, data engineering and DevOps skills. Core expertise includes building APIs and microservices, implementing middleware and real-time, event-driven integrations, and managing data transformation and migration. This individual combines integration engineering depth with operational readiness and troubleshooting skills, collaborating effectively with business partners, enterprise technology teams and external stakeholders through complex delivery and support priorities. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Serve as the technical subject matter expert for legal technology platforms, with primary responsibility for the data orchestration and integration layer connecting legal applications to internal and external systems. 
 - Lead data and analytics engineering for legal technology, including reporting systems, dashboards, data models, data pipelines, and operational analytics capabilities. 
 - Analyze legal operations data to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies related to spend, supplier performance, cost savings, contract compliance, and process effectiveness. 
 - Support data-driven decision-making for legal business partners by delivering insights that improve operational efficiency, compliance, and cost management. 
 - Design and optimize data models, data structures, data flows, data extraction processes, data cleansing methods, and integration-ready datasets.

 - Plan and execute data migrations from existing systems to legal SaaS platforms while maintaining data accuracy, completeness, and integrity.

 - Apply appropriate integration patterns for synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and event-driven use cases. 
 - Engage stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle to communicate technical decisions, progress, risks, and trade-offs. 
 - Guide system integrators and engineering partners to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture and engineering standards. 
 - Validate solution quality through design reviews, testing practices, and adherence to nonfunctional requirements. 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex technical and integration issues across applications, services, and data flows. 
 - Stay current with emerging engineering, integration, cloud, and automation technologies relevant to the platform ecosystem. 
 - Proactively investigate incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive issues through resolution. 
 - Contribute to architecture discussions and help engineering teams make effective, scalable, and supportable technical decisions. 

Skill and Experience: 

- Strong understanding of full stack development principles and best practices. 
 - Strong technical skills in data manipulation, analysis, visualization, cloud data warehousing, ETL or ELT processes, SQL, Python, and BI tools. 
 - Experience with data modeling, dimensional modeling, fact tables, dimension tables, data warehousing, and related data modeling practices. 
 - Experience using AI-driven data classification methods to cleanse, normalize, classify, and harmonize datasets. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining ETL or ELT data pipelines using orchestration and transformation tools such as Apache Airflow and dbt. 
 - Experience implementing data quality checks, testing processes, and monitoring practices to ensure accuracy, reliability, and consistency of data products. 
 - Proven ability to lead engineering initiatives involving packaged platforms, SaaS products, custom applications, integrations, data migration, and technology delivery. 
 - Experience with scripting using Node. js, Java, or Python. 
 - Experience developing RESTful APIs, microservices, adapters, webhooks, ETL processes, middleware solutions, scalable message brokers such as Kafka, and common back-end integrations. 
 - Expertise writing high-quality, efficient, reusable code for full-stack web applications within a cross-platform ecosystem. 
 - Solid understanding of database design and management, including SQL and NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Solid understanding of platform engineering tools, DevOps principles, environment management, release management, source-code versioning, deployment methodologies, and OAuth-based authentication and authorization solutions. 
 - Experience configuring, customizing, implementing, and maintaining SaaS platforms, including workflow automation and integration with surrounding enterprise systems. 
 - Experience integrating content and document management systems with enterprise applications and data workflows. Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts and technologies, including practical awareness of how they can support automation, analytics, and data quality. 
 - Experience with testing frameworks, tools, and methodologies for validating application functionality, integration quality, and data reliability. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, debugging, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams. Experience working in Agile development environments and participating in iterative planning, delivery, and continuous improvement practices. 

Relevant Skills Listing: 

- Front-end development using React and Typescript, . Back-end development using NodeJS, Python and Nest JS
 - API/Microservices: Java and Spring Boot, RESTful, GraphQL and Apollo Federation
 - Languages & Querying: Python (PySpark), SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Java, Scala

 - DevOps & Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD pipelines
 - API Security: CORS, CSRF protection, OAuth-based integration etc
 - Databases: Data modeling, MySQL, document based
 - Architecture: Responsive SPA framework, REST API design and integration, modular

Data & Integration:

Marriott's core values: 

At Marriott, our core values make us who we are. We believe that success is never final. Being part of Marriott Tech Accelerator means being part of a proud history and a thriving culture.

data.title: Engineer - Information Systems
data.description:
Xperi invents, develops and delivers technologies that create extraordinary experiences at home and on the go for millions of people around the world. Powering billions of consumer electronics, connected cars and digital content titles, we make entertainment more immersive, driving more intelligent and every interaction seamlessly personalized through our renowned consumer brands: DTS®, HD RadioTM and TiVo®. 

Xperi (NYSE: XPER) is a publicly traded technology company headquartered in San Jose, CA with over 1, 500 employees across North America, Europe and Asia. Come join a thriving team where you can play an integral role in shaping the future of entertainment technology. 

About The Role

As an Engineer - Information Systems in the IT Automation and Observability team, you will work at the intersection of DevOps and Artificial Intelligence. You will design, build and own the CI/CD pipelines, automation and infrastructure that power our projects, while bringing AI capabilities into the enterprise by integrating Large Language Models with our data, systems and user interfaces. 

A key focus of the role is building interactive AI agents and integrating them with master agent (orchestrator) frameworks, so that specialized agents coordinate seamlessly to deliver intelligent, end-to-end automation. Working hands-on with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Python, REST APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Microsoft Azure / AWS and Microsoft Power Platform, you will connect agents to enterprise systems through REST APIs, custom connectors, Power Automate and agent flows and develop MCP servers and tools that enable reusable integrations across AI applications. 

The automation, pipelines and AI-driven workflows you build will reduce manual effort and help create a more efficient, scalable and resilient platform. You are a collaborative team player who documents your work thoroughly and takes ownership of solutions from design through production. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Engineering

- Core Technical Expertise: Demonstrate hands-on proficiency in Microsoft Copilot Studio, Python, REST APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Microsoft Azure / AWS and Microsoft Power Platform. Proven experience in direct integration with enterprise applications is essential. 
 - Application Integration: Develop and maintain MCP servers and tools where appropriate, enabling reusable integrations across compatible AI applications. 
 - Enterprise Systems Integration: Integrate agents with enterprise systems through REST APIs, custom connectors, Power Automate and agent flows. 
 - Workflow & Agent Design: Build agentic AI chatbots and multi-step automated workflows, integrated with master agent (orchestrator) frameworks. 
 - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Implement RAG architectures using vector databases and embedding models to enable AI to query private or domain-specific company data. 
 - Prompt Engineering & Fine-Tuning: Craft, test and optimize prompts, in-context learning and model outputs for reliability and precision. 
 - Production & Monitoring: Test, deploy, scale and monitor AI features for latency, cost, security and accuracy. 
 - AI Security & Governance: Apply AI security and governance best practices across all AI solutions, including data privacy, access control, prompt injection mitigation and responsible AI, ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory policies. 

DevOps & Infrastructure

- CI/CD Pipelines: Design, implement and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to automate build, test and deployment processes, including for AI-enabled applications. 
 - Version Control: Manage source code using Git, following best practices for branching, merging and version control in a collaborative team environment. 
 - Automation Scripting: Develop and maintain Python scripts to automate repetitive tasks such as system configuration, deployments and data processing. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Use Terraform to manage and provision cloud infrastructure, ensuring consistency and scalability. 
 - Configuration Management: Use tools such as Ansible to automate and standardize server and application configuration. 

Collaboration & Documentation

- Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work alongside development and operations teams to troubleshoot issues, streamline workflows and ensure the smooth, reliable delivery of applications. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Evaluate and adopt new DevOps and AI tools and best practices, and share learnings with the team. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain clear technical documentation so that knowledge is shared and accessible to the entire team. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

- A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Engineering or a related technical field. 
 - 5 - 7 years of overall experience, including a minimum of 3 years of relevant hands-on experience in AI and DevOps. 

Programming & Development

- Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python (primary), with familiarity in SQL and JavaScript. 
 - Web Technologies: Working knowledge of React JS, JavaScript and jQuery. 
 - Software Engineering Fundamentals: Git/version control (commits, branches, pull requests) and designing and consuming REST APIs. 

AI Agent Development & Integration

- Microsoft Copilot Studio: Hands-on experience designing, building and deploying AI agents in Copilot Studio, including topics, actions and agent flows. 
 - Microsoft Power Platform: Practical experience with Power Automate, custom connectors and agent flows to automate business processes and connect agents to enterprise systems. 
 - Model Context Protocol (MCP): Experience developing and maintaining MCP servers and tools to enable reusable, standardized integrations across compatible AI applications. 
 - Enterprise Application Integration: Proven, direct experience integrating with enterprise applications via REST APIs, including authentication (e. g. , OAuth 2. 0), API security and error handling. 

DevOps, Cloud & Infrastructure

- CI/CD: Hands-on experience with CI/CD principles and tools such as Jenkins. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform for provisioning and managing infrastructure. 
 - Configuration Management: Experience with tools such as Ansible. 
 - Cloud Platforms: Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including their compute, networking, storage and AI-related services. 
 - Operating Systems: Strong knowledge of Linux OS and fundamentals, including Ubuntu, RHEL and CentOS/Rocky Linux. 
 - Databases: Understanding of databases such as MariaDB, MySQL and MongoDB. 
 - Monitoring & Observability: Knowledge of monitoring platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana and Zabbix for enterprise monitoring, including metrics collection, dashboarding and alerting. 

Soft Skills

- Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across development and operations teams. 
 - Analytical, problem-solving mindset and a passion for using technology to solve real problems. 
 - Good documentation habits and a commitment to continuous learning. 

Life @ Xperi: 

At Xperi, we value People, Customers, Performance and Innovation. We are dedicated to creating a workplace where all employees have a voice and sense of belonging, feel safe and valued, and are acknowledged for how their unique differences contribute to organizational culture and business outcomes. 

Our employees and their families are important to us, and our comprehensive pay, stock and benefits programs reflect that. Xperi supports personal well-being, builds financial security and enables employees to share in our collective success. 

Rewards include: 

- Competitive compensation (salary, equity and bonuses) and comprehensive benefits designed to foster work-life balance, care for your health, protect your finances and help you save and invest for the future. 
 - Generous paid time away from work, including flexible time off, holidays and sick time, health and wellness initiatives, and a charitable match program to help you give back to your community. 
 - Great perks, which vary by location and can be site-specific: employee discounts, transportation reimbursements, subsidized cafes and fitness facilities. 
 - A flexible, hybrid work environment combining the best of in-office collaboration and community-building along with the benefits of working from home. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

As a Lead AI Quality Engineer - Agentic AI & Automation, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered autonomous agents that transform software testing and quality engineering processes. You will leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI frameworks, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to build intelligent testing solutions capable of test generation, execution orchestration, defect analysis, root-cause identification, and self-healing automation. 

The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in AI/ML and Agentic AI engineering with a solid foundation in test automation technologies such as Playwright, RestAssured, SoapUI, and Python. You will work closely with QA, Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams to drive next-generation AI-enabled quality engineering initiatives. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and deploy AI agents and multi-agent systems to automate and optimize software testing lifecycles. 
 - Build intelligent solutions using LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI frameworks, and orchestration platforms to enhance quality engineering outcomes. 
 - Develop and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources. 
 - Create AI-powered agents capable of: 
 - Automated test case generation
 - Test script creation and maintenance
 - Intelligent test execution orchestration
 - Defect triage and root-cause analysis
 - Self-healing test automation
 - Test data generation and validation
 - Integrate LLM-based capabilities with existing automation frameworks using Playwright, RestAssured, SoapUI, and Python.

 - Collaborate with QA, Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams to identify opportunities for AI-driven productivity and quality improvements. 
 - Ensure responsible AI practices including model evaluation, guardrails, observability, security, and governance. 
 - Evaluate and implement emerging AI technologies, frameworks, models, and tools to continuously enhance testing effectiveness. 
 - Monitor agent performance, prompt quality, retrieval accuracy, and testing outcomes to drive continuous improvement.

 - Contribute to AI strategy, architecture decisions, and innovation initiatives across the Quality Engineering organization. 
 - Communicate technical solutions and outcomes effectively to business and technical stakeholders. 
Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, or AI-powered automation solutions.

 - Strong understanding of:

 - Hands-on experience with AI frameworks such as:

 - LlamaIndex
 - CrewAI
 - AutoGen
 - Semantic Kernel
 - Strong programming expertise in Python. 
 - Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AI services such as Vertex AI and related GenAI offerings. 
 - Practical experience with automation testing tools including:

 - SoapUI
 - Selenium (preferred)

 - Experience integrating AI solutions with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps toolchains. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and system design skills. 
Preferred Qualifications

 - Knowledge of MLOps, AI observability, and model monitoring practices. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native architectures, microservices, and containerized deployments.

data.description: Forward Deployment Engineer - Expert - 5G/6G/NTN Responsibilities The Expert Forward Deployment Engineer works inside a customer's development program as software developer, systems engineer, and deployment lead in one role, and ships production code. This person reduces broad concepts and business strategies into structured deployment projects, acts as the key technical lead and go-to person for Department or Senior Management on the most complex, high-impact engagements, diagnoses problems deep within the protocol stack (Layer 1 to Layer 3), modifies software, validates fixes, and delivers controlled releases during a customer's early development, integration, and regression cycles. This is a customer-facing software engineering role where you will embed directly within a customer environment to customize, integrate, and deploy technology into real-world production systems, solving complex, high-impact problems. Core responsibilities • Reduce broad account concepts and business strategies into structured, multi-workstream deployment projects • Act as the key technical lead and go-to person for Department or Senior Management on the most complex or highest-impact deployment engagements • Architect and own solutions to problems that require a unique or highly specialized skill set • Work onsite or closely with wireless customer development teams during major feature introductions • Analyze signaling flows, traces, timing behavior, and performance data to isolate failures across Keysight and customer implementations • Write and modify application and protocol-stack software, plus the supporting software and firmware the customer environment requires • Develop and extend Python APIs that customer teams integrate against • Build automation workflows inside the customer's workflows • Create diagnostic instrumentation when existing tools are insufficient • Develop, validate, and deploy controlled patches, feature flags, and interim releases under Keysight's release process • Run rapid prototyping loops directly with customers to test and iterate on new features based on live feedback • Act as a feedback loop to the core product and engineering teams, translating field problems into engineering requirements and defects for product management and R&D • Incorporate broadly applicable field-developed improvements into the core product • Mentor lower-level engineers and help develop the broader forward deployment engineering team Qualifications Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) and 8+ years of relevant software/systems engineering experience. Post-graduate study and/or relevant certification/license may be required. • Strong software-development experience across multiple software stacks • Preferred expertise in at least one domain (PHY/L1, MAC/RLC/PDCP and L2, or RRC/NAS and L3), plus working knowledge of adjacent layers and end-to-end 4G, 5G, and 5G-Advanced system behavior • Proficiency in C/C++ and Python (including API development), Linux, embedded or real-time software, and automated testing • Experience debugging protocol interactions through logs, traces, packet captures, call flows, and timing analysis • Familiarity with 3GPP specifications and the practical differences among standards compliance, interoperability, and implementation behavior • Experience in design and test instrumentation and test emulation tools • Ability to produce production-quality code that ships in a customer's build • The judgment and customer presence to operate inside confidential development programs • Excellent communication skills; able to explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders • Willingness to relocate or travel to a specific customer site as required by the assignment • Specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise across multiple protocol layers, software stacks, and deployment domains • Demonstrated technical leadership: ability to design solutions to unusually complex problems and set direction for other engineers Travel Requirement: Up to 50% travel to local client sites. Occasional international travel may also be required.

In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embedding sustainability even deeper across our operations. 

KDT unit within KTI is responsible for developing Digital Services products such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Residential Flow and Partnership Ecosystem

Role purpose

We are seeking a Lead Architect to define and govern the end-to-end architecture of our global industrial IoT and digital platform ecosystem. 

The role connects physical equipment, gateway runtimes, device connectivity, cloud platforms, digital applications, enterprise identity, and AI-enabled capabilities into a coherent, evolvable architecture. 

The architect will establish architecture-first delivery practices in which business capabilities, quality attributes, system boundaries, contracts, security requirements, and operational models are defined before implementation. 

You will translate complex technical decisions into clear recommendations for engineering and business stakeholders, connecting choices to customer value, cost, risk, reliability, delivery timelines, and operational readiness. 

What You Will Do

- Own target architectures, system boundaries, contracts, quality requirements, and technical roadmaps. Document alternatives, assumptions, failure modes, and trade-offs before implementation. 
 - Design multi-region routing, tenant and workload isolation, data placement, replication, failover and failback. Define RTO, RPO, availability objectives, and recovery validation for each workload. 
 - Enable repeatable regional expansion through reusable infrastructure, automated onboarding, configuration-driven deployment, and application designs that avoid regional forks. 
 - Govern industrial edge connectivity, device provisioning, certificate lifecycle, offline behavior, secure OTA updates, and command handling with embedded and safety specialists. 
 - Architect cloud services, APIs, real-time integrations, messaging, and data platforms with explicit ownership, compatibility, tenant isolation, and failure behavior. 
 - Embed security, observability, capacity planning, cost management, upgrade paths, and operational readiness into every architecture. 
 - Establish practical architecture standards, ADRs, reusable platform capabilities, repository boundaries, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery checks. 
 - Communicate through clear diagrams, business-focused narratives, and decision options. Lead cross-team reviews, mentor engineers, and build trust with stakeholders. 
 - Evaluate AI-assisted engineering and AI-enabled applications with specialist teams, considering business value, privacy, permissions, security, limitations, evaluation, and human oversight. 

PKI, device identity, and cryptographic architecture

Architecture focus: PKI is a foundational device trust system, not merely a subtopic within general identity and security. The role must govern identity from factory provisioning through operational use, renewal, revocation, retirement, and long-lived hardware replacement. 

- Define hardware-backed device identity using IEEE 802. 1AR concepts, including factory identity and operational identity, with TPM 2. 0 or secure-element roots of trust. 
 - Design zero-touch enrollment and renewal using appropriate protocols such as EST, SCEP, or CMPv2, with explicit bootstrap, recovery, renewal, revocation, and offline behavior. 
 - Author X. 509 certificate profiles aligned with RFC 5280, including subject naming, SAN conventions, EKU constraints, key usage, validity periods, policy OIDs, CRL distribution points, and validation rules. 
 - Design CA hierarchies, trust domains, signing boundaries, key ceremonies, offline root protection, intermediate CA operations, HSM integration, and delegated issuance. 
 - Govern certificate rotation at fleet scale, including clock drift, intermittent connectivity, dual-certificate overlap, compromised-device recovery, factory reset, ownership transfer, and end-of-life handling. 
 - Define cryptographic agility and long-term migration strategies for algorithm changes, including assessment of post-quantum standards such as ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA where appropriate. 

Standards, RFCs, and normative specifications

Establish a reference architecture and standards catalogue that distinguishes mandatory requirements from recommendations. Use RFC 2119 and RFC 8174 terminology consistently when writing normative specifications. 

- Use MUST and MUST NOT for binding requirements; use SHOULD and SHOULD NOT for strong recommendations with documented exceptions; use MAY for permitted options. 
 - Maintain versioned specifications for identity, certificate profiles, TLS, MQTT topics, API contracts, event schemas, command semantics, error handling, and regional deployment. 
 - Reference applicable standards such as RFC 5280 for X. 509 certificates, RFC 7030 for EST, RFC 8446 for TLS 1. 3, RFC 6455 for WebSockets, OAuth 2. 0 and OpenID Connect specifications, OpenAPI, and the OASIS MQTT specification. 
 - Use ADRs to record context, decision, alternatives, consequences, security impact, operational impact, and conditions for revisiting the decision. 
 - Keep C4, deployment, sequence, threat, and data-flow models versioned with the systems they describe. 

Required Experience

- 14+ years in software engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or systems architecture, including 6+ years leading architecture for complex enterprise, industrial, or mission-critical systems. 
 - Proven production delivery and operational experience with multi-region systems, disaster recovery, incident response, and recovery validation. 
 - Strong system design judgment and hands-on ability to validate decisions through prototypes, code reviews, performance testing, load testing, and operational evidence. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence multiple teams and explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, leadership, and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience creating standards and governance that enable delivery rather than introducing unnecessary process. 

Preferred Experience

- Industrial equipment, fleet management, OT cybersecurity, predictive maintenance, digital twins, or large-scale multi-tenant platforms. 
 - Platform engineering, technology modernization, and practical exposure to AI-assisted development or enterprise AI integration. 
 - Experience with long-lived devices, constrained connectivity, safety-related command paths, and supplier or partner integration. 

Certifications

Certifications are desirable but not mandatory. They do not replace demonstrated system design expertise and production experience. 

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional or AWS Certified Security - Specialty. 
 - Certified Kubernetes Administrator or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist. 
 - TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture qualification. 
 - Relevant Microsoft identity, security, industrial cybersecurity, or cryptography certifications. 

What Success Looks Like

- Architecture decisions are clear, trusted, documented, and adopted by delivery teams. 
 - Multi-region applications meet agreed availability, RTO, and RPO objectives, with recovery regularly tested. 
 - Device identity and PKI operations are automated, observable, recoverable, and secure throughout the asset lifecycle. 
 - Platforms remain secure, operable, and maintainable as devices, tenants, integrations, and capabilities grow. 
 - Normative standards and reusable platform capabilities reduce duplication, incompatible changes, and operational toil. 
 - AI experimentation is practical, governed, privacy-aware, and separated from unsafe or unverified control of physical equipment.

Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.

Our approach covers a comprehensive total rewards package, including both financial and non-financial benefits. We are committed to fostering a culture of fairness, respect, equity, diversity, and inclusion.
