Job Summary: The Tech Lead Application Development role is responsible for the architecture, development and sustained health of mission-critical applications in the Payments and Billing domain. The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership: owning system design, setting engineering standards, and leading a team to deliver resilient, secure and observable cloud-native microservices built on event streaming. The person must have a proven track record of owning and leading critical applications at scale, modernizing legacy platforms, and delivering agentic AI solutions that automate business workflows. The successful candidate will be an expert in Java, Spring Boot and cloud technologies, will influence senior stakeholders, and will raise the engineering bar of the team through mentoring and example. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end design, development and maintenance of mission-critical Payments and Billing applications, owning the architecture, technical roadmap and delivery outcomes. 
 - Architect and deliver production-grade, cloud-native microservices platforms with event streaming and robust NFRs, and set the reference patterns the wider organization follows. 
 - Own the event-driven architecture on Kafka: topic and schema strategy, partitioning, ordering, idempotency and delivery guarantees, retry and dead-letter handling, replay, and multi-region resiliency. 
 - Own NFRs end to end (performance, scalability, resiliency, availability, security, observability and reliability): define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets, and validate them through load, chaos and failover testing. 
 - Drive resiliency engineering with circuit breaker, retry, bulkhead, rate limiting, timeouts, graceful degradation and disaster recovery design (for example, Resilience4j). 
 - Establish observability standards (metrics, logs and distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, dashboards, alerting and runbooks) and lead incident response and root cause analysis for critical production issues. 
 - Embed security by design: OAuth2/JWT, secrets management, threat modelling and vulnerability scanning (SonarQube, Veracode) built into the CI/CD pipeline. 
 - Partner with business, product and architecture stakeholders to define requirements, shape solutions and influence the technology roadmap. 
 - Lead and mentor a team of engineers; own design and code review quality, set engineering standards and drive best practices. 
 - Lead the design and delivery of agentic AI applications: LLM-powered agents with tool/function calling, MCP, multi-agent orchestration, RAG grounding, guardrails, evaluation and human-in-the-loop controls, integrated with event-driven microservices to automate Payments and Billing workflows. 
 - Drive CI/CD and DevSecOps maturity, and lead legacy-to-cloud-native modernization using AI-assisted engineering (for example, GitHub Copilot agent mode) to improve team productivity and quality. 

Qualification

- Preferred bachelor's degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, Applied Science, Electrical Engineering, or Math; Developer nanodegree; or equivalent experience. 
 - Typically requires 12+ years of experience in software development. 
 - Proficiency in Java, Spring boot (Rest, Security), Spring Integration, Kafka, Kubernetes, Oracle Server. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering event-driven microservices in production, with measurable NFR outcomes (for example, latency, availability and throughput targets met). 
 - Should be able to rewrite the legacy applications into modern Cloud Native Microservices applications independently

Experience

- 12+ years of experience in developing cloud-native microservices applications using Java/Spring Boot. 
 - Strong communication skills and fluency in English. 
 - Experience in collaborative, team-oriented environments. 
 - Solid hands-on technical experience in Java, spring boot, and cloud deployment. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Github Actions, Postman and Jenkins. 
 - Experience building Kafka-based event streaming solutions and implementing NFRs (performance, resiliency, scalability, security and observability) in production microservices. 
 - Proven experience taking agentic/GenAI applications to production), including evaluation of agent quality, LLM observability (tracing, token cost, latency) and responsible-AI guardrails; uses AI coding agents such as GitHub Copilot agent mode in day-to-day engineering. 

Core Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Flexibility to support critical releases and production issues, and ability to work independently to drive issues to closure. 
 - Effective handling of multiple and complex work assignments, consistently delivering high-quality work. 
 - Perform application analysis and propose technical solutions for enhancements.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

The Experience

We are seeking a lead full stack engineer with enterprise software engineering experience to drive the architecture, technical roadmap, and execution for our next-generation Security Assurance Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform. In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform's core engines-including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules. 

Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. You will also pioneer the team's operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Architecture & System Design: Architect resilient, cloud-native microservice architectures that process large-scale compliance telemetry, support automated evidence ingestion, and execute low-latency risk evaluation engines. 
 - Roadmap & Project Planning: Partner with Product Management, Security Architects, and GRC leaders to translate broad business and regulatory strategies into detailed technical roadmaps, milestones, and sprint backlogs. 
 - Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org. 
 - Policy & Governance as Code: Design and implement extensible Policy as Code and Compliance as Code engines (e. g. , leveraging Open Policy Agent/OPA or custom evaluation frameworks) and runtime platforms (e. g. CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules. 
 - Automated Evidence Collection: Lead the design of automated evidence collection pipelines integrating with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers, enterprise security tools, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and productivity / corporate applications (Workday, Netsuite, etc). 
 - Risk & Regulatory Modeling: Build dynamic risk analysis engines and auditing interfaces capable of mapping continuous technical evidence against major regulatory standards (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2). 
 - AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption and integration of AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, Gemini, OpenAI APIs) across the engineering lifecycle to optimize team productivity, automate test generation, and streamline refactoring. 
 - Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 - Lead cross-functional alignment and technical discussions across a geographically dispersed team operating in an asynchronous-first culture. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- Experience: 9+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, including 3+ years at the Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) or Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) level leading technical projects and distributed engineering teams. 
 - Project Ownership Track Record: Proven experience taking complex SaaS platforms or enterprise software projects from architectural inception to production delivery. 
 - Strategic Execution: Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous business requirements into high-level architecture designs, concrete technical epics, and actionable execution plans. 
 - Systems Engineering: Deep mastery of both Python and Java, including enterprise frameworks (e. g. , FastAPI, Django, Flask, Spring Boot) and microservices design patterns. 
 - Front-End Architecture: Advanced proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular), with experience designing scalable component libraries and complex data visualization dashboards. 
 - AI Tooling & Innovation: Advanced proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery, paired with a strategic vision for integrating AI into technical workflows. 
 - Data & Cloud Systems: Strong expertise in relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL/graph databases, distributed data processing, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Regulatory Frameworks: Working knowledge of regulatory standards including NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria). 
 - Compliance Engineering: Direct experience building or architecting systems around continuous control monitoring, automated audit trails, or policy engine evaluation (e. g. , OPA/Rego). 

Even Better If. . . 

- Prior experience architecting commercial GRC tools, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), or Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) systems. 
 - Practical experience implementing Open Policy Agent (OPA) or similar policy-as-code domain tools at scale. 
 - Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or Cloud Security Specialties. 
 - Experience with Salesforce platform including Lightning Web Components, Apex, and SOQL

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. What We're Looking For. . .

data.title: Senior Manager, IPQA
data.description:
Key Responsibilities

JOB DESCRIPTION

- To lead and oversee day-to-day IPQA activities across manufacturing and support operations for sterile/injectable products. 
 - To provide effective QA oversight on shop-floor activities including dispensing, solution preparation/compounding, filtration, aseptic filling, sealing, visual inspection, labelling, packing and other manufacturing operations, as applicable. 
 - To ensure manufacturing operations are performed in compliance with approved SOPs, BMR/BPR, specifications, validated procedures, regulatory requirements and cGMP standards. 
 - To ensure effective implementation of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Documentation Practices (GDP), Data Integrity and ALCOA+ principles across manufacturing operations. 
 - To provide QA oversight for line clearance activities before commencement of manufacturing, filling, packing and other GMP operations. 
 - To verify and ensure appropriate area, equipment and material status identification and compliance with approved procedures. 
 - To review and approve/verify Batch Manufacturing Records, Batch Packing Records, logbooks, checklists, equipment records and other GMP documents within defined responsibilities. 
 - To monitor and ensure compliance with in-process controls (IPCs) and critical process parameters during manufacturing operations. 
 - To provide QA oversight during aseptic filling and critical manufacturing operations and ensure compliance with approved procedures and validated process parameters with contamination control requirements. 
 - To coordinate with EM/ Microbiology for appropriate monitoring and review of environmental monitoring, personnel monitoring, microbial monitoring and other microbiological controls, as applicable. 
 - To ensure compliance with the site's Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) and identify potential contamination risks during manufacturing operations. 
 - To monitor personnel gowning, hygiene, aseptic practices and behavioral compliance in classified areas and initiate appropriate actions for observed deficiencies. 
 - To conduct routine shop-floor GMP inspections, IPQA rounds and compliance audits and ensure timely closure of identified observations. 
 - To initiate/review/coordinate Deviation, Incident, OOS/OOT, CAPA and other quality investigations arising from manufacturing and IPQA activities, as applicable. 
 - To ensure investigations are scientifically sound, adequately documented, supported by appropriate evidence and completed within defined timelines for root cause analysis, impact assessment, risk assessment and CAPA determination. 
 - To monitor implementation and effectiveness of CAPAs related to manufacturing and IPQA observations. 
 - To provide QA oversight for Change Controls related to manufacturing processes, equipment, facilities, utilities, materials, procedures and other GMP-impacting changes. 
 - To review and provide QA input on risk assessments, process-related risks and quality-impacting changes. 
 - To ensure appropriate QA involvement in process validation, cleaning validation, media fills/aseptic process simulations, equipment qualification and other validation activities, as applicable. 
 - To provide QA oversight during Media Fill / Aseptic Process Simulation (APS) activities and ensure compliance with approved protocols and procedures. 
 - To ensure appropriate QA review of process simulation interventions, personnel practices, environmental conditions, support and provide QA oversight during equipment qualification, process validation and validation-related manufacturing activities. 
 - To review and evaluate manufacturing trends, recurring deviations, process observations and other quality indicators and recommend appropriate improvement actions. 
 - To monitor IPQA quality metrics and KPIs, including deviations, documentation errors, line clearance observations, GMP observations, CAPA status and other relevant parameters. 
 - To identify critical, recurring and overdue quality issues and ensure appropriate escalation to site management. 
 - To participate in internal audits, customer audits and regulatory inspections and provide support for IPQA/manufacturing-related areas. 
 - To coordinate preparation of manufacturing/IPQA documentation and evidence required for USFDA, EMA, MHRA, WHO and applicable Indian regulatory authority inspections. 
 - To support preparation, review and implementation of responses to audit and inspection observations related to manufacturing and IPQA. 
 - To ensure effective implementation and sustainability of CAPAs arising from regulatory inspections, customer audits and internal audits. 
 - To ensure appropriate training and qualification of IPQA personnel on GMP, SOPs, aseptic practices, GDP, Data Integrity and other applicable quality requirements. 
 - To mentor, guide and develop IPQA team members and promote a strong quality and compliance culture. 
 - To review IPQA observations and ensure effective communication and follow-up with Production and other concerned departments. 
 - To coordinate with Production, QC, Microbiology, Engineering, Validation, Warehouse, Regulatory Affairs and other functions for timely resolution of quality and manufacturing issues. 

Qualifications

- M. Sc. / B. Pharm/ M. Pharm with minimum 16-18 years of relevant experience. 
 - Strong experience in IPQA/ shop-floor QA operations in injectable manufacturing site. Experience in sterile/injectable/aseptic manufacturing is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of cGMP, GDP, Data Integrity, ALCOA+ and Pharmaceutical Quality Systems. 
 - Hands-on experience in QA oversight of dispensing, compounding, filling, packing, line clearance and in-process activities. 
 - Sound knowledge of aseptic processing, contamination control and sterile manufacturing practices. 
 - Experience in reviewing BMR/BPR, logbooks, batch documentation and manufacturing records. 
 - Experience in handling Deviation, CAPA, Change Control, OOS/OOT, Incident and Quality Risk Management activities. 
 - Experience in Media Fill/APS, process validation, cleaning validation and equipment qualification will be preferred. 
 - Good understanding of Environmental Monitoring and microbiological controls in sterile manufacturing environments. 
 - Experience in handling internal audits, customer audits and regulatory inspection readiness.

data.description:
About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate large-scale batch and streaming data pipelines using Spark, Java, and Python, processing data at Walmart scale. 
 - Apply strong software engineering fundamentals - clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, code review discipline - to data engineering work; this is a software engineering role that specializes in data, not a script-writing role. 
 - Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous data and platform problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term durability before writing a line of code. 
 - Flex into platform/software engineering work when needed: build and maintain services, APIs, and distributed systems that data pipelines depend on, contributing directly to GDF's broader platform codebase. 
 - Integrate AI, GenAI, and agentic capabilities directly into the data platform: embeddings/vector search for data discovery, LLM-assisted data quality and anomaly detection, agentic pipeline monitoring and self-healing, AI-assisted schema and lineage documentation. 
 - Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to build feature pipelines, model-serving data paths, and the data infrastructure that MLOps depends on. 
 - Own data quality, observability, and governance for the pipelines and datasets you build, with a strong Operational Excellence / Engineering Excellence discipline. 
 - Participate in and lead architecture and design reviews spanning both data engineering and platform engineering domains. 
 - As a Principal engineer, set technical direction and best practices across multiple teams and the broader GDF platform without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDF's broader data engineering standards. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging Big Data, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience with significant hands-on data engineering at scale; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required, and strong working knowledge of Spark for distributed data processing is required, not optional. Additional experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 
 - Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not bolted on afterward. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Deep experience with the Big Data ecosystem - Spark, Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, Kafka, workflow orchestration (Airflow or equivalent) - including batch and streaming processing, and large-scale data transformation. 
 - Strong data platform fundamentals: data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, data quality and observability, data governance, and integration with lakehouse architectures (e. g. , Delta Lake, BigQuery, Databricks). 
 - Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices (feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 
 - Working literacy in platform engineering: microservices, API design, Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration, CI/CD, and cloud-native practices - enough to flex into platform/software engineering work confidently. 
 - Strong distributed systems fundamentals: event-driven patterns, service contracts, asynchronous processing, and fault tolerance at scale - paired with strong system design, domain-oriented design (DDD), and low-level design (LLD) skills, and demonstrated ability to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost when owning production code. 
 - Strong software engineering craftsmanship: testing strategy, code review standards, design patterns, and system design for high-throughput data systems. 
 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous data/business problems into clear technical execution plans, particularly across a newly formed platform organization without fully established process. 
 - Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with high autonomy in a 0-to-1 environment. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts, and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits - maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn, and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is - and feels - included, everyone wins. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being inclusive of all people.

Option 2: 7 years' experience in software engineering or related area.

Master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 3 years' experience in software engineering or related area. , We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. 2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. Senior AI Lead - CYURAE

Location: Gurugram · Work arrangement: On-site · Employment: Permanent

Experience required: 5+ years of professional experience in software or AI/ML engineering, including 3+ years in applied AI/ML and 2+ years leading AI engineers through technical leadership or engineering management. These periods may overlap. 

CYURAE is looking for a Senior AI Lead who combines strong artificial intelligence expertise with the ability to lead engineers and deliver production-ready software. 

You will be accountable for the technical quality, execution, and operational readiness of AI development. You will lead AI engineers, remain involved in important technical decisions, and coordinate with backend, frontend/mobile, QA, and infrastructure teams to deliver complete, reliable releases. 

We are looking for someone with direct experience delivering recommendation systems and virtual try-on solutions to real users. You should be able to explain your individual contribution, the engineering decisions you made, how you evaluated the results, and how you handled problems after deployment. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Leading AI engineering. Translate business objectives into practical technical approaches. Guide model selection, experimentation, implementation, and integration, balancing quality, development effort, maintainability, and operating cost. 

- Managing the AI team. Break work into clear assignments, establish ownership, review progress, and resolve technical blockers. Mentor engineers, provide constructive feedback, and maintain consistent standards for code, evaluation, testing, and documentation. 

- Planning and managing delivery. Prepare realistic estimates, sequence work, identify dependencies, and agree acceptance criteria. Maintain visibility of commitments, raise risks early, and recommend adjustments when requirements, capacity, or feasibility change. 

- Coordinating the wider engineering team. Work closely with backend, frontend/mobile, QA, and DevOps owners. Clarify interfaces and integration requirements, resolve shared blockers, and ensure individual components work correctly together. 

- Providing hands-on technical leadership. Review architecture and code, investigate difficult failures, and contribute to critical implementation work where needed. Help engineers make decisions they can explain and validate. 

- Establishing meaningful evaluation. Define baselines and suitable measures before promoting changes. Review model quality, data quality, failure cases, and performance across relevant conditions. Ensure reported improvements are supported by reproducible evidence. 

- Managing production readiness. Coordinate integration testing, deployment preparation, monitoring, recovery arrangements, and support ownership. Ensure limitations and failure-handling behavior are understood before release. 

- Improving reliability and efficiency. Work with backend and infrastructure engineers to investigate production issues, manage resource requirements, and improve latency, stability, and cost. Follow incidents through to corrective action. 

- Communicating decisions and progress. Give product and engineering leadership a clear view of delivery status, unresolved decisions, technical risks, and proposed next steps. 

You should bring the following experience: 

- Recommendation systems: Hands-on delivery experience covering data preparation, candidate retrieval, ranking, personalization, cold-start handling, and feedback. Be able to explain how you measured relevance and improved the system after observing real users. 

- Virtual try-on and computer vision: Direct experience building, adapting, or integrating a solution used by real users. Understand input processing, output-quality evaluation, supported conditions, common failures, and the tradeoffs between quality, latency, and cost. 

- Applied machine learning: Strong Python skills and practical experience with embeddings, model training or adaptation, experimentation, and evaluation. Be comfortable investigating poor data, leakage, and misleading metrics. 

- Backend architecture: A solid understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, caching, asynchronous processing, retries, and service contracts. Be able to reason about reliable integration between AI services and applications. 

- AWS and MLOps: Practical experience deploying or operating AI workloads, including model serving, versioning, deployment pipelines, monitoring, scaling, and recovery. Understand CPU/GPU requirements and infrastructure cost drivers. 

- Technical leadership: Experience leading AI engineers, reviewing their work, mentoring team members, and taking responsibility for delivery. Bring concrete examples of resolving technical disagreements, integration failures, or missed commitments. 

- Engineering judgment: A practical approach to testing, maintainability, data privacy, access controls, and commercial-use rights for models and datasets. 

Experience managing the complete engineering team is a strong advantage. 

We particularly value candidates who have directly managed delivery across AI, backend, and frontend/mobile teams. This includes coordinating parallel work, resolving competing priorities, guiding releases, and organizing improvements after launch. 

Success in this role means the team has clear priorities and ownership, technical decisions are documented, integration dependencies are addressed early, and releases are supported by relevant evaluation and testing. Quality, reliability, latency, and operating cost should be understood and measured, with improvements tied to observed results. 

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV or Send Email on nitin@cyurae. com with a brief delivery summary covering: 

- The number of distinct products you helped launch and substantial projects you led. 

- One recommendation-system delivery and one virtual try-on delivery. 

- Your personal technical contribution and measurable outcomes. 

- The size and functions of the teams you led or directly managed. 

Please distinguish prototypes and internal pilots from systems used by real users. Anonymized case studies are welcome where previous work is confidential.

Agivant Technologies is a fast-paced, AI-first IT services company helping clients design, build, and scale autonomous solutions by combining deep engineering expertise with modern AI, cloud, and data capabilities. We move quickly, wear multiple hats, and expect our leaders to be builders first.

We are looking for a hands-on, technically strong Engineering Director to lead our engineering organization from Pune. This is not a pure people-management or project-management role-we want a builder and solutioner who stays close to the technology, architects and troubleshoots alongside the team, and brings real, practical experience with AI systems. 

You will lead a high-performing team, drive delivery excellence across client engagements, and act as a trusted technical voice for clients in a startup environment where priorities shift quickly and hands-on ownership matters more than process for its own sake. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Solutioning

- Personally architect, review, and troubleshoot complex solutions alongside the team rather than delegating every technical decision. 
 - Apply AI systems (LLM, agentic, and ML-based approaches) to client solutions and internal productivity.

 - Drive adoption of efficient engineering practices such as Agile and DevOps. 
 - Deliver measurable productivity gains through AI-led tooling and ways of working. 
 - Improve gross margin through efficient delivery, smart resourcing, and process discipline. Client & Stakeholder Engagement

- Serve as a trusted technical voice for clients by providing regular updates and managing expectations. 
 - Translate client business objectives into technical roadmaps and hands-on solution designs. 
 - Proactively identify opportunities to add value through AI-driven and autonomous solutions, new technologies, or process improvements. 
 - Treat revenue and account growth as a core part of client engagement alongside technical delivery. 

Requirements

Must-Have Requirements

- Experience: 10 to 15 years overall, including proven hands-on technical experience as an Engineering Manager or Director. 
 - Technical Depth: Strong track record of architecting, building, and troubleshooting complex systems. 
 - AI Experience: Hands-on experience taking AI into production (e. g. , LLM or agentic solutions, ML pipelines, or applied AI) beyond high-level awareness.

 - BFSI Domain: Strong background in banking, financial services, or insurance, including knowledge of regulatory, security, and compliance requirements. 
 - Location: Based in Pune, or willing to relocate and join within a defined notice period. 
 - Education: B. Tech or B. E. in any engineering stream. Core Competencies

- Ability to architect, code, and troubleshoot complex systems. 
 - Solid grounding in distributed systems, product engineering, or advanced data analytics. 
 - Strong grasp of Agile, DevOps, QA discipline, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Operational and delivery rigor with a disciplined focus on quality, timelines, and gross margin. 
 - Commercial acumen around revenue, margin, and account growth levers. 
 - Strong client-facing communication, stakeholder management, and comfort with ambiguity in fast-changing environments. 

Who Will Thrive Here

You will thrive here if you are a hands-on engineering leader with deep technical and AI experience who has led large teams, enjoys building, and feels most energized close to the architecture, code, and client

AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. 

As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. 

General Description Of Role

About the Role

As a DevOps Engineer within the Assessment Solutions business, you will own the delivery infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and platform operations that keep the Aon Assessment Platform running reliably at scale. The Aon Assessment Platform is the enterprise solution for accurate and fair workforce assessments used by millions of participants worldwide - the infrastructure you build and maintain is what makes that scale possible. 

You will work across multiple engineering squads (Germany and India), ensuring that every team has fast, reliable, and secure delivery pipelines, and that the platform's cloud infrastructure is observable, cost-efficient, and resilient. You are a hands-on practitioner: writing Terraform, maintaining Kubernetes configurations, building pipeline templates, and driving the automation that reduces toil and increases engineering throughput. 

Above all, this role requires strong systems thinking. Our platform is deeply interconnected, and infrastructure decisions have wide downstream effects on reliability, security, and delivery speed. You must be able to reason about those effects and design infrastructure that the whole engineering group can depend on. 

Key Responsibilities

CI/CD Pipeline Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps that serve multiple engineering squads building on different release cadences. 
 - Own pipeline templates and shared workflow components - ensuring consistent, reusable patterns across squads rather than per-team divergence. 
 - Integrate automated testing (unit, integration, API spec validation) into pipelines so quality gates run at the right point in every delivery workflow. 
 - Maintain and improve build performance - reducing pipeline duration and queue times to keep squad delivery velocity high. 
 - Enforce API governance in delivery: pipelines validate implementations against OpenAPI specifications before merge and deployment. 

Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes

- Own the platform's Azure infrastructure: AKS clusters, networking, storage, identity, and supporting services - defined and managed as code using Terraform. 
 - Manage Kubernetes workloads across environments (development, staging, production): deployments, resource allocation, autoscaling, and health management. 
 - Design and maintain environment promotion workflows that give squads reliable, consistent progression from development through to production. 
 - Implement and maintain infrastructure security controls: network policies, managed identities, secret management (Azure Key Vault), and RBAC. 
 - Monitor infrastructure costs and drive efficiency improvements - right-sizing resources, identifying waste, and contributing to cloud spend targets. 

Observability & Reliability

- Build and maintain observability tooling across the platform: metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or equivalent). 
 - Define and implement SLI/SLO frameworks in collaboration with Engineering Team Leads and Solution Architects, ensuring the platform can demonstrate reliability against defined targets. 
 - Own incident response for infrastructure-layer events: diagnosing, communicating, and resolving outages with clear post-incident reviews and preventive actions. 
 - Drive reliability improvements - identifying single points of failure, improving resilience patterns, and reducing mean time to recovery. 

Engineering Enablement & Standards

- Work closely with Solution Architects and Engineering Team Leads to ensure application architecture is deployable, observable, and operable - raising infrastructure requirements early in the design process, not after delivery. 
 - Define and maintain infrastructure-as-code standards: Terraform module structure, naming conventions, state management, and code review practices. 
 - Build internal documentation and runbooks that give squads and support teams the operational knowledge they need to work independently. 
 - Evaluate and introduce tooling improvements that raise engineering throughput and platform quality - with a pragmatic eye for adoption, not novelty. 

AI-Augmented Engineering

- Use AI tools in your day-to-day work - for infrastructure design, pipeline authoring, incident investigation, and documentation - and apply them effectively and responsibly. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have. 
 - Identify where AI-assisted tooling can reduce toil, accelerate root cause analysis, and improve infrastructure quality. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 4-6 years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering experience on a large-scale SaaS or enterprise platform. 
 - Strong, production-proven experience with Azure: AKS, Azure DevOps, Azure Container Registry, Azure Key Vault, networking, and managed identities. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code: module design, state management, and code review practices at team scale. 
 - Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps across multiple squads or products. 
 - Solid Kubernetes expertise: workload management, autoscaling, networking, and operational troubleshooting. 
 - Strong understanding of infrastructure security: network policies, RBAC, secret management, and least-privilege access design. 
 - Experience with observability tooling and a practical understanding of SLI/SLO/SLA frameworks. 
 - Excellent analytical and systems thinking - able to reason about the downstream infrastructure impact of application architecture decisions. 
 - Strong communication skills: able to explain infrastructure constraints and tradeoffs clearly to engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Day-to-day use of AI tools in infrastructure and engineering work. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with messaging and mediation frameworks relevant to the platform (e. g. , Wolverine, Azure Service Bus). 
 - Familiarity with API governance tooling - integrating OpenAPI spec validation into pipelines. 
 - Experience with contract testing or consumer-driven contract frameworks in a microservices context. 
 - Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost optimisation at meaningful scale. 
 - Experience supporting globally distributed engineering teams working across multiple time zones. 
 - Familiarity with . NET / ASP. NET Core application deployment patterns at the infrastructure level.

Join Vultr

Vultr is building its first Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) in Chennai as a 24×7 hub for physical security monitoring and incident response across its global facilities. 

We are looking for a GSOC Shift Lead to lead the floor during an assigned shift, oversee Junior and Senior GSOC Analysts, own critical escalations, manage shift performance, and serve as a key point of contact for US counterparts and cross-functional stakeholders. 

Role Overview

The GSOC Shift Lead has end-to-end operational ownership of the assigned shift, including monitoring, incident response, escalation, team performance, and shift handover. The role provides leadership during complex security and emergency events, coordinates cross-functional response, coaches GSOC analysts, and drives adherence to procedures and operational standards. 

The Shift Lead also serves as a key connection between the Chennai GSOC and global stakeholders, particularly US-based teams, providing regular reporting, KPI visibility, operational updates, and continuous improvement recommendations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the shift end-to-end, including real-time monitoring, alert triage, incident response, escalation, team coordination, and shift handover, with accountability for operational performance. 
 - Oversee monitoring of CCTV/VMS, access control, intrusion detection, alarms, perimeter security, visitor management, and life-safety systems across global facilities. 
 - Maintain real-time situational awareness of active incidents and operational impacts and direct the team's response based on severity and risk. 
 - Serve as the primary escalation point on shift for Sev-0/Sev-1 and other incidents beyond Senior or Junior GSOC Analyst authority. 
 - Lead and coordinate response to critical security and emergency events, including unauthorized access, forced entry, security breaches, tampering, workplace violence, fire/life-safety events, perimeter breaches, and other emergencies. 
 - Coordinate response and escalation across Global Security, Data Center Operations, Facilities, GIOC/NOC/SOC, IT Operations, PeopleOps/Legal, security vendors, and emergency services as required. 
 - Make timely, well-informed response decisions during high-pressure situations and ensure decisions and actions are accurately documented. 
 - Lead, coach, and develop Junior and Senior GSOC Analysts, providing real-time guidance, feedback, and support on monitoring, incident handling, escalation, and documentation. 
 - Support onboarding, training, shadowing, readiness assessments, and ongoing development of GSOC analysts. 
 - Maintain a strong shift culture focused on accountability, operational discipline, attention to detail, and calm decision-making. 
 - Serve as a key point of contact between the Chennai GSOC and global/US security stakeholders, maintaining regular communication and coordinating operational priorities across time zones. 
 - Prepare and deliver weekly and monthly operational reports and dashboards, covering incidents, response performance, escalations, system issues, and key GSOC metrics. 
 - Own and track shift-level KPIs, including response and escalation times, SLA adherence, documentation quality, false-alarm trends, and operational performance. 
 - Identify recurring incidents, false-alarm patterns, system issues, and process gaps and drive improvements to GSOC monitoring, response, reporting, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Coordinate with Facilities, IT, security technology teams, and vendors on security-system issues, remediation, tooling requirements, and third-party security services. 
 - Maintain and continuously improve GSOC SOPs, incident response playbooks, escalation matrices, and operational procedures. 
 - Ensure compliance with security policies, procedures, confidentiality requirements, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Participate in and lead security training, emergency drills, audits, exercises, and operational reviews. 
 - Ensure accurate shift handovers, incident records, logs, reports, and follow-up actions. 

Required Qualifications

- 6-9 years of experience in GSOC, SOC, security operations, NOC, or a similar 24×7 environment, with shift/team leadership experience. 
 - Strong knowledge of CCTV/VMS, access control, alarms, intrusion detection, and perimeter security. 
 - Proven experience leading security incidents, escalations, and cross-functional response. 
 - Experience coaching, mentoring, or supervising security operations teams. 
 - Strong communication, judgment, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Experience managing operational KPIs, reporting, and shift performance. 
 - Willingness to work 24×7×365 rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience as a GSOC/SOC/NOC Shift Lead or Supervisor. 
 - Experience supporting data centers, cloud, or critical infrastructure. 
 - Familiarity with incident management and security monitoring platforms. 
 - Experience managing security vendors and third-party providers. 
 - Knowledge of security compliance, audits, or emergency response. 
 - CPP, PSP, or equivalent security certification. 

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted. 

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U. S. privacy rules and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures. 

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

Business Introduction

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Adopt engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Work with principal engineers and partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Related Experience Required

 - Experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems. Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud. Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Platform Engineering, SAP on Azure, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Technical Leadership, Terraform (Software), Virtualization

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

data.title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY- Assurance - Senior - Digital

Role: GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)

Position Details

As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment. 

This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions. 

You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk. 

This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria. 

Responsibilities

- Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows. 
 - Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements. 
 - Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams. 
 - Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across: 
 - Core user journeys and primary business intents
 - Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
 - Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
 - Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)
 - Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e. g. , minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk). 
 - Build reusable evaluation pipelines for: 
 - Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
 - Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
 - Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
 - Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)
 - Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks). 
 - Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling: 
 - batch runs on scenario suites
 - configurable metric definitions
 - reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
 - storage of traces and outputs for auditability
 - Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples): 
 - Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
 - Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
 - Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
 - Training data leakage / memorization probes
 - Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns
 - Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers. 
 - Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows: 
 - tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
 - unauthorized action execution
 - exfiltration via tools/connectors
 - prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)
 - Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts. 
 - Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including: 
 - methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
 - quantitative results
 - qualitative results
 - risk assessment summary and recommended control actions
 - Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go. 

Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification: 

- Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor's or a master's degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments. 
 - 4-7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas: 
 - ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
 - security testing / red teaming
 - building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness. 
 - Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines). 
 - Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing. 
 - Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design). 
 - Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias). 
 - Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
 - Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls. 
 - Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns. 
 - Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring. 
 - Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses. 
 - Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes. 
 - Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards. 
 - Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments. 
 - Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to challenge assumptions constructively ("effective challenge") and influence engineering teams toward remediation. 
 - Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

- Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset). 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts). 
 - Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants. 
 - Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault). 

Additional skills requirements: 

- Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
 - Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline. 
 - Must have demonstrated project management experience. 
 - Knowledge of firm's reporting tools and processes. 
 - Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask. 
 - Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions. 
 - Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources. 
 - A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

What We Look For

- A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment

data.title: Associate Program Manager, Tech
data.description:
About The Role And Team

The GSS Quality Assurance team (part of the Global Customer Experience org) drives the Quality Assurance strategy for various Uber product areas. We conceptualize & launch new strategic initiatives, build & scale new testing capabilities, and own the overall test suite management for different product lines at Uber. We are strategic partners to engineering, product management, product operations, and technical program management teams, running programs that deliver frictionless experiences for Uber users. 

We seek a QA program manager with strong quality assurance skills who wants to become a subject matter expert in testing methods across product categories. You will delve into the specifics to comprehend product and stakeholder requirements while collaborating across global and market teams to establish scalable, effective testing procedures. Additionally, you will support the testing team in Hyderabad, helping them succeed by removing major obstacles and guiding key tasks to ensure a smooth UAT process. 

- Requirement Analysis & Test Plan: The candidate must analyze the Product Requirement Document (PRD), the Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD), and other pertinent documents to develop a robust test plan that addresses all edge cases and recognizes potential functionality gaps. 
 - Business Flow Analysis: Creates comprehensive test cases aligned with product functionality through business flow analysis. 
 - End-to-End Testing: The individual should have a solid overview of the QA lifecycle and ensure seamless product validation by implementing and adhering to testing policies, and should also be able to define strategies for pre- and post-launch depending on the type of product
 - Stakeholder Management/Collaboration: Translate business needs into critical test scenarios by engaging with stakeholders across teams (Product, Engineering, Operations), improving product quality, and providing updates on blockers and challenges to support timely launches. 
 - Root Cause Analysis: Investigates recurring issues, collaborates with the team to prevent defects at the source, and contributes to process improvements to ensure we identify defects in the QA phase

What You'll Do

- Review & Understand Requirements: Analyze business requirements, Product Requirement Documents (PRD), and flow charts to create relevant test scenarios. Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify requirements and improve product testing quality. 
 - Create & Execute Test Cases: Design effective test plans and test cases based on business workflows and try to discover edge cases for the product so that no defects are leaked. 
 - Stakeholder Communication: Regularly interact with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to discuss testing progress and critical issues. 
 - Identification & Reporting: Identify, document, and track bugs and defects. Work closely with developers to troubleshoot and ensure timely fixes. Document steps to reproduce issues, expected vs. actual results, and severity levels to assist developers in debugging
 - Scrum Meetings: Before the meeting, the tester comes prepared with all the necessary information to contribute effectively and avoid back-and-forth communication. 
 - QA Initiatives: May also lead the Device Lab Program, partnerships with XFN teams within the GCX (Global Customer Experience) org, and execution of strategic initiatives across the QA org. 

Basic Qualifications

- Educational Qualification: Must have completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) or software testing or in a related domain. 
 - Knowledge of Testing Processes: Familiarity with test case creation, execution, Bug reporting, and analysis of bugs in pre- and post-test phases
 - Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze business requirements and identify test scenarios to generate a robust test plan
 - Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders, developers, and business users. 
 - Basic Technical Understanding: Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC), databases, and testing methodologies. 

Preferred Qualifications

- AI Proficiency: Should be proficient with the latest AI tools and developments in the market. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you. 

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. 

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. 

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.
