Job Summary

We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to help shape and grow our next-generation data engineering capability. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an experienced engineer who can set technical direction, establish engineering standards, mentor and elevate other engineers, and build enterprise-scale data solutions. 

You will help design and evolve a modern, scalable, cloud-based data platform that may span technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, and cloud-native services. Rather than being tied to a single technology stack, we are looking for someone who understands modern data architecture principles and can make thoughtful technology choices based on business, data, scalability, interoperability, and operational needs. 

Just as importantly, we are looking for an AI-first engineering leader who can help the team rethink how we design, build, test, operate, and continuously improve data products using AI. 

Key Responsibilities

Lead Engineering Excellence

- Provide hands-on technical leadership for a growing team of data engineers. 
 - Set engineering standards and reusable patterns across architecture, coding, testing, data modeling, documentation, observability, security, and deployment. 
 - Lead architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews. 
 - Mentor engineers and develop technical depth, ownership, problem-solving, and engineering judgment across the team. 
 - Translate complex initiatives into clear technical approaches and guide teams from design through production. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, curiosity, experimentation, continuous learning, and accountability. 

Build & Evolve a Modern Data Platform

- Lead the architecture and engineering of scalable, secure, and governed enterprise data platforms. 
 - Design solutions across lakehouse, data warehouse, data lake, streaming, and data-product architectures based on the needs of the use case. 
 - Build batch, incremental, near-real-time, and event-driven data processing solutions. 
 - Create reusable engineering frameworks for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data quality, metadata, and data delivery. 
 - Design scalable data models supporting operational, analytical, reporting, and AI use cases. 
 - Establish patterns that promote interoperability and reduce unnecessary platform and vendor dependencies. 
 - Evaluate technology choices based on performance, scalability, reliability, security, cost, maintainability, and business value. 
 - Remain hands-on and contribute directly to engineering solutions when needed. 

Champion AI-First Engineering

- Champion the use of AI across the engineering lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and operations. 
 - Establish responsible practices for reviewing, validating, securing, and governing AI-generated engineering artifacts. 
 - Promote spec-driven development, using well-defined requirements, data contracts, acceptance criteria, and automated tests. 
 - Design data platforms and products that are ready to support AI agents, RAG, semantic models, machine learning, and conversational analytics. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI and data technologies through focused experimentation and translate successful approaches into reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Help engineers use AI to increase productivity and innovation without compromising security, quality, or engineering accountability. 

Build Reliable & Trusted Data Products

- Establish automated data quality, reconciliation, validation, and testing practices. 
 - Build observability across data pipelines, datasets, APIs, and platform services. 
 - Define operational expectations and reliability measures for critical data products. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis for significant issues and ensure corrective actions address systemic problems. 
 - Continuously improve platform reliability, resilience, performance, and operational efficiency. 
 - Treat data as a product with clear ownership, quality expectations, documentation, and consumer needs. 

Design Enterprise Integration & Data Access

- Design secure, scalable integration patterns across enterprise applications, data platforms, and external data sources. 
 - Develop and guide the implementation of REST and GraphQL APIs. 
 - Design event-driven and serverless integration solutions. 
 - Establish standards for API lifecycle management, authentication, versioning, monitoring, and governance. 
 - Enable data access through appropriate patterns including APIs, data sharing, event streams, and governed analytical interfaces. 
 - Apply modern identity and access patterns such as OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, JWT, managed identities, service principals, or equivalent approaches. 

Embed Governance, Security & Compliance

- Build data governance, lineage, metadata, data quality, security, privacy, and auditability into platform designs. 
 - Ensure engineering solutions align with applicable governance, risk, security, and compliance requirements. 
 - Apply appropriate engineering rigor to KYC, UCC, public-record, and other regulated or sensitive data domains. 
 - Partner with architecture, cybersecurity, governance, and compliance teams to address risks early in the engineering lifecycle. 
 - Maintain clear architectural decisions, data contracts, lineage, transformation logic, and operational documentation. 

Partner & Influence Across the Organization

- Partner with product, architecture, analytics, AI, operations, and business teams to translate business opportunities into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Communicate architectural decisions, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and opportunities clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Influence technical direction through expertise and collaboration rather than authority alone. 
 - Balance strategic platform modernization with near-term product and operational needs. 
 - Help establish a strong engineering community where ideas, patterns, and lessons are shared across teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, data platforms, or related disciplines. 
 - Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers, and leading complex initiatives from architecture through production. 
 - Strong understanding of modern data platform and distributed data architecture principles. 
 - Advanced SQL skills and strong expertise in data modeling, database design, and performance optimization. 
 - Deep hands-on experience designing and building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and reusable data engineering frameworks. 
 - Significant experience with one or more modern cloud data platforms, such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, or comparable platforms. 
 - Strong programming experience using Python, PySpark, Scala, Java, C#, or comparable languages. 
 - Experience with cloud architecture and services across Azure, AWS, GCP, or comparable cloud environments. 
 - Experience with APIs, distributed processing, event-driven architectures, and modern integration patterns. 
 - Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Understanding of data governance, lineage, security, identity, and data quality practices. 
 - Practical experience incorporating AI-assisted tools into engineering workflows. 
 - Strong communication, technical judgment, problem-solving, and stakeholder-influence skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience architecting solutions that span or integrate multiple data platforms or cloud technologies. 
 - Experience with lakehouse architectures, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or other open data technologies. 
 - Experience designing data products and applying data-as-a-product principles. 
 - Experience with interoperable data-sharing patterns and open data architectures. 
 - Experience building governed APIs or external data-delivery capabilities. 
 - Experience supporting AI-oriented data architectures including semantic models, RAG, data agents, machine learning, or conversational analytics. 
 - Experience with streaming and messaging technologies such as Kafka or comparable cloud-native services. 
 - Experience with API management and enterprise integration architecture. 
 - Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code and cloud automation. 
 - Experience working with sensitive or highly governed data in financial services, legal, compliance, or regulatory environments. 
 - Familiarity with KYC, UCC, public-record, GRC, or SOC 2 concepts. 
 - Experience leading data platform modernization or migration initiatives. 

Key Skills

Modern Data Platforms | Data Lakehouse & Warehousing | Databricks | Microsoft Fabric | Snowflake | Cloud Data Services | SQL | Python / PySpark | Apache Spark | Delta Lake / Apache Iceberg | Data Modeling | ETL/ELT | Data Products | REST & GraphQL APIs | Event-Driven Architecture | Data Quality & Observability | Data Governance & Lineage | CI/CD & DevOps | AI-Assisted Engineering | AI Agents & RAG

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Products developed and maintained by the team form the basis of a lot of other applications across the firm that are critical to the day-to-day activities of the firm. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: 

As a member of the Python Infrastructure team, you will set up and lead a new function that makes the firm's core Python platform legible to AI. You will own its strategy and roadmap, hire and develop a team of applied AI engineers, and define the standards that the team and platform developers build against, from knowledge structure and evaluation quality bars to release gating for AI plugins. Staying hands-on, you will architect the knowledge systems our AI assistants retrieve from and the evaluation suites, CI-gated regression sets, and LLM-as- judge rubrics that tell us whether AI output about our systems is correct. You will partner with product owners and the firm's GAI Tech group and report AI quality to stakeholders. Because these tools reach developers across the firm, you will build the standards, systems, and team that determine whether thousands of AI-assisted interactions with our platform are right or subtly wrong. 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate should hold: 

Basic qualifications: 

- A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field, with 8+ years of experience in software engineering
 - Experience leading engineers or a technical function, including hiring, managing, and developing people, and setting technical direction
 - Exceptional engineering depth in Python, with the ability to write production-quality code, read and reason about large codebases and APIs, and hold substantive design conversations with platform developers, including on system architecture
 - Experience leading the design of and shipping production LLMpowered systems, such as retrieval/RAG pipelines, agents or tool use, MCP servers, or Claude/GPT-class assistant integrations, along with working fluency in prompt and context engineering
 - Experience designing or running evaluations for LLM/AI systems, including test-set curation, rubric design, and judging model output, along with familiarity with at least 1 evaluation approach or framework, such as LLM-as-judge, Promptfoo-, Inspect-, Braintrust-, or RAGAS-style harnesses, or a homegrown equivalent
 - Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align product owners, platform developers, and partner groups on priorities and standards, and to explain AI-quality trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders

data.title: Senior QA/DV Program Manager
data.description:
About Axiado Corporation

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we're a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we're extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. 

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We're small enough that every person's work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company's future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let's talk. 

Job Description

The Senior QA/DV Program Manager a highly skilled and driven Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the execution, delivery, and quality assurance of multiple ASIC SOC hardware and BMC software solutions portfolios. In this role, you will lead the program management for our End-to-End Quality Assurance (QA) team, and drive the program execution for our complex SOC Design Verification projects (DV). 

You will have the opportunity to work closely with various engineering teams, from HW/SW design, verification, validation and system integration. 

Program Management & Execution

- Multi-Project Lifecycle Ownership: Track multiple parallel ASIC SOC projects from pre-silicon phases through to final deployment. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate schedules and dependencies between QA, Software, Architecture, Design, and DV teams. 
 - Risk Mitigation & Resolution: Identify technical and schedule bottlenecks early to develop clear mitigation plans. 
 - Metrics & Reporting: Report key execution metrics and milestone readiness regularly to engineering leadership. 

QA Program Focus

- System-Level QA Strategy: Oversee the testing schedule for full server systems and BMC boards hosting the SOC. 
 - Bug Tracking & Resolution: Drive the end-to-end triaging, tracking, and closure of system-level defects with engineering teams. 
 - Hardware/Software Co-Verification: Manage program dependencies for QA teams validating firmware, security layers, and Linux OS. 
 - Automation & Infrastructure: Track the deployment of automated test regressions running on physical server infrastructure. 

DV Program Focus

- Milestone Tracking & Delivery: Drive schedule adherence for block-level, subsystem, and full-chip verification milestones. 
 - Bug Lifecycle Management: Monitor pre-silicon bug burn-down rates and prioritize critical fixes to keep tape-out schedules on track. 
 - Scope Tracking: Coordinate with DV team leads to ensure timelines account for coverage all critical components. 
 - Emulation & Pre-Silicon Planning: Drive reviews, schedule and track dependencies for emulation and FPGA development, and coordinate with design, DV and software teams. 

Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 7+ years as a Technical Program Manager managing complex silicon or system-level validation programs. 
 - Systems QA Expertise: Strong understanding of system-level QA frameworks, automated test setups, and server or BMC testing. 
 - Silicon Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with multi-CPU SOC architectures, hardware security, and interfaces like PCIe, USB, or Ethernet. 
 - Verification Fundamentals: Basic grasp of pre-silicon Design Verification concepts, coverage metrics, and bug-tracking lifecycles. 
 - Tools & Methodologies: Proven proficiency with project management tools like Jira and standard hardware/software release processes. 
 - Preferred qualifications: 
 - 
 - Advanced Degree: Master's degree in EE, CE, CS, or a technical MBA. 
 - AI Productivity Tools: Proficiency using AI-based tools for program management optimization, action-item tracking, and automated meeting minutes. 
 - BMC & Server Ecosystem: Direct experience with Baseboard Management Controllers, embedded Linux, or IPMI/Redfish protocols. 
 - Security Frameworks: Understanding of hardware Root-of-Trust, cryptographic accelerators, and secure boot architectures. 
Additional Information

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. 

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. data.description:
Department/Group Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

Database Product Development Organization (DB-PDO) is the Crown jewel of Oracle Corporation, creating World's best Database and Data Management Software Products used by 100s of Thousands of Large Enterprises, SMB and Cloud customers worldwide. 

97% FORTUNE GLOBAL 100 enterprises are powered by Oracle DB for their Mission Critical deployments and workloads. We have been constantly innovating for the past 45+ Years to make Oracle DB #1 with a ton of cool features!

SHARP-VLDB group ( S calability, H igh A vailability, R eliability, P erformance) within DB-PDO is a well-respected, highly sought after group with a long track record of success. The group focuses on improving Scalability, High availability, Reliability and Performance aspects for core Oracle AI DB Server (OnPrem), Oracle AI Autonomous DB Cloud, Oracle GoldenGate and other AI DB Cloud Services (DBCS, ExaCS, ExaC@C). This is achieved by Designing, Developing and carrying out Stress, Integration, System and Macro-Performance Test Solutions, simulating Complex Real-world Enterprise usage scenarios and leveraging Very Large DBs (VLDB) hosted on Large RAC Clusters, Exadata or Autonomous DB Cloud and OCI. Our group contributes on New Feature Innovations that makes Oracle DB World's Best Hyper Converged and Open Database. 

With 200+ dedicated Product Engineers distributed across the globe and working on a single mission, our group has been extremely instrumental in delivering highest quality Oracle DB Server products/cloud services for every major release . 

Job Description

SHARP-VLDB / System Test Solutions Development group envisions & architects Large-scale, High Load/Volume, Massively concurrent , Multi-tier simulation tools & Data-Centric applications to emulate Real-world Autonomous DB Cloud usage scenarios to detect product defects & architectural limitations. 

As a member of this group, you will Learn and Shape the NextGen/Cutting Edge Oracle AI Autonomous DB & GoldenGate Replication Cloud Services & On-prem features as they are designed (26ai+) and gain state-of-the-art experience in Managing /Tuning/Debugging VLDBs emulating real-world/complex production and cloud usage scenarios

You would be fully responsible for Designing, Implementing, Maintaining, and Enhancing Cloud/AI Test plans, Test Suites/Solutions, and Test methodologies via AI-Powered Tools/Processes that ensure exhaustive testing of all assigned Services/features to ensure highest product quality by exposing defects, identifying regressions, and verifying solutions. Requires strong interpersonal and technical skills to work effectively and efficiently with development staff and fellow colleagues to identify/debug and resolve software defects. 

Multi-tier Stress/Integration/System/Performance Cloud/On-prem Test AI-Driven simulations are conducted in a State-of-the-art Cloud /On-prem environment (grid of hundreds of OCI/On-prem servers) mimicking end-to-end high stress scenarios. This Solution effort involves complex DB Design (TB of Data, Billions of Rows, 1000s of tables), Massively concurrent workload/query development (100K transactions per sec, 1000s of queries per hour), Extreme concurrency levels (5000-10000 concurrent users/sessions), High Velocity/Volume IOT/Streaming Data Ingestion/Replication etc. The focus is primarily on high-end enterprise customer use-case scenarios (Ex: Bank of America, NYSE, Apple, LinkedIn, Dell, HDFC, SBI etc. ) involving Extreme dimensions of Cloud, On-prem and Hybrid Usage with Large Scale, Data-Volume and Velocity. 

You would have the unique opportunity to Innovate, Shape and Impact Futuristic Oracle AI DB Cloud/GoldenGate Cloud Replication Technologies like: 

- Oracle Autonomous DB Cloud - Shared and Dedicated Infrastructure (ADB-S/ADB-D) 
 - Oracle Multitenant DB Features (HA/MAA focus) 
 - Oracle GoldenGate Enterprise Replication and Various HA/MAA Use-cases/Features 
 - Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) GoldenGate Service / OCI GG Marketplace 
 - Oracle Database Migration Service / Zero Downtime Migration

Oracle AI Autonomous Database Cloud (both Shared & Dedicated): 

https: //www. oracle. com/autonomous-database/

https: //www. oracle. com/database/technologies/datawarehouse-bigdata/adb-faqs. html

https: //www. oracle. com/in/autonomous-database/autonomous-data-warehouse/

https: //www. oracle. com/in/autonomous-database/autonomous-transaction-processing/

Oracle GoldenGate Replication & GoldenGate Cloud Service: 

https: //www. oracle. com/integration/GoldenGate/

https: //www. oracle. com/in/integration/GoldenGate/features/

https: //docs. oracle. com/en/cloud/paas/GoldenGate-service/druyg/index. html#articletitle

https: //www. oracle. com/database/zero-downtime-migration/

https: //www. oracle. com/in/cloud/database-migration/

Oracle Multitenant DB, HA/MAA : 

https: //www. oracle. com/database/multitenant/

https: //www. oracle. com/database/technologies/high-availability. html

https: //www. oracle. com/database/technologies/high-availability/maa. html

https: //www. oracle. com/database/technologies/high-availability/dataguard. html

Responsibilities

Detailed Responsibilities

- Design & Develop Highly Automated Multi-Tier/Multi-Stack System/Stress/Performance Test Suites/Solutions simulating End-to-End Real-world Cloud Enterprise Usage scenarios. This may include DB Schema Design/Normalisation, Data generation, Load generation, Advanced GoldenGate Replication topologies and Application/Business Logic programming in Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, Perl/Shell/Python and Java/JDBC/JMS or Python/cx_oracle and REST Clients. 
 - Review New Functionality/Features in NextGen Oracle AI Autonomous/DB & GoldenGate releases, Develop and Maintain Test Specs/Plans/Methodologies and then Design, and Implement End-to-End Test Solutions simulating Real-world production Cloud Usage. 
 - Execute these developed Test Suites on ADB Cloud PODs and On-prem DB Cluster/EXADATA to discover product defects and architectural limitations by exposing defects and regressions and verifying these resolutions. 
 - Develop Cloud Automation Tools/Frameworks/Solutions to seamlessly orchestrate ADB-S Cloud Full Life-cycle Operations such as Cloud DB Provisioning, Configuring/Scaling, Complex Workload/Traffic generation, Monitoring/Debugging and Upgrading/Patching cases. 
 - Develop relevant OS/DB/Application Monitoring and Debugging Tools/scripts and integrate them into the Live Cloud Execution PODs. 
 - Log and track product defects (bugs), Collaborating closely with Development teams to resolve problems encountered in these Multi-tier Cloud test simulations. 
 - Serve as ADB-S CloudOPs/DevOPs to address various Cloud DB New feature Automation, Test Harness Design/Development and Execution/Monitoring on Cloud PODs. 
 - Participate in Product Feature Review, Certification experiments and User Document reviews . 
 - Deploy AI/ML Technologies and Good GenAI/Agentic AI Engineering (LLMs like GPT, Grok, Claude, Gemini etc. ) across these various Solution Design/Development/Testing Lifecycle is preferred

Qualifications

Technical

- Expert Oracle Design/Development/Principal DBAs cum Oracle DB Developers with 10+ years of Strong IT experience 
 - Strong Experience with Oracle DB Enterprise features like Oracle Grid/RAC/ASM, Data Guard (Physical/Logical Standby), Oracle GoldenGate, Multi-tenant DB (CDB/PDB), Replication/Migration is required. 
 - Good Hands-on Expertise of Oracle GoldenGate Replication, Design/Build/Debug High Velocity GG Replication Pipelines/Topologies between Oracle and Non-Oracle DBs (Active-Active, Multi-Master), GG Performance Tuning and deploying GG for Zero Downtime/Online Migration are essential skill sets 
 - Sound Experience as Development cum Production Oracle DBA - Administering Large-scale OLTP/DW Mission critical databases in real world production/Test environment. 
 - Experience with Oracle Cloud/DBaaS Private (Exadata based Multi-tenant deployments) or Public Cloud (DBCS, ExaCS/ExaCC or Autonomous DB Cloud), Amazon AWS or MS Azure and implementing REST-API Client Orchestrations dealing with Cloud hosted Micro-Services Components is a big plus. 
 - Strong Linux/UNIX OS understanding including OS Architecture & Internals (Networking, File Systems, Process/Memory Monitoring/Tuning/Linux Virtualization etc. ). Experience w/ Windows is a plus. 
 - Oracle DB/GG/SQL/Application Performance Monitoring/Tuning/Troubleshooting skills-sets, Logical/Physical Design and Workload Design/development is preferred. 
 - Exposure to Other DBs like MySQL, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis etc. is a plus. 
 - Good Knowledge of RDBMS/Oracle DB Architecture, Configuring & Testing Oracle 23ai New Features. 
 - Programming/Scripting & Automation skills in one or more of the below specified languages is needed. 
 - Scripting - Shell / Python / JavaScript 
 - Programming - SQL, PL/SQL, Java/JDBC, Python/cx_oracle, Microservices/REST APIs 
 - Exposure to AI/ML Technologies and Good GenAI via Prompt Engineering (LLMs like GPT, Grok, Llama, Gemini etc. ) for AI-Accelerated Solution Design/Development/Testing/Debugging/Triage is preferred 
 - B. E, M. E. /MS in CS/ECE/EE, MCA from Reputed Engineering Colleges preferred. 

Interpersonal

- Good Verbal and Written communication skills 
 - Self-Motivated and Constant/Quick Learner, Team player & Attention to detail 
 - Good Analytical and Problem-solving skill sets 
 - Ability to multitask, Positive Attitude and deliver under pressure

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Manager, Software Development & Engineering
data.description:
Your opportunity

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client's goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and commitment to doing what's right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success - they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape. 

What you have

This position is for a software quality assurance test automation lead engineer on the Sales and Service Technology team. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating and enhancing automated test plans solutions that support our business within the Salesforce platform. The Sales and Service Technology team is a forward leaning development organization that leverages agile methodologies. This position will interact with business stakeholders and technology counterparts across many areas within Schwab. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience
 - 9+ years' experience in quality assurance with distributed applications across the full development and operational support life cycle
 - Demonstrated ability to lead testing efforts of high value capabilities
 - Ability to guide and teach other test automation engineers in order to maintain best practices and test suite health
 - Familiarity of the Java Technology Stack, Seleniun, Playwright, GitHub Version Control, and GitHub Actions
 - Ability to design and execute functional, regression, and end-to-end tests for web applications
 - Experience leveraging AI tools to generate test cases, test data, and automation scripts
 - Identify defects, usability issues, and performance bottlenecks
 - Document and maintain test cases, prompt libraries, and test results
 - Interact with product managers, business analysts, and developers to define test plans and test cases for new and enhanced capabilities
 - Experience working with geographically distributed teams, working collaboratively across team boundaries

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong analytical & critical thinking
 - Ability to interpret ambiguous AI outputs
 - Excellent communication & documentation skills
 - High attention to detail
 - Curiosity and "break-the-system" mindset
 - Demonstrated ability to work alone or in a group while multi-tasking on different projects
 - Working knowledge of the Agile/Scrum development methodology a plus

What's in it for you

At Schwab India, you're empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration - so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security. 

Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include

- Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
 - Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
 - Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
 - Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
 - Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
 - Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work
 - Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

data.title: Delivery Lead-QA Lead
data.description:
Job Purpose

We are seeking a hands-on QA Lead for a Legacy Application Modernization programme. The role will own test strategy, test planning, automation, quality gates and release evidence for the migration from legacy on-premises applications and reporting platforms to a cloud-based, modern enterprise architecture with enhanced analytics and reporting. 

The candidate must combine strong QA leadership with practical test automation and advanced SQL-based data testing. The role includes end-to-end source-to-report reconciliation, data lineage validation, transformation-rule verification, API-based data-consumption testing, batch scheduling, error/replay scenarios, historical migration and parallel-run comparison. The QA Lead will work closely with business analysts, engineers, reporting developers, DevOps, security and business stakeholders to establish traceable acceptance evidence before cutover. 

The programme supports a Sales and Trading platform spanning order capture, pricing, execution, trade booking, post-trade processing, risk, and regulatory and management reporting across asset classes such as equities, fixed income, FX and derivatives. The QA Lead must bring strong capital-markets domain knowledge and ensure the platform meets regulatory obligations including MiFID II/MiFIR, EMIR, SFTR and MAR. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the QA strategy, test plans, estimates, quality metrics, defect governance, release exit criteria and testteam coordination for the legacy application modernization milestones. 
 - Design and execute end-to-end tests from agreed source feeds through ingestion, cloud landing storage, raw/refined/curated data layers and reporting outputs. 
 - Validate legacy ETL source-to-target mappings, database transformations, historical data extracts, control totals, business rules, schedules and downstream file/report outputs. 
 - Test layered data processing: raw-layer completeness and batch metadata; refined-layer cleansing, deduplication and enrichment; curated-layer reconciled aggregates, measures and publication gates. 
 - Perform data lineage testing to trace source fields, batch/correlation IDs, transformations, derived attributes and report measures through the full processing chain; validate lineage and audit evidence. 
 - Build and maintain automated tests using a modern web automation framework for web-based reporting, user workflows, report navigation and relevant UI/API scenarios; integrate suites with CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Use advanced SQL queries to compare legacy relational database and ETL outputs with cloud data platform tables, including counts, checksums, balances, keys, nulls, duplicates and exceptions. 
 - Validate BI semantic models, calculated measures, filters, row-level security, scheduled refresh and report parity with legacy reporting and analytical outputs. 
 - Test REST API-based data access, including authentication, authorisation, JSON payloads, pagination, throttling, timeouts, retries and refresh failure recovery. 
 - Test data-quality thresholds, rejected batches, quarantine, replay, idempotency, dependency sequencing, restartability and the last-approved curated dataset after failed publication. 
 - Lead reconciliation and regression testing during legacy/new parallel run, including intraday, end-of-day and T+1 business cycles and agreed business sign-off thresholds. 
 - Coordinate non-functional test coverage for performance, volume, resilience, security, observability and recovery against approved NFRs. 
 - Maintain traceability from BRD requirements and acceptance criteria to automated/manual tests, execution results, defects and business approval evidence. 
 - Design and execute end-to-end tests across the Sales and Trading trade lifecycle: client order and RFQ capture, pricing, execution, allocation, booking, confirmation, settlement, position and P&L, and reporting, across relevant asset classes (equities, fixed income, FX, rates and OTC/exchange-traded derivatives). 
 - Validate MiFID II/MiFIR transaction reporting (RTS 22) and reference data, including LEI/client identifiers, trading capacity, execution and algo flags, instrument classification (ISIN/CFI), and reporting via ARM/APA within T+1 timelines. 
 - Validate pre- and post-trade transparency, best execution, systematic internaliser and transaction-cost reporting outputs against MiFID II/MiFIR requirements. 
 - Validate EMIR trade repository reporting for derivatives (ISO 20022 XML), including UTI/UPI generation, lifecycle events (new, modify, terminate, compress, novate), valuation and collateral data, and dual-sided reconciliation and pairing/matching outcomes. 
 - Test SFTR reporting for securities financing transactions and, where in scope, Dodd-Frank/CFTC reporting, ensuring the correct regime is applied to each trade and avoiding duplicate or missing reports. 
 - Test MAR-related controls: trade and order surveillance feeds, audit trail, order and trade record-keeping, time synchronisation (clock sync) and communications capture where applicable. 
 - Verify front-to-back trade data integrity between order management/execution systems (including FIX messaging), booking, risk, finance and regulatory reporting, and support regulatory exception, rejection and resubmission scenarios. 
 - Lead defect triage, root-cause collaboration, test-data management, UAT support, go-live readiness and knowledge transfer to operational support. 

Key competencies

- 8-12 years in software/data QA, including leadership of complex enterprise application modernization, ETL/ELT, reporting and migration test programmes. 
 - Mandatory hands-on experience with a modern test automation framework using TypeScript/JavaScript or Python, maintainable automation frameworks, API/UI testing and CI/CD execution. 
 - Strong relational database and advanced SQL skills: joins, CTEs, window functions, reconciliation queries, stored procedures and data profiling. 
 - Hands-on testing of ETL packages, enterprise reports, multidimensional/tabular models, BI dashboards, semantic models and calculation expressions. 
 - Knowledge of cloud data platforms, distributed data processing, SQL, open table formats and layered raw/refined/curated architecture, including data-quality and publication controls. 
 - Proven ability to validate end-to-end data flows and field-level lineage from upstream sources to curated datasets, APIs, semantic models and reports. 
 - Experience testing incremental/full loads, CDC where applicable, batch orchestration, dependencies, backfills, historical migration, replay and exception handling. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, test leadership, coaching, communication and business-facing UAT facilitation. 
 - Practical API testing knowledge covering REST/JSON, token-based authentication, pagination, rate limits and error handling. 
 - Strong Sales and Trading / capital-markets domain knowledge across the trade lifecycle (front, middle and back office) and asset classes such as equities, fixed income, FX and derivatives. 
 - Working knowledge of MiFID II/MiFIR, EMIR, SFTR and MAR, with hands-on experience validating transaction and trade reporting (ARM/APA/trade repository), LEI/UTI/ISIN usage and reconciliation. 
 - Familiarity with FIX protocol, order management and execution systems, trade booking and post-trade (confirmation, settlement, position, P&L and risk) platforms. 
 - Ability to reconcile financial/trade, position, risk, regulatory, finance and management reporting data and understand business cut-offs. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling, source control, test management, defect tracking, automated evidence and regulated change controls.

data.title: Staff Layout & Design Automation Engineer
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Analog Devices' Platform IP organization is seeking an experienced Senior Layout & Design Automation Engineer to join our growing team. This role combines deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal IC layout with a passion for engineering productivity, automation, and IP reuse. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering complex block and subsystem layouts while also driving continuous improvement of layout methodologies, automation frameworks, and reusable IP infrastructure. A key aspect of the role will be identifying challenging or repetitive analog layout problems and developing practical automation solutions that can be applied across IP, projects, and technologies. 

The engineer will collaborate closely with circuit designers, layout engineers, EE teams, and technology experts to enable high-quality silicon solutions across multiple business units and process technologies. 

This position is ideally suited to an engineer who is equally comfortable understanding and solving challenging physical design problems, developing automation to address those problems, and supporting other engineers in the application of those solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Layout Leadership

- Lead development of analog and mixed-signal layouts from floor-planning through tapeout. 
 - Own layout execution for critical IP, subsystems, and test-chip developments on planer nodes. 
 - Drive high-quality layout implementation for: 
 - Data converters (ADCs/DACs)
 - Power management circuits (LDOs, references, regulators)
 - Amplifiers and signal chain circuits
 - PLLs and clock-generation circuits
 - High-voltage and mixed-voltage designs
 - Ensure designs meet performance, matching, reliability, ESD, latch-up, and manufacturability requirements. 
 - Drive successful DRC, LVS, ERC, EMIR and parasitic extraction closure. 
 - Develop a detailed understanding of process-specific layout rules, limitations, and physical-design trade-offs, and provide practical guidance to designers and layout engineers. 

Design Automation & Productivity

- Develop and deploy automation solutions that improve layout productivity and design quality. 
 - Work directly with layout engineers and designers to identify difficult, repetitive, or time-consuming physical-design tasks that are suitable for automation. 
 - Develop scripting and automation, including Cadence SKILL programming, to improve and extend Virtuoso-based analog layout workflows. 
 - Explore automation of analog placement, routing, layout generation, checking, and other areas where engineering knowledge can be translated into repeatable methodologies. 
 - Identify repetitive engineering tasks and implement scalable solutions. 
 - Support advanced methodologies including: 
 - Automated layout generation
 - Placement and routing automation
 - Layout verification automation
 - IP qualification workflows
 - Reusable analog building blocks
 - AI-assisted design and productivity initiatives
 - Develop solutions that can evolve from individual productivity improvements into reusable capabilities for wider engineering teams. 
 - Partner with CAD and EDA teams to improve design flows and tool integration. 

IP Development & Reuse

- Contribute to the development of reusable Platform IP across multiple technology nodes. 
 - Support IP migration, qualification, and reuse activities. 
 - Apply automation techniques across a broad portfolio of analog and mixed-signal IP, including data converters, references, power management, signal-chain, clocking, high-voltage and mixed-voltage circuits. 
 - Identify opportunities where automation can simplify IP migration, adaptation, verification, and deployment across different process technologies. 
 - Promote best practices for containerized IP, version control, and design traceability. 
 - Assist in defining scalable methodologies that enable reuse across business units and geographical teams. 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Provide technical guidance to layout engineers across the organization. 
 - Perform layout reviews and design audits. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level layout engineers. 
 - Contribute to engineering standards, training material, and best-practice documentation. 
 - Serve as a go-to technical resource for questions relating to analog layout methodology, process rules, technology limitations, and the practical application of automation. 
 - Help capture experienced layout knowledge and translate it, where appropriate, into reusable methodologies, checks, scripts, and automation. 
 - Act as a recognized subject matter expert in one or more technical domains. 

Required Qualifications

- BS, MS, or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of analog or mixed-signal IC layout experience. 
 - Proven experience delivering silicon in advanced and mature process technologies. 
 - Expert knowledge of: 
 - Cadence Virtuoso Layout XL / VXL methodologies
 - Calibre DRC, LVS, ERC and extraction flows
 - Deep understanding of: 
 - Device matching
 - Parasitic effects
 - Shielding and isolation techniques
 - Reliability and ESD considerations
 - Power distribution and substrate management
Scripting & Automation Experience

- Strong scripting/programming experience, with demonstrated ability to develop and maintain engineering automation solutions. 
 - Experience with Cadence SKILL programming for Virtuoso-based layout automation, productivity utilities, design checks, or flow integration. 
 - Experience with Python for engineering automation, data processing, workflow integration, or tool development. 
 - Working knowledge of Shell/Bash and/or Tcl for design-flow automation and EDA tool integration. 
 - Ability to translate analog layout knowledge and repetitive engineering workflows into robust, reusable automation used by other engineers. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing engineering automation deployed to multiple users. 
 - Experience with analog layout generators and parameterized cell development. 
 - Experience with, or interest in, analog placement and routing automation. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering workflows. 
 - Experience supporting IP libraries shared across multiple design groups. 
 - Knowledge of multiple foundries and process nodes. 
 - Experience working with distributed global engineering teams. 
 - Previous technical leadership or project-lead responsibility. 

Success Profile

A successful candidate will: 

- Consistently deliver high-quality layouts on complex projects. 
 - Recognize where difficult analog layout problems can be addressed through automation rather than repeated manual effort. 
 - Improve engineering productivity through automation and workflow enhancement. 
 - Develop practical automation grounded in real analog layout and process knowledge. 
 - Influence layout methodology across projects and teams. 
 - Champion IP reuse and standardization. 
 - Mentor engineers and raise the technical capability of the organization. 
 - Become a trusted resource for analog layout process, rules, limitations, and automation opportunities. 
 - Act as a recognized technical leader while remaining hands-on with design execution.

As such, applicants for this position - except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3) - may have to go through an export licensing review process.

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer - SDET
data.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We are looking for a Senior level SDET to support our product development teams. As the Principal SDET, you will play a crucial role in shaping and leading our software testing strategy. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing robust test automation frameworks, mentoring a team of SDETs (Software Development Engineer in Test), and ensuring the overall quality and reliability of our software products. 

Your Mission

As a Senior SDET, You Will

- Provide technical leadership and guidance to the SDET team. 
 - Collaborate with development and QE (Quality Engineering) teams to integrate testing into the software development process. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient test automation frameworks and test architectures. 
 - Rub shoulders with developers in writing unit and integration tests using their tools and frameworks. 
 - Ensure the frameworks support various testing types, including functional, integration, and performance testing. 
 - Mentor and guide junior SDETs, providing technical expertise and career development support. 
 - Conduct training sessions to enhance the skills of the testing team. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive test plans. 
 - Execute and oversee the execution of test cases, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and non-functional requirements. 
 - Analyze test results and provide meaningful insights to improve product quality. 
 - Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and user stories. 
 - Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, providing clear updates on testing progress and issues. 
 - Add, maintain, and update scripts in existing automation suite, helping with running the suite across various checkpoints in the release cycle. 
 - Participate in various POCs (Proof of Concept) to keep the automation framework and technology relevant and current to product offerings. 
 - Conduct peer reviews of test code and automation frameworks. 

You Are

- You are a seasoned SDET with an automate anything anywhere attitude who is looking for a challenging technical leadership role in a dynamic and innovative company. 
 - You can efficiently find the underlying cause of a failure (in an integrated environment) and alert the right team. 
 - You are consistently willing to pitch in to support a long running deployment, even after hours. 
 - You are willing to learn and pick up new skillsets to support the ever-changing technology landscape like Cloud computing & AI (Artificial Intelligence). 
 - You can understand complex product and deployment architectures and create efficient test solutions. 
 - You want to be part of a team that is passionate about delivering high-quality software solutions. 

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field. 
 - 4+ years of relevant experience working as a developer, automation engineer or SDET. 
 - 4+ years of experience coding in Java and must have strong practical knowledge of OOPs and Core Java principles. 
 - 4+ years of experience contributing to Test-Driven Development or BDD (Behavior Driven Development) with tools like Cucumber, Junit, Mockito, or TestNG. 
 - 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Circle CI, or Azure DevOps with the ability to create test pipelines using Java or Groovy. 
 - 4+ years of experience with Selenium or Cypress frameworks for automating GUI (User Interface) and E2E tests of the application. 
 - 4+ years of experience with REST Assured or similar tools like Postman for automating APIs. 
 - 4+ years of experience working in a highly automated CI/CD environment. 
 - 4+ years of experience with source control tools such as Bitbucket, GitHub or GitLab. 
 - 2+ years of experience mining meaningful logs for troubleshooting using tools like Splunk, Dynatrace or Coralogix. 
 - 3+ years of experience working in a cloud shop preferably Azure with exposure to various Azure services like Gateways, Redis, Storage, VMs (virtual machines) and Kubernetes clusters. 
 - 3+ years of experience in testing mobile applications, both native and websites using Appium on both real devices and simulators either in a private farm of 3rd party vendors like Sauce Labs or BrowserStack. 
 - 4+ years of experience working with geographically distributed teams in US, Canada, and India. 
 - Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to work as part of a team, demonstrate initiative, solve problems independently and mentor others. 
 - Passion for high quality work and attention to detail. 
 - Strong oral and written communication skills. 

Extra Awesome

- Prior exposure to AI/ML systems and how to use them in testing thus making test pipeline more intelligent. 
 - Experience in analyzing the CPU Utilization, Memory usage, Network usage, Garbage Collection and DB Parameters and DB Reports to verify the performance of the applications. 
 - Ability to spin up scalable test architecture using Docker or Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and extended usage patterns for test grids, auto scale properties. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Your Data

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? data.description:
Job Description

The Technology Leader will work closely with customers, project delivery teams, product line management, pre-sales organizations, business development teams, and global customer engineering organizations to drive successful delivery of Optical Transport, Cloud Infrastructure, and Subsea networking solutions. 

The role is responsible for leading and scaling a high-performance Remote Delivery Engineering organization focused on optical transport networks, subsea connectivity solutions, and cloud-integrated network infrastructures. The individual will provide technical leadership across architecture, design, validation, deployment, optimization, and lifecycle management of customer networks while ensuring delivery excellence and superior customer experience. 

The candidate will lead a team of highly skilled engineers covering solution architecture, technical delivery, network design, interoperability validation, automation, customer acceptance, and technical consultancy across Nokia's Optical Networks portfolio, subsea transport solutions, and cloud-native infrastructure environments

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Lead end-to-end remote delivery of Optical Transport, DWDM, OTN, ROADM, Metro, Long-Haul, and Subsea network solutions. 
 - Own architecture, design, deployment, migration, and lifecycle management of optical and transport networks. 
 - Provide technical leadership for cloud-integrated network infrastructures (cINF) supporting network modernization and cloud transformation initiatives. 
 - Lead customer engagements from solution definition through deployment and operational acceptance. 
 - Build, mentor, and develop globally distributed engineering teams. 
 - Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Product Management, and Customer stakeholders to drive strategic growth opportunities. 
 - Act as a trusted technical advisor to executive and senior customer stakeholders. 
 - Drive adoption of network automation, SDN-based transport architectures, cloud-native operational models, and AI-driven network assurance. 
 - Support deployment and optimization of subsea transport networks, landing station connectivity, and terrestrial extension architectures. 
 - Ensure first-time-right delivery with high-quality engineering outputs and technical governance. 
 - Establish best practices, reusable delivery frameworks, engineering standards, and solution blueprints. 
 - Drive risk management, technical escalation management, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Align customer solutions with Nokia product roadmaps and future technology evolution. 

Key Skills And Experience

Optical Networks

- DWDM, CWDM, OTN, ROADM, Optical Switching
 - Metro, Regional, Long-Haul, and Ultra Long-Haul Transport Networks
 - Optical planning, design, performance engineering, and network optimization
 - Carrier-grade transport architectures and resiliency frameworks
 - Nokia Optical product portfolio (1830 PSS and related transport solutions)

Subsea Networks

- Subsea cable systems and transport technologies
 - Landing station architecture and terrestrial integration
 - Capacity planning and service provisioning across subsea infrastructures
 - Multi-domain optical network operations and service assurance

Cloud Infrastructure (cINF)

- Cloud Infrastructure platforms supporting telecom workloads
 - Kubernetes, OpenStack, VMware, and cloud-native environments
 - Infrastructure virtualization and containerized deployments
 - Network cloud integration and automation frameworks

Automation & Software Defined Networking

- SDN-controlled transport networks
 - Network automation and orchestration frameworks
 - Python, Ansible, APIs, and model-driven networking
 - Telemetry, analytics, and closed-loop assurance

Leadership & Customer Skills

- Strong customer engagement and executive relationship management. 
 - Proven ability to influence customer technology strategy and investment decisions. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in managing large, geographically distributed engineering organizations. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills. 
 - Strong commercial acumen with ability to support business growth and opportunity development. 
 - Strategic thinker with excellent problem-solving and decision-making capabilities

Experience

- 20+ years of experience in Telecommunications, Optical Networking, Transport Networks, or Network Infrastructure domains. 
 - 10+ years leading engineering, architecture, or delivery organizations. 
 - Proven experience in large-scale Optical Transport, Cloud Infrastructure, and Subsea network deployments. 
 - Experience managing global customer engagements and remote delivery organizations. 
 - Strong understanding of service provider, hyperscaler, enterprise, and subsea operator environments. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or related discipline. 
 - Industry certifications in Optical Networking, Cloud Infrastructure, IP Networking, or equivalent technologies preferred. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in Optical Transport, cINF, Subsea, and Network Automation technologies.

data.title: VP Engineering (Core Platform)
data.description:
Hiring for BRAHMA AI - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

BRAHMA AI is an enterprise AI content platform used by some of the world's largest media & entertainment, sports and advertising companies. It grew out of Prime Focus Technologies, the team behind CLEAR®, the cloud media asset management and content supply chain platform. BRAHMA AI now combines CLEAR with generative and visual AI, which won a 2026 Technology & Engineering Emmy®. With new funding and an AI-native content operating system in market, BRAHMA AI is scaling the core platform that every product runs on, and needs an engineering leader in Bengaluru to own it. 

About the Role

As VP Engineering for the Core Platform, you'll own end-to-end delivery of BRAHMA AI's platform, from understanding the business need to choosing the solution, testing it and rolling it out. You'll lead a global organisation of 75+ software engineers and DevOps, work with product line management on the vision and roadmap, and keep the platform AI-first, scalable and reliable for enterprise customers. The role is onsite in Bengaluru, and you'll stay close enough to the code to build with AI tools yourself. 

What you'll do

- Own delivery of the core platform end to end and turn the product roadmap into a delivery plan with product line management
 - Lead the build and launch of AI-first enterprise SaaS capabilities, including agentic AI workflows across media asset management, localisation and content operations
 - Provide technical oversight on microservices, horizontal scaling and Docker/Kubernetes across AWS, GCP and Azure
 - Direct a global team of 75+ engineers and DevOps: set KRAs, grow managers and build a high-performance culture
 - Run Agile programs for intermediate-to-large cross-functional modules, delivering on time and with high quality
 - Manage the engineering cost centre and budget, and report progress to leadership and global operations partners in weekly and monthly reviews
 - Bring AI into how software is built (AI-led SDLC) and drive technical innovation across the team

What you bring

- 15-20 years in software, now in a VP or Director-level engineering leadership role
 - 8+ years of software program management and delivery in a software product company
 - Have led an engineering and DevOps organisation of 75+ people, including managers of managers, across locations
 - Have shipped and scaled a multi-tenant enterprise SaaS product built on microservices and Kubernetes in the cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure)
 - Have delivered AI-first or agentic AI product features, and use AI coding tools hands-on
 - Strong technical grounding in Java, SQL/NoSQL databases and DevOps
 - Have owned a cost centre or engineering budget and tracked delivery with Jira, MPP and spreadsheets
 - Clear written and spoken communication, from individual contributors to senior leadership; a B. E. , B. Tech or M. Tech

Nice to have

- Experience with media operations or the media & entertainment industry (OTT, broadcast, content supply chain, media asset management)
 - A program management certification

Originally posted on: 7 Nov 2026

data.title: Senior Manager, Engineering
data.description:
About The Team

Zillow's Core Technology organization empowers our people with the tools and platforms they need to thrive. ServiceNow runs IT and HR service delivery and is the foundation of the help experience at Zillow: how employees ask for help, find answers and get things done. We own our platforms end to end: production access, change ownership, on-call, configuration and development, and direct stakeholder relationships. This team works closely with teams across IT, HR, Product, and Engineering functions to configure, implement, and maintain software applications that are used by Zillow Group employees in their day-to-day job activities. This team plays a critical role in ensuring that Zillow operates efficiently and effectively, and fosters a culture of inclusion and collaboration. 

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager of Engineering to lead the team that supports the ServiceNow platform, all integrations to and from ServiceNow, and the automations around it. You will lead six direct reports: one TPM and five ServiceNow developers and admins, with additional roles planned for 2027. You will own engineering delivery and operations for ServiceNow, partner with US product, engineering, IT and People leaders, and help define the future of the help experience. This role requires effectively balancing the expertise and career aspirations of your team members with the organization's objectives. A proven track record of project implementation and the ability to identify opportunities for technical enhancement and drive continuous improvement initiatives are key aspects of this position. 

What You'll Do

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of ServiceNow developers and admins and a TPM, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and growth. 
 - Drive execution of initiatives in support of the help experience roadmap, ensuring that projects are delivered on time and within budget
 - Own delivery and operations of the ServiceNow platform
 - Own integrations to and from ServiceNow and the automations around it, including virtual agent and AI-assisted resolution
 - Partner with the US platform and agentic engineering team on MCP integrations and agent capabilities
 - Own on-call, change management, security and availability for the platform, with a low-toil operating model
 - Discover possibilities to reduce technical debt and propel ongoing improvement initiatives, guaranteeing Zillow maintains a top-tier technology infrastructure
 - Collaborate regularly in planning and estimating activities, offering guidance and support to team members using your previous experience and understanding of the business, and actively participate in discussions about capacity and priorities
 - Establish strong connections with important individuals in the Product, IT and HR departments, serving as a reliable consultant who can provide guidance, anticipate challenges, and find innovative solutions for business issues
 - Represent Zillow's needs and best interests with third-party vendors, ensuring that they are accountable to expectations, service level agreements (SLAs), and contractual commitments
 - Constructively negotiate trade-off discussions with other senior leaders, articulating pros and cons while providing options and recommendations that align with Zillow's goals and values
 - Prioritize initiatives that balance short-term needs with long-term vision, ensuring consistent delivery of high-impact solutions
 - Be responsible for measuring the impact of the roadmap, ensuring that the changes are having the result expected, using data such as deflection, resolution time and employee satisfaction
 - Guide the team through capacity planning, agile execution, and continuous improvement of team operations
 - Identify operational opportunities and come up with a plan to implement improvements, focused on a continuous improvement philosophy
 - Lead quarterly, mid-year and annual planning for your team
 - Mentor future leaders by supporting their development in strategy, collaboration, and execution
 - Communicate key progress, risks, opportunities and alternative options to executive audiences with clarity and confidence

This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. 

Who you are

- 8+ years of experience in enterprise IT and HR service management technology stacks, with extensive exposure to the ServiceNow ecosystem
 - 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven track record of getting results through others
 - Familiar with Agile Scrum processes and associated ceremonies, and can effectively lead a team in an agile environment
 - Passionate about career development and multiplying the impact of your team members, providing mentoring and coaching to individual contributors
 - Ability to seamlessly adapt your communication style to the audience ranging from individual contributors on your team to senior leaders and executives
 - Strong commitment to operational excellence, constantly striving to uncover the underlying causes of problems, using data to guide your decision-making, and fostering a culture of ongoing improvement within your team
 - Previous experience maintaining relationships with external vendors and a solid understanding of commonly accepted approaches in the industry
 - Track record of successfully delivering projects through team members that report to you, and can collaborate effectively with partner teams
 - Willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into the details to ensure a thorough understanding of the work at hand
 - Has built and operated platforms, not only implemented them
 - Hands-on with ServiceNow integrations and automation
 - Uses AI tools in their own work and has moved AI use cases into production

Get to know us

At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U. S. , we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. 

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U. S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. 

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. 

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment. 

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly. 

Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.

data.title: Digital S/W Eng Lead Analyst - C13 - MUMBAI
data.description:
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Engineering Lead Analyst to architect and deliver secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise integration ecosystems across microservices, cloud platforms (Openshift/AWS/GCP), APIs, and hybrid database environments (Oracle & NoSQL). 

In this role, you will serve as a technical domain expert bridging architecture, engineering, and data governance-driving API and event-driven data pipelines, privacy-by-design automation (data masking, synthetic data, consent management), and technical build-vs-buy evaluations for enterprise SaaS integrations. 

You will translate complex regulatory and data risk frameworks into actionable engineering deliverables while ensuring adherence to enterprise security, compliance, and architectural standards. 

Responsibilities: 

- Collaborate with architects and product managers to build system integration, ensuring it is scalable, resilient, and secure. 
 - Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and Core Engineering teams to design resilient, scalable, and secure API integrations, event-driven pipelines, and data sync workflows. 
 - Build ecosystems spanning front-end, backend, APIs, microservices, cloud services and platform components. 
 - Design, develop, and optimize robust database solutions across relational (Oracle PL/SQL, schema design, query optimization) and distributed NoSQL databases (e. g. , MongoDB, DynamoDB), creating scalable data access layers, indexing strategies, and automated data synchronization pipelines. 
 - Engineer RESTful API consumption/creation, data mapping, identity integration (OAuth2, SAML, OIDC), and telemetry/observability. 
 - Provide hands-on technical guidance on privacy automation within CI/CD pipelines, SDK integrations, and synthetic/masked data generation. 
 - Participate in technical product discovery through collection, detailed technical build vs buy analysis, review to understand requirements and align these to Data Governance and/or Data Risk and Controls standards to drive appropriate solutions. 
 - Act as the central Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Privacy by Design, automated data discovery and consent management. 
 - Translate complex regulatory frameworks, enterprise data governance policies, and data risk taxonomies into actionable technical user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency. 
 - Conduct technical build-vs-buy analyses and architecture evaluations for incoming SaaS platforms, ensuring compatibility with enterprise microservices, cloud infra (OpenShift/AWS/GCP), and hybrid environments. 

Qualifications: 

- 6+ years of experience, Banking or Finance industry preferably in Data Engineering or a development area. 
 - Hands-on background in software development with proficiency in at least one modern language (e. g. Java). 
 - Proven hands-on expertise with RESTful APIs, microservices architectures, distributed systems, and integration middleware (Kafka, MQ, API Gateways). 
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience in database development with Oracle and enterprise NoSQL technologies, including designing high-availability, low-latency, and distributed data architectures. 
 - Strong grasp of cloud native paradigms (Kubernetes/OpenShift, AWS/GCP, Docker) and enterprise security/auth protocols (OAuth 2. 0, SAML, mTLS). 
 - In-depth knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns. 
 - Proven expertise in Excel, PowerPoint, JIRA, Confluence and SharePoint. 
 - Communicates effectively, develops and delivers multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences; able to drive consensus, and influence relationships at all levels. 
 - Collaborate effectively by building partnerships and working well with others to meet shared objectives. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise data governance frameworks, metadata management, automated data discovery and classification. 
 - Optimizes work processes by balancing effective / efficient processes with a focus on continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrates ability to balance between seeing the "big picture" while paying close attention to detail. 
 - Organizational savvy: understands systems, management processes, knows where to go for information and how to interpret the data. 
 - Working knowledge of Data Operating Model practices, Data Governance and Data Compliance & Security laws within large, financial services firms will be a plus.
