data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

- As Senior Principal Software Engineer develop strategic methods and principles to improve the technical stability and efficiency of the company's products/services. 
 - You lead and influence several teams and initiatives. 

Your Mission

- Has deep knowledge of entire system and can jump into code in any component and fire fight and contribute. Makes decisions on product direction and internals based on deep subject matter knowledge. 
 - Sets product direction and has ownership over large components. Thinks both strategically and tactically, keeping in mind both technical goals and company goals. 
 - Given long term strategic goals, can lay out a path across many versions. Participates in and supports initiatives outside of main area of responsibility. Provides technical leadership for projects including 3-4 individuals. 
 - Builds strong relationships in their own team and across the company. Understands multiple points of view and drives a process to conclusions in a timely and respectful manner. 
 - Mentor others with high-level technical guidance. Improve the company's technical prowess. Put customers first and set strategic short-term targets. Take up open-ended problems. 
 - Designing, coding, and debugging software. 
 - Improving the performance of existing software. 
 - Providing training to other engineers. 
 - Maintaining and upgrading existing software. 
 - Recommending new technologies that can help increase productivity. 
 - Supervising and overseeing the technical aspects of projects. 
 - Investigating software-related complaints and making necessary adjustments to ensure optimal software performance. 
 - Regularly attending team meetings to discuss projects, brainstorm ideas, and put forward solutions to any issues. 
 - Work with testing team to develop performance test plans and cases. 
 - Research and collect product information and support the development of specifications and requirements for consideration. 

You Are

- High technical and/or technological competence 
 - Strong documentation, analytical and problem-solving skills 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
 - Minimum of 10+ years of hands-on experience with Java based development projects using RESTful APIs, SpringBoot, Micro services. 
 - Strong analytical skills. 
 - Good communication skills. 
 - Excellent organizational and leadership skills 
 - Proven experience in high-level programming languages, like Java. 
 - Proven experience in software development methodologies. 
 - Proven experience building complex web systems. 

Extra Awesome

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field 
 - Expertise with running web services at scale. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address. data.title: .Net Fullstack Developer
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. 

Job Description

Experience: 

- 4-7 years of experience with developing end-to-end web applications using Microsoft stack of technologies. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Web application development using . NET, C#, Asp. net, MVC, WebAPI. 
 - Strong Working knowledge of Angular 2 or above, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS3. 
 - Good working knowledge of Cosmos DB, MSSQL - SQL etc. 
 - Experience with usage of TFS
 - Familiar UI testing and Unit Testing (MS Test/ Jasmine/ MOQ/ NUnit/ Karma etc. )
 - Good understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP)
 - Strong working knowledge of SOLID principles and design patterns that includes Creational, Structural, Behavioral
 - Strong experience in designing and working with n-tier architectures
 - Able to provide technical recommendations and solve technical problems
 - Should have working knowledge on Code review that includes, raising code review, resolve comment reviews, Closing code reviews. 
 - Should be aware of best practices in programming
 - Should know how to troubleshoot performance-related issues, how to write efficient code and query, how to use SQL profiler
 - Working knowledge Authentication and Authorization [Plus OAuth2, OpenIDC etc. ] (5+)
 - Should have worked on at least one SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) project
 - Should have worked in an AGILE practice methodology (preferably SCRUM)

Additional Information

- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; 
 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; 
 - Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; 
 - Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); 
 - Structured and clear writing skills; 
 - Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; 
 - Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

data.title: Lead Architect - BSA
data.description:
Company Profile

Lennox (NYSE: LII) Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member's contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us. 

Job Description

The Lead Architect owns the end-to-end technical design of enterprise applications built on Java and the Spring ecosystem. The role combines hands-on architecture of cloud-ready, event-driven microservices with technical leadership across the software development lifecycle - setting standards, mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative and future-proof solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end architecture for assigned systems, from solution design through detailed component, integration, and deployment architecture. 
 - Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions while collaborating closely with business, product, and delivery teams. 
 - Define and maintain architectural standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and technical roadmaps. 
 - Ensure non-functional requirements including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and fault tolerance are incorporated into all solutions. 
 - Design and oversee the development of Java-based, cloud-ready microservices using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure implementation aligns with the approved architecture. 
 - Partners with product and delivery leads to estimate effort, sequence work, and manage architectural dependencies and technical risks. 
 - Lead the development of new features, enhancements, and modernization initiatives across the application landscape. 
 - Participate in and provide technical leadership throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support). 
 - Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and quality best practices. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through Agile architecture, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, and cloud adoption. 
 - Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability. 
 - Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence. 
 - Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities

Qualifications

- 10-12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, distributed applications and microservices. 
 - Strong expertise in Java SE/EE and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security). 
 - Proficiency in Java as the primary language, with working knowledge of Python or JavaScript as an advantage. 
 - Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and integration using SOAP where required. 
 - Experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and API Gateway technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and database design principles. 
 - Familiarity with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React. 
 - Experience with Git and modern software development workflows. 
 - Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud-native deployment patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and SLO/SLA definition. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. 
 - Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership. 
 - Ability to influence technical decisions and drive architectural governance across multiple teams.

Job Description

Who we are?

Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we've been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since. 

Today, we offer the world's largest portfolio of building products, technologies, software, and services; we put that portfolio to work to transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play. This is where Johnson Controls comes in, helping drive the outcomes that matter most. Through a full range of systems and digital solutions, we make your buildings smarter. Sustainability is a top priority for our company. 

We committed to invest 75 percent of new product development R&D in climate-related innovation to develop sustainable products and services. We take sustainability seriously. Achieving net zero carbon emissions before 2040 is just one of our commitments to making the world a better place. 

What You Will Do

Johnson Controls Digital Solutions is looking for an experienced engineer with a deep knowledge on building technologies including BMS, VMS, and Access Control etc. 

As a member of the Global Center of excellence the Presales technical lead will help customers to make technology decisions, implement best practices for asset management and overall facilitate transforming buildings into smart connected entities. 

This role requires a blend of technical expertise, customer service, and sales skills to effectively support potential clients and the sales team in understanding, evaluating, and adopting the company's digital products and solutions. You are obsessed with driving continuous process improvements to optimize solution and deliverables in presales process. 

How You Will Do It

- Develop and implement pre-sales strategies that align with the organization's business goals & targets. 
 - Review opportunity inputs, requirements and specifications; should be able to capture the Digital Solution scope and understand the complete requirements of the customer. 
 - Drive RFP/RFI responses, preparing technical solution writeups, compliance matrices, BoQs, Hardware sizing calculations, and architecture diagrams tailored to customer use cases across global markets. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product management, and engineering, to ensure alignment and effective Solution development.

 - Provide technical leadership to coordinate, prioritize and deliver proposal, commercials in pre-sales process. 
 - Articulate goals, desired outcomes, risks/issues and mitigation plan clearly in pre-sales process. 
 - Clearly qualify out of the box solutions and possible customizations needed. 
 - Provide feedback to product management and development teams regarding customer needs and market demands

What We Look For

- 8-10+ years' experience as Presales engineer and delivering proposals, commercials in overall Bid process. 
 - Expertise in Solutioning, designing and delivering building technology Solutions e. g. BMS, Security, Fire and Lighting. 
 - Hands-on experience in SCADA Platforms (WinCC, Iconics, Ignition or similar) and PLC programming is preferred. 
 - Experience in IoT Gateway configuration and Device Onboarding to cloud is a must have. 
 - Knowledge of different types of OT/IT network protocols like BACnet, Modbus, OPC, MQTT, SNMP, AMQP and other protocols. 
 - knowledge of HVAC or Industrial Process Control systems, IT-OT Integrations, API integrations. 
 - Knowledge of L2 and L3 Networking, Switching, Servers, Virtualization concepts and Clustering. 
 - knowledge of cloud IoT platforms and services (MS Azure is preferred)
 - Familiar with Energy Management, Cloud based Analytics tools, Digital Twin, Digital asset management and BRICK schema concepts. 
 - Ability to handle multiple priorities in an energizing and fast-paced environment. 
 - Experience working with industry leaders to understand current technology trends and relevancy. 
 - Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape, and new product features. 

Skills And Competencies

- Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new products and technologies. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Proficiency in using Integrated software and digital communication tools. 
 - Ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and customer-oriented mindset. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

data.title: Director, Team Lead, Regional Engineering Group Lead
data.description:
Role Summary

Pfizer is building one Data, AI & Engineering organisation to build and run the data, artificial intelligence (AI) and digital products for International Commercial. This role leads one of the five regional engineering groups that together form the pillar's single engineering pool across data, AI and full-stack engineering. Reporting directly to the Vice President - Data, AI & Engineering and sitting on the pillar's leadership team, the Regional Engineering Group Lead manages a group of 6 to 8 engineers, including senior engineers, and is the technical lead for the products they build, from minimum viable product (MVP) through build, scale and enhance. The role decides how engineering quality, security and production readiness are met in every product the group touches, takes MVPs from the Principal Engineer, Strategic Programs and scales them into products, and holds colleagues and partner engineers to one engineering bar. Five posts share this profile across the Americas, Europe and Asia; location is the variable. This role owns the people in the group, the technical leadership of its products, their delivery quality and release readiness, and the group's craft coverage. 

Role Responsibilities

- Delivery leadership
 - Acts as technical lead for the products built by the group, or names a senior engineer as technical lead for each
 - Leads delivery from MVP to build, scale and enhance, accountable for engineering quality, security and production readiness
 - Takes MVPs from the Principal Engineer, Strategic Programs at handover and carries them into build and scale
 - Holds colleagues and partner engineers to one engineering bar
 - People management
 - Hires, develops and manages performance for a group of 6 to 8 engineers, including senior engineers
 - Assigns engineers to the pillar's highest-priority work and rotates them across products as the work moves through stages
 - Develops senior engineers as craft leaders and candidates for the Strategic Programs roles, and grows junior engineers and bench colleagues
 - Hires people who embrace change, want varied problems and move quickly
 - Engineering practice and standards
 - Keeps data, AI and full-stack engineering craft covered in the group
 - Serves as a guild steward when nominated and applies the guild standards in every build
 - Acts as acceptance owner for the group's domains, feeding the certification gate
 - Cross-region collaboration
 - Works as one engineering pool with the other four group leads, pairing and rotating engineers across regions
 - Provides engineers for the pillar's shared tooling
 - Acts as the senior engineering leader for the pillar in its region, accountable for the local hiring pipeline and partner engineers
 - Ways of working
 - Uses coding agents for routine engineering and reviews their output before it ships
 - Keeps technical ownership of the group's work when vendors and contractors are involved
This role covers a broad spectrum of skills and we encourage you to apply even if you meet partially. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field
 - 10 or more years of relevant experience, including 2 or more years leading teams
 - Hands-on experience in data engineering, AI or machine learning engineering or full-stack development
 - Experience with cloud platforms, modern data stacks and programming languages, including Structured Query Language (SQL)
 - Experience with continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), infrastructure as code, automated testing and secure engineering practice
 - Experience leading agile, cross-functional engineering teams, with an AI-first approach to changing ways of working
 - Experience communicating technical decisions to product owners, business stakeholders and engineers, and working across regions and time zones
 - Experience solving complex, ambiguous engineering problems with structured analysis and clear recommendations
 - Experience leading engineers and influencing peers and stakeholders without direct authority
 - Experience evaluating engineering tools and practices and introducing them to teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or a related field
 - Experience managing engineers and leading delivery at the same time as a tech lead inside a matrixed portfolio
 - Experience growing senior engineers and juniors while keeping sustainable spans and succession
 - Experience balancing staffing, delivery, technical debt and partner capacity across competing priorities
 - Experience keeping technical ownership when working with vendors and contractors, and comfort with change and rotation
 - A hands-on engineering craft still practised
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure or equivalent, modern data stacks such as Databricks, Snowflake or equivalent, and languages such as Python, TypeScript or equivalent
 - Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure tooling such as GitHub Actions, Terraform, Docker or equivalent
 - Experience using coding agents and AI-assisted development tools and verifying their output
 - Knowledge of commercial pharmaceutical processes and operations across field force, marketing, market access, pricing and tenders, and launch

Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements

Ability to work non-traditional work hours interacting with global teams spanning across the different regions (eg: North America, Europe, Asia)

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

- Other teams within Data, AI & Engineering
 - Other teams within Business Transformation & Technology
 - Chief Marketing Office, Global Commercial Analytics
 - CIO platform teams

Supervision: 6 to 8 engineers, including senior engineers

Closing date for applications is November 29th. 

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers. 

Information & Business Tech

data.title: Senior Engineering Program Manager – Lifecycle.
data.description:
Position summary: 

The Head - Lifecycle Management / Engineering Program Manager - Lifecycle Management has complete end-to-end lifecycle ownership for Vision Care Solutions (VCS) products, Software solutions and the installed base. The role is accountable for lifecycle strategy, portfolio prioritization, sustaining engineering, post-market actions, release governance, serviceability, obsolescence and end-of-life execution across hardware, software and systems. 

The position is the functional manager for all Engineering Product Owners (EPOs), setting common operating mechanisms, priorities, quality expectations and leadership standards and program management for all Install base programs. The role converts customer, field, quality, regulatory, service and business signals into an integrated lifecycle roadmap, executable portfolio and measurable outcomes for product quality, customer safety, reliability, cyber resilience, cost and delivery. 

Primary duties and responsibilities: 

Lifecycle portfolio and installed-base ownership: 

- Own the VCS lifecycle portfolio from post-launch stabilization through upgrades, sustaining releases, refurbishment/service improvements, obsolescence management and end-of-life actions. 
 - Establish lifecycle strategy, multi-year roadmaps, prioritization principles, funding proposals and governance across products; balance customer safety, regulatory urgency, business value, technical risk and capacity. 
 - Drive installed-base performance through complaint and defect trends, Customer Safety Orders (CSOs)/ Customer Complaints, Field Modification Instructions (FMIs), hazardous investigations, CAPA actions and closure effectiveness. Functional leadership of Engineering Product Owners : 

- Lead, coach and develop all lifecycle EPOs; define role clarity, decision rights, objectives, performance expectations, capability development and succession plans. 
 - Ensure each EPO converts lifecycle needs into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, acceptance criteria, milestones, dependencies, risks and measurable success criteria. 
 - Build an ownership culture centered on customer impact, technical judgment, facts-based decisions, transparent escalation, accountability and reliable delivery. Engineering program execution and release governance : 

- Direct cross-functional execution across systems, software, hardware, verification, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, sourcing, supply chain and external engineering partners. 
 - Govern scope, schedules, resources, budgets, risks, changes, tollgates and release readiness; resolve cross-program dependencies and escalate critical decisions early. 
 - Drive design verification, validation, design transfer, manufacturing/process readiness and documented release evidence appropriate to lifecycle changes. Quality, regulatory, cybersecurity and risk: 

- Ensure lifecycle execution complies with QMS, design controls, risk management, traceability, change control, CAPA and applicable medical-device regulations. 
 - Lead disciplined investigation, root-cause analysis, defect management and risk-benefit decisions; ensure complete, audit-ready closure documentation. 
 - Strengthen product cybersecurity through vulnerability management, secure-by-design practices, risk-based remediation and predictable cyber release governance. Cross-functional, customer and supplier leadership: 

- Act as the senior engineering interface for lifecycle topics across product management, commercial, regional, service, quality, regulatory, manufacturing and leadership stakeholders. 
 - Communicate portfolio status, customer/installed-base impact, risks, decisions and outcomes through concise dashboards and leadership reviews. 
 - Align suppliers, OEMs, contractors and engineering partners to ZEISS expectations for quality, reliability, maintainability, documentation, serviceability and lifecycle readiness. 
 - Lead service engineering for VCS product development team collaborating with VCS service team. 
 - Lead Value engineering to improve year-on-year productivity for VCS products. Operational excellence and measurable outcomes: 

- Establish standard work, decision forums, portfolio dashboards and KPIs for release predictability, field impact, complaint/hazard closure, CSO/FMI readiness, cybersecurity, QMS compliance and customer satisfaction. 
 - Use data, automation and AI-enabled analytics to identify trends, accelerate investigations, improve verification effectiveness and strengthen post-market performance. 
 - Own lifecycle resource and budget prioritization, vendor strategy and capacity planning; drive simplification and continuous improvement across the lifecycle operating model. Education, experience and job specifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Software, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science or a related STEM discipline; an MBA or advanced business qualification is advantageous. 
 - Typically 15+ years of relevant industry experience, including substantial engineering/product-development experience and demonstrated leadership of regulated lifecycle, sustaining or installed-base programs. 
 - Proven experience leading people and globally distributed cross-functional teams, including functional leadership, vendor management, resource planning and budget prioritization.

data.title: Principal Cyber Security Test Engineer
data.description:
Join OneAdvanced

We are looking for an experienced application security engineer who will champion a shift-left security philosophy by integrating automated security analysis into CI/CD pipelines, SAST scanning, GitHub Actions, and SCA. To ensure we embed security into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) across the organisation's . NET, Java, and Node. js technology stacks. This role is also needed to run web application security assessments or penetration tests. 

What You Will Do

- Threat Modelling 
 - Code reviews 
 - Supporting engineering teams with security related design and build issues 
 - Reviewing the results from various security code scanning tools 
 - Reviewing CI/CD pipeline configurations 
 - Create or amend code and generate pull requests for code fixes 
 - Reviewing and testing AI integrations and relevant guard rails etc 
 - Assisting other members of the team with application security related issues 
 - Completing web and desktop security assessments 
 - Carrying out risk assessments using the IRAM2 methodology 
 - Attending architecture board technical reviews

Success Measures: 

- Number of threat models completed 
 - Number of penetration tests completed 
 - Number of engagements on AI and Software Engineering Projects

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.

data.title: Quality Engineer-Test Management.SAP
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer specializing in Test Management for SAP, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality of applications and systems implemented using SAP. Your focus will be on developing test scenarios and test cases, executing them to verify that the system meets the requirements, with a primary emphasis on functional testing. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Test Scenarios and Cases: Create comprehensive test scenarios and test cases to ensure thorough coverage of system functionality, identifying potential issues before they impact users. 
 - Execute Test Cases: Run developed test cases to verify that the system is built according to the specified requirements, meticulously documenting outcomes and any discrepancies found. 
 - Verify System Requirements: Confirm that the system adheres to the established requirements through rigorous testing, focusing on functional aspects to guarantee compliance and quality. 
 - Identify and Report Defects: Detect defects and inconsistencies during testing, reporting them promptly to facilitate timely corrections and improvements. 
 - Ensure Functional Quality: Concentrate on the functional testing of applications, ensuring they operate as intended and meet the necessary standards. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- SAP Testing Experience: Experience with testing applications and systems implemented using SAP, including developing test scenarios and test cases to verify system functionality. 
 - Functional Testing Knowledge: Experience in functional testing of applications, with a focus on verifying system requirements and identifying potential issues. 
 - Test Case Development: Experience with creating comprehensive test scenarios and test cases to ensure thorough coverage of system functionality. 
 - Test Execution and Analysis: Experience in executing test cases, documenting outcomes, and analyzing results to identify defects and inconsistencies. 
 - Quality Assurance Understanding: Experience with ensuring functional quality of applications, confirming system adherence to established requirements through rigorous testing. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- SAP Testing Tools Knowledge: Experience with various SAP testing tools and methodologies would be beneficial for this role, enabling more efficient test case development and execution. 
 - Automated Testing Exposure: Exposure to automated testing techniques and tools in an SAP environment would be advantageous, allowing for more comprehensive testing coverage and faster defect identification. 
 - Agile Methodologies Familiarity: Familiarity with agile development methodologies would be valuable, facilitating collaboration with development teams and ensuring testing aligns with iterative development cycles.

data.title: Senior Devops Engineer , CX
data.description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. 

What's the Role All About?

The Senior DevOps Engineer is a key member of our DevOps group in Pune, supporting the Analytics platform engineering organization. The role builds and maintains the cloud infrastructure, automation frameworks and continuous delivery pipelines behind scalable, high-quality SaaS products. It combines hands-on AWS operations, DevOps automation, Kubernetes and Jenkins platform ownership and production support, and it uses AI-driven automation to improve deployment speed, reliability and the productivity of the whole group. The Senior DevOps Engineer also acts as a technical mentor within the engineering organization. 

How Will You Make an Impact?

- Partner with the Analytics development groups to plan and deliver DevOps initiatives and user stories. 
 - Design, build and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure, including EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, RDS, Kinesis and CloudFormation or CDK. 
 - Automate AWS infrastructure with infrastructure as code, backed by lint and validation checks in GitHub Actions. 
 - Design, implement and manage CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins (Groovy and shared libraries) and GitHub Actions, across all environments up to production, for multiple language stacks. 
 - Own the Jenkins platform on EKS: Jenkins and plugin upgrades, EKS version, node and add-on lifecycle, backup, right-sizing and production readiness of dev and prod instances. 
 - Manage release engineering: manifest-based deployments, release tagging and per-product rollback. 
 - Manage Docker containers and containerized microservices environments. 
 - Design and implement automated quality gates and release validation, including regression-test pipelines and test reporting. 
 - Strengthen security and compliance: IAM user-to-role migration, security agent rollout across accounts and regions, credential remediation and audit-ready change records. 
 - Drive cost optimization and consolidation: right-sizing, shutting down unused environments, ECR and region migrations and decommissioning of legacy stacks. 
 - Plan, execute and close change requests with the NOC, including sovereign and FedRAMP environments, and troubleshoot production issues, performance bottlenecks and outages. 
 - Manage daily DevOps operations: build systems, release management, artifact repositories, and support requests from development groups. 
 - Build AI-assisted DevOps tooling: agents and skills that triage failed builds, pre-check and draft change requests, summarize incidents, and answer operational questions from runbooks and documentation. 
 - Connect AI agents to our systems (Jira, ServiceNow, Jenkins, GitHub, Grafana, Kubernetes, AWS) through MCP servers and APIs, with least-privilege access, human approval steps and audit trails. 
 - Use AI coding assistants every day for infrastructure code, pipelines and reviews, share what works, and measure the result in hours saved, failure rate, lead time and cost. 
 - Evaluate, prototype and introduce new technologies that improve automation, scalability and operational efficiency. 
 - Mentor and train DevOps and software engineers on best practices and emerging technologies, including AI-assisted engineering. 
 - Participate in occasional after-hours support, for example planned change windows, when required. . 

Have You Got What It Takes?

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering within software development organizations, including 4+ years running production workloads on AWS. 
 - 3+ years building and managing Docker containers and containerized microservices. 
 - Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting, and proficiency in Python and Bash or Shell; a second object-oriented language, preferably Java. 
 - Hands-on AWS experience: EC2, S3, CloudWatch, Lambda, Kinesis, RDS and CloudFormation or CDK. 
 - Jenkins at administrator level (Groovy and shared libraries) and GitHub Actions; experience building, operating and securing CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Kubernetes and EKS in production, including version upgrades and add-on management. 
 - Infrastructure automation and configuration management with tools such as CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform, Chef, Puppet or Ansible. 
 - Hands-on AI engineering for DevOps: daily use of LLM coding agents (such as Claude Code) and at least one tool, agent or automation you built, with the result it delivered. 
 - Working knowledge of how LLM agents connect to systems (tool calling, MCP, prompt and context design) and of their risks: hallucination, prompt injection and data leakage. 
 - Strong understanding of DevOps, continuous delivery and automation best practices, and of cloud security basics: IAM least privilege, secrets management and audit-ready changes. 
 - Self-driven, able to manage tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 
 - Strong communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate with global groups. 

Core Technical Skills

- AWS cloud services
 - Jenkins, Groovy and GitHub Actions
 - Kubernetes and EKS
 - Infrastructure as code (CloudFormation, CDK)
 - Linux administration
 - Microservices and Docker
 - AI-assisted automation and agentic workflows
 - Production operations

Nice to Have

- Building agentic workflows with AWS Bedrock or the Anthropic API, developing MCP servers, retrieval over runbooks and wikis, and evaluating agent output. 
 - AIOps experience: log and alert summarization, automated root-cause hints, or AI-assisted change-risk checks. 
 - Guardrails for AI in regulated settings: data classification, secrets handling, human approval and audit logs (FedRAMP or similar). 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and Puppet or Ansible at scale. 
 - FinOps practice: right-sizing and automated shutdown of unused environments. 
 - Automated regression testing (for example Playwright) inside pipelines. 
 - Pipeline template libraries and internal developer platform or golden-path work. 
 - AWS certifications (Solutions Architect or DevOps Professional) or CKA. 

How We Work

- Hours: Pune working hours with overlap with Israel from morning to evening and with US mornings. Planned change windows may fall outside standard hours. 
 - Support: a shared rota for DevOps support and change execution with the NOC and colleagues in Israel and the US. No one carries it alone. 
 - Product groups: the group supports several product pods, and you will be the named DevOps contact for some of them, joining their planning and reviews. 
 - Tools: Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Jenkins, GitHub, Grafana, AWS, Microsoft Teams, and company-approved AI assistants. 

What's in it for you?

- Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams - comprised of the best of the best - work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

- At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere. 

About NICE

- NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) is an innovation leader in AI, cloud, and digital solutions, serving over 25, 000 global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations. With over 8, 500 employees across 30+ countries, NICE software handles more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors over 3 billion financial transactions daily. NICE is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates. 

Requisition ID: 12040

Reports to: Group Lead, DevOps

Role type: Individual contributor

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25, 000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. 

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8, 500 employees across 30+ countries. 

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. data.title: Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
data.description:
Location: Pune, India

About GF

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U. S. , Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www. gf. com. 

Introduction

GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery. 

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained. 

Your Job

- Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities. 
 - Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation. 
 - Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data. 
 - Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement. 
 - Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts. 
 - Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance. 
 - Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks. 
 - Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption. 
 - Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments. 
 - Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams. 

Other Responsibilities

- Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. 
 - Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements. 
 - Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Minimum 4 to 8 years of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields. 
 - Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python. 
 - Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development. 
 - Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies. 
 - Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems. 
 - Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA. 
 - Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments. 
 - Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments. 
 - Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration. 
 - Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams. 
 - Ability to travel up to 10% as required. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's or Ph. D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 
 - Experience with RISC-V processor architectures, toolchains, and ecosystem development. 
 - Knowledge of AUTOSAR, safety-critical systems, and functional safety standards including ISO 26262. 
 - Experience developing IDE plugins, engineering productivity tools, or software developer platforms. 
 - Experience with MLOps infrastructure, GPU-based training and inference environments, and enterprise AI deployments. 
 - Exposure to static code analysis, compiler technologies, program analysis, or code intelligence platforms.

Experience testing RAG based AI systems. 

Competence with Automation test execution in CI-CD Pipelines. 

Ability to use AI effectively in product testing process.

We have designed HV Substations upto 400kV and Electrical infrastructure for large industrial/ Multi Use developments and Heavy industries. The team provides services to clients across the globe, however the major clients are in UK and Middle East. 

The Power T&D team is looking for experienced Sr. Principal engineers in HV Plant Discipline, as we look to grow the team in line with business requirements. So, if you are interested in working for an internationally renowned consultancy and working on some challenging projects across UK, Canada & ANZ, come join us at AtkinsRéalis

Your role

Responsibilities

- Using your experience and knowledge, you will be leading the delivery of a variety of projects drawing upon the wider team for the technical engineering requirements and building a strong relationship with our clients. 
 - You will be client-facing, responsible for the delivery of our work and making sure it meets our client's'expectations. 
 - You will be taking up the following responsibilities: 
 - Experience of undertaking FEED or Detailed design of HV and EHV (132kV to 765kV) AIS , GIS and HVDC Substations
 - Produce design drawings & documentation for Front End Engineering Design (FEED) such as Protection Single Line Diagram (or) Key Line Diagram (KLD), Work Specification, Assessment of requirement for Auxiliary Systems etc. 
 - Complete Detailed Design Deliverables - Circuit Diagrams, Wiring Diagrams, Cable Schedules, Cable Block Diagrams, General Arrangement Diagrams, Termination Schedules etc. 
 - Interface substation auxiliary systems and other equipment with Protection & Control Systems
 - Complete design calculations - LVAC & DC System Sizing, CT & VT adequacy checks, Cable Sizing etc. 
 - You could also be working on Fault Current Calculations, Relay Settings and IED Configuration based on the skill set and project requirements. 
 - Report Writing Skills. 
 - Preparation of bid documents and bid evaluations. 
 - Ensure interdisciplinary coordination. 
 - Contribute to Tendering activities by supporting with preliminary design documentation & drawings, Bill of Quantities, Engineering Man Hour Estimates etc. 
 - Lead P&C design on a project and engage with junior engineers & graduate engineers. 
 - Mentoring other engineers and help them become better engineers. 
 - Manage the team and actively involve in finding the requirements of engineers and find ways to fulfil. 
 - Provide engineering support and solve queries during construction, testing and commissioning, attend site meetings and inspections. 

About You

Qualification

- Graduate/Post-Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering with around 15+ years of experience in Design of Protection & Control Systems. 
 - Hands-on Experience in design of protection systems applied to Busbars, Feeders, Transformers, Reactors, Bus Section, Bus Couplers, Reactors etc. on the 132kV and above systems. 
 - Appreciation for the principles of Current & Voltage Transformers, Auto Reclose, Circuit Breaker Fail & Plant Auto Switching arrangements. 
 - Ability to complete design deliverables - Single Line Diagram (SLD) & Protection SLD (or) Key Line Diagram (KLD); Circuit Diagrams, Wiring Diagrams, General Arrangement Diagrams, Cable Schedules, Cable Block Diagrams and Termination Schedules etc. 
 - Ability to produce design documentation - Design Basis Report, Case Studies and Project Design Specification. 
 - Be competent to review/approve the design drawings & documents produced by other engineers. 
 - Member of IET & working towards Chartered Engineer accreditation. 
 - Desirable 
 - Experience as Commissioning engineer will be added advantage. 
 - Experience of working UK National Grid / SSEN substation projects / EPC Contractor. 

Behavioural requirements

- Strong English Communication Skills needed to co-ordinate with client and other internal stake holders. 
 - Be a part of the team which is working at different geographical locations and co-ordinate for the needs of the project. 
 - Flexibility to travel to client sites when required. 
 - Capability to work under tight deadlines while achieving objectives with the ability to deal with competing priorities and manage time appropriately. 
 - To provide support and advice to members the team, this may also include line management responsibilities. AtkinsRéalis focus is on developing our staff to realise their full potential, with development plans geared to individual needs and abilities. 

Software & Design Tools

- MS Office
 - AutoCAD 2D
 - Trimble (Amtech) - Desirable
 - ETAP/PSCAD - Desirable

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. 

This Includes

- Comprehensive life insurance coverage. 
 - Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents. 
 - Generous annual leave balance. 
 - Flexible and hybrid work solutions. 
 - Remote work opportunities outside of country. 
 - Company gratuity scheme. 
 - Discretionary bonus program. 
 - Relocation assistance. 
 - Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition. 

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make. 

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Your Role at a Glance

The Manager, Digital Systems, India is responsible for the day-to-day leadership, coordination, staffing, and development of Digital Systems resources located in India. This role supports Digital Enablement, Digital Experience, and Digital Integrations teams, serving as the primary local people leader while partnering closely with global functional leaders to ensure successful delivery of business and technology initiatives. This position is specifically focused on leadership of digital teams supporting Salesforce CRM, MuleSoft integrations, and WordPress. 

How You'll Drive Success

Leadership & People Management

 - Support recruiting, onboarding, succession planning, and workforce development efforts. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Delivery & Portfolio Management

 - Help establish consistent development, integration, and support practices across all Digital Systems teams. 

The Talents We're Seeking

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - Salesforce, MuleSoft, Agile, Scrum, or related certifications a plus.

data.description:
Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - Mantri

Job Purpose

The Senior Software Engineer / Software Delivery Manager (SDM) (Salesforce) role exists in driving the development, integration, administration, and support of our Salesforce Wheels org and associated applications in scope of the respective POD. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying scalable solutions, code reviews, and team handling on Salesforce to support business processes and requirements. 

The position is vital for ensuring system reliability, enabling effective business processes for loan origination and underwriting, supporting multiple business teams, and delivering strategic technology projects to help Bajaj Finance achieve its business goals efficiently. 

Duties And Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead the design, development, customization, and integration of Salesforce CRM and allied business-critical applications, including loan origination and underwriting systems, to achieve desired functionality and efficiency for business operations. 
 - Ensure the stability, availability, and optimal performance of the Salesforce platform by proactively monitoring system health, troubleshooting issues, and minimizing potential business disruptions. 
 - Coordinate effectively with internal cross-functional teams and external partners to drive the timely completion of project milestones, oversee change management processes, and ensure all deliverables align with organizational standards. 
 - Pull requests and code review of junior developers' team who are responsible for delivery. 
 - Provide advanced technical support (Tier 2 and Tier 3), handle incident management, and implement permanent resolutions for recurring issues to enhance the end-user experience. 
 - Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date documentation, including support processes, user guides, training materials, and knowledge base articles, to aid user enablement and knowledge transfer. 
 - Oversee and implement system integrations between Salesforce and other business-critical systems using industry-standard APIs (SOAP/REST), thus supporting data integrity and seamless process flows. 
 - Participate in full software development lifecycle (SDLC) including requirement gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and support. 
 - Uphold governance by tracking delivery schedules, managing change processes, and providing regular status reports to relevant stakeholders. 

Key Decisions / Dimensions

- Selection of appropriate technical approaches and programming methodologies (including choice of Java/Apex patterns, integration strategies, and API usage) for developing and enhancing Salesforce and related business applications. 
 - Prioritization and scheduling of development tasks, support activities, and incident resolution to ensure alignment with project timelines and business priorities. 
 - Evaluation and implementation of integration techniques to connect Salesforce with other platforms (e. g. , Portals, EDW, mobile applications) while ensuring data consistency and system reliability. 
 - Identification and application of best practices for change management, version control, and deployment within the Salesforce ecosystem, in alignment with DevOps and ITIL principles. 
 - Determination of root cause solutions for recurring system issues, including whether to implement temporary workarounds or permanent fixes, while balancing risk and impact. 
 - Decisions regarding escalation or resolution of complex incidents and service requests, including coordination with cross-functional teams and external partners as appropriate. 
 - Selection and preparation of documentation, training materials, and user guides to maximize knowledge transfer and facilitate user adoption. 
 - Assessment of technological advancements and recommendations for adoption of relevant new tools, frameworks, or practices to support ongoing platform improvements. 
 - Decide how tech components can be reused across different functions to minimize development effort|
 - Direct Reports/Supervision (if applicable): [5-7 junior engineers/administrators] depending on POD size
 - Change Requests/Feature Deployments per month: 110-150 Man-days or 5-7 Man-months

Major Challenges

- Ensuring seamless integration of Salesforce CRM with diverse external and internal systems (such as portals, enterprise data warehouses, and mobile applications) while maintaining data integrity and system performance. 
 - Managing platform enhancements and multiple ongoing projects simultaneously, including the definition, execution, and timely delivery of project milestones within stringent deadlines. 
 - Addressing complex technical issues and resolving recurring incidents quickly to minimize downtime and maintain business continuity in a fast-paced financial services environment. 
 - Balancing the need for rapid delivery of new features and enhancements with stringent quality standards and regulatory compliance requirements. 
 - Coordinating effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners to align IT initiatives with evolving business requirements, while managing stakeholder expectations. 
 - Maintaining comprehensive documentation and knowledge bases despite frequent changes and updates in business processes and technology. 
 - Adapting to advancements in Salesforce technology, system integrations, and DevOps practices, and ensuring continuous skill development for sustained platform excellence. 
 - Salesforce releases updates three times a year (Winter, Spring, Summer), often introducing new features, changes, and deprecations -Need to be updated and work with business on translating broad problem statements to tangible deliverables. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Qualifications

Bachelor's / master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience in Manual and Automation Testing. 

- Work Experience

4+ years of experience in a Salesforce Admin/Developer role within a technology or IT organization. 

Preferred Salesforce certifications: Salesforce Certified administrator, Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I & II. 

Skills and Knowledge

- Strong proficiency in Apex programming languages, with hands-on experience in object-oriented programming and development on the Salesforce platform. Visualforce, Apex Classes/Controllers, Apex Triggers, SOQL, Lightning Web Components, Process Builder, Flow, Salesforce1, App Cloud, Communities, and AppExchange/ISV solutions. 
 - In-depth understanding of Salesforce architecture, including configuration, customization, workflows, and security models. 
 - Practical experience with Salesforce APIs (SOAP/RESTful) for system integrations with internal and external platforms such as portals, data warehouses, and mobile applications. 
 - Demonstrated capability in project management: defining milestones, managing delivery schedules, monitoring progress, and facilitating status reporting with a team. 
 - Proficient in Salesforce administration, platform health monitoring, incident management, and providing Tier 2 and Tier 3 technical support. 
 - Strong analytical and diagnostic skills for troubleshooting system issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing permanent resolutions. 
 - Ability to document technical solutions, support processes, and create training materials and user guides for varied stakeholders. 
 - Sound understanding of the loan business lifecycle, financial processes, and the operational requirements of a financial services organization. (Good to have)
 - Basic knowledge of database systems and data management principles.

data.title: Principal AI/ML Architect
data.description:
What you will do: 

● Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction: Own the end-to-end

architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference

architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices

across engagements. 

● Build at the frontier - hands-on: Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage

technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, 

advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic

workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI. 

● Engineer AI for production: Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, 

scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and

LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, 

and continuously improved. 

● Architect agentic systems at scale: Design and operate multi-step reasoning and

multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent

frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, 

human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls. 

● Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards: Define

measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, 

groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, 

governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle. 

● Shape data and retrieval architectures: Design production-scale retrieval and

knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, 

vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous

content refresh. 

● Advise clients and shape opportunities: Partner with client executives and

engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution

architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off

discussions, and pre-sales solutioning. 

● Multiply engineering capability: Raise the technical bar through architecture

reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and

clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater

confidence. 

● Own outcomes across the full lifecycle: Guide initiatives from problem framing

and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, 

adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions

to resolution. 

Your technical toolkit: 

● Languages and software engineering: Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting

API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system

fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership. 

● Models and AI ecosystem: Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class

models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; 

structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation. 

● Agentic AI engineering: Hands-on production experience with Google Agent

Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model

Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, 

guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design. 

● Retrieval and search: Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, 

re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, 

Pinecone, or equivalent technologies. 

● Cloud infrastructure and AI systems: End-to-end experience architecting highly

available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, 

AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, 

security, observability, and cost management. 

● Frameworks: Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent

orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more

maintainable patterns when appropriate. 

● MLOps and LLMOps: CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, 

automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, 

and production incident response. 

● Data and ML foundations: Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine

learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to

connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

About Position

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Platform Architect to drive platform architecture, cloud strategy, and engineering transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, Platform Engineering, and DevSecOps practices. This role requires strong leadership capabilities to define platform roadmaps, establish engineering standards, build self-service platform capabilities, and drive operational excellence across enterprise environments. 

- Role: Principal Platform Architect

 - Experience: 10 to 15 Years
 - Job Type: Full-Time Employment

What You'll Do

- Define and own the enterprise platform architecture, technology roadmap, and platform engineering strategy. 
 - Design and implement scalable cloud-native platforms using AWS, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Lead platform modernization initiatives focused on automation, self-service capabilities, and developer productivity. 
 - Architect and govern AWS EKS-based container platforms and cloud infrastructure solutions. 
 - Drive adoption of GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and Platform Engineering best practices. 
 - Design and implement secure, highly available, and resilient cloud platforms.

Expertise You'll Bring

- 10 to 15 years of experience in Cloud Architecture, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles. 
 - Deep expertise in AWS services including EKS, IAM, VPC, Route 53, Load Balancers, Security Services, and Cloud-native architectures. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-native platforms. 
 - Extensive experience with Docker containerization technologies. 
 - Expertise in Helm Charts and Kubernetes package management. 
 - Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing and managing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation practices. 
 - Deep understanding of Platform Engineering principles and Internal Developer Platforms (IDP). 
 - Strong experience implementing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) methodologies. 
 - Expertise in DevSecOps, cloud security, governance, risk management, and compliance controls. 
 - Strong understanding of security frameworks, regulatory compliance, and enterprise governance standards. 
 - Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry. 
 - Strong Unix/Linux administration and Shell scripting expertise. 
 - Proven experience architecting highly scalable and resilient enterprise platforms. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, leadership, mentoring, and communication skills.

- Competitive salary and benefits package
 - Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
