data.title: PLM Architect
data.description:
This is where  your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride.   

Your Role at Baxter

As a PLM Architect, you will be responsible for designing and configuring solutions on our core PLM platforms, Siemens Teamcenter and Agile. You will own the end-to-end technical solution, including architecture, migration, and integration design. You will drive the implementation of solutions that align with business processes and requirements, with opportunities to design and develop solutions within the Teamcenter environment using a variety of configuration and customization tools. Your extensive knowledge of Teamcenter architecture, customization, and integration will be instrumental to the success of our projects. Experience working with laboratory systems such as Empower, Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN), OpenLab, and Compliance Builder is highly desirable.   

  

What you'll be doing

- Architecture and Solution Building - Leverage your expertise to configure and build solutions on Teamcenter, ensuring they effectively address and optimize business processes and needs. Develop a comprehensive understanding of requirements and translate them into efficient and functional Teamcenter solutions. 

- Team Management - Be able to lead members in technical areas to mentor and develop junior resources. 
 - Customization and Integration - Customize Active Workspace (AW) to create tailored and efficient user experiences. Utilize ITK (Integration Toolkit) to implement powerful customizations that enhance system functionality. Experienced in Teamcenter customization, utilizing SOA, BMIDE, Rich Client plugins to create seamless and powerful solutions. Integrate Teamcenter with various applications, including MCAD, ECAD, MES, ERP, ALM systems to enhance system capabilities. 
 - Solution Implementation and Support - Demonstrate a proven track record in implementing and supporting Teamcenter solutions, including BOM Management, Change Management, Security modules, and Material Management IMM. 
 - Technical Documentation and Collaboration - Create detailed functional and technical specification documents. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and effective project execution. 
 - Cloud Deployment and Architecture - Experience in deploying Teamcenter solutions on Cloud platforms like AWS and Azure, enhancing scalability and accessibility. 
 - Data Migration and Legacy Integration - Assist in data migration efforts, mapping, and data validation from legacy applications (Windchill) to Teamcenter, ensuring data integrity and accuracy. 
 - Agile Project Management - Leverage Agile project methodologies and Sprint-wise delivery to facilitate efficient project execution. 

  

What you'll bring

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 
 - A minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience in Teamcenter customization and development. 
 - Experience in ITK, RAC, SOA, and AWC customization, showcasing your expertise in creating tailored solutions. 
 - Expert knowledge of AWC customization and configuration, UI customization, extension layers for Rich Client, and tool integrations. 
 - Familiarity with BMIDE configuration, Property settings, application configuration, and administration activities. 
 - Proficiency in programming languages such as C, C++/. net, Java
 - Strong familiarity with ITK (rule handler, action handler, extension, Utility) and RAC (GUI creation, calling SOA - custom and OOTB). 
 - Experience working with Lab systems like Empower, Electronic Lab Notebook, OpenLab, Compliance Builder. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice. 

AI Disclaimer

Baxter may use AI-enabled technologies to support portions of the hiring process, such as scheduling or skills matching. Final decisions regarding candidate applications and selection are made by our hiring teams, who review any AI-assisted outputs before decisions are made, and we remain committed to fairness, inclusion, and thoughtful decision-making led by our hiring teams throughout the selection process. Our AI-enabled technologies do not automatically disqualify candidates or make hiring decisions.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 

Microsoft's Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 

Within Microsoft Fabric, the Data Analytics team delivers the core analytics experiences that allow customers to turn data into insight and action. Spanning data engineering, data warehousing, data science, and AI, this team enables end-to-end scenarios on a single, unified platform. By bringing structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data together, the team is advancing our mission to provide a seamless analytics experience that drives real business impact at enterprise scale. 

The Azure Data Engineering Infrastructure team is hiring for Senior Software Engineer to technically lead the infrastructure services that powers critical Azure Data products. In this role, the right candidate would be accountable for the end-end-end feature delivery, reliability, compliance, customer support of owned services and deliver success leading a team of engineers. 

We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. 

Responsibilities

Adopt AI-first development practices for creating, implementing, optimizing, debugging, refactoring, and reusing code to establish and enhance features, performance, maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI). 

Collaborate with appropriate stakeholders to determine user requirements for product scenarios. 

Drive end-to-end across multiple teams starting from identification of, documentation of design to completion of development of a feature, product, application, service, or platform. 

Leverage subject-matter expertise of product features and partner with appropriate stakeholders (e. g. , product managers) in driving workgroup's project plans, release plans, and work items. 

Act as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) and guide other engineers in developing and following the playbook, working on call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions, alerting stakeholders about status and initiates actions to restore system/product/service for simple and complex problems when appropriate. 

Proactively seek new knowledge and adapt to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale. 

Embody our culture and values

Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering or Mathematics or Physics or related technical discipline. 

8+ years of software engineering and product development experience in industry

8+ years of proven track record of shipping end-user software services or products

8+ years of in-depth object-oriented programming experience in (not limited to) Java/C++/C#

Equal ability in reading and enhancing existing code as well as writing entirely new code from scratch. 

Job Requirements: Other & Additional

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

Preferred/Additional Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering or Mathematics or Physics or related technical discipline. 

Experience with open-source software components. 

Experience working on continuous integration and flighting services toolset. 

Curiosity and willingness to question. 

High enthusiasm, integrity, ingenuity, results-orientation, self-motivation, and resourcefulness in a fast-paced environment. 

Have a deep desire to work collaboratively, solve problems with groups, find winning solutions and celebrate successes. 

Get excited by the challenge of hard technical problems. 

Love the next problem, the next experiment, the next partner. 

Solve problems by always leading with deep passion and empathy for customers. 

Experience working with Service Fabric or Kubernetes. 

Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

data.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering | Technology Delivery Leadership — Azure Cloud, Web Applications, Salesforce, and Payments
data.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned technology leader to serve as Senior Manager, Software Engineering. This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across Azure Cloud, modern web applications, Salesforce, and payment platforms. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with disciplined execution, build high-performing engineering teams, and coordinate complex initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. This leader will translate business priorities into scalable technology outcomes while strengthening engineering practices, operational resilience, security, and accountability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end execution: Own planning, architecture alignment, engineering delivery, testing, release readiness, production launch, and post-production stabilization for a portfolio of strategic initiatives. 
 - Drive multi-platform delivery: Provide leadership across Azure Cloud services, web application ecosystems, Salesforce capabilities and integrations, and payment processing platforms. 
 - Translate strategy into outcomes: Partner with product, business, architecture, security, risk, operations, and infrastructure leaders to convert priorities into roadmaps, executable plans, and measurable results. 
 - Strengthen engineering excellence: Champion scalable architecture, secure coding, automation, CI/CD, observability, performance engineering, reliability, and disciplined software development lifecycle practices. 
 - Build high-performing teams: Recruit, develop, coach, and retain engineers; establish clear expectations, empower decision-making, and create succession and capability-development plans. 
 - Coordinate globally: Align teams, vendors, dependencies, and stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones, ensuring clear ownership, effective handoffs, and timely escalation of risks and decisions. 
 - Manage delivery health: Establish transparent governance for scope, schedule, quality, budget, capacity, dependencies, risks, and technical debt; use metrics to guide decisions and continuous improvement. 
 - Own operational outcomes: Ensure platforms meet availability, resilience, security, compliance, recovery, and support expectations; lead effective incident response and root-cause remediation. 
 - Influence technology direction: Evaluate emerging technologies, guide build-versus-buy decisions, and shape modernization plans that balance innovation, maintainability, cost, and risk. 
 - Communicate with impact: Provide concise, data-driven updates to senior leaders and stakeholders, surfacing trade-offs and enabling timely decisions. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Proven technology delivery experience, including significant experience leading engineering teams across multiple projects/initiatives in parallel. 
 - Demonstrated success delivering complex, enterprise-scale programs from concept through production and ongoing operations. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Azure Cloud architecture and services, cloud-native design, integration patterns, APIs, and DevSecOps practices. 
 - Experience overseeing modern web application delivery, including front-end, back-end, security, performance, accessibility, and production support considerations. 
 - Experience with Salesforce platforms, custom development, integrations, release management, and governance. 
 - Experience with payment ecosystems, including transaction flows, integrations, reconciliation, resiliency, security, and regulatory or control requirements. 
 - Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, resolve cross-team dependencies, and lead distributed teams across geographies. 
 - Strong financial, vendor, resource, risk, and change-management capabilities. 
 - Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and decision-making skills. 

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Pune Office

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3, 000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe. 

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10, 000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

data.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking a Head of Strategic Program to lead large program ownership and strategic innovation across our GCDC tech stack. This leader will shape the ZICC GCDC operations, drive measurable business outcomes, and elevate our capabilities through AI-driven automation, scalable architecture, and modern engineering/operating practices. 

The role blends hands-on program and program leadership with thought leadership-partnering closely with Sales, Service, Marketing, Data/AI, Security, and eCommerce Technology teams to deliver reliable releases, accelerate adoption, improve customer and agent experiences, and ensure governance, data quality, and compliance. Success requires a strong point of view on platform strategy, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, with a persistent focus on leveraging AI (e. g. , agent assist, next-best-action, intelligent case routing, predictive insights) and automation to reduce friction, cost-to-serve, and time-to-value. 

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

- Delivery ownership & roadmap leadership: Own end-to-end delivery across large complex programs, ensuring predictable execution, quality, and measurable outcomes; define and drive the value stream - eCommerce + CRM + customer data strategy and roadmap aligned with Sales, Service, Data/AI, Security, and Technology stakeholders 25%
 - Strategic innovation (AI/automation) & platform direction: Provide thought leadership on platform architecture, operating model, and best practices to scale capabilities and reduce time-to-value; champion AI and automation (e. g. , intelligent routing, agent assist, next-best-action, workflow automation) to improve customer/agent experience and reduce cost-to-serve 20%
 - Governance, adoption & value realization: Establish governance for ZICC hiring, data quality, privacy, security, and compliance, including standards for releases, integrations, and reusable components; drive adoption and benefits realization through change management, enablement, KPI dashboards, and continuous optimization of user journeys and processes 15%
 - People & partner leadership: Build, coach, and retain high-performing teams and partners, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and innovation 20%
 - Financial & commercial management: Own portfolio financial management including estimates and budgeting, forecasting, accruals vs. actuals, and vendor commercial governance including SOW development/review, PO management, and spend tracking 20%

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

- Proactively take up challenges across the technology landscape 
 - Work with technical contacts to ensure support and resolution of technical challenges 
 - Work with cross functional teams across the organization including business stakeholders, Value stream teams and business process team 
 - Groom and mentor teams

RESOURCES MANAGED

Financial Accountability

- Lead key programs and BAU delivery for Global Commercial, owning end-to-end execution across large technical programs with strong governance, quality, and on-time outcomes. 
 - Own portfolio financials, managing an estimated ~$1M delivery/resource budget plus an additional budget for software licensing, including forecasting, accruals vs. actuals, and value tracking. 
 - Manage vendor commercial operations-estimates, SOWs, POs, and contract controls-ensuring cost transparency and delivery accountability. 

Supervision

People leadership: Directly manage a core team of 4-6 team members and provide matrix/indirect leadership for delivery, ensuring clear accountability, capacity planning, and performance outcomes. 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - MBA or Master's (preferred) for portfolio, finance, and operating-model leadership. 
 - Certifications (preferred): 
 - Microsoft Azure technology Stack 
 - Delivery/ways of working: SAFe / Scrum / ITIL (as applicable)

TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

- Technical & domain experience (typical for this level) 
 - 10+ years in Azure platforms and enterprise delivery; 5+ years leading teams/programs in a matrixed global environment. 
 - Deep development ecosystem experience: React, Angular, Rest, Azure platform technology stacks 
 - Integration & architecture: API-led integration patterns (REST/SOAP, events), middleware (MuleSoft or equivalent), ERP/Order, Marketing platforms, and knowledge of SSO/IAM. 
 - Data and analytics: strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, metadata management, and analytics/BI consumption; comfort partnering with data engineering and governance teams. 
 - AI & automation: practical experience applying AI for sales/service productivity (e. g. , summarization, next-best-action, case classification/routing, agent assist) and automation using Flow, orchestration, and low-code tooling with appropriate controls. 
 - DevOps & quality: experience with CI/CD, release management, environment strategy, testing automation, and operational readiness; tools such as Copado/Gearset/Jenkins/Git (any mix). 
 - Security, risk, and compliance: experience designing with privacy/consent, role-based access, auditability, and regulated-data handling; strong partnership with InfoSec and Risk. 
 - Financial/vendor management: estimating, budgeting/accruals/actuals, license cost management, and commercial governance including SOWs, POs, and supplier performance. 

PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Travel -10%

Office attendance- 50% attendance or as per local HR policy

About Zoetis

At Zoetis, our purpose is to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals. As a Fortune 500 company and the world leader in animal health, we discover, develop, manufacture and commercialize vaccines, medicines, diagnostics and other technologies for companion animals and livestock. We know our people drive our success. Our award-winning culture, built around our Core Beliefs, focuses on our colleagues' careers, connection and support. We offer competitive healthcare and retirement savings benefits, along with an array of benefits, policies and programs to support employee well-being in every sense, from health and financial wellness to family and lifestyle resources.

Expert - Full Stack Development - IN

Full Stack Development are involved in full stack development and implement end-to-end components of custom applications. Their job involves designing and developing the UI, business logic, data & integration layer along with testing and maintenance of these layers. 

Key Responsibilities And Duties

- They are adept in the use of tools and technologies across tiers, and are proficient in working with systems infrastructure, creating, querying & manipulating databases, APIs and integration, Front-end code (HTML/CSS, bootstrap, React JS, Angular JS) and web stack back-end technologies (PHP, Python, Java, ruby on rails etc. ). 
 - They have a sound understanding of CI/CD processes, agile development. 
 - They possess deep understanding of programming fundamentals and can learn new frameworks, languages and tools as required on projects. 

Educational Requirements

- University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience

- 10+ Years Required

Physical Requirements

- Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Career Level

9IC

Associate Director - AWS, Python & Snowflake Developer

Experience Required

10+ years of relevant technology experience, with substantial hands-on engineering work in cloud data platforms

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Associate Director to join our team who continues to write code and build solutions. This role requires deep, practical expertise in AWS, Python, and Snowflake, with a strong emphasis on Snowpark development, serverless architectures, and orchestrated data pipelines. The ideal candidate combines senior-level technical depth with the ability to guide architecture decisions and mentor engineering teams. 

Must-Have Skills (Core Requirements)

- Python Development

Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, including building production-grade data processing applications, writing efficient and maintainable code, and working with common libraries used in data engineering workflows. 

- Snowflake & Snowpark

Demonstrated experience building and deploying Snowpark stored procedures, working with Snowflake's data engineering capabilities, writing efficient SQL, and optimizing Snowflake warehouses and query performance for large-scale datasets. 

- AWS Cloud Services

Practical, Hands-on Experience With: 

- AWS Lambda for serverless compute and event-driven processing
 - Amazon S3 for data storage, lifecycle management, and integration with downstream pipelines
 - General familiarity with the AWS ecosystem to support cross-service integrations
 - Workflow Orchestration

Experience designing, building, and maintaining DAGs (using tools such as Apache Airflow or equivalent orchestration frameworks) to manage complex, multi-step data pipelines with dependencies, scheduling, and failure handling. 

- Secondary Skills (Good to Have)
 - Version control proficiency with Git, including branching strategies, pull request workflows, and CI/CD integration
 - Familiarity with additional AWS services such as Glue, Step Functions, CloudWatch, IAM, ECS/EKS, or SNS/SQS
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation)
 - Exposure to containerization (Docker) and deployment pipelines
 - Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance practices in cloud environments
 - Domain Knowledge

Prior exposure to or working knowledge of the asset management/Investment banking or broader financial services industry is a strong plus. Familiarity with investment data concepts, portfolio management systems, or regulatory reporting requirements in this space would be beneficial. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable data engineering solutions using Python, Snowflake, and AWS services
 - Build and optimize Snowpark stored procedures for complex data transformations
 - Develop serverless applications leveraging AWS Lambda integrated with S3 and other AWS services

The individual would also lead efforts in planning, execution of all infrastructure needs which would include hardware, Servers & Tools required for efficient execution of Projects delivered by the team at MEIC. The individual must inspire, coach and mentor Associate Directors, Managers, Sr Pr/ Principal Software Engineers, Technical Leads and Engineers with diverse skills sets and technologies. This individual must lead the product innovation & champion industry best practices by applying an array of technologies, tools, and standards throughout the SW support that MEIC provides across the Surgical Robotics Team and Functional Partnerships in various stages of Product Development, RPE and support as required to ensure superior performance and value delivery. 

The ideal candidate is a technology expert as well as a critical thinker who would collaborate across the disciplines - product design, software architecture and development, software engineering process, operational performance, and customer support. The individual must be able build strong relationships across the matrix. The individual must be a self-starter and should be able to strongly influence the design of new products, processes, standards, or operational plans. The individual must improve the existing processes and systems using significant conceptualizing, reasoning and interpretation. The individual must interact with internal and external customers and vendors at various levels, including executive leadership, on significant matters. 

The role requirement for the current & potential engagements with the OU would require: 

- Agile software product development experience

 - Data Science, Product Security experience / exposure

Position: Senior Software Engineer II (SSE 2) - Backend Platform & Data System

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer II (SSE 2) to join our Core Platform team. In this role, you will design, architect, and optimize the high-throughput real-time data pipelines, advanced polyglot storage layers, and core backend orchestration microservices that power our enterprise AI/ML Platform. 

This role is heavily focused on advanced backend software engineering and highly concurrent distributed systems. You will build the foundational software layer that enables our platform to interact dynamically with massive streaming datasets. Using a mix of Golang and Python, you will orchestrate real-time data streams through Kafka and Apache Spark, and design highly resilient distributed data layers utilizing Apache Cassandra alongside PostgreSQL. As a senior leader, you will champion modern development workflows, utilizing AI coding assistants to optimize engineering velocity across the team. You will scale these capabilities across Amazon EKS (Kubernetes) and AWS cloud infrastructure. 

Key Responsibilities

- Backend Architecture: Design, build, and optimize high-concurrency production-grade architectures and runtime engines using Golang and Python. 
 - Advanced Engineering Workflows: Lead by example in utilizing advanced AI coding interfaces to accelerate code generation, framework migrations, system debugging, and documentation standards. 
 - Polyglot Storage & System Design: 
 - Architect and optimize highly available Apache Cassandra data models, managing partition keys and CQL queries to ingest massive streaming execution logs. 
 - Design robust relational schemas, query tuning, and index optimizations in PostgreSQL to handle transactional states and analytical metadata. 
 - Streaming & Event Orchestration: Architect resilient data streaming architectures utilizing Apache Kafka for event sourcing, alongside Apache Spark for high-velocity real-time and batch data processing pipelines. 
 - Technical Leadership & Quality Control: Drive architectural reviews, establish engineering standards for platform reliability, enforce CI/CD, and mentor junior-to-mid-level engineers on scaling distributed data layers. 

Required Technical Skills & Experience

- AI Tooling (Must Have): Direct, deep hands-on experience integrating AI-powered development environments and LLM assistants (e. g. , Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) into your workflow to significantly accelerate systems engineering and debugging tasks. 
 - Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Golang (Go) for writing highly concurrent, memory-efficient systems, and strong production experience in Python. 
 - Data Stream Technologies: Production experience implementing and managing enterprise-scale Apache Kafka topologies and distributed processing frameworks like Apache Spark. 
 - Database Management (NoSQL & Relational): Deep understanding of distributed storage trade-offs (CAP theorem) with advanced hands-on experience in Apache Cassandra and PostgreSQL. 
 - Containerization & Orchestration: Production-level experience with Docker and multi-cluster orchestration via Kubernetes / AWS EKS. 

Qualifications

- Professional Experience: 6 to 8+ years of non-internship professional backend software engineering experience. 
 - Data & Systems Background: 3+ years of experience specifically focused on distributed systems, real-time data streaming pipelines, polyglot storage design, or platform engineering for data-intensive applications. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Distributed Systems, Software Engineering, or a highly technical related domain

Job Purpose

IT PMO (Partnerships): Own end-to-end solutioning, system architecture, and API-led partner integrations, driving cross-system delivery from requirement discussions to go-live across the BFL. 

Duties And Responsibilities

- Drive end-to-end solutioning for partner integrations, covering JV and co-lending journeys across 4W/TWF flows. 
 - Lead detailed requirement discussions with partner teams, translating into US/UD aligned to BFL partnership framework. 
 - Design and own integration architecture across systems: Partner MW, PMW DB, DL, HMW, BRE, Risk, 3-in-1, 3-in-1 MW, COSMOS, SFDC, Pennant LMS. 
 - Define and govern API flows including Create Application, KFS generation, Cancel, Status, Webhooks, and Additional Info APIs. 
 - Ensure correct mapping of data fields, product configurations, and BRE logic across SFDC and Middleware layers. 
 - Act as solution SPOC, coordinating with API, DB, Middleware, SFDC, BRE, and Data Lake teams for seamless delivery. 
 - Drive partner onboarding, including API specs alignment, CUG/UAT execution, webhook setup, and production readiness. 
 - Manage end-to-end delivery timelines for partners, tracking dependencies like SFDC Convert, API readiness, and partner callbacks.

 - Monitor funnel metrics, disbursal flows, and API performance, ensuring scalability and stability post go-live training to IT staff and end-users on SCCM and Intune usage and capabilities.

- Solution Design Across Systems: Defining scalable integration architecture across partners, Partner MW, PMW DB, DL, HMW, BRE, Risk, 3-in-1, 3-in-1 MW, COSMOS, SFDC, Pennant LMS while balancing speed vs reusability. 
 - Managing Changing Requirements: Handling evolving partner/COE requirements and deciding scope freeze vs CR during UAT and delivery phases. 
 - Dependency & Timeline Control: Navigating critical dependencies (SFDC Convert, APIs, partner readiness) and deciding parallel vs sequential execution. 
 - Partner Readiness & Go-Live Calls: Driving partner integration (APIs, webhooks, mapping) and taking go-live decisions despite partial readiness.

Major Challenges

- Complex cross-system delivery & dependencies: Managing integrations across partners, Middleware, DL, 3in1, SFDC, SFDC MW and LMS with evolving requirements, partner readiness gaps, and limited control over external teams.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Technology; MBA preferred. 
 - 3-4 years of experience in IT PMO / Product / Solution roles (preferably BFSI / Fintech).

 - Understanding of Agile methodologies, requirement documentation (US/UD/BRD).

 - Experience in solutioning and system design for co-lending/JV journeys, preferably with BFDL or similar partners.

data.description:
Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - Mantri

Job Purpose

The QA Automation Engineer role exists to ensure high-quality delivery of Salesforce and related business applications through effective manual testing, Playwright-based automation, API validation, regression coverage, and structured defect management. The role contributes to reliable releases by building reusable automation scripts, validating business-critical workflows, and supporting faster, more controlled delivery through Azure DevOps, Git, and CI/CD practices. 

Duties And Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities: 

- Develop, enhance, and maintain Playwright automation scripts using JavaScript and TypeScript for Salesforce and related application workflows. 
 - Design reusable automation components using page object model, modular scripting practices, and data-driven testing approaches. 
 - Execute UI, API, functional, and regression testing to validate business-critical Salesforce processes and release changes. 
 - Create, update, and maintain test cases, test execution records, and traceability in Azure DevOps Test Plans or JIRA. 
 - Log, track, retest, and validate defects through Azure DevOps Boards or JIRA, ensuring clear documentation and timely closure. 
 - Integrate and maintain automation suites within CI/CD pipelines and support Git-based version control practices. 
 - Collaborate with developers, business analysts, QA leads, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and support release readiness. 

Key Decisions / Dimensions

- Selection of suitable test scenarios for automation based on regression impact, business criticality, stability, and reusability. 
 - Choice of appropriate Playwright locators, assertions, waits, browser handling methods, and reusable automation design patterns. 
 - Prioritization of test execution, defect retesting, and automation maintenance activities in line with release timelines and QA priorities. 
 - Identification of defects, documentation of observations, and recommendation of severity or impact based on business workflow understanding. 
 - Determination of whether test failures are caused by script issues, environment instability, test data gaps, or actual application defects. 
 - Recommendations for improving automation coverage, reporting, framework maintainability, and CI/CD execution effectiveness. |
 - Direct Reports/Supervision (if applicable): [1-3 junior test engineers] depending on POD size
 - Change Requests/Feature Testing & Regression per month: 110 Man-days or 5 Man-months

Major Challenges

- Maintaining stable and reusable Playwright automation scripts while handling frequent UI changes, dynamic Salesforce components, and evolving business workflows. 
 - Ensuring adequate regression coverage within tight release timelines while balancing manual validation, automation execution, and defect retesting activities. 
 - Debugging framework-level and script-level automation failures, including locator instability, waits, assertions, browser handling, and test data dependencies. 
 - Coordinating with developers, BAs, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, validate expected behavior, and ensure timely closure of defects. 
 - Maintaining accurate test documentation, execution evidence, and defect updates across Azure DevOps Test Plans, Boards, or JIRA. 
 - Supporting CI/CD execution of automation suites while ensuring failures are analysed and reported with clear root cause details. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Qualifications

Bachelor's / master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Relevant QA automation certification or Salesforce testing exposure will be preferred. 

- Work Experience

3 to 4 years of QA and automation testing experience, including minimum 2+ years of hands-on Playwright automation using JavaScript and TypeScript. Salesforce testing experience is preferred. 

Skills and Knowledge

- Strong hands-on experience in Playwright automation using JavaScript and TypeScript. 
 - Good understanding of page object model, reusable automation design, data-driven frameworks, and maintainable scripting practices. 
 - Strong knowledge of Playwright locators, assertions, waits, browser handling, test execution, and debugging techniques. 
 - Experience in UI, API, functional, and regression automation testing for web-based applications. 
 - Exposure to Salesforce testing, including validation of business workflows, user journeys, and integrated processes. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps Test Plans and Boards or JIRA for test management, defect logging, tracking, and closure. 
 - Hands-on API testing experience using Postman and ability to validate request-response flows, status codes, payloads, and integration behaviour. 
 - Working knowledge of Git, branching practices, code reviews, and maintaining automation scripts in version control. 
 - Experience integrating automation suites with CI/CD pipelines and analysing pipeline execution results. 
 - Exposure to automation reporting integrations such as Allure reports and Playwright reports. 
 - Good understanding of Agile methodology, sprint ceremonies, QA estimation, test execution planning, and release validation. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Skills Keywords

Playwright, JavaScript, TypeScript, Salesforce Testing, QA Automation, UI Testing, API Testing, Postman, Regression Automation, Page Object Model, Data-driven Frameworks, Playwright Locators, Assertions, Waits, Browser Handling, Automation Debugging, Azure DevOps Test Plans, Azure DevOps Boards, JIRA, Bug Tracking, Defect Management, Git, CI/CD Pipelines, Allure Reports, Playwright Reports, Agile Methodology, Test Case Design, Test Execution, Defect Validation, Stakeholder Collaboration, Release Testing

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story. 

Your role and responsibilities: 

In this role The Quality Specialist - Supplier Quality, Vendor Development & Incoming Inspection is responsible for end-to-end supplier quality management for vendors engaged in manufacturing processes including Molding (Injection/Compression), Stamping, Resistance Welding, and Plating. This role encompasses vendor qualification, process development, quality audits, Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) implementation, incoming material inspection, and corrective action management. This role demands solid knowledge in Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) operation, dimensional metrology, process-specific quality parameters, supplier audits, PPAP methodologies, APQP/FMEA tools, and ISO 9001: 2015 compliance within a manufacturing environment. 

The work model for the role is: 

The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification, Smart Building Business to be based at Nelamangala, Bangalore India. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Supplier Qualification & Development - Evaluate, qualify, and develop suppliers across Molding, Stamping, Resistance Welding, and Plating processes through capability assessments, process audits, quality system audits, supplier scorecards, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Supplier Audits & PPAP Management - Plan and conduct initial, periodic, and surveillance audits; manage PPAP Level 0-5 for new parts and engineering/process changes, reviewing PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, FAI, and PSW documentation. 
 - Incoming Quality & Process Control - Manage IQC activities and material clearance through SAP Usage Decision (UD), while establishing process-specific inspection standards and monitoring critical quality parameters, Cp/Cpk, SPC, and measurement system effectiveness. 
 - Supplier Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions - Manage supplier rejection, RGA, NC tracking, 8D corrective actions, SNCRP, root-cause analysis, and verification of corrective action effectiveness; support resolution of supplier-related customer complaints. 
 - Supplier Performance, Compliance & Quality Assurance - Lead supplier performance reviews, monitor Defect PPM, OTD, Cost, Cp/Cpk, and responsiveness, maintain quality documentation and certifications, and ensure compliance with applicable IEC, UL, CE, RoHS, ISO 9001: 2015, and customer-specific requirements. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution. 
 - 5-10 years of relevant experience in Supplier Quality, Supplier Development, or Quality Assurance within a manufacturing environment. 
 - Practical experience in at least 2-3 manufacturing processes, including Injection Molding, Metal Stamping, Resistance Welding, and Plating. 
 - Minimum 3 years of practical experience in supplier audits, vendor assessments, process audits, and supplier qualification. 
 - Practical experience in PPAP, APQP, PFMEA/FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA/Gauge R&R, GD&T, and supplier approval processes. 
 - Mandatory proficiency in CMM operation and programming, using ZEISS CALYPSO, along with knowledge of dimensional and material testing. 
 - Experience in Switchgear, Electrical, Automobile, or Heavy Engineering industries, with knowledge/certification in ISO 9001: 2015/IATF 16949, Six Sigma/Lean, PPAP, APQP, FMEA, and process-specific quality standards.

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to develop and maintain automated testing solutions for enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, and document-processing platforms in a financial services environment. 

This is a hands-on software engineering and test automation role. The SDET will work closely with developers, platform SMEs, architects, DevOps engineers, and product teams to ensure applications are functionally correct, reliable, scalable, secure, and production-ready. 

The ideal candidate has strong programming and automation skills and can validate complex end-to-end workflows spanning . NET/Java services, REST APIs, event-driven systems, AWS, EKS/Kubernetes, databases, document capture, and Enterprise Content Management platforms. 

The SDET will take ownership of test automation throughout the software development lifecycle and ensure quality is engineered into the product rather than validated only at the end of development.

Document Ingestion → API/Service → Queue/Event → Captiva Processing → Documentum Repository → Search/Retrieval → Downstream Application

- Test event-driven and asynchronous processing, including message delivery, retries, duplicate handling, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, and failure recovery.

data.title: Manager, Customer Identity, Security Engineering
data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology-anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.   

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.   

Join our team! We're building a world where Identity belongs to you. 

The Role

We seek a technical, research-minded Security Engineering Manager to lead security engineering teams within Auth0 Customer Identity. Your teams' work spans two areas. The first is threat protection: providing general and AI-driven threat intelligence in partnership with Identity Security, and researching how attackers leverage AI, how we build AI-assisted defenses, and how we protect AI workloads across our products, infrastructure, and customer tenants. The second is software development for security: building micro-services and tooling that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including how secrets are generated, stored, distributed, rotated, and retired. 

This role leads teams embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to deliver proactive threat intelligence, get ahead of emerging attack vectors, and build the security software that protects our platform, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business. 

We are an engineering-focused organization that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you will set direction for teams that don't just assess our current security posture - they research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, build the software that delivers those protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses and secure-by-default secrets handling into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants. 

You will lead a globally distributed group of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta's Secure Identity Commitment. 

You will stay technical enough to challenge designs, evaluate research, review software architecture, and earn the respect of strong engineers, while spending most of your time on leadership: hiring, growing, and retaining your teams and shaping their roadmaps. 

Responsibilities: 

- Hire, lead, coach, and develop globally distributed teams of security engineers (Senior through Staff), building a culture of research discipline, technical excellence, and ownership
 - Define and execute a multi-quarter roadmap for your teams, aligned with Customer Identity business goals and Okta's company-wide security strategy, and balance investment and prioritization across them
 - Lead the delivery of scalable, reliable micro-services and automation that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including secrets storage, rotation, access control, auditing, and workload identity
 - Drive adoption of secure-by-default secrets handling across Auth0 engineering teams, and reduce the risk from hard-coded, long-lived, or over-privileged credentials
 - Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12-24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from, then prioritize investments in detection, tooling, and protections to get there
 - Direct research and protections against emerging general and AI-driven security threats targeting Auth0 and Auth0's customers - including traditional identity attacks as well as adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP), and data poisoning - as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants
 - Guide the review and hardening of Auth0's AI security offering, using analysis of past incidents to drive improvements such as new detection signals, heuristic updates, and data labeling enhancements, while identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited
 - Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through comprehensive defenses and security countermeasures
 - Partner across Product, Engineering, and Identity Security leadership to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants, both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)
 - Drive adoption of scalable security solutions and automation that operationalize threat defenses and secrets protections at scale
 - Own and influence high-impact security architecture decisions across Auth0 and Okta Customer Identity infrastructure to support long-term threat resilience
 - Collaborate with the Okta Security team on security operations and, where relevant, support investigations, root cause analysis, and remediation
 - Advise stakeholders on mitigation strategies for security risks, including end-of-life software and vulnerabilities, in support of the teams that own patching
 - Communicate risk, progress, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership, and turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams
 - Manage team health, prioritization, and delivery across time zones, including IndiaWhat this position is not:   

- Dedicated application security, line-by-line code review, or compliance-focused leadership
 - Owning reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function - this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them
 - A purely people-management role without technical depthRequirements: 

- You have 8+ years of experience in security engineering, with a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure and/or product security
 - You have 3+ years of experience managing security or software engineering teams, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers
 - You have a hands-on development background - Go / Node preferred - sufficient to guide the design and review of micro-services, evaluate prototypes, and steer the building of security tooling and AI-powered defenses

data.title: Senior Payments Engineer — Acquiring & Payment Processing
data.description:
The salary range for this role is $5, 000 - $9, 500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation{{{{~}}}}

For this senior development role, with 7+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5, 000 - $9, 500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience. 

About the Role{{{{~}}}}

We're hiring a Senior Payments Engineer to own and scale the systems at the heart of Sezzle's acquiring and payment-processing stack - the services that integrate with processors and gateways (Stripe, Adyen, Fiserv, Plaid, and more partners from the broader acquiring ecosystem), move funds, and keep transactions accurate, auditable, and resilient. 

This is a backend-focused, high-ownership role. You'll partner closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Support, as well as other engineering teams, to deliver scalable solutions to hard problems in authorization, settlement, reconciliation, and disputes. You'll mentor teammates, unblock peers, and occasionally lead small project teams to delivery. 

What You'll Do{{{{~}}}}

- Design and build backend services in Golang that integrate with payment processors, gateways, and card networks
 - Own critical money-movement flows end to end{{{{~}}}} authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, reconciliation, and chargeback/dispute handling
 - Build idempotent, fault-tolerant, auditable transaction processing within a distributed architecture (transactional outbox patterns; queues such as Kafka, SQS, or RabbitMQ)
 - Operate within PCI DSS scope - tokenization, network tokens, secure handling of payment data, and 3DS/SCA flows where applicable
 - Instrument and monitor payment health{{{{~}}}} authorization/decline rates, processor performance, latency, and settlement accuracy, driving continuous improvement
 - Use AI tooling (Claude and equivalent LLMs) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate design, coding, research, testing, and documentation - within Sezzle's security and data-handling policies
 - Mentor engineers and help raise the bar across the team
 - Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. 

What We Look For{{{{~}}}}

- 7+ years of backend or full-stack engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on payments, fintech, or money-movement systems
 - Strong Go (preferred), or comparable experience in Python, building and serving REST APIs
 - Hands-on experience integrating with payment processors, gateways, or acquiring systems, and familiarity with payments fundamentals{{{{~}}}} authorization vs. settlement, tokenization, idempotency, reconciliation, and chargebacks/disputes
 - Experience in distributed, cloud-based architectures using patterns like transactional outboxes or queuing tools (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ)
 - Demonstrated, hands-on use of Claude or an equivalent LLM to enhance productivity, research, and communication - you're comfortable making AI a core part of how you work and can show how it's improved your output
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 

Preferred Knowledge and Skills{{{{~}}}}

- Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
 - Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting. 
 - DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
 - Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
 - Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
 - A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback. 

Nice to Have

- Direct experience with payments acquiring ecosystem like; Adyen, Stripe, Marqeta, Fiserv, etc. 
 - Exposure to PCI DSS, 3DS/SCA, network tokenization, or payments compliance
 - SQL-based RDBMS through an ORM
 - Observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic) for production instrumentation and alerting
 - DevOps / CI/CD pipeline experience; containerized microservices on Kubernetes / AWS
 - A track record of shipping commercial payment APIs and prioritizing based on stakeholder/customer feedback

AI at Sezzle

Sezzle runs an AI-first product and engineering culture - we start projects in Claude and expect engineers to use AI to move faster and think more rigorously. In a payments environment, we do this responsibly{{{{~}}}} AI tools accelerate how we design, build, and document, but cardholder data, credentials, and secrets never leave our secured environment. We're looking for someone who treats AI fluency and secure-by-default engineering as two sides of the same skill. 

About You{{{{~}}}}

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
 - You're not bound by convention - your success-and much of the fun-lies in developing new ways to do things
 - You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
 - You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
 - You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. 
 - You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. 

Sezzle's Technology Stack{{{{~}}}}

- Languages{{{{~}}}} Golang, Typescript, Python
 - Frontend{{{{~}}}} Typescript - React and React Native
 - Backend{{{{~}}}} Golang
 - Database{{{{~}}}} MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
 - DevOps & Cloud{{{{~}}}} AWS, Kubernetes
 - Version Control{{{{~}}}} Git
 - CI/CD{{{{~}}}} Gitlab
 - Testing{{{{~}}}} Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
 - Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

• 6-10 years in precision machine-shop quality, with hands-on experience in both CNC turning and VMC machining. 

• Diploma, B. E. or B. Tech in Mechanical, Production or a related engineering discipline.

Department

ADAS - Firmware Engineering (BSW/ASW)

Head - Embedded Systems/Program Management (ADAS OEM)

8-12 years in automotive embedded/firmware development, with 3+ years in a technical leadership and people management

ABOUT THE ROLE

Novus Hi-Tech Robotic Systemz Pvt. Ltd. is seeking an experienced Engineering Manager - Firmware to lead firmware development for its ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) Business Unit. This role owns the technical direction, delivery, and quality of embedded firmware across radar- and vision-based ADAS platforms, while also managing and mentoring a team of embedded/firmware engineers. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on expertise in automotive embedded systems with proven people and program leadership. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead end-to-end firmware (BSW & ASW) development for ADAS products across Qualcomm, Infineon, ST, and NXP/KEA platforms, covering radar and vision-based systems. 
 - Own the technical architecture and design of AUTOSAR-based embedded software, including RTE, BSW module configuration, and diagnostics. 
 - Drive functional safety compliance (ISO 26262, ASIL-D) across the firmware development lifecycle, from requirements through verification and validation. 
 - Define and enforce automotive cybersecurity practices to ensure secure firmware and system architectures. 
 - Manage bootloader and device driver development, and lead low-level debugging (CAN, hardware/software integration issues) across platforms. 
 - Build, mentor, and manage a team of firmware/embedded engineers; own technical hiring, performance reviews, and career development for direct reports. 
 - Partner with product management, hardware, systems, and QA teams to translate ADAS product requirements into firmware deliverables and release plans. 
 - Manage project timelines, technical risk, and resource planning for firmware workstreams within the ADAS Business Unit. 
 - Drive innovation and IP generation - identify and file patents in areas such as V2X, radar, suspension/steering control, and in-cabin monitoring. 
 - Establish and improve firmware development processes, coding standards, and review practices across the team. 
 - Act as the primary technical escalation point for firmware issues with OEM and Tier-1 stakeholders. 

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- 8+ years of experience in automotive embedded systems, with direct exposure to ADAS, telematics or camera based systems. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in BSW & ASW development within an AUTOSAR architecture, including RTE and BSW module configuration. 
 - Proven experience delivering safety-critical software compliant with ISO 26262 (ASIL-D) for global OEMs or Tier-1 suppliers. 
 - Working knowledge of automotive cybersecurity principles and secure firmware design. 
 - Practical experience with bootloader development, device drivers, and CAN-based debugging and diagnostics. 
 - Experience developing on Qualcomm, Infineon, ST, and/or NXP/KEA microcontroller/SoC platforms. 
 - Exposure to radar-based and/or vision-based ADAS systems is highly desirable. 
 - Demonstrated track record of technical innovation, ideally with patents filed in automotive/embedded domains (e. g. , V2X, radar, suspension, in-cabin monitoring). 
 - Prior experience leading or mentoring a firmware/embedded engineering team, with the ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people management. 

EDUCATION

- Bachelor's degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred but not mandatory). 

WHAT WE OFFER

- Opportunity to lead firmware development for cutting-edge ADAS products spanning radar, vision, and autonomous driving technologies. 
 - A high-ownership role bridging deep technical leadership with people management within a fast-growing robotics and automotive technology organization.

Job Summary~

We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and Jenkins. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in GCP, along with working knowledge of service mesh technologies like Istio and modern observability tools such as Google Cloud Monitoring and New Relic. 

About the team~

The DevOps team is responsible for building and operating the core infrastructure that powers JioStar's digital platforms. The focus is on automation, scalability, and reliability to ensure seamless delivery and high system uptime. 

The team manages cloud environments across AWS and GCP, containerized workloads on Kubernetes, and service communication using Istio. They enable robust CI/CD pipelines, efficient caching layers (e. g. , Redis), and standardized environment provisioning. 

Acting as the backbone of engineering operations, DevOps ensures secure deployments, proactive monitoring, performance optimization, and cost efficiency across systems. 

The team's mandate is to deliver a resilient, scalable, and high-performing platform that supports rapid development and consistent user experience. 

Key responsibilities~

- Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and other tools
 - Deploy, manage, and scale applications on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)
 - Build and maintain infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
 - Implement and manage service mesh (Istio) for microservices architecture
 - Set up and manage monitoring, alerting, and observability using Google Cloud Monitoring and New Relic

Skills and attributes for success~

Good to Have

Preferred education and experience~

Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. JioStar is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. data.title: Software Engineer - Data Quality
data.description:
About Truveta

Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values. 

Location - Hyderabad, India. 

This opportunity

Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early members, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. 

Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve to benefit from the large-scale technological innovation and digital intelligence that have driven progress in other industries. In this position you will build online services, automation, and tooling that monitor Truveta's data and make sure it continues to meet our high-quality standards. The work calls for creative problem solving and a strong appetite for applying AI and machine learning to anomaly detection, supported by statistical methods, to monitor and reason over big data at scale. 

Who We Need

We are looking for software engineers who are excited by the opportunity to improve healthcare in far-reaching ways, and who sit comfortably at the boundary between production engineering and applied machine learning. You will design and ship services rather than notebooks, and you will be expected to explain why a given detection method suits a given data problem, how you evaluated it, and what its false-alert rate costs the people who receive its alerts. 

Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, collaborative teammates, and people willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. You will learn the healthcare domain quickly, because the quality of clinical data cannot be judged without understanding what the data is meant to represent. 

What You Will Do

In this role you will: 

- Build performant AI-based anomaly detection and monitoring systems, using machine learning and supporting statistical methods to analyze big data at scale. 
 - Design, implement, test, deploy, operate, and tune the online services, automation, and tooling that monitor Truveta's data, contributing hands-on to every stage of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Detect and characterize data-quality issues such as missing or late feeds, volume and distribution shifts, schema and contract drift, duplication, and implausible clinical values. 
 - Develop and evaluate detection approaches, from statistical baselines and time-series methods through machine-learning models, and measure them on precision, recall, and alert usefulness rather than accuracy alone. 
 - Turn detection output into signals people can act on: alerts with root-cause context, data-quality metrics, and dashboards that engineering and clinical teams trust. 
 - Work with data-processing engineers to build quality checks into pipelines so that defects are caught where they are introduced. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, clinical informaticists, architects, and other engineers to define what quality means for each data domain. 
 - Take part in design reviews, code reviews, and the on-call rotation for the services you own. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 1+ of experience building production-quality services on a cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - 2+ years writing Python for machine learning, AI-based data analytics, or statistical modeling. 
 - Hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, operations, and performance. 
 - Working knowledge of the statistics and model-evaluation methods that underpin that modeling work. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to learn a new domain quickly. 
 - Clear written and spoken communication, and comfort collaborating across disciplines. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing and evaluating AI or machine-learning approaches for anomaly detection, with supporting knowledge of statistical methods, time-series analysis, or data-quality monitoring. 
 - Experience working as part of distributed teams, particularly across India and the United States. 
 - Experience processing large datasets with Spark, Databricks, or comparable distributed frameworks, and strong SQL. 
 - Experience running services on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Familiarity with data-quality and observability tooling such as Great Expectations, Deequ, Soda, or equivalent in-house frameworks. 
 - Experience operating machine-learning models in production, including drift monitoring and retraining. 
 - Exposure to healthcare, clinical, or other regulated data.

data.title: Quality Supervisor
data.description:
Company Description Paragon Footwear, founded in 1975 in Kerala, has grown from a small operation to India's leading organized rubber footwear brand with a vast nationwide presence. The company distributes its products through 18 depots and more than 450 distributors, ensuring timely delivery to retailers across the country. Paragon offers a wide range of durable footwear made from rubber, PU, PVC, EVA, and TPR, supported by an in-house design team that continuously develops new models. With ISO 9001 and ISO 14001: 2004 certified factories and a CARE A- rating for bank facilities, Paragon emphasizes strong quality standards and sustainable operations. The organization values its staff and distribution network as key contributors to its success and large-scale annual sales. 
Role Description The Quality Supervisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for overseeing quality standards across footwear production processes. This role includes monitoring product quality on the shop floor, conducting inspections and quality checks, and ensuring adherence to established quality control and quality assurance procedures. The Quality Supervisor will analyze defect trends, support root-cause investigations, and collaborate with production, design, and maintenance teams to implement corrective and preventive actions. The position also involves maintaining documentation for audits, supporting compliance with ISO and internal quality management systems, and training team members on quality guidelines and best practices. The supervisor is expected to coordinate daily with line leaders and operators to drive continuous improvement and consistent product quality. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong skills in Quality Control and Product Quality to oversee inspections and ensure footwear meets defined standards. 
 - Candidates should possess solid Quality Assurance and Quality Management skills to maintain systems, procedures, and compliance with ISO and internal policies. 
 - Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret quality data, identify trends, and support problem-solving and process improvements. 
 - Relevant experience in manufacturing or footwear/consumer goods production, preferably in a supervisory quality role. 
 - Knowledge of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 standards and familiarity with audit and documentation practices. 
 - Diploma or degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Industrial Production, or a related field is preferred. 
 - Ability to lead and coach shop-floor teams, with clear communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Attention to detail, strong organizational abilities, and readiness to work in fast-paced production environments on-site in Hyderabad.

Platform teams own the outcomes. This role makes those outcomes achievable, and its success is measured by how much AI work happens outside the hub, not inside it. Solution delivery sits with the Director, Automation Engineering / Product Manager. Architectural standards and governance sit with the Director, Automation Platform Architect, and this role packages them into something teams can adopt. Delivery method for DPTF sits with the Senior Principal, Agile CoE, and the governed delivery lifecycle itself is owned through the GSK quality management system. 

Key Responsibilities

 - Experience setting patterns, standards or reference implementations adopted by teams outside direct control.

 - Experience building capability in other engineers through coaching, community practice or structured enablement. 
 - Experience translating enterprise standards and policy into something delivery teams can practically apply. 
 - Experience measuring adoption and acting on where uptake is weak. 
 - Experience working across multiple technology domains rather than within a single platform. 
 - Familiarity with Responsible AI requirements and how they are implemented in a delivery pipeline. 

Desirable

Why is this Level of Experience Required?

Skills/Background

 - Ability to build standards that teams adopt willingly, because they are useful, not because they are mandated.
