data.title: Lead Engineer
data.description:
About Bonterra

Bonterra builds software for nonprofits, public agencies, and social good organizations. Our products help these organizations manage programs and measure the outcomes of their work in their communities. 

Our engineering teams build and run cloud-based SaaS applications. We work closely with Product Management, QA, DevOps, Customer Success, and Support to ship software our customers rely on every day. 

Role Summary

As a Lead / Staff Engineer, you are a hands-on contributor who takes on our hardest technical problems. You write production code, verify your work, and answer for what happens after release. You spend most of your time building, not reviewing or advising. 

You own the technical outcome of efforts across multiple teams, including when they go wrong. You decide which problems are worth solving and break large problems into parts others own. 

You use AI across spec, code, and tests, and you hold yourself and your team to a high verification standard. Your influence comes from the work you deliver, not from your title. 

Key Responsibilities

Deliver hard technical work yourself

- Personally build the hardest parts of the system, from design through production code. 
 - Write, test, and ship production code every week. 
 - Take the hardest failures, such as outages hard to reproduce and data problems, and fix the root cause in code. 
 - Build prototypes to settle design debates, then build the production version. 
 - Review the highest-risk changes in addition to your own delivery. 

Verify your work and own production results

- Define how each change is verified before release. Write the tests and checks. 
 - Run the rollout, watch production metrics, and respond when something fails. 
 - Fix the problems you find after release and write down what you learned. 
 - Keep reliability and release quality high in the areas you build. 

Own technical outcomes across teams

- Own the technical outcome of multi-team efforts, from a vague ask to a measured result. 
 - Set the migration or rollout plan, run the response when a cutover fails, and sign off on completion. 
 - Partner with engineering and product leaders on technical sequencing. 

Use AI and set the bar for verification

- Use AI across spec, code, and tests in your own daily work. Explain every line you ship and how you verified the result. 
 - Require evaluation suites for high-risk AI-generated work, such as migrations. 
 - Train the team in the standards you set. 

Decide well on hard problems

- Make design decisions on problems across systems or teams, with competing objectives and high cost if wrong. 
 - Weigh risk, cost, and roadmap tradeoffs. Choose a phased path when the path lowers risk. 
 - Choose the simplest design to meet the need. Write down the decision and the reasons. 
 - Design APIs, schemas, and contracts for durability and correctness, and build them. 

Frame problems and simplify

- Decide which problems are worth solving and which are not. 
 - Cut or cancel work when a smaller change meets the goal. 
 - Name what you chose not to build. 

Align teams and grow engineers

- Align teams with competing goals on one direction, using evidence and working code. 
 - Mentor engineers and leads. Take part in interviews and candidate evaluation. 

What Success Looks Like

- You personally deliver code for the hardest problems in your area, and the code holds up in production. 
 - Every major change you ship has a stated verification plan and a known production result. 
 - Production incidents in your area lead to fixes in code and in process. 
 - Multi-team efforts you lead reach their measured outcomes. 
 - Your team ships AI-assisted work safely, under verification standards you set. 
 - Teams agree on one direction because of the working evidence you provide. 
 - Projects are smaller and clearer because of your framing. 

Requirements

Three requirements are mandatory minimums for this role: technical execution, end-to-end ownership, and AI accountability. We screen for these first. 

- Hands-on code you personally delivered for a hard problem, how you verified the work, and what happened in production. 
 - Recent professional experience writing production code as your primary work, not only prototypes or reviews. 
 - Evidence of accountability for the technical outcome of a multi-team effort, including a failure and how you responded. 
 - A repeatable AI workflow with verification built in, and the standards you set for others. 
 - At least one multi-team outcome, with named teams, decisions, and results. 
 - Examples of design decisions on poorly defined problems, with competing objectives and high cost if wrong. 
 - Examples of cutting scope or deciding not to build, with the evidence you used. 
 - Examples of aligning teams with competing goals, with named people and how the disagreement was resolved. 
 - Production experience with distributed systems, APIs, and cloud infrastructure such as AWS. 
 - Experience designing API and data contracts for durability and correctness. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and leads, and taking part in hiring. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical leaders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or operating AI agents in engineering workflows. 
 - Experience building and evaluating LLM-based systems, including testing for non-deterministic output. 
 - Experience with API schema governance or platform-wide contract management. 
 - Experience with event-driven or serverless architectures. 
 - Experience with security and compliance requirements in a SaaS context. 
 - Interest in building technology for nonprofits and social impact.

data.title: IBMS & Structured Cabling Design (AI Data Centers) - SME
data.description:
Job Title: Subject Matter Expert (SME) - IBMS & Structured Cabling Design (AI Data Centers)

Location: Mumbai

Department: : AI Datacenter Design Engineering & Technical Architecture Tea

Reports To: Head of Design

Position Overview

We are seeking an industry-leading Subject Matter Expert (SME) - Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS) & Structured Cabling Design to serve as the ultimate technical authority for control automation, monitoring networks, and ultra-high-density fiber optic infrastructure across our AI data center portfolio. 

You will define global design standards for BMS architecture, DCIM integration, environmental/leak monitoring, and high-speed network cabling. This role ensures our building automation systems seamlessly control critical liquid cooling loops while our structured cabling pathways support massive East-West fabric traffic and 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack AI cluster topologies. 

Key Responsibilities

1. IBMS, Automation & DCIM Architecture

Control System Topology: Design robust BACnet/IP, Modbus, and SNMP control architecture for real-time monitoring and automated feedback loops governing Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs), primary chillers, dry coolers, and high-voltage electrical trains. 

Liquid Cooling Control Integration: Architect high-speed automated control sequences, flow balancing algorithms, dynamic pressure differential monitoring, and emergency shut-off valves for direct-to-chip and immersion liquid cooling systems. 

DCIM & Environmental Monitoring: Lead design and integration of Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) platforms, continuous thermal mapping, dynamic power metering, and high-sensitivity water/chemical leak detection networks. 

2. Structured Cabling & Optical Network Engineering

Ultra-High Density Fiber Design: Architect high-count single-mode and multi-mode optical fiber trunking networks (MPO/MTP connectors, OS2/OM5 fiber) engineered for 400G/800G/1. 6T InfiniBand and Ethernet AI fabrics. 

AI Cluster Connectivity: Design intra-hall and inter-hall cable pathways, Main Distribution Areas (MDA), Horizontal Distribution Areas (HDA), and optical patch fields optimized for ultra-dense GPU rack layouts (100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack). 

Physical Pathway Architecture: Specify overhead and underfloor cable tray systems, optical raceways, fire-stopping penetrations, and pathway segregation protocols to prevent thermal obstruction and signal degradation. 

3. Peer Review, Standards & Compliance

Design Validation: Perform deep-dive peer reviews of low-voltage drawings, IBMS network schematics, software integration logic, and telecommunications cabling layouts developed by MEP design consultants. 

Industry Compliance: Enforce strict adherence to TIA-942, ISO/IEC 11801, BICSI data center standards, and cybersecurity protocols for operational technology (OT) networks. 

Failure Analysis & Escalation: Act as the escalation lead for IBMS network latency failures, sensor calibration errors, optical insertion loss issues, or BMS/DCIM telemetry gaps during commissioning or live operations. 

Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: 12-15+ years in data center low-voltage, automation, and telecommunications engineering, with at least 5+ years as a lead designer/SME for hyperscale facilities. 

Domain Mastery: Technical authority in BMS/DCIM protocols (BACnet, Modbus, SNMP), high-density fiber optronics (MTP/MPO 400G+), liquid cooling control integration, and continuous leak detection. 

AI Workload Focus: Proven track record designing IBMS telemetry and structured cabling for 100 kW to 150 kW+ rack densities and high-density GPU fabric clusters. 

Education & Credentials: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunications, or Computer Engineering (RCDD or DCDC certification highly preferred). 

Key Skills: OT network architecture, DCIM platform integration, fiber insertion loss budgeting, BMS sequence of operations (SOO) design, and optical pathway routing

Job Purpose: 

Integration Engineer provides technical leadership for the design, implementation and lifecycle management of data integrations connecting shop-floor and laboratory systems with site, enterprise and R&D data platforms. The role focuses on ISA-95 (International Society of Automation standard 95) Levels 2, 3 and 5, enabling governed and contextualized data flow from automation and equipment through manufacturing operations systems to enterprise, analytics and scientific environments. 

The role leads integration across Manufacturing, MSAT (Manufacturing Science and Technology), Quality, Laboratory, CMC and R&D use cases, including Factory Integration Layer (FIL) capabilities, industrial connectivity, event-driven integration, canonical data models, Unified Namespace patterns, APIs and secure cloud or edge interfaces. The job holder ensures solutions preserve manufacturing context, genealogy, data integrity and semantic meaning while aligning with approved architecture, cyber security, validation and engineering standards. 

The role coordinates automation, OT, IT, data, cloud, application and scientific teams and acts as the technical lead for complex cross-layer delivery and operational issues. (Manufacturing Operations Management), LIMS ( Laboratory Information Management System), LES (Laboratory Execution System), PAT (Process Analytical Technology), laboratory instruments, asset systems and enterprise or scientific data platforms.

data.title: Software Engineer in Test
data.description:
This is a Permanent and Employee Referral role with one of the IPO listed Fintech client of SourcingXPress. 

Job Summary: 

Payment Services Organization is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. You'll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If you'd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on - the best is yet to come!

Job Description: 

Essential Responsibilities: 

- Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
 - Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
 - Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
 - Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
 - May contribute to code & design reviews

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 2+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications: 

What you need to know about the role: 

Organization POS sits at the heart of how many SMBs run their businesses every day. Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you won't hand down verdicts after the fact; you'll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Organization mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it. 

Your way to impact: 

As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. Your work will reduce production defects, speed up releases, and improve the experience of small businesses that use Organization every day. You will grow toward a Senior Test Engineer role as you build your technical depth and ownership. 

In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: 

- Understand requirements and design test cases, test scenarios, and end-to-end tests for Organization mobile app features on Android and iOS. 
 - Write and merge automated cross-service / interop tests into CI/CD pipelines that gate real merges; debug every failure to root cause. 
 - Perform manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions. 
 - Test APIs and backend services using Postman or RestAssured and validate data using SQL queries. 
 - Run tests on BrowserStack and in CI/CD pipelines (Harness) and analyze failures to find the root cause. 
 - Log clear, reproducible defects in JIRA with logs (Logcat, Xcode), screenshots, and screen recordings, and follow them through to closure. 
 - Maintain test cases and test runs in TestRail, and report test status and risks to the team. Reduce flaky tests and suggest ideas to improve test coverage, speed, and quality. 
 - Exposure to contract testing, mutation testing, or AI-assisted quality practices (AI-generated test case review, test gap analysis)

What do you need to bring: 

- 2-4 years of experience in software testing, with at least 1-2 years in mobile (Android and/or iOS) testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with Espresso and/or XCUITest, with willingness to learn the other. 
 - Good Java programming fundamentals and basic knowledge of data structures. 
 - Experience with API testing (Postman, RestAssured) and writing SQL queries. 
 - Good understanding of SDLC/STLC, test design, and defect management using JIRA and TestRail. 
 - Familiarity with Jenkins, BrowserStack, and debugging tools such as Logcat and the Xcode console. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with developers and product managers. 
 - Ownership, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. 
 - Nice to have: Appium, Kotlin or Swift reading ability, mobile performance testing (Android Profiler, Xcode Instruments), JMeter, AWS, and experience in payments or FinTech.

data.title: Supply Chain Security Engineering, VP
data.description:
Who We Are Looking For

The State Street Cyber Security Architecture & Engineering team is seeking an accomplished professional with proven expertise in Application (AppSec) and software supply chain security implementation/governance. The ideal candidate will have previous hands-on experience in application security, build and release management, secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), and the automation of security processes within CI/CD pipelines. Additionally, the candidate should have experience with configuring and managing artifact caches (e. g. JFrog Artifactory) and other artifact sources of truth at an enterprise scale, deep familiarity with package ecosystems like Maven Central, PyPI and familiarity with SLSA principles. 

Why This Role Is Important to Us

Software supply chain attacks have emerged as one of the most significant cybersecurity risks facing modern enterprises. As organizations increasingly rely on open-source components, third-party libraries, cloud-native platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and AI-assisted development, securing the end-to-end software development lifecycle has become critical to maintaining trust, resilience, and regulatory compliance. 

This role plays a pivotal part in ensuring that software is developed, built, tested, signed, and deployed through secure and verifiable processes. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Help build and execute our software supply chain security strategy to expand upon State Street's ability to deploy secure-by-default open-source artifacts, etc. , across the enterprise. 
 - Partner with Engineering teams leads to create, implement, and apply DevSecOps, and AppSec principles and processes. 
 - Assist application teams with onboarding to the adopted security tools/technologies; working with vendors to troubleshoot the platform and issues related to such integrations. 
 - Deliver and communicate reporting via dashboard, and metrics. 
 - Develop and maintain supply chain security and DevSecOps documentation. 
 - Work with teams to continuously improve DevSecOps, & Software Supply Chain Security processes and tools. 
 - Deliver tasks based on project objectives; technically support projects through to completion. 

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

- Previous experience developing software in technologies such as Java, . Net, Python, and Node. js etc. 
 - Experience in cloud technologies such as Azure and AWS. 
 - Extensive experience in developing and managing solutions for application and software supply chain security including managing artifact caches, locking down artifact sourcing, and continuous security assessment. 
 - Experience with automation and orchestration tools, such as Ansible, Terraform, or Kubernetes, is valuable. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and experience in automating deployment and management tasks in a hybrid cloud environment is beneficial. 
 - Proven technical solutioning experience with current and emerging technologies including, but not limited to: Agile Development, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, System Hardening, DevSecOps, Cybersecurity, Cloud Security. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills across internal and external organizations. 
 - Ability to prioritize and manage several projects or priorities simultaneously. 

Education & Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 14+ of years of relevant combined experience across development, CI/CD, software supply chain security and application security. 
 - Experience with application security tooling and its operations with modern CI/CD, and DevSecOps best practices. 
 - Experience partnering with Dev community to influence without authority to adopt application security best practices, and tooling. 
 - Certifications like Security+, CISSP are highly desirable
 - Experience with one or more common programming languages such as Java, . Net, Python, etc. 

Work Requirement

Hybrid: Expected to work from base office location 4 days in a week

Shift: Standard business hours with flexibility to support global stakeholders across multiple time zones

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you'll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

Job Description

Working within the FMS India team the Quality & operation Supervisor will have the responsibility of driving down the cost of non-quality and continually reduce customer escapes through the application of appropriate Quality and Continual Improvement tools & techniques, including inspection activity. 

The Quality team is a Support function to the wider NOV business, as a result the Quality & operation Supervisor will foster and develop relationships both within assigned departments, and as required by the business, conducive of offering the support needed

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities

- Coordinate daily assembly and testing plans, assign work, monitor progress and balance priorities against delivery commitments and available resources. 
 - Supervise and coach assembly operators, test personnel and service engineers as assigned; set clear expectations, verify task readiness and support skills development. 
 - Ensure work is performed to approved drawings, work instructions, inspection plans, test procedures and customer requirements; verify that required records are complete and traceable. 
 - Oversee in-process and final inspections, test readiness and release documentation. Confirm equipment and measuring instruments are suitable and within calibration before use. 
 - Maintain and improve the site Quality Management System in line with ISO 9001 and applicable company procedures; support internal, customer and certification audits and close assigned findings. 
 - Lead containment, non-conformance review and root-cause problem solving for internal, supplier, test, field-service and customer issues. Use structured methods such as 8D and track corrective and preventive actions through effectiveness checks. 
 - Apply relevant quality tools, including PPAP, FAIR, FMEA, control plans, MSA and process capability methods, in coordination with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing and suppliers. 
 - Plan and coordinate service-engineer assignments, job readiness, parts/tools availability, customer updates and service reports. Review field feedback and escalate safety, technical or customer-impacting concerns promptly.

 - Track and report operational and quality performance, such as delivery attainment, rework, scrap, first-pass yield, test failures, customer complaints, service response and action closure; use trends to prioritize improvement. 
 - Identify operational risks, constraints and recurring process losses; resolve routine issues, remove barriers and escalate decisions or risks beyond delegated authority.

Qualifications

Education and experience

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, Industrial, Production Engineering or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

data.description:
About Us: 

Mobileum is a leading provider of Telecom analytics solutions for roaming, core network, security, risk management, domestic and international connectivity testing, and customer intelligence. More than 1, 000 customers rely on its Active Intelligence platform, which provides advanced analytics solutions, allowing customers to connect deep network and operational intelligence with real-time actions that increase revenue, improve customer experience, and reduce costs. Know our story: https: //www. mobileum. com/

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Mobileum has global offices in Australia, Dubai, Germany, Greece, India, Portugal, Singapore and UK with global HC of over 1800+. 

Join Mobileum Team

At Mobileum we recognize that our team is the main reason for our success. What does work with us mean? Opportunities!

Role: Lead AI/ML QA Engineer

About the Role

Mobileum is looking for a highly skilled Lead AI/ML QA Engineer to join our engineering organization in India. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in AI/ML testing, automation frameworks, Generative AI systems, and telecom technologies. This role will focus on validating LLM-based applications, AI-powered telecom platforms, and GenAI-driven solutions while ensuring reliability, safety, scalability, and compliance. 

We are looking for candidates with hands-on experience in testing GenAI and Agentic AI applications, including end-to-end agent workflows, Golden Dataset creation, fine-tuning/training dataset preparation, AI evaluation, and security testing of AI applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for Generative AI and LLM-based applications. 
 - Validate LLM outputs for accuracy, relevance, coherence, groundedness, and safety. 
 - Design and execute test plans for single-agent and multi-agent systems, including tool/function calling, planning, and multi-step task execution. 
 - Validate agent trajectories - verify the agent takes the right steps, calls the right tools with the right arguments, and recovers gracefully from errors, not just whether the final answer looks right. 
 - Validate guardrails, content filtering, and refusal behavior for out-of-scope or unsafe requests. 
 - Define and track quality metrics: accuracy, faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision/recall, task success rate, tool-call accuracy, and consistency
 - Test prompts systematically across input variations, edge cases, and adversarial phrasings. 
 - Validate prompt robustness, consistency, and determinism (where expected) across runs and temperatures. 
 - Perform Bias Detection and A/B prompt testing
 - Build and maintain automation frameworks for UI, API, and AI workflow testing. 
 - Collaborate closely with AI engineers, product teams, DevOps, and telecom domain experts to improve overall system quality. 
 - Implement observability and monitoring validation using Prometheus, Grafana, and LLM tracing tools. 

- Validate telecom AI use cases including Network anomaly detection, Fraud detection, Roaming analytics, Customer experience optimization
 - Ensure compliance with telecom and data privacy regulations including GDPR and DPDP. 
 - Experience with GenAI evaluation and observability tooling, e. g. DeepEval, RAGAS, Promptfoo, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, TruLens, Braintrust, OpenAI Evals. 
 - Experience with AI red-teaming / security tools, e. g. Garak, PyRIT, Giskard, or similar. 
 - Performance testing tools: Locust, k6, JMeter. 

Desired Profile

- 7+ years of experience in QA/Automation testing with exposure to AI/ML or GenAI systems. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python; knowledge of SQL and Java is preferred. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/ML ecosystems and frameworks such as: 
 - LangChain
 - LlamaIndex
 - Vector databases including Pinecone, Weaviate, and ChromaDB
 - Strong experience with Playwright, Selenium, REST API, and gRPC testing. 
 - Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP along with Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. 
 - Strong understanding of telecom business processes and telecom product ecosystems. 
 - Understanding of telecom-grade scalability, reliability, and high-availability systems. 
 - Knowledge of telecom regulatory and compliance requirements including GDPR and DPDP. 
 - Prior telecom product engineering/testing experience is highly preferred. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience testing enterprise-scale AI platforms. 
 - Exposure to Responsible AI and AI governance frameworks. 
 - Experience in performance and scalability testing for AI systems. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and communication skills. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of telecom protocols including SS7, Diameter, GTP, SIP, SCTP
 - Strong understanding of mobile core network technologies including 4G/LTE, 5G SA/NSA
 - Experience working on telecom use cases such as Roaming analytics, Fraud management, Revenue assurance, Customer experience analytics, Network intelligence

Work Experience: 7+ Years

Educational Qualification: 

BE. / B. Tech. , M. E. /M. Tech. or M. Sc. in Computer Science or any related qualification.

data.title: Senior LLM/GenAI Engineer
data.description:
The Senior LLM/GenAI Engineer is a hands-on coding role responsible for designing, building, integrating and deploying AI-powered applications and agents for enterprise HR workflows. The engineer will develop backend services and application APIs, retrieve and process data from the Databricks data lake, Oracle databases and HRMS systems, and connect that data to grounded LLM experiences. The role combines software engineering, data integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent development to deliver secure, reliable applications for employee self-service, HR policy queries, recruitment support and workforce analytics. 

Key Responsibilities : 

• Write, test and maintain production application code using Python, FastAPI and NodeJS; build backend services and APIs for LLM/GenAI applications rather than prompt-only prototypes. 

• Build and maintain integrations that retrieve and process data from the Databricks data lake, Oracle databases and HRMS systems using SQL, APIs and approved connectors; handle authentication, data mapping, validation and integration failures. 

• Design and implement RAG pipelines that combine HR documents with authorised enterprise data, including ingestion, retrieval, context assembly, source attribution and access-aware responses. 

• Build agents using Google ADK, LangGraph or equivalent frameworks; implement tool and function calling, workflow orchestration, state management and connections to Databricks, Oracle and HRMS services. 

• Engineer and evaluate prompts, retrieval and agent behaviour using representative test cases; validate grounded answers, tool selection and task completion, and implement guardrails and human approval for sensitive actions. 

• Enforce HR data privacy, role-based access control (RBAC), PII protection and audit logging across data access, application APIs and agent tools; optimise reliability, latency, concurrency and inference cost. 

• Deliver end-to-end applications for HR policy assistance, employee self-service, recruitment support and conversational workforce analytics, from requirements and coding through integration testing, deployment and production support. 

• Maintain modular code, automated tests, technical documentation and deployment pipelines; troubleshoot production issues and mentor junior engineers through code reviews and hands-on implementation guidance. 

Required Qualifications & Experience: 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 

• Demonstrable hands-on coding experience building LLM applications and agents, including integrations with Databricks data lake and Oracle databases or HRMS systems. 

• 5-8 years of hands-on software and backend application development experience, with recent experience delivering production-grade LLM/GenAI applications and tool-enabled agents. 

Educational Background

• Required: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 

• Preferred: Advanced certifications in AI/ML, Databricks, Cloud Architecture, or Backend Application Development from recognized institutions. 

Years & Type of Experience

• 5-8 years of hands-on software engineering experience, including application coding, API development, SQL-based data access, automated testing and production deployment. 

• Proven delivery of LLM/GenAI applications and agents that use enterprise data, with practical experience integrating Databricks data lake and Oracle databases or HRMS systems; HR Tech or People Analytics experience is preferred. 

Domain Expertise

• Strong understanding of LLM application architecture, RAG, structured data retrieval, tool calling and multi-step agent workflows, including error handling and evaluation. 

• Ability to translate recruitment, onboarding, employee self-service, HR policy and workforce analytics requirements into working applications with defined data sources, access rules and human review points. 

• Practical understanding of enterprise data governance, record-level access restrictions, PII protection, auditability and secure handling of confidential employee data across applications and agents. 

Digital & Operational Tools

• LLM & Agent Engineering: Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Search, prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling and agent evaluation. 

• Enterprise Data & Integration: Databricks data lake, Databricks Genie, SQL, Oracle databases, HRMS APIs, approved connectors, data validation and enterprise data pipelines. 

• Application Engineering: Python, FastAPI, NodeJS, RESTful APIs, backend services, Git, automated testing, deployment pipelines, logging and monitoring. 

• Retrieval & Data Access: FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma or Vertex AI Vector Search; secure SQL queries, document retrieval and access-aware context assembly. 

Leadership Capabilities

• Technical Leadership: Lead application and agent design, contribute production code, review integrations and drive secure, maintainable engineering practices. 

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with HR stakeholders, product managers, data engineers and Oracle/HRMS system owners to define requirements, data access and integration contracts. 

• Mentorship: Coach junior engineers in application coding, SQL, enterprise integrations, RAG and agent development through code reviews and practical guidance. 

• Delivery Ownership: Own implementation from requirements through production support, balancing business value, data privacy, reliability and operating cost.

Finding solutions to climate change is the priority of the 21st century, and means switching to low-carbon energy. At Assystem, our mission is to accelerate the energy transition worldwide. In our 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Asia) of operation, we are working on the production and distribution of low-carbon electricity, through the development of nuclear and renewable energies. We are also supporting the modernisation and development of energy grids, managing the setup and siting for new transmission and distribution networks, and using hydrogen to decarbonise the transport and industry sectors. 

The Assystem Safety & Risk business unit has over 20 years' experience, delivering bespoke, high-quality safety, risk, and reliability consultancy services to high-hazard industries. We help our clients to minimise risk, delivering improved safety and security and fostering a nuclear safety and risk aware culture. Assystem Safety & Risk delivers an integrated and cost-effective service that includes Safety Case, Human & Organisational Factors (HOF), Risk & Reliability (Including Probabilistic Safety Assessment), Security & Resilience, and Process Safety. 

We use deterministic and probabilistic techniques to help our clients to assess the risk associated with facilities and activities and confirm that risks are reduced to a level that is As Low as Reasonably Practicable (ALARP).

data.title: Red Team Engineer - Adversary Simulation
data.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

ABOUT US

We are a stealth Frontier AI security startup building foundation models for security. Backed by Tier 1 venture capital firms and built by experts in sovereign AI, foundation models, and cybersecurity. 

We have built models that already outperform frontier LLMs on cybersecurity benchmarks. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Founding Senior Red Team Engineer to run realistic adversary simulations, develop offensive tooling, and close the loop from successful attack to tested detection. 

You will execute full attack chains across endpoints, identity, cloud, and containers while building labs, benchmarks, and autonomous offensive agents. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role with a path to shape the offensive program. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build and execute adversary-simulation plans mapped to real threat-actor tradecraft and critical assets. 

- Run complete attack chains across initial access, execution, persistence, privilege escalation, defense evasion, credential access, lateral movement, collection, and exfiltration. 

- Develop and extend offensive tooling, including loaders, payloads, command-and-control profiles, and modules. 

- Develop and weaponize exploits into reliable, controlled operational capabilities. 

- Build intentionally vulnerable Windows, Linux, container, identity, and cloud environments. 

- Design instrumented, multi-stage kill chains and create the datasets and benchmark environments used to train and measure offensive-security AI systems. 

- Build and evaluate agents that autonomously discover, validate, and exploit vulnerabilities. 

- Execute Active Directory and Entra ID paths including Kerberos, delegation, ACL and ADCS abuse, plus cloud/container paths such as token theft, metadata-service abuse, role chaining, privileged containers, and Kubernetes RBAC escalation. 

- Run a recurring purple-team cadence: for each technique that lands, partner with blue-team and threat-research engineers until a tested detection exists, then retest and track remaining coverage gaps. 

- Operate with disciplined scoping, reproducibility, logging, cleanup, and reporting. 

QUALIFICATIONS

- Strong hands-on experience in red teaming, penetration testing, adversary simulation, exploit development, or offensive-tool development. 

- Demonstrated tool-development ability in C, C++, C#, Go, Rust, Nim, Python, or another relevant language. 

- Working knowledge of Windows and Linux internals and the mitigations that affect offensive techniques. 

- Understanding of memory-corruption classes, exploitability, and debugging or root-cause analysis. 

- Strong Active Directory attack knowledge and familiarity with hybrid Entra ID paths. 

- Current understanding of EDR visibility, evasion, and the limitations of offensive techniques. 

- Creative attack-path reasoning and the ability to describe defensive detections for your own techniques. 

- Strong operational discipline, reproducibility, and clear written communication. 

- We value demonstrated ability over formal credentials, certifications, or a fixed number of years of experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with AI agents, autonomous security systems, or offensive-security automation. 

- Fuzzing, vulnerability research, kernel research, reverse engineering, or exploit-development depth. 

- Cloud red teaming across AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

- Container and Kubernetes offensive-security experience. 

- Prior blue-team, detection-engineering, or purple-team experience. 

- Published research, CVEs, bug-bounty findings, open-source tooling, or advanced lab and CTF work. 

- Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, or OSCE3 as supporting evidence, not a substitute for demonstrated work. 

- Experience building lab, range, or CTF environments. 

- Physical or social-engineering experience where relevant to the threat model.

We are looking for an innovative AI Architect who will lead the design and implementation of Agentic AI, Generative AI (GenAI), and Large Language Model (LLM) - driven solutions across enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will bridge research and production-defining AI strategy, architecture, and scalable model pipelines that transform business outcomes and our global clients. 

Key Responsibilities

• Architect and design end-to-end AI systems leveraging LLMs, GenAI, and Agentic AI frameworks. 

• Define AI/ML solution architecture involving data ingestion, model training, orchestration, and deployment across Azure / AWS / GCP. 

• Work on prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and fine-tuning of open-source and proprietary LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, LLaMA, etc. ). 

• Collaborate with data scientists, MLOps engineers, and software developers to operationalize AI solutions in production environments. 

• Design and implement AI agent workflows, leveraging frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel. 

• Ensure responsible AI principles, focusing on security, compliance, and ethical model usage. 

• Define AI governance and observability frameworks for tracking model drift, bias, and performance. 

• Stay updated on Agentic AI, multimodal AI, and self-learning systems, and evaluate emerging GenAI tools and APIs for business adoption. 

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to AI teams, guiding solution design, architecture reviews, and best practices. 

Required Skills & Experience

• 10+ years of experience in software development, with at least 4+ years in AI/ML/GenAI architecture. 

• Strong proficiency in Python, TensorFlow / PyTorch, and transformer-based architectures (BERT, GPT, T5, etc. ). 

• Proven experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus). 

• Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, or similar LLM orchestration tools. 

• Solid understanding of MLOps pipelines, CI/CD, and model deployment using Azure Machine Learning, SageMaker, or Vertex AI. 

• Knowledge of API orchestration, microservices, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 

• Experience in integrating GenAI capabilities into enterprise apps (chatbots, copilots, document intelligence, code assistants, etc. ). 

• Strong analytical, communication, and solution design skills.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Software Security
data.description:
Hello, 

Greetings from ZettaMine!!!

Full Time Opportunity: We are hiring Engineering Manager - Software Security for a short-term freelance/contractor Role. 

Locations: Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Ghana, India, Pakistan, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, Turkey, Vietnam

Role: Engineering Manager - Software Security

Experience: Minimum 10+ Years

Mode: Remote

Duration : 3 month

Start: Immediate

Mandatory Eligibility Criteria

Role Overview

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the development of security-focused training and evaluation tasks for frontier AI coding models. This role owns delivery, quality, and capacity across multiple pods and is accountable to Google for throughput, task difficulty, quality standards, and on-time batch completion. 

The Engineering Manager acts as the final quality gate, ensuring that vulnerability-based tasks are technically accurate, reproducible, robust against gaming, and aligned with the project's evaluation goals. The role combines software security expertise, people leadership, client communication, delivery management, and data-driven capacity planning. 

What does day-to-day look like

- Own delivery, quality, and capacity across multiple pods. 
 - Plan batches, assign work to Pod Leads, and track daily throughput against phase targets. 
 - Ensure batches meet Google's expectations for volume, difficulty, quality, and timelines. 
 - Lead weekly client reporting and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies. 
 - Escalate tooling issues, rate limits, safety blocks, and staffing constraints early. 
 - Align with Google on scope, timelines, task volume, and difficulty changes. 
 - Conduct final reviews of security tasks before delivery. 
 - Calibrate Pod Leads on CWE classification, verifier robustness, task quality, and difficulty. 
 - Run interviews and make hiring decisions against the approved JD. 
 - Identify and promote high-performing Trainers to Pod Lead roles. 
 - Forecast headcount needs using throughput and workload data. 
 - Start hiring waves approximately three weeks ahead of projected capacity requirements. 
 - Use dashboards and operational metrics to drive delivery and staffing decisions. 

Requirements

- Senior software security engineer with overall 10 years of experience
 - Experience in leading teams against measurable delivery, quality, and schedule targets. 
 - Strong understanding of CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10 across multiple programming languages and software ecosystems. 
 - Demonstrated experience reproducing vulnerabilities, reviewing security patches, and evaluating proof-of-vulnerability tests. 
 - Experience designing or reviewing automated tests, verifiers, CI workflows, or reproducible technical evaluation environments. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one major programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift. 
 - Experience with Git, Linux, Bash, Docker, and common software security tooling. 
 - Comfortable using dashboards, throughput metrics, quality data, and operational reports to make delivery and staffing decisions. 
 - Experience managing or mentoring technical teams, including assigning work, reviewing output, giving feedback, and developing team leads. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical risks and project status clearly to clients and internal stakeholders. 
 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple pods, priorities, and delivery phases simultaneously. 

Availability Requirements

8 hours per day with an overlap of 4 hours with PST. 

Offer Details

- Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST. 
 - Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
 - Duration of contract : 3 month; [expected start date is next week]

Interested candidates: Please share your updated CV at: Swetha. p@zettamine. com

Regards, 

Swetha. P

data.title: Senior Automation QA Engineer – AI Platforms, Conversational AI & Agentic AI
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Automation QA Engineer with strong expertise in Playwright and modern test automation practices to validate enterprise-grade Conversational AI, Agentic AI, Chatbot, and Generative AI platforms. 

The ideal candidate should have experience testing AI-powered applications, ensuring response accuracy, validating AI workflows, identifying hallucinations, testing multi-agent interactions, and building automation frameworks that assess both traditional software functionality and AI-specific behaviours. 

This role will work closely with AI Engineers, Product Owners, Data Scientists, and DevOps teams to ensure the reliability, quality, security, and trustworthiness of AI-driven solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Playwright. 
 - Build automated UI, API, integration, regression, and end-to-end test suites. 
 - Create reusable test assets and automation libraries. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Execute functional, non-functional, and exploratory testing. 

Conversational AI & Chatbot Testing

- Validate chatbot and conversational AI responses across various user scenarios. 
 - Test multi-turn conversations and context retention. 
 - Verify intent recognition and conversation flows. 
 - Validate fallback and error-handling responses. 
 - Verify integration with external systems, APIs, and knowledge repositories. 

Agentic AI Testing

- Validate AI Agent workflows and decision-making capabilities. 
 - Test task orchestration across multiple agents. 
 - Verify agent-to-agent communication and collaboration. 
 - Test autonomous execution paths and exception handling. 
 - Validate tool usage, API invocations, and workflow outcomes. 
 - Assess reliability of agent planning, reasoning, and execution processes. 

Hallucination & AI Response Validation

- Design test cases specifically focused on identifying AI hallucinations. 
 - Compare generated responses against trusted knowledge sources. 
 - Validate factual accuracy and response grounding. 
 - Test for misinformation, fabricated data, and unsupported claims. 
 - Create automated evaluation metrics for response correctness. 
 - Measure consistency of AI outputs across repeated executions. 

AI Quality Evaluation

- Validate relevance, completeness, and correctness of generated responses. 
 - Define acceptance criteria for AI-generated content. 
 - Measure: 
 - Response Accuracy
 - Hallucination Rate
 - Grounding Accuracy
 - Latency
 - Context Retention
 - Response Consistency
 - Safety Compliance
 - Support automated AI evaluation frameworks and quality scorecards. 
API & Integration Testing

- Test REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, AI service integrations, and agent orchestration layers. 
 - Validate integrations with: 
 - LLMs
 - Vector databases
 - Knowledge bases
 - MCP servers
 - Third-party applications
 - Conduct contract and integration testing across distributed systems. 
Performance & Reliability Testing

- Validate chatbot and AI platform scalability. 
 - Perform load, stress, and performance testing. 
 - Measure AI response times and throughput. 
 - Test resilience under high-volume concurrent requests. 
 - Validate recovery and failover mechanisms. 

Security & Compliance Testing

- Perform security testing of AI applications. 
 - Validate authentication, authorization, and role-based access controls. 
 - Test prompt injection vulnerabilities. 
 - Validate data privacy and sensitive data handling. 
 - Assess AI guardrails and content moderation controls. 

Required Experience

- 5+ years of QA Automation experience. 
 - 3+ years of experience with Playwright automation. 
 - Hands-on experience testing chatbots, conversational platforms, or AI-enabled applications. 
 - Experience validating AI-generated responses and identifying hallucinations. 
 - Experience building API automation frameworks. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar. 
 - Experience validating RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions. 
 - Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, OpenSearch, Weaviate, or ChromaDB. 
 - Understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and AI evaluation metrics. 
 - Experience with AI observability and monitoring platforms. 
 - ISTQB certification is a plus. 

Soft Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to challenge AI outputs using data-driven validation techniques. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Strong attention to detail and quality mindset. 
 - Ability to work independently in a fast-paced AI product environment. 

Success Criteria for the Role

The Successful Candidate Should Be Able To

- Build robust Playwright automation frameworks for AI platforms. 
 - Detect and report hallucinations, inaccurate responses, and reasoning failures. 
 - Validate chatbot conversations, AI agent decisions, and workflow outcomes. 
 - Measure AI quality through automated evaluation and scorecards. 
 - Ensure enterprise-grade reliability, security, and scalability of Conversational AI and Agentic AI solutions

About Us: 

Marriott International Inc. , headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine-seat A&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 10, 000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world's largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At Marriott Tech Accelerator center (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. At Marriott Tech Accelerator, we are a team of passionate engineering minds dedicated to creating and building cutting-edge solutions that streamline operations and elevate guest experiences. 

Marriott Tech Accelerator center is fully owned and operated by ANSR. All associates at Marriott Tech Accelerator will be ANSR employees, delivering services exclusively to ANSR's client, Marriott International. 

Marriott Tech Accelerator is an ANSR entity incorporated exclusively for providing services to Marriott International. 

Role Title: Senior Quality Engineer II

JOB SUMMARY: 

Responsible for defining, governing, and continuously improving the quality assurance and testing strategy for Marriott's Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) services. This role serves as the quality authority for SailPoint IdentityIQ capabilities, ensuring that new features, application onboardings, integrations, identity lifecycle processes, access governance controls, certifications, RBAC enhancements, and production changes are validated against business, functional, technical, security, and operational requirements. 

The IGA Quality Assurance & Testing Manager partners closely with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, RBAC Analysts, Developers, Operations teams, application stakeholders, and business users to establish testing standards, quality processes, automation strategies, and release validation activities. While initially operating as an individual contributor, this role is expected to provide quality leadership across both the India-based SailPoint delivery pod and the broader US-based IGA service while helping mature Marriott's long-term IGA testing capabilities

Key Responsibilities: 

- Define, maintain, and govern the quality assurance strategy, testing standards, testing methodologies, and release validation processes for Marriott's Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) services. 
 - Serve as the quality lead for the IGA service, establishing testing best practices, quality controls, automation standards, and testing governance processes across both US-based and India-based delivery teams. 
 - Lead testing activities for the India-based SailPoint delivery pod while providing guidance and quality oversight supporting broader IGA initiatives across the enterprise. 
 - Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, Developers, Operations teams, and business stakeholders to ensure testing requirements, acceptance criteria, and quality expectations are incorporated throughout the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Define and oversee System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, end-to-end testing, production validation, and release readiness activities supporting the IGA roadmap. 
 - Develop and maintain reusable test plans, test cases, test data strategies, traceability models, and testing procedures supporting scalable and repeatable delivery practices. 
 - Lead testing efforts supporting application onboarding, identity lifecycle management, access governance, certification campaigns, role-based access control (RBAC), provisioning processes, integrations, and operational readiness activities. 
 - Define and drive the test automation strategy for the IGA service, including development of automated regression testing capabilities and integration of automated testing into CI/CD and release management processes. 
 - Define and oversee performance, scalability, volume, endurance, and stress testing activities while establishing performance baselines, capacity planning inputs, and release acceptance criteria for the SailPoint platform. 
 - Partner with Architects, Developers, and Operations teams to identify quality risks, performance bottlenecks, integration issues, and opportunities for platform optimization and continuous improvement. 
 - Manage defect tracking, prioritization, root cause analysis, retesting activities, and quality metrics to improve platform stability, release quality, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Define testing KPIs, automation coverage metrics, quality dashboards, and testing effectiveness reporting to support program governance and leadership visibility. 
 - Create and maintain testing standards, quality documentation, operational validation procedures, release readiness checklists, and quality governance artifacts supporting the SailPoint platform. 
 - Support audit, compliance, risk, and governance activities through testing evidence, control validation, documentation management, and quality reporting. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality engineering maturity, automation adoption, testing efficiency, performance validation, release reliability, and operational excellence across the IGA service. 

Qualifications: 

- 7+ years of Quality Assurance, Testing, or Quality Engineering experience. 
 - 3+ years of Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), cybersecurity, or enterprise security testing experience. 
 - Experience developing testing strategies, test plans, regression testing frameworks, automation roadmaps, performance testing approaches, and release validation processes for enterprise platforms. 
 - Experience supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ, identity lifecycle management, access governance, certification, RBAC, provisioning, integration, and application onboarding initiatives. 
 - Strong understanding of System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, end-to-end testing, performance testing, defect management, and release validation methodologies. 
 - Experience working within Agile delivery models and supporting cross-functional engineering, product, and business teams. 
 - Experience with test management tools, defect tracking processes, quality reporting, root cause analysis, quality governance practices, and testing metrics. 
 - API Testing, SQL, Test Case Management, Automation Testing, Defect Management, Traceability Management, Performance Testing, Release Validation, Quality Metrics, Reporting. 

Technical Skills: 

- Strong experience developing and executing testing strategies supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ solutions including application onboarding, identity lifecycle management (Joiner/Mover/Leaver), provisioning, certifications, access governance, role-based access control (RBAC), integration testing, performance testing, and release validation activities. 
 - Experience designing and executing System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, performance testing, API testing, end-to-end testing, production validation, defect management, quality reporting, and continuous quality improvement processes within enterprise IAM environments. 
 - Preferred experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ, SailPoint ISC/Identity Now, test automation frameworks, Playwright, Selenium, Zephyr, Jira, CI/CD practices, performance testing tools, Agile delivery methodologies, IAM governance controls, and quality assurance certifications such as ISTQB or equivalent. 

Work location: Hyderabad, India. 

Work mode: Hybrid

Marriott's core values: 

At Marriott, our core values make us who we are. We believe that success is never final. As we change and grow, the beliefs that are most important to us stay the same putting people first, pursuing excellence, embracing change, acting with integrity, and serving our world. Being part of Marriott Tech Accelerator means being part of a proud history and a thriving culture.

data.title: Team Lead/Manager — AI & IP Innovation - Biotech
data.description:
Purpose

Lead complex patent intelligence engagements across Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences, and Healthcare technologies, while guiding research teams and leveraging agentic AI workflows to deliver reproducible, defensible insights and strategic outcomes for clients. 

Key Responsibilities

• Define research strategy and execution approach for complex patent intelligence engagements across biotechnology and pharmaceutical technologies. 

• Design and optimize AI-assisted search workflows and prompt strategies. 

• Lead large-scale novelty, patentability, invalidation, freedom-to-operate, opposition, and patent landscape projects. 

• Oversee development of claim-element mappings and Evidence of Use (EoU) with precise technical and patent citations. 

• Interpret complex patent claims, patent families, CPC/IPC classifications, sequence-related disclosures, Markush structures, and citation networks. 

• Conduct and supervise technical searches across patent and non-patent literature, including scientific publications, clinical literature, regulatory sources, sequence databases, and product-related information. 

• Validate AI-generated results through expert scientific and technical review. 

• Prepare and review client-ready sections including methodology, sources, findings, claim analysis, and strategic conclusions. 

• Ensure research outputs are scientifically accurate, reproducible, and legally defensible. 

• Improve prompt libraries, search methodologies, and quality assurance frameworks for biotechnology and pharmaceutical research. 

• Lead and mentor a team of strategists and senior strategists, providing scientific guidance and reviewing research outputs. 

• Allocate research tasks, monitor project progress, and ensure high-quality deliverables. 

• Support client discussions by translating complex scientific and patent findings into clear strategic insights. 

Must-have

• 6-10+ years of experience in patent research, IP analytics, or patent intelligence within Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences, or related technologies. 

• Proven expertise in novelty searches, invalidation studies, freedom-to-operate analysis, patent landscapes, claim charts, and drafting support. 

• Strong understanding of patent claims, patent families, classification systems, sequence searching, Markush structures, and citation analysis. 

• Ability to understand and analyze complex scientific disclosures across biologics, pharmaceuticals, molecular biology, and life sciences. 

• Experience leading research teams and managing complex client projects. 

• Excellent analytical thinking, scientific interpretation, and technical writing skills. 

Patent & IP Expertise

• Advanced experience in patent research including novelty, invalidation, FTO, opposition, landscapes, and claim charts. 

• Expertise in interpreting patent claims, families, CPC/IPC classifications, prosecution histories, and citation networks. 

• Experience analyzing composition-of-matter, formulation, method-of-treatment, dosage regimen, biomarker, biologics, process, and platform technology claims. 

• Understanding of Markush claims, chemical structures, biological sequences, antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids, and sequence identity-based claims. 

• Familiarity with global patent databases such as USPTO, EPO, WIPO Patentscope, Google Patents, and Espacenet. 

• Familiarity with scientific and life-sciences databases such as PubMed, Google Scholar, NCBI, UniProt, BLAST, ClinicalTrials. gov, and regulatory databases. 

• Ability to review and guide claim-element mapping and Evidence of Use (EoU) aligned with patent and scientific evidence standards. 

• Experience supporting litigation, licensing, due diligence, competitive intelligence, or portfolio strategy engagements. 

Education Background

• Bachelor's/Master's degree in Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacy, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Biomedical Sciences, Life Sciences, or related fields. 

• PhD or advanced specialization may be preferred for highly technical biotechnology or pharmaceutical engagements. 

Strong understanding of: 

• Molecular biology and genetics

• Biochemistry and cell biology

• Recombinant DNA and gene technologies

• Proteins, antibodies, peptides, and biologics

• Genomics, proteomics, and bioinformatics

• Pharmaceutical formulations and drug delivery systems

• Pharmacology and drug development

• Small-molecule and biologic therapeutics

• Vaccines and immunology

• Cell and gene therapies

• Diagnostics, biomarkers, and personalized medicine

• Fermentation, bioprocessing, and biologics manufacturing

• Clinical development and regulatory concepts

Tools - Examples

• Patent: Google Patents, Espacenet, Patentscope, USPTO, EPO

• Scientific/NPL: PubMed, Google Scholar, NCBI, UniProt, BLAST, ClinicalTrials. gov

• Other: Sequence-search tools, chemical/biological databases, translators, spreadsheets, visualization and reporting tools

KPIs

• Project delivery quality and audit pass-rate

• Turnaround time adherence across engagements

• Scientific and technical accuracy of research outputs

• Defensibility and reproducibility of patent research findings

• Team mentoring effectiveness and peer-review quality

• Contributions to biotechnology/pharma research playbooks and AI-enabled workflows

Levelling Notes

Lead - AI & IP Innovation (Team Leader): 

Leads biotechnology/pharma patent research projects, including patentability, FTO, invalidation, landscaping and competitive intelligence studies. Guides and mentors a team of strategists, conducts quality reviews, translates client requirements into clear project scope and methodology, and ensures timely, high-quality delivery. 

Manager - AI & IP Innovation (Biotechnology): 

Owns a portfolio of biotechnology/pharma engagements and manages multiple research teams and team leads. Acts as the senior point of contact for key clients, drives technical and commercial proposals, and handles the most complex scientific and patent matters. data.description:
About Team

What You'll Do

Architect and implement multi-tenant / multi-market solutions that support locale-specific business rules, tax regulations, fulfillment models, and delivery SLAs across geographies. 

Lead the technical design of core order life cycle domains: order capture, orchestration, inventory reservation, fulfillment routing, shipping, and post-order flows (returns, cancellations, modifications). 

Build event-driven, microservices-based architectures using Java/Spring Boot, Kafka, and NoSQL databases to ensure high throughput and low latency at scale. 

Drive platform convergence efforts - unifying order and fulfillment platforms across markets to reduce duplication and accelerate speed-to-market for new geographies.

What You'll Bring

data.title: Systems Architect / Engineer
data.description:
Summary-

We are seeking an experienced Data Science Systems Architect / Engineer who can bridge deep software-engineering and systems-architecture expertise with hands-on Data Science and Machine Learning capabilities. The ideal candidate brings 6-15 years of overall technical experience, with around 2 years dedicated to data-science, ML, and AI-driven system design. In this role, you will lead the architectural definition of ML pipelines, model-inference platforms, and intelligent systems that integrate with Mavenir's core network products. You will collaborate closely with R&D, Product Management, Sales Engineering, and global account teams to deliver production-grade solutions. Telecom / IMS / VoLTE domain experience is a strong add-on advantage. 

Key Job Responsibilties-

Architecture & System Design

- Lead architectural and functional discussions for ML-enabled network solutions, defining end-to-end data, pipeline, and model architectures. 
 - Design scalable, production-grade ML pipelines covering ingestion, feature engineering, model training, inference, and monitoring. 
 - Draft comprehensive functional and development requirements for data/ML systems, APIs, and integration points with core network products. 
 - Collaborate with R&D to review code, ensure implementation meets architectural requirements, and guide CI/CD and deployment practices. 

Data Science & Machine Learning

- Analyze network and operational data using statistical techniques; identify data distributions, correlations, and causation patterns. 
 - Identify preprocessing and post-processing requirements aligned with business logic and telecom protocol specifications. 
 - Experiment with algorithms, architectures, and frameworks to identify the best solutions for network-analytics and automation use cases. 
 - Develop, train, and optimize classical ML, deep-learning, and generative-AI models (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, etc. ). 
 - Implement explainability frameworks (SHAP, LIME) and model-monitoring practices to ensure transparency and reliability in production. 

AI / Agentic & Emerging Technologies

- Build LLM-powered applications, RAG workflows, and agentic systems using modern frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, vector stores). 
 - Integrate ML models with API-based microservices, backend services (FastAPI / Flask / Django), and external telecom systems. 
 - Experiment with GANs for synthetic data generation and augmentation where applicable. 

Domain & Customer Collaboration

- Work with customers, product managers, and industry experts to identify and design ML / AI requirements for telecom solutions (VoLTE, IMS, 5G, Enterprise network). 
 - Understand protocol specifications and telecom KPIs to gain deeper insight into data sources, distributions, and business logic. 
 - Assist Sales Engineering and Business Development in creating technical proposals, RFP / RFI responses, competitive analyses, and white papers. 
 - Develop positioning papers and technical presentations that demonstrate Mavenir's leadership in AI-driven network solutions. Leadership & Intellectual Property

- Mentor junior data scientists, ML engineers, and software developers; promote best practices in coding, testing, and model quality. 
 - Protect Mavenir's intellectual property through patent filings, invention disclosures, and competitive-technology tracking. 
 - Attend occasional off-hour conference calls with offices across the US, Europe, and Asia to support global delivery. 

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Experience Profile

- 6 - 15 years of professional experience in software engineering, systems architecture, or telecom/network engineering. 
 - ~2 years of focused, hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI engineering, including production ML pipeline design and deployment. 
 - Demonstrated track record of leading technical discussions and delivering complex, multi-system solutions. Technical Skills - Core

- Strong hands-on programming in Python and SQL; experience with data modeling, feature engineering, and database technologies. 
 - Solid understanding of ML lifecycle - regression, classification, clustering, time-series, anomaly detection, classical ML (Bagging / Boosting), and Deep Learning (CNN, RNN, Transformers). 
 - Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, and model-evaluation / explainability frameworks (SHAP / LIME). 
 - Experience building REST APIs, microservices, and backend integration workflows (FastAPI / Flask / Django) for ML model inference. 
 - Proficiency with version control (Git), modular code structure, debugging, code optimization, and basic CI/CD practices. Technical Skills - Architecture & Integration

- Experience with API-based systems, service-oriented / microservice architectures, and containerization (Docker / Kubernetes). 
 - Understanding of virtualized product architecture, NFV, cloud-native deployment, and scalable data storage / object-store technologies. 
 - Ability to design and document comprehensive functional / non-functional requirements for data and ML systems. Generative AI & Agentic Systems (Plus)

- Practical exposure to LLMs, embeddings, vector stores, and RAG pipelines. 
 - Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Langflow, MCP) for multi-step AI workflow orchestration. 
 - Familiarity with GANs for synthetic data generation (optional but valuable). 

PREFERRED / ADD-ON ADVANTAGES

Telecom Domain Experience

- Understanding of telecom network architectures and protocols (VoLTE, VoWiFi, IMS, 5G, Enterprise solutions) - strong plus. 
 - Experience with telecom KPIs, network analytics, signaling data, and protocol-level data interpretation. 
 - Prior work with telecom core-network products, NFV infrastructure, or operator-grade deployment environments. Advanced Education & Certifications

- Master's or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Data Science, AI / ML, Electronics / Telecom Engineering, or a closely related field. 
 - Relevant certifications (TensorFlow Developer, PyTorch, AWS / GCP / Azure ML, Kubernetes, etc. ) are a plus. SOFT SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

- Effective oral and written communication skills; ability to explain complex ML / architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to decompose complex issues into actionable tasks and deliver under tight timelines. 
 - Ability to work successfully under limited supervision; self-driven and ownership-oriented from idea to implementation. 
 - Collaborative team player who can adapt to different personalities, work across time zones, and thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment. 
 - Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning, especially in rapidly evolving AI technologies and telecom innovations.
