data.title: Emulation Engineer – AI Inference Systems
data.description:
About the Company

www. enchargeai. com

About the Role

Location: Onsite/hybrid/Remote Emulation Engineer - AI Inference Systems Location: Onsite/Hybrid/Remote Job Description: EnCharge AI is seeking an experienced Emulation Engineer with deep expertise in hardware emulation to help bring up the next-generation AI inference platform, from the accelerator SoC to multi-chip, rack-scale scale-up and scale-out systems. You will set the technical direction for, build, and own the pre-silicon environments that let hardware, firmware, and software teams run real inference workloads months before silicon arrives, and that de-risk tape-out at datacenter scale. This role focuses on emulation model build and partitioning of large AI accelerator SoCs and chiplet-based systems on Siemens Veloce, speed bridges and transactors for PCIe, LPDDR, HBM, Ethernet, and scale-up links, multi-chip and multi-node emulation of scale-up and scale-out fabrics, and pre-silicon bring-up of firmware, drivers, and the AI software stack. You will define and drive the emulation methodology for debug, power and performance analysis, and regression, and carry that infrastructure forward into post-silicon bring-up. 

Responsibilities

- Set the emulation strategy for AI accelerator SoCs and multi-die/chiplet systems, and own the Siemens Veloce emulation environment (Veloce Strato/Strato+ and Veloce CS) end-to-end. 
 - Build, compile, and partition multi-billion-gate designs across emulator boards and systems, managing clocking, memory modeling (HBM, DDR, on-chip SRAM), capacity, and compile turnaround time. 
 - Develop and integrate transactors for PCIe host interfaces, HBM, Ethernet, and die-to-die and chip-to-chip scale-up links (e. g. , UCIe). 
 - Architect multi-chip and multi-node emulation configurations that model scale-up domains and scale-out fabrics, including collective communication traffic (e. g. , all-reduce, all-to-all) across accelerators. 
 - Enable pre-silicon bring-up of boot ROM, firmware, kernel drivers, runtime, and compiler output, and run real inference models (e. g. , LLMs and other transformer models) end-to-end on emulation with the ML software team. 
 - Perform power and performance analysis with Veloce Power App: capture switching activity on realistic workloads for power estimation and peak-power and di/dt analysis, and measure throughput, bandwidth, and latency to correlate against architectural performance models. 
 - Define the emulation debug methodology (full-visibility waveform and trace capture, triggers, assertions, transaction monitors, save/restore) and lead triage of the hardest issues spanning RTL, firmware, and software. 
 - Build and maintain regression infrastructure and automation that keeps emulation models current with RTL releases, integrates with CI, and maximizes emulator utilization and throughput. 
 - Provide technical leadership for emulation across architecture, RTL design, verification, firmware, and system software teams: define emulation plans, milestones, and tape-out readiness criteria, mentor engineers within the emulation team, and drive capacity planning and tool roadmap discussions with Siemens EDA. 
 - Partner as a peer with the FPGA prototyping team on shared RTL releases, and jointly decide which workloads run on emulation versus prototypes. 

Qualifications

- BS/MS/Ph. D. in EE, CE, CS, or related field with deep hardware emulation experience on complex SoCs, including technical leadership of emulation for at least one large SoC program through tape-out. 

Required Skills

- Deep hands-on experience with Siemens Veloce emulation (Veloce Strato/Strato+ or Veloce CS), including compile, partitioning, and runtime flows. 
 - Strong SystemVerilog/Verilog skills, with experience in emulation-friendly coding, design partitioning, and multi-clock-domain designs. 
 - Experience with transactor-based verification (e. g. , AXI/PCIe transactors) for high-speed interfaces such as PCIe Gen5/6, HBM, and Ethernet. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Tcl, and shell, including regression management and CI systems. 
 - Proven ability to debug across the hardware/software boundary and to drive technical direction for emulation across multiple teams. 
 - Experience with emulation-based power analysis platforms a strong plus. 
 - Equivalent experience on Cadence Palladium or Synopsys ZeBu a plus. 
 - Experience with multi-chip/chiplet emulation, scale-up interconnects (e. g. , UCIe, UALink), or scale-out networking (e. g. , RoCE, Ultra Ethernet) a plus. 
 - Experience bringing up firmware, Linux drivers, or software stacks on emulation; proficiency in C/C++, Linux, and embedded debug (JTAG, GDB) a plus
 - Familiarity with AI/ML accelerators, inference workloads, and frameworks such as PyTorch or ONNX Runtime a plus. 
 - We value demonstrated ability over years of experience; motivated, exceptional candidates at any career stage are encouraged to apply.

YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation. 

At YASH, we're a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth - bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future. 

We are looking forward to hire Automation Testing Professionals in the following areas : 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer with strong expertise in AI-based systems, LLM applications, and intelligent agent testing. This role will be responsible for defining and implementing quality strategies for AI-powered platforms, including multi-agent systems, conversational AI, and LLM-driven workflows. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience validating AI outputs, testing prompt-based systems, evaluating explainability, and ensuring Responsible AI compliance. 

Key Responsibilities

AI & Agent Testing

Design and execute test strategies for AI/LLM-based applications and multi-agent systems. Validate agent behaviors, reasoning flows, tool usage, and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) interactions. Test follow-up question handling, performance, and contextual continuity. Perform evaluation of prompting techniques and prompt robustness. Validate explainability outputs and reasoning traceability. 

Model & Output ValidationConduct qualitative and quantitative evaluation of LLM outputs. Develop evaluation datasets and benchmark test cases. Implement automated scoring mechanisms where applicable. Identify hallucinations, bias, unsafe outputs, and performance inconsistencies. 

Responsible AI & Compliance

Ensure AI systems comply with Responsible AI guidelines (fairness, transparency, safety). Perform bias testing, toxicity checks, and adversarial testing. Validate guardrails and content moderation mechanisms. 

Automation & Tools

Develop automation frameworks for API, backend, and agent workflows. Work with tools such as: Postman / REST AssuredSelenium / Playwright (PyTest / JUnitAI evaluation frameworks (e. g. , LangSmith, Opik, custom evaluation pipelines)Validate streaming responses and real-time agent interactions. 

Observability & Monitoring

Validate logging, tracing, and observability of agents. Test telemetry, response time, and performance under load. Ensure proper monitoring of BYOA (Bring Your Own Agent) and out-of-the-box agents. 

Collaboration

Work closely with AI engineers, prompt engineers, backend developers, and product teams. Participate in architecture discussions to ensure testability. Provide risk assessments and quality metrics to stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

6-10 years of QA experience, with at least 2-3 years in AI/ML or LLM-based systems. Strong understanding of: Large Language Models (LLMs)Prompt engineering conceptsMulti-agent architecturesAPI and backend testingExperience testing conversational AI or agent-based workflows. Proficiency in automation using Python/Java/JavaScript. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and test integration. Strong analytical and debugging skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e. g. , RAG evaluation, vector DB testing). Familiarity with Responsible AI standards and AI governance frameworks. Experience testing streaming APIs. Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure). Understanding of embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval systems. 

Key Competencies

Strong problem-solving skillsDetail-oriented with a quality-first mindsetAbility to evaluate non-deterministic AI outputsExcellent communication and documentation skillsProactive and ownership-driven

What We Offer

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and agent platformsHigh-impact role in shaping AI quality standardsCollaborative and innovation-driven environment

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale. 

Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles

- Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity

Technology Background

Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Collaborate with implementation teams to address synthesis, timing, power, and integration challenges. 

Quality & Process Improvement

- Establish and enforce design methodologies, coding guidelines, and best practices. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in design processes, productivity, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure designs meet functional, performance, and reliability requirements. 

Silicon Bring-Up & Product Support

 - Provide technical leadership for future product enhancements and next-generation designs. 

Team Leadership & Management

- Lead, mentor, and manage a team of SoC/RTL design engineers.

 - Participate in hiring and onboarding of new team members. 
 - Foster a collaborative and high-performance engineering culture. 

Qualifications

- Required Qualifications
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC design and development. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams or technical projects. 
 - Strong expertise in RTL design using Verilog/SystemVerilog. 
 - Experience with SoC integration, interconnects, memory subsystems, and industry-standard protocols such as AXI, AHB, APB, PCIe, USBUALink, Ethernet, or DDR. 
 - Strong understanding of the complete ASIC development lifecycle. 
 - Experience working with Verification, Physical Design, DFT, and Post-Silicon Validation teams. 
 - Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Experience with AI/ML, networking, datacenter, automotive, or high-performance computing SoCs. 
 - Knowledge of low-power design techniques and clock/reset architectures. 
 - Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Tcl. 
 - Prior experience delivering multiple successful tape-outs. 
 - Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams. 

Required Skills

We are seeking talented Design Verification Professionals with proven expertise in industry-standard protocols such as PCIe and CXL.  - Develop user-controlled random constraints in transaction-based verification methodologies.

data.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (DNS, NTP, LDAP, Linux)
data.description:
Company Description

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. 

Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%. 

Job Description

We are seeking a highly experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to implement and support our current and future DNS architecture in private/public cloud. You will be directly responsible for ensuring the scalability, resilience, automation, and performance optimization of our DNS environment by leveraging Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Ansible, and Terraform, or Pulumi. 

This is a deeply technical role requiring expert-level understanding of DNS, NTP, LDAP and extensive working knowledge on Linux Operating systems. You will also collaborate with platform and SRE teams to maintain secure, performant, and multi-tenant-isolated services that serve high-throughput, mission-critical applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Implement and support large scale DNS Architecture that stretches private & public cloud across multiple regions. 
 - Implement and support Infoblox DDI solutions (DNS, IPAM, DHCP), Cloudflare DNS management, Google & AWS DNS services. 
 - Implement and support highly reliable NTP and LDAP services on Linux instances. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as code leveraging CI/CD automation, Ansible, Terraform/Pulumi, Python and Bash for automated provisioning of DNS services. 
 - Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure updates, patches, and rollbacks. 
 - Automate monitoring, alerting, and self-healing with GitOps and observability tools (Prometheus, Loki, Grafana). 
 - Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and scalable operations. 
 - Troubleshoot and analyze performance across hypervisors, storage, and networking. 
 - Support on-call rotation, incident response, and root cause analysis. 

Qualifications

- 5+ in managing global DNS, NTP and LDAP systems on Linux Operating Systems. 
 - Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code with Ansible, Terraform, or Pulumi. 
 - Working experience implementing OpenLDAP & NTP services (preferably Microchip SyncServer systems). 
 - Expertise with Infoblox DDI systems (or similar enterprise DNS systems: BlueCat, Bind9, CloudFlare, GCP and AWS DNS services). 
 - Familiar with various Infrastructure technology stacks like Hypervisor Technologies (KVM, Vsphere, ), storage protocols (SDS) (iSCSI, NFS, CEPH), L2/L3 Networking 
 - Strong Linux (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu) systems engineering background with advanced scripting in Python, Bash, or Go. 
 - Fluency with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated test frameworks. 
 - Strong experience supporting mission critical 24x7 customer facing production environments. 
 - Demonstrated success building or maintaining multi-region or high-availability OpenStack clusters. 
 - Ability to write technical documentation and contribute to community wikis or knowledge bases and background in large enterprise infrastructure environments. 

Nice To Have

- Familiar with Cisco UCS Blade Servers (or similar server Infrastructure), Block/File Storage (Soft defined storage preferred). 
 - Understanding of security best practices for system patching and security compliance (e. g. , CIS, NIST). 
 - Background in telco, edge cloud environments.

data.title: Associate Engineer  FDM 3D Printing (Hardware & Process)
data.description:
About the job

At Drucks, we're building the future of footwear. 

Every pair we make is designed for one person, printed on demand, and manufactured through our in-house 3D printing technology stack. We don't buy machines and run them. We build them, modify them, improve them, and push them beyond what they're designed to do. 

If you've ever looked at a printer and thought "I can make this better", you'll feel at home here. 

This isn't an operations role. This is for someone who loves hardware, understands FDM printing inside out, and enjoys solving problems that don't have documentation or YouTube tutorials. 

What You'll Do

You'll own our print farm and help make it faster, more reliable, and more capable every single week. Your work will include: 

Operating & Optimising the Print Farm

• Run and monitor multiple FDM printers across production

• Maximise machine uptime and minimise print failures

• Calibrate, maintain and continuously improve printer performance

• Develop robust print profiles for production

Process & Material Development

• Tune parameters for TPU, PVA and multi-material printing

• Optimise temperature, flow, speed, cooling, 

retraction and adhesion

• Handle moisture-sensitive materials and establish

reliable material workflows

• Conduct experiments and convert learnings into production-ready SOPs

Hardware, Firmware & Electronics

• Assemble, rebuild and upgrade custom FDM printers

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical and thermal issues down to root cause

Work on Klipper firmware, macros and printer configurations

• Troubleshoot motion systems, extruders, toolchangers, heated beds, drivers, thermistors, control boards and related electronics

• Commission new machines and validate hardware upgrades

Quality & Documentation

• Define print quality standards

• Create and maintain SOPs, parameter libraries and troubleshooting documentation

• Build systems that reduce recurring failures and improve repeatability

• Track defects, identify patterns and drive corrective actions. 

What We're Looking For

• 2-6 years of hands-on experience with FDM 3D printing

• Strong understanding of printer mechanics, electronics and firmware

• Experience assembling, modifying or repairing FDM printers

• Hands-on experience with Klipper (preferred) or similar open firmware

• Ability to diagnose hardware issues rather than simply re-running prints

• Comfortable working with flexible and hygroscopic materials like TPU and PVA

Strong understanding of process optimisation and print quality

• Mechanical aptitude with printer assembly, maintenance and troubleshooting

• Electronics fundamentals including soldering, schematics and low-voltage systems

• Experience creating SOPs and production processes

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Manufacturing Engineering. 

This Role Isn't For You If

• Your experience is limited to SLA or resin printing

• You've only operated commercial "plug-and-play" printers

• Hardware troubleshooting has always been someone else's responsibility

You prefer structured processes over figuring things out from first principles

Why Join Drucks?

You'll work on one of the world's few end-to-end 3D printed footwear platforms. Our team designs the hardware, develops the materials, writes the firmware, builds the manufacturing workflow and ships products that people wear every day. 

You'll have real ownership, work directly with the founding team, and solve problems that don't exist in traditional manufacturing. 

If you enjoy building machines as much as building products, we'd love to hear from you.

As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world - like AI and IoT. Location: 

Bangalore, IND

We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Technical Lead - Algorithm Developer

Location : ITPL, Bangalore

What's In It for You?

- Work with the best: Join a team of algorithm experts and researchers who are passionate about solving complex challenges in semiconductor inspection. 
 - Innovate at scale: Contribute to the development of cutting-edge detection algorithms that power the next generation of optical wafer inspection tools
 - End-to-end impact: Be involved in the full lifecycle-from concept and feasibility to implementation and integration-of algorithms that directly influence product performance
 - Shape the future: Your work will help enable the production of advanced microchips, driving innovation across industries from AI to consumer electronics

Our Team

We are an algorithm research and development group composed of highly skilled developers who thrive on pushing technological boundaries. We focus on designing and implementing advanced detection, classification, and calibration algorithms for optical inspection systems used in semiconductor manufacturing. With a strong emphasis on innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence, we turn complex challenges into impactful solutions that shape the future of chipmaking. 

What You'll Do

- Drive end-to-end algorithm development projects independently, from problem statement refinement to production deployment

What You Should Have

- Master's degree or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Image/Signal Processing, Computer Vision, or related field from a premier engineering institute

 - Strong mathematical foundation with expertise in applied mathematics for algorithm development
 - Strong background in classical computer vision and image processing (filtering, segmentation, feature extraction, pattern recognition, anomaly detection, image registration)

 - Proven track record of combining classical and deep learning methods to deliver end-to-end solutions
 - Proficient in Python programming with ability to write optimized, production-quality code
 - Experience with image processing libraries such as OpenCV, scikit-image
 - Experience working with domain-specific raw data and building data pipelines
 - Strong experience in algorithm validation, benchmarking, and concept-feasibility methodologies

 - Ability to work independently and drive projects from problem definition to production deployment

 - Experience with chip design data formats (GDSII, OASIS)
 - Proficiency in C/C++ or Java
 - Knowledge of GPU programming using CUDA or OpenCL
 - Experience with MATLAB

Responsibilities

 - Automate tool development, validation, and release workflows using scripting and software engineering techniques, including the effective use of LLMs and AI-assisted development tools. 

Necessary Skills and Experience: 

- Proven experience in C/C++, Java, Python, and shell programming with the ability to add significant new functionality, analyze, and fix complex defects.

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. data.description:

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing electrical systems that power sustainable water solutions for millions of people worldwide? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people. 

As our new Senior Electrical Engineer, you will be driving the design, development, and optimization of electrical systems for next-generation of pump manufacturing & testing technologies, collaborating across manufacturing and R&D to deliver robust, energy-efficient solutions. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Be the tester technical responsible person for CBS EMEA region.

 - Lead technical troubleshooting for tester performance, reliability, control logic, and validation-related issues.

data.title: Guest Relations Supervisor
data.description:
Job Description - Guest Relations Supervisor

Company DescriptionGrand Hotel (Bombay) Pvt. Ltd. is a hospitality company with a legacy dating back to 1922, when the Grand Hotel, Mumbai, was established. The company owns and operates two distinctive properties in India, committed to delivering memorable guest experiences through personalised service, comfort, and hospitality. 

The Grand Hotel, Mumbai, is the flagship property, designed by renowned architect George Wittet and located in the historic Ballard Estate precinct of South Mumbai. Valley View Grand Resort, the group's second property, is situated in the picturesque hill station of Panhala, Kolhapur, at an altitude of approximately 3, 000 feet above sea level. 

With over a century of hospitality heritage, the company is committed to maintaining high service standards while blending traditional hospitality with contemporary guest expectations. 

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site role for a Guest Relations Supervisor at Grand Hotel, Mumbai, located in South Mumbai. 

The Guest Relations Supervisor will be responsible for ensuring exceptional guest experiences through personalised attention, proactive service, and effective resolution of guest concerns. The role involves overseeing guest relations activities, monitoring guest satisfaction, coordinating with Front Office and other hotel departments, and ensuring that guests receive a warm, seamless, and memorable experience throughout their stay. 

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a strong service-oriented attitude, and the ability to lead by example while maintaining the hotel's standards of hospitality. 

Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience & Relations

- Welcome and engage with guests in a warm, courteous, and professional manner. 
 - Build rapport with guests and provide personalised attention, particularly to VIPs, repeat guests, corporate guests, and guests with special requests. 
 - Proactively interact with in-house guests to assess satisfaction and identify opportunities to enhance their experience. 
 - Ensure guest requests, preferences, and special arrangements are communicated to the relevant departments and followed through promptly. 
 - Assist guests with information regarding hotel facilities, dining options, transportation, and local attractions. Complaint Handling & Service Recovery

- Handle guest complaints, feedback, and service-related concerns professionally, ensuring timely and appropriate resolution. 
 - Coordinate with the Front Office Manager, Duty Manager, and other department heads to address escalated issues. 
 - Follow up with guests after resolution to ensure satisfaction and restore confidence in the hotel's service. 
 - Record guest feedback, complaints, and corrective actions to help prevent recurring issues. 
 - Escalate serious complaints, unusual incidents, or matters affecting the hotel's reputation to the management. Team Supervision & Coordination

- Supervise daily guest relations activities and guide team members in maintaining consistent service standards. 
 - Coordinate closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Engineering, and Security to ensure smooth guest experiences. 
 - Monitor room readiness, special amenities, guest preferences, and VIP arrangements in coordination with the concerned departments. 
 - Support the Front Office team during peak arrival and departure periods whenever required. 
 - Encourage teamwork, professional conduct, and a guest-first approach across departments. Guest Feedback & Quality Standards

- Monitor online reviews, guest feedback, and satisfaction trends across relevant booking platforms and feedback channels. 
 - Coordinate with the management team in preparing appropriate responses to guest reviews and feedback. 
 - Maintain accurate records of guest preferences, complaints, service recovery measures, and special requests. 
 - Identify recurring service gaps and recommend practical improvements to management. 
 - Ensure compliance with hotel policies, service standards, grooming requirements, and quality assurance procedures. Administrative & Operational Responsibilities

- Maintain effective communication and handover records between shifts. 
 - Prepare guest relations reports and provide updates on guest satisfaction, pending concerns, and service issues. 
 - Maintain confidentiality of guest information and safeguard hotel assets. 
 - Assist with VIP arrivals, special occasions, guest celebrations, and other hospitality arrangements. 
 - Perform additional duties as assigned by the Front Office Manager or Hotel Management. 
Qualifications & Skills
 - A degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality, or a related field. 
 - Prior experience in Guest Relations, Front Office, or Guest Services in a hotel environment. 
 - Previous supervisory experience will be preferred. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; knowledge of Hindi and additional languages would be an advantage. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills with a natural ability to interact confidently with guests from diverse backgrounds. 
 - Excellent complaint-handling, problem-solving, and service recovery skills. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with hotel Property Management Systems (PMS). 
 - Knowledge of online travel agency platforms, guest feedback systems, and online review management would be an advantage. 
 - Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 
 - A professional appearance, positive attitude, and commitment to delivering exceptional guest service. 
Job SummaryThe Guest Relations Supervisor serves as a key point of contact for guests, ensuring that their needs are anticipated, requests are fulfilled, and concerns are resolved promptly and professionally. The role requires close coordination with hotel departments, effective supervision of guest relations activities, and a proactive approach to guest satisfaction. 

The successful candidate will help strengthen guest loyalty, encourage positive reviews, improve service delivery, and uphold the reputation and hospitality standards of Grand Hotel, Mumbai. 

Salary PackageAn attractive salary package will be offered in accordance with industry standards, commensurate with the candidate's experience, qualifications, and suitability for the role.

 - Participate in process creation, product architecture decisions, technology roadmap creation and continuous improvement initiatives
 - Encourage team members to think, organize and lead while providing them with developmental and career growth opportunities. 
 - Lead effective cross-disciplinary collaboration between various stakeholders and teams. 
 - Facilitating collaboration between other departments (Supply chain, Service, Operations)
 - Interviewing and hiring new team members. 

Critcal Capabilities And Qualifications

- Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, interpersonal and presentation)
 - Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a team. 
 - Strong decision-making and judgment. 
 - System level thinking at both a product and enterprise level. 
 - Excellent knowledge of the mechanical design discipline
 - Demonstrates high degree of flexibility and embraces changing priorities. 
 - Knowledge of Husky products, tools, standards, processes and technology is an asset. 

Education

- Bachelor or Master's of engineering degree from accredited university

Experience

- 10+ years relevant engineering experience. 
 - Proven leadership experience. 
 - Previous engineering experience in heavy machinery or injection molding industry is an asset.

Job Description

Reporting to the Supplier Quality Manager, the Supplier Quality Analyst (SQA) executes activities aiming to ensure that all supplied components within their portfolio of suppliers are ready to use when reaching internal or external customers. The SQA is the primary quality contact for assigned suppliers and is responsible for supplier qualification, audits, performance monitoring, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Qualify and audit new and existing suppliers to Husky standards. 
 - Monitor supplier performance and drive improvement actions. 
 - Manage supplier part qualification activities. 
 - Support containment actions, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation. 
 - Participate in Andon and Clinic activities related to supplier quality issues. 
 - Conduct quality risk assessments for localization and dual-sourcing initiatives. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Supply Chain Quality Management System. 

Critical Capabilities

- Strong knowledge of quality systems, supplier quality management, and auditing. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills using structured methodologies (8D, 5 Why, RCA). 
 - Ability to influence suppliers and drive corrective actions to closure. 
 - Understanding of manufacturing, assembly, and logistics processes. 
 - Strong analytical, project management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Willingness to travel domestically as required. 

Education, Experience & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Quality Engineering. 
 - Knowledge of machining, casting, fabrication, and assembly processes is an asset. 
 - Ability to read engineering drawings and interpret GD&T. 
 - Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and SPC. 
 - Experience with ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. 
 - Fluent in written and spoken English.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets

Incident & Operational Support

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads

data.title: Senior Principal - Platform Architect WiFi
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's enterprise wireless platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture. 
 - Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations. 
 - Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational. 
 - Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after. 
 - Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim. 
 - Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work. 
 - Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions. 
 - Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why. 
 - Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it. 
 - Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted. 
 - Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems). 
 - Architecture certifications desirable (e. g. , TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance. 
 - Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable. 

Why is this level of Education Required?

- Deep architecture credentials are needed because the role sets the standards that engineering teams and suppliers must build to, and those standards have to withstand security, compliance and reliability challenge. 

Experience Required

- Overall, 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace. 
 - Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard. 
 - Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets. 
 - Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context. 
 - Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet. 
 - Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 
 - Extensive experience designing enterprise wireless services across complex campus environments. 
 - Deep knowledge of radio frequency design, capacity, roaming, guest access and wireless security. 
 - Evidence of defining wireless architectures that improved coverage, user experience, resilience or operational efficiency. 

Desirable Requirements

- Advanced wireless certification, such as Certified Wireless Network Expert. 
 - Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Meraki or Juniper Mist wireless platforms. 
 - Experience supporting location services, Internet of Things or operational technology wireless use cases. 

Other Job-Related Skills/Background

- Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented. 
 - Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard. 
 - Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them. 
 - Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome. 
 - Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright. 
 - Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform. 

#AGTech

Skills

Automation Technology, Cisco IP, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Design Assurance, GxPs, IP Address Management (IPAM), Juniper MX, Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, RF Design, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless Architecture, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

data.title: SDE-2 (React Native + Full stack)
data.description:
Software Development Engineer - II

Frontend Platform (Orion)

Urban Company | Gurugram

About the Company

Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc. , all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high-quality, standardised, and reliable service experience. To fulfil this promise, we work closely with our hand-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise. 

Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind -

- Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
 - Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
 - Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age-old industry

About the Role & Team

Orion is Urban Company's in-house frontend platform: the framework, component system, rendering layer and release infrastructure that every customer and provider facing entity at Urban Company is built on. It is not a library we adopted; we designed and own all of it. 

Orion is deliberately cross-stack. It spans React Native as the base rendering engine for our customer and partner apps, a micro-frontend architecture, and native Android and iOS layers underneath, with a single component system across all of them. 

At UC we follow a micro frontend architecture, every product flow: a booking flow, a category page, a checkout step is built as an independently developed and independently deployed micro-frontend that renders inside the Orion shell, on both app and web. A team ships its changes without coordinating a release with anyone else. 

Our pod owns that architecture: the shell and its contracts, routing and lifecycle, isolation between micro-frontends, shared state and navigation across them. As the number of micro-frontends grows, holding that boundary clean while keeping the app feeling like one product is among the hardest problems on the platform. 

Orion's server-driven UI lets product teams change what a screen shows without shipping an app release, and its own in-house over-the-air pipeline delivers JavaScript updates straight to users' devices. Every product engineer at Urban Company builds on Orion, which means a change to the platform is felt across the entire company. 

Our pod sits inside the Orion team, and owns the following charters built on top of it: 

- Merchant Platform: Letting integrating partners sell their services from inside Urban Company. Their experience runs in a container inside our app session, integrated SSO auth, deeplinks, order lifecycle, discovery touchpoints, and their orders showing up alongside ours in the customer's bookings. The bar is performance good enough that our users cannot tell where our product ends and theirs begins while keeping in mind the security and stability repercussions. 
 - Third-Party Integrations: Taking Urban Company services into other companies' apps. Their users book us without ever leaving their product, server-to-server booking flows, request journeys, catalogue mapping, idempotency, and reconciliation when the other side goes quiet. 
 - Release & Over-the-Air Delivery: OTA bundles for customer and partner apps, Android, iOS and web release pipelines, canary rollouts. 
 - Platform itself: Because the pod is part of the Orion team, whoever joins also owns and contributes to Orion itself, the shared components, the rendering and navigation layer, the release pipeline. You will not just consume the platform, you will improve it, and what you build there is used by every product team at Urban Company and has a direct impact on both our customer and provider app and website ecosystem. 

This is a genuinely cross-stack charter. A single feature here routinely spans a React Native container, a Node. js service and an event pipeline, which is why we hire strong frontend engineers and grow them across the full stack rather than keeping them on one side of it. 

What You'll Do

- Build the Merchant Platform: Take partner brands live inside the Urban Company app, session handoff, order lifecycle, discovery surfaces. While making it secure and fast enough that our users cannot tell where our product ends and theirs begins. 
 - Take Urban Company Into Other Apps: Design and ship server-to-server booking flows that let another company's users book us from inside their product. From the first partner call through contract design, idempotency, rollout and reconciliation. 
 - Strengthen Orion Itself: Improve the shared components, rendering layer and release infrastructure that every Urban Company product team depends on. 
 - Own and Scale the Micro-frontend Architecture: Evolve the shell, contracts and lifecycle that every product team's surface plugs into, and keep the experience feeling like one app as the number of micro-frontends grows. 
 - Grow Across the Stack: Start in React Native, then take on the Node. js services behind your own features. We expect this, we plan for it, and you will not be doing it alone. 
 - Elevate Technical Standards: Write production-grade code, drive architectural design discussions, and raise the bar on performance, correctness and observability. 

Technology Stack

You will get hands-on exposure to: 

- Frontend (primary): React Native, TypeScript, micro-frontends architecture
 - Native: Kotlin (Android), Swift (iOS)
 - Backend: Node. js, TypeScript
 - Databases: MongoDB, MySQL, redis
 - Events: Kafka, event-driven systems
 - Analytics: Snowflake
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana
 - Architecture: Micro-frontends, server-driven UI, microservices
 - Delivery: In-house over-the-air pipeline, feature flags and experiments

What We're Looking For

- 2-4 years of software engineering experience. 
 - At least 2 years building React Native, or modern web with React/Next. js, shipped to real users at real scale. 
 - Strong JavaScript and TypeScript. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals. 
 - Comfortable debugging on real devices: logs, traces, profilers, network waterfalls. 
 - You already develop with an AI agent. Claude Code is mandatory for every engineer at Urban Company, it is how we write code, debug production issues and find our way around unfamiliar services. You should be comfortable building with an AI coding agent. 
 - Strong ownership mindset. You have taken a feature from spec through build and release, and then watched the metrics. 
 - Open to writing backend. No backend experience needed on day one; genuine interest is the requirement. (Backend code in production in any language is a plus. )
 - Native Android or iOS exposure, server-driven UI, design systems, or hard performance work is a plus. 
 - Experience with mobile release pipelines, CI, or over-the-air delivery is a plus. 
 - Comfortable working in a large codebase you did not write. 

What Can You Expect at UC?

- Massive ownership and direct customer impact. 
 - An AI-native engineering org: Claude Code is standard for every engineer here. It changes what a small pod can own, and it collapses the time it takes to understand a service you have never opened. We are still working out what good practice looks like, and you will help decide it. 
 - Work on the surfaces every Urban Company customer touches, and the platform every product team builds on. 
 - Genuine full-stack growth, frontend to backend, web to native, rather than a single layer for years. 
 - A high-performance, high-velocity engineering culture. 
 - Quick iterations with real-world feedback loops. 
 - Opportunity to grow into senior technical leadership roles. 
 - Exposure to problems involving, Cross-platform rendering, app performance on low-end devices, over-the-air delivery and safe rollback, partner API integration, idempotency and correctness.

data.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer/ Expert
data.description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. 

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2, 500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. 

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA

PURPOSE

Responsible for the proactive support of products so that there is high product performance that is continuously improved. Responsible for identifying and resolving the root causes of operational incidents implementing solutions to improve stability and prevent recurrence. Manages the creation and maintenance of the event catalog to trigger events and develops both manual remediation approaches and automated workflows to resolve alerts. Oversees the deployment of IT services and solutions ensuring successful integration with minimal disruption. Focuses on operational automation and integration to enhance efficiency and collaboration between development and operations within service operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Site Reliability Engineer

- Define, build, and maintain support systems to ensure high availability and performance. 
 - Handle complex cases for the Operations team. 
 - Build events to add to the event catalog for the relevant product or application. 
 - Implement automation for system provisioning, self-healing, auto recovery, deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Perform incident response and root cause analysis for critical system failures. 
 - Monitor system performance and establish service-level indicators (SLIs) and objectives (SLOs). 
 - Collaborate with development and operations to integrate reliability best practices, including moving to zero downtime architecture. 
 - Proactively identify and remediate performance issues. 
 - Work closely with Product, Software & Infra Engineering and Service support architects for new product productization
 - Ensure Operations readiness to support new products
 - Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders for feedback for continual service improvement for in scope products & drive plan till successful closure

 - Coordinate with incident management teams, operations experts and collaborate with different Service Operations and Engineering teams to develop and implement permanent solutions. 
 - Monitor the effectiveness of problem resolution activities, provide regular reports on problem management activities, and ensure continuous improvement.

- Define and maintain an event catalog, specifying active events, thresholds, and relevant remediation, and optimize it for efficiency.

 - Automate operational processes, monitor system performance, and resolve issues related to automation scripts to increase efficiency. 
 - Implement and manage infrastructure as code, provide ongoing support for automation tools, and continuously improve DevOps practices.

 - Proven experience in managing high-availability systems and ensuring operational reliability. 
 - Extensive experience in root cause analysis (RCA) incident management and developing permanent solutions for recurring service disruptions.

 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation system performance monitoring and the implementation of infrastructure as code.

data.title: Data Engineer L3
data.description:
Forbes Advisor is a new initiative for consumers under the Forbes Marketplace umbrella that provides journalist- and expert-written insights, news and reviews on all things personal finance, health, business, and everyday life decisions. We do this by providing consumers with the knowledge and research they need to make informed decisions they can feel confident in, so they can get back to doing the things they care about most. 

We are looking for a highly skilled Data Engineer (L3) with strong expertise in Python, data ingestion pipelines and marketing data systems, particularly with the Meta Ads ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and social/native platforms, enabling scalable data pipelines, high-quality datasets, and lead generation and business decision-making. 

This role goes beyond building pipelines - will be responsible for: 

- Designing scalable data architecture
 - Driving business outcomes (revenue, lead quality, conversion efficiency)
 - Owning how data is used, trusted and acted upon

The ideal candidate will not manage campaign buying or bidding directly but must clearly understand ad platform mechanics, attribution models and lead quality scores and will work closely with the Data Lead / Engineering Lead, acting as a key contributor in shaping solutions, making technical decisions, and delivering high-impact data products. . 

Responsibilities

- Data Engineering & Pipelines
 - Design, build, and maintain robust data data pipelines for social marketing and product data sources (APIs, event streams, batch systems)
 - Develop scalable ETL/ELT workflows / microservices using Python and SQL
 - Ensure high data quality, reliability and observability across pipelines
 - Optimize data models for analytics and reporting use cases
 - Marketing & Ad Platform Data
 - Own ingestion and modeling of data from Meta Ads (Facebook) and other digital marketing platforms
 - Build datasets that support campaign performance tracking, lead funnel analysis, attribution and conversion tracking
 - Understand key concepts such as campaign structure (campaign/ad set/ad level), bidding & optimization signals, attribution windows, pixel / event tracking. 
 - Business Understanding & Collaboration
 - Translate business requirements from marketing, growth and product teams into scalable data solutions
 - Define success metrics tied to revenue and performance
 - Enable self-serve analytics through well-structured datasets
 - Data Quality & Governance
 - Implement validation checks, monitoring and alerting for pipelines
 - Ensure consistency across different marketing data sources
 - Maintain clear documentation of data models and pipelines
 - Business Collaboration & Use Case Ownership
 - Work closely with marketing, growth, and analytics teams to understand real-world use cases and define success metrics tied to revenue and performance
 - Own key use cases such as lead funnel optimization, campaign attribution and revenue reporting and forecasting
 - Ensure data enables decision-making, not just reporting
 - Engineering Standards & Best Practices
 - Design and implement modular, reusable microservices that enable the scalable development of data products. 
 - Drive standardization through well-architected, loosely coupled services that can be leveraged across multiple use cases. 
 - Uphold high standards in code quality and modularity, pipeline reliability and monitoring, documentation and data contracts
 - Contribute to shared frameworks and reusable components
 - Promote best practices across the data engineering team

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Core Technical Skills
 - Strong proficiency in Python (must-have)
 - Advanced SQL skills for large-scale data processing
 - Hands-on experience with data ingestion from APIs (rate limits, pagination, retries)
 - Experience with data orchestration tools (e. g. , Airflow or equivalent)
 - Familiarity with cloud data platforms (BigQuery, etc. )
 - Experience building scalable data ingestion systems
 - Familiarity with microservices-style or modular data systems
 - Strong understanding of performance and cost optimization
 - Ad Platform Knowledge
 - Solid understanding of Meta Ads platform fundamentals
 - Familiarity with campaign hierarchy and metrics (CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS), conversion tracking and attribution model, Lead generation workflows and funnel metrics
 - Ability to interpret marketing data beyond surface-level metrics
 - Exposure to event tracking systems (GA4, Snowplow, etc)

Good to Have

- Experience with other ad platforms (Google Ads, Bing Ads, etc. )
 - Knowledge of data modeling best practices (e. g. , star schema, dbt)
 - Experience with real-time or near real-time data pipelines

What Success Looks Like

- Reliable, scalable pipelines for marketing data ingestion
 - High-quality datasets enabling accurate campaign and lead analysis
 - Strong partnership with marketing teams, translating business needs into data solutions
 - Improved visibility into lead quality, attribution and campaign performance
 - Clear ownership of end-to-end data use cases, not just components

Why Join Us

- Work at the intersection of data engineering and growth marketing
 - Solve high-impact problems in performance marketing and attribution
 - Own meaningful data products end-to-end
 - Influence both technical architecture and business outcomes
 - Be part of a team that values ownership, impact and engineering excellence

Perks

- Day off on the 3rd Friday of every month (one long weekend each month)
 - Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Program to promote health well-being
 - Monthly Office Commutation Reimbursement Program
 - Paid paternity and maternity leaves

 - Strong problem-solving skills, ownership, and a proactive, go-getter attitude.

If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. 

How We Work

No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.

Our Approach to Flexible Work: 
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter. 

Who We Are

We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world's leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. 

Mattel's award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

data.title: Senior cosmetic formulator
data.description:
About the RoleWe are establishing a new cosmetic manufacturing facility in Noida and are looking for an experienced Cosmetic Formulator and R&D Leader to build and lead our formulation and product development team. 

We are looking for someone who has hands-on industry experience in cosmetic formulation, with a proven track record of developing products that have successfully gone to market. The ideal candidate should have experience working with existing commercial SKUs, understand the entire product development cycle, and possess the technical creativity to develop innovative, high-performance formulations rather than simply replicate existing products. 

This role will be responsible for building our formulation capabilities from the ground up, developing new product formulations, optimizing existing formulations, establishing laboratory processes, and leading a team of chemists to create differentiated cosmetic products. 

Key Responsibilities1. Formulation Development & Innovation
 - Develop innovative, high-performance formulations across skincare, haircare, body care and other cosmetic categories. 
 - Create unique formulations with differentiated textures, sensory experiences, ingredient combinations and performance benefits. 
 - Develop products inspired by global market trends while creating original formulations with a distinct competitive advantage. 
 - Formulate creams, serums, gels, lotions, sunscreens, cleansers, toners, emulsions, masks and other cosmetic products. 
 - Work with advanced active ingredients, functional ingredients, delivery systems, emulsifiers, preservatives and rheology modifiers. 
 - Troubleshoot formulation challenges and continuously improve stability, efficacy, aesthetics and product performance. 2. Commercial Product & Market Experience
 - Bring practical experience with cosmetic products that have already been commercialized and are available in the market. 
 - Understand the journey from laboratory formulation to pilot batch, manufacturing scale-up and commercial production. 
 - Develop formulations that are commercially viable, scalable, stable and cost-effective. 
 - Evaluate competing products, ingredient technologies and global cosmetic trends to identify opportunities for innovation. 
 - Translate product briefs and consumer requirements into technically sound formulations. 3. R&D Laboratory Setup & Operations
 - Establish and organize the formulation laboratory at our new manufacturing facility. 
 - Identify laboratory equipment, instruments, raw materials, testing requirements and operational workflows. 
 - Establish formulation SOPs, documentation systems, batch records and laboratory protocols. 
 - Build a systematic product development process from concept and prototype through validation and production handover. 
 - Develop a structured raw material database, formulation library and product development pipeline. 4. Stability, Testing & Quality
 - Design and execute stability testing, compatibility testing and accelerated stability studies. 
 - Evaluate product parameters including pH, viscosity, texture, appearance, spreadability, sensory properties and performance. 
 - Troubleshoot issues related to separation, oxidation, discoloration, fragrance instability, preservative efficacy and packaging compatibility. 
 - Coordinate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure formulations meet applicable cosmetic regulations and safety requirements. 5. Manufacturing & Scale-Up
 - Transfer formulations from laboratory scale to pilot and commercial manufacturing scale. 
 - Work closely with production teams to establish manufacturing processes, mixing parameters, temperatures, homogenization requirements, addition sequences and processing times. 
 - Troubleshoot manufacturing issues and ensure reproducibility between laboratory batches and commercial batches. 
 - Optimize formulations for manufacturing efficiency, yield, consistency and cost. 6. Team Leadership
 - Recruit, mentor, train and lead a team of formulation chemists and laboratory personnel. 
 - Set R&D priorities, timelines, project milestones and development targets. 
 - Foster a culture of scientific curiosity, innovation, experimentation and accountability. 
 - Review formulations, technical work and development progress while ensuring the team consistently delivers quality results. Required Experience & Qualifications
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline. 
 - Minimum 5-8 years of hands-on experience in cosmetic formulation and product development. 
 - Strong preference for candidates currently or previously working with established cosmetic manufacturers, skincare brands, third-party manufacturing companies or product development laboratories. 
 - Proven experience developing formulations that have successfully launched commercially and are currently sold in the market. 
 - Strong expertise in formulation chemistry, ingredient functionality, emulsification, rheology, preservation, stability and cosmetic product design. 
 - Experience in commercial manufacturing scale-up and production troubleshooting. 
 - Previous experience managing, mentoring or leading a formulation/R&D team is highly desirable. 
 - Ability to independently develop formulations rather than relying entirely on supplier-provided base formulas. Ideal Candidate ProfileWe are looking for a technically strong, hands-on formulator who is equally comfortable working in a laboratory and leading a team. 

The ideal candidate: 

- Has personally developed multiple successful commercial cosmetic SKUs. 
 - Has a strong portfolio of products they have formulated or helped bring to market. 
 - Has the ability to develop genuinely differentiated formulations and innovative textures. 
 - Is knowledgeable about new ingredients, actives, formulation technologies and global beauty trends. 
 - Can build a formulation laboratory and R&D team from scratch. 
 - Understands commercial realities including raw material costs, margins, manufacturing feasibility and scalability. 
 - Is proactive, entrepreneurial and capable of taking ownership of product development. What We Offer
 - Opportunity to lead and build the formulation R&D function at a new cosmetic manufacturing facility. 
 - Freedom to experiment, innovate and develop proprietary formulations. 
 - Access to laboratory infrastructure, raw materials and product development resources. 
 - Leadership role with direct influence over the company's product portfolio and innovation strategy. 
 - Opportunity to build and lead your own formulation team. 
 - Monetary incentiveApplication RequirementsCandidates should share: 

- Updated CV detailing formulation and R&D experience. 
 - List of cosmetic products/SKUs they have developed or contributed to that have been commercially launched. 
 - Categories and formulation technologies they specialize in. 
 - Previous employers and nature of their responsibilities. 
 - Experience in laboratory setup, team leadership and manufacturing scale-up. Candidates without hands-on commercial cosmetic formulation experience will not be considered.

Expected outcomes:

Experience Requirements

data.title: Staff Platform Engineer
data.description:
Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data!

Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. As a Staff Platform Engineer

You'll develop internal tools, create and enhance Linux CLI applications and extend Go-based tools with plugins. You'll also build web applications to integrate these tools with customer APIs and services. 

A day in the life of Staff Platform Engineer

Primarily developing/extending Linux command-line (CLI applications for the various product offerings at Acceldata. Example: tools similar to kubectl, docker-cli and aws-cli). 

Extending our existing internal tools developed in Go programming language by developing various plugins. (Example: plugins that can extend the functionalities of Telegraf, Filebeat etc. , )

You are a great fit for this role if you have

- 9-12 years of total experience. 
 - Hands-on experience in Go programming language paradigms, constructs and idioms
 - Experience with Golang frameworks such as Cobra, Gin or HashiCorp's Go-Plugin. 
 - Understanding of Go-specific data structures & algorithms, RESTful web services. 
 - Experience in relational & non-relational databases. 
 - Knowledge of DevOps tools such as Docker/Kubernetes and practices is an advantage. 
 - Experience in Linux and system application development. 

Bonus Points for

- Proficiency in Big Data Systems or Hadoop components. 

We care for our team

- Mentorship & Growth
 - ESOPs
 - Medical and Life Insurance
 - Paid Maternity & Parental Leave
 - Corporate Uber Program
 - Learning & Development Support

Acceldata for All

We are a fast-growing company, solving complex data problems at scale. We are driven by strong work ethics, high standards of excellence, and a spirit of collaboration. We promote innovation, commitment, and accountability. Our goal is to cultivate a healthy work environment that fosters a sense of belonging, encourages teamwork, and brings out the best in every individual. 

Why Acceldata?

Acceldata is redefining data observability for enterprise data systems. Founded by experts who recognized the need for innovative monitoring and management solutions in a cloud-first, AI-driven environment, our platform empowers data teams to effectively manage data products. We address common challenges such as scaling and performance issues, cost overruns, and data quality problems by providing operational visibility, proactive alerts, and monitoring reliability across the various environments. 

Delivered as a SaaS product, Acceldata's solutions have been embraced by global customers, such as HPE, HSBC, Visa, Freddie Mac, Manulife, Workday, Zoominfo, GSK, Oracle, PubMatic, PhonePe (Walmart), Hersheys, Dun & Bradstreet, and many more. Acceldata is a Series-C funded company and its investors include Insight Partners, March Capital, Lightspeed, Sorenson Ventures, Industry Ventures, and Emergent Ventures.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

This role supports mission‐critical systems, demands strong engineering discipline, and offers opportunities to collaborate with senior architects and cross-functional cloud teams. Cloud Engineering & Delivery

- Build, migrate, and manage Microsoft Azure IaaS solutions, including SAP Workloads, VMs, VNets, App Services, Functions, Databases, Storage, and Integration Services.

 - Enhance, follow, and contribute to enterprise cloud designs, processes, and governance.
