- 7+ years of Azure Cloud experience in application development, cloud operations, or infrastructure engineering. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Azure core services: 
 - IaaS (VMs, VNets, NSGs, Load Balancers, Storage, ASR)
 - Experience automating deployments using PowerShell, Python, JSON, YAML, CI/CD, Azure DevOps (Microsoft VSTS). 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across distributed systems and global network environments. 
 - Experience supporting or building cloud architectures in production environments. 
 - Ability to perform development/deployment assignments without close supervision. 
 - Ability to work directly on technical problem identification and resolution, including responding to off-shift and weekend support calls. 
 - Ability to deploy or integrate infrastructure technology components based on requirements gathered from customers. 
 - Ability to perform integrated testing and customer acceptance testing of components that require careful planning and execution to ensure timely, quality results. 
 - This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office

- Experience with Azure infrastructure operations or applications development, with special emphasis in areas of SAP workloads, networking, DNS, application services, security, distributed computing, databases, and storage

S. which can be found through our employment website at www. caterpillar. com/careers

Your Role at Baxter

As System Verification Test engineer for Infusion pumps team within Medication delivery business, the incumbent will have an independent responsibility of following instructions clearly in executing Test procedures for supporting all activities related to Design Verification of the medical devices. Candidate will also assist in maintaining Lab equipment, work with Design engineers to help build Test fixtures/assemblies and assisting with Lab logistics. 

What You'll Be Doing

Lead/Execute, perform, summarize and report out verification test activities Medical devices: Which includes but not limited to: 

- Understand URS (User requirements) / System Requirements and prepare the System Level Test cases and Prepare test procedures. 
 - Understand the product functionality and perform the Functional and Performance testing for the product. 
 - Lead/Support and perform all Design Verification activates
 - Perform Installation/Operational/Performance Qualification Protocols
 - Prepare Traceability Matrices and Final Reports. 
 - Support compliance/ closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements
 - Follow Test instructions and Test protocols. 
 - Follow instructions clearly from Design engineers during Test execution. 
 - Support Design engineers in Test fixture creation, building up & tearing down Test equipment. 
 - Support Lab logistics and maintain the material supply for testing requirements. Support Calibration activities. 
 - Diagnose, isolate and investigate problem reports and defects. 
 - Support to work with external test houses (such as EMI, EMC tests for electrical boards and full device) to define the test scope, author the test plans, test procedures, execute & consolidate the reports
 - Ensure good documentation and Good Manufacturing practices are followed in the Verification Process
 - Experience in IEC basic safety, EMI-EMC standards
 - Interacts with design team to resolve tests-related technical issues. 
 - Presents the findings / objective evidence and able to present with rationale with applicability / exclusions
 - Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective / Preventive action as needed. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Bio-Medical, Industrial Engineering or related field

 - Hands on experience in overall final design verification/validation(V&V) testing of medical products.

 - An understanding of test methods and processes as well as the methods used to verify product in the realms of; mechanical, electrical, functional testing environments. 
 - Basic hands on experience in data analysis of Performance testing and Sample size calculations for variable/Attribute data
 - Experience in Tools like Minitab( Data Analysis) / JIRA ( Defect ) / ALM ( test Environment) etc. 
 - Understanding of hardware and software product design methodologies and test practices. 
 - Experience in medical device or similar product development, design verification/validation, system integration (hardware/Subsystem/Software), risk management, reliability engineering, process validation and Quality systems
 - Basic understanding of and adherence to FDA, MDD/MDR, ISO and IEC design control procedures, regulations and standards. 
 - Self-motivated with good interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to follow instructions clearly. 
 - Good to have System V&V Engineers with Experience in Infusion pumps design verification testing.

This role applies a systems engineering foundation with a strong emphasis on requirements‐based verification, interface testing, and system integration activities. The position does not own validation activities, but collaborates closely with teams responsible for clinical and user validation. 

Your team

 - Contribute to continuous improvement of interoperability verification methods, tools, and best practices

 - 3+ years of experience in medical device or regulated product development, with a focus on verification activities
 - Systems engineering background with strong experience in requirements management, traceability, and verification planning
 - Hands‐on experience with system, interface, or integration verification testing
 - Familiarity with medical device interoperability concepts, healthcare IT integration, or connected systems
 - Experience participating in design control and change management processes

data.title: Software Development Manager, AWS Just Walk Out
data.description:
Description

As part of the AWS Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use. 

Just Walk Out builds technology enables a new kind of stores with no lines and no checkout-you just grab and go! Customers simply use the Amazon Go app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go!

Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you're done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we'll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earths' most customer centric company and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in vision, machine learning, distributed systems and hardware. 

As a Software Development Manager, you will own delivery of cross functional initiatives to build new features and improve Just Walk Out experience. You will manage a team of 6-10 software development engineers to build and enhance the shopping experience in Just Walk out stores. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for an individual that thrives by creating high-bar engineering culture. You'll be chartered with building software that deliver critical capabilities to our AWS Just Walk out business enabling bar raising customer experience, embed operational knowledge and encode best practices into everything we do. 

We have a team culture that encourages innovation and we expect team members and management alike to take high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. Beyond a strong engineering, data storage/modeling, visualization, and front-end background, a successful candidate will have experience successfully leading teams, developing people, and building a scalable infrastructure. We are looking for someone that is a self-starter, someone that approaches complex business questions with data and curiosity, and a person that dives below the surface to identify the root cause and "so what" rather than just superficial trends

About The Team

Just Walk Out (JWO) is an AWS technology that eliminates checkout lines using computer vision, sensors, & AI. JWO operates across multiple countries, spanning stadiums, airports, college campuses, & Amazon fulfillment centers. We run multiple business models - including vision-based stores & RFID checkout - & we're growing fast. As we scale into new markets & verticals, we're deploying LLMs for shopper support, building AI agents that can operate autonomously, & re-architecting our platform to serve multiple businesses across countries with varying tax, privacy, & regulatory requirements. 

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications & skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive & broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing & never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products & services to power their businesses. 

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity & connection. Our employee-led & company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion & empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, & passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, & other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- 2+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Compute Platforms
data.description:
Five9 is a leader in AI-powered cloud contact center software, serving thousands of customers around the world and powering billions of customer interactions every year. We help enterprises deliver smarter customer experience with every interaction, turning every customer conversation into an opportunity to build trust, deepen loyalty, and drive growth. Our Genius CX platform combines deep contact center expertise with applied AI to deliver outcomes the business can measure. 

Our team-first culture enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. 

About The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Sr DevOps Engineer - Compute Platforms with strong operational expertise in enterprise compute platforms to implement, and support Kubernetes on baremetal and hypervisor platforms in a private cloud environment. This role focuses on the deployment, automation, support, and continuous improvement of large-scale compute environments spanning bare metal infrastructure, virtualization, private cloud, and Kubernetes platforms using Infrastructure-as-Code and GitOps practices. 

This is a deeply technical role requiring expert-level understanding of compute hardware management, Kubernetes, OpenStack, hypervisors and extensive working knowledge on Linux Operating systems. You will also collaborate with platform and SRE teams to maintain secure, performant, and multi-tenant-isolated services that serve high-throughput, mission-critical applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Operate and support enterprise compute platforms across hardware, OS, virtualization, and container orchestration layers 
 - Develop and improve automation for provisioning, patching, upgrades, validation, and routine platform work using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Git, Bash, Python, or similar technologies 
 - Deploy and Support Ubuntu-based systems, hypervisors, Kubernetes clusters, and related platform services in day-to-day operations 
 - Implement and maintain PXE-based provisioning environments leveraging Redfish APIs for large-scale server deployments 
 - Operate and support virtualization and private cloud platforms, including KVM on Ubuntu, OpenStack environments and Harvester HCI 
 - Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability; proactively address reliability risks 
 - Troubleshoot complex cross-stack issues spanning hardware, OS, virtualization, OpenStack, and Kubernetes 
 - Manage to SLAs, KPIs and error budgets 
 - Participate in on-call escalation support for complex platform-related issues 
 - Collaborate globally on change management, documentation, and operational best practices. 
 - Develop and maintain runbooks, operational procedures, and technical documentation

Minimum Qualifications

- Minimum 6 years of experience as a DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, or Infrastructure Operations Engineer with a strong focus on compute 
 - Strong hands-on experience operating bare metal compute environments at scale 
 - Experience with PXE boot, automated OS provisioning, and server imaging systems 
 - Practical experience supporting Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS) platforms leveraging Redfish APIs 
 - Strong Linux administration skills, especially with Ubuntu 
 - Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation 
 - Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible, or similar) 
 - Operational experience with virtualization and private cloud platforms, including KVM on Ubuntu, OpenStack operations and troubleshooting, Harvester HCI 
 - Experience deploying and operating production Kubernetes environments 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar languages 
 - Strong understanding on SRE functions like toil reduction, error budgets and meeting SLAs 
 - Proven troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills in complex distributed systems 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- OpenStack, Ubuntu KVM administration. 
 - BareMetal as a Service (PXE, Redfish). 
 - Kubernetes on BareMetal 
 - Understanding CIS/NIST security and infrastructure lifecycle management. 
 - ITIL Foundation/advanced certifications in support of ITSM standard methodology. 
 - Background in telco, edge cloud, or large enterprise environments. 
 - Ubuntu Certifications, CNCF Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) 
 - Master's degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience and relevant industry certifications will also be considered. 

What You'll Get

- A collaborative team that's deeply invested in infrastructure excellence. 
 - Complex technical challenges that require creative, scalable solutions. 
 - The opportunity to shape a next-generation private cloud platform-built reliability. 
 - Access to the latest tools, frameworks, and upstream project developments.

data.title: Director of Engineering
data.description:
About Bright Money

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck. 

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U. S. -market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools. 

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. 

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B. 

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia. 

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey's Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi's Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India. 

What is the role about?

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright's consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them. 

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO's technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next. 

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U. S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric. 

What will you do?

- Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams. 
 - Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you. 
 - Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO's technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship. 
 - Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability. 
 - Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U. S. consumer-lending business. 
 - AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org. 
 - Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them. 
 - Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them. 
 - Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed. 

Ideal candidate profile

Experience & Background: 

- Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads. 
 - Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling. 
 - Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument. 
 - Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced. 
 - ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams. 
 - Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning. 
 - Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers. 
 - Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus. 
 - Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate. 

Mindset & Operating DNA: 

- Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams' deliverables. 
 - Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position. 
 - Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience. 
 - Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop. 
 - Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it. 

Non-Fit Profiles

- Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience. 
 - Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale. 
 - Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions. 
 - Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting. 
 - Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership. 

What Bright Offers?

- A profitable sub-unicorn with U. S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations. 
 - Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO. 
 - Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale. 
 - A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed. 
 - Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

data.description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) - the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI-powered applications and experience with agility and ease. 

We're proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a Principal Rust Engineer and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. Know more about us. 

We are building a production language runtime in Rust - compiler, virtual machine, wire protocol client, and application server. You will join as a long-term technical owner of this system, working alongside experienced platform architects and a second FTE Rust engineer. 

In This Role, You Will

Runtime & VM

- Implement and optimize an async register-based virtual machine with cooperative scheduling and built-in function dispatch. 
 - Translate language semantics from a reference C implementation into idiomatic, correct Rust. 

Compiler

- Extend a multi-stage compiler pipeline (lexer, parser, AST, IR, codegen). 
 - Deliver new language features end-to-end with conformance and property-based tests. 

Protocol & Data Layer

- Extend a binary wire protocol implementation reverse-engineered from C source. 
 - Own TLS, authentication, and connection pooling. 

Async & Networking

- Maintain a Tokio-based async runtime handling thousands of concurrent requests with shared state and admission control. 
 - Contribute to HTTP, WebSocket, and gRPC server layers. 

Engineering & Build

- Manage a large multi-crate Cargo workspace - dependency hygiene, CI performance, and release engineering. 

Team Enablement

- Mentor senior engineers (20+ years platform experience) adopting Rust - teaching-oriented code reviews, pair programming, and progressive ownership handoff. 
 - Document architecture decisions and maintain design docs as first-class deliverables. 

Your Background

- Overall 10+ years of Software Engineering Experience
 - 5+ years production Rust in systems software (runtimes, compilers, databases, or networking). 
 - Compiler or language runtime experience - at least one of: parser, AST/IR, bytecode compiler, VM, or interpreter. 
 - Async Rust at scale - Tokio, shared-state concurrency, cancellation safety. 
 - Large multi-crate workspace fluency. 
 - Ability to read large C codebases and derive correct Rust implementations. 
 - Mentorship mindset - patience, clear communication, progressive handoff. 
 - Long-term ownership orientation - multi-year commitment. 
 - Excellent written and verbal English. 
 - CS degree or equivalent (data structures, algorithms, OS, compilers)

Additionally, It Would Be Beneficial If You Have

- VM design - opcode dispatch, cooperative scheduling, register allocation.

data.title: Senior Staff Solution Architect – Revenue Recognition (Oracle Fusion))
data.description:
Job Description Summary

This role is part of the IT Finance Systems team and provides senior solution leadership for Revenue Recognition as GE HealthCare migrates from Oracle E-Business Suite R12 to Oracle Fusion Cloud. We are looking for a revenue accounting practitioner who has delivered multiple ERP implementations across industries and can bring leading practices that go beyond any single platform. The role shapes global solution decisions and guides controlled, scalable revenue recognition capabilities across revenue management, accounting, integrations, and reporting. 

Job Description

In this role, you will

- Act as the design authority for revenue recognition: define target-state business processes and the solution architecture across contract and performance obligation management, revenue accounting, adjustments, reconciliation, close, and reporting. 
 - Advise Finance, Controllership, Commercial, Tax, and business leaders on leading practices in revenue accounting, drawing on experience from other industries and challenging current ways of working where a process should change rather than be configured around. 
 - Lead revenue recognition design for contract and transaction scenarios, including performance obligations, allocation, satisfaction events, contract modifications, variable consideration, billing-versus-revenue differences, and period-end accounting, in line with approved accounting policies under ASC 606 / IFRS 15. 
 - Define and govern the use and integration of Revenue Management, Subledger Accounting, General Ledger, and upstream order, billing, and commercial systems that feed revenue contracts, evaluating options and documenting trade-offs, controls, and accounting impact. 
 - Provide hands-on application leadership for configuration, setup validation, and prototyping, and assess downstream business, accounting, control, security, reporting, and integration impacts. 
 - Lead workshops, fit-gap analysis, solution confirmation, and design reviews, and manage decisions, risks, and dependencies. 
 - Oversee and produce high-quality functional specifications, process flows, user stories, accounting examples, mappings, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria for RICE components; guide technical teams on source-to-target mappings, event and accounting logic, interface controls, error handling, reconciliation, and reporting. 
 - Define test strategy and lead CRP, SIT, UAT, regression, conversion, cutover, and validation of revenue contracts, revenue schedules, accounting entries, balances, and reports. 
 - Lead R12-to-Fusion migration and reconciliation of revenue contract, performance obligation, deferred or unearned revenue, and related accounting data. 
 - Drive training, deployment readiness, and hypercare, and own the solution beyond go-live, including controls, operational documentation, impact assessment of Oracle quarterly releases, enhancements, and continuous improvement. 
 - Mentor product team members, manage cross-workstream risks and dependencies, and communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of experience in revenue accounting or finance systems, including ERP implementations. 
 - Deep expertise in revenue accounting and recognition that does not depend on any one system: the ASC 606 / IFRS 15 framework, contract and performance obligation analysis, allocation, deferred and unearned revenue, contract modifications, and the relationship between contracts, billing, and GL accounting. 
 - Led or held a principal design role in at least three end-to-end ERP implementations across at least two different industries, covering revenue recognition. 
 - Proven ability to advise business stakeholders on alternative process models and leading practices, and to translate approved accounting policies into system requirements. 
 - Working expertise in Oracle Fusion Revenue Management, Subledger Accounting, and integration with Order Management, Receivables (as the billing source), GL, and upstream systems (or Oracle E-Business Suite R12 equivalents), sufficient to validate configuration and explain accounting, control, reporting, and integration impacts. 
 - Experience leading functional design and partnering with technical teams on RICE components. 
 - Experience leading testing, defect resolution, data validation, reconciliation, conversion, deployment, and stabilization. 
 - undefinedPreferred / Added AdvantageDirect participation in an Oracle E-Business Suite R12 to Oracle Fusion migration. Experience with phased deployment and hybrid R12/Fusion coexistence. Hands-on experience with Oracle Revenue Management Cloud Service. Exposure to other ERP, billing, or revenue management platforms, which helps bring a platform-independent perspective. Knowledge of OTBI, BI Publisher, FBDI, web services, and light SQL for analysis and validation. Professional certification such as CPA, CA, or ACCA, or Oracle Cloud certification. undefinedDesired CharacteristicsPlatform-independent thinking and the credibility to challenge and influence senior Finance and business stakeholders. Strong business acumen and ability to translate finance requirements into scalable application solutions. Structured problem-solving, attention to detail, and ability to assess downstream process and system impacts. Strong collaboration and influencing skills across Finance, Business, Product, Architecture, Development, and external implementation partners. Continuous-improvement mindset focused on standardization, controls, adoption, and sustainable support. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

data.title: L4 – Team Lead – Software Tester
data.description:
The Role

- You don't just find defects. You build the team and systems that prevent them from reaching production. 
 - At WWS, the Team Lead - Software Tester drives testing strategy, automation, sprint execution, and release quality while leading and developing the testing team. You bridge Software Development and Testing to ensure reliable, defect-free releases. 
 - The Quality Architect standard: Build a capable testing team, strengthen automation, and make quality accountable in every sprint. 

What You Will Own - Your Responsibilities

- Team Leadership: Manage team workload, sprint planning, performance reviews, KPIs, and individual development. 
 - Test Strategy: Drive manual, automation, API, regression, and performance testing strategies. 
 - Automation Engineering: Build and review Playwright, Cypress, and Postman frameworks and integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Quality Governance: Maintain testing SOPs, documentation, defect standards, and release sign-off processes. 
 - Defect Management: Monitor defect trends, root causes, reopen rates, and resolution timelines. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with SDT, Product, and DevOps teams to ensure sprint and release quality. 
 - Healthcare Compliance: Validate PHI-related workflows and ensure applicable HIPAA security and privacy requirements. 

Non-Negotiable Metric

- DEFECTS CAUGHT BEFORE RELEASE
 - TARGET: ≥ 75%
 - At least 75% of identified defects must be caught during testing before production release, supported by strong automation coverage, effective regression testing, and accurate defect reporting. 

The Fight: What You Will Fight: 

- Recurring defects, weak test strategies, ineffective automation, poor sprint coordination, and releases without proper quality validation. 
 - Your mission: Build strong testing standards, reliable automation, and accountable quality systems that ensure consistent results, regardless of who performs the testing. 

WHO THRIVES HERE: Three Traits We Cannot Teach

- Own the Outcome: Identify root causes, drive corrective actions, and prevent recurring defects. 
 - Build Team Capability: Coach, delegate, evaluate, and develop a high-performing testing team. 
 - Champion Quality: Challenge gaps, question requirements, and escalate release risks while maintaining strong collaboration. 

The Wws Perks

- Leadership exposure in a growing healthcare technology and product engineering environment. 
 - Opportunity to own and strengthen the Software Testing function. 
 - Exposure to modern automation frameworks, CI/CD, AWS, and product engineering practices. 
 - Direct collaboration with Software Development, Product, and DevOps leadership. 
 - Opportunity to build team capabilities, testing standards, and measurable quality systems. 
 - A defined leadership growth path within WWS. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 3+ years in Software Testing / Quality Assurance, with demonstrated team-leading or mentoring experience. 
 - Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of manual testing, functional testing, API testing, regression, integration, and automation testing. 
 - Automation: Practical experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent automation frameworks; Postman for API testing. 
 - Engineering Exposure: Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, AWS, and defect management tools. 
 - Leadership: Ability to manage team performance, sprint priorities, workload allocation, coaching, and technical reviews. 
 - Governance: Experience preparing test strategies, SOPs, test reports, and release sign-off documentation. 
 - Domain Advantage: Exposure to healthcare applications, medical insurance workflows, PHI, and HIPAA compliance. 
 - Work Arrangement: Full-time, Work From Office. 

Contact us on jobs@wonderws. co / 9047477375

To Apply: https: //careers. wonderws. com

data.title: Application Engineer – Automation (PLC / HMI / Servo)
data.description:
Application Engineer - Automation (North India, Delhi NCR)

Luna Technologies is looking for a hands-on Application Engineer who enjoys being on the shop floor: writing PLC and HMI programs, tuning servo systems and commissioning machines at customer sites across North India. 

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides industrial automation, robotics, motion control, mechatronics and pneumatics solutions to OEMs and manufacturers across India. It is headquartered in Navi Mumbai and has offices across the country. 

What You Will Do

• Write, modify and debug PLC programs (ladder and structured text) for customer machines and special-purpose machines. 

• Design and program HMI screens: alarms, recipes, trends and operator screens. 

• Size, configure, tune and commission servo drives and motors: gain tuning, auto-tuning, positioning, homing, multi-axis sync and electronic cam. 

• Commission complete systems at the customer's site: I/O checks, dry runs, trial runs, performance proving and handover. 

• Configure VFDs and set up communication between PLC, HMI, servo and VFD (Modbus RTU/TCP, EtherCAT, Profinet, EtherNet/IP, CANopen). 

• Troubleshoot breakdowns on site and remotely, find the root cause, and keep downtime short. 

• Train customer engineers and operators, and prepare commissioning and test reports. 

• Support the North sales team with technical presentations, demos, application studies and feasibility checks. 

Products You Will Work With

Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek PLC, HMI, servo and VFD products. 

Must Have

• BE/BTech or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Mechatronics. 

• 2-5 years of hands-on PLC and HMI programming. 

• Practical experience with servo tuning and commissioning at customer sites. 

• Good working knowledge of industrial communication protocols. 

• Willingness to travel frequently across North India: Delhi NCR, Haryana, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh. 

Good to Have

• Experience with motion control for packaging, printing, textile, plastic or special-purpose machines. 

• SCADA knowledge and basic control panel and wiring understanding. 

What We Offer

CTC: ₹8-12 lakh per annum, plus performance incentives, travel allowance as per policy, training from the manufacturers we represent, paid leave, and statutory benefits. 

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Role: Director - Analytics Products and Solutions

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

Role Type: People Leader (multi-team / product portfolio)

What We Are- MiQ

We're MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we're all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better. 

Role purpose

As Director - Analytics Products and Solutions, you will be the technical leader who owns the end-to-end architecture, solutioning, and delivery of MiQ's local product portfolio. Product strategy, roadmap prioritisation, and go-to-market plans are owned by commercial product leadership; you will partner closely with them, contributing technical feasibility, architectural input, and solutioning expertise to shape what gets built. Your core accountability is for how products are built, tested, deployed, maintained, and evolved - spanning product architecture, scalability best practices, DevOps, QA and testing frameworks, adoption tracking, and Agile/Scrum delivery practices - ensuring world-class engineering practices and leveraging AI accelerators to ship high-quality solutions at speed. You will also maintain strong awareness of and hands-on familiarity with modern data and analytics tooling (Ex: Databricks, Spark, Gathr) to inform sound technology choices. 

As You Help Shape The Strategy, Prioritisation, And Evolution Of MiQ's Local Products Capability - In Partnership With Commercial Product Leadership - Your Core Mandate Is Also To Ensure Local Products Builds The Right Capabilities - Not Just More Capabilities - By

- Defining what Local Products should and should not build
 - Establishing clear ownership boundaries with Sigma (central product)
 - Driving prioritised, scalable, high-impact product development by integrating AI accelerators into the process
 - Shifting Local Products from a reactive build function to a structured, product-led capability layer

This is a technical leadership and product governance role with deep technical depth, working in close partnership with commercial product leadership - who are accountable for product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market plans. 

You Will Work At The Intersection Of

- Data Science organisation - partnering with the DS leadership to translate models and analytical capabilities into production-ready product features. 
 - Local Product & Commercial teams - shaping products that drive measurable business outcomes for key markets. 
 - Engineering & Platform teams - ensuring products are robust, scalable, well-tested, and cost-efficient.

What You'll Do

What LP does NOT build

How LP supports markets vs Product vs DnA

- Partner with central Product teams to: transition scalable capabilities into Sigma

avoid parallel / duplicate builds

- Evolve LP from a feature factory to capability-driven organisation

 - Prioritise across multiple products and initiatives using impact, effort, and strategic alignment frameworks (Ex: RICE, MoSCoW, Cost of Delay); ensure product and solution OKRs are met across the portfolio. 
 - Own the product lifecycle end-to-end - from ideation and proof-of-concept through build, launch, adoption tracking, iteration, maintenance, and sunset decisions. 
 - Make deliberate build vs buy vs partner decisions - evaluating technology options, open-source components, and third-party integrations against in-house development for each product capability. 
 - Partner with Product Management and commercial stakeholders to validate opportunities and translate market needs into technically sound, deliverable product plans. 

Scalability

- Technical Leadership & Solutioning
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership across solutioning and product architecture - designing systems that are robust, extensible, and built to scale across markets, in line with scalability best practices. 
 - Champion DevOps practices - CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, environment management, and release orchestration - to enable fast, reliable, and safe deployments. 
 - Own QA and testing frameworks across the portfolio - defining automated testing strategy, coverage standards, and quality gates that products must clear before release. 
 - Drive adoption tracking and instrumentation - ensuring every product has clear usage, engagement, and adoption metrics built in from day one. 
 - Bring strong Scrum ceremonies expertise and best practices - leading and coaching teams through sprint planning, stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to drive predictable, high-quality delivery.

 - Prioritisation and Product Governance

Reusability

Sigma alignment

- Act as the single-threaded owner of roadmap decisions and deployment excellence, making trade-offs across: market demand

engineering capacity

strategic priorities

- Reduce: ad-hoc builds

Duplication

low-impact features

- Provide technical leadership across the full (SDLC): requirements analysis, system design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

 - Champion the integration of AI accelerators into the product development workflow - evaluating and embedding tools such as AI-powered code assistants (Ex: Copilot, Cursor), automated code review, AI-driven test generation, intelligent documentation, and GenAI-powered prototyping to boost developer productivity and reduce cycle time.

prioritise effectively

operate cross-functionally

Product Data Science

 - Partner with: Product (Sigma)

Engineering

Markets & Commercial

- Drive alignment across: Roadmap

Ownership

delivery expectations

 - Champion a product-led mindset across the organisation - advocating for quality-first delivery, user-centricity, and continuous improvement as cultural norms. 
 - Proactively contact new and existing clients and educate, propose and secure buy-in on MiQ Solutions

Who are your stakeholders?

You Will Work Closely With

- Product Data Science organisation: as a key stakeholder and partner, collaborating on model productionisation, ML feature integration, and analytical capability roadmaps. 
 - Data & Analytics leadership: to shape strategy, investment, and talent plans. 
 - Product Management (global and local): to co-own roadmaps and outcomes for local products. 
 - Engineering & Platform teams: to build robust, scalable, and maintainable systems and shared infrastructure. 
 - Design & UX: to ensure products are intuitive, usable, and aligned with end-user workflows. 
 - Markets & Commercial teams (Sales, Trading, Account Management, Solutions, Client Partners): to validate opportunities, understand market needs, and drive client value at scale. 

What You'll Bring

- 12+ years in product, platform, or technical leadership roles in data-heavy environments (adtech/martech preferred)
 - Proven experience: defining product strategy and roadmaps

prioritising across competing demands

scaling products from 0->1 and 1->N

- Experience working across: product

engineering

data science

commercial teams

- Comfortable making trade-offs across: scale vs custom

speed vs quality

market vs product

- Ability to connect: Capabilities

Workflows

platforms (Sigma)

- Strong understanding of: data platforms (Databricks, AWS)

engineering practices

ML/DS productionisation

Enough to challenge teams - not to micromanage

Technical Skills

- Strong proficiency in Python (and ideally PySpark) for building data-intensive applications and automation. 
 - Strong command of SQL and experience with large-scale data processing in big data ecosystems. 
 - Good understanding of engineering best practices - system design, design patterns, API design, microservices architecture, and scalable application development. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling, automated testing frameworks, and deployment orchestration (Ex: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform). 
 - Exposure to modern GenAI techniques and AI-powered development tools (Ex: Copilot, Cursor, RAG, LLM-based agents, automated code review) and a point of view on integrating them into the product development lifecycle. 
 - Sufficient understanding of ML/statistical modelling concepts (regression, classification, clustering, experimentation) to effectively partner with and challenge the Data Science organisation on productionisation requirements. 
 - Familiarity with MLOps practices: model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle management in production. 
 - Familiarity with product analytics tools and frameworks - understanding of funnel metrics, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and adoption/engagement measurement. 

Leadership & Product Mindset

- Strong product thinking and strategic vision - able to connect market needs, client realities, competitive dynamics, and operational constraints into clear product development strategies. 
 - Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, present product narratives, and make complex ideas intuitive. 
 - Deep customer empathy - a habit of spending time with commercial teams to understand the real problems behind the requested features. 
 - High degree of ownership, resilience, and a "figure it out" attitude - comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities, and competing stakeholder demands. 
 - Ability to drive cross-functional alignment - skilled at navigating matrixed organisations, building trust with engineering, design, commercial, and market leaders. 
 - Passion for building diverse, inclusive teams, and for creating environments where people can do their best work. 

We've highlighted the skills and experience that matter most. If you don't meet every single one but are excited by the role and its impact, we'd still love to hear from you. 

We've highlighted some key skills, experience and requirements for this role. But please don't worry if you don't meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that's a fit for this role, or another opportunity at MiQ.

What impact will you create?

Everything you and your teams build will help MiQ create the next generation of data and AI-powered products, enabling our markets and clients to make smarter decisions, run better campaigns, and measure success more effectively.

data.title: Senior Ignition Developer
data.description:
ASSA ABLOY is a global leader in access solutions, dedicated to shaping the future of security and convenience. With a rich heritage spanning over 150 years, ASSA ABLOY has built a reputation for delivering innovative and reliable locking and access control solutions. Their diverse portfolio includes well-known brands like Yale, HID Global, and Mul-T-Lock, offering a comprehensive range of products and services to meet the unique needs of customers worldwide. From residential and commercial buildings to critical infrastructure and healthcare facilities, ASSA ABLOY's cutting-edge technologies ensure safety, security, and seamless user experiences. With a commitment to sustainability and customer satisfaction, ASSA ABLOY continues to drive advancements in access solutions for a safer and more connected world. 

Summary: Manufacturing Technology Support Analyst provides operational and technical support for manufacturing platforms across ASSA ABLOY Door Group facilities. These platforms include ShopGrid, a custom MES solution with a significant footprint across the Door Group, Inductive Automation Ignition, ERP integrations, reporting solutions, and manufacturing databases. The role coordinates ServiceNow incidents and feature requests, troubleshoots systems and data, supports testing, and improves long-term supportability by documenting legacy and new solutions. 

Summary Of Responsibilities

- Provide first-level support for custom MES solutions, including ShopGrid, as well as Ignition, reporting solutions, integrations, and related manufacturing applications. 
 - Facilitate incidents, service requests, and feature requests through ServiceNow, including prioritization, routing, tracking, communication, and closure. 
 - Troubleshoot MES workflows, work orders, routings, transactions, configuration, access, reports, and ERP integration issues. 
 - Support Ignition applications using Python/Jython scripting, tag configuration, gateway diagnostics, database connectivity, and application testing. 
 - Use SQL to validate data, investigate discrepancies, support root cause analysis, and monitor interfaces and system health. 
 - Execute functional and regression testing for updates, enhancements, integrations, and deployments. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, support procedures, knowledge articles, user guides, test scripts, and training materials. 
 - Document legacy ShopGrid solutions, workflows, integrations, reports, labels, and configurations to reduce knowledge gaps and improve supportability. 
 - Coordinate issue resolution with plant personnel, IT teams, Manufacturing Technology resources, and software vendors

TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE And/or ABILITIES

- SQL querying, relational databases, data analysis, and technical troubleshooting. 
 - Python/Jython scripting, preferably within Inductive Automation Ignition. 
 - MES administration and manufacturing concepts such as work orders, routings, production workflows, transactions, data collection, and ERP integrations. 
 - ServiceNow request coordination, software testing, technical writing, and documentation development. 
 - Strong communication, organization, analytical thinking, and ability to work effectively across time zones
 - Ability to work through complex issues and identify required interventions. 
 - General understanding of business strategies. 
 - Proven ability for effective problem analysis and problem resolution at both strategic and functional level. 
 - Person must have leadership ability, excellent interpersonal skills, consulting skills and the proven ability to develop relationships and influence all levels within the organization and external to the organization with developers, and business users. 
 - Demonstrated presentation, oral and written communication skills. 
 - Ability to comply and enforce compliance of all state and federal regulations, Company standards, and the ASSA ABLOY Code of Conduct. 

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

EDUCATION: 

Preferred undergraduate degree in computer science, information systems or related field and/or equivalent work experience. 

EXPERIENCE: 

A Minimum of 5 years related experience in a business production environment. 

GOOD TO HAVE: 

Manufacturing industry experience would be beneficial but is not required if the candidate possesses a strong technical foundation and demonstrates the ability to learn the manufacturing domain, experience with Ignition, Power BI, . NET, and related manufacturing technologies would be valuable. 

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63, 000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces - physical and virtual - safer, more secure, and easier to access. 

As an employer, we value results - not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions - supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. 

As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

data.title: Engineering Leader
data.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model - which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. 

At Celonis, we're committed to supporting your growth and development, as well as internal career mobility. Our Internal Mobility Program provides you with career path options - not just based on what you've been doing, but based on what you could do for other teams, functions, or locations. We believe in your potential, that's why we hired you, and that's why we're excited to share a new job opportunity with you. 

The Team: 

You will be part of a team that owns the core Data layer. The Data layer includes a purpose built generic storage layer which is highly scalable, elastic, dynamic and open Data Lake that enables our customers to bring their enterprise data to our Data Lake. The Data layer also includes a Process Query Engine which is an analytical database and our core product for process mining that enables our customers to interactively mine enterprise-sized data sets. In order to handle the strong growth of our customer base and their demands, we are continuously expanding our Lake and Engine domain and heavily invest in the performance and scalability of our engine. 

The Role: 

As an Engineering Leader, you will lead and inspire a team of talented engineers and engineering managers, driving the design, development and maintenance of our scalable, secure, and high-performing software that aligns with our strategic goals in the area of process orchestration and automation. You will work closely with product management, design, customer success, and other cross-functional teams to align engineering efforts with our business objectives, ensuring our products meet and exceed our customers' needs. You will play a critical role in defining and executing the technical vision that supports both the immediate growth and long-term success of our product offering while fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration and empowerment of your teams. 

For the Core squad of our Data Lake and Process Query Engine team, we are looking for a leader with experience managing teams with solid experience in system programming and the skills to build a highly parallelized and distributed database and Data Lake with modern C++. As part of a talented engineering team, you'll develop and implement new concepts and algorithms for our Lake and Process Query Engine, take ownership of our solutions to increase reliability and performance, and drive initiatives to shape future innovations. 

The work you'll do: 

- Collaborate with senior leadership and product teams to define the product and technical strategy and roadmap, prioritising engineering efforts to meet business objectives while balancing short-term goals with strategic initiatives. 
 - Ensure the architecture and design emphasize scalability, high availability, and security. 
 - Foster a culture of engineering excellence by promoting best practices in software design, implementation, and delivery. 
 - Provide strategic leadership and guidance to multiple engineering teams, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, collaboration and accountability within the team as well as the department. 
 - Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of key engineering projects, balancing resource allocation and timelines to meet business needs. 
 - Regularly engage with customers and customer-facing teams to stay abreast of how users are interacting with our products, understand their current challenges, and make data-driven decisions to further improve functionality, usability and the value we deliver to our users. 
 - Set clear goals and success metrics for your teams, monitoring progress and adjusting as necessary to meet project and organizational objectives. 
 - Mentor, develop and retain top engineering talent within your organization - ranging from individual contributors to managers - supporting their growth and career development. 
 - Drive team engagement, performance and morale by implementing best practices in team management and creating a collaborative and inclusive work environment. 
 - Communicate strategy, plans and progress to the wider Product and Engineering team, Celonis, stakeholders and customers, determining the right level of communication appropriate for each situation. 
 - Drive the technical vision and guide teams in developing advanced concepts and algorithms for data management and query execution. 
 - Shape and contribute to our development and maintenance processes
 - Take responsibility for the performance, scalability, and reliability of our solutions
 - Provide high-level architectural guidance and mentor engineering leads in solving complex system challenges
 - Take ultimate organizational accountability for the end-to-end delivery, performance, and reliability of your teams' solutions. 

The qualifications you'll need: 

- Proven ability to lead and mentor engineering teams
 - University degree in Computer Science or comparable education
 - 15+ years experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing teams
 - Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and grow engineering teams. Proven track record of building high-performing teams that deliver ambitious results. 
 - Proven experience in managing highly distributed teams across multiple locations, with the flexibility to travel to foster team cohesion, build strong relationships, and ensure effective collaboration. 
 - Experience in delivering high-quality engineering projects that meet or exceed customers' needs. 
 - Experience in building data-driven decision-making practices. 
 - Solid knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Parallel Computing, Distributed Systems or Database Internals
 - Experience in cloud engineering, Linux systems, infrastructure as code, build systems, performance monitoring is a plus
 - An analytical mindset with great understanding of performance and algorithms
 - Excellent communication skills in English, German is a plus

Benefits of Internal Mobility: 

- Exciting options for internal career growth
 - Exposure to new challenges, perspectives, people, and locations
 - Relocation assistance and financial support when permitted
 - Seamless Interview and transition experience 
 - Support and connection to help you settle into your new role

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. 
 - Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. 
 - Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy-24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. 
 - Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. 
 - Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. 
 - Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance. 
 - Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. 
 - Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. 
 - Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values-Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future-drive every decision. 

About Us:

data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

We are seeking a Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead to architect and implement low-level software for our next-generation microcontrollers/ SoCs. You will bridge the gap between hardware architecture and final software delivery. You will own the pre-silicon development lifecycle-including driver development for CAN/CAN-FD/CAN XL stacks -using high-performance enterprise emulation environments and ensures hardware-software co-design that satisfies strict ISO 26262 safety and high-quality engineering frameworks up to ASIL-D. 

What You'll Achieve

Technical Leadership & Hardware Co-Design

- Drive firmware architecture and technical roadmaps for in-house microcontroller/ SOCs. 
 - Align development milestones with SoC architecture, RTL design, verification, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Provide technical mentorship and enforce rigorous coding standards (MISRA C/C++). 
 - Author comprehensive design specifications, firmware architecture documentation, and test strategies. 

Pre-Silicon Validation & Emulation

- Develop early boot code, low-level drivers, and runtime firmware targeting pre-silicon environments. 
 - Lead virtual bring-up and hardware-software co-verification using both enterprise emulation platforms like Cadence Palladium/ Synopsys ZeBu. 
 - Optimize firmware execution speed
 - Debug complex, deep-silicon anomalies using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and internal emulator trace features. 

Communication Drivers & Protocols

- Design, implement, and optimize highly robust peripheral drivers for CAN, CAN-FD, and CAN XL. 
 - Develop and maintain critical application layer protocols, featuring standard diagnostics (ISO 14229), network management, and heavy-duty diagnostic framing fault handling. 
 - Design, implement and Integrate communication driver stacks into industry standard layers (e. g. , AUTOSAR MCAL interfaces). 
 - Deep knowledge of priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and cyclical redundancy check (CRC) validation

Safety & Quality Compliance

- Enforce absolute compliance with ISO 26262 safety requirements. 
 - Participate in safety analyses (FMEA, root cause analysis) to ensure driver-level fault-handling routines are deterministic. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware development, specifically within the embedded semiconductor or safety-critical industry
 - 3+ years acting as a Technical Lead or Principal Engineer guiding architectural decisions and mentoring engineering teams. 
 - Expert proficiency in Embedded C with strict adherence to MISRA guidelines. 
 - Deep knowledge of embedded MCU/SoC architectures, including ARM Cortex-M/R or multi-core safety architectures. 
 - Direct hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms, specifically Cadence Palladium and/or Synopsys ZeBu systems
 - Authoritative understanding of industrial fieldbus architectures (ISO 11898 standard family), physical/data link layers, priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and diagnostic implementations
 - Proficient with professional embedded pipelines, including ARM compiler toolchains, JTAG debuggers (e. g. , Lauterbach), and emulation control scripts
 - Experience with ISO 26262 functional safety requirements up to ASIL-D
 - Understanding of HSM/SHE concepts and secure boot requirements
 - Experience building automated testing setups using Python and continuous integration tools (e. g. , Jenkins)

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

data.title: System Performance Engineer (NSP/NPU, AI/ML)
data.description:
Company: 

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area: 

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary: 

Job Overview: 

You will be part of System Performance team that is responsible for profiling and optimizing the System Performance on Snapdragon chipsets. This role will require a strong knowledge of AI/ML performance using NPU cores. The knowledge of CPU, DDR, NoCs will be an added advantage. 

Skills Required: 

- A deep understanding of NPU, CPU and DDR architecture internals like
 - NPU: Understanding of NPU micro-architecture, including its specialized processing elements for operations like matrix multiplications and convolutions. 
 - A strong grasp of deep learning fundamentals, including neural network architectures like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), transformers, GenAI etc. 
 - Understanding the distinction between the compute-intensive training of a model (often done on GPUs) and running inference (making predictions) on NPUs. 
 - Knowledge of Model optimization and compression techniques (Quantization, Pruning, Distillation etc. )
 - CPU caches (L1, L2, L3), instruction pipelines, branch prediction, memory hierarchy (including register, cache, and main memory) and multi-core/multi-threaded processing. You need to understand how memory access, instruction dependencies, and contention for shared resources can impact performance. 
 - DDR: Understanding of JEDEC specifications LPDDR4, LPDDR5, LPDDR6, including command and timing parameters (e. g. , tCL, tRCD, tRP), memory organization (rows, columns, banks), and basic view of training and initialization sequences, how a memory controller works and its specific features like command queue, port arbitration, and various control schemes. 
 - Familiarity with frameworks like TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch Mobile, and ONNX Runtime for preparing models for deployment. Experience with NPU-specific compilers, such as those from Qualcomm (QNN), Arm (Vela), Intel (OpenVINO), to optimize and orchestrate AI workloads. 
 - Evaluating hardware and software to determine the best fit for specific AI tasks and measure performance metrics like TOPS/W (trillions of operations per second per watt). 
 - Using tools like the Windows Performance Toolkit and Qualcomm's Snapdragon Profiler to analyze and optimize NPU and system-level performance
 - A core understanding of how to use parallel processing architectures for efficient AI computations. 
 - Expertise in how operating systems manage processes, threads, memory, MMU, and interrupt handling. This knowledge is crucial to understanding software for the kernel scheduler and system-level bottlenecks. 
 - Good understanding of Benchmarks CPU (like GeekBench, SpecInt, CoreMark etc) and DDR (like lat_mem, stream, bw_mem etc. ) and how they exercise the underlying CPU/GPU/DDR architecture. 
 - Experience with a variety of performance monitoring tools like Intel VTune, Linux perf, and Utilities like top, vmstat, iostat, and netstat to monitor system resources like CPU, memory, and I/O. Experience with software tools to monitor system hotspots, command bus utilization, and identify memory traffic patterns is critical. This includes validating that the traffic generated by software is as expected. 
 - Good understanding of memory allocation policies, prefetching, and caching to minimize latency and maximize bandwidth. Understanding how an application accesses memory is vital. Skills in profiling code to analyze memory access patterns and then optimizing the code for better data locality. 
 - Analyzing large datasets from performance tests requires strong statistical skills. This can involve creating histograms of transaction latencies and deriving performance metrics to understand a system's behavior. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Drive Performance analysis on silicon using various System and Cores (i. e. NPU, AI/ML, CPU, Memory) benchmarks like Dhrystone, GeekBench, SPECInt, CNN/GenAI ML networks etc. 
 - Use of Performance tools to analyze the load patterns across IPs and identify any performance bottlenecks in system. 
 - Analyzing Perf KPIs of SoC subsystems like NPU, CPU, Memory, and corelate performance with projection
 - Evaluate and characterize performance at various junction temperatures and optimize running at high ambient temperatures. 
 - Analyze and optimize the System performance parameters of SoC infrastructure like NoC, LP5 DDR, etc. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional global teams to plan and execute performance activities on chipsets as well as make recommendations for next generation chipsets. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 1 to 5 years of industry experience in the following: 
 - Experience working on any ARM/x86 based platforms, mobile/automotive/Data center operating systems and/or performance profiling tools. 
 - Experience in application or driver development in Linux\QNX and ability to create/customize make files with various compiler options is a plus. 
 - Must be quick learner and should be able to adapt to new technologies.

Additional skills in the following areas are preferred:

data.title: Engineering Manager - AI & Agentic Systems
data.description:
About PlumPlum is an employee insurance and health benefits platform focused on making health insurance simple, accessible and inclusive for modern organisations. 

Healthcare costs in India are rising three times faster than general inflation. Most Indians can't afford health insurance on their own, and as many as 600 million will likely depend on employer-sponsored insurance. Plum is on a mission to provide the highest-quality insurance and healthcare to 10 million lives by FY2030, through companies that care. Plum is backed by Tiger Global and Sequoia. 

About the roleAt Plum, AI isn't a side project. It's how our products work. We're building agentic workflows that read documents, reason over policies and help members get clear, dependable answers, starting with insurance claims. 

We're looking for an Engineering Manager who has built and run AI agent systems in production and can lead a team doing the same. You'll grow a team of engineers, own delivery for AI-powered products, and stay close to the architecture, the code and the production issues yourself. 

What you will own
 - Lead the team: hiring, coaching, performance and growth. Build a team that owns and operates what it ships. 

- Design and ship agentic AI workflows that are reliable in production: clear tool use, safe retries, failure handling, and a path to human review when needed. 

- Decide where AI fits: choose when to use fixed, tested code and when to use models or agents. Keep money-related calculations and policy rules in code you can trust. 

- Stay hands-on with architecture, code reviews and production debugging. 

- Own reliability and safety: safe releases, rollback, incident response, access controls and careful handling of sensitive member data. 

- Partner with product, operations and domain experts to turn real workflows, such as claims, into well-defined AI systems. 

- Champion AI-first engineering: use coding agents and AI tools in your own work and help your team do the same. 

What you'll bring
 - 8-10 years of software engineering experience. 

- Experience managing engineers and developing technical leaders: 1: 1s, hiring, performance and growth. 

- Hands-on experience shipping and operating AI or agent systems in production, beyond prototypes. You can explain what went wrong, how you found it and what you changed. 

- Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: APIs, queues, state management, data contracts and recovery. 

- A hands-on approach: you still write and review code and debug production issues. 

- Day-to-day use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot or similar). 

Nice to have
 - Experience with document pipelines: OCR, extracting data from bills or records, schema validation, deduplication and tracking where data came from. 

- Experience designing agent infrastructure: typed tool contracts, durable state, idempotent actions, timeouts. 

- Insurance, claims, fintech or healthcare experience, or working with domain experts on rules such as eligibility, limits and co-pay. 

- Experience with tracing and monitoring of AI systems: quality, latency and cost. 

Your first 90 days
 - Understand our AI workflows, starting with claims, and the biggest technical risks. 

- Set a quality baseline with product and operations. 

- Ship one well-scoped improvement with monitoring, a human fallback and a tested rollback, then plan next priorities from what you learn.
