data.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Lead - Mechanical Design to drive the design, development, analysis, qualification, and product support of high-reliability aerospace and defense mechanical/electromechanical systems. This role is ideal for a senior mechanical engineering professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, colloborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering robust products for demanding aerospace applications. 

The successful candidate will bring strong expertise in mechanical design, aerospace product development, CAD/CAE, GD&T, tolerance analysis, structural and thermal analysis, environmental qualification, and technical leadership. The role involves working closely with systems, electrical, power electronics, thermal, manufacturing, quality, certification, supply chain, program management, customer, and global engineering teams. 

What You Will Do

Mechanical Design & Product Development

- Lead mechanical design and development of aerospace-grade electromechanical products such as actuators, motors, starter-generators and electronic packaging systems. 
 - Own concept design, 3D modelling, detailing, assembly design, drawing release, and engineering documentation. 
 - Develop mechanical architectures that balance performance, reliability, weight, cost, manufacturability, testability, and serviceability. 
 - Design components and assemblies involving sheet metal, machined parts, castings, enclosures, sealing features, connector interfaces, and EMI/EMC shielding. 
 - Support board fitment, enclosure design, packaging optimization, vibration tolerance, and thermal management for aerospace electronic and electromechanical products. 

Analysis, Simulation & Qualification Support

- Lead structural, thermal, modal, vibration, shock, and fatigue analysis activities to support design validation and product performance. 
 - Review FEA and thermal analysis results and guide design improvements based on simulation, qualification, and test outcomes. 
 - Support environmental qualification activities covering thermal, vibration, altitude, EMI/EMC, conducted emissions, and radiated emissions requirements. 
 - Support qualification and verification processes for aerospace products, including DO-160-related test and compliance activities. 

Technical Leadership

- Provide technical leadership across the product lifecycle, from concept development through qualification, certification, production release, and field support. 
 - Mentor engineers, review technical work, establish design best practices, and promote engineering excellence across the team. 
 - Lead technical reviews including PDR, CDR, TRR, design reviews, risk reviews, and root-cause reviews. 
 - Own technical risk identification, mitigation planning, design trade studies, and engineering decision-making for mechanical product development. 
 - Drive design standardization, reuse, cost reduction, manufacturability improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Documentation, PLM & Configuration Management

- Prepare and review engineering documentation, technical reports, design justifications, analysis reports, proposals, and customer presentations. 
 - Manage BOMs, drawing releases, configuration control, and engineering change activities through PLM systems. 
 - Support Engineering Change Requests/Engineering Change Notices and product upgrade activities through PLM systems such as ARAS / Teamcenter / Windchill or equivalent. 
 - Ensure released designs meet internal engineering processes, customer requirements, quality expectations, and aerospace compliance expectations. 

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

data.title: IT&D Manager - Azure DevSecOps engineer
data.description:

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Information Technology & Digital

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products. 

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen. 

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced IT&D Manager - Azure DevSecOps engineer to join our global Cloud Platform team. This is a senior, hands-on technical role combining responsibilities of a Senior Cloud Engineer and DevSecOps/Security Engineer, focused on the design, implementation, security, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise Azure cloud platforms. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and operating Azure platform capabilities using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), driving cloud security best practices, embedding security into the software delivery lifecycle, and ensuring governance and compliance across the Azure estate. As a senior member of the team, the role also includes mentoring colleagues, collaborating across globally distributed teams, and supporting operational excellence as part of an L4 engineering function. 

Your responsibilities

Azure Platform Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain enterprise-scale Azure cloud platforms and services. 
 - Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, ARM/Bicep, and Azure-native tooling. 
 - Implement cloud architecture patterns that deliver scalability, resilience, security, and operational efficiency. 
 - Automate provisioning, configuration, deployment, and operational processes. 
 - Contribute to platform engineering standards, reference architectures, and technical roadmaps. 
 - Support onboarding of applications and workloads onto Azure platform services. 

DevSecOps & Cloud Security

- Embed security controls and practices across the software development and delivery lifecycle. 
 - Design and maintain security guardrails for Azure workloads and platform services. 
 - Manage and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and threat protection capabilities. 
 - Define and implement Azure governance frameworks using: 
 - Azure Policy
 - Management Groups
 - Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
 - Landing Zones
 - Compliance and regulatory controls
 - Drive remediation of security findings, vulnerabilities, and compliance gaps. 
 - Implement and maintain security benchmarks and standards (e. g. , Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark, CIS Azure Foundations Benchmark, industry best practices). 
 - Partner with security, architecture, and engineering teams to continuously improve cloud security posture. 

DevOps & Automation

- Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and related tooling. 
 - Integrate security controls, scans, and compliance checks into deployment pipelines. 
 - Promote Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and automation-first operating models. 
 - Support development teams in adopting DevSecOps practices and secure engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new tools and technologies to improve platform capabilities and developer experience. 

Operations & Service Management

- Participate as a member of the L4 support team for Azure platform services, including ticket dispatching and resolution activities. 
 - Occasionally perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures. 
 - Collaborate with support and operations teams to maintain platform reliability and service excellence. 
 - Contribute to operational documentation, knowledge management, and continuous service improvement initiatives. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers within the team. 
 - Support capability development through coaching, knowledge sharing, and best practices. 
 - Collaborate effectively with stakeholders across Europe, India, and other global locations. 
 - Participate in Agile delivery frameworks, including Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid operating models. 
 - Influence technical decisions and contribute to strategic cloud transformation initiatives. 

The experience we're looking for

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus. 

- 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or cloud security roles. Strong hands-on expertise with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC) tools (Terraform, ARM) and Azure security best practices. 
 - Strong understanding of: Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, RBAC and Privileged Access Management, Cloud Governance, Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL), Security by Design principles, Vulnerability management
 - Experience implementing cloud security controls and compliance frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of cloud security benchmarks and industry standards. 
 - Microsoft Azure certifications (e. g. , AZ-305, AZ-500, AZ-400, AZ-104) - nice o have. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 

The skills for success

Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, DevSecOpsCloud Infrastructure Management, Azure Cloud Services, Azure Governance, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Cloud Security Architecture, Cybersecurity Engineering, Security Operations (SecOps), Network Engineering, Enterprise Networking, Compute Services Management, Storage Management, Subscription & Resource Management. 

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy. 

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer I
data.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. 

Summary

Menlo Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing Threat Protection and ShadowAI team in Bangalore. This team makes sure our users can safely browse the web through our secure cloud, protecting them from malicious sites (including those built or operated with AI) and securing access to authorized web applications. The services this team builds are a core part of Menlo's secure enterprise browser for both humans and AI agents, which means you will be working directly on one of the fastest-moving problems in security today: how organizations get visibility into and control over unsanctioned AI use without shutting it down. The team also uses AI in how it builds, from code assistants and AI-assisted test generation through to LLM-supported log and incident analysis, so you will be applying these tools as well as defending against their misuse. If you like distributed systems, deep technical problems, and work where the threat landscape changes month to month, this is a strong fit. 

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned: 

- Reliable, performant delivery of Threat Protection and ShadowAI services that detect and control risky web and generative AI application usage for Menlo customers. 
 - End to end ownership of assigned features, from design through production operation and iteration. 

Success Metrics / KPIs: 

- Service availability and latency for owned components meet or exceed team SLOs. 
 - Features delivered on committed roadmap dates, with quality measured by post-release defect and rollback rates. 
 - Automated test coverage maintained or improved on owned code paths. 
 - Detection accuracy for AI application and malicious site coverage, measured by false positive and false negative rates. 
 - Mean time to detect and resolve production issues in owned services. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and own new features and services in the Threat Protection and ShadowAI product area, contributing directly to Menlo's technical roadmap. 
 - Build highly available, scalable distributed systems and APIs, including multithreaded and asynchronous applications, with performance and security considered from the start. 
 - Build and refine the detection and policy capabilities that give customers visibility into generative AI and unsanctioned web application usage in their environments. 
 - Participate in building, deploying, and operating the Menlo Security platform in production, using dashboards, error reporting, metrics, and AI-assisted log and trace analysis to find and resolve defects quickly. 
 - Use AI code assistants and AI-assisted test generation as part of your normal workflow to move faster, while applying your own judgment on correctness, security, and maintainability before anything ships. 
 - Partner with product, security, operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to align on requirements, tradeoffs, and schedules. 
 - Write unit and automated tests, conduct code and design reviews for peers, and evaluate emerging technologies that could improve our products. 

Functional Competencies

Required: 

- 3-5 years of professional software development experience with one or more of NodeJS, Go, or Python. 
 - 3-5 years of hands on experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS. 
 - Working experience with Linux and standard development tooling such as git. 
 - Degree in Computer Science or a related field (BE, BTech, or Masters). 
 - Practical fluency with AI coding and debugging assistants, including sound judgment about when to rely on LLM output and when to verify it independently. 
 - Self-directed approach to problem solving, with the ability to pick up unfamiliar systems and technologies with limited guidance. 

Preferred / Nice to Have: 

- Experience building large scale web applications and REST APIs. 
 - Strong grounding in complex data structures and database technologies. 
 - Experience with containers, Docker, and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure as code tooling such as Terraform. 
 - Familiarity with the Tornado web application framework and test automation. 
 - Track record of adapting and improving engineering practices such as test driven development, continuous delivery, agile ceremonies, automation, and maintainable, testable code. 
 - Interest in or exposure to security, threat detection, or AI governance and safety. 
 - Well organized and thorough, with strong attention to detail and documentation. 

MSGL-I4

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo - in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it - you'll thrive here. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. 

TO ALL AGENCIES: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Menlo Security outside of the Talent organization. Menlo Security's policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.

data.title: Senior MLOps Engineer - LLM Infrastructure & GPU Performance | $90-$120/Hour
data.description:
We are seeking experienced MLOps Engineers, ML Systems Engineers, and GPU Performance Engineers to contribute to cutting-edge AI development projects. 

In this role, you will leverage your expertise in machine learning infrastructure, accelerator optimization, distributed computing, and large language model (LLM) serving to help evaluate and improve next-generation AI systems. 

You will work on challenging technical problems involving GPU kernels, performance profiling, distributed workloads, and high-throughput inference systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and optimize GPU kernels using CUDA, Triton, Pallas, or related technologies. 
 - Profile and analyze accelerator workloads to identify performance bottlenecks. 
 - Debug distributed training and inference workloads across GPU and TPU environments. 
 - Optimize LLM inference serving, including batching, KV caching, and memory utilization. 
 - Evaluate AI-generated solutions involving ML infrastructure, compilers, and accelerator programming. 
 - Develop complex technical tasks, reference solutions, and evaluation rubrics for AI training. 
 - Review ML systems implementations and provide detailed technical feedback. 
 - Analyze throughput, latency, GPU utilization, and memory-performance trade-offs. 

Ideal Qualifications

- 2+ years of professional experience in ML systems, MLOps, ML infrastructure, or GPU performance engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with at least one of the following: 
 - GPU kernel programming: CUDA, Triton, Pallas, or CUTLASS. 
 - Performance profiling: NVIDIA Nsight, PyTorch Profiler, Kineto, or JAX/XLA Profiler. 
 - LLM inference serving: vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or similar frameworks. 
 - Distributed ML workloads and accelerator debugging. 
 - Production experience with PyTorch and/or JAX. 
 - Familiarity with GPU and accelerator architectures such as NVIDIA H100, B200, AMD MI300, or Google TPUs. 
 - Understanding of distributed training, model sharding, memory optimization, and inference performance. 
 - Strong Python and systems programming skills, particularly C++. 
 - Excellent technical communication and problem-solving abilities. Experience with XLA, MLIR, StableHLO, FSDP, Megatron, or compiler-level optimization is a strong advantage. 

Engagement Details

- Compensation: $90-$120/hour, depending on experience. 
 - Work Arrangement: Fully remote, worldwide. 
 - Commitment: 40 hours per week. 
 - Availability: Weekday availability required. 
 - Engagement: Full-time role with no conflicting professional engagements. Previous AI research, model evaluation, or AI training experience is advantageous but not mandatory. Apply now to contribute your expertise to the development and evaluation of next-generation AI systems. 

About Hirely

Hirely connects qualified professionals with remote opportunities in AI research, creative industries, software engineering, and technology. We are recruiting qualified candidates on behalf of a hiring partner. The hiring partner manages final candidate selection, onboarding, project assignments, and engagement terms.

data.title: Data Quality Engineer
data.description:
Company Overview

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best - bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what's next. 

Overview

As a Quality Engineer II, you will help ensure the quality and reliability of data solutions that support General Mills' business. You will design and execute data and Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) testing, validate data across systems, and partner with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to deliver trusted insights. Reporting to the Manager - Quality Engineering, you will contribute to test strategy, continuous improvement, and delivery governance in a collaborative Digital and Technology environment. 

Key Accountabilities

- Design and execute test plans, test strategies, test cases, and test data for data, extract-transform-load (ETL), business intelligence, and related technology solutions. 
 - Review data models, data mappings, architecture documentation, and requirements to identify test coverage, risks, and validation needs. 
 - Write and execute SQL queries (inside BigQuery) to validate, reconcile, and compare data across source systems, transformations, and data warehouse targets in Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Perform validation of end to end data flow from source to destination including reports (Tableau Reports). 
 - Perform Data Quality Checks, and document results, defects, evidence, and recommendations. 
 - Collaborate with developers, business analysts, data analysts, data engineers and stakeholders to clarify requirements, troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive resolution. 
 - Use appropriate test automation tools for extract-transform-load validation and identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency. 
 - Maintain accurate testing documentation, status reports, productivity metrics, escalations, and delivery sign-offs while meeting project milestones and quality standards. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, stakeholder responsiveness, and a positive, adaptable team environment. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in computers and related fields. 
 - Experience: 5 to 7 years of experience in software quality engineering, data testing, extract-transform-load (ETL) testing, or a related area. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis abilities. 
 - Strong understanding of the software development life cycle and multiple software engineering and testing methodologies. 
 - Proficiency in SQL, database testing, business intelligence testing, and data validation. 
 - Experience creating test cases and testing documentation from requirements or specifications, including for projects with limited development documentation. 
 - Familiarity with issue-tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. 
 - Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills, attention to detail, self-motivation, and the ability to work accurately in a fast-paced, changing environment. 
 - Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with peers and stakeholders, with a continuous-improvement mindset and technical agility. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced capability in agile testing, test management, and database testing, including SQL. 
 - Working knowledge of extract-transform-load processes, test design techniques, and test planning. 
 - Foundational knowledge of application programming interfaces, artificial intelligence and machine learning, dbt, and Monte Carlo. 
 - ISTQB certification. 
 - Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and related services such as BigQuery or Cloud Functions. 
 - Knowledge of big data concepts, data warehouse structures, extract-transform-load processes, and data architecture principles. 
 - Basic knowledge of Python programing. 
 - Exposure to usage of GenAI tools in testing. 
 - Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines and DevOps methodologies. 
 - Demonstrated alignment with General Mills values: do the right thing, play to win, grow and inspire, win as a team, and act boldly and move quickly. 

ELIGIBILITY

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

data.title: Automation Engineer
data.description:
Automation Engineer - Mumbai

Turn PLCs, HMIs, servo systems and drives into working machines on real shop floors, from first demo to final handover. You will be the technical support behind Luna's automation business, working with Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek products and with our sales team to turn customer requirements into working solutions. 

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides industrial automation, robotics, motion control, mechatronics and pneumatics solutions to OEMs and manufacturers across India. It is headquartered in Navi Mumbai and has offices across the country. 

What You Will Do

• Study customer machines and processes, and recommend the right PLC, HMI, servo and VFD solution. 

• Program and configure PLCs, HMIs, servo drives and VFDs (Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem, Fatek). 

• Commission systems at customer sites, including wiring checks, parameter setting and communication setup. 

• Run product demos, trials and proof-of-concept tests for customers. 

• Troubleshoot on site and over the phone, and resolve issues quickly to keep customer machines running. 

• Train customer engineers, operators and maintenance teams. 

• Support sales with application inputs, product selection and technical content for proposals. 

• Document every project and share field feedback that improves our solutions. 

Products You Will Work With

Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek PLC, HMI, servo and VFD products. 

Must Have

• BE/BTech/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics or Automation Engineering. 

• 2-5 years of hands-on PLC and HMI programming and commissioning (or strong project work for freshers). 

• Working knowledge of servo systems, VFDs and control panels. 

• Familiarity with industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP. 

• Strong troubleshooting skills, a customer-first attitude, and willingness to travel to customer sites. 

Good to Have

• Experience with Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek products. 

• SCADA, motion control or multi-axis servo applications. 

• Exposure to special-purpose machines, packaging, textile, plastics or process industries. 

What We Offer

Real ownership from demo to a running machine, manufacturer certification and technical training, a clear path to senior application roles, travel allowance and reimbursement as per policy, paid leave, and statutory benefits. 

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer II (Java Microservices)
data.description:
At Precisely, we're not just building software - we're shaping the future of data integrity. As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here - it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data - and help define what's possible - we'd love for you to apply!

Overview

The role will be responsible for translating product strategy and business priorities into a coherent set of features for one or more scrum teams. Take on multiple roles including Feature lead, Developer, product designer, QA, and project manager. Key member of the team strategizing and presenting the future vision of the product to business and technology stakeholders in collaboration with the Product Manager. 

What You Will Do

- Execute the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities. 
 - Helps conduct market and competitive analysis, defines products to serve those needs, the addressable market, ability to penetrate and sell, and overall business justification and strategic fit for products. 
 - Help execute the value proposition and business case. 
 - Provides team leadership through communication and coordination of cross functional teams at all levels of the organization. 
 - Leads architecture for all components in an investment segment. May focus on one component but must have expertise across all components. 
 - Responsible for design of systems in the investment segment. 
 - Actively supports Product Manager in the Product Planning, business performance of one or more products. 
 - Engage with customers throughout the product lifecycle to better glean product insights. 
 - Understand requirements that comes from stakeholders and helps turn them into consumable backlog items for the team. 
 - Write clear, compelling, and detailed (technical) user epics and stories with user acceptance criteria. Participate in story grooming exercises for crisp and unambiguous documentation and communication of features to be developed. 
 - Ensure the backlog is prioritized in order before the sprint. 
 - Coordinate with appropriate architects to ensure tech decisions are made and implemented. Also Identifying business process improvements and opportunities for automation. 
 - Work with the Product Manager and Engineering Leader to propose percentage of effort for different types of value in each release. 
 - Participates in technical and sales enablement. 

What We Are Looking For

- Bachelor's Degree (or higher) in business or technical field. 
 - 8+ years of industry experience in the areas of data engineering and product management. 
 - Expertise in Java for backend development. 
 - Expertise with databases, particularly Mongo Atlas, and developing/consuming REST APIs. 
 - Track record of Designing and developing data products or software products. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, and microservices architecture is a must. 
 - Basic understanding of agile and scrum methodologies is a must. 
 - Experience of AWS/Azure/GCP, Redis, Security Domain, Datadog, Code fresh
 - Working knowledge of data ETL will be preferred. 
 - Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI etc. 
 - Ability to communicate with various stakeholders at all levels of the organization. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Excellent interpersonal skills and active listener. 
 - Able to set and meet time-sensitive goals. 
 - Able to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and adapt to change while providing structure to operations and go-to-market teams. 

AI Skills/Knowledge

- AI-assisted development: Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor to support coding, code review, documentation, and test generation. 
 - LLM and agentic workflows: Familiarity with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, with the ability to apply them thoughtfully in software engineering use cases. 
 - Responsible AI practices: Understanding of responsible AI principles, including bias mitigation, security considerations, explainability, and appropriate use of AI-generated outputs. 

Preferred Skills (a Plus But Not Required)

- Familiarity with frontend scripting languages such as Node. js and React. js
 - Understanding of spark framework along with Snowflake and Databricks. 
 - Hands on Terraform will be advantageous.

If Precisely identifies such fraudulent conduct, then as applicable and to the extent permitted by law, the application will be rejected, an offer (if made) will be rescinded, or the employment will be terminated, and legal action may be taken against the impersonators.

data.title: Staff Streaming/Messaging Infra Engineer
data.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

About the Team and the Role Join the infrastructure engineering team responsible for building, scaling, and operating eBay's core messaging and real-time streaming platforms. Our infrastructure powers mission-critical, high-throughput applications across eBay's global ecosystem. 

In this role, you will act as a core developer and architect, taking full ownership of both the control plane and data plane for our distributed streaming platforms-including Apache Flink and Apache Kafka-deployed across multiple private cloud Kubernetes clusters spanning various Availability Zones (AZs) and Data Centers (DCs). You will also play a key role in designing and evolving our next-generation streaming lakehouse storage systems. 

What You'll do

- Build a cloud-native distributed systems: Design and develop core Streaming components, supporting independent scaling, high availability, and fault tolerance. 
 - Solve distributed systems challenges: Design and implement replication, consistency, crash recovery, failover, and distributed coordination mechanisms. 
 - Build Streaming Lakehouses: Lead the design and development of our real-time streaming lakehouse storage architecture, enabling low-latency analytical workloads at massive scale. 
 - Ensure Operational Excellence: Drive high availability, automated fault recovery, and zero-downtime operations for large-scale production streaming topologies. 
 - Enhance System Observability: Advance enterprise monitoring, distributed tracing, automated alerting, and failure-diagnosis tooling to maximize platform uptime. 
 - Collaborate Globally: Partner with cross-functional architecture and platform teams worldwide to shape the future of eBay's real-time data ecosystem. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering: Use modern AI coding agents to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and validation while maintaining high engineering standards. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience building production-grade systems software, databases, storage engines, or large-scale distributed systems, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. 
 - Core Distributed Systems Experience: Deep hands-on background in computer science fundamentals (data structures, concurrency, OS internals, and networking) with strong expertise in Java, Rust, or C++. 
 - Stream Processing Engine Expertise: Strong hands-on experience developing, tuning, and operating Apache Flink at scale (e. g. , state backend management, checkpointing tuning, custom operators, Flink Kubernetes Operator). 
 - Distributed Messaging Deep-Dive: Proven experience with Apache Kafka (or Pulsar/RocketMQ), including core broker architecture, partition strategy, and control/data plane management. 
 - Container & Multi-Cluster Orchestration: Solid experience running high-throughput stateful workloads on Kubernetes across hybrid or private cloud environments. 

Nice to Have

- Deep knowledge of embedded storage engines (RocksDB, LevelDB) and memory management. 
 - Active contributions to open-source projects in the streaming ecosystem (e. g. , Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Apache Paimon). 

Why Join Us?

- Build at hyperscale: Solve challenging distributed systems problems that directly impact eBay's global commerce platform. 
 - Work on deep systems engineering: Go beyond application development and work on messaging internals, distributed storage, replication, and fault tolerance. 
 - Shape the architecture: Make meaningful technical contributions to a next-generation cloud-native streaming platform. 
 - Own what you build: Take projects from architecture and implementation through production deployment and operations. 
 - Innovate with AI: Explore modern AI-assisted development practices to accelerate complex systems engineering. 

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay. com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

data.title: Industrial automation engineer
data.description:
Company Description MachineryFix is dedicated to bringing transparency, speed, and standardization to factory floor maintenance for MSME manufacturing units across India. The company connects vetted ITI and diploma-certified technicians with factories that rely on critical machinery to power nearly half of the nation's exports. By replacing fragmented local networks and volatile pricing with accountable, professional service, MachineryFix helps plant managers reduce downtime and improve reliability. The team focuses on building a trusted ecosystem where manufacturers can access timely, high-quality maintenance support and technicians can find consistent, well-structured work opportunities. 

Role Description As an Industrial Automation Engineer at MachineryFix, you will work on-site in Hyderabad in a full-time capacity, supporting automation and control systems across a variety of manufacturing environments. You will design, implement, and optimize industrial automation solutions, including PLCs, robotics, and process control systems, to improve efficiency and reduce machine downtime. Daily responsibilities include diagnosing and troubleshooting equipment and control system failures, coordinating corrective and preventive maintenance activities, and collaborating with technicians and plant teams to ensure stable, safe operations. You will document system configurations, maintain technical records, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability, standardization, and performance of factory floor automation. 

Sharing an opening for industrial electronics engineers 🔧

MachineryFix (machineryfix. in) is hiring an Electronics Repair & Quality Engineer (Drive / PLC Cards). 

MachineryFix gets faulty drives, PLC cards and control electronics repaired for manufacturers and large industrial clients, working with specialist repair labs across India. They need a strong technical person in the middle: someone who understands what's actually wrong with a card, works it through with the repair lab, and makes sure it really works before it's approved and sent back to the client. 

📍 Hyderabad, or willing to relocate (travel to repair labs and client sites when needed)

🕒 Full-time | 4+ years of experience

What the role involves

• Inspecting incoming faulty cards (VFD power and gate driver boards, PLC and I/O cards, control PCBs), recording symptoms and doing a first-level diagnosis

• Discussing fault findings and repair scope with repair labs, and checking that the quoted work matches the actual fault

• Doing or witnessing bench and load testing of repaired cards

• Checking replaced components, soldering and overall workmanship

• Signing off a repair only once test results confirm the card works, and sending back any repair that fails

• Preparing clear test reports for clients, with photos, replaced parts and results

• Building a record of common failures by make and model to speed up future jobs

What they're looking for

• 4+ years in drive, PLC or industrial electronics card repair (a repair lab, OEM service centre or plant electronics maintenance)

• Component-level fault finding on IGBTs, gate drivers, SMPS, ICs, capacitors and optocouplers

• Confident with an oscilloscope, multimeter, IGBT and component testers, DC power supplies and SMD rework stations

• Experience with drives from ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Yaskawa, Schneider or similar

• Can read circuit diagrams, and trace circuits on boards that come without schematics

• Honest and detail-oriented: this is the person who says no when a repair isn't good enough

• Diploma or B. E. /B. Tech in ECE, EEE, EIE or a related field

Why it's worth a look

• An early, founding-team role with real responsibility from day one

• Cards and drives from many brands and industries, including large enterprise clients

• They want someone who'll grow with the company for the long run

📩 To apply, send your CV to contact@machineryfix. in with a short note on the most difficult card you've repaired. 

- Candidates should possess strong skills in Automation and Process Control, including PLC programming, SCADA/HMI configuration, and industrial control system integration. 
 - Candidates should possess solid Electrical Engineering skills, with the ability to interpret wiring diagrams, manage power and control circuits, and ensure compliance with electrical safety standards. 
 - Candidates should possess proven Troubleshooting skills for mechanical, electrical, and automation-related issues, using diagnostic tools and structured problem-solving methods. 
 - Candidates should possess foundational knowledge of Robotics, including configuration, operation, and maintenance of robotic systems used in manufacturing environments. 
 - Relevant bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline. 
 - Experience in industrial automation within manufacturing or process industries, particularly with MSME units, is beneficial. 
 - Ability to work on-site in demanding factory environments, adhere to safety protocols, and coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary teams. 
 - Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills, with the capacity to manage multiple assignments and respond quickly to critical machine breakdowns.

Serving as a critical bridge between Support and Engineering, the team ensures that serviceability and usability are considered throughout the product lifecycle. By analyzing customer issues, monitoring field performance, validating releases, and incorporating customer feedback, the team drives improvements that make Nutanix products easier to deploy, upgrade, troubleshoot, and operate. 

You will report to the Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement. The team works in a hybrid environment that encourages collaboration, technical learning, and ownership. 

Your Role

As a Senior Serviceability Engineer for Life Cycle Manager (LCM), you will help make upgrades predictable, diagnosable, and safe across Nutanix software and hardware environments. You will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality Assurance, Release Management, and Support to improve the serviceability of LCM from product definition through release and post-deployment adoption. 

LCM provides a cluster-aware framework for inventorying and updating software and firmware across a Nutanix environment. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys understanding complex distributed systems, investigating customer-impacting failures, improving product diagnostics, and influencing teams to prevent recurring issues. 

The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities. 

What You'll Do

- Define and maintain serviceability requirements for LCM features, upgrade workflows, inventory, prechecks, compatibility validation, recovery, and diagnostics. 
 - Partner with Product Management and Engineering during product planning and development to ensure customer troubleshooting and operational needs are addressed early. 
 - Lead serviceability validation for LCM releases, including upgrade-path testing, upgrade and inventory workflows, precheck coverage, failure and recovery scenarios, interoperability, scale, and upgrade resiliency. 
 - Build and maintain representative test matrices across Nutanix software, hypervisors, server platforms, firmware components, cluster configurations, and supported deployment models. 
 - Review field issues, support cases, telemetry, and diagnostic data to identify trends, customer impact, recurring failure modes, and opportunities for product improvement. 
 - Investigate complex LCM failures by correlating application logs, task and workflow data, cluster state, system events, network behavior, and firmware or hardware-management responses. 
 - Work with Engineering to isolate root causes, reproduce issues, define corrective actions, and drive critical and deferred defects to closure. 
 - Review precheck and compatibility behavior to ensure that failures are actionable, accurately classified, and supported by clear remediation guidance. 
 - Evaluate upgrade rollback, recovery, and partial-failure scenarios and help define safe customer outcomes when an upgrade does not complete as expected. 
 - Collaborate with Quality Assurance and test automation teams to improve coverage for upgrade paths, dependency conflicts, hardware variants, network conditions, disconnected or restricted environments, and negative scenarios. 
 - Partner with Release Management and Documentation teams on release readiness, known issues, upgrade guidance, troubleshooting content, and Support enablement. 
 - Translate complex technical findings into clear requirements, defect reports, troubleshooting guides, executive summaries, and customer-safe recommendations. 
 - Represent the customer and Support perspective in design reviews, technical discussions, defect triage, and release decisions. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote serviceability practices that reduce customer effort, support case volume, time to resolution, and avoidable upgrade risk. 

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years of experience in enterprise software, platform engineering, systems engineering, quality engineering, technical support, or serviceability. 
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. 
 - Experience working with complex infrastructure products, distributed systems, virtualization platforms, cloud infrastructure, or data-center operations. 
 - Strong experience troubleshooting customer-impacting issues across multiple layers of a technology stack and converting investigation findings into durable product improvements. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Support without relying solely on formal authority. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, technical support teams, product leaders, and executive stakeholders. 

Technical Requirements

Life Cycle Management and Upgrade Workflows

- Strong understanding of software and firmware lifecycle management, including inventory, repositories, package or bundle management, prechecks, dependencies, compatibility, upgrade sequencing, and post-upgrade validation. 
 - Experience testing or troubleshooting upgrade workflows involving failure handling, partial completion, recovery, retry, and resumption scenarios. 
 - Understanding of the operational risks associated with infrastructure upgrades and the importance of clear customer-facing diagnostics and remediation guidance. 

Virtualization and Nutanix Technologies

- Hands-on experience with one or more virtualization or hypervisor technologies, such as Nutanix AHV/KVM or VMware ESXi. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure concepts such as clusters, controllers, virtual machines, storage, networking, high availability, and rolling maintenance. 
 - Experience with Nutanix technologies such as AOS, Prism, AHV, or LCM is a plus. 

Systems and Infrastructure Troubleshooting

- Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including process, service, filesystem, permissions, networking, and system-resource analysis. 
 - Ability to analyze logs, task histories, service states, configuration files, alerts, and diagnostic bundles to identify failure patterns. 
 - Familiarity with server hardware, firmware, boot processes, out-of-band management, and hardware-management interfaces such as Redfish or IPMI is preferred. 
 - Understanding of network fundamentals relevant to infrastructure upgrades, including DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, TLS certificates, repositories, and connectivity validation. 

Automation, APIs, and Diagnostics

- Proficiency in Python, Shell, or another scripting language for test automation, log analysis, data extraction, and operational tooling. 
 - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and API-driven infrastructure workflows. 
 - Familiarity with observability, telemetry, log collection, diagnostic bundles, and metrics used to detect and troubleshoot product issues. 
 - Experience building or improving automated validation for upgrade, compatibility, failure-injection, or recovery scenarios. 

Serviceability and Quality Engineering

- Experience defining test strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, release gates, and validation metrics for complex products. 
 - Proven ability to review and prioritize defects using customer impact, frequency, severity, reproducibility, and business risk. 
 - Ability to create high-quality defect reports with clear symptoms, impact, reproduction steps, evidence, suspected scope, and validation criteria. 
 - Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent systems for defect tracking, documentation, and cross-functional execution. 
 - Experience using AI to automate workflows, build task-oriented agents, or analyze defects, bugs, and diagnostic data. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with infrastructure lifecycle management, firmware orchestration, server vendors, or data-center management platforms. 
 - Experience supporting or validating air-gapped, dark-site, proxy-based, or restricted-network environments. 
 - Knowledge of upgrade compatibility models, dependency graphs, release branches, backward compatibility, and interoperability testing. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, test frameworks, continuous validation, or quality dashboards. 
 - Background in technical support, escalation engineering, site reliability engineering, or customer-facing engineering for enterprise infrastructure products. 
 - Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base content, troubleshooting guides, or Support readiness material. 

Why This Role Matters

Infrastructure upgrades are high-trust operations for customers. In this role, you will help ensure that LCM does more than execute an upgrade: it should explain what is happening, identify risks early, recover safely when conditions change, and give customers and Support a clear path to resolution. 

If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, working across product boundaries, and turning field experience into better engineering outcomes, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the reliability and usability of Nutanix products. 

Nutanix is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

--

The company has inherited proven designs, advanced manufacturing facilities, and a highly experienced team of managers and engineers. data.title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer Voice
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's voice and unified communications platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across voice and unified communications to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Minimum Level Of Job-Related Experience Required

- Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 
 - Extensive experience engineering enterprise voice and unified communications services. 
 - Strong knowledge of Session Initiation Protocol, call routing, session border controllers, quality of service and high availability. 
 - Evidence of improving voice quality, resilience, provisioning or operational support. 

Desirable Requirements

- Professional level unified communications certification, such as CCNP Collaboration or Microsoft Teams Voice Engineer. 
 - Experience with cloud calling, contact centre or emergency calling services. 
 - Experience automating voice provisioning, monitoring or service assurance. 

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

#AGTech

Skills

Automation Technology, Call Routing, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Infrastructure Engineering, IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Platform Engineering, QoS Management, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Voice Casting, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

data.title: AI Full-Stack Developer, Maintenance & Enhancements
data.description:
Hiring for PULS Group - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1, 700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure. 

About the Role

PULS runs live AI solutions used every day by Purchasing, Finance, Logistics, R&D and Sales: chat agents integrated with SAP, scheduled Azure jobs, document pipelines, workflow apps and dashboards. You will keep them reliable and keep improving them. That means resolving incidents at the root cause, shipping change requests in regular maintenance releases, and keeping everything monitored and documented. You will work from India with core hours overlapping the Munich morning (about 13: 00-18: 00 IST), with no night shifts and no solo on-call, alongside the AI team, DevOps and Cybersecurity. Onboarding is in Munich, with one or two visits a year after that. 

What you'll do

- Own the incident and change-request queue for all live AI solutions: reproduce on the test stage, separate bugs from change requests and agree weekly priorities with the AI Team Lead
 - Fix root causes across the stack: TypeScript/React frontend, Node. js or Python (FastAPI) backend, scheduled jobs, SAP OData integration, PDF and mailbox automation, and write the test that proves each fix
 - Ship enhancements in maintenance releases (new SAP fields, document layouts, extended agent skills) and turn larger requests into specifications for the project team
 - Use Claude Code and Codex to draft fixes and tests, then review, verify on the preview stage and merge
 - Catch rising error rates, silently failed jobs and token-cost drift with KQL in Log Analytics; release prompt, skill and model updates on Azure OpenAI only after regression cases and an LLM-as-judge review pass
 - Run Azure Container Apps and jobs across preview, pilot and production with DevOps: Bicep, rollbacks, Key Vault secrets, Entra app registrations and Teams app updates
 - Take over solutions built by business teams and keep runbooks and documentation current

What you bring

- 4-6 years of full-stack development on production systems you not only built but kept running
 - TypeScript/React and Node. js, plus Python with FastAPI; SQL with PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB
 - Azure in daily practice: Container Apps, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Service Bus, Entra ID, Bicep and the Azure CLI
 - Has shipped LLM applications to production: tool calling, prompt guardrails, RAG (pgvector) and evaluation
 - Real debugging depth, e. g. has traced a 401/403 through an OAuth on-behalf-of chain and an API gateway to its root cause, and reads logs with KQL
 - At least 6 months of daily Claude Code or Codex use on production code. Expect live pairing on a real ticket in the interview
 - Secrets management, RBAC and GDPR as everyday practice; clear written English (C1) for non-technical colleagues in Jira and docs

Nice to have

- SAP OData integration experience
 - PowerShell for Windows-based deployment and operations tooling
 - Microsoft Teams app development

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.

This is where  your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride.   

  

Your Role at Baxter

As System Verification Test engineer for Infusion pumps team within Medication delivery business, the incumbent will have an independent responsibility of following instructions clearly in executing Test procedures for supporting all activities related to Design Verification of the medical devices. Candidate will also assist in maintaining Lab equipment, work with Design engineers to help build Test fixtures/assemblies and assisting with Lab logistics. 

  

What you'll be doing

  

Lead/Execute, perform, summarize and report out verification test activities Medical devices: Which includes but not limited to: 

- Understand URS (User requirements) / System Requirements and prepare the System Level Test cases and Prepare test procedures. 
 - Understand the product functionality and perform the Functional and Performance testing for the product. 
 - Lead/Support and perform all Design Verification activates
 - Perform Installation/Operational/Performance Qualification Protocols
 - Prepare Traceability Matrices and Final Reports. 
 - Support compliance/ closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements
 - Follow Test instructions and Test protocols. 
 - Follow instructions clearly from Design engineers during Test execution.   
 - Support Design engineers in Test fixture creation, building up & tearing down Test equipment. 
 - Support Lab logistics and maintain the material supply for testing requirements. Support Calibration activities. 
 - Diagnose, isolate and investigate problem reports and defects. 
 - Support to work with external test houses (such as EMI, EMC tests for electrical boards and full device) to define the test scope, author the test plans, test procedures, execute & consolidate the reports
 - Ensure good documentation and Good Manufacturing practices are followed in the Verification Process
 - Experience in IEC basic safety, EMI-EMC standards
 - Interacts with design team to resolve tests-related technical issues. 
 - Presents the findings / objective evidences and able to present with rationale with applicability / exclusions
 - Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective / Preventive action as needed. 

What you'll bring

- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Bio-Medical, Industrial Engineering or related field
 - Overall 5 to 8 yrs of experience with minimum 2 years in System Verification testing and performance testing. 
 - Hands on experience in overall final design verification/validation(V&V) testing of medical products. 
 - Relevant technical testing/reliability experience in electro-mechanical, electrical testing of Medical Devices. 
 - An understanding of test methods and processes as well as the methods used to verify product in the realms of; mechanical, electrical, functional testing environments. 
 - Basic hands on experience in data analysis of Performance testing and Sample size calculations for variable/Attribute data
 - Experience in Tools like Minitab( Data Analysis) / JIRA ( Defect ) / ALM ( test Environment) etc. 
 - Understanding of hardware and software product design methodologies and test practices. 
 - Experience in medical device or similar product development, design verification/validation, system integration (hardware/Subsystem/Software), risk management, reliability engineering, process validation and Quality systems
 - Basic understanding of and adherence to FDA, MDD/MDR, ISO and IEC design control procedures, regulations and standards. 
 - Self-motivated with good interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to follow instructions clearly.

The company connects factories with vetted ITI and diploma-certified technicians to resolve critical machine breakdowns quickly and reliably. By replacing informal, unverified mechanic networks, MachineryFix brings transparency, standardized pricing, and clear accountability to factory floor maintenance. The organization leverages technology to streamline service requests, improve response times, and enhance operational uptime for industrial plants. Applicants join a mission-driven team committed to modernizing industrial maintenance across India. 
Role Description The Instrumentation Engineer will be responsible for overseeing, installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting instrumentation and control systems on-site at client manufacturing facilities in Hyderabad. Day-to-day tasks include configuring and calibrating sensors, transmitters, and control devices, monitoring process parameters, and ensuring accurate data acquisition for safe and efficient operations. The role involves diagnosing equipment issues, coordinating with electrical and mechanical teams, documenting maintenance activities, and supporting preventive and predictive maintenance programs. The engineer will collaborate with technicians and plant managers to optimize process control strategies and adhere to safety standards and regulatory requirements. - Strong Process Control and Instrumentation skills, including experience with industrial sensors, PLCs, and control systems.
