 - Bachelor's degree or diploma in Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Experience in industrial manufacturing or plant maintenance environments; exposure to MSME units is an advantage. 
 - Ability to interpret P&IDs, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals, and to maintain clear technical documentation. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and capability to work independently and within cross-functional teams. 
 - Willingness to work on-site at factories, adhere to safety protocols, and engage directly with customers and technicians.

Lead Software Engineer

Technology at Mastercard

What we create today will define tomorrow. Revolutionary technologies that reshape the digital economy to be more connected and inclusive than ever before. Safer, faster, more sustainable. 

And we need the best people to do it. Technologists who are energized by the challenges of a truly global network. With the talent and vision to create the critical systems and products that power global commerce and connect people everywhere to the vital goods and services they need every day. 

Working at Mastercard means being part of a unique culture. Inclusive and diverse, a rich collaboration of ideas and perspectives. A place that celebrates your strengths, values your experiences, and offers you the flexibility to shape a career across disciplines and continents. Software Engineers at Mastercard design and code a variety of applications covering transaction processing, analytics, user interfaces, and APIs using a blend of cutting-edge technologies across big data, distributed systems, machine learning, and more. This will involve developing high-performing, highly scalable software solutions and products for some of the world's top brands. Specific tasks vary depending on the project and the business unit that you join in.

 - Own complex problems with dependency across services and facilitate cross-functional team interactions to drive resolution
 - Drive prioritization decisions and trade-offs in working with product partners
 - Provide development and architecture guidance to team members

 - Guide and mentor teams effectively as per needs. 
 - Communicate effectively and coordinate with various global groups in MasterCard to ensure success of the projects. 
 - Lead various initiatives for improving automation, defect metrics and overall quality. 

All About You

- Full Stack Development hands on experience using Java, Springboot tech stack, Microservice Architecture, Messaging/Event Driven Frameworks, CI/CD on a Cloud Native environment
 - Experience on System design and Architecture, on multi-tier distributed systems
 - Experience using AI tools and ability to explore and adapt to newer skillset
 - Key driver/owner for delivering multiple product features on or ahead of schedule. Extensive experience leading the full product development lifecycle including coordinating/shepherding technical design discussions, documentation, comparing & contrasting approaches, tasking out stories, and architecting test plans. 
 - Strong oral and written communicator with expertise in evangelizing complex ideas/solutions, spanning multiple, often conflicting, requirements. Facilitates discussions amongst technical and business stakeholders across organization and team boundaries to build consensus. 
 - Drives operational excellence by suggesting improvements to product modules/features using test data, performance data, and production metrics. Leverage testing to verify both functional and non-functional application requirements. Drives efforts to build and maintain lower environments that accurately reflect production. 
 - Demonstrable expertise with root cause analysis of issues in multi-tier distributed systems, with the ability to prescribe risk-reward balanced short-, mid- and long-term changes, over multiple release cycles. 
 - Highly regarded mentor. Instills best practices and proactively coaches others to high technical and quality standards. Identifies and sponsors junior teammates for key growth opportunities. 
 - Extensive experience using enterprise tooling and processes to improve products and processes by proposing changes/enhancements to the full SDLC lifecycle. 
 - Approaches discussions and problem solving, across organization and team boundaries with differing motivations/priorities, with empathy and a goal of building consensus. Finds way pitches in and lends support where needed. Valuable partner with organization and business partners in all roles and geographies. 
 - Key technical voice in anticipating, articulating, and evangelizing solutions to technical challenges, spanning org/team boundaries, based on broader industry trends, prioritized based on business needs. 

Equal opportunities considerations

In the US, Mastercard is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard. com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

data.description:
Company Description B Fouress Private Limited (BFL), based in Bengaluru, India, is a long-established player in the global small hydropower sector, with origins dating back to 1985 and technology partnerships with leading international firms. The company designs and manufactures Kaplan, Francis, and Pelton turbines ranging from 500 KW to 50, 000 KW, along with substations up to 220 kV. BFL operates overseas branch offices in Guatemala, Turkey, Vietnam, and Nepal and serves markets across South & Central America, the Balkans, Africa, Southeast Asia, and Nepal. The organization provides end-to-end services, including design and engineering, installation, commissioning, modernization, and refurbishment of small hydro projects. With decades of experience, BFL focuses on delivering high-performance, model-tested turbines and comprehensive solutions while expanding into new geographies. 
Role Description The QA Manager will oversee quality assurance activities for turbine manufacturing and related hydroelectric project components, ensuring compliance with internal standards, customer specifications, and relevant industry regulations. This full-time on-site role, based in Bengaluru, involves developing and implementing QA policies and procedures, defining inspection plans, and coordinating quality audits across design, production, installation, and commissioning stages. The individual will lead the QA team, monitor non-conformities, manage root cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions to improve product reliability and process efficiency. The role includes collaborating with engineering, production, procurement, and project management teams, managing documentation and certifications, and interacting with clients and third-party inspectors to address quality-related requirements and feedback. The QA Manager will also track quality metrics, prepare reports for leadership, and support continuous improvement initiatives aligned with global best practices. 
Qualifications

- Strong foundation in quality management, including QA/QC processes, standards, audit practices, and root cause analysis. 
 - Experience in manufacturing or heavy engineering, preferably in hydro turbines, power equipment, or similar industrial sectors. 
 - Proficiency in quality tools and methodologies such as ISO standards, FMEA, control plans, statistical process control, and risk-based quality management. 
 - Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications, and collaborate effectively with design, production, and project teams. 
 - Experience managing quality documentation, certifications, and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Demonstrated leadership skills, including team management, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with attention to detail and a focus on continuous improvement. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; advanced qualifications in quality management (e. g. , Six Sigma, ASQ certifications) are an advantage.

data.title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer

Wolters Kluwer is seeking a Senior Enterprise Software Engineer to design, develop, and implement scalable cloud-based solutions, with a strong focus on Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps practices, and automation. 

This role represents a key step in the evolution from traditional IT operations toward software-driven infrastructure engineering, where systems and environments are built, deployed, and managed through code and automated pipelines. 

The engineer will contribute to the development of enterprise platform capabilities, leveraging modern CI/CD toolchains and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, quality, and delivery speed.

 - Build automation solutions to replace manual operational activities
 - Contribute to the development of enterprise cloud services across Azure and AWS

CI/CD and Automation

- Design and maintain pipelines using: 
 - Azure DevOps (ADO Pipelines)
 - Jenkins
 - GitHub Actions
 - GitLab CI/CD
 - Ensure consistent and repeatable deployment processes across environments
 - Integrate validation, testing, and security controls into delivery pipelines

AI-Enabled Development

 - Accelerate code and IaC development

 - Validate AI-generated outputs and ensure adherence to engineering standards

Operations & Reliability

 - Contribute to observability practices (logging, metrics, alerting)
 - Improve system reliability through automation and continuous improvement

Work Breakdown

 - 10% Innovation & AI enablement

Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience

Experience

 - Normal professional office environment. 

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. data.title: Welding Engineer
data.description:
Job Description - Welding Engineer

Department: Quality Assurance

Reporting To: Head - Quality / VP - Foundry Operations

Job Purpose

To ensure all weld repair activities on steel castings are carried out in compliance with customer specifications, international codes, and internal quality standards, while minimizing repair rates and ensuring first-time acceptance. 

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare, qualify, and maintain WPS, PQR, and Welder Qualification Records (WPQ) as per ASME Section IX and customer requirements. 

- Plan and supervise weld repairs on carbon steel, stainless steel, duplex, super duplex, and nickel alloy castings. 

- Review RT, UT, PT, MT, and VT reports and define appropriate weld repair procedures. 

- Coordinate with foundry, heat treatment, machining, and quality teams to ensure timely completion of repair welding. 

- Monitor preheating, interpass temperature, PWHT, and welding consumable storage and usage. 

- Conduct root cause analysis for welding defects and implement corrective and preventive actions. 

- Train, qualify, and monitor welders to improve productivity and weld quality. 

- Maintain complete welding documentation for customer inspections and audits. 

- Support customer, TPI, and third-party inspections related to welding activities. 

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce weld repair rates and improve first-pass acceptance. 

Qualification

- B. E. /B. Tech. or Diploma in Mechanical, Metallurgical, or Welding Engineering. 

- CSWIP 3. 1/3. 2, IWE/IWT, AWS-CWI, or equivalent certification is preferred. 

Experience

- 3-10 years in a steel casting foundry or heavy engineering industry. 

- Experience in pump castings, duplex and super duplex stainless steels, and pressure-containing components is preferred.

data.title: Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director
data.description:
Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director - Digital Project Delivery

(This role can be based in any global Worley office)

About Worley

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. 

With more than 40, 000 employees in over 40 countries, we specialise in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. 

The role

Shape how the world's energy, chemicals and resources projects are built and brought to life. As our Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director, you'll lead the team that digitally enables successful Construction and Commissioning (C&C) delivery across Worley's global project portfolio. 

Why this role matters

At Worley, digital enablement spans the full stack of people, process and technology a global EPC company needs. Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Project Delivery (DPD) and joining the DPD leadership team, you'll set the direction for C&C digitalisation and have the authority and autonomy to make it happen. You will own the strategy, technology and corresponding processes that help our project teams deliver better outcomes for our customers. 

DPD is part of Digital Operations at Worley and exists to support Operations, so your work in this global role will have impact across the organisation. 

This is where deep digital expertise meets senior leadership. Rather than writing code yourself, you'll set the technical direction and lead a talented team across multiple locations, bringing them together to turn that vision into results on our projects. You'll engage with functional representatives in Operations to ensure C&C project needs are understood and delivered. 

Worley has placed Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) at the centre of project execution. A key part of this role is supporting the seamless digital enablement of AWP on projects. AI is also central to our digital strategy, and this role will help shape how we adopt AI across C&C delivery. 

What You Will Do

- Set the strategy: Define the strategy for digital enablement of C&C as part of the wider DPD strategy, build the plans to deliver it, and develop strategic relationships with external technology partners that support our DPD ambition. 
 - Own the solution: Take ownership of the C&C technology stack, including tools, integrations, automation, AI, data management and reporting, across its full build-operate-support-retire lifecycle, partnering closely with other parts of the Worley digital team. 
 - Own the approach: Define the end-to-end C&C workflow for digitally enabled projects in collaboration with the project delivery function. 
 - Lead implementation: Drive adoption of the C&C digital way of working, collaborating with the DPD People and Processes team to ensure a consistent approach across project delivery. 
 - Enable our people: Contribute to organisational change management, define the digital competency requirements for project personnel, and support the governance framework that embeds the Worley digital approach. 
 - Deliver standout support: Build a support culture focused on keeping our people productive, using service metrics to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Lead and grow the team: Manage geographically dispersed direct and indirect reports, including subcontractors, and develop and manage the team budget in line with company delegation of authority requirements. 

What You Will Bring

- Demonstrated experience in construction and commissioning. 
 - Strong digital execution expertise and AI capability. 
 - A proven record of directly leading and managing teams. 
 - A relevant university degree. 
 - Experience collaborating across teams to deliver practical solutions. 
 - Experience developing strategies, operating models and frameworks, with a track record of successfully implementing new ways of working. 
 - Experience with digital solutions on projects and awareness of software commonly used for C&C delivery. Knowledge of O3 is preferred. 
 - Thought leadership, with the ability to move between strategic and tactical thinking and work comfortably with new concepts and complexity. 
 - Strong relationship and influencing skills across all levels, cultures and external parties, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and facilitate discussions with large groups. 

What's In It For You

- A senior leadership role on the DPD leadership team, with genuine authority and autonomy over C&C digitalisation. 
 - The opportunity to shape how digital technology is used to build and commission projects globally. 
 - The opportunity to build capability in deploying digital solutions across a large multinational organisation. 
 - Latitude to explore emerging C&C digital technologies with technology providers that could shape the future of project delivery at Worley. 
 - Applicants must possess valid working rights for the country in which the role will be based.

data.title: Principal - Platform Engineer Segmentation
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's network segmentation and identity-based access platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across network segmentation and identity-based access to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Adopt engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Work with principal engineers and partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Experience Required

- Overall 10 years and typically 5-7 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 
 - Strong experience engineering enterprise network security, segmentation or identity based access. 
 - Deep knowledge of 802. 1X authentication, network access control, firewalls, routing and resilient service design. 
 - Evidence of implementing segmentation that improved security coverage, access control or operational resilience. 

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

#AGTech

Skills

Automation Technology, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Cloud Networking, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Microsegmentation, Network Design, Network Segmentation, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), SRE Observability, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture, Zscaler Architecture

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - QA will help shape and evolve the organisation's quality engineering platform, enabling teams to build, test, deploy and operate software faster, more securely, and more reliably. The QA role will set the testing and quality standards helping to build test automation that can be adopted across platform and application teams. They will also mentor the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the test automation as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality strategy and architecture

- Define the platform quality engineering strategy, test pyramid and quality gates for all cloud platform products. 
 - Set standards for testing infrastructure-as-code: static analysis, policy-as-code, unit, integration and end-to-end tests for Terraform modules. 
 - Design ephemeral test environments that provision, validate and tear down platform stacks on every change. 

Continuous verification and automation

- Build shift-left quality into CI/CD: automated gates for security, compliance, cost and drift before merge and release. 
 - Establish contract and compatibility testing so module and API changes never break consuming business teams. 
 - Lead resilience and chaos testing for platforms. 
 - Drive performance and scale testing for self-service provisioning paths. 

GxP and computerised system assurance

- Modernise qualification from document-heavy validation to risk-based, automated Assurance. 
 - Generate qualification evidence (IQ/OQ traceability, test results, approvals) directly from pipelines. 
 - Partner with Quality, GRC and the CISO office to keep evidence audit-ready for GxP, SOX and data integrity requirements. 

Images, supply chain and security quality

- Own test frameworks for VM, OS, database and container image bakeries: CIS benchmarks, vulnerability thresholds, SBOM and signing checks. 
 - Integrate CNAPP and code scanning findings (e. g. Wiz, GitHub Advanced Security) into release gates with clear SLAs. 

AI and agentic platform quality

- Define evaluation frameworks for platform AI agents: accuracy, safety & guardrail 
 - Test agent-generated artifacts for correctness, policy compliance and blast radius before execution. 

Engineering leadership

- Set quality metrics and SLOs, report them to platform and security leadership, and drive corrective actions. 
 - Mentor engineers across platform teams; grow a quality-engineering community of practice. 
 - Evaluate and select tooling; make build-vs-buy recommendations. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 15+ years in software or platform engineering, with 3+ years leading quality or test engineering for tenant platforms at enterprise scale. 
 - Deep hands-on Terraform experience 
 - Strong policy-as-code skills around OPA/Rego 
 - Production experience on Azure and GCP; working knowledge of Kubernetes and GitOps 
 - Built CI/CD quality gates in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar. 
 - Proficient in at least one of Python, Go or TypeScript for test frameworks and tooling. 
 - Experience in a regulated industry (life sciences, pharma, finance or healthcare), including GxP or equivalent validation. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing LLM-based or agentic systems 
 - Familiarity with software supply chain standards: SLSA, SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), Sigstore/cosign. 
 - Chaos engineering tools such as Azure Chaos Studio, LitmusChaos or Gremlin. 
 - Experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Azure Arc or hybrid estates. 
 - Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, ISTQB Advanced or CKA. 

Leadership behaviors and ways of working

- Quality as an engineering discipline: builds automation and paved roads, not manual sign-off queues. 
 - Risk-based judgement: scales testing rigour to patient, product and data-integrity impact. 
 - Influence without authority: aligns platform, security, Quality and GRC stakeholders on shared standards. 
 - Hands-on credibility: writes and reviews code, and can debug a failing pipeline alongside the team. 
 - Clear communicator: turns quality data into decisions for senior leadership and auditors alike.

data.description:
Business Introduction

Job Purpose

The SRE Principal, Automation & Toil Reduction leads the engineering of automation that removes repetitive operational work and improves the reliability, resilience and efficiency of GSK platforms. The role acts as a hands-on principal SRE, shaping reusable automation patterns, enabling safe autonomous operations and embedding measurable toil reduction across platform domains. 

The role sits in Reliability Engineering & Operations and works across platform domains through a hub-and-spoke model. It owns the enterprise approach for identifying, baselining and prioritising toil, and converts high-value candidates into production-grade automation for diagnostics, remediation, recovery, fulfilment and compliance workflows. Platform build direction remains with Principal Engineers and Engineering Directors, major incident command remains with the Major Incident Manager, and the central reliability and automation standard is set by the Reliability Engineering Senior Director. Automation outcomes and priorities are agreed jointly with Platform Managers and Product Owners. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own and evolve the enterprise SRE automation and toil-reduction strategy, roadmap, reference patterns and engineering standards. 
 - Establish a consistent toil taxonomy and measurement approach using operational data, service-management evidence, task frequency, effort, risk and business impact. 
 - Prioritise automation candidates by hours avoided, repeatability, reliability risk, human-error exposure, control value, delivery complexity and reuse potential. 
 - Design and build secure, reusable automation for provisioning, diagnostics, incident triage, remediation, recovery, capacity, patching, service requests and compliance evidence. 
 - Create APIs, event-driven integrations, workflows, infrastructure-as-code modules, runbook automation and self-service capabilities rather than isolated scripts. 
 - Engineer closed-loop and AI-assisted operations with strong telemetry, policy controls, confidence thresholds, auditability and human approval for higher-risk actions. 
 - Establish production guardrails covering identity, least privilege, secrets, testing, change integration, release, rollback, failure containment and support ownership. 
 - Instrument automation to measure success, failure, latency, coverage, adoption, exceptions, cost and reliability impact end to end. 
 - Integrate automation with observability, ITSM, CI/CD, configuration, orchestration and knowledge platforms to reduce hand-offs and context switching. 
 - Use incident, problem and post-incident evidence to identify recurring failure modes and convert them into permanent engineering fixes or automated prevention. 
 - Partner with service and platform owners to define SLOs for automation-enabled services and use error-budget and risk evidence to prioritise reliability work. 
 - Lead technical design reviews for high-impact automation and prevent unsafe, brittle or low-value automation from becoming operational debt. 
 - Coach engineers, publish reusable patterns and grow an automation community of practice across internal and supplier teams. 
 - Provide technical oversight of supplier-delivered automation and ensure GSK retains maintainable code, documentation, telemetry, security evidence and knowledge. 
 - Track outcomes including toil ratio, capacity returned, automation adoption, cycle time, repeat incidents, MTTR, human-error reduction and control effectiveness. 

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience, such as Computer Science or Software Engineering. 
 - Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, security, IT service management or automation certifications are desirable. 

Area of Specialisation

- Site reliability engineering, toil management and operations automation at enterprise scale. 
 - Software engineering for production operations, including APIs, event-driven integration, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, testing and observability. 
 - AIOps and safe autonomous operations, including anomaly detection, decision support and governed remediation. 

Experience Required

- Overall 15 years and degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical engineering experience. 
 - Typically 8 or more years of experience in software, platform, infrastructure or reliability engineering, with substantial hands-on ownership of production services and automation. 
 - Demonstrated experience converting recurring operational work into reliable, reusable automation with measurable adoption and benefits. 
 - Advanced programming and automation engineering using Python or an equivalent language, including
 - APIs, testing, packaging, error handling and secure coding. 
 - Deep coding or scripting capability, plus practical experience with APIs, source control, automated testing and CI/CD. 
 - Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management or enterprise orchestration. 
 - Experience instrumenting distributed systems and automation workflows using metrics, logs, traces and events. 
 - Experience applying SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, incident management, postmortems, resilience and toil reduction. 
 - Experience designing safe production automation controls for access, secrets, approvals, change, rollback, audit and ongoing support. 
 - Experience leading technical design across multiple teams, mentoring experienced engineers and influencing without formal authority. 
 - Platform engineering depth in at least one domain such as cloud, hosting, networks, containers, databases or digital workplace. 

Desirable requirements: 

- Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, security, IT service management or automation certifications. 
 - Experience with AIOps, generative AI or agentic operations, including evaluation, confidence thresholds, guardrails and human-in-the-loop approval. 
 - Experience creating self-service platforms, service catalogues, golden paths or reusable automation products. 
 - Experience with chaos engineering, game days, automated recovery testing, progressive delivery and pre-change or post-change validation. 
 - Experience integrating observability, ITSM, CMDB, CI/CD and orchestration platforms to reduce operational hand-offs. 
 - Experience operating in a global, multi-supplier environment and assuring supplier-delivered code, documentation, telemetry and knowledge transfer. 
 - Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry, including GxP or validated systems. 
 - Experience measuring capacity returned, repeat-incident reduction, automation execution success, exception rates, control effectiveness and reuse. 

Skills/Background

- Principal-level judgement to distinguish genuine toil from valuable engineering work and to know when simplification is better than automation. 
 - Ability to influence platform, product, operations, security, quality and supplier teams without formal authority. 
 - Product mindset for automation, including users, SLOs, ownership, documentation, lifecycle, support and decommissioning. 
 - Composure during live incidents and discipline to convert restored service into permanent prevention. 
 - Ability to explain complex technical decisions to engineers and senior stakeholders in outcome-oriented language. 
 - Commitment to automate work away rather than becoming indispensable to recurring manual activity. 
 - Learning mindset toward evolving AIOps, agentic automation and platform engineering practices, without adopting technology ahead of control maturity. 

Preferred Skills

- Production-grade software engineering in Python (or equivalent): APIs, testing, packaging, error handling and secure coding, with 8+ years of hands-on production ownership
 - Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and orchestration with CI/CD: Terraform/Ansible, event-driven integrations, automated testing, release and rollback
 - SRE practices: SLOs, error budgets, incident management and postmortems, converting recurring failure modes into permanent engineering fixes
 - Toil identification and measurable automation: baselining, prioritising by hours avoided, risk and reuse, and evidencing adoption and capacity returned
 - Safe production automation controls: least privilege, secrets management, approvals, change integration, audit trail, rollback and failure containment
 - Observability and instrumentation of distributed systems and automation workflows: metrics, logs, traces and events
 - Platform engineering depth in at least one domain (cloud, hosting, network, containers, databases or digital workplace) plus technical leadership: design reviews, mentoring and influence without authority

data.title: Principal Network Automation Engineer
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

We're looking for a Network Automation AI Engineer to design, build, and operate AI agents that automate network operations, ITSM, and lifecycle management across a large enterprise network estate. You'll combine traditional network automation (Cisco, Itential, ServiceNow) with modern agentic AI (LLM orchestration, MCP tool integration, RAG) to build production-grade, safety-gated automation. 

Responsibilities

- Design and build AI agents (using frameworks like Google ADK, LangChain, or similar) that interact with network infrastructure via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or custom tool integrations
 - Write and iterate on system prompts/instructions that ground LLM behavior in real tool schemas, enforce anti-hallucination discipline, and avoid unsafe automation
 - Integrate agents with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow) for incident, change, and CMDB data, and with network orchestration platforms (Itential) for workflow execution
 - Build human-in-the-loop approval workflows for any agent capability that can modify production network state (e. g. , plan → approve/reject → apply patterns), with strict identity/authorization guardrails
 - Develop and maintain backend services (Python, FastAPI) exposing agents via REST/A2A/JSON-RPC protocols
 - Containerize and deploy agents (Docker, Cloud Run, CI/CD via GitHub Actions) with per-agent configuration, environment isolation, and secrets management
 - Instrument agents with observability (OpenTelemetry, structured logging, Cloud Logging) for tool I/O, session traces, and audit trails
 - Collaborate with network engineering teams to translate operational runbooks (EOL/EOS tracking, device lifecycle, LAN/WAN/wireless health checks, config change validation) into agent capabilities
 - Own RBAC/token propagation and security review for agent-to-tool and agent-to-user authentication
 - Test agents against live/staging MCP servers, validate tool schemas, and iterate on prompt engineering based on real session traces
 - Document architecture decisions, known gotchas, and operational runbooks for the agent fleet

Required Qualifications

- Overall 10 Years and strong Python skills; experience building async services (FastAPI, asyncio)
 - Hands-on experience with LLM application development: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, RAG, multi-turn session/state management
 - Familiarity with agent frameworks (Google ADK, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar) and agent-to-agent/tool protocols (MCP, A2A)
 - Networking fundamentals: Cisco IOS/IOS-XE, LAN/WAN/wireless architecture, routing, switching, firewalls
 - Experience with ITSM tooling (ServiceNow) and network orchestration platforms (Itential, NSO, or similar)
 - Docker containerization and CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or equivalent)
 - Cloud platform experience (GCP preferred: Vertex AI, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Secret Manager)
 - Strong understanding of security practices for automation that can modify production infrastructure (least privilege, approval gating, audit logging)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with LiteLLM or multi-provider LLM routing/fallback strategies
 - Familiarity with Itential Automation Platform / Operations Manager workflows
 - Experience with vector search / RAG pipelines (Vertex AI Search, embeddings, citation grounding)
 - Background in network automation scripting (Netmiko, NAPALM, Genie/pyATS, Ansible)
 - Experience designing safety guardrails for write-capable AI agents (change management, approval workflows)
 - Exposure to OpenTelemetry/observability tooling and FinOps/cost tracking for LLM usage

Title: Control Software Designer-PLC-Husky (India), Chennai

Id: 21587

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As part of the Development Engineering team, the Control Software Designer designs, supports, and troubleshoots control systems for Injection Molding Machines(IMM) and Mold controllers. This role operates in a fast-paced, innovative environment and focuses on developing creative, high-quality solutions to complex technical challenges. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability: 

- Design control systems for IMM and Mold controller applications including servo drive and servo-hydraulic controls, injection molding process control. 
 - Provide functional, design specifications and validation plans for new IMM and Mold controller functionality. 
 - Software development of machine sequences (PLC IEC 61131-3), process control, human-machine interface(HMI) in Windows environment. 
 - Troubleshoot and debug real-time and non-real-time software. 
 - Document software changes using resources such as TFS/VSTS and Azure DevOps. 
 - Document development, design changes and production design activities. 
 - Communicate design with other design groups and businesses. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Electrical & Electronics/ECE/Instrumentation/Software Engineering preferred, or equivalent. 
 - Minimum 5 years hands-on experience in automated control system design and troubleshooting preferred. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - PLC structured text language design and programming using IEC 61131-3. 
 - Experience in programming using C, C++, C# or other high-level languages for HMI applications (Ruby). 
 - Strong knowledge of PC based control systems and embedded system. 
 - Strong Knowledge of control theory and model-based design principles. 
 - Knowledge of PLC's and motion controllers. 
 - Working knowledge of standard industrial communication networks and protocols such as RS232, RS485, Ethernet, CANOpen, Profibus, Profinet and EtherCAT. 
 - Ability to read control circuits using Eplan as a resource. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff TwinCAT3. 
 - Experience designing, debugging and deploying software in VSTS development environment. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - Experience in Agile software design process and Test Driven Development methodologies. 
 - Familiarity and experience with AI and it's use in software development, ideation, and the creation of tools
 - Strong proficiency in English with effective verbal, written. 

Personal Qualifications: 

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, verbally and in writing. 
 - A quick independent learner, able to digest and understand complex concepts. 
 - An intelligent thinker, able to formulate hypotheses, troubleshoot, analyze, and propose solutions. 
 - Highly creative with the ability to develop multiple concepts to resolve problems. 
 - Capable of Working in a multi-disciplined international team with excellent personal organization skills. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end-to-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human-in-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks. 

As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human-in-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and manage a team of Analysts & Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery. 
 - Act as a Subject matter expert & support the team on complex document processing
 - Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
 - Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data
 - Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput. 
 - Act as a primary escalation point for operational and data quality issues. 
 - Partner with our Machine Learning Operations team to identify and relabel documents for model retraining
 - Engage clients, GPs, or Fund Admins on statement data related inquiries
 - Support the Maintenance Alternatives Data Operations workflow procedures and play-books. 
 - Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and standardization. 
 - Partner with Product and Engineering to implement new processes and tooling features that improve Alternatives Data processing UX and increase operational workflow efficiency. 

Who You Are

- Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
 - Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
 - Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
 - Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
 - Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
 - Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
 - Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
 - Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
 - Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. data.description:
Job Title: IT Lead -IT Engineering

Location: Coimbatore

Immediate joiners or notice period of less than 10 days are needed

This Role: 

The IT Lead, IT Engineering leads the engineering of LogixHealth's Microsoft cloud and workplace platforms: Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Azure including Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Purview data protection, ITSM tooling and automation. The role owns everything beyond day-to-day operations in a healthcare technology environment that handles Protected Health Information (PHI). 

This is a strategic and technical leadership role. The Lead sets the standards and roadmap for these platforms, is the technical authority on design decisions and major incidents, stays hands-on for the most complex work, and leads and mentors the IT engineers who deliver the rest. The Lead turns business and security requirements into a practical platform plan with costs, risks and timelines for the IT Infrastructure Leadership, and serves all LogixHealth locations. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Strategy, Standards and Roadmap

- Own the architecture, design standards and 12 to 24 month roadmap for identity, endpoint management, data protection, cloud and virtual desktop and IT tooling; translate business, security and compliance requirements into options and investment cases with cost, risk and timeline. 
 - Provide input to budgeting, Azure forecasts, Microsoft licensing and tooling decisions; lead projects end to end (requirements, design, pilot, phased rollout, handover) and act as technical approver in design and change reviews. Platform Ownership (Entra ID, Intune, Purview, Azure, AVD)

- Own Entra ID standards: Conditional Access framework, MFA and authentication strategy, Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, application integration and hybrid identity (Entra Connect). 
 - Own endpoint and data protection standards: Autopilot, Autopatch, configuration and compliance policies, Defender for Endpoint, application deployment, Purview DLP and encryption, for Windows and macOS. 
 - Own Azure Virtual Desktop design and operation (host pools, image strategy, FSLogix, autoscaling, capacity, cost and monitoring) and the supporting Azure resources. Security Hardening, Patch and Vulnerability Management

- Own the hardening standard (Microsoft or CIS baselines, Defender for Endpoint and ASR rules, Credential Guard, firewall, device control, encryption, Windows LAPS) and the patch programme: policy and SLAs by severity, monthly cycle, third-party patching, maintenance windows, exception governance and zero-day response. 
 - Own the vulnerability management programme: intake from Defender Vulnerability Management or scanners, prioritisation, remediation SLAs, exception and risk-acceptance register with Security, verified closure and monthly posture reporting with owners and dates for gaps. ITSM Tooling and Automation

- Own the engineering of IT tooling, including ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus design and its integrations with Intune, Entra ID and Microsoft 365, plus monitoring, reporting and self-service automation. 
 - Set automation and documentation standards for the team (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure DevOps or Git) and introduce Infrastructure as Code where it adds value. Incident, Compliance and Team Leadership

- Act as technical lead on major incidents affecting these platforms and on the technical response to security incidents with Information Security; manage Microsoft and vendor escalations; own ISO 27001, SOC 2 and HIPAA evidence for the platform controls. 
 - Lead, mentor and develop the IT engineering team: allocate work, review designs, provide escalation support and build capability across the platforms. Qualifications: 

The following requirements are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the duties. 

Required (Mandatory): 

- B. E. /B. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 9 to 12 years in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 2 to 3 years as technical lead, with at least 4 years hands-on on Microsoft 365 and Azure in a design and build (engineering) capacity rather than support-only roles. 
 - Strong hands-on Microsoft Entra ID: Conditional Access design, MFA and authentication methods, PIM, access reviews, enterprise application SSO and hybrid identity. 
 - Strong hands-on Microsoft Intune: Autopilot, compliance and configuration policies, Autopatch or update rings, Defender for Endpoint, macOS management. 
 - Strong hands-on Azure Virtual Desktop: architecture, host pools, image lifecycle, FSLogix, autoscaling, security and monitoring, with working knowledge of the Azure platform (networking, storage, monitoring, RBAC, cost). 
 - Proven ownership of patch and vulnerability management for an endpoint or VDI estate: hardening standards, Defender Vulnerability Management or Tenable, Rapid7 or Qualys, SLA-based remediation, exception governance and reporting. 
 - PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; proven ability to define a roadmap, lead major incidents, run design reviews and explain architecture, cost and risk to senior management. 
 - Work from office; shifts and on-call as required for a 24×7 healthcare operation; travel between Coimbatore and Bangalore when needed. Preferred (Good to Have): 

- Infrastructure as Code: owning a Terraform (azurerm, azuread) or Bicep practice with module standards, remote state, Git pull-request workflow, pipeline deployment and drift detection, including identity objects managed as code. 
 - Deeper Azure platform design (vNets, NSGs, private endpoints, Azure Files, Compute Gallery, Log Analytics) and Azure DevOps or GitHub CI/CD; Windows 365, Nerdio, Citrix or VMware Horizon to AVD migration. 
 - Microsoft Purview DLP and Defender XDR depth; ITSM tool design or integration (ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, ServiceNow or similar); experience moving from AD-dependent estates to cloud-native Entra ID and Intune; healthcare, HIPAA or other regulated environment. Preferred Certifications (Good to Have): 

Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, MD-102, SC-300, AZ-140; ITIL Foundation; HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

data.title: Senior CQV Engineer
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. 

The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals. 

The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities. 
 - Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards. 
 - Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success. 
 - Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management. 
 - Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule. 
 - Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e. g. , ASTM E2500, ISPE)
 - Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies. 
 - Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems. 
 - Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design. 
 - Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements. 
 - Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner. 
 - Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews. 
 - Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site. 
 - Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction. 
 - System Startup activities

Working Conditions

- The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities. 
 - Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements. 
 - Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 10-15 year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 
 - Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects. 
 - Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project. 

Technical Skills

- Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations. 
 - Experience with process validation and computer system validation. 
 - Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc. 
 - Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong project management and organizational skills. 
 - Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

data.description:
Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India

JOB OVERVIEW

Are you passionate about building large-scale applications leveraging public cloud services and integration design patterns? As an Integration Engineer, you will work on developing and maintaining Integration & Automation Solutions for Legion WFM customers. 

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another. 

- Please note that this opportunity is an overnight shift. 
 - Expected hours: 10: 30 pm - 07: 30 am IST
 - This role involves participation in an on-call rotation. 
 - This role may require work outside of normal business hours. 
Technical Integrations

- Design and implement scalable integration architectures connecting Legion with HR, POS, Payroll, and other enterprise systems. 
 - Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato
 - Develop secure and efficient REST APIs within Legion's API-driven ecosystem. 
 - Ensure high-performance, reliable integrations using modern cloud platforms. 
 - Engage with architects and engineers for design collaboration and code reviews. 
 - Improve development practices and stay ahead of agile software engineering trends. 

Legion Product Expertise

- Gain and maintain deep knowledge of Legion's product and integration ecosystem. 
 - Identify, report, and prioritize product bugs and enhancements. 
 - Work with core engineering and production engineering teams to improve backend reliability and troubleshoot production issues
 - Stay updated on new releases and enhancements to drive product adoption. 
 - Write secure, enterprise-grade integration code using leading platforms and technologies. 
 - Write well-designed, testable, efficient code
 - Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle
 - Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability. 

Team Collaboration & Mentorship

- Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing. 
 - Contribute to best practices for integration and internal technical documentation. 
 - Support process improvements and advocate for scalable, sustainable integrations. 
 - Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals. 

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- 7+ years of business/information/solution/technical architecture experience
 - Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree
 - Must be able to work as a team player, yet can work independently. 
 - Analytical, results-driven, and have a solution-oriented approach
 - Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills, including verbal, written presentation, and listening. 
 - 3+ years of experience with event-driven Architecture and Microservices
 - Demonstrated deep technical expertise in Integration technologies and protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, SOAP, REST, JMS, JDBC
 - Experience using Linux/Unix environments
 - Demonstrate proficiency with Core Java. 
 - Experience with Relational Databases, SQL and JDBC (one of Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc. )
 - 2+ years of experience using AWS technologies such as AWS CDK, Cloud formation, S3, ECS, EKS, and EC2
 - Demonstrate experience with test-driven development. 
 - Strong experience with Java/RESTful web services
 - Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e. g. , Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)
 - Demonstrate knowledge and experience with CI/CD processes and tools. 
 - Proven track record of using problem-solving / root-cause analysis

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

- The ideal candidate has workforce management integration experience
 - Preferred experience in the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions with integration platforms such as Workato, SAP BTP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit, SnapLogic 
 - Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence
 - Technical consulting experience. 
 - Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies. 
 - Experience working with external applications integrations end-to-end such as Workday, SAP, etc. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. 

We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant's location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. 

Benefits include, but are not limited to: 

- Health Benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
 - Parental Leave 
 - Equity 
 - Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
 - Monthly Lunch on Legion

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry's most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It's proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. 

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. 

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3, 200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options.
