data.title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
data.description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer - Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance

GCL: D3

Introduction To Role

Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?

In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide. 

You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities-hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery. 

Accountabilities

- Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams. 
 - Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption. 
 - Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails. 
 - Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability. 
 - Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks. 
 - Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption. 
 - Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery. 
 - Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value. 
 - AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline. 
 - GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization. 
 - Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
 - Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures. 
 - Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design. 
 - Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang. 
 - Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security. 
 - Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments. 
 - Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles. 
 - Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations. 
 - Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts. 
 - Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies. 
 - Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments. 
 - Familiarity with Azure cloud services. 
 - Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, . NET, or React. 
 - Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement. 
 - Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists-engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders-around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. You will build from scratch as part of an inclusive group of self-starters who share ideas openly, challenge with respect, and take accountability for making things real. We value patience alongside ambition, learn fast from real-world use, and hold high ethical standards because the stakes are patients' lives. 

If you're ready to build the enterprise golden paths that make secure delivery the default and accelerate life-changing science, send us your CV and show us the platform you would create next!

Date Posted

20-Nov-2026

Closing Date

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

Position Overview:

data.title: SAP Order Management Solution Architect
data.description:
Role: SAP Order Management Solution Architect

Location: Pune (Hybrid)

Life Unlimited. At Smith+Nephew, we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living. 

Smith & Nephew (S+N) is a large multinational Medical Technology organization with an extensive Enterprise Applications ecosystem to run end-to-end business operations. ERPs form the core of this ecosystem and are tightly integrated with best-in-class systems such as Salesforce, Windchill, Movemedical, Maestro, Ariba, Workday and many more. At S+N, SAP serves as our primary and strategic ERP platform, running 80% of our operations and revenue. 

We are seeking an SAP Order Management Solution Architect to design and deliver SAP solutions and customizations aligned with business requirements, while supporting and preparing for our strategic transition to SAP S/4HANA. Therefore, this role is both strategic and pivotal, playing a key part in enabling Smith & Nephew's digital transformation and continued growth over the coming years. 

What will you be doing?

- The Order Management Solution Architect is responsible for partnering with Business Process Owners to design and deliver Order to Cash solutions that meet business needs. 
 - This role requires strong SAP OM/SD expertise, a solid understanding of complex multinational business processes, and experience delivering large-scale global SAP implementations. 
 - The ideal candidate combines strong solution architecture capabilities with the ability to drive business value through standardized, scalable, and efficient processes. 
 - Define enterprise integration architecture aligned with SAP roadmap (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, SAP BTP etc. ). 
 - Collaborate with business, functional, and technical stakeholders and translate business requirements into integration architecture designs. 
 - Lead system integration architecture across SAP and third-party applications. 
 - Design end-to-end integration solutions using: SAP PI/PO (Process Integration/Orchestration) SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI, API Management, Open Connectors). 
 - Ensure integration scalability, high availability, and performance optimization. 
 - Implement security protocols (OAuth, SAML, certificates, encryption).

data.title: Software Development Manager III, Seller Fulfillment Technology (International FBA Team)
data.description:
Description

Own a core part of Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) for Amazon's fastest-growing and most strategic marketplaces - from emerging international markets to the future of FBA in Europe. International FBA builds the software that lets third-party (3P) sellers send inventory into Amazon's network, keep it in stock, and fulfill orders, and we're hiring a Software Development Manager to lead a high-impact engineering charter end to end. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly execution for the engineering charter, translating seller and business goals into a clear, prioritized delivery plan. 

Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers - owning hiring, performance management, and career development, and building a strong bench of technical leaders. 

Drive the architecture and design of high-scale, low-latency, highly available distributed systems, making sound technical and build-vs-adopt decisions. 

Build Generative AI (GenAI) solutions and conversational assistants that simplify complex, multi-step seller workflows into guided experiences. 

Own operational excellence - availability, latency, and correctness - for services with direct seller and business impact; strengthen on-call, reduce operational load, and drive issues to root-cause resolution. 

Manage region-specific complexity across diverse international marketplaces, including local compliance, tax, and capacity requirements. 

Partner across Product, Applied Science, Operations, Compliance, and worldwide (WW) FBA teams to align on shared roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and deliver end to end. 

Represent your area in leadership, business, and operational reviews; communicate crisply in writing (narrative style) and in person to both technical and business audiences. 

Set and uphold a high bar for engineering quality, security, and best practices across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 

A day in the life

You start the morning by scanning your team's operational dashboards and any overnight on-call activity - checking the health of the seller-facing systems you own and making sure nothing is blocking sellers from getting inventory into Amazon. You join your team's daily standup, unblock engineers, and dive into a design review for a new Generative AI (GenAI) conversational assistant feature that will help sellers manage their inventory. 

Midday, you meet with your Product and Applied Science partners to align on the quarterly roadmap and prioritize the next set of deliverables - balancing near-term seller impact against longer-term bets like the Europe FBA transformation. You spend focused time writing or reviewing a technical narrative, and you have a career-development one-on-one with one of your engineers. 

In the afternoon, you make a key architecture decision on a high-scale service, review a peer's design document, and represent your area in a business review with leadership. You close the day by clearing code reviews, responding to your team, and jotting down priorities for tomorrow. Throughout, you're operating as both a builder and a leader - setting technical direction, growing your people, and delivering measurable impact for sellers across International FBA's marketplaces. 

About The Team

International FBA builds the seller-facing software behind Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) across two strategic frontiers. In Emerging Markets - India, UAE, KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), Egypt, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Australia, and South Africa - we own the end-to-end seller journey, building region-specific architecture where local law and network economics demand it, and pioneering Generative AI (GenAI) assistants that make selling on Amazon radically simpler. 

In Europe, we're reinventing FBA itself: transforming a fragmented, country-by-country operation into a single, unified European supply chain (the "One EU" vision) - one shipment, one inventory pool, one set of controls - so sellers reach the whole continent effortlessly. 

We're a team of builders who care equally about seller experience and engineering excellence. We work across product, science, and operations, own our systems end to end, and take real ownership of outcomes that move Amazon's international business forward. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: QA Lead
data.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we're looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works. 

About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)

Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a "100, 000-year data gap" - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork's answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world's leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here. 

What you'll do

- Lead Workforce & Operations: Drive day-to-day workforce management for Clippers, Graders, Regraders, SMEs, and ICs across shifts/sites, optimizing staffing, capacity planning, and throughput against SLA targets. 
 - Implement Quality Systems & Methods: Maintain the QMS and apply structured methods (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, SPC) to address recurring defects, calibration drift, gold-sample injections, and consensus checks. 
 - Own SOPs & Process Standards: Build, version-control, and continuously iterate SOPs for existing and new program launches, ensuring floor adoption and structured QA onboarding/re-calibration paths. 
 - Bridge Cross-Functional Teams: Translate engineering data requirements into floor-executable QA criteria, report field issues back with evidence, and represent QA in program launches and crisis calls. 
 - Drive Data-Led Quality: Monitor and analyze key QA metrics-defect/reject rates, inter-grader agreement (kappa), gold-sample pass rates, yield, and escalation volume-to root out quality degradation with data. 

What we're looking for

- Distributed QA/QC Leadership: Proven experience managing large or dispersed grading/QA teams across multiple shifts or sites. 
 - Quality Methods Depth: Strong working command and practical application of RCA, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, SPC, and QMS frameworks. 
 - Analytical & Data-Driven Mindset: Proven track record of building and interpreting quality dashboards, interrogating metrics, and quantifying operational trade-offs. 
 - Stakeholder & Communication Skills: Clear, structured communication skills across all levels-upward to leadership, cross-functionally with engineering, and directly to floor teams. 
 - Hands-on, High Ownership: A proactive problem-solver who thrives on the floor building processes and tackling operational challenges directly, rather than just administering them. 

What success looks like

- QA metrics (defect rates, inter-grader agreement/kappa, gold-sample pass rates) show clear, measurable improvement across all programs. 
 - Quality issues and calibration drifts are caught early, analyzed via structured methods (RCA/CAPA/8D), and systematically resolved. 
 - SOPs are systematically updated, version-controlled, and seamlessly adopted on the floor with full operational alignment. 
 - Engineering requirements are accurately translated into actionable floor criteria, enabling smooth program launches and rapid feedback loops. 
 - Grading and QA operations scale smoothly across teams, shifts, and locations with balanced staffing and clear role execution. 

Our Values

- Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don't shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback. 
 - Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it's OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct! 
 - Always Be Learning We're a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry. 
 - Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description. 

About Instawork

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation's leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies-and we're just getting started!

Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we're doing it at scale. 

Join our team to help us build something that matters! We're looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York and Phoenix, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. 

Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www. instawork. com/about.

data.description:

You will be part of the Consumer Experience Engineering organisation responsible for building fast, intuitive, accessible and premium digital experiences across web and mobile. The organisation owns the web & mobile platforms, engineering delivery for consumer-facing journeys, shared design systems, performance, accessibility and AI-native engineering practices that help product teams deliver consistent, reusable, high-quality consumer experiences across the globe.

- Lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of large-scale consumer-facing mobile applications.

 - Partner with Product, Design, Architecture, Quality Engineering, and Platform teams to deliver optimized consumer journeys. 
 - Establish engineering patterns for state management, API integration, offline capabilities, caching, and error handling. 
 - Drive mobile performance engineering across application startup, rendering, network utilization, memory, and responsiveness. 
 - Lead integration of mobile applications with commerce platforms, APIs, content platforms, analytics, and third-party services. 
 - Ensure mobile experiences meet WCAG accessibility standards and inclusive design principles. 
 - Partner with design teams to develop reusable components and evolve mobile design systems. 

Support experimentation, feature flagging, A/B testing, and data-driven optimization of consumer journeys. 

YOUR TALENT: 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with significant expertise in mobile application development. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading a technical capability, project or engineering team. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in React Native and modern TypeScript/JavaScript development. 
 - Deep understanding of iOS and Android fundamentals, platform capabilities, and mobile application lifecycles. 
 - Strong experience with mobile build, signing, release, distribution, and application store processes. 
 - Proven expertise in frontend and mobile system design, application architecture, and engineering patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of state management, API integration, caching, offline-first, and synchronization patterns. 
 - Experience integrating native iOS and Android modules into React Native applications. 
 - Proven experience in optimizing startup time, rendering, memory utilization, network efficiency, and application responsiveness. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile asset delivery, caching, network efficiency and content delivery considerations. 
 - Understanding of consumer journeys, conversion optimization, personalization, and digital experience quality. 
 - Practical knowledge of WCAG standards, mobile accessibility, and inclusive experience engineering. 
 - Experience with experimentation platforms, feature flags and A/B testing. 
 - Strong understanding of design systems, reusable component libraries, and mobile UX engineering principles. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Proven ability to drive architectural decisions, influence technical direction and mentor engineers. 
 - Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity. 
 - Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is strongly preferred. 

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination. 

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play. 

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22, 000 employees worldwide.

Engineer III, Software Test At Thermo Fisher, our mission is to cure cancer with genomic data. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional setting where we believe none of us is as smart as all of us and we each have something valuable to contribute toward our goal. The software services team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the design, development, and deployment of world-class software products. We are looking to hire individuals with experience with software development and test engineering in clinical and research settings, and who can help us solve the next wave of technical challenges using the latest cloud-based, big-data, and rich analytics toolsets. We are seeking enthusiastic Leader in Software Verification and Validation who will define scope, design, for automated and manual tests for highly advanced bioinformatics software. We require strong coding skills as well as a solid understanding of Quality Assurance principles and Continuous Integration methods. You will drive writing positive and negative smoke and regression test scripts to test product functionality and integration with dependencies. You will drive strategies for test APIs, user interfaces, web services, and/or web apps and write performance, load, and stress tests. You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet and exceed customer expectations and continuously drive towards quality improvements. You like the idea of partnering with users and other team members to brainstorm the best possible approaches to validating systems. You welcome the challenge of working in a fast-paced, discovery-oriented environment and will be genuinely excited about the prospect of creatively exercising your problem-solving skills continuously to ultimately improve the human condition. Essential Functions: 

- Develop and implement software testing Strategy, Methods and Best Practices that allow high quality NGS analytics and instruments software products to be designed, developed, and released into the regulated in-vitro diagnostics/ medical device space. 
 - Effectively work on established software quality standards and KPI metrics to actively help measuring software and bioinformatics product quality. 
 - Work with Leads to implement software quality tracking tools and methodologies to provide on-going visibility and action during software product development lifecycle. 
 - Effectively work with Leads while working with external partners to deliver state of the art Software products in market. 
 - Partner with software and bioinformatics leadership, functional and project managers to identify appropriate scope of software testing, verification and validation required for a project and managing the overall testing activities for projects. 
 - Partner with internal and external stakeholders to drive the requirements for regulated assays and software. Help software development team to understand the complex informatics and visualization requirements leading into design implementation Minimum Qualifications (must have): 
 - Masters/PhD preferred or Bachelors with minimum 4-6 years of work experience and strong track record of industry productivity
 - 04+ experience performing software verification and validation testing, preferably in the medical device/ biotech space
 - Strong understanding of NGS-based regulated software, IVD assay development practices and informatics data analysis pipelines. 
 - Practical experience as a leader in the use of modern software development methodologies/ processes with an ability to direct the use of resources to meet department goals
 - Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e. g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e. g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820). 
 - Ability to work well with senior leadership.

As a Lead Full Stack Developer, the candidate will be responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of a scalable and high-performance application. About you: 

We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements: 

Assignment, Context, Job Main Challenges & Key Expectations: 

- Learning Curve: The candidate is expected to quickly acquire deep knowledge of the application's technical and business context.

Job Scope: 

- Analyze user stories and oversee the translation of functional requirements into technical tasks. 
 - Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable architecture solutions. 
 - Optimize database schema design, queries, and application performance. 
 - Ensure robust documentation, comprehensive unit testing, and effective resolution of issues. 
 - Act as a mentor and guide to the development team, ensuring adherence to coding standards and promoting a culture of technical excellence. 

Responsibilities:

 - Implement user stories with clean, maintainable, and secure code. 
 - Design scalable and reliable architecture while ensuring adherence to security and performance benchmarks. 
 - Utilize tools such as SonarQube and Snyk to identify and resolve code vulnerabilities, technical debt, and code smells. 
 - Conduct and oversee thorough code reviews to maintain quality and enforce secure coding practices. 
 - Integrate DevSecOps practices into the CI/CD pipeline, including automated security scanning using SonarQube (SAST) and Snyk (dependency/container vulnerability checks), secrets management, DAST, and compliance-as-code, ensuring security is a shared responsibility across the development lifecycle.

 - Ensure responsible use of AI tools in line with company AI policy: review all AI-generated code before merge and never share confidential or client data in prompts.

 - Design and write comprehensive unit test cases to ensure high reliability and code coverage. 
 - Debug and resolve complex issues identified in QA, UAT, pre-production, and production environments.

 - Mentor team members, facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions, and foster team development. 
 - Stay updated on emerging technologies and propose their adoption when relevant. 
 - Lead strategies for code cleanup, performance optimization, and process improvements.

 - Track and manage technical debt as a prioritized backlog item, agreed with the Product Owner.

Success Measures (KPIs):

Your career with us

Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, Graduate Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development.

Description

Invent the future with us.

About The Role

As a core member of the Ampere Debug Tools team, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, and development of Debug Tools solutions for the next generation of Ampere products. This role is distinguished by deep technical ownership, architecture leadership, and cross-team influence. 

The Debug Tools Team is part of the Ampere Software Team. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive debug strategy and roadmap for internal debug capabilities, as well as to develop and deploy debug solutions for all internal and external Ampere SoC users. 

- Internal users include Debug Tools software users from the Virtual Platform, Emulation, Platform, Design Validation (DV), Post-Silicon Validation, Design For Test (DFT), Firmware, Operating System, Software, Performance, and Application Engineering teams. 
 - External users include partners, ODMs, OEMs, datacenter, edge and embedded customers. 
 - Debug solutions include Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, and OpenOCD debuggers, Arm Self-Hosted Trace for Linux, and utilities for invasive debug, bus trace, instruction trace, array dump, and scan dump. This role will be for the lead of the Arm Development Studio implementation. 

What You'll Achieve

- Architect, design, develop, and deploy software-based Debug Tools for custom 64-bit Armv9 SoC and other processors. 
 - Invent new debug tools and techniques for future products and technologies. 
 - Influence the architecture and design team decisions with knowledge of internal and external debug tools on Ampere SoCs. 
 - Contribute to software architecture and design documents, application notes, and other software product documentation. 
 - Develop tooling for advanced debugging techniques, such as instruction trace, bus trace, array dump, scan dump, and ATE bootstrapping. 
 - Develop open source JTAG and self-hosted trace and debugger software for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Develop Arm Development Studio, TRACE32, and OpenOCD utilities for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Perform pre-silicon bring-up of debug software on software simulators and hardware emulation platforms. 
 - Collaborate with hardware design, architecture, post-silicon validation, and platform AE teams, as necessary, to resolve critical customer issues. 

About You

 - Proficiency in C/C++, Python, and Bash programming. 
 - Experience using Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, OpenOCD, and GDB debuggers. 
 - Experience with instruction trace, bus trace, scan dumps, array dumps, and crash capture. 
 - Experience with version control tools such as git, and software best practices. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and testing methodology skills. 
 - Proven ability to own problems and drive them to a resolution.

 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

DR

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Site Engineer, Test Capability
data.description:
Job Description

- This role is a Site Engineering position within Nokia's Product Validation & Test (PV&T) R&D organization, where you will operate as a full member of the PV&T engineering team. Your primary purpose is to serve as PV&T's direct presence and working arm at manufacturing sites, focusing on Test Station Development (TSD). You will be actively involved on the factory floor, responsible for the setup, debugging, and continuous improvement of test stations. A key aspect of the role is driving the implementation of R&D-developed hardware, software, fixture, and procedural changes directly into manufacturing operations. This is distinctly an R&D engineering role situated within the production environment, not a CM test technician, supply chain, operations, or pure program management function. The position specifically covers TSD for either coherent pluggable and/or TROSA stations, requiring deep expertise in at least one of these station families. 

NILightpath

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Design, bring up, debug, and improve optical test stations for performance, reliability, and production readiness in PV&T manufacturing. 
 - Work on-site with manufacturing and Contract Manufacturer (CM) teams to integrate stations into the factory test flow, including fixtures, instruments, automation, and measurement procedures. 
 - Analyze station data and provide feedback for station design, test protocols, and Test Station Development (TSD)/R&D. 
 - Manage the transition of R&D changes to factory reality, including software/firmware/fixture updates, procedure changes, and confirmation of line capability. 
 - Develop and maintain test protocols to ensure accurate and repeatable results, proactively addressing compliance, safety, and measurement-integrity issues. 
 - Represent PV&T at the manufacturing site, mentoring others and ensuring visibility and resolution of station-related issues. 

Key Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's or master's in engineering, Physics, or a related field (equivalent industry experience considered). 
 - Typically, 3+ years developing test stations or automated test equipment (ATE) in optical and/or electrical test. 
 - Working knowledge of optical measurement principles and how test hardware/software produces results. 
 - Comfort working in a manufacturing environment and willingness to travel regularly to Nokia/CM sites in Thailand and Malaysia. 
 - Ability to work effectively across hardware, software, and manufacturing teams to resolve issues. 
 - Coherent pluggable / PIC test-station or ATE development, OR TROSA / photonic-assembly test-station or ATE development. 
 - Electrical design, simulation, or schematic/layout support for test hardware; fixture, thermal, or PCB work, including RF and low-frequency analog/digital signals. 
 - Source control and software-driven test infrastructure (e. g. , Git, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket), with Continuous Integration (CI) for hardware test being a plus. 
 - Production data analysis, Statistical Process Control (SPC), or yield/debug of station-limited failures. 
 - Mentoring junior engineers or leading a station bring-up across multiple teams. 

About Us

Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we're advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

About Bozzo Cabs

Bozzo Cabs is an early-stage mobility and ride-hailing startup building a platform that connects customers with driver partners through Bike, Auto, Car and SUV ride services.

Role Overview

As the Founding CTO, you will be responsible for leading the complete technology function, including architecture, application development, backend systems, integrations, infrastructure, security and technical operations. 

We are looking for someone who is hands-on and capable of independently understanding, building, improving and maintaining the platform. 

This is a founding-team opportunity for someone who wants to take ownership and grow with an early-stage startup.

 - Manage Firebase, APIs, cloud infrastructure and server architecture. 
 - Integrate and maintain Google Maps, payment gateways, OTP, SMS, notifications and other third-party services. 
 - Develop and improve ride booking, driver matching, tracking, pricing and payment systems. 
 - Implement security, data protection, monitoring and backup systems. 
 - Manage source code, repositories, deployment and technical documentation. 
 - Establish development standards, testing procedures and release management. 
 - Build and lead the future engineering team as the company grows. 
 - Work closely with the Founder & CEO on product strategy and technical decisions. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong experience in mobile application development (Android/iOS).

 - Firebase / Firestore or equivalent backend technologies. 
 - Database design and management. 
 - Cloud infrastructure and server management. 
 - REST API integration and development. 
 - Google Maps API and location-based services. 
 - Payment gateway integrations. 
 - Real-time tracking and notification systems. 
 - Application security, performance optimisation and debugging.

Preferred Experience

- Previous experience building ride-hailing, mobility, logistics, delivery or marketplace platforms. 
 - Experience with driver and customer applications. 
 - Experience managing production applications. 
 - Experience scaling applications and backend infrastructure. 
 - Previous startup or founding-team experience. 

Who We Are Looking For

- A hands-on technical leader, not just a project manager. 
 - Someone who can take ownership of technology decisions. 
 - A problem-solver who can work independently in an early-stage environment. 
 - Someone comfortable working with limited initial resources. 
 - Strong communication and leadership skills. 
 - Long-term commitment to building a startup. 
 - Willingness to work closely with the Founder & CEO. 

Compensation & Founding Opportunity

Bozzo Cabs is currently an early-stage, bootstrapped startup. This position is structured as a founding-team opportunity with equity participation and revenue sharing, rather than a conventional fixed-salary position at the initial stage. 

Equity participation will be discussed based on experience, contribution, responsibilities and long-term commitment. Revenue-sharing arrangements will be mutually discussed and agreed upon.

Opportunity to join an early-stage mobility startup as a founding CTO.

- Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable AWS infrastructure supporting enterprise contact-center solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, ensuring infrastructure is repeatable, version controlled, and consistent across development, test, and production environments. 
 - Provision and configure AWS services supporting contact-center workloads, including Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, S3, VPC, subnets, and security groups.

 - Use Git and GitHub pull-request workflows for source control, peer review, automated validation, approvals, and controlled integration of infrastructure changes.

 - Create and maintain infrastructure documentation, implementation plans, validation steps, rollback procedures, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks. 
 - Monitor cloud-resource utilisation and cost indicators and contribute to AWS cost-optimisation activities. 
 - Coordinate and collaborate with team members and stakeholders with limited supervision across multiple workstreams. 

What You Bring

- 6+ years of professional experience of hands-on DevOps, AWS cloud engineering, platform engineering, or infrastructure automation experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud architecture, particularly IAM, Lambda, KMS, CloudWatch, S3, VPC, subnets, security groups, and API integrations. 
 - Strong Terraform knowledge, including modules, resources and data sources, variables, locals, providers, remote state, environment-specific configuration, plan/apply workflows, imports, and troubleshooting. 
 - Practical experience developing and supporting CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or a comparable enterprise automation platform. 
 - Strong Git and GitHub skills, including branching, pull requests, peer review, merge controls, and release practices. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix, Bash or Shell scripting, Python, JSON, YAML, and REST/API troubleshooting. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS security and DevSecOps practices, including least-privilege IAM, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, dependency scanning, and secure configuration. 
 - Working knowledge of networking fundamentals including DNS, routing, firewalls, TLS certificates, load balancing, private connectivity, and network troubleshooting. 
 - Experience monitoring, logging, alerting, incident investigation, defect management, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum, change management, release governance, and Jira-based delivery. 
 - BE / B. Tech / MCA / M. Tech, or an equivalent degree or relevant practical experience. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate business and operational needs into secure technical solutions and explain technical decisions to varied stakeholders. 
 - Adaptable, team-oriented, and results-driven, with strong ownership, prioritisation, and time-management skills. 

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer – Performance & Reliability
data.description:
About Axiado Corporation

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we're a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we're extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. 

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We're small enough that every person's work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company's future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let's talk. 

Job Description

Axiado is a top-tier manufacturer of TCU (Trusted Control/Compute Unit) solutions. We are hiring a Senior QA Engineer - Performance & Reliability to lead the performance characterization and reliability validation of our Secure TCU System, ensuring it meets rigorous data center standards. 

In this role, you will own the test design, execution, and deep-dive analysis for performance and reliability, working closely with development teams to identify bottlenecks and resolve complex system-level issues. 

Key Responsibilities

Performance & Reliability Strategy

- Test Design & Execution: Design and execute comprehensive test plans for performance benchmarking, stress testing, longevity/endurance testing, and thermal/power characterization of TCU/BMC systems. 
 - Workload Analysis: Analyze system behavior under various heavy workloads to identify performance bottlenecks in throughput, latency, and resource utilization (CPU, Memory, PCIe). 
 - Reliability Validation: Conduct Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) prediction, long-duration stability tests, and error injection campaigns to validate system robustness. 

Deep Dive & Issue Resolution

- Root Cause Analysis: Lead the deep-dive investigation of performance degradation and reliability failures. Use advanced debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, firmware traces) to isolate issues. 
 - Developer Collaboration: Work directly with firmware and hardware engineers to reproduce complex bugs, analyze crash dumps, and verify fixes. 
 - Infrastructure Enhancement: Develop and maintain automated performance testing frameworks and reporting dashboards to track regression and trends over time. 

Reporting & Leadership

- Reporting: Generate detailed performance assessment reports and reliability analysis metrics for stakeholders. 
 - Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers on performance testing methodologies and system debugging techniques. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in embedded system testing, with a strong focus on performance verification and reliability engineering. 
 - System Knowledge: Deep understanding of TCU, BMC, HMC, RoT (Root of Trust), Secure Boot, TPM, HSM, PCIe (Gen4/5), DDR memory, and networking protocols. 
 - Performance Tools: Proficiency with performance profiling tools, traffic generators, and standard benchmarks (e. g. , SPEC, IOzone, iperf). Experience with thermal and power measurement tools. 
 - Programming: Strong scripting skills in Python for test automation and data analysis; familiarity with C/C++ for code analysis is a plus. 
 - Operating Systems: Strong Linux/Unix skills, including kernel tuning, system monitoring, and log analysis. 
 - Tools: Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) and version control (Git). 
 - Education: BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

Ways to Stand Out

- Experience with AI-driven log analysis or anomaly detection tools to predict reliability issues. 
 - Background in validation of high-speed interfaces (PCIe, CXL) and memory subsystems (DDR5/LPDDR5). 
 - Experience with data center server architecture and thermal management. 
 - Knowledge of industry reliability standards (e. g. , Telcordia, JEDEC). 

Note: We do not expect candidates to meet every single requirement. A strong core of these skills with a problem-solving mindset is what we value most. 

Additional Information

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. 

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are. 

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

General Summary

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

We are looking for a Staff / Senior Staff CPU Tools, Platform & QA Engineer to drive the quality, validation, automation, and scalability of CPU engineering infrastructure across the complete product lifecycle - from testbench and emulation platforms through firmware and silicon. 

The role will have broad technical ownership across CPU tools, PnP (Power & Performance), telemetry, regression infrastructure, firmware, and platform QA (BareMetal and OS based Frameworks test execution etc. )

This is a senior technical leadership role requiring strong CPU fundamentals, software/firmware expertise, validation and automation experience, and the ability to debug complex issues spanning CPU hardware, tools, firmware, emulation, and silicon. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive end-to-end QA and validation strategy for CPU tools and platforms across: 
 - Pre-silicon testbenches
 - Emulation platforms
 - Firmware / bare-metal environments
 - Silicon platforms
 - Post-silicon labs

- Own quality and validation of CPU infrastructure including: 
 - CPU firmware and low-level software
 - Platform testbenches
 - PnP infrastructure
 - Telemetry and data-collection frameworks
 - Regression and automation infrastructure

- Drive Power & Performance (PnP) framework validation, including automated execution, data collection, analysis, regression detection, and correlation across platforms. 
 - Develop and maintain telemetry regression frameworks to track CPU performance, power, functional, and system-level metrics across builds, platforms, and silicon generations. 
 - Establish automated nightly/weekly regression pipelines, including: 
 - Test execution
 - Telemetry collection
 - Golden-data comparison
 - Performance/power deviation analysis
 - Regression detection
 - Failure triage
 - Dashboards and reporting

- Build mechanisms to correlate emulation, testbench, and silicon results, enabling early identification of potential silicon issues. 
 - Define quality gates and release criteria for CPU tools, firmware, PnP infrastructure, telemetry, and platform releases. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis of failures spanning CPU architecture, firmware, tools, test infrastructure, emulation, and silicon. 
 - Identify systemic gaps in test coverage, telemetry, automation, and regression infrastructure and drive solutions across engineering organizations. 
 - Develop scalable frameworks that transition CPU validation from manual execution to automated, data-driven QA. 
 - Partner closely with CPU architecture, design, firmware, CAD, validation, performance, power, emulation, and post-silicon teams. 
 - Lead technical initiatives across multiple CPU programs and generations. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical direction to distributed engineering teams. 

PnP & Telemetry Responsibilities

- Define methodology for CPU power and performance characterization and regression. 
 - Build automated pipelines for collecting and analyzing: 
 - CPU performance metrics
 - Frequency / Fmax behavior
 - Power metrics
 - Performance counters / telemetry
 - Workload-level KPIs
 - Platform health metrics

- Establish golden baselines and deviation thresholds for automated regression detection. 
 - Develop correlation between pre-silicon models, emulation, and silicon telemetry. 
 - Detect performance/power regressions early and drive cross-functional debug to root cause. 
 - Build dashboards providing clear visibility into CPU quality, performance, power, and platform health. 
 - Enable scalable telemetry analysis across large regression datasets and multiple CPU programs. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - 10+ years of relevant engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership at Staff/Senior Staff level. 
 - Strong understanding of CPU architecture, system architecture, and low-level software. 
 - Experience in CPU validation, post-silicon, emulation, firmware, performance, power, or system-level engineering. 
 - Strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python. 
 - Experience developing automation, regression, CI/CD, telemetry, and QA frameworks. 
 - Strong debugging skills across hardware/software boundaries. 
 - Experience analyzing large datasets and identifying performance, power, functional, or telemetry regressions. 
 - Ability to lead complex cross-functional debug and drive issues to closure. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with ARM / ARM64 CPU architecture and ISA. 
 - Experience with CPU Power & Performance (PnP) validation. 
 - Experience with CPU performance counters, telemetry, profiling, and workload characterization. 
 - Experience with Veloce, Palladium, or equivalent emulation platforms. 
 - Experience with CPU firmware, bare-metal environments, Linux, and low-level debugging. 
 - Experience with post-silicon CPU validation and silicon debug. 
 - Experience developing large-scale regression infrastructure and data analytics. 
 - Experience establishing golden-data based regression and automated quality dashboards. 
 - Experience across multiple CPU generations or complex SoC programs. 

Staff / Senior Staff Leadership Expectations

At This Level, The Engineer Is Expected To

- Drive technical strategy and architecture, not just execute individual projects. 
 - Own quality across the Tools → Firmware → Testbench → Emulation → PnP/Telemetry → Silicon ecosystem. 
 - Identify systemic problems and develop solutions that scale across CPU programs. 
 - Influence architecture, infrastructure, and validation methodologies. 
 - Lead complex cross-functional technical investigations. 
 - Establish engineering standards for automation, regression, telemetry, and quality. 
 - Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization.

CPU Tools | Firmware | Testbenches | Emulation | Silicon | PnP | Telemetry | Regression | QA | Automation

data.title: Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways
data.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. 

The Mission

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native SaaS platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a multi-tenant control plane, automation, and platform services that enable customers to securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. 

At its core, building and operating this platform is a large-scale software engineering challenge, involving complex distributed systems, automation, and infrastructure orchestration. The platform must deliver 4-9s (99. 99%+) reliability while operating across multiple clouds, regions, and highly distributed customer environments. Achieving this requires deep software engineering expertise and strong distributed systems fundamentals, with a focus on scalability, resilience, performance, and multi-tenancy. 

As an engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Platform, you will take full ownership of the engineering charter, leading and growing the team while being accountable for the architecture, development, delivery, and operation of this multi-tenant SaaS platform. With Cloud Gateways growing 100% YoY and becoming increasingly central to Kong's API and AI strategy, your work will directly influence product innovation, customer experience, platform economics, and our ability to serve some of the world's largest enterprises at global scale. 

This is a highly technical Software Engineering leadership role building the software platform behind a globally distributed, multi-cloud SaaS infrastructure product, with end-to-end ownership of everything from code to production infrastructure. It sits at the intersection of hardcore software engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale infrastructure ownership. We believe in a you-build-it-you-run-it model, where engineering teams take 100% ownership of the systems they build, from architecture and implementation through deployment, reliability, and production operations. You're expected to stay close to the code and architecture, lead complex engineering challenges alongside your team, and take complete accountability for engineering outcomes. 

What You'll Do

- Own the Managed Gateways Platform engineering charter end-to-end, providing technical direction, building and growing a high-performing team, raising the engineering bar, and taking full accountability for execution and outcomes. 
 - Lead the design and development of core SaaS platform capabilities, including provisioning systems, fleet management, automation frameworks, platform services, and software lifecycle management. 
 - Architect and build highly scalable distributed systems powering a multi-tenant SaaS platform across regions and clouds, driving sound architectural decisions around isolation, scalability, fault tolerance, and blast-radius management. 
 - Drive 100% ownership across the software lifecycle, from design and development through deployment, observability, reliability, and production operations. Establish a strong you-build-it-you-run-it culture where engineering teams are fully accountable for what they build and operate. 
 - Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of the platform and its underlying infrastructure, driving 99. 99%+ availability across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP), with a focus on resilience, capacity management, and infrastructure efficiency. 
 - Stay hands-on in critical engineering challenges, contributing to architecture reviews, complex implementations, production debugging, and high-stakes technical decisions. 
 - Drive platform automation and operational excellence, building self-service capabilities and tooling while strengthening SLOs/SLIs, incident response, root cause analysis, zero-downtime upgrades, and engineering efficiency. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product, engineering, and support teams to shape the platform roadmap, influence product capabilities, and ensure engineering investments translate into customer and business outcomes. 

What You'll Bring

The Toolkit

- Proven experience leading software engineering teams building and operating large-scale software platforms in high-growth environments, with a strong track record of technical leadership and hands-on involvement. 
 - Deep expertise in designing, developing, and operating highly available distributed systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Comfortable writing and debugging code, troubleshooting production systems, and making architectural decisions. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production. 
 - Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for building scalable platform services and distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar. 
 - Experience managing critical production incidents, performing root cause analysis, and implementing preventative measures. 
 - Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus. 

The DNA

- Ownership: You take 100% responsibility for the systems, teams, and outcomes you own, driving initiatives from conception to completion without waiting for someone else to connect the dots. 
 - Urgency: You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision. 
 - Collaboration: You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals. 

Bonus Points

- Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities. 
 - Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e. g. , CKA, CKAD). 
 - Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management. 

About Kong

Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www. konghq. com.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically competent professional with 5-6 years of experience in the electrical switchgear industry to join our Quality & Testing team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in testing, inspection, and quality assurance of Low Voltage (LV) and Medium Voltage (MV) switchboards, along with a strong understanding of applicable IEC standards and customer inspection requirements. 

The role involves conducting electrical tests, ensuring product compliance, coordinating customer and third-party inspections, preparing and closing inspection reports, and driving quality improvements throughout the manufacturing process. The candidate should be capable of independently managing Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), resolving technical and quality concerns, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure product reliability and customer satisfaction. 

A sound technical understanding of LV/MV switchgear products, electrical protection systems, busbar assemblies, control circuits, and relevant IEC standards is essential.  - Insulation Resistance (IR) Test

 - Functional & Interlock Verification 
 - Protection Relay Testing 
 - Primary & Secondary Injection Tests

 - Lead customer inspections, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), and third-party inspections. 
 - Interface confidently with customers, consultants, and inspection agencies during inspections.

 - ACBs, MCCBs, MCBs

 - CTs, PTs, Metering Devices 
 - Busbar Systems 
 - Working knowledge of applicable IEC standards, including:

data.title: Senior Product Validation Engineer
data.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today's needs and tomorrow's next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape. 

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. 

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

About the position: 

As a Senior Product Validation Engineer, you will be part of firmware verification team that design and develop white box and grey box tests in Python to verify device firmware designs for each firmware/Product/System feature. You will be working closely with product/System architects and firmware engineers to create a comprehensive system verification test for features. In this role, you will be contributing to test strategy, test development, integrating the tests using various development platforms, deploying it on system verification lab for regression runs and perform failure analysis. The role focuses on defining and executing robust firmware/Device/system verification strategies for UCIe/AXI and custom host-device protocols across both pre‐silicon and post‐silicon environments. 

Responsibilities

- Collaborate closely with firmware engineers & architects on product architecture and designs to define the comprehensive verification plan to validate each product features
 - Design, Develop and Integrate the white box and gray box tests on products in roadmap
 - Conduct test plan reviews and code reviews to ensure the tests are scalable and meeting the requirements
 - Participate in driving failure analysis and collaborate with integration/execution engineers for test deployment. 
 - Validate designs against UCIe Specification ensuring compliance with electrical, logical, and transaction-layer requirements. 
 - Define and own firmware/System validation strategy for UCIe front-end subsystems, including resets, interrupts, Logging and error handling. 
 - Define, plan, and execute system-level validation strategies for front-end (PHY + controller) IP, back end(Controller +NAND) IP and SoC-level integration. 
 - Integrate tests into scalable automation frameworks supporting simulation, emulation, and silicon validation. 
 - Debug firmware issues, perform front-end error injection, and expose design or integration defects. 
 - Validate UCIe compliance, robustness of fault detection and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Review and verify firmware trace logs and debug telemetry for correctness and completeness. 
 - Drive validation readiness across pre‐silicon and post‐silicon platforms, ensuring alignment of firmware specs, drivers, and test collateral. 
 - Interface with cross‐functional stakeholders to ensure validation coverage meets product and customer requirements. 
 - Drive compliance and interoperability testing with various endpoints 
 - Proven expertise in defining and driving end-to-end validation strategies across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon platforms for complex SoCs and storage systems. 
 - Strong experience validating hardware IPs in pre-silicon environments (RTL simulation, SystemC/VDK, emulation, FPGA prototyping) and post-silicon environments. 
 - Possess deep understanding of Host SoC integration, firmware-hardware interactions, subsystem interoperability, and system-level debug across the complete product stack. 
 - Proficiency in high-performance/AI compute architectures, accelerator data paths, workload scheduling, and system-level performance validation

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Skills: 

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech degree in CSE/ ECE/ EEE/ IS or related field
 - In-depth knowledge of UCIe/AXI, flow control, ordering rules, error handling, power management
 - Proficiency with protocol analyzers/exercisers (Teledyne LeCroy, Keysight) etc. 
 - Experience with high‐performance storage, networking, or compute SoCs. 
 - Strong expertise in UCIe protocol, DMA, and ASIC front-end architecture. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python/C/C++ based scripting API's. 
 - Hands-on experience with error injection, fault modeling, and silicon debug tools. 
 - Familiarity with pre‐silicon (simulation/emulation) and post‐silicon lab validation flows. 
 - Solid understanding of firmware-hardware interaction and system-level debugging. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in test strategy definition, technical reviews, and mentoring. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to drive issues to closure under schedule pressure. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and influence technical decisions. 
 - Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, C/C++, or Bash. 
 - Minimum 6 - 8 years of related experience in firmware verification or system level testing
 - Knowledge on Git, CI & source code management flow and agile development practices. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis. 
 - Collaborative and proactive communication style. 
 - Attention to detail and quality assurance mindset. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team. 

Additional Information

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution. 

Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs. accommodations@sandisk. com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.
