data.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test — C#.NET Distributed Systems
data.description:
Hyderabad, India | Hybrid - 3 days onsite

Role Overview

Nasuni is expanding the DryvIQ engineering team in Hyderabad. DryvIQ brings intelligent content discovery, classification, sensitivity detection, and policy-driven governance to enterprise unstructured data across cloud and on-premises repositories. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Test (SDET) to strengthen and scale automated quality across DryvIQ's complex, Kubernetes-based distributed application environment. 

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with a primary focus on C#/. NET test automation. You will maintain, extend, and improve existing automation frameworks, build high-value automated coverage, strengthen test infrastructure, and help automation scale as the DryvIQ platform evolves. You do not need to have built an automation framework from scratch; what matters is demonstrated depth improving and scaling automation in a complex software environment. 

You'll work across APIs, integrations, distributed and asynchronous workflows, containerized deployments, and user-facing functionality. Python and PyTest experience is valuable as we expand reusable tooling and cross-team libraries, but C#/. NET is the primary technical stack for this role. 

This role is for an engineer who approaches quality as a software-engineering problem, applying strong coding, debugging, systems thinking, and test-design judgment rather than focusing only on test execution. 

What You'll Do

- Maintain, extend, and scale existing C#/. NET-based test automation frameworks supporting DryvIQ. 
 - Design and implement reliable automated validation across API, integration, system, UI, regression, and end-to-end testing layers. 
 - Improve framework architecture, reusable components, test utilities, test-data capabilities, diagnostics, reporting, and maintainability. 
 - Build automated testing for Kubernetes-based, containerized, distributed applications, including multi-service and asynchronous workflows. 
 - Identify automation gaps, product risks, flaky tests, and framework limitations and prioritize improvements based on engineering and release impact. 
 - Build automated validation for APIs, microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous jobs, cloud and on-premises repositories, connectors, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Validate installation, deployment, configuration, upgrade, recovery, and failure scenarios in containerized environments. 
 - Integrate automated validation into CI/CD pipelines and improve the speed and quality of release feedback. 
 - Diagnose complex failures using application logs, APIs, Kubernetes/container evidence, telemetry, exceptions, service behavior, and other system evidence. 
 - Partner with developers to improve testability and determine the appropriate balance of unit, API, integration, system, and end-to-end coverage. 
 - Create maintainable automation patterns and reusable libraries that can be adopted by developers and QA engineers. 
 - Contribute to Python/PyTest-based utilities, tooling, or shared libraries as cross-team automation capabilities evolve. 
 - Help QA teammates strengthen automation skills through pairing, code reviews, examples, and technical guidance. 
 - Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools where appropriate for test design, code generation, scenario discovery, debugging, and coverage analysis, while independently validating generated outputs. 
 - Develop appropriate testing and validation approaches for AI-assisted or non-deterministic functionality. 

Qualifications

Must-Have

- 6+ years of software engineering, SDET, test automation, or quality engineering experience with substantial hands-on automation development. 
 - Strong hands-on programming and test automation experience using C# and . NET. 
 - Demonstrated experience maintaining, extending, troubleshooting, and scaling an existing test automation framework. 
 - Experience improving framework reliability, maintainability, reusable components, utilities, test infrastructure, or execution efficiency. 
 - Strong hands-on experience testing Kubernetes-based, containerized, distributed applications. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, containers, distributed-system behavior, service dependencies, asynchronous processing, and failure modes. 
 - Experience building automated validation across APIs, integrations, systems, and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Experience testing microservices, asynchronous processing, or comparable distributed workflows. 
 - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Ability to diagnose complex failures using logs, APIs, application exceptions, Kubernetes/container evidence, telemetry, and system behavior. 
 - Strong judgment about what to automate, at which testing layer, and when manual or exploratory testing provides greater value. 
 - Strong collaboration skills working with software engineers, Product, DevOps, and QA peers. 

Preferred

- Hands-on experience with Python and PyTest, particularly for test utilities, reusable libraries, tooling, fixtures, or cross-team automation. 
 - Experience working in engineering environments where C#/. NET and Python-based automation coexist. 
 - Experience creating reusable automation components or shared libraries used across teams. 
 - Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable UI automation technologies. 
 - AWS and/or Azure experience. 
 - AKS, EKS, K3s, or comparable Kubernetes environments. 
 - Cloud and on-premises connectors and storage integrations. 
 - SMB/NFS, S3, Azure Blob, or comparable enterprise data technologies. 
 - Postgres, ClickHouse, Keycloak, OAuth/OIDC, or similar technologies. 
 - Performance, load, reliability, resilience, or failure-injection testing. 
 - Test-data and test-environment architecture. 
 - Practical use of AI-assisted software or test-engineering tools with disciplined validation of generated outputs. 

Ideal

- Significant experience improving automation for a complex product previously dependent on manual regression. 
 - Experience evolving an established automation framework as product scale, architecture, or engineering requirements changed. 
 - Strong experience testing distributed C#/. NET applications. 
 - Enterprise storage, content management, data governance, security, or data-infrastructure experience. 
 - Experience building reusable automation capabilities adopted across engineering or QA teams. 
 - Experience helping manual QA engineers become productive automation contributors. 
 - Experience testing large-scale distributed enterprise applications. 
 - Experience validating AI-enabled or non-deterministic functionality. 

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. 

As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform-turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration. 

Why Work at Nasuni - Hyderabad

With Vista Equity Partners' backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders, cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities-combining the pace of a growing product company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor. 

In this role, you'll help evolve and scale the automation foundation for an increasingly important enterprise product. You'll work at the intersection of cloud, Kubernetes, distributed systems, AI, content intelligence, data governance, and enterprise infrastructure while collaborating with DryvIQ and Nasuni engineering teams globally. 

Benefits At Nasuni Hyderabad

As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers competitive benefits designed to support every stage of your life and career: 

- Competitive compensation programs
 - Flexible time off and leave policies
 - Comprehensive health and wellness coverage
 - Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
 - Employee referral and recognition programs
 - Professional development and learning support
 - Inclusive, collaborative team culture
 - Modern office spaces with team events and perks
 - Retirement and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations

To all recruitment agencies: Nasuni does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job boards, Nasuni employees or any other company location. Nasuni is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment. 

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, "Nasuni") from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

data.description:
Job Description

Job Summary -

A Application Automation & Support Engineer to manage a critical project for one of our biggest clients in banking domain. The Individual should be passionate about technology, experienced in developing and managing cutting edge technology applications. 

Experience: 5-9Years

Working Hours: UK Business Hours (including on-call support when required)

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on engineer with strong software development skills who can help drive automation and continuous improvement across the Production Support function. The ideal candidate should be capable of developing tools, scripts, dashboards, and operational automations while also supporting business-critical applications during UK working hours. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop automation solutions to eliminate manual support activities and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Build and maintain scripts, tools, dashboards, and integrations using technologies such as Java, Python, or . NET.

data.title: Lead AI Engineer - Generative AI & Agentic AI Cogentiq
data.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Lead AI Engineer - Generative AI & Agentic AI to design, build and productionize enterprise-scale AI solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs and modern AI architecture. 

The ideal candidate will be comfortable taking AI solutions from experimentation to production, working across models, data, APIs, cloud infrastructure and enterprise applications, while providing technical leadership to engineering teams. 

What You'll Do

- Architect, build and productionize AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for complex enterprise use cases. 
 - Design and develop LLM-powered applications using RAG, AI agents, tool/function calling, orchestration and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Build scalable AI services and backend applications using Python, REST APIs and modern microservices architectures. 
 - Design end-to-end RAG architectures incorporating embeddings, vector search, retrieval, reranking and enterprise knowledge sources. 
 - Develop AI applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex or equivalent. 
 - Work with leading LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or equivalent. 
 - Design and implement practices around LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, security, latency and cost optimization. 
 - Build robust AI/ML pipelines covering experimentation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. 
 - Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, data platforms and cloud services. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks and technologies and translate them into practical enterprise solutions. 
 - Drive technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions across AI platforms and products. 
 - Establish engineering best practices for building secure, scalable and maintainable AI applications. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across AI engineering initiatives. 
 - Partner with product managers, data scientists, architects and business stakeholders to convert business problems into scalable AI solutions. 

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering or related technology roles. 
 - Strong hands-on development experience in Python, with excellent software engineering and system-design fundamentals. 
 - Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Generative AI and Large Language Models. 
 - Demonstrated experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM applications into production. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, LLM orchestration and AI agents. 
 - Experience designing agentic AI workflows, including tool/function calling and complex or multi-agent orchestration. 
 - Experience working with at least one major LLM ecosystem such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, databases and enterprise application architecture. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Experience with LLM evaluation, monitoring, observability, responsible AI and guardrails. 
 - Ability to independently own the technical architecture and implementation of complex AI solutions. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication and technical leadership skills. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and influencing engineering/architecture decisions. 

Good to Have

- Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic layers or GraphRAG. 
 - Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, CI/CD and AI observability platforms. 
 - Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Redis or equivalent. 
 - Experience with fine-tuning, model adaptation and open-source LLMs. 
 - Experience with AI security, governance, privacy and enterprise AI architecture. 
 - Hands-on exposure to PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience leading small engineering teams or mentoring senior engineers. 
 - Understanding of data engineering, streaming, distributed data processing and modern cloud data platforms. 

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related quantitative/technical discipline. 
 - Strong academic background, preferably from a premier engineering/technology institution with a demonstrated record of academic and technical excellence. 

What Will Make You Stand Out

We are particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate that they have personally architected and built production GenAI systems, rather than simply experimented with LLMs. 

Strong candidates will be able to discuss real-world experience around: 

- Production RAG and Agentic AI architectures
 - Building scalable Python/API-based AI services
 - LLM evaluation and observability
 - Enterprise data and application integration
 - Security and guardrails
 - Latency and inference-cost optimization
 - Taking an AI solution from prototype → production → scale

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

data.title: Lead Engineer - Ad Tech
data.description:
About Us

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400, 000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. 

Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. 

Overview About TII

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn't happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target's global team and has more than 4, 000 team members supporting the company's global strategy and operations. 

Team Overview

Roundel is Target's entry into the media business with an impact of $1B+; an advertising sell-side business built on the principles of first-party, people-based data, brand-safe content environments and proof that our marketing programs drive business results for our clients. 

We are here to drive business growth for our clients and redefine "value" in the industry by solving core industry challenges rather than simply replicating existing industry methods of operation. Roundel is a key growth initiative for Target and aims to lead the industry toward a better way of operating within the media marketplace. 

Target Tech is on a mission to offer the systems, tools and support that our clients, guests and team members need and deserve. We drive industry-leading technologies in support of every angle of the business and help ensure that Target operates smoothly, securely and reliably from the inside out. 

As part of this evolution, we are building intelligent platforms for retail media space like ad decisioning, bidding, ad explanations etc. that combine traditional software engineering with Large Language Models, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs and agentic architectures to solve complex business and engineering problems at scale. 

Role Overview

As a Lead Engineer (Ad Tech & Applied AI), you will provide technical leadership across backend platforms and emerging AI-powered capabilities. 

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to help define the technology strategy for Ad Tech platforms, including DSP, SSP and Ad Servers, supporting self-service advertising needs. You will assess build-versus-buy decisions for new capabilities through POCs and prototypes while considering long-term architecture, scalability, reliability and operational trade-offs. 

A key part of this role will be designing and building production-grade applications powered by Large Language Models and agentic systems from experimentation through production operation and continuous evaluation. We are looking for engineers who have moved beyond conversational AI prototypes and have experience engineering LLM-powered systems that operate reliably within real business workflows. 

You will design architectures that combine deterministic software components with probabilistic AI capabilities, making deliberate decisions about where traditional code, rules and workflow engines should be used versus where LLM-driven reasoning and autonomous agents provide value. 

You will lead engineering efforts to meet functional and non-functional requirements and assist teams in solving complex business challenges through scalable technical solutions. 

You will work closely with engineering managers to build high-performing engineering teams and provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, coaching and mentoring. You will also participate in the selection of technical talent and contribute actively to Target's broader technical community. 

About You

You have 8+ years of software development experience, with experience designing, building and operating complex distributed systems through at least one complete implementation lifecycle. 

You have strong backend engineering fundamentals and are comfortable designing scalable APIs, microservices, asynchronous systems and data-intensive applications. 

You are fluent in Java / Spring and microservices architecture, with experience building highly available production systems. 

You have experience working with databases including RDBMS and NoSQL technologies such as Cassandra and MongoDB, and understand data modeling and storage trade-offs. 

You have experience building distributed event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka. 

You understand Ad Tech business fundamentals and how technology supports business objectives, and can translate business vision into technical strategy while understanding architectural and financial trade-offs. 

Experience building or integrating DSP, SSP or Ad Server technology platforms in support of self-service advertising is preferred. 

Applied AI & LLM Engineering

You have hands-on experience designing, building and operating production applications using LLMs, beyond chat interfaces, prompt experimentation and proof-of-concept applications. 

You have designed and optimized production-grade RAG systems, with strong understanding of data ingestion and chunking, retrieval and ranking, context and grounding, hybrid retrieval, and evaluation. 

You have experience with knowledge graphs and graph-based retrieval, and understand when to use vector search, Graph RAG, structured queries, traditional search or hybrid approaches based on the problem and data. 

You understand the engineering trade-offs of production LLM systems, including quality, latency, cost, reliability, observability, security and failure handling, and can systematically improve retrieval and overall system performance rather than relying primarily on prompt engineering. 

Agentic Systems

You have designed or built agentic applications or orchestration frameworks where LLM-powered components interact with tools, APIs, retrieval systems and other agents to accomplish multi-step tasks. 

You Understand Concepts Such As

- Tool/function calling 
 - Agent planning and execution 
 - Workflow and state management 
 - Multi-agent orchestration 
 - Agent memory and context management 
 - Routing and delegation 
 - Human-in-the-loop workflows 
 - Guardrails and policy enforcement 
 - Retry, timeout and fallback strategies 
 - Agent observability and traceability 
 - Evaluation of agent behavior and task completion

You understand the distinction between deterministic and non-deterministic execution paths and can design systems that deliberately combine both. 

You know when a business workflow should remain deterministic and testable using conventional software and when probabilistic reasoning using an LLM or agent is appropriate. 

You design AI systems assuming that model outputs can be incorrect or unpredictable and therefore incorporate appropriate validation, constraints, structured outputs, fallbacks, idempotency, observability and human intervention where required. 

AI Quality & Evaluation

You understand that production AI systems require rigorous quality and evaluation practices beyond model selection and prompting. 

You have experience establishing offline and online evaluation strategies for LLM-powered systems, covering retrieval and response quality, factual grounding, task completion, reliability, latency and cost. 

You can build evaluation harnesses and regression tests with representative datasets, metrics and quality thresholds, and integrate them into CI/CD as deployment and quality gates. 

You can use evaluation, observability and tracing to diagnose quality issues across data, retrieval, context, prompts, models and orchestration, and drive systematic improvements. 

Engineering Leadership

You can translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical architectures and incrementally deliver solutions from experimentation through production. 

You make architecture decisions based on measurable trade-offs rather than technology trends and are comfortable challenging unnecessary complexity. 

You can lead POCs and technical experiments while clearly distinguishing between what demonstrates feasibility and what is required to operate the capability reliably at enterprise scale. 

You have proven technical leadership capabilities and the ability to influence engineers, product leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. 

You enjoy mentoring engineers and raising the technical capabilities of the broader engineering team. 

You collaborate effectively with Product and domain experts and can communicate complex architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

You stay current with evolving engineering and AI technologies through formal training and self-directed learning, while applying new technologies pragmatically. 

You have experience working within CI/CD and DevOps environments and understand production engineering practices including monitoring, observability, resilience, security and operational readiness. 

Useful Links

- Life at Target: https: //india. target. com/
 - Benefits: https: //india. target. com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
 - Culture: https: //india. target. com/life-at-target/belonging

About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. 

Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate distributed platform services and APIs using Java and Python, applied

against Kubernetes or equivalent cloud-native infrastructure. 

- Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous platform

problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term

durability before writing a line of code. 

- Flex into data engineering work when needed: contribute directly to Spark-based data pipelines and

processing jobs, working comfortably in GDF's data engineering codebase alongside platform work. 

- Build AI, GenAI, and agentic-powered platform capabilities: intelligent developer tooling, workflow

automation, agentic services, and AI-assisted operational tooling (monitoring, incident triage, capacity

planning). 

- Own platform reliability, scalability, and observability - service-level objectives, distributed tracing, 

alerting, and incident response for services you build, with a strong Operational Excellence /

Engineering Excellence discipline. 

- Guide architecture and system design decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and

enterprise integrations, with an explicit eye toward how platform choices affect downstream data

engineering workloads. 

- Partner with data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to ensure platform services expose the

right primitives for data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving paths. 

- Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and

production readiness reviews for a team building process from scratch. 

- As a Staff engineer, set technical direction and best practices within your team and technical domain

without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDF's broader platform

engineering standards. 

- Continuously evaluate emerging platform, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them

pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and

operating large-scale distributed platforms; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required -

comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code, not just directing others. Additional

experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 

- Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a

nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, 

proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not

bolted on afterward. 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or

equivalent practical experience. 

- Deep experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API

design, service contracts, and enterprise system integration - backed by strong system design, 

domain-oriented design (DDD), and low-level design (LLD) skills, with demonstrated ownership of

production code and the judgment to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost. 

- Deep understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or

equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 

- Strong exposure to Big Data / data engineering technologies - Spark required at a working level, with

familiarity in Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, or Kafka - enough to flex into data engineering work confidently, not

just integrate with it from a distance. 

- Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and

GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step

autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices

(feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 

- Strong knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, 

alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale systems. 

- Strong grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, 

authorization, data protection, and secure API design.

data.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension)
data.description:
TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension) to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. 

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Build the Agent UI shell, the Chrome extension, the slide-out / pill workspace, the Control UI, and the per-module panels
 - This is the product wedge - what an evaluator demos in 5 minutes and decides "yes. "
 - Real-time UI over live voice, desktop, and AI event streams, in a startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- React app + Chrome extension (Manifest V3, content scripts, injected iframe, page-overlay pill)
 - WebSocket-driven real-time UI
 - plugin / module-federation patterns
 - Screen-real-estate management
 - The design system in code
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- A self-starter with a show-me mentality - you move from prototype to real-world product quickly and demonstrate ideas with working UI, not mockups
 - You love new technology and adapt fast when it changes
 - Consistent by discipline: you use shared libraries and established patterns instead of reinventing per feature - consistency is what keeps a small team fast
 - You use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity
 - You consider yourself exceptional, love solving hard problems, and like winning. 

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years frontend; senior-level React + TypeScript mandatory. HTML5, JavaScript, and graphics skills all ++++ - 
 - You're a master of the browser platform itself, not just a framework user (canvas/SVG/WebGL, animation, rendering). 
 - Strong design/UI skills a +++ - you have taste; your UIs look and feel professional without a designer holding your hand. 
 - Real Chrome Extension experience - Manifest V3, content scripts, the messaging model, injecting UI over a host page. This is core, not a footnote. 
 - Strong API skills - you design and consume clean APIs, and you understand the backend messaging systems behind them (pub/sub, event streams, WebSocket) well enough to reason about ordering, reconnects, and state sync. 
 - Heavy WebSocket / real-time UI; you've built interfaces that update from a live event stream. 
 - Plugin / module-federation or dynamic-component-loading experience. 
 - Performance as a habit - render profiling, virtualization for dense data, sub-frame updates under a firehose event stream; the UI must never be the latency bottleneck. 
 - State management under streaming data - optimistic updates, reconnect/replay handling, conflict resolution. 
 - Extension security fluency - CSP, sandboxing, isolated worlds; we inject UI into other companies' pages and can never break or leak. 
 - Automated UI testing (Playwright-class) as part of shipping, not a QA handoff. 
 - Accessibility and keyboard-first flows as defaults - agents live in this UI 8 hours a day. 
 - A master debugger in the browser - DevTools is an extension of your hands; you see the render bug, the leak, the layout thrash. 
 - Go literacy is a plus (you'll read it). 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

JOB DESCRIPTION

This role is responsible for conducting in-process and final product quality testing and analyses in strict compliance with established standards and regulatory requirements within a global pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The incumbent interprets and evaluates analytical results in terms of accuracy and precision against predefined specifications to ensure product integrity. Various measuring devices, testing equipment, and predetermined methods are employed to accept or reject products based on prescribed specifications. Random samples of finished goods are tested to verify conformance with internal and regulatory quality standards. The position supports continuous improvement initiatives by suggesting enhancements to testing methods and quality processes. It operates within a structured quality management framework aligned with 21 CFR Part 210 and 211, ICH guidelines, and applicable Indian and international pharmaceutical regulations.

 - Test random samples of finished goods to verify conformance with quality specifications
 - Report manufacturing process deviations and defects in finished goods to relevant stakeholders

data.title: Senior Staff Digital Methodology Engineer - Design for Testability (DFT)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months. 

You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99. 5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences. 

At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
 - Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
 - Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149. 1, IEEE 1149. 6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
 - Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
 - Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
 - Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
 - Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
 - Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
 - Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
 - Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
 - Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
 - Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
 - Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 10+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
 - Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
 - Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
 - Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
 - Expertise deploying IEEE 1149. 1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149. 6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
 - Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
 - Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
 - Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
 - Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
 - Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
 - You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
 - You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
 - You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
 - You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
 - You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

 - Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
 - Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
 - Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
 - Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
 - Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
 - Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
 - Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
 - Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
 - Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
 - Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 15+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
 - Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
 - Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
 - Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
 - Expertise deploying IEEE 1149. 1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149. 6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
 - Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
 - Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
 - Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
 - Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
 - Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
 - You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
 - You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
 - You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
 - You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
 - You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

data.title: AI Backend Engineer
data.description:
Hiring for COSO Intelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About Company

- COSO Intelligence is a construction intelligence platform that uses AI to help construction professionals work with project data and make decisions. 
 - Company website: https: //cosobuild. ai

Job Roles & Responsibilities

- Build production Python APIs and asynchronous workflows for reliable document-grounded AI services. 
 - Develop hybrid RAG retrieval, reranking, query rewriting, chunking and metadata filtering over production vector stores. 
 - Establish labelled AI evaluation datasets and CI/CD release checks for retrieval quality, groundedness and faithfulness. 
 - Enforce strict multi-tenant RLS and query-layer isolation across storage, retrieval, caching and background tasks. 
 - Deliver source-document/page citations and honest refusals when available evidence cannot support an answer. 
 - Build layout-aware extraction and OCR pipelines for messy documents while preserving provenance and page metadata. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 3-5 years of experience with hands-on production backend and AI delivery. 
 - Own production Python services using FastAPI or Django, REST APIs and async execution; PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and Docker. Show deployed workloads, queue retries/idempotency, performance and failure handling rather than notebook-only work. 
 - Ship hybrid dense plus sparse/BM25 retrieval with reranking, query rewriting, chunking and metadata filtering. Demonstrate a production vector store such as Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone or FAISS; these are alternatives, not cumulative requirements. 
 - Maintain labelled evaluation sets in CI/CD; use Recall@k, MRR and nDCG for retrieval and groundedness/faithfulness for answers. Explain baselines, regression thresholds, dataset versioning and failure slices. 
 - Enforce tenant isolation through RLS at the database/query layer, not prompts alone. Carry tenant context through retrieval, cache keys and Celery jobs; demonstrate negative cross-tenant tests and least-privilege service access. 
 - Return source-document and page citations tied to evidence actually retrieved; refuse or qualify unsupported answers honestly. Explain citation provenance, unsupported-query tests and failure handling. 
 - Extract messy PDFs, scanned documents and complex layouts using layout-aware extraction/OCR; example tools include Tesseract, docTR, Textract and DocLayout. Preserve page identity, reading order, tables and metadata into retrieval. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: Agent orchestration with human-in-the-loop using LangGraph, Agno, AutoGen or CrewAI; staged actions committed by a human and no unattended database writes. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: Quantized self-hosted model routing using vLLM or Ollama, int4/int8, data sovereignty, open-source fallbacks and cost/latency tradeoffs. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: OpenTelemetry (OTel), structured logging, tracing and operational dashboards. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: PySpark, Parquet and CDC-based ETL. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: AWS or GCP cloud delivery; LoRA/QLoRA only with judgement about when fine-tuning is unnecessary. 

What We Offer

- Remote work. 
 - Hands-on ownership of backend and document-grounded AI engineering for construction intelligence.

data.title: Staff Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
About Us: 

Versa Networks, Inc. is a vendor of a unified Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) platform. Versa's goal is to provide unprecedented business advantages through a software-based approach that allows for unmatched agility, cost savings and flexibility. We have created a platform that is feature-rich, scalable and easy to use for both enterprise and service provider use cases. 

Job Summary: 

VMS is a core component of Versa's SASE security platform. It collects user identity, authentication, device posture, IoT, UEBA and threat intelligence data and distributes it, per tenant, to Versa enforcement points for Zero Trust, identity-based firewall, micro-segmentation and SSE policies. Data sources include SCIM, passive and active authentication, RADIUS and threat intelligence feeds. We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to lead the testing of VMS, covering functional correctness, tenant isolation, high availability, upgrades and performance. 

Educational Qualification: 

B. E. /B. Tech. or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication or equivalent. 

Professional Qualification: 

8-12 years of experience in software quality engineering and test automation, including at least 3 years testing networking, security or distributed systems products. 

Job Responsibilities: 

Quality strategy

- Define the test strategy, test plans and release-readiness criteria for VMS. 
 - Provide the quality status for each release, with test results and defect data. 
 - Mentor SDETs and review their test designs and automation code. 
 - Work with developers to add unit and contract tests to every change, and add quality gates to the CI/CD pipeline. Functional and security testing

- Test that identity, posture and threat intelligence records are delivered correctly to enforcement points, including adds, updates, deletes and revocations. 
 - Measure how long it takes for a change, such as a user logout or a new threat feed entry, to take effect. 
 - Test tenant isolation, so that data for one tenant is never sent to or changed by another. 
 - Test behavior when a data source or downstream consumer is unavailable, including data aging and recovery. Test automation

- Build integration and end-to-end test frameworks for the publish/subscribe path across record types, services and tenants. 
 - Build contract and schema-evolution tests for the gRPC/Protobuf interface to keep backward compatibility with deployed clients. 
 - Build simulators for upstream data sources (SCIM, RADIUS, authentication events, threat feeds and posture data) to test at scale. Platform, high availability and performance

- Maintain the installation and upgrade test matrix: ISO and package installs, single-node and HA setups, FIPS and non-FIPS builds, upgrade, rollback and data migration. 
 - Test active/backup failover and data replication, including random failures and reboots, and measure RTO and RPO. 
 - Run performance, capacity, soak and memory-growth tests, and document the supported limits for throughput, record count and tenants. 

Essential Skills: 

- Test automation development in Go or Java, and Python or another scripting language. 
 - Experience testing distributed or stateful systems, such as messaging, streaming, data stores (for example Redis or Kafka) and HA failover. 
 - API and contract testing, preferably with gRPC/Protobuf. 
 - Good knowledge of TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS/mTLS and PKI basics. 
 - Strong Linux and shell scripting skills. 
 - Experience testing on-premises or appliance software, including installation and upgrade. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Performance and soak testing, including load generation and profiling. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates (for example Jenkins). 

Desirable Skills: 

- Experience with SASE, SSE, ZTNA, NGFW, SD-WAN or micro-segmentation products. 
 - Knowledge of identity protocols such as SCIM, SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, RADIUS and LDAP. 
 - Experience with threat intelligence feeds, UEBA, endpoint posture, IoT device identification or security group tags. 
 - Experience with syslog and log analytics pipelines. 
 - Exposure to security certification testing (FIPS 140-3, STIG, Common Criteria). 
 - Deeper Kubernetes experience (cluster setup, networking, storage, operators). Experience with Prometheus and Grafana, and with public cloud platforms

data.title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect
data.description:
Job Description - Lead Specialist, Solution Architect

Role: Solution Architect

Division: Pearson Qualifications - Consumer Services

Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India (Hybrid)

About Pearson

Pearson's mission is to "add life to a lifetime of learning. " With more than 20, 000 employees worldwide, we deliver high-quality, digital-first educational experiences that empower learners and educators. Our teams are passionate about creating accessible, sustainable solutions that drive real-world impact. 

About Pearson Qualifications - Consumer Services

Consumer Services creates and operates digital products that help teachers teach and learners build the knowledge, confidence and skills needed to succeed in their qualifications. Our services bring together curriculum-aligned content, learning activities, practice assessment, progress insight and supporting administration for schools, teachers and learners. 

The portfolio includes modern cloud-based products alongside established applications that are being simplified, consolidated or retired over time. The architecture role is focused on evolving a coherent consumer product ecosystem, improving integration and operational quality, and supporting the controlled migration of users and capabilities to strategic platforms. This remit is distinct from systems used to administer and deliver qualifications, examinations, marking and certification. 

Role Summary

As a Solution Architect, you will shape and oversee solutions across Pearson Qualifications Consumer Services. You will work primarily with modern digital teaching and learning products in the UK Secondary Education market (K-12) and Post-16 Education, while also supporting the safe evolution, integration and retirement of applications across the wider consumer portfolio. 

You will translate content, product and business needs into secure, scalable and supportable solution designs, working closely with content, product, engineering, user experience, data, security, service management, and external partners. The role requires strong architecture judgement across customer-facing web applications, APIs, event-driven integration, data, identity, cloud infrastructure and operational readiness. 

You will balance strategic direction with pragmatic delivery, assessing reuse before new build, documenting trade-offs, estimating cost and effort, and ensuring functional and non-functional requirements are addressed. Clear communication, constructive challenge and the ability to guide delivery teams through change are essential. 

Key Responsibilities

- Solution Architecture Design: Lead end-to-end architecture for consumer-facing digital products and supporting services. Define application, integration, data and deployment views that meet functional and non-functional requirements, sometimes including sovereign data requirements in a highly regulated industry. 

- Product and Platform Evolution: Shape roadmaps that simplify the application estate, encourage reuse and support controlled migration from established products to strategic capabilities without disrupting customers. 

- Architecture Options and Trade-offs: Evaluate solution options across technology fit, customer impact, delivery effort, security, operability, scalability, time to market and total cost of ownership. 

- Integration Architecture: Design and govern APIs, events and integration patterns across internal products, enterprise platforms, third-party services and school or customer systems. 

- Technical Leadership and Governance: Act as a design authority through discovery, delivery and release. Maintain alignment with enterprise standards, architecture principles and agreed guardrails. 

- Delivery Team Support: Work closely with engineering leads, developers, testers, DevOps and SRE teams to turn architecture into implementable designs and resolve technical issues. 

- Customer and User Experience Alignment: Partner with product and UX teams to support accessible, coherent and responsive teacher, learner and administrator journeys. 

- Data and Insight: Define appropriate data ownership, contracts and flows for learning activity, assessment, content, subscription and insight use cases. 

- Security and Privacy by Design: Ensure solutions protect customer and learner data and follow Pearson security and privacy standards. 

- Reliability and Operability: Define availability, performance, resilience, observability, support and recovery requirements. 

- Vendor and Partner Oversight: Review third-party architectures and implementation approaches and hold partners accountable for quality and conformance. 

- Documentation and Decision Management: Maintain architecture blueprints, C4 views, interface and event specifications, data flows, non-functional requirements, decision records and transition roadmaps. 

- Cost and Sustainability: Assess infrastructure, platform, licensing and operational costs and promote efficient, maintainable cloud usage. 

- Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Evaluate relevant developments in digital learning, AI, analytics, software delivery and cloud technology. 

- Lifecycle Support: Support solutions from discovery through implementation and live operation, including technical debt reduction, consolidation and decommissioning planning. 

Working Relationships

The role works across product management, engineering, UX and accessibility, data and analytics, information security, SRE and operations, service management, enterprise architecture, commercial teams and external delivery partners. The successful candidate will be comfortable influencing across organisational boundaries without relying on formal authority. 

Essential Experience and Skills

- Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: A proven track record designing and guiding complex enterprise or digital product solutions from concept through implementation and operation. 

- Modern Cloud Architecture: Strong experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-native design, including compute, containers, serverless, networking, storage, managed data services, identity, monitoring and resilience. 

- Java and Web Application Architecture: Strong understanding of Java-based service architectures and modern web applications, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs and distributed systems. 

- Architecture and Design Communication: Ability to create clear architecture blueprints, C4 diagrams, data flows, integration views, interface specifications and architecture decisions. 

- Integration and API Design: Practical experience with API-first and event-driven architectures, contract design, service boundaries and asynchronous messaging. 

- Data Architecture Awareness: Good understanding of transactional data, data modelling, analytics, reporting, ownership, privacy, retention and performance. 

- Security and Privacy: Strong knowledge of secure software design, identity and access management, data protection and application security. 

- Technical Leadership: Experience guiding multidisciplinary teams, reviewing implementation, mentoring colleagues and constructively challenging suppliers. 

- Solution Analysis and Cost Estimation: Ability to make evidence-based recommendations balancing customer value, quality, delivery effort, operational impact and cost. 

- Stakeholder Engagement: Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including explaining trade-offs and gaining alignment. 

- Problem Solving and Adaptability: A pragmatic approach to ambiguity and change, moving between strategic architecture and detailed delivery issues. 

- Business and Customer Focus: Ability to connect architecture decisions to teaching, learning, customer experience, product outcomes and sustainable value. 

Desirable Skills

- AWS Delivery Tooling: Infrastructure as code and CI/CD experience, including Terraform, GitHub Actions or equivalent tooling. 

- Containers and Event Streaming: Experience with container platforms, microservices, Kafka or equivalent technologies. 

- Modern Front-End Architecture: Familiarity with React, micro-frontends, design systems and accessible user experiences. 

- Cloud Data Technologies: Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, data warehouses, search, caching and near-real-time analytics. 

- Education Technology: Experience with teaching and learning platforms, digital content, learning management, formative assessment or school-system integration. Knowledge of 1EdTech standards for rostering and LTI integration protocols is desirable. 

- Identity and Subscription Services: Understanding of SSO, roles, entitlements, onboarding, subscription management and digital access control. 

- Legacy Modernisation: Experience planning incremental migrations, coexistence, strangler patterns, user transition and decommissioning. 

- Operational Excellence: Understanding of SRE, observability, performance engineering, business continuity and disaster recovery. 

- AI and Emerging Technology: Awareness of responsible AI in content, teaching, learning, insight and software delivery. 

- Azure Awareness: Familiarity with Azure where consumer services integrate with wider Pearson platforms or enterprise capabilities. 

Education and Certification

data.description:
Req ID: 393903

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a Senior AWS Engineer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN). 

Key Responsibilities

- Cloud Infrastructure Design & Management o Architect, deploy, and manage AWS cloud solutions aligned with best practices for security, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Implement and optimize network architecture including VPCs, subnets, routing, VPNs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and load balancers. 
 - Ensure high availability and disaster recovery strategies are in place. 
 - DevOps & Automation o Build, manage, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with CloudFormation, Terraform, or Ansible. o Manage container orchestration (EKS, ECS, Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Security & Compliance o Implement identity and access management (IAM) policies, encryption, monitoring, and auditing in AWS. o Ensure compliance with industry standards (e. g. , ISO, SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, etc. ) as applicable. 
 - Monitoring & Performance Optimization o Set up logging, monitoring, and alerting using CloudWatch, ELK stack, Prometheus, or other third-party tools. 
 - Continuously monitor costs and optimize AWS usage through cost-e ective solutions. 
 - Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
 - Work closely with developers, QA, and operations teams to enable seamless application delivery. o Engage with third-party vendors/tools for integration and ensure smooth ecosystem interoperability. o Provide mentorship and guidance to junior engineers.

- AWS Expertise: Deep knowledge of core AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, Route53, CloudFormation, etc. ).

 - Infrastructure & Networking: Strong understanding of cloud networking, hybrid cloud, VPNs, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, and security groups. 
 - Automation Tools: Proficiency with Ansible, Terraform, or CloudFormation. 
 - Scripting & Development: Working knowledge of Python, Bash, or other scripting languages.

- AWS Certification is a must (Associate or Professional level).

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with serverless architectures and microservices.

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

data.description:

Your impact

Lead CQVENgineer is responsible for leading and delivering end-to-end commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) programs for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects. This role combines technical subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards while meeting project timelines, quality, and budget targets. 

The role requires deep experience in GxP environments, risk-based validation, and facility/equipment qualification, along with strong stakeholder and team management skills. The role will require an experienced, energetic, and committed CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals and having experience of >15 years. The person should have experience of leading CQV engineers for big projects and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle, from SLIA generation through to OQ/ PQ completion. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

- Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments. 
 - Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors. 
 - Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams. 
 - Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client. 
 - Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle. 
 - Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation. 
 - Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff. 
 - Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies. 
 - Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e. g. , FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e. g. , ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc.

Who We Are

Job Description

Job Description

HPE GreenLake Platform Cloud (GLCP) team allows you the opportunity to collaborate with both creative and engineering types to build HPE's next generation cloud platform. Combining agile methodologies and a continuous integration and delivery pipeline, the GreenLake Cloud Platform partners with all of HPE and powers HPE's transformation as a true cloud-native provider. It's the cloud that comes to you!

On the GLCP team you will build innovative cloud platform capabilities that enable the delivery of rich HW and SW aaS solutions to customers. Our team brings simplified hybrid cloud environment that will build, deploy and manage business clouds while optimizing productivity. Join us redefine what's next for you. 

What You'll Do

Product Overview

HPE VM Essentials (VME) is a next-generation virtualization platform that enables customers to provision and manage KVM-based HVM and VMware ESXi virtual machines through a single, unified management interface. 

The solution includes an enhanced KVM-based HVM hypervisor with enterprise-grade cluster management capabilities such as high availability, live migration, distributed workload placement, integrated data protection, secure hardening, and external storage support. VME is designed to deliver a scalable, resilient, and secure virtualization experience for enterprise workloads. 

Role Overview

You will combine hands-on technical leadership, people management, and execution ownership to drive high-quality outcomes aligned with HPE's product strategy and customer commitments. 

This role requires strong alignment with HPE leadership expectations, including ownership, accountability, collaboration, and customer focus, while maintaining deep technical credibility in systems and virtualization platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical & Execution Leadership

- Own delivery of key virtualization components, ensuring on-time, high-quality, and predictable execution. 
 - Provide architectural oversight to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with HPE's long-term technology roadmap. 
 - Experience in driving development, automation, CI/CD, performance engineering, reliability testing and production readiness. 
 - Ability to work with product management, architecture, QA, support and other teams. 
 - Drive technical decision-making with a strong focus on customer impact, operational excellence, and business value. 
 - Ensure adherence to HPE engineering standards, quality gates, and compliance requirements. 

People Leadership & Talent Development

 - Build an inclusive, high-performing team culture that emphasizes ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Actively identify skill gaps and drive upskilling and succession planning within the team. 

Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product Management, Architecture, QA, Support, and Global Engineering teams to align priorities and deliver customer-focused outcomes. 
 - Engage with partners and customers to understand requirements, address escalations, and incorporate feedback into product improvements. 
 - Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership and stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making. 

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

- Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and architectural improvements, balancing innovation with stability and delivery commitments. 
 - Drive adoption of best practices across DevOps, CI/CD, reliability, security, and release management. 
 - Champion a security-first and quality-first mindset across all phases of development. 

What You Need To Bring

Education & Experience

- BE / ME in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Minimum 15 years of industry experience, with demonstrated experience leading engineering teams. 

Required Knowledge And Skills

- Strong experience in the virtualization ecosystem, preferably with KVM-based solutions. 
 - Experience in managing a team for developing, debugging/troubleshooting, and maintaining enterprise-grade infrastructure software
 - expertise in Linux OS, clustering technologies (e. g. , Corosync, Pacemaker), and file systems. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise storage and networking. 
 - Working knowledge on clustering technologies (e. g. , Corosync, Pacemaker), and file systems. 
 - Knowledge on REST APIs, Groovy, Java, C++, Python, Shell Scripting or similar technologies
 - Solid understanding of storage technologies and networking in enterprise environments. 
 - Expertise in software systems design, distributed architecture, and integration across heterogeneous platforms. 

Additional Skills

- Working knowledge on any cloud type (AWS/Azure/GCP . . . etc). 
 - Knowledge on Microservices, Multi tenancy & RBAC. 
 - Knowledge on k8s eco-system, Cloud Identity & Access Management (IAM), Secret and key management (KMS, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault). 

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here. 

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
