data.title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
data.description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Ahmedabad/GiftCity

Description

We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD - the cross-functional team accountable for delivering customer-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements. 

This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code - reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems - while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require. 

Key Responsibilities

- Delivery & stakeholder ownership - Own end-to-end delivery of customer-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership. 
 - Hands-on technical leadership & design - Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non-trivial customer-funded features and review designs produced by the team - ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C++, and be the escalation-of-last-resort on hard issues. 
 - Cross-component versatility & engineering excellence - Deliver across a broad surface - Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements - as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C++ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer-funded work as first-class product code, not throwaway one-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them. 
 - AI-assisted engineering - Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e. g. , Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use - quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code - and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org. 
 - SE + SQE leadership - Lead a cross-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness. 
 - People management & culture - Line-manage the POD: 1: 1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip. 

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

Essential Skills & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2+ years managing a mid-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers. 
 - Expert-level hands-on proficiency in modern C++ (C++11 through C++20) - able to review and write production-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance. 
 - Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high-performance, mission-critical, low-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks. 
 - Proven track record delivering complex, customer-committed software projects in an Agile environment - working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows - and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e. g. , Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery - with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control. 
 - Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar). 
 - Demonstrated success as a people manager - growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations - with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers. 

Desirable Skills & Experience

data.title: Mechanical (HVAC) Data Center Source Inspection & Quality Control Engineer
data.description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment. 

We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios. 

Job Description

The Mechanical (HVAC) Source Inspection & Quality Control Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality, performance, and compliance of critical mechanical systems and equipment prior to shipment from supplier and manufacturing facilities. This role is essential in safeguarding the reliability and efficiency of HVAC infrastructure that underpins mission-critical environments such as data centers. 

Through detailed inspection, testing oversight, and quality surveillance, the engineer verifies that all mechanical equipment-such as chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, pumps, and piping systems-is manufactured, assembled, and tested in accordance with approved specifications, industry standards, and client requirements. The role places a strong emphasis on performance validation, ensuring systems will meet stringent operational and uptime expectations. 

Acting as a key quality gate within the supply chain, the engineer identifies and mitigates risks early, drives resolution of non-conformities, and ensures completeness of technical documentation and certification. This ultimately supports smooth installation, commissioning, and long-term operational performance of mechanical systems within high-availability data center environments. 

Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct inspections for mechanical equipment such as chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, AHUs, pumps, piping systems, valves, and associated assemblies. 
 - Execute inspection activities across: 
 - Pre-production (design review, material verification, supplier readiness)
 - In-process (fabrication, assembly, welding, pressure testing)
 - FAT and functional testing (performance verification, controls integration)
 - Pre-shipment inspections (preservation, packing, tagging, documentation)
 - Verify compliance with: 
 - Approved drawings, datasheets, and specifications
 - ITPs / QCPs
 - ASME, ISO, AHRI, and other relevant standards
 - Client and project requirements
 - Witness pressure tests, leak tests, performance tests, and balancing procedures. 
 - Identify non-conformities and ensure timely resolution. 
 - Ensure correct documentation, including test reports, certificates, and O&M manuals. 
 - Collaborate with commissioning teams and project stakeholders. Qualifications

- Degree or HND/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering. 
 - 10-15 years' experience in HVAC systems for mission-critical facilities (data centers, hospitals, labs). 
 - Strong experience with vendor inspections and manufacturing processes. 
 - Knowledge of chilled water systems, air distribution systems, and mechanical controls. 
 - Familiarity with FAT procedures and commissioning requirements. 
 - Certifications in QA/QC or mechanical inspection are desirable. 

Additional Information

Why Join Us?

At FPC Global, you'll be part of a community-not just a company. When you join us, you'll: 

- Work across a broad and impactful remit

- Gain exposure to multiple business functions

- Develop a strong foundation for future growth opportunities

- Be part of a collaborative, people-first culture where your contribution truly matters

- Work on impactful projects that shape industries and redefine the built environment

- Grow your career through leadership development, cross-functional collaboration, and exposure to cutting-edge technologies

- Be supported and included in a culture that values diversity, balance, and teamwork

- Make a real difference, contributing to high-performance, innovative, and iconic outcomes worldwide

We offer a competitive salary and a benefits package tailored to your location and role, including: 

- Flexible & hybrid working

- Private medical insurance

- Competitive salary & discretionary annual bonus

- Ongoing professional development

data.title: QA Automation Tester (Selenium/Playwright)
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. 

Job Description

Role: Senior QA Test Engineer

Location: Bengaluru, India

Department: Eurofins IT Solutions - ELN

Experience: 5-8+ Years

Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

With 36 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies. 

BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next-generation applications and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). As Senior Automation Engineer, you will be a crucial part of our delivery team, ensuring the product features are completely automated and reducing the idea to live time to Business. As a technology leader, BPT wants to give you the opportunity not just to accept new challenges and opportunities but to impress with your ingenuity, focus, attention to detail and collaboration with a global team of professionals. 

This role reports to a Manager. 

Required Experience and Skills

Experience: 

- Experience between 5 to 8 yrs. 
 - Expertise in Automation Testing of Web based applications
 - Good experience in building and using automation frameworks using technologies: Java/ C#. 
 - Experience in doing in-sprint automation. 
 - Strong Automation background with experience in identifying and reviewing test cases and testing results. 
 - Ability to understand complex requirements and transform those into Test Scenarios, Test cases and Test Scripts. 
 - Proficient in Version Control tool (ex: GIT )
 - Worked on automating the CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Good Knowledge of Manual Testing of Web and Windows-based applications. 
 - Have an excellent understanding of SDLC and STLC lifecycles. 
 - Hands-on work experience in preparing Test Strategy, Test plans and Requirement traceability matrix. 
 - Exposure to different Testing types - Sanity, Functional, Integration, Exploratory and System testing. 
 - Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology and working experience in an Agile environment. 
 - Proficient in creating Test Reports. 
 - Should know about analyzing the Risks. 
 - Prior experience in testing LIMS would be an added advantage. Specific skills required

- Expertise in Automation Testing using Selenium/Specflow/BDD/Protractor/WebDriver IO. 
 - Hands-on experience in programming languages (C#, Java, Python, JavaScript). 
 - Experienced in Creating VM for Automation and setting up the configuration in the test suite and runners. 
 - Hands-on experience in SQL to write medium complex queries (e. g. Joins/sub-queries etc. ). 
 - Good understanding of JSON, XML, REST and experience in testing web services using POSTMAN, REST Assured, JSON Lint, SOAP UI. 
 - Experience with any defect tracking tool like Jira, TFS/MTM, Bugzilla, etc. 
 - Experience on any test management tools like TFS/MTM, ALM, etcDesirable Experience

- Knowledge of Performance testing. 
 - Knowledge of Security testing. 

Additional Information

Personal Skills: 

- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; 
 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; 
 - Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; 
 - Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); 
 - Structured and clear writing skills; 
 - Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; 
 - Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

Responsibilities include programming and configuring automation systems, integrating sensors and control devices, and optimizing process parameters to improve efficiency and quality. The role involves diagnosing and resolving equipment and control system issues, performing preventive maintenance, and collaborating with design, production, and quality teams to support new projects and continuous improvement initiatives. The Automation Engineer will also prepare technical documentation, support commissioning and trials at customer sites, and ensure compliance with safety and industry standards. 

Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong skills in Automation for industrial welding and manufacturing environments. 
 - Candidates should possess Electrical Engineering and Process Control skills to design, integrate, and optimize control systems. 
 - Candidates should possess effective Troubleshooting skills to identify, analyze, and resolve equipment, software, and process issues. 
 - Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related field. 
 - Experience with PLCs, HMIs, control panels, and industrial communication protocols is highly beneficial. 
 - Knowledge of resistance welding processes and safety standards is an advantage. 
 - Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering documentation. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively on-site.

data.title: Engineering Manager, SSCS Supply Chain
data.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role

As an Engineering Manager, you'll guide GitLab's dedicated Software Supply Chain Security (SSCS) Add-On engineering team as it develops core capabilities including Dependency Firewall, Build Provenance, Malicious Packages detection, and Artifact Signing. This is a founding management role where you'll help shape how the team works, partner closely with the Staff Backend Engineer, Product Manager, and SSCS stage management, and turn a defined roadmap into steady, high-quality delivery for enterprise customers with strict security and compliance needs. You'll focus on developing the team, creating a healthy operating rhythm, and establishing predictable execution for the SSCS SKU. 

You'll join a product area where customers in regulated industries are already validating the need, and your work will help GitLab deliver software supply chain security features that customers can rely on. While technical credibility matters, your main focus will be growing a strong backend engineering team, enabling team members in their development, and creating the conditions for long-term delivery and quality. 

What you'll do

- Guide a backend engineering team building the SSCS Add-On across dependency enforcement, build provenance, malicious package detection, and artifact signing. 
 - Be responsible for Drive engineering delivery for general availability milestones by aligning sequencing, scope, and dependencies with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager. 
 - Develop the team by partnering with Talent Acquisition on sourcing, interview design, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions. 
 - Run regular 1: 1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations that enable growth and clear expectations. 
 - Advance engineering quality by monitoring cycle time, defect rates, and test coverage, and by addressing risks early. 
 - Coordinate quarterly planning and roadmap tradeoff discussions with SSCS stage leadership and Product. 
 - Work with Finance and other partners on headcount pacing and team planning as the Add-On scales. 
 - Represent the SSCS Add-On team within stage leadership discussions and help ensure strong communication across functions. 
 - Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it. 

What you'll bring

- Over 3 years of experience guiding backend product engineering teams in security, DevOps, or platform engineering environments. 
 - Ability to hire and grow backend or security engineers in distributed team environments, with practical understanding of the talent landscape for these roles. 
 - Technical credibility to contribute to architecture discussions involving package registries, CI/CD pipeline security, and signing infrastructure. 
 - Experience managing predictable delivery across multi-quarter product roadmaps and managing cross-team dependencies. 
 - Comfort working in an asynchronous, documentation-driven organization with clear written communication. 
 - Familiarity with supply chain security, artifact management, or compliance-focused product areas, or transferable experience from related domains. 
 - Working knowledge of concepts related to frameworks and ecosystems such as SLSA and Sigstore. 
 - Ability to build credibility with engineers, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders through clear judgment, coaching, and teamwork. 

About The Team

The SSCS Add-On team is a product engineering team within GitLab's Software Supply Chain Security stage. We work on key capabilities in the SSCS Add-On SKU and collaborate closely with product and engineering partners to deliver security features for customers operating in regulated environments. You'll report to the SSCS Senior Engineering Manager and partner directly with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager. As a distributed team working asynchronously across regions, we are focused on strong delivery practices, team health, and scaling the product area with clarity and accountability. For more on how related teams work, see Team Handbook Page. 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
 - Flexible Paid Time Off 
 - Team Member Resource Groups
 - Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
 - Growth and Development Fund
 - Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. 

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. 

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. 

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab's policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields. 
 - 5 years of experience working in a complex organization. 
 - Experience leading through technical and organizational complexity. 
 - Experience with Java, C++, or both. 
 - Passion for technology, collaboration, and solving challenging problems. 

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information - any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally. 

Responsibilities

- Guide the technical direction to transition the core fabric of Search into an inherently multimodal platform, driving critical AI Mode (AIM) and AI Overviews (AIO) orchestration improvements. 
 - Drive the organizational working methodology toward agent-driven architectures and spec-driven development. Have AI fluency and be prepared to discuss your knowledge of AI tools in the hiring process. 
 - Manage complex integrations with sibling infrastructure teams, product teams, and downstream AI partners. Leverage the local Uber Tech lead (UTL)/Technical Lead (TL) presence in Bangalore to make effective architectural decisions and unblock your team. 
 - Foster rigorous engineering practices. Advocate system reliability, precise capacity planning, and latency optimizations. 
 - Hire, mentor, and sponsor a high-performing engineering team. Establish clear operational standards, support career development, and actively advocate for your team's technical visibility. 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Lead a high-performing, research-driven engineering team developing next-generation autonomous robotic systems that service complex semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Design and develop research roadmaps for current and future robotic capability, champion strategic research directions with senior executive leadership, and drive external innovation through university partnerships, research institutions, and emerging robotics/AI startup engagements. 

What You'll Do

- Manage, mentor, and grow a multidisciplinary team of robotics research engineers across four core areas - perception, mobility, Robotic Manipulation & Dexterity, Physical AI/ML

 - Lead the development of Automated Mobile Robots (AMR) based mobile manipulation systems - integrating robotic arms onto custom and off-the-shelf AMRs with human-safe autonomous navigation, high-precision automated tool docking. 
 - Pioneer Physical AI, multi-modal sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning models-including imitation/mimic learning, reinforcement learning (RL), Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, and sim-to-real deployment pipelines

 - Stay at the forefront of the latest state-of-the-art breakthroughs in robotics, computer vision, dexterous manipulation, and Physical AI/ML, translating academic and industry advances into practical, high-precision prototypes for semiconductor fab environments. 
 - Guide projects from initial hypothesis, simulation, and Design of Experiments (DOE) in the robotics lab through hardware/software prototyping and functional technology-readiness demonstrations, ensuring smooth handoff to production engineering. 

Who We're Looking For

- MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, with 12+ years of industry/research experience in robotics and autonomous systems, including 3+ years of experience managing research-based, high-performance engineering teams. 
 - Deep technical expertise of modern robotics SOTA with demonstrated experience across at least two of the following areas
 - Perception & Computer Vision - 3D vision, calibration, pose estimation, visual inspection, scene understanding
 - Autonomous Mobility - AMR navigation, perception, ROS2 navigation (nav2), SLAM, obstacle detection and avoidance
 - Robotic Manipulation & Dexterity - kinematics/dynamics, force/impedance control, motion/path planning, visual servoing, dexterous hands/end effectors/Grippers
 - Physical AI & Machine Learning - imitation/mimic learning, reinforcement learning, foundation models for robotics/VLAs, sensor fusion, sim-to-real deployment pipelines 
 - Proven track record of formulating R&D roadmaps, securing buy-in from senior/executive leadership, and translating ambiguous operational challenges into structured research programs. 
 - Demonstrated experience initiating and managing university research sponsorships, academic collaborations, OEM partnerships, or startup evaluations/co-development. 
 - Strong grounding in C++, Python, ROS2, and modern robotics software architectures sufficient to review technical designs, guide architectural decisions, and mentor staff/senior researchers. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong track record of peer-reviewed publications in top-tier robotics, computer vision, or ML venues (e. g. , ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL, CVPR, NeurIPS) and/or leadership in open-source robotics initiatives. 
 - Experience with modern robotics simulation and training ecosystems (e. g. , NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo) and hardware integration with industrial/collaborative arms (Flexiv, UR, ABB, Denso). 

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. 

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. 

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories - On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. 'On-site Flex' you'll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you'll fit right in. 

Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays. 

The Role:

Description: 

Manages team delivering scalable distributed systems and components on a 2-4 quarter horizon. Standardizes engineering practices and scalability requirements across teams; oversees optimization for high‐throughput, hyper‐scale workloads; and ensures effective use of distributed state tools and data plane platforms. Guides teams to design fault‐tolerant, in‐service‐upgradable systems, set SLO‐aligned durability/availability targets, and implement resiliency mechanisms (load‐shedding, throttling, rate‐limiting). Provides oversight for KPIs, telemetry, and moderately complex dashboards; directs design of functional/correctness requirements, fault‐injection tests, and replication/synchronization strategies. Ensures proactive incident management, operational readiness, and on‐call coverage; drives encryption/access control practices, remediation plans, and compliance documentation. Oversees development and maintenance of automation/IaC and partners with teams on change‐management plans enabling safe patching, updates, and rollbacks. 

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

- Manages the development and implementation of scalable distributed systems and components across multiple teams, including the effective use of distributed state management tools. 
 - Oversees code and/or system optimization efforts for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements within and across teams to support hyper-scale systems. 
 - Guides teams to define scalability requirements for owned components and ensures design and implementation requirements are met. 
 - Manages the use of data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 
 - Ensures team accurately designs performance and load testing. System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

- Manages the strategy for building fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by guiding the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 
 - Develops design strategies for systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 
 - Leads implementation and optimization initiatives across teams for approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 
 - Guides teams to design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

- Provides oversight in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 
 - Oversees the building and customization of moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

- Oversees the design and implementation of functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 
 - Guides teams to design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 
 - Directs implementation strategies for data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

- Guides teams to be proactive when diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation. 
 - Ensures teams leverage expertise to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 
 - Oversees operational readiness protocol and ensures teams remain knowledgeable of owned components and systems to support effective troubleshooting and performance. 
 - Oversees and approves schedules for operational support rotations. Compliance & Security: 

- Oversees implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, ensuring team strategies incorporate encryption techniques and access controls. 
 - Directs execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, promoting continuous improvement of security measures. 
 - Ensures comprehensive documentation and cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations. Automation & Change Management: 

- Oversees the development and maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Works with teams to create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and guides development of components to allow for automation of these processes. Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets (when applicable) are monitored and met. 
 - Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. 
 - Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align on expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. 
 - Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. 
 - Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues, as well as guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. 
 - Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping teams to identify potential solutions. Continuous Learning: 

- Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. 
 - Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. 
 - Identifies skill gaps across teams and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge-sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to apply learnings to advance the organization. Continuous Improvement: 

- Drives teams to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. 
 - Guides teams to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement. Performance and Development: 

- Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. 
 - Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. 
 - Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources.

data.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today's needs and tomorrow's next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape.

These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

About the position: 

As a Senior Product Validation Engineer, you will be part of firmware verification team that design and develop white box and grey box tests in Python to verify device firmware designs for each firmware/Product/System feature. You will be working closely with product/System architects and firmware engineers to create a comprehensive system verification test for features. In this role, you will be contributing to test strategy, test development, integrating the tests using various development platforms, deploying it on system verification lab for regression runs and perform failure analysis. The role focuses on defining and executing robust firmware/Device/system verification strategies for UCIe/AXI and custom host-device protocols across both pre‐silicon and post‐silicon environments. 

Responsibilities

- Collaborate closely with firmware engineers & architects on product architecture and designs to define the comprehensive verification plan to validate each product features
 - Design, Develop and Integrate the white box and gray box tests on products in roadmap
 - Conduct test plan reviews and code reviews to ensure the tests are scalable and meeting the requirements
 - Participate in driving failure analysis and collaborate with integration/execution engineers for test deployment. 
 - Validate designs against UCIe Specification ensuring compliance with electrical, logical, and transaction-layer requirements. 
 - Define and own firmware/System validation strategy for UCIe front-end subsystems, including resets, interrupts, Logging and error handling. 
 - Define, plan, and execute system-level validation strategies for front-end (PHY + controller) IP, back end(Controller +NAND) IP and SoC-level integration. 
 - Integrate tests into scalable automation frameworks supporting simulation, emulation, and silicon validation. 
 - Debug firmware issues, perform front-end error injection, and expose design or integration defects. 
 - Validate UCIe compliance, robustness of fault detection and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Review and verify firmware trace logs and debug telemetry for correctness and completeness. 
 - Drive validation readiness across pre‐silicon and post‐silicon platforms, ensuring alignment of firmware specs, drivers, and test collateral. 
 - Interface with cross‐functional stakeholders to ensure validation coverage meets product and customer requirements. 
 - Drive compliance and interoperability testing with various endpoints 
 - Proven expertise in defining and driving end-to-end validation strategies across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon platforms for complex SoCs and storage systems. 
 - Strong experience validating hardware IPs in pre-silicon environments (RTL simulation, SystemC/VDK, emulation, FPGA prototyping) and post-silicon environments. 
 - Possess deep understanding of Host SoC integration, firmware-hardware interactions, subsystem interoperability, and system-level debug across the complete product stack. 
 - Proficiency in high-performance/AI compute architectures, accelerator data paths, workload scheduling, and system-level performance validation

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Skills: 

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech degree in CSE/ ECE/ EEE/ IS or related field
 - In-depth knowledge of UCIe/AXI, flow control, ordering rules, error handling, power management
 - Proficiency with protocol analyzers/exercisers (Teledyne LeCroy, Keysight) etc. 
 - Experience with high‐performance storage, networking, or compute SoCs. 
 - Strong expertise in UCIe protocol, DMA, and ASIC front-end architecture. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python/C/C++ based scripting API's. 
 - Hands-on experience with error injection, fault modeling, and silicon debug tools. 
 - Familiarity with pre‐silicon (simulation/emulation) and post‐silicon lab validation flows. 
 - Solid understanding of firmware-hardware interaction and system-level debugging. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in test strategy definition, technical reviews, and mentoring. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to drive issues to closure under schedule pressure. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and influence technical decisions. 
 - Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, C/C++, or Bash. 
 - Minimum 6 - 8 years of related experience in firmware verification or system level testing along with Gen5/Gen6 PCI-SIG protocol testing
 - Knowledge on Git, CI & source code management flow and agile development practices. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis. 
 - Collaborative and proactive communication style. 
 - Attention to detail and quality assurance mindset. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team.

data.title: NPI & Test Automation Engineer
data.description:
JD - NPI & Test Automation Engineer (Electronics / Power Systems)

Role summary

The engineer owns NPI support, hardware validation and automated test system development for telecom power products, EV DC chargers and Li-ion battery packs. The role bridges R&D and production: it turns new designs into tested, production-ready products and builds the test setups that cut test time and improve repeatability on the line. 

Key responsibilities

Automated test systems (ATS) and Test Jigs

- Study schematics, rack architecture and engineering documents to define test and validation requirements. 
 - Prepare wiring diagrams and design universal ATS setups that cover multiple product or rack variants. 
 - Integrate and commission test hardware: PLCs (e. g. Siemens S7-200 Smart), relay cards, contactors, programmable DC loads (e. g. Chroma), rectifiers/SMRs and power supplies. 
 - Assemble, wire and verify test setups, then validate them against manual testing before release to production. 
 - Develop Python applications for functional test cases, real-time monitoring, data logging and Excel/report generation. 
 - Design and maintain burn-in, life-cycle and regenerative test setups for batteries and SMRs. 
 - Design simple PCBs for jigs and fixtures (cell simulators, pre-charge test, CAN splitters). New Product Introduction (NPI)

- Take part in Cross-Functional Team (CFT) reviews of design documents, specifications and customer requirements. 
 - Find design, assembly and testing issues at prototype stage and drive corrective actions with R&D. 
 - Review prototype builds, test reports and engineering documents before production release. 
 - Prepare assembly and test documents (SOPs, work instructions) for manual and automated testing. Production support and validation

- Support testing and troubleshooting of telecom power systems, EV DC fast chargers and Li-ion battery packs / BMS. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis of assembly and functional failures with Production, Quality and R&D. 
 - Suggest and implement improvements that raise test coverage, throughput and first-pass yield. Required skills

Area

What we need

Programming

Python, including hands-on test or monitoring tools; PyQt/PySide (GUI), Pandas and Matplotlib preferred

Communication protocols

CAN plus at least two of RS485, RS232, UART, SPI, I2C, Modbus

Automation hardware

PLC programming (Siemens preferred), relay/contactor logic, Arduino or similar controllers

Test equipment

Programmable DC loads, power supplies, rectifiers/SMRs, DMMs, oscilloscopes, data loggers

Electronics & power

Power electronics basics, SMPS/rectifiers, battery packs and BMS, PCB-level troubleshooting

Documentation

Wiring diagrams, test procedures, test reports, SOPs and work instructions

Tools

Git/GitLab, Excel; a PCB tool such as EasyEDA or Altium is a plus

Preferred experience

- Has built and deployed at least one automated test station (ATS) or test jig that is running in production. 
 - NPI experience: prototype reviews, production validation and handover from R&D to manufacturing. 
 - Domain exposure to telecom power systems (48V DC power plants, SMRs), EV DC fast chargers or Li-ion battery packs and BMS. 
 - Experience with regenerative or energy-saving test setups, burn-in and life-cycle testing. 
 - Track record of cutting test or analysis time through automation (with numbers). Behavioural competencies

- Works well in cross-functional teams with R&D, Quality and Production. 
 - Takes ownership from requirement study through to production deployment. 
 - Methodical problem solver; uses root-cause analysis, not trial and error. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including documentation for operators.

Good-to-have

B. E. /B. Tech in Electronics, Electrical or Instrumentation

Instrumentation & Control background

2-3 years in hardware testing, test automation or NPI

Telecom power, EV charger or Li-ion battery/BMS industry

Python used for real test or data-logging tools

PyQt/PySide GUI and Pandas/Matplotlib reporting

Hands-on CAN plus one serial protocol (RS485/RS232/UART)

SPI, I2C, Modbus

PLC or relay/contactor-based automation they built themselves

Siemens S7 PLC experience

Has used programmable loads and power supplies

Regenerative / burn-in test setups; basic PCB design

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Rust
data.description:
Senior Rust Software Engineer (Desktop Native)

Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" - we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog. 

As a Senior Rust Engineer on the Desktop Native team, you will own desktop autofill and native OS integrations, including the SSH agent, Autotype, native passkeys, and the DuckDuckGo integration, built on the same cross-platform Rust SDK that also powers browser autofill. This role is primarily for someone strong in Rust, FFI and language bindings, and native OS-level integration on Windows, macOS, and Linux, with the unusual challenge of delivering secure, reliable native experiences on top of a zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted product. This is not primarily a front-end or UI role. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design, build, and maintain native desktop integrations including the SSH agent, Autotype, native passkeys, and the DuckDuckGo integration
 - Participate in the hands-on design, development, and evolution of the shared Rust SDK, including language bindings and FFI, consumed across desktop and browser clients
 - Interface directly with OS-level APIs on Windows, macOS, and Linux to deliver reliable native behavior. 
 - Improve performance, reliability, security, and maintainability of native integrations handling sensitive credential data. 
 - Partner with product, design, QA, and the Autofill team to deliver high-quality experiences end to end. 
 - Review pull requests and help raise the quality of native/systems engineering, including community contributions in GitHub. 
 - Identify technical debt and contribute to pragmatic refactoring and architecture improvements to the Desktop Native roadmap
 - Participate in code reviews, learning, and spreading technical knowledge
 - Independently plan, estimate, and deliver new feature work and bug fixes
 - Occasionally review & approve bug fixes submitted by the user community

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

- Strong production Rust experience - 4-6+ years overall backend/systems experience, including FFI and language bindings
 - Native desktop application experience, interfacing directly with OS-level APIs on Windows, macOS, or Linux
 - Experience designing and versioning cross-platform SDKs or shared libraries consumed by multiple client surfaces
 - Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred)
 - Experience with Electron, TypeScript, and other web tech for cross-platform desktop applications and web clients is a plus
 - Collaborative and adaptable mindset
 - Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
 - Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills - you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

WHY WORK WITH US

- Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. 
 - Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. 
 - We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. 
 - Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development. 
 - At Bitwarden, we are passionate about what we do, but not necessarily everything we do. Our engineering team makes it a policy to carve out some time for personal growth, learning, skill building and pursuing personal passions that positively impact the team and company. To ensure that everyone has time to reaffirm their purpose and grow, you are encouraged to self-direct up to 15% of your week to what you feel is important for the company and for yourself. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You are someone who gets a quiet satisfaction from finding the bug no one else caught, from writing a script that saves the team three hours a week, from seeing a pattern in test data that points to something fixable. You do not just run tests, you think about what they mean and what they are missing. You know that quality is not something you inspect in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start. 

Scripting is not a chore for you. Whether it is Python or Tcl, you see automation as a way to make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human. You are comfortable sitting with a dataset, pulling it apart, and surfacing the insight that changes how the team approaches the next release cycle. 

You are early in your career but already understand that good engineering is about details, follow-through, and clear communication. You ask questions when something does not make sense. You document what you learn. You show up ready to contribute, not just observe. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the quality work you do here will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Coordinate kickoff and release meetings with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and process alignment throughout development and verification. 
 - Run regression test suites on Embedded Memory IP releases and track results across validation cycles. 
 - Analyze test data to surface trends, flag anomalies, and identify root causes of failures or quality gaps. 
 - Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that streamline testing, reporting, and compliance workflows. 
 - Document test outcomes, process gaps, and improvement recommendations in clear, actionable formats. 
 - Support the team in refining Quality Management System processes based on real-world validation feedback. 

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver zero-defect Embedded Memory IP to customers by catching issues before they reach production. 
 - Enable faster, more reliable releases through automation that reduces manual testing overhead. 
 - Surface data-driven insights that help engineering teams make better decisions about where to focus next. 
 - Strengthen the Quality Management System so every release cycle is more efficient than the last. 
 - Support the development of IP on advanced technology nodes that power AI, mobile, and smart device applications. 
 - Build a foundation of quality practices that scale as the product portfolio grows. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 0 to 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role. 
 - Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation. 
 - Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, you notice when something is off and you dig into why. 

Who You Are

- You can take a messy test log, pull out what matters, and explain it to someone who was not in the room. 
 - You are comfortable working across teams, coordinating meetings, and making sure people have what they need to stay on track. 
 - You do not wait to be told what to automate, you see repetitive work and you build a script for it. 
 - You are adaptable and do not get thrown when priorities shift or requirements change mid-cycle. 
 - You care about doing things right, not just fast, and you are willing to ask for clarity when the path forward is not obvious. 

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will be part of a highly skilled, dynamic team focused on defining and executing processes and methodology for Quality Management of Embedded Memories. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and are committed to continuous learning and improvement, fostering an environment where creativity and technical excellence thrive. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer (Supply Chain, FinTech & ERP platforms)
data.description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties. 

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset. 

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Quality Engineer will play a critical role in embedding quality across Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Quality Engineer to independently own testing activities and strengthen quality across our Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms. Working closely with software engineers and product managers, this role identifies risks early, improves testability, and embeds quality into requirements, design, development, and release practices. The Senior Quality Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. 

How Will You Drive Impact

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. 

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

- Partner with development and product teams during refinement and design to challenge ambiguous requirements, define testable acceptance criteria, and identify edge cases and integration risks before implementation begins. 
 - Contribute to shared QE standards, review automation code for test design and maintainability, and mentor teammates on continuous testing, shift-left, and AI-assisted testing practices. 
 - Collaborate with developers on appropriate unit, component, API, and integration coverage to drive shift-left and continuous testing practices across the team. 

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

- Build end-to-end automated tests for critical business journeys including order, fulfillment, payment, and ERP/finance posting flows to protect reliability for end customers. 
 - Perform focused exploratory and manual testing for complex workflows, boundary conditions, and scenarios requiring human judgment to catch issues before they reach production. 
 - Validate data accuracy and consistency across services, databases, and integrated systems - including reconciliation checks - to ensure customers experience accurate, trustworthy transactions. 
 - Define, maintain, and report quality metrics and dashboards covering defect trends, escaped defects, and release readiness to support confident delivery decisions. 

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

- Apply LLMs and AI-assisted or agent-based (including MCP-based) workflows to test scenario generation, test data creation, automation implementation, maintenance, and failure triage, reviewing generated tests for correctness and meaningful assertions. 
 - Test AI/LLM-powered features where applicable, validating output quality and behavior with evals and non-deterministic testing approaches, and evaluate AI self-healing and visual testing tools for fit. 
 - Investigate flaky tests, diagnose failures using logs, API responses, and queries, and work with developers on root causes and regression prevention to continuously improve pipeline reliability. 
 - Contribute experience in performance, resilience, and security testing for critical flows, bringing a proactive lens to systemic risk reduction. 

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

- Independently own test strategy, planning, estimation, test data, execution, defect triage, and quality reporting for the team - identifying dependencies and escalating risks early. 
 - Design, build, and maintain reusable automation frameworks and suites for APIs, web applications, integrations, and data validation, keeping coverage aligned with business risk and system changes. 
 - Integrate automated tests and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines, improving execution speed and reliability to maintain dependable regression feedback at every stage of delivery. 
 - Provide regular, evidence-based updates on testing progress, blockers, residual risks, and release readiness to support delivery decisions and continuous improvement. 

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: 

- Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
 - Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
 - Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
 - Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

- 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with demonstrated senior-level technical depth and independent ownership of testing in an Agile engineering team. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks and reliable test suites, with strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (Java or Go also valued) and comfort working across languages. 
 - Practical experience using AI in test automation workflows - including LLM-assisted test and test-data generation, agentic/MCP-based automation, testing AI/LLM-powered features, or AI self-healing and visual testing tools - with concrete examples of improved coverage, faster delivery, or reduced maintenance effort and the ability to explain how generated tests were reviewed and validated. 
 - Strong understanding of shift-left testing, continuous testing, risk-based test planning, and the appropriate balance of unit, component, integration, and end-to-end coverage, combined with experience with API automation for REST and/or gRPC services and web automation frameworks such as Playwright (preferred), Selenium, or WebdriverIO. 
 - Proficiency in SQL and relational databases for test data preparation and validation, with the ability to investigate data consistency issues across integrated systems and diagnose failures using logs and API responses. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, working with Git-based code review (GitHub/GitLab), and testing in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, alongside familiarity with test case management and API testing tools such as TestRail and Postman. 
 - Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to collaborate closely with developers and product managers, prioritize independently, and communicate quality risks with supporting evidence; prior experience in Supply Chain Management (SCM) and/or FinTech/Payments domains, or with ERP systems and their integrations, is strongly preferred. 

WORK LOCATION

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located Hyderabad, India, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team. 

About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses - Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios - maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem - connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport - delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players' associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7, 000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2, 000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22, 000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience. 

About The Team

Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally - as well as its flagship site, www. fanatics. com. 

Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world-including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA). 

At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do: 

- Build Championship Teams
 - Obsessed with Fans
 - Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit
 - Determined and Relentless Mindset

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. 

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.

Title : Senior Engineering Manager

Direct reports: Principal Domain Engineers; Associate Engineering Managers

The Senior Engineering Manager owns the engineering capability for Customer Platforms, including the engineering standards, practices, tooling and technical context that every engineer and AI agent operates within. The role is established to bridge and unify two software development lifecycles: the squad lifecycle, where engineers build to specifications, and the AI-native lifecycle, where specifications and code are agent-generated with engineers providing human-in-the-loop review before production commit. 

By establishing a single, high standard of engineering across both delivery models, the role enables Officeworks to progressively transition toward an AI-native engineering capability. It ensures that high technical quality, architectural compliance and operational delivery are maintained without dropping performance during the transition. 

In this role you will: 

Engineering Standards and Practice: 

- Own engineering standards, technical practices and code quality across every team, ensuring consistent application regardless of delivery construct. 
 - Set and hold teams accountable to the human-in-the-loop review standard applied prior to production code commits. 
 - Approve significant technical decisions and manage ongoing engineering technical risk across Customer Platforms. 
 - Own the engineering toolchain, developer experience and development environments to ensure efficiency and delivery stability. 

AI Tooling Adoption and Agent Workflow Consistency: 

- Drive and enforce the team's adoption of AI tooling, ensuring consistent use of the latest tooling and agent workflow approaches across all engineering work. 
 - Establish agent workflow standards and maintain the technical context framework within which AI agents operate. 
 - Evaluate emerging engineering tools and AI practices to determine adoption roadmaps and timing. 
 - Measure and evidence engineering productivity and throughput uplift against established baseline metrics. 

Quality Inside Engineering and QA Responsibilities: 

- Lead the integration of quality assurance directly into engineering workflows as QA responsibilities transition into the engineering team. 
 - Drive the execution, oversight, and governance of test development, test execution, and comprehensive defect metrics across all delivery channels. 
 - Maintain code quality standards for agent-generated output and cultivate rigorous review discipline across the engineering cohort. 
 - Drive root-cause investigation when agent outputs fail or drift, feeding learnings back into technical context to prevent reoccurrence. 

Operations and Incident Management: 

- Manage and coordinate the end-to-end engineering on-call process, rotas, and escalation protocols to guarantee continuous run stability. 
 - Oversee incident response for engineering issues, ensuring effective triage, swift restoration of critical platform services, and rigorous post-incident reviews. 

Context and Knowledge Integrity: 

- Own context integrity as a core engineering discipline, partnering with platform and operations teams who maintain the base context layer. 
 - Govern the documentation and knowledge artefact discipline so that domain knowledge is embedded in system context. 
 - Partner with architecture and cyber security teams to ensure policy and security standards are embedded directly into agent context. 

People Leadership and Capability: 

- Define the technical bar and lead hiring, talent retention and capability building for an AI-native engineering profile. 
 - Guide the engineering reskilling pathway, supporting the evolution of team members into hybrid engineering capabilities. 
 - Oversee engineering resource allocation, team composition and attrition risk through the operating model transition. 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in engineering leadership or engineering management roles. 
 - Technical Mastery: Strong technical credibility across system design, code quality, CI/CD, DevOps, platform architectures (digital, commerce, cloud) and agentic engineering toolchains. 
 - Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams through operating model transformations and capability transition pathways. 
 - Quality Engineering: Proven experience in modern automated testing strategies, test development and execution, and defect metrics tracking. 
 - Operations and Support: Proven track record in managing and coordinating engineering on-call frameworks and operational incident response processes. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication and alignment skills when working across architecture, operations, and business planning functions. 

Preferred: 

- Retail / Digital Context: Experience within complex retail, omnichannel, or high-volume digital platform environments. 
 - Advanced AI Practice: Hands-on experience with agentic coding environments, prompt/context engineering frameworks, or multi-agent orchestration tools. 
 - Cross-Border Exposure: Experience working across distributed, global capability centres (e. g. , Australia and India collaboration).

Primary Stack: Python/Django, Go/Gin, Angular/TypeScript, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Azure, Docker, Terraform, Playwright

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Architect to define and evolve the application architecture of Nextpower's engineering and business platforms. 

The role will focus on designing scalable, maintainable, and secure applications across the full technology stack, including domain models, APIs, services, user interfaces, data stores, integrations, and deployment environments. 

The architect will also establish practical guidelines for AI-assisted software development, helping teams use AI tools to improve productivity while maintaining strong standards for design quality, security, testing, maintainability, and responsible use. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role that works closely with product management, engineering, QA, DevOps, security, and subject-matter experts. The role remains hands-on in complex or high-risk areas through design reviews, prototypes, reference implementations, and critical code reviews. 

Key Responsibilities

Application Architecture and Design

- Define target application architectures, reference architectures, and reusable design patterns. 
 - Design end-to-end solutions covering domain models, business services, APIs, user interfaces, persistence, integrations, security, and deployment. 
 - Establish standards for modular application design, service boundaries, API contracts, error handling, configuration, and versioning. 
 - Review major application designs for functional suitability, scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational supportability. 
 - Guide teams in selecting appropriate architectural styles, including modular monoliths, microservices, event-driven components, and workflow-based solutions. 
 - Identify architectural risks, design inconsistencies, and technical debt, and drive practical remediation plans. 
 - Remain hands-on through prototypes, proof-of-concepts, reference implementations, and targeted development in uncertain or high-risk areas. 

AI-Assisted Software Engineering

- Define guidelines for the responsible and effective use of AI coding assistants and generative AI tools across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Establish recommended practices for AI-assisted requirements analysis, architecture, coding, testing, documentation, code review, and troubleshooting. 
 - Define quality gates and review expectations for AI-generated or AI-assisted code. 
 - Develop reusable prompts, templates, coding patterns, architectural context, and development workflows that improve consistency and engineering productivity. 
 - Guide teams in using AI to generate and maintain unit tests, API tests, UI tests, documentation, migration scripts, and technical designs. 
 - Define guardrails for security, privacy, intellectual property, licensing, data handling, and human oversight when using AI tools. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI development tools and recommend their adoption where they provide measurable engineering value.
