Role Description

UST Title - Lead I - Embedded Testing

Who We Are

At UST, we help the world's best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30, 000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact-touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at . 

Role Overview

We are looking for experienced System Validation Engineers to support client's bare-metal platform validation initiatives. The engineers will be responsible for validating system-level functionality across Security, Multimedia, Power, CPU, and Operating Systems, ensuring platform stability, performance, and compliance with specifications. 

The ideal candidates should possess strong technical knowledge of platform specifications, test development and modification, defect triage, and debugging. This role requires engineers who can independently analyse failures, identify root causes, and deliver high-quality validation outcomes in a fast-paced engineering environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- System-Level Validation: Execute system validation on bare-metal platforms across Security, Multimedia, Power Management, CPU, and OS domains. 
 - Specification Analysis: Understand platform specifications, identify differences between hardware or software revisions, and assess their impact on validation coverage. 
 - Test Development and Modification: Adapt existing test cases and validation procedures to accommodate specification changes, new features, and platform requirements. 
 - Test Execution and Reporting: Execute validation suites, analyze results, document failures, and maintain accurate test reports. 
 - Defect Triage and Debugging: Investigate test failures, perform root-cause analysis, isolate issues, and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve defects. 
 - Platform Bring-Up and Validation: Support bare-metal platform bring-up and system-level validation activities across relevant hardware and software configurations. 
 - Quality and Coverage: Identify gaps in test coverage, improve validation methodologies, and ensure robust testing across platform features. 
 - Technical Collaboration: Work closely with hardware, firmware, software, and system engineering teams to resolve technical issues and improve platform quality. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of system-level validation on bare-metal platforms. 
 - Ability to interpret technical specifications and translate requirements into validation scenarios. 
 - Hands-on experience in modifying existing test cases based on specification changes. 
 - Strong debugging, failure analysis, and defect-triage capabilities. 
 - Understanding of CPU architecture, power management, security, multimedia, and OS-related validation concepts. 
 - Experience with hardware/software interaction and platform-level testing. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++ / Python scripting for test development, automation, or debugging, where applicable. 
 - Familiarity with validation tools, debug logs, test automation frameworks, and defect-tracking systems. 

Experience And Qualifications

- 6 to 9 years of relevant experience in system validation, platform validation, firmware validation, or embedded systems testing. 
 - Engineering degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work independently on technical issues and deliver validation results. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Qualcomm Snapdragon platforms or comparable SoC platforms. 
 - Exposure to pre-silicon or post-silicon validation environments. 
 - Experience in bare-metal programming, firmware testing, board bring-up, or low-level system debugging. 
 - Knowledge of ARM architecture, boot flows, hardware registers, interrupts, and memory subsystems. 
 - Experience with JTAG, Lauterbach TRACE32, logic analyzers, or similar debugging tools.

data.title: Senior Privacy Engineer – Automation & Data Mapping
data.description:
Job Description

The Senior Privacy Operations Engineer bridges privacy compliance and technical implementation, architecting, building, and maintaining the tooling, automation, and data infrastructure that powers the company's global privacy program across UK/EU, US, APAC, and other regions. This role works closely with engineering and product teams to operationalize privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default requirements, and owns the technical backbone connecting privacy management platforms (e. g. , OneTrust), work-management systems (e. g. , Azure DevOps, Jira), and the organization's broader data and cloud infrastructure. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role requiring both strong technical depth and working knowledge of global privacy regulatory concepts. 

Key Responsibilities

Privacy Automation Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain automation for privacy operations workflows, including data subject rights fulfillment, data discovery, data mapping, and privacy assessment triggering. 
 - Build and maintain API and Power Automate integrations between privacy management platforms (e. g. , OneTrust) and internal systems (ticketing/ADO/Jira, identity, data stores), including field mapping, assignment logic, bi-directional status sync, and error handling/logging so systems do not drift apart. 
 - Implement risk-based conditional logic and trigger workflows for privacy assessments (PIAs/DPIAs/TIAs) tied to intake or procurement systems, including escalation paths for high-risk triggers and governance/audit trails over the trigger rules themselves. 
 - Design and maintain automated redaction and exception-flagging pipelines (e. g. , keyword/pattern matching, ML classifiers) for DSAR fulfillment, ensuring a mandatory human-review checkpoint before release and maintaining an audit log of redaction decisions. 

Data Mapping & ROPA Infrastructure

- Build and maintain an automated, event-driven data flow inventory and data mapping pipeline, tied to system/vendor intake and procurement processes rather than periodic manual surveys. 
 - Build and maintain integrations with data discovery and classification tooling (e. g. , OneTrust Data Discovery, BigID, Collibra, AWS Macie, Azure Purview, database crawlers) to automatically feed classifications and data flows into ROPA records. 
 - Implement drift-detection mechanisms that reconcile ROPA records against discovery/mapping tool outputs, and support metrics such as percentage of ROPA records reviewed within a defined window. 
 - Support technical aspects of privacy impact assessments, including data flow diagrams and system/architecture review. 

Privacy-by-Design Engineering & Product Collaboration

- Partner with engineering and product teams to implement privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default controls within products and internal systems. 
 - Assist in the technical implementation of data retention and deletion requirements across structured and unstructured data sources. 
 - Advise engineering teams on technical architecture considerations for new products and features from a privacy and data protection perspective. 

Program Tooling, Reporting & Observability

- Build and maintain KPI dashboards and reporting pipelines (e. g. , ADO Analytics, Power BI) that translate raw work-item and automation data into executive-ready privacy program metrics (DSAR SLA compliance, assessment backlog, incident response times). 
 - Monitor and report on the health of privacy tooling and automated processes, troubleshooting integration or data-quality issues as they arise. 
 - Maintain governance over report definitions and automation/trigger rule changes so metrics and workflows remain consistent and trustworthy over time. 

DSAR & Assessment Automation at Scale

- Design and maintain automated routing of DSAR tasks with data-owner mapping across multiple systems, SLA tracking tied to statutory deadlines, and tiered escalation as deadlines approach. 
 - Build scalable automation and surge-capacity mechanisms (triage automation, templated responses) to support DSAR volume spikes, incorporating lessons learned into ongoing process improvements. 
 - Support automation of assessment intake quality, including conditional required fields, real-time validation, and automated reminders to reduce incomplete submissions. 

Required Qualifications

- 5-7 years of experience in a data engineering, software engineering, or technical privacy/compliance engineering role, ideally supporting privacy or compliance operations at a global or multinational organization. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (e. g. , Python, SQL) and demonstrated experience building and maintaining API integrations and automated workflows (e. g. , Power Automate, custom scripts, middleware). 
 - Hands-on experience building integrations between privacy management platforms (e. g. , OneTrust, BigID, Collibra) and internal systems (ticketing/ADO/Jira, identity, data stores), including field mapping, assignment logic, and bi-directional status sync with error handling. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining automated data discovery and data mapping pipelines across structured and unstructured data sources (e. g. , AWS Macie, Azure Purview, database crawlers) that feed ROPA records. 
 - Experience implementing risk-based conditional logic and trigger workflows for privacy assessments (PIA/DPIA/TIA) tied to intake or procurement systems. 
 - Experience building reporting/analytics pipelines (e. g. , ADO Analytics, Power BI) that translate raw operational data into KPI dashboards for privacy program leadership. 
 - Solid understanding of core privacy concepts (data minimization, purpose limitation, data subject rights, retention) and global privacy regulations (UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, or similar) as applied to technical system design. 
 - Experience working with structured and unstructured data across multiple systems and cloud environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with privacy management platforms (e. g. , OneTrust, BigID, Collibra) and their APIs/connector frameworks. 
 - CIPT certification. 
 - Experience with cloud data infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including native discovery/classification services (e. g. , Macie, Purview). 
 - Experience building automated redaction/exception-flagging pipelines with tuned accuracy and governed human-review checkpoints. 
 - Experience supporting DSAR automation at scale, including SLA tracking/escalation design and volume-spike scaling strategies. 
 - Experience designing event-driven data mapping architectures integrated with CMDB/asset inventory or cloud discovery tooling. 

Skills & Competencies

- Strong systems-design thinking with the ability to balance automation against defensibility and risk 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global engineering, legal, and privacy teams 
 - Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across integrated systems 
 - Adaptability to evolving regulatory and technical requirements 
 - Clear communication skills to translate technical architecture into terms non-technical privacy and legal stakeholders can act on

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

data.title: Sr. Engineer - Product Design Validation(Testing & V&V)
data.description:
Position Summary

Product Validation, a global function within Milacron's Technology & Innovation organization, is seeking a results-oriented Senior Engineer. The role will plan and execute validation of injection molding machines, systems, subsystems, and critical components to verify functional performance, reliability, durability, safety, regulatory compliance, and readiness for production release. The Senior Engineer will convert product and design requirements into robust validation plans, acquire and analyze test data, identify design risks and failure mechanisms, and provide evidence-based recommendations to Engineering, Controls, Application, Quality, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Product Management, and Service teams. 

Essential/Key Functions Of The Job

Keeping product performance, consistency, safety, and reliability at the core, the Senior Engineer - Product Validation will perform the following responsibilities: 

- Collaborate with NPD, Product Engineering, Controls/Electronics, Application, Quality, Manufacturing, Service, and Product Management teams to understand product requirements and translate them into a clear Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP&R), test matrix, instrumentation plan, acceptance criteria, schedule, and resource requirement. 
 - Review technical specifications, drawings, hydraulic and electrical schematics, control sequences, DFMEA outputs, risk assessments, customer requirements, and lessons learned to ensure adequate validation coverage and traceability. 
 - Plan, set up, and execute functional, performance, endurance, reliability, thermal, hydraulic, electrical, structural, noise, vibration, energy-consumption, safety, and application trials on complete machines, systems, subsystems, and components. 
 - Perform testing in accordance with applicable Milacron procedures and relevant standards such as EUROMAP, ISO, EN, IEC, UL/NFPA, and customer-specific requirements, as applicable to the product and market. 
 - Define instrumentation and acquire synchronized test data using calibrated pressure, temperature, flow, force, strain, displacement, vibration, speed, electrical power, current, voltage, and other sensors together with suitable DAQ systems. 
 - Set up and operate DAQ and test data analysis platforms such as HBK QuantumX/Catman or Siemens Simcenter Testlab or National Instruments LabVIEW, or equivalent tools; ensure correct sampling, sensor configuration, signal conditioning, filtering, time synchronization, and data integrity. 
 - Analyze test data using time-domain, frequency-domain, statistical, trend, correlation, cycle-counting, fatigue, thermal, hydraulic, and performance methods; convert results into clear engineering conclusions and actionable design recommendations. 
 - Evaluate machine performance parameters such as cycle time, platen movement, injection speed and pressure, repeatability, energy consumption, temperature stability, hydraulic pressure and flow, clamp force, vibration, deflection, strain, and subsystem response against approved acceptance criteria. 
 - Lead structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of failures using methods such as 5 Why, Ishikawa, fault-tree analysis, design-of-experiments, comparative testing, teardown inspection, and correlation with simulation or field data. 
 - Work with responsible design owners to define corrective actions, verify fixes through re-testing, document residual risks, and support technical closure before design or product release. 
 - Apply DFMEA, reliability science, accelerated life testing, duty-cycle analysis, Weibull/life-data concepts, and test-to-failure approaches, where appropriate, to assess robustness and predict product or component life. 
 - Develop repeatable validation methods, fixtures, test rigs, automation scripts, templates, checklists, and standard work to improve laboratory capability, data quality, test efficiency, and global consistency. 
 - Create concise validation reports containing objective, configuration, instrumentation, procedure, raw and processed data, acceptance criteria, observations, deviations, photographs, conclusions, risks, and recommendations; maintain complete data and configuration traceability. 
 - Maintain validation schedules, test logs, issue trackers, calibration records, equipment utilization, and regular visibility of progress, risks, and decisions to Product Chief Engineers, Product Validation leadership, and relevant stakeholders. 
 - Support benchmarking of competitor machines and assessment of NPD products to generate performance evidence for product strategy, product management, sales, and customer-facing technical discussions without compromising test integrity. 
 - Travel to customer and supplier sites for field validation, critical issue resolution, component trials, supplier development, and pre-validation activities, with appropriate planning, safety controls, and documentation. 
 - Partner with Sourcing and Supplier Quality to evaluate new suppliers, alternate components, localization opportunities, and new technologies through qualification plans, first-article testing, and performance/reliability validation. 
 - Maintain calibration and functional readiness of instruments, sensors, DAQ systems, fixtures, and laboratory equipment; identify capability gaps and raise justified requests for tools, sensors, software, training, and infrastructure. 

Eligibility/Required Qualifications

- Total experience at least 5-7years in field of testing, validation, R&D in the machinery industries (for example but not limited to, Injection molding machineries, Automotive & sister industries, Hydraulic industry, Steel, Heavy machineries) with high/standard production volume. 
 - Bachelor of engineering degree (BE/BTech min required qualification) in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Instrumentations, Control & automation, Electronics, or similar engineering discipline from an accredited 4-year college or university. 
 - Good analytical skills are required to drive the functional needs from product performance & reliability. 
 - Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in product testing, validation, reliability, R&D testing, or test engineering within injection molding machinery, industrial machinery, automotive, hydraulics, heavy equipment, machine tools, or a comparable engineered-product industry. 
 - Demonstrated ability to develop validation plans, define measurable acceptance criteria, execute complex tests, analyze data, and produce release-quality technical reports. 
 - Hands-on experience with measurement of pressure, flow, temperature, force, strain, stress, vibration, displacement, speed, electrical parameters, and other machine-performance variables. 
 - Hands-on experience with DAQ systems and software such as Siemens Simcenter Testlab, HBK QuantumX/Catman, NI LabVIEW, nCode, or equivalent platforms, including sensor selection, signal conditioning, sampling, filtering, and data management. 
 - Working knowledge of hydraulics, electrical and electronic systems, sensors, instrumentation, servo systems, controls, mechanical structures, thermal systems, and machinery safety. 
 - Ability to read and interpret hydraulic and electrical schematics, general arrangement drawings, manufacturing drawings, layouts, specifications, control sequences, and engineering BOMs. 
 - Experience applying DFMEA, DVP&R, root-cause analysis, reliability methods, accelerated testing, and statistical analysis to support successful product launches and resolution of field or laboratory failures. 
 - Working knowledge of applicable machinery validation and safety standards or internal engineering standards, based on product and market requirements. 
 - Strong analytical judgment, troubleshooting ability, attention to detail, disciplined documentation, and ownership of test accuracy and data integrity. 
 - Proficient written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to explain test evidence, technical risks, and recommendations to engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Ability to manage multiple validation assignments, prioritize laboratory resources, work independently with periodic guidance, and travel to customer or supplier sites when required. 

Who We Are

Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company's 1, 900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27, 000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron's global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America. 

Eeo

The policy of Milacron is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@milacron. com. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer II

Role Overview: As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability-ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. 
 - Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. 
 - Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability-codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks-operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. 
 - Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery. 
 - Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement-rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable. 
 - Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production-holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. 
 - Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering-cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering-together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. 
 - Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate-and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. 
 - Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
 - Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 
 - 5+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C#/. NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks. 
 - 3+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large-scale systems-defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging-e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre-production and production; and segregation-of-duties controls (least-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk. 
 - 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP-including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI-plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure-as-code, networking, and multi-environment management. 
 - Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production-their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side. 
 - Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e. g. , LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e. g. , Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution). 
 - Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. 
 - Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e. g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale. 
 - Platform admin for reporting Tools: Tableau, Qlik SaaS, ETL tools : Informatica IICS/MDM, SAP BODS, BOE or SLT

Databricks, AWS cloud practitioner

Other: 

- Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build. 
 - Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

data.title: Principal Emulation IP Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. Sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe does not faze you. You walk out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. Ask the right questions, push back when something does not make sense, and move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high-speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high-performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best-in-class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting-edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
 - Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
 - Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
 - You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work. You read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
 - You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
 - You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
 - Mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification comes naturally to you, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
 - You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
data.description:
About RocketlaneRocketlane is a B2B SaaS platform for client onboarding and project delivery. Our product runs on a set of microservices that power projects, resourcing, time tracking, billing and a customer-facing portal. We're also building Nitro, an AI-native layer where Nitro agents do real delivery work for our customers. 

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test who can test both: the core platform, and the GenAI and agentic features we build on top of it. 

This is not a "run the regression suite and file tickets" role. You'll own quality for the areas you cover, from functional testing to automation to release sign-off. 

What you'll own
 - Functional testing: Understand features end to end, from requirements to edge cases. Write test plans and test cases, and run exploratory testing before every release. 

- UI and end-to-end automation: Build and maintain Playwright suites in TypeScript for critical user journeys. Keep them fast, stable and free of flaky tests. 

- API and microservices testing: Test REST APIs and the contracts between services. Cover authentication, permissions, data validation and error handling. 

- Distributed systems testing: Test asynchronous flows, background jobs and event-driven workflows across services. Check for data consistency, retries, idempotency and behaviour when a downstream service fails or slows down. 

- Performance and reliability: Run load and performance tests on key services and workflows. Find bottlenecks before customers do. 

- GenAI and agentic testing: Test Nitro agents and other GenAI features for accuracy, consistency and safe behaviour. Build eval suites, curate test datasets from real scenarios, and check tool-use accuracy and handoff to humans. 

- CI/CD and release quality: Wire automated suites into CI so every change is checked before it ships. Provide quality sign-off for the areas you cover. 

- Frameworks and documentation: Enhance our existing test frameworks and tools. Document test strategies, test cases and guidelines for the team. 

Requirements
 - 4-7 years in software testing and test automation for web applications

- Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Java or Python for test automation

- Solid programming fundamentals: data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design, applied to writing clean, maintainable test code

- Hands-on experience with Playwright or Selenium for UI and end-to-end testing, including building and maintaining a framework

- Strong functional testing skills: breaking down requirements, writing test cases and finding edge cases

- Experience testing REST APIs and microservices, including service-to-service contracts

- A good understanding of distributed systems: async processing, queues or events, eventual consistency and partial failures, and how to test for them

- Exposure to testing GenAI or agentic features, and an understanding of how they fail (hallucination, non-deterministic output, tool misuse)

- CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Daily use of AI coding agents, and the judgement to review the test code they write

- Excellent written communication: bug reports an engineer can act on without a meeting

Nice to have
 - Experience with an LLM eval framework (such as DeepEval, Promptfoo or RAGAS)

- Load testing experience (k6, Locust or similar)

- Security testing experience, including for AI applications

Why this roleYou'll join a team that already tests and automates our platform and AI features, and help raise the bar as both grow. You'll work across the full product: core workflows, the services behind them, and the Nitro agents built on top. You'll work directly with the engineers and PMs building them, and your quality sign-off is a key input to every release. If you want to grow from strong product testing into AI testing, this role is for you.

data.title: SASE Firewall QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

NETGEAR is looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help validate our next-generation firewall and cybersecurity platform. In this role, you will build and maintain automated tests that verify firewall behavior across critical security domains including Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW), Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Web Gateways (SWG), Virtual Private Networks (VPN), and Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN). 

Working alongside firewall developers and senior QA engineers, you will automate functional, regression, and performance testing against real and simulated network traffic. You will not be expected to know every area of the stack on day one - we will support you in growing across it. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain automated test suites that validate firewall functionality - policy and rule evaluation, NAT, stateful session handling, and traffic filtering across NGFW, SASE, ZTNA, SWG, VPN, and SD-WAN features. 
 - Build and maintain test topologies and lab environments, including virtual machines, containers, and physical firewall appliances. 
 - Generate and shape realistic network traffic to exercise the firewall data plane, and verify observed behavior against expected policy outcomes. 
 - Run test suites in CI, triage failures, distinguish product defects from environment and test issues, and file clear, reproducible defect reports with supporting packet captures and logs. 
 - Contribute to test plans and test-case design from firewall requirements, and help keep automation coverage mapped to those test cases. 
 - Support performance and scale testing - throughput, connections per second, and concurrent sessions - and help identify regressions. 
 - Work with developers to improve testability, and stay current with automation tooling, including AI-assisted test generation, maintenance, and failure triage. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 2-4 years of professional experience in QA automation or test engineering, preferably for networking or security products. 
 - Strong automation scripting ability in Python and Bash, comfort working in Ubuntu or other Linux environments from the command line, and day-to-day use of Git. 
 - Working knowledge of networking protocols and traffic flows - TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, NAT, and routing fundamentals. 
 - Understanding of firewall fundamentals such as packet filtering, stateful connection tracking, NAT, and rule and policy evaluation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux networking and firewall tooling - iptables and nftables rule configuration, conntrack for session inspection, and iproute2 (ip addr, ip route, network namespaces, bridges, VLANs) for building and inspecting test topologies. 
 - Proficient in analyzing logs and network captures using tools such as Wireshark, tshark, and tcpdump. 
 - Experience with a test framework and runner such as pytest or Robot Framework. 
 - Experience with REST API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or scripted HTTP clients, for validating firewall management and policy APIs. 
 - Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). 
 - Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools (e. g. , Jira, TestRail, Xray), and good communication skills in an agile, cross-functional team. 

Preferred Qualifications (optional)

- Experience with traffic generation, shaping, and impairment tools such as iperf3, Scapy, hping3, tc/netem, TRex, or commercial testers like Spirent or Ixia. 
 - Contributions to open-source security or networking projects. 
 - Exposure to firewall security testing - IPS/IDS signature validation, TLS/SSL inspection, URL filtering, and threat-feed verification. 
 - Familiarity with virtualization and container tooling for building test labs - Docker and Docker Compose, VMware or KVM, Kubernetes - and with infrastructure-as-code such as Ansible or Terraform. 
 - Exposure to performance and scale testing, and to high-availability and failover validation. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic testing tools - for example LLM-assisted test generation, self-healing test maintenance, or agent-based exploratory testing - and an interest in applying them to network security test suites. 
 - Experience automating network devices and appliances over SSH and CLI using libraries such as Paramiko or Netmiko. 
 - Familiarity with certificate and PKI tooling such as OpenSSL, for generating test certificates and validating TLS/SSL inspection behavior. 
 - Experience validating firewall logging and telemetry - syslog, NetFlow, or IPFIX export - against expected policy events. 

Company Statement

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live. 

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. You'll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture. 

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity. 

NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Job Description: 

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world's largest enterprises. 

Cloudera IT team is seeking a talented, motivated, and passionate Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevOps) to join the Infrastructure Engineering team within our Technical Operations organization. In this role, you will build and maintain the automation, tooling, and self-service capabilities that enable software engineering teams to consume and integrate with our private cloud environment quickly, safely, and consistently. 

You will play a hands-on part in Cloudera IT's Enterprise-as-Code (EaC) evolution-applying our EaC standard, developed in collaboration with the EaC Platform Architect, to bring infrastructure, network, configuration, and policy under version control. Working closely with our Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer alongside our Sr Infrastructure Solutions Engineer, Sr Platform Operations Engineers, and Sr Systems Engineers, you will support Enterprise Cloud Services Operations, Networking, and Service Desk teams by turning recurring manual processes into automated workflows-making the right way the easy way while growing your DevOps skills on an experienced team. 

As an Infrastructure Automation Engineer you will: 

- Build, test, and maintain automation and tooling (scripts, CLIs, Terraform modules, Ansible roles, pipelines, and self-service workflows) that enable software engineering teams to provision and integrate with our private cloud environment. 
 - Bring creativity and curiosity to everyday automation work by proposing new approaches, building prototypes, and iterating on tools based on user feedback. 
 - Implement infrastructure and configuration as code aligned with IT's Enterprise-as-Code (EaC) and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards-following conventions for repository structure, module design, code review, testing, versioning, and promotion across environments, including bringing manually managed resources under code. 
 - Contribute to improving the EaC standard by sharing gaps, friction points, and improvement ideas from day-to-day implementation with the Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer and the EaC Platform Architect. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform services using GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions, aligned with the EaC standard and incorporating automated linting, testing, security scanning, and policy checks. 
 - Support the Enterprise Cloud Services Operations team by codifying private and public cloud resources and automating operational runbooks. 
 - Support the Networking team with network automation and source-of-truth initiatives (e. g. , NetBox/Nautobot, Ansible, Terraform), such as DNS/IPAM and firewall configuration as code. 
 - Support the Service Desk team by automating repetitive requests and connecting self-service catalog items and ticket workflows (e. g. , ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) to backend automation. 
 - Apply policy-as-code, secrets management, and security controls (e. g. , OPA, HashiCorp Vault) so that automation is secure and compliant by default. 
 - Help software engineering teams onboard to the private cloud by troubleshooting automation and pipeline issues and answering technical questions. 
 - Monitor automation and pipelines, investigate failures and configuration drift, implement fixes, and contribute metrics, logging, and alerting for the tools you build. 
 - Create and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, templates, and examples for your tools. 
 - Participate in a shared on-call rotation to support mission-critical IT services, with clear documentation and runbooks provided. 
 - Grow your skills by collaborating with the Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer and other senior engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing. 

We're excited about you if you have: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or 4+ years of equivalent experience, including 2+ years of hands-on work in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or systems engineering. 
 - Hands-on Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform/OpenTofu and Ansible, including writing or extending modules and roles. 
 - Proficiency in Python and shell scripting, with comfort working with REST APIs and JSON/YAML. 
 - Demonstrated curiosity and creativity in solving problems with automation, supported by examples of tools, scripts, or workflows you have built to eliminate manual work. 
 - Experience with Git workflows (branching, pull requests, code review) and CI/CD tools (e. g. , GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 
 - Working knowledge of private cloud platforms (e. g. , OpenStack, VMware vSphere/VCF) and/or public cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Familiarity with containers (Docker) and basic Kubernetes concepts. 
 - Solid Linux systems administration skills (e. g. , Red Hat, Rocky, Ubuntu). 
 - Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, load balancing). 
 - A security-aware mindset covering secrets management, service accounts, and least-privilege practices. 
 - Good communication skills and a customer-focused approach to supporting internal engineering and operations teams. 
 - Comfort working within shared engineering standards, with a willingness to contribute improvements through collaboration and code review. 

You may also have:

data.description:

Job Description: 

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world's largest enterprises. 

Cloudera IT team is seeking a talented, motivated, and passionate Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevOps) to join the Infrastructure Engineering team within our Technical Operations organization. In this role, you will build and maintain the automation, tooling, and self-service capabilities that enable software engineering teams to consume and integrate with our private cloud environment quickly, safely, and consistently. 

You will play a hands-on part in Cloudera IT's Enterprise-as-Code (EaC) evolution-applying our EaC standard, developed in collaboration with the EaC Platform Architect, to bring infrastructure, network, configuration, and policy under version control. Working closely with our Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer alongside our Sr Infrastructure Solutions Engineer, Sr Platform Operations Engineers, and Sr Systems Engineers, you will support Enterprise Cloud Services Operations, Networking, and Service Desk teams by turning recurring manual processes into automated workflows-making the right way the easy way while growing your DevOps skills on an experienced team. 

As an Infrastructure Automation Engineer you will: 

- Build, test, and maintain automation and tooling (scripts, CLIs, Terraform modules, Ansible roles, pipelines, and self-service workflows) that enable software engineering teams to provision and integrate with our private cloud environment. 
 - Bring creativity and curiosity to everyday automation work by proposing new approaches, building prototypes, and iterating on tools based on user feedback. 
 - Implement infrastructure and configuration as code aligned with IT's Enterprise-as-Code (EaC) and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards-following conventions for repository structure, module design, code review, testing, versioning, and promotion across environments, including bringing manually managed resources under code. 
 - Contribute to improving the EaC standard by sharing gaps, friction points, and improvement ideas from day-to-day implementation with the Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer and the EaC Platform Architect. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform services using GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions, aligned with the EaC standard and incorporating automated linting, testing, security scanning, and policy checks. 
 - Support the Enterprise Cloud Services Operations team by codifying private and public cloud resources and automating operational runbooks. 
 - Support the Networking team with network automation and source-of-truth initiatives (e. g. , NetBox/Nautobot, Ansible, Terraform), such as DNS/IPAM and firewall configuration as code. 
 - Support the Service Desk team by automating repetitive requests and connecting self-service catalog items and ticket workflows (e. g. , ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) to backend automation. 
 - Apply policy-as-code, secrets management, and security controls (e. g. , OPA, HashiCorp Vault) so that automation is secure and compliant by default. 
 - Help software engineering teams onboard to the private cloud by troubleshooting automation and pipeline issues and answering technical questions. 
 - Monitor automation and pipelines, investigate failures and configuration drift, implement fixes, and contribute metrics, logging, and alerting for the tools you build. 
 - Create and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, templates, and examples for your tools.

data.title: Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

The Cloud/Infrastructure Engineer will help design, implement, and maintain our organization's cloud and on-premise infrastructure. This role owns day-to-day infrastructure work independently while contributing to broader strategy alongside senior engineers. The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of system stability, monitoring, and performance optimization, and can troubleshoot complex issues and drive practical solutions with limited oversight. 

YOUR IMPACT

At Redwood, we strive to automate and optimize our operations and application integrations to support the scale of our business and customer needs. As an observability engineer, you will build and maintain systems that collect, analyze, and visualize data from software applications and infrastructure. You will provide insight into system health and performance, enable proactive problem identification, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of our observability solutions in partnership with other teams. 

Responsibilities

- Implement Infrastructure Strategy: Contribute to the design and implement infrastructure initiatives, including data collection pipelines, data processing, and visualization dashboards, with scalability and performance in mind. This includes metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting to provide end-to-end visibility into system behavior. 
 - System Monitoring and Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to optimize efficiency and reliability, including proactive identification of potential issues and preventative measures. 
 - Incident Response and Troubleshooting: Respond to incidents, troubleshoot complex system issues, and perform root cause analysis to help prevent future occurrences. 
 - Tooling and Infrastructure: Configure, manage, and maintain observability tooling and infrastructure (log aggregation, metric collection, distributed tracing, alerting), and contribute to tool evaluation and selection. Work with tools such as Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic, VictoriaMetrics, and similar to capture relevant metrics, logs, and traces. 
 - Alerting and Incident Management: Configure and maintain alerts based on defined thresholds and anomalies, ensuring timely notification of potential issues and supporting rapid incident response. 
 - Data Analysis and Troubleshooting: Analyze collected data to identify performance bottlenecks, root causes, and trends within complex systems, collaborating with engineering teams to resolve problems. 
 - Automation and Optimization: Develop and implement automation for monitoring and alerting to improve response times and reduce manual effort. Create automations for repetitive tasks (e. g. , RMJ automation for new employees). 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with development, operations, and other teams to apply cloud and infrastructure best practices across the software development lifecycle, ensuring proper instrumentation and data collection. 
 - Capacity Planning: Use observability data to identify potential capacity constraints and support infrastructure scaling decisions. 
 - Security and Compliance: Support security and compliance efforts, including access reviews, in line with organizational requirements. 
 - Problem Solving: Resolve challenges related to system stability, data connectivity, and application configurations. 
 - Dashboard Development: Build and maintain comprehensive, user-friendly dashboards that provide real-time insights into system health, key performance indicators, and operational metrics. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 3-5 years of systems administration/engineering experience. 
 - Solid understanding of Windows Server and Linux systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with layer 2/3 networking, including VLANs, routing, and ACLs; experience with multi-vendor switches and firewalls (e. g. , HP, Dell, Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Sophos) a plus.

 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes).

 - Experience configuring IPSec VPN tunnels, with familiarity with BGP routing and subnet peering across hybrid cloud environments.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present findings to cross-functional teams.

Position Title: QA Engineer |||

About Americana Restaurants International PLC

Americana Restaurants International PLC is a pioneering force in the MENA region and Kazakhstan's Out-of-Home Dining industry, ranking among the world's leading operators of Quick Service Restaurants (QSR) and casual dining establishments. With an extensive portfolio of iconic global brands and a dominant regional presence, we have been driving growth and innovation for over 60 years. 

Our expansive network of 2, 600+ restaurants spans 12 countries throughout the Middle East, North Africa, and Kazakhstan - from Kazakhstan in the east to Morocco in the west - powered by a team of 40, 000+ talented individuals committed to delivering exceptional food, superior service, and memorable experiences. 

In line with our vision for innovation and operational excellence, we have established our Center of Excellence in Mohali, India. This state-of-the-art facility plays a pivotal role in Product Development, IT, Digital, AI, and Analytics, while implementing global IT best practices. Serving as a strategic hub, it strengthens our technology backbone and drives digital transformation across our worldwide operations. 

Your Impact: 

- Data Quality Testing: 
 - Perform data validation to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data across all stages of the ETL pipeline (Extract, Transform, Load). 
 - Verify that data transformations are executed correctly and that business rules are applied properly. 
 - Perform data reconciliation between source systems and target data stores to ensure completeness and correctness. 
 - Automation and Scripting: 
 - Design and implement automated test scripts for validating ETL processes and Big Data pipelines. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation frameworks for scalable and repeatable testing processes. 
 - Work with CI/CD pipelines to ensure automated testing is integrated into the build and deployment process for continuous quality validation. 
 - Performance and Scalability Testing: 
 - Conduct performance testing on ETL processes and Big Data pipelines to assess scalability and efficiency. 
 - Monitor and evaluate the data processing speed, resource utilization, and overall system performance under varying loads. 
 - Collaborate with data engineers to optimize pipeline performance based on test results. 
 - Big Data Platform Validation: 
 - Ensure data accuracy and consistency in large-scale distributed systems like Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Presto, or Kafka. 
 - Perform end-to-end testing across the data flow to validate the transformation, integration, and storage of large datasets. 
 - Validate the integration of ETL pipelines with Big Data tools and databases (e. g. , HDFS, NoSQL, relational databases). 
 - Data Integration and Automation Testing: 
 - Validate integration between multiple data sources (relational databases, NoSQL databases, APIs, external data systems) and the Big Data platform. 
 - Test data exchange across heterogeneous systems, ensuring data is transferred, transformed, and loaded without errors or data loss. 
 - Bug Identification and Troubleshooting: 
 - Identify, document, and track defects found during testing and work closely with the development team to resolve issues. 
 - Perform root cause analysis for defects in data pipelines or data quality issues and ensure they are properly addressed. 
 - Retest fixed issues and ensure regression testing is done to verify that changes did not impact existing workflows. 
 - Documentation and Reporting: 
 - Provide regular test progress reports and communicate the status of testing efforts, including any critical issues or blockers, to stakeholders. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, 
 - 4 + years of experience in QA testing with a focus on CDP, ETL processes and Big Data platforms. 
 - Strong knowledge of ETL processes and understanding of data pipeline architectures (e. g. , Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Hive, Presto). 
 - Experience with Big Data platforms (HDFS, Hive, HBase, Presto, etc. ) and distributed computing environments. 
 - Proficiency in writing and executing SQL queries to validate data across various platforms. 
 - Experience with automation frameworks and tools for ETL testing, such as Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, PyTest, or similar. 
 - Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, and other collaboration tools for issue tracking and test management. 
 - Strong scripting skills in languages such as Python, Java, Scala, or Bash. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD processes and integration testing in an Agile environment. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues related to data quality, transformation, and integration. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

You will bridge cloud-native engineering and quality engineering by building production-grade test infrastructure, benchmarking systems across AWS, Azure, and Kubernetes, and setting technical excellence standards across the engineering organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architecture, Multi-Cloud & K8s Infrastructure Leadership
 - Cloud-Native Test Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable, extensible test automation frameworks and harnesses across AWS and Azure environments. 
 - Kubernetes Automation: Architect dynamic, containerized test infrastructure leveraging Kubernetes (K8s) to spin up ephemeral test clusters, mock environments, and end-to-end integration environments on demand. 
 - Technical Strategy: Drive the overall test and quality strategy across cloud and local topologies, establishing best practices for unit, integration, microservices, chaos, and performance testing. 
 - CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated validation systems into localized and cloud-based Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps). 
 - Domain-Specific Ownership
 - Scale Connectors: Build robust testing tools to validate high-volume data connectors, API integrations, and ingestion pipelines across multi-cloud setups (AWS S3/SQS, Azure Blob/Event Hubs). Stress test for concurrency, throughput, message loss, network degradation, and cloud cost efficiency at scale. 
 - Graph Engine & Traversal: Architect test matrices and verification suites for complex Graph databases/architectures (e. g. , AWS Neptune, Neo4j, GraphQL), verifying node-edge relationship queries, indexing performance, and path traversal correctness under heavy concurrent loads. 
 - Reporting & Analytics: Validate data fidelity, aggregation logic, latency, and correctness across high-volume reporting engines and dynamic query visualization platforms. 
 - Local System Testing: Drive local environment and system-level integration testing in our San Jose lab/office-ensuring localized hardware/software dependencies, edge topologies, and containerized local Kubernetes environments (e. g. , Minikube, K3s, Kind) operate seamlessly under real-world scenarios. 
 - Quality Engineering & Operations
 - Identify architectural bottlenecks, reliability risks, and memory leaks before features hit production across AWS, Azure, and local systems. 
 - Establish standard observability, distributed tracing (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog), and automated reporting dashboards to expose systemic quality issues and pipeline health. 
 - Code review, mentor, and elevate the technical engineering bar across development and quality engineering teams. 

Basic Qualifications

 - Coding Proficiency: Advanced expertise in at least one modern object-oriented language (Java, Python, C++, or Go) with a proven background writing production-level code. 
 - Cloud Platforms (AWS & Azure): Hands-on experience developing test strategies, automating infrastructure, and testing applications deployed on AWS (e. g. , EC2, EKS, S3, Lambda) and Azure (e. g. , AKS, Blob Storage, Event Hubs). 
 - Kubernetes (K8s) & Containerization: Deep experience with Docker and Kubernetes orchestration-ability to write Helm charts, manage K8s test manifests, and debug containerized microservices in distributed clusters. 
 - Distributed Systems & Scale: Proven experience testing, debugging, and benchmarking high-scale distributed systems, data pipelines, APIs (REST/gRPC), and streaming architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc. ). 
 - Graph & Data Layer: Experience testing Graph-based architectures/databases (e. g. , AWS Neptune, Neo4j, GraphQL) and relational/non-relational data stores. 

Preferred Qualifications

data.title: Controls Engineer (PLC and Automation)
data.description:
About Harley Instruments

Harley Instruments has been a trusted for scientific and research institutions and firms since 1979, providing advanced scientific instrumentation and dedicated after-sales support to research and industrial customers across India. Our portfolio includes electron microscopy sample preparation, PVD/CVD, plasma cleaning and etching, thin-film metrology, magnetic field cancellation, laser micromachining and diamond wire sawing. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Controls Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of developing a PLC-based control system for a new thin-film deposition system. This is a ground-up machine development role: from understanding requirements and designing the controls architecture to selecting and procuring hardware, programming, integration, testing and commissioning. This is not a routine PLC maintenance role. Candidates must have personally built and commissioned PLC-based automation systems from scratch. 

Key Responsibilities

• Own the controls project end to end: Translate machine requirements into an executable plan, architecture, schedule and commissioning strategy. 

• Design the controls architecture: Define PLC, I/O, HMI, sensors, actuators, drives, controllers, electrical panels and communication interfaces. 

• Program PLC and HMI: Develop machine sequences, operating modes, alarms, diagnostics, permissives and interlocks using appropriate PLC languages. 

• Select and procure hardware: Prepare I/O lists and BOMs, identify components, evaluate vendors, obtain quotations and coordinate procurement. 

• Develop electrical documentation: Prepare electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules and control-system documentation. 

• Integrate machine subsystems: Interface the PLC with pumps, valves, vacuum gauges, mass-flow controllers, temperature controllers and other equipment as required. 

• Test and commission: Carry out I/O checks, debugging, functional and safety-interlock testing, system integration and machine commissioning. 

• Drive execution with the team: Coordinate with mechanical, electrical and process engineers; resolve technical issues and maintain project documentation. 

  

Controls Engineer - PLC & Automation

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline. 

• 3-5 years of hands-on experience in PLC programming and industrial automation. 

• Demonstrated experience designing, building and commissioning at least one PLC-based machine or automation system from scratch. 

• Practical experience in hardware selection, I/O planning, electrical drawings, PLC/HMI development, integration and commissioning. 

• Hands-on PLC experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Mitsubishi, Beckhoff or an equivalent industrial platform. 

• Working knowledge of Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram and/or Structured Text; HMI development; and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP. 

• Good understanding of digital/analogue I/O, 4-20 mA, 0-10 V, sensors, actuators, drives, PID control and machine interlocks. 

• Able to plan work independently, make sound technical decisions and take responsibility for delivery with minimal supervision. 

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with vacuum systems, PVD/CVD, thin-film deposition, plasma systems or scientific/process equipment. 

• Experience integrating vacuum gauges, mass-flow controllers (MFCs), pressure and temperature controllers. 

• Exposure to control-panel fabrication, vendor coordination and machine-safety circuits. 

How to Apply

Apply through the Harley Instruments LinkedIn Job Profile or share your CV and cover letter via: 

E-mail: nilesh@harleyinstruments. co. in / hr@harleyinstruments. co. in

Website: harleyinstruments. co. in | +91 20 2422 0602

or by DMing the company LinkedIn ID

The GW Test Automation Lead will drive quality engineering and test automation initiatives for enterprise-level insurance applications built on the Guidewire InsuranceSuite platform. This senior-level role combines hands-on automation development, technical leadership, and deep insurance domain expertise to ensure application quality, reliability, and performance. The successful candidate will design and maintain scalable automation frameworks while overseeing functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing activities. Working closely with developers, business analysts, solution architects, and QA teams, the role will support quality assurance throughout the software development lifecycle. The position also plays a key role in integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and improving testing efficiency across projects. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced QA professional to lead automation strategies, mentor engineering teams, and contribute to large-scale digital transformation initiatives in the insurance sector. 

Accountabilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components for Guidewire InsuranceSuite applications.

 - Lead testing activities across Guidewire InsuranceSuite applications, including PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and BillingCenter. 
 - Validate critical insurance business processes, including policy submission and issuance, endorsements, renewals, cancellations, reinstatements, claims processing, billing, and payment workflows.

 - Develop and execute automated API tests for REST and SOAP services using tools such as REST Assured, Postman, or equivalent technologies.

 - Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, defect management, and software testing techniques. 
 - Ability to translate business requirements into comprehensive test cases, automation scenarios, and effective testing strategies. 
 - Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to quality and detail.
