Trusted by millions-from startups to Fortune 500 companies-SurveyMonkey helps teams gather insights and information that inspire better decisions, create experiences people love, and drive business growth. Discover how at surveymonkey. com. 

What We're Looking For

SurveyMonkey's Platform Operations team owns the reliability, security, and cloud infrastructure layer that keeps SurveyMonkey running. We're looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to own a major area of that foundation end to end and raise the operational bar across the team. 

What You'll Be Working On

- Own a major infrastructure area end to end: the Kubernetes platform, cloud networking, search, or observability
 - Design and operate cloud networking, including VPCs, routing, load balancing, DNS, and cross-environment connectivity
 - Manage cloud account structure, IAM, and access governance
 - Lead upgrades and migrations of managed infrastructure services with minimal customer impact
 - Own OpenSearch operations at scale, including capacity planning, index and shard strategy, cluster migrations, and version upgrades
 - Design observability strategy, including SLOs, telemetry pipelines, alerting, and cost efficiency
 - Plan and run disaster recovery and resilience exercises
 - Evaluate infrastructure options and document decisions in design docs or ADRs
 - Build reusable tools and convert complex procedures into SOPs others can run
 - Use cost and efficiency metrics to demonstrate improvements
 - Mentor engineers and act as primary contact for initiatives
 - Participate in on-call and extended-hours coverage rotations supporting 24x7 operations

We'd love to hear from people with

- 8+ years in SRE, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure
 - Deep AWS experience across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, and DNS
 - Terraform or similar infrastructure as code at scale
 - Production Kubernetes operations, including upgrades and autoscaling
 - Observability design using open standards such as OpenTelemetry
 - Production experience operating OpenSearch or Elasticsearch at scale, including index design, shard balancing, and cluster migrations
 - Experience with event streaming and caching systems
 - Python or Go
 - Experience leading incident response and disaster recovery

Nice to have

- Container networking (eBPF-based CNIs)
 - Cloud cost optimization
 - Zero Trust access

SurveyMonkey believes in-person collaboration is valuable for building relationships, fostering community, and enhancing our speed and execution in problem-solving and decision-making. 

As such, this opportunity is hybrid and requires you to work from the SurveyMonkey office in Bengaluru 3 days per week. 

- Hybrid

At SurveyMonkey, curiosity powers everything we do. We're a global company where people from all backgrounds can make an impact, build meaningful connections, and grow their careers. We've been trusted by organizations for over 25 years, and we're just getting started. data.title: Design System/UX Engineer
data.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive. 

TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. 

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge - the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panels
 - UX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath - events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading - so what you design flows and works, not just looks good
 - Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- The design system as a real component library - templates and patterns developers implement without friction
 - Agent UI / Control UI interaction patterns
 - Active Listening and Agent Handover UX
 - The graphics language of the product (iconography, motion, data visualization)
 - Accessibility (Lighthouse a11y > 90) and keyboard-first agent flows
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- A self-starter with taste and grit - a designer who ships
 - Show-me mentality: you demo working UI on Fridays like every other engineer
 - You think from the developer's seat: every component you design, you've already thought through how the squads will implement, extend, and theme it - your design system makes them faster, never slower
 - You love new technology, adapt fast when the product shifts weekly, use AI tools daily to multiply velocity, consider yourself exceptional, and like winning. 

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years of product design with real front-end engineering - you ship React + TypeScript, not just specs. 
 - Strong graphics experience - ++++ on visual craft: iconography, motion design, canvas/SVG data visualization, rendering dense live data beautifully and legibly. 
 - Has owned a design system as a living component library in a fast-shipping product - versioned, documented, themed, adopted. 
 - Strong templating discipline - reusable patterns and layout systems built for developer implementation; you understand component APIs, composition, and what makes a pattern cheap or expensive to build. 
 - Understands the tech underneath - WebSocket-driven state, event ordering, render performance, module federation/plugin loading - well enough that your designs never fight the architecture. 
 - Strong on dense, real-time, professional-tool UX (think trading terminals, not marketing sites) - an agent lives in this UI 8 hours a day. 
 - Accessibility and keyboard-first design as defaults, not afterthoughts. 
 - Perceived-performance craft - skeletons, optimistic updates, motion that masks latency; the UI must feel instant even when the network isn't. 
 - Design tokens as the theming backbone - enterprise customers will want branding; tokens make that config, not a rewrite. 
 - Overlay/extension constraints fluency - designing UI injected over a host page (pill, slide-out) with its size, z-index, and isolation realities. 
 - Usability evidence at startup speed - lightweight session recordings and agent feedback loops instead of month-long studies. 
 - A debugger in the browser - you profile the render, find the jank, and fix your own component.

data.title: Software Development Manager, AWS IoT Fleet Management
data.description:
Description

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. The Physical AI team develops services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across processors inside autonomous machines including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead the team behind edge-first fleet management for Physical AI. Your team owns software that runs on embedded processors inside autonomous machines and the cloud control plane that orchestrates them coordinating deployments across hierarchical heterogeneous processor topologies that often operate entirely offline. You will lead engineers writing production C++ and Rust for local artifact caching cryptographic verification peer discovery over link-local networks and coordinated over-the-air updates across nested processor hierarchies and you will own the cloud services that track fleet state when the fleet is not reachable. Physical AI is a new business for AWS so you will define the platform while you build it hire the team that builds it and decide what the team does not build. This is a rare chance to lead where cloud services meet physical machines shipping software that keeps autonomous systems running safely in the real world. The Physical AI team within AWS IoT is focused on delivering intelligence to every processor inside autonomous machines at scale. We build the services that provision, deploy, and secure AI software across robots, vehicles, drones, and industrial equipment worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and embedded systems and we partner closely with other AWS IoT teams to push what is possible in disconnected resource-constrained environments. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every engineer's voice matters and new ideas are welcomed. 

Key job responsibilities

Description

AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. Our Physical AI team is developing services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across every processor inside autonomous machines - including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells - operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to define and drive the architecture of our edge-first fleet management platform for Physical AI. You will own the end-to-end system design spanning cloud control planes, edge gateways, and device-tier processors - reasoning deeply about state, consistency, partition tolerance, failure domains, recovery, and reconciliation across tiers that are routinely disconnected from each other. You will design APIs, platform abstractions, and SDKs that enable customers to manage heterogeneous machine fleets as coherent units, and architect secure software and model distribution pipelines with hardware attestation, cryptographic signing, and device-bound authorization. 

This role demands the ability to start from ambiguity and deliver production architecture. You will take large, loosely defined initiatives and decompose them into parallel workstreams that L4 and L5 engineers can execute against. You will write high-quality architecture and design documents that set the technical bar for the team, lead cross-team technical discussions, and drive alignment on decisions that affect adjacent services and organizations. You will own operational excellence for device fleets at scale - not just service availability, but the health, versioning, and security posture of tens of thousands of physical processors in the field. 

This is an opportunity to be a technical leader on a foundational new AWS platform - shaping how intelligence is delivered, protected, and maintained across the physical world at scale. 

Key job responsibilities

data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Job Description: Principal Digital DFT Engineer

Role Summary

The Principal Digital DFT Engineer is responsible for architecting, implementing, and verifying advanced DFT solutions for complex digital ASICs and SoCs. This position emphasizes direct technical execution, deep problem-solving, and ownership of DFT flows for robust testability and manufacturing yield. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own and drive all aspects of DFT architecture, definition, and implementation for digital chips, including scan insertion, ATPG, boundary scan, MBIST, logic BIST, JTAG and test compression techniques. 
 - Hands-on execution with EDA tools for scan synthesis, test pattern generation, fault simulation, and DFT rule checks. 
 - Create and validate test plans targeting high coverage for stuck-at, transition, and critical path faults. 
 - Integrate DFT with RTL and physical design teams; resolve complex trade-offs impacting fault coverage, PPA, or manufacturability. 
 - Optimize test modes, design for manufacturability, and debug silicon failures from bring-up through production ramp. 
 - Develop and implement low-overhead test structures and warranty schemes for new and legacy IP. 
 - Directly debug, analyze, and resolve DFT-related issues in simulation, emulation, and in the lab using standard test equipment. 
 - Deliver documented DFT architectures, test strategies, implementation scripts (TCL/Python/Perl), and design guidelines for engineering teams. 
 - Collaborate with ATE test engineers to implement production test solutions, reduce test costs, and improve coverage. 
 - Mentor engineers in DFT methodology, best practices, tool usage, and industry standards. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics/VLSI Engineering or equivalent. 
 - 10+ years' proven hands-on experience in DFT for digital ASIC/SoC development, with multiple tapeouts for large designs. 
 - Expert skills in DFT flows: scan, ATPG, MBIST, BIST, JTAG, boundary scan, fault simulation. 
 - Strong command of EDA tools: Synopsys DFT Compiler, Tessent, Cadence Modus, or equivalent. 
 - Scripting abilities (TCL, Python, Perl) for DFT automation and reporting. 
 - Solid knowledge of RTL design, synthesis, timing, and SoC architecture constraints. 
 - Demonstrated ability to debug complex DFT and test-mode issues at lab and production level. 
 - Ability to create technical documentation, guides, and mentor junior engineers. 

Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience with DFT for advanced nodes (≤ 7nm), 2. 5D/3D packaging, or high-speed IP. 
 - Production ATE pattern development and test data evaluation. 
 - Knowledge of safety (ISO 26262) or security-oriented DFT requirements. 
 - DFT for memory BIST (SRAM/DRAM), and custom macro testing. 

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U. S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position - except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3) - may have to go through an export licensing review process. 

Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.

Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time

Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

IoT Software Developer

Do you want to work on software applications that connect industrial machines, edge devices, and cloud platforms?

As an IoT Edge Software Developer within the Device Engineering Team (DET), you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and support of software running on edge devices that collect machine data, communicate securely with cloud platforms, and enable remote management at scale. You will work with Windows-based edge devices, cloud-connected applications, and device lifecycle management processes that support customers worldwide. 

This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys hands-on software development, troubleshooting complex device and connectivity issues, and working at the intersection of industrial systems, edge computing, and cloud technologies. 

If you want to build software where industrial IoT, edge computing, and cloud technologies converge, the Device Engineering Team is where it happens. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Implement software components and features based on provided designs, specifications, and guidance. 
 - Contribute to the development of reliable, maintainable, and secure code within the assigned scope. 
 - Apply agreed coding standards, patterns, and best practices in daily development work. 
 - Make basic technical decisions within assigned tasks, escalating questions or uncertainties when needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate assigned requirements and tasks into working software. 
 - Complete development work in alignment with sprint goals and delivery commitments. 
 - Contribute to task breakdowns and effort estimates for assigned work. 
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, or implementation issues to the team. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable code and contribute to unit and integration tests. 
 - Participate in code reviews, incorporating feedback and learning from peers. 
 - Ensure individual contributions meet Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria. 
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality practices. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects and issues in development and production environments. 
 - Support corrective (bug fixes) and evolutive (enhancements) maintenance of existing solutions. 

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate effectively with other developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads. 
 - Seek feedback and guidance to continuously improve technical skills. 
 - Actively learn the systems, tools, and technologies used by the team. 
 - Contribute positively to team culture and shared ownership of outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
 - Proficiency in C# and the . NET platform
 - Working knowledge of Python or other scripting languages
 - Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Familiarity with DevSecOps concepts
 - Familiarity with device communication protocols such as MQTT, OPC-UA, or similar technologies
 - Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Assets

- Hands-on experience with IoT, industrial automation, edge computing, or device lifecycle management
 - Experience with Azure IoTHub, DPS, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, or Azure Data Explorer
 - Experience supporting Windows based machines
 - Familiarity with OTA software and firmware update mechanisms
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity and data privacy controls for IoT environments

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

 - Drive adherence to production schedules while maintaining quality and safety standards. 
 - Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machines, and material resources. 
 - Lead shift-wise production activities and address operational bottlenecks. 

Process Control & Yield Improvement

- Monitor critical process parameters across cell manufacturing processes such as: 
 - Texturing
 - Diffusion
 - PECVD
 - Laser Processing
 - Screen Printing
 - Firing
 - Testing & Sorting
 - Analyze process deviations and implement corrective actions. 
 - Support continuous yield improvement and defect reduction initiatives. 
 - Lead root cause analysis for quality and process issues using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies. 
Quality Management

- Ensure compliance with established quality standards and SOPs. 
 - Monitor key manufacturing KPIs including: 
 - Yield %
 - OEE
 - Productivity
 - Line Efficiency
 - Defect Rate
 - Scrap Rate
 - Coordinate with Quality team for containment and corrective actions. 
 - Drive first-time-right manufacturing culture. 
Team Management

- Lead and develop production supervisors, engineers, and operators. 
 - Ensure proper manpower deployment and shift management. 
 - Conduct skill development and training programs for shop-floor personnel. 
 - Drive employee engagement and performance management initiatives.

 - Ensure implementation of 5S, Kaizen, and TPM practices.

Continuous Improvement

- Identify productivity improvement opportunities through automation and process optimization. 
 - Lead cost reduction initiatives related to consumables, utilities, and operational losses. 
 - Implement Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and World Class Manufacturing (WCM) practices. 
 - Support new product introductions and technology upgrades.

 - Electronics Engineering
 - Chemical Engineering
 - Production Engineering
 - Industrial Engineering

data.title: Manager II, Quality
data.description:
About Us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. 

The Role

As a Manager II, Quality with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc. 

- Review the 'Issued for Construction' drawings. Request for clarifications, if required, as per established procedure of the project site. 
 - Collaborate with the Planning Engineer/Team at project site for developing the construction schedule for the respective discipline. 
 - Understand the requirements specified in the contract agreement of the contractors for respective discipline. 
 - Assist in review/approval of the Quality Plan and Inspection Test Plan of the contractors. 
 - Collaborate with the contractors for development of the detailed construction schedule/review the construction schedule, resource status submitted by contractors. 
 - Review JHAs, method statements and lifting plan (if applicable). 
 - Supervise for safety to maintain a safe workplace. Carry out inspections of activities performed by the contractors to confirm compliance to Field HSE Specification

Additional Responsibilities

 - Participate in review meetings with Contractors, if required. 
 - Review and certify the interim and final measurement records submitted by the contractors.

About You

- Knowledge of quality control, safe ways of working, resource requirement, sequence of activities, and supervision of construction activities for the respective discipline. Aware of the requirements of various applicable standards (Indian Standards, ASME etc. ) for the respective discipline

 - HSE Capability: Knowledge
 - Proficient in MS Office 
 - Team Player, interpersonal skills
 - Adaptable, open towards learning and development, person of integrity of safe methods of execution of construction activities for the respective discipline

Moving forward together

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here. 

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

data.title: Integration Test Automation Engineer (SAP Ecosystem)
data.description:
Dear Aspirant!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make a great addition to our vibrant international team. 

We are looking for: Integration Test Automation Engineer (SAP Ecosystems)

The Test Manager is responsible for the overall planning, coordination, governance and reporting of testing activities within the SHERPA X environment. The role ensures effective validation of SAP S/4HANA and connected applications across functional, integration, end-to-end and non-functional testing, while driving risk-based testing, automation and the effective use of AI-supported testing capabilities. The Test Manager works closely with business, E2E process teams, development teams, the Testing Factory, Release Management and technical specialists to ensure transparency of quality, risks and release readiness. 

You'll make an impact by: 

- Define and manage the overall test strategy, scope and planning for SHERPA X releases. 
 - Lead and coordinate functional, integration, end-to-end, regression and non-functional testing across the SHERPA X landscape. 
 - Drive cross-system integration testing across SAP S/4HANA, APIs, EDI, middleware, interfaces and connected applications. 
 - Coordinate testing across Business, E2E Process Teams, Development Teams, Testing Factory, Release Management and technical specialists. 
 - Manage test execution, defects, risks, quality gates and test evidence, ensuring transparency of overall quality status. 
 - Ensure release readiness and provide clear quality and risk assessments as input for Go/No-Go decisions. 
 - Drive risk-based regression testing and test automation, focusing on business-critical processes and high-risk scenarios. 
 - Coordinate performance and non-functional testing with Performance Architects and Engineers, including load, endurance, performance regression, API/interface and batch testing. 
 - Ensure relevant performance requirements and KPIs are defined and validated, including response time, throughput, stability and error rates. 
 - Drive the adoption of AI-supported testing, including test-case generation and optimization, risk-based test selection, defect analysis and test-data support. 
 - Provide transparent test KPIs, quality status, risks and management reporting to support release decisions. 
 - Continuously improve testing through shift-left, automation, AI, standardization and lessons learned. 

You're excited to build on your existing expertise, including: 

- 7+ years of experience in test management, test leadership or comparable roles, ideally within complex SAP environments. 
 - Strong experience in test strategy, planning, governance and execution management across large-scale transformation programs. 
 - Good understanding of SAP S/4HANA, integration and end-to-end business process testing. 
 - Proven experience coordinating testing across business, process, development and technical teams. 
 - Experience with defect management, quality gates, release readiness and Go/No-Go preparation. 
 - Good understanding of risk-based regression testing and test automation. 
 - Practical understanding of performance and non-functional testing, including relevant performance KPIs and NFRs. 
 - Knowledge of integration technologies such as APIs, OData/REST, middleware and EDI. 
 - Practical experience or strong understanding of AI/GenAI applications in testing and test automation. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, communication and reporting skills in an international environment. 
 - Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive testing from strategy and planning through execution and continuous improvement.

data.description:
The group you'll be a part of

The Global Information Systems Group is dedicated to the success of Lam through providing best-in-class and innovative information system solutions and services. Together, we support users globally with data, information, and systems to achieve their business objectives. 

The impact you'll make

Role Overview

The QA Analyst Enterprise Applications is a fully hands-on performance testing role responsible for planning, scripting, executing, analyzing, and reporting performance tests for complex enterprise applications. The role requires deep, current expertise in OpenText LoadRunner, particularly Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, and TruClient 2. 0 protocols, together with strong knowledge of C-based scripting, correlation, parameterization, custom requests, and performance diagnostics. 

The analyst will work directly with product owners, development teams, functional teams, infrastructure and platform teams, database administrators, application support teams, and business stakeholders to translate non-functional requirements into realistic workload models and actionable performance evidence. The role requires agility in moving scripts across environments, maintaining scripts through frequent application and environment upgrades, and meeting demanding

What You'll Do

Key Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end performance testing lifecycle: requirements, NFR validation, strategy, workload modelling, scripting, execution, monitoring, analysis, defect mgt, reporting. 
 - Develop, debug, maintain LoadRunner VuGen scripts (Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, TruClient 2. 0); independently resolve correlation, session, authentication, replay issues. 
 - Build stable, maintainable scripts using HTTP/HTTPS functions, C, parameterization, correlation, validations, error handling, reusable libraries. 
 - Design realistic load, stress, endurance, volume, scalability, spike, capacity scenarios in LoadRunner Controller/ Enterprise Engg/ Performance Center. 
 - Adapt scripts to changes in environments, endpoints, certificates, authentication, applications, applying modular design, naming standards, version control. 
 - Gather business volumes, concurrency, transaction mix, response-time targets; translate them into workload models, acceptance criteria. 
 - Monitor client- and server-side metrics, correlate user experience with application, web/API, database, middleware, infrastructure behavior
 - Analyze results, logs, percentiles, throughput, errors, and resource utilization to identify bottlenecks recommend improvements
 - Partner with product owners and technical teams on scope, environment readiness, dependencies, risks, timelines; escalate blockers
 - Document test plans, scripts, results, defects, findings, residual risks in approved platforms; support defect triage, tuning, retesting, release-readiness reviews. 

Role Requirements Performance Testing & LoadRunner

- Strong hands-on LoadRunner exp, including current or recent Web HTTP/HTML protocol exp. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, TruClient 2. 0; Web Services/API expdesirable. 
 - Advanced VuGen scripting manual correlation, parameterization, custom requests, dynamic values, tokens, C functions, reusable libraries, error handling. 
 - Strong knowledge of LoadRunner Controller and/or Enterprise Performance Engineering/Center. 
 - Ability to independently troubleshoot recording/replay failures, certificates/proxies, authentication, session handling, script instability. 
 - Experience designing load, stress, endurance, spike, volume, scalability, capacity tests based on business , release risk. 

Performance Analysis & Monitoring

- Strong ability to analyze client- and server-side metrics and correlate findings across application and infrastructure layers. 
 - Experience with AppDynamics, Splunk, SiteScope, PerfMon, Wily/Introscope, VisualVM. 
 - Knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, load balancers, web/application servers, APIs, DB, OS metrics. 
 - Ability to interpret percentiles, throughput, error rates, , , GC, thread/connection pools, database waits. 

Planning, Collaboration & Delivery

 - Ability to challenge incomplete NFRs, align stakeholders on scope, workloads, success criteria.

 - Experience working in Agile and DevOps delivery models and using Azure DevOps, Jira, or comparable platforms for backlog, defect, evidence, and release tracking.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

The Software Test Engineer II will perform full-stack testing on modern web and backend applications. The role involves testing UI, APIs, databases, performance, and security to ensure high-quality software delivery. While the role does not involve DevOps tasks, a basic understanding of DevOps pipelines is required for effective collaboration. Additionally, the QA Engineer will work closely with performance testers to support load and stress testing. 

Responsibilities

- Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies covering UI, API, database, and integration testing. 
 - Design test plans for multi-tier applications, ensuring functionality across the front end, back end, and data layers. 
 - Define best practices for test automation and continuous validation. 
 - Perform functional, regression, and integration testing across web, mobile, and backend services as needed. 
 - Collaborate on automated test scripts using tools like Selenium, Katalon, Cypress, Playwright, SmartBear or like. 
 - Validate APIs using Postman, Rest Assured, or Like. 
 - Execute manual exploratory testing when automation is not feasible. 
 - Conduct database testing, including SQL validation and data integrity checks. 
 - Test backend services for data consistency, business logic, and API contract validation. 
 - Validate microservices interactions and ensure API responses adhere to expected outputs. 
 - Work alongside performance testers to assess system responsiveness and scalability. 
 - Define test cases for load, stress, and endurance testing. 
 - Analyze performance metrics and support issue triaging. 
 - Conduct basic security testing to identify vulnerabilities in front-end and back-end systems. 
 - Ensure compliance with industry standards and data protection guidelines. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects using JIRA, Zephyr or another test management tool. 
 - Provide detailed test coverage reports, risk assessments, and root cause analyses. 
 - Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot and resolve bugs efficiently. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Standups, Retrospectives). 
 - Understand DevOps concepts and CI/CD workflows to support continuous testing efforts.

 - Other duties as assigned. 

Deliverables

Business Impact: 

Education

Experience

 - Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, processes, and best practices. 
 - Proficiency in writing clear and concise test plans, test cases, and test scripts. 
 - Knowledge of automated testing tools and frameworks. 
 - Experience of relational databases and SQL. 
 - Eagerness to learn and stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends. 
 - Familiarity with Agile development methodologies. 
 - Strong Proficiency in API testing.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs our connectors framework. In this role, you will be accountable for the team's delivery across several concurrent projects, from platform enhancements to large programs that need multiple teams to collaborate. You will lead by example as a hands-on technical manager, grow the engineers on your team, and remove roadblocks so the connector engineers who build on your platform can move fast. 

What You'll Do

- Own Team Delivery: Be accountable for delivering multiple framework projects and features at the same time. Make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver, and personally deliver features when the team needs it. 
 - Lead Technically: Stay hands-on and lead by example. Guide the team through large, complex projects that need several teams to complete, such as migrating on-premises connectivity to a cloud-managed agent or extracting the integrations code into its own service. Design features in the framework yourself when needed. 
 - Direct Quality and Reliability: Set the quality processes the team follows. Own framework reliability, including sync health, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution of security findings. 
 - Develop Talent: Run 1: 1s, performance reviews, goal setting, and career guidance. Enable ownership on the team, resolve conflict, and grow engineers into their next level. 
 - Remove Roadblocks Across Teams: Work closely with the connector development team, other product teams, SRE, security, and PM to keep work clear and unblocked. 
 - Lead AI-First Engineering: Train the team on our tools and processes, including AI-assisted development workflows, and set the discipline for verifying AI-generated code. 
 - Drive Initiatives: Run initiatives within the team, such as cutting the time it takes to build a new connector or reducing sync failures. 
 - Keep Customers in Focus: Understand customer use cases and problems, and use them to set priorities with PM. 
 - Build the Team: Actively recruit, lead interviews, and make hiring decisions. 
 - Communicate Clearly: Present plans, progress, and risks to engineering and senior leadership. 

Nice to Have

- Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. 
 - Integration Platforms: Experience leading teams that build integration frameworks, data pipelines, or SDKs used by other engineers. 
 - Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with products that run agents inside customer networks. 
 - Multi-Site Teams: Experience leading engineers across more than one office location. 
 - DevOps & Observability Ecosystems: Practical experience with progressive delivery, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and monitoring tools such as Datadog. 

Impact

As an Engineering Manager on the connectors framework, you will lead the team that every connector in our product depends on. Your impact will be measured by your team's delivery, the reliability of the framework in production, and the growth of the engineers you lead. Co-workers will look to you for clarity, technical judgment, and a steady path forward. 

Qualifications

- People Leadership: Experience managing software engineers, including 1: 1s, performance reviews, career development, and hiring. 
 - Technical Depth: Strong hands-on background with Node. js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and AWS, plus experience with data integration or distributed systems. Able to review designs and code with credibility. 
 - Delivery Track Record: Proven record of delivering large, complex projects that need collaboration across several teams. 
 - Operational Ownership: Experience running production services, leading incident response, and driving RCAs to durable fixes. 
 - AI Tooling Adoption: Experience leading a team's adoption of AI tools while keeping review rigor high. 
 - Conflict Resolution & Influence: Able to resolve conflict, remove roadblocks across teams, and build strong working relationships with ICs and managers. 
 - Communication: Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering and business audiences. 
 - Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations. 

Qualifications

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Technical Leadership

Strong API testing knowledge with hands-on Karate automation. 

Strong SQL skills, including joins, subqueries, aggregations, data comparison, and validation of complex business rules. 

Understanding of REST, JSON, HTTP methods/status codes, authentication, schemas, contracts, and service dependencies. 

Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, defect management, test data, environments, and agile delivery. 

Strong analytical thinking, attention to data quality, and clear communication.

Primary - Karate for API automation SQL and database testing

Secondary / supporting - REST Assured Postman or equivalent API clients Playwright with TypeScript or Selenium for supporting end-to-end validation

Experience with REST Assured, Postman, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL, and NoSQL validation. 

Exposure to ETL/data pipeline testing, message queues, event-driven systems, service virtualization, and contract testing. 

Performance testing exposure using JMeter, LoadRunner, or k6. 

Exposure to approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Codex.

Automation is stable, maintainable, and integrated into delivery pipelines. 

Coverage is risk-based, traceable to business functionality, and balanced across UI, API, integration, data, and exploratory testing. 

Defects and failures are investigated with clear evidence and strong root-cause thinking. 

The engineer collaborates effectively, delivers commitments reliably, and demonstrates continuous improvement in technical depth and quality practices.

data.title: Team Lead, Field Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

As a Field Engineer, Team Lead you will serve as a player-coach - guiding a team of field engineers while personally executing the most complex, mission-critical technical work yourself. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you are both the technical anchor for your team and Addepar's technical vanguard in the field, translating complex business requirements into production-grade integrations, automations, and data solutions. 

You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite - from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling. At the same time, you will develop your people-management skills: providing daily guidance, coordinating work allocation, and turning the vision set by leadership into reality while keeping your team aligned to our core processes. This role combines a forward-deployed delivery model with hands-on technical depth and functional leadership of a high-performing engineering team. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i. e. 2: 30 PM to 11: 30 PM IST. (hybrid role)

What You'll Do

- Serve as a player-coach: provide functional leadership and daily operational guidance to a team of field engineers while remaining a hands-on technical contributor on the most complex engagements
 - Architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
 - Manage the team's work allocation and coordinate activities across simultaneous client engagements, ensuring results are delivered on schedule and in collaboration with cross-functional partners
 - Guide the team through issue resolution, proactively escalate blockers, and maintain alignment with client and internal stakeholders
 - Design and implement production-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time-to-value, and enable operational scale
 - Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
 - Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
 - Write and review production-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
 - Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
 - Support career development by providing continuous feedback loops on technical and project execution, mentoring engineers as they grow
 - Identify and drive opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and automation for greater team efficiency, and develop internal frameworks and best practices that accelerate delivery
 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence the platform roadmap
 - Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value

Who You Are

- Experience: Minimum 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles, with demonstrated experience guiding, mentoring, or leading other engineers
 - Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines; strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Platform Software Development:

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Problem Solving:

Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement:

data.title: Quality Engineering & SIT Delivery Lead
data.description:
Who We Are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation. 

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30, 000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability. 

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. 

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking an experienced Quality Engineering & SIT Delivery Lead to own successful end-to-end System Integration Testing (SIT) delivery for CCS releases in Pune. 

In this role, you will oversee scope and risk assessment, capacity planning, test preparation and execution, defect governance, Future Usage Testing (FUT), launch assurance and release readiness. You will work closely with VOIS CIT management, onshore Test Management and programme stakeholders to align scope, risks, timelines, resource requirements and launch decisions. 

You will also use delivery and defect insights to improve test effectiveness, automation adoption and productivity while reducing customer journey testing (CJT) issues and production defect leakage. The role includes direct leadership and development of 8-10 team members, alongside workforce and performance governance. 

What You'll Do

- Own scope assessment, high-level risk assessment, capacity planning and delivery governance for programme EPICs across CCS releases 
 - Secure alignment and sign-off with VOIS CIT management, onshore Test Management and programme stakeholders on scope, risks, timelines, consumption plans, resource requirements and launch readiness 
 - Oversee test preparation, daily execution allocation, progress tracking, FUT, launch testing, defect triage and timely resolution through Leads, SMEs and Defect Management 
 - Ensure adherence to test execution, evidence-management, defect lifecycle and defect-governance standards 
 - Improve quality and productivity through automation demand, scripting handover, audits, capacity optimisation and measurable service-level improvements 
 - Analyse delivery and defect data to identify SDLC improvements, reduce CJT issues and production leakage, and improve overall test effectiveness 
 - Act as an escalation point for delivery and defect risks and provide clear daily and senior-management updates 
 - Showcase SIT outcomes through show-and-tell sessions and success stories 
 - Lead and develop the team through regular performance discussions, skills development, training, Vodafone Spirit behaviours, psychological safety and recognition 
 - Maintain workforce governance across utilisation, attendance, leave, timesheets, extra hours, ZBB submissions, succession planning and replacement planning

Who You Are

- You have a minimum of 8 years' experience in software quality engineering, system integration testing and release delivery within a complex technology environment 
 - You have strong knowledge of SIT delivery, release governance, test planning, execution management, defect management and launch assurance 
 - You can assess scope, delivery risk, capacity, productivity and resource requirements across multiple EPICs and releases 
 - You apply data-led problem-solving to test effectiveness, defect prevention, audit quality and continuous improvement throughout the STLC 
 - You have working knowledge of progression and regression automation, including demand prioritisation, handover and execution governance 
 - You can manage and influence stakeholders across onshore and offshore delivery environments and communicate effectively with senior management 
 - You have demonstrated experience in people leadership, coaching, performance development and capability building 
 - You bring commercial awareness to capacity proposals, productivity commitments and approval discussions 
 - You have a good understanding of test management and defect governance tooling, reporting and evidence standards 
 - You have a B. Tech or equivalent bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline 
 - An ISTQB Certified Tester qualification and ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager or Test Management certification are preferred 
 - Relevant Agile certification, such as Professional Scrum Master, Certified ScrumMaster or SAFe Agilist, is preferred 
 - A relevant cloud or DevOps certification, such as Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or equivalent, is desirable

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

Based on the scope of the role, you will have the opportunity to: 

- Take end-to-end accountability for SIT delivery across complex CCS releases and influence release readiness and service quality 
 - Work with cross-functional and onshore/offshore stakeholders across Quality Engineering, Test Management and programme delivery 
 - Develop leadership experience through direct responsibility for a team of 8-10 colleagues 
 - Contribute to measurable improvements in automation adoption, productivity, test effectiveness and defect prevention 
 - Build broader experience in delivery governance, stakeholder influencing, workforce planning and continuous improvement

What Skills You Will Learn

This role provides opportunities to further develop: 

- End-to-end SIT and release delivery governance 
 - Risk-based testing, scope assessment and capacity planning across multiple EPICs 
 - Data-led defect prevention and test-effectiveness improvement 
 - Progression and regression automation governance 
 - Launch assurance and production defect-leakage reduction 
 - Senior stakeholder communication, influencing and escalation management 
 - People leadership, coaching, succession planning and capability development 
 - Workforce utilisation and productivity governance 
 - Commercial awareness relating to capacity and productivity proposals

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background. 

Join Us

At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this. 

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

The Opportunity

Hitachi Energy FACTS technology uses a very high-end system for its control, protection and monitoring. This system is called MACH. This computerized system is built with state-of-the-art electronics, microprocessors and digital signal processors, connected by high performance industry standard busses and fiber optic communication links. They operate on very high standard application software designed by the control engineering team for which there is a need for experienced SOM Application engineers for the Control System. As the system is being continuously evolved, the Station Operating and Monitoring System (SOM) is becoming more complex and customized. It requires a great deal of design, testing & verification of HMI, SCADA, Network & Cybersecurity areas. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Development and Engineering of HMI and SCADA Application for FACTS technology in AVEVA System Platform and MicroSCADA solutions. 
 - Perform verification of HMI and SCADA/Gateway Solutions of our Control systems in Test area and participate in Factory Acceptance Test and Site Acceptance Test.

 - Extensive contact with other engineering disciplines, the project manager, project management engineer and externally to our customer during factory acceptance and commissioning phase. 
 - Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. 
 - Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. 

You will become part of a dedicated project team, in which we work together throughout all phases of our extensive projects. Collaboration is, in other words, a central part of your new position that will provide you with a great starting point in our organization your possibilities of further career opportunities. It will also give you the benefit to travel globally during the commissioning period based on the project requirements. 

Your Background

- Bachelor's degree in electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), or Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering (E&I). 
 - At least 4 years of relevant experience in oil and gas, energy, utilities, or substation automation systems. 
 - Strong foundation in electrical control systems and SCADA/DCS platforms.

 - Motivated to contribute to continuous improvement and the development of new solutions.
