data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Lead to own the technical direction of our global web platform, built on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Sites and AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS). You will lead the move of high-volume marketing properties onto EDS, keep our core AEM estate healthy and scalable, and bring AI into how the team designs, builds, tests and ships - not as a talking point, but as part of everyday engineering practice. 

This role sits at the intersection of architecture, delivery and people leadership. You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, eCommerce, MarTech, Compliance and Analytics teams, and guide both internal engineers and contractor partners. 

Job Description

Platform architecture & technical leadership

- Architecture ownership: Own the end-to-end architecture across AEM as a Cloud Service and EDS - including the decision framework for which properties belong on each, and how they coexist (CDN routing, shared design system, shared integrations). 
 - EDS migration: Lead migration and creation of sites / microsites and marketing pages to EDS, with a focus on performance, authoring simplicity and lower run cost. 
 - Engineering standards: Set coding standards, review designs and code, and make the hard technical trade-offs between speed, quality and maintainability. 
 - Integrations: Guide integrations with commerce (e. g. , SAP Hybris), search (e. g. , Algolia), Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target/CDP, Marketo, Salesforce and tag management (GTM), plus consent/compliance tooling. 

AI-enabled development

- AI in the workflow: Actively use AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to accelerate component and block development, refactoring, documentation and test creation - and set team guidelines for using them safely and well. 
 - Prompt engineering: Design and refine prompts, prompt templates and lightweight agents/automations for repeatable engineering and content tasks (e. g. , content migration, page/block scaffolding, metadata and alt-text generation, QA checks). 
 - AI-powered features: Support AI-driven experiences on the site, such as conversational/concierge assistants, AI-assisted search and personalization - including API integration, guardrails, and evaluation of output quality. 
 - Responsible use: Bring a clear point of view on where AI should assist, accelerate or automate - and where it should not - with attention to security, privacy, IP and regulatory compliance. 

Delivery, quality & people

- Delivery: Lead a team of developers (internal and partner), plan sprints with Product, and deliver predictable releases against time-bound commitments such as global launches and events. 
 - Quality & performance: Build an automation-first quality approach: unit tests, Playwright (or similar) end-to-end tests, Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals performance budgets in CI/CD, and accessibility checks (WCAG 2. 1 AA). 
 - DevOps & operations: Own Cloud Manager pipelines, environments, release management and production support, including incident response and root-cause analysis. 
 - Mentoring & influence: Mentor engineers, grow EDS and AI skills across the team, and act as the technical voice in conversations with business stakeholders and leadership. 

Required

What You Bring

- 10-14 years of web/software engineering experience, with at least 8+ years on Adobe AEM (Sites, ideally AEM as a Cloud Service) and 2+ years in a technical lead or architect role. 
 - Hands-on experience building on AEM Edge Delivery Services - blocks, document-based or Universal Editor authoring, aem. live tooling, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong core AEM skills: Java, OSGi, Sling Models, HTL, Core Components, Dispatcher, content and component architecture, multi-site/multi-language management (MSM). 
 - Strong front-end skills: modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and Core Web Vitals optimization. 
 - Demonstrated, practical use of AI tools in day-to-day development, plus solid prompt-design skills - able to show real examples of what you built or sped up with AI. 
 - Experience integrating REST/GraphQL APIs, headless delivery, and third-party platforms (search, commerce, analytics, marketing automation). 
 - CI/CD and Git experience (Adobe Cloud Manager, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), and comfort with Agile/Scrum delivery. 
 - Clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and influence without direct authority. 

Nice to have

- Adobe certifications (AEM Sites Developer / Architect). 
 - Experience with Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics/CJA, Real-Time CDP or AEM Assets/Dynamic Media. 
 - Experience with Algolia or other search platforms, and with SAP Commerce (Hybris) integrations. 
 - Experience building with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI), RAG patterns, or agentic workflows. 
 - Background in regulated industries (healthcare, life sciences, financial services) - consent management, privacy and compliance tooling such as Evidon and GTM governance. 
 - Experience migrating from other CMS platforms (Sitecore, WordPress) to AEM. 

What Success Looks Like In Year One

- A clear AEM-vs-EDS architecture and migration roadmap, with first priority properties live on EDS and measurable gains in page performance and authoring speed. 
 - AI-assisted development practices adopted across the team, with documented guidelines and visible improvements in delivery speed and quality. 
 - Automated testing and performance checks running in the release pipeline, reducing defects and manual QA effort. 
 - A stronger, more self-sufficient engineering team, less dependent on individual experts.

About The Role

The ideal candidate will work with multi-functional global teams to design, implement and verify Boundary Scan, ATPG (Stuck-AT/AT-Speed) SCAN, MBIST, IO BIST and JTAG/IJTAG DFT features on our next generation highly complex server class processor products. Will work in close collaboration with test engineering team to deliver ATE patterns and post silicon bring-up and debug.

data.title: Senior Principal - Principal RE, Cloud & Hosting
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Site Reliability Engineer improves the reliability, resilience and observability of GSK's platforms as a hands-on engineer, reducing toil, preventing incidents and meeting agreed reliability targets. The role defines and monitors SLOs, instruments platforms for observability, leads incident response through to permanent prevention, and applies AI and automation for anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing. It also coaches platform engineering teams in reliability practice and error-budget discipline. 

The role sits in Reliability Engineering & Operations and is deployed into a platform domain while drawing on the central capability, so it holds the central reliability standard inside a team it does not report to. Platform build and engineering direction sit with the Principal Engineers and the Engineering Director, the major incident process sits with the Major Incident Manager, and the reliability standard itself is set by the Reliability Engineering Senior Director. Reliability targets are held jointly with the Platform Manager rather than imposed on them. 

ROLE SCALE AND COMPLEXITY

This is a senior enterprise reliability leadership role operating across globally distributed, business-critical cloud and hosting services. The post holder is accountable for setting technical direction, resolving systemic and ambiguous reliability risks, and influencing prioritisation across multiple platform teams, suppliers and geographies without relying on direct line authority. 

The role manages a portfolio of interdependent services with material operational, regulatory, cyber, resilience and financial consequences. It shapes investment and supplier decisions and may influence or govern an annual technology and service portfolio of up to approximately GBP 23 million, where applicable to the assigned scope. 

MARKET SCOPE

Global scope, supporting business operations across regions, countries and markets in which GSK operates. The role establishes consistent reliability outcomes across regional delivery teams while accommodating local regulatory, data-residency, business-continuity and market-criticality requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and monitor SLOs for the platforms served, and instrument those platforms for observability so reliability is measured rather than assumed. 
 - Apply AI and automation for anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing, so that recurring conditions are handled without human intervention. 
 - Lead incident response for the platforms served, and drive root-cause resolution through to permanent prevention rather than closing on restoration. 
 - Improve resilience through capacity, failover and recovery engineering, and test recovery rather than documenting it. 
 - Reduce operational toil through automation and reusable tooling, working the identified manual task and toil candidates and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platforms served, prioritising by the reliability risk each gap leaves unmeasured. 
 - Coach platform engineering teams in reliability practice and error-budget discipline, so reliability is built in rather than inspected in. 
 - Track reliability metrics against SLOs and team OKRs, and act on the trend rather than only reporting it. 
 - Support reliability oversight of supplier-run services, holding partner-operated components to the same SLOs as internal ones. 
 - Hold the central reliability standard while deployed in a platform domain, escalating to the Reliability Engineering Senior Director where local pressure would erode it. 
 - Feed reliability evidence into the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, so that resilience work competes on stated risk rather than on goodwill. 
 - Hold the boundaries with the Principal Engineers on platform build, the Major Incident Manager on the major incident process, and the Platform Manager on the reliability targets the platform commits to. 
 - Set the multi-year reliability strategy and engineering roadmap for the assigned cloud and hosting portfolio, translating enterprise risk and business priorities into funded reliability outcomes. 
 - Own cross-platform reliability governance, including service tiering, SLO policy, error-budget decisions, resilience exceptions and common engineering standards across internal and supplier-operated services. 
 - Lead resolution of complex, high-impact and systemic failure modes spanning cloud, hosting, network, security, applications and third-party dependencies, with authority to convene senior technical and service leaders. 
 - Provide evidence-based recommendations for investment, risk acceptance and supplier performance decisions, including prioritisation across a material service portfolio and, where delegated, spend of up to approximately GBP 25 million. 
 - Represent Reliability Engineering in Director, Senior Director and VP-level governance, communicating service risk, business impact, trade-offs and required decisions in clear executive terms. 
 - Mentor Principal and Senior Engineers, build communities of practice and raise engineering capability across regions rather than delivering only through individual contribution. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering). 
 - Reliability or platform certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or ITIL 4 for incident and problem practice). 

Area of Specialisation

- Site reliability engineering, covering SLOs, observability instrumentation, error budgets and toil reduction. 
 - AIOps and operations automation, covering anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing. 

Why is this level of Education Required?

- An engineering grounding is needed because the role writes the automation and instrumentation itself and must be credible to platform engineers whose systems it is changing. 

Job-Related Experience

- Overall 15 Years and typically 10-12+ years in infrastructure, cloud, platform or reliability engineering, including significant experience leading enterprise-scale reliability outcomes across multiple teams or service domains. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on SRE, Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Operations experience. 
 - Experience supporting large-scale production cloud and hosting environments. 
 - Experience owning operational reliability for critical business services. 
 - Proven record of improving service availability, resiliency, and operational efficiency. 
 - Demonstrated accountability for globally distributed, 24x7, business-critical services and for decisions with material operational, regulatory, customer or financial impact. 
 - Proven ability to influence Directors, Senior Directors and VP-level stakeholders, including presenting options, quantified risk, trade-offs and investment recommendations. 
 - Experience governing strategic suppliers and complex service ecosystems, with exposure to substantial technology budgets or portfolios; direct budget ownership is desirable but not mandatory where strong investment influence is evidenced. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction, leading through ambiguity and developing senior engineering capability across organisational and geographic boundaries. 

Requirements

Technical Requirements

- Strong experience with: Azure and/or GCP, Linux and Windows Server platforms, Containers and Kubernetes, Cloud networking fundamentals, Infrastructure as Code , Cloud observability platforms
 - Hands-on proficiency in: Terraform, Ansible, Python , CI/CD pipelines, Monitoring and telemetry solutions. 

Reliability & Operations

- Experience defining and operating: SLIs , SLOs, Error Budgets, Operational KPIs
 - Experience leading: Major incident response, post-incident reviews, Root-cause analysis , Capacity management, Resiliency and recovery testing. 

Operational Excellence

- Demonstrated experience in: Runbook development, Operational readiness reviews, Service transitions, Continuous service improvement, Automation-led toil reduction

Skills/Background

- Comfort operating inside a team that is not the reporting line, holding a central standard without formal authority. 
 - Composure in live incidents, including deciding when to stop investigating and restore. 
 - Discipline to pursue root cause after service is restored and attention has moved on. 
 - Ability to coach engineers into reliability practice rather than policing them into it. 
 - Judgement about which observability gaps matter and which are noise. 
 - Willingness to automate away the work rather than becoming indispensable to it. 

Preferred Skills: 

- Hands-on SRE practice: defining and governing SLIs, SLOs and error budgets for global, business-critical 24x7 cloud and hosting services (5+ years hands-on SRE/cloud operations)
 - Azure and/or GCP production depth: Linux and Windows Server, containers and Kubernetes, cloud networking and landing-zone design at enterprise scale
 - Hands-on coding and Infrastructure as Code: writes Python, Terraform and Ansible personally and ships through CI/CD pipelines (not just reviews others' code)
 - Observability and AIOps: telemetry/monitoring platforms, closing coverage gaps by reliability risk, anomaly detection, predictive alerting and guarded self-healing
 - Major incident leadership: RCA, blameless post-incident reviews and driving root cause through to permanent prevention
 - Resilience engineering: capacity management, failover/DR design, and proven recovery and resiliency testing
 - Executive influence and supplier governance: influencing Director/VP stakeholders and holding managed service/cloud providers to SLOs without line authority; mentoring senior engineers

#AGTech

Skills

CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), Disaster Recovery (DR), Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Major Incident Management, Operating Systems (OS), Performance Tuning, Resilience Engineering, Scripting, SRE Observability, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Vulnerability Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

Job Purpose

The Principal GCP Platform Architect owns the technical design of the Google Cloud platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the Google Cloud and Edge services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture. 
 - Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations. 
 - Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational. 
 - Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after. 
 - Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim. 
 - Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work. 
 - Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions. 
 - Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why. 
 - Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it. 
 - Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted. 
 - Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build. 

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems). 
 - Architecture certifications desirable (e. g. , TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform). 

Experience Required

- Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to. 
 - Strong experience as a Google Cloud Architect. Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments. 
 - Experience deploying, configuring and managing services in Google Cloud Platform including AI Services
 - Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard. 
 - Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets. 
 - Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context. 
 - Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet. 
 - Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 

Skills/Background

- Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented. 
 - Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard. 
 - Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them. 
 - Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome. 
 - Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright. 
 - Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, Design Assurance, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Google Cloud Platform Architecture, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Reference Architectures, Security Compliance, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Job description: 

Head of Quality & Product Industrialisation, India & Vietnam - Safety Fabrics

Location: Madurai, India

  

Role purpose:   

The Head of Quality & Product Industrialization - Safety Fabrics is responsible for leading the global quality strategy, product industrialization, certification and technical governance for Coats' Safety Fabrics business. 
This role ensures that new and existing products are robustly industrialized, consistently manufactured and fully compliant with global safety standards. Working closely with Innovation, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Commercial teams, the role provides technical leadership across Coats' Safety Fabrics manufacturing operations in India and Vietnam, including third-party manufacturing partners, to drive product quality, manufacturing excellence, certification readiness and continuous improvement in support of sustainable global business growth.   
An ideal candidate for the role needs to technically strong and execution-oriented leader with proven experience in safety fabrics or technical textiles, responsible for product development, quality, certification and industrialisation within a manufacturing environment. Brings deep understanding of global safety standards, product testing, regulatory compliance and manufacturing processes, with the ability to successfully transition new products from development into stable, scalable production. Experienced in working across cross-functional teams, including manufacturing, quality, supply chain, procurement and commercial, to deliver consistent product performance, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement. Demonstrates strong problem-solving capability, technical credibility and hands-on leadership, with experience supporting manufacturing operations across multiple sites and third-party manufacturing partners.

Quality Leadership

- Job Title: Network Automation Engineer
 - Experience Required: 5-7 Years
 - Location: Bengaluru

Job Description

We are looking for a Network Automation Engineer with 5-7 years of experience to join the Network Engineering team. The primary focus of this role will be network automation, with approximately 70% emphasis on automation and 30% on networking fundamentals. 

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining network automation solutions, configuration templates, and operational workflows to improve network consistency, scalability, and resiliency. The role involves automating network provisioning and deployment workflows, supporting network infrastructure changes, and collaborating with technology and infrastructure teams. 

The ideal candidate should have strong Python programming and scripting skills, hands-on experience with network automation tools such as Ansible and Cisco NSO, and a good understanding of enterprise networking concepts. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain network automation solutions, configuration templates, and operational workflows to improve consistency, scalability, and resiliency. 
 - Evaluate client requirements and identify suitable solutions, primarily focusing on campus and branch wired and wireless networks. 
 - Develop automation workflows for network provisioning, configuration, and deployment. 
 - Collaborate with technology and infrastructure teams to deliver network automation solutions. 
 - Contribute to the development of high-level design patterns, standards, and configuration templates. 
 - Develop execution and test plans for network changes. 
 - Automate network deployment and provisioning activities using Python, Ansible, Cisco NSO, or equivalent tools. 
 - Support network operations teams during deployments and endpoint migrations. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve network automation, operational efficiency, and infrastructure reliability. 

Core Technical Requirements

- 5-7 years of experience in a systems integrator or enterprise networking environment. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in network automation. 
 - Strong Python programming and scripting skills. 
 - Experience with network automation platforms such as Ansible, Cisco NSO, or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience with API-based and CLI-based network automation. 
 - Understanding of REST APIs, NETCONF, and YANG. 
 - Good understanding of networking fundamentals, network architecture, VLANs, and network segmentation. 
 - Solid routing and switching knowledge, including OSPF, BGP, MPLS, RSTP, and EtherChannel. 
 - Hands-on experience with network provisioning and deployment automation. 
 - Experience with Git-based development workflows and source control. 

Networking Skills

- Working knowledge of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, VLANs, and segmentation. 
 - Experience with Cisco Catalyst product lines. 
 - Understanding of network security techniques such as IPSEC, MACSec, MAB, and 802. 1X. 
 - Good understanding of wireless networking, preferably Cisco. 
 - Conceptual knowledge of Quality of Service (QoS). 

Desired Technical Skills

- Experience with GitHub, GitLab, or similar code repositories. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure deployment. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Exposure to hybrid infrastructure environments involving on-premises and cloud platforms. 
 - Experience with overlay-based networking solutions such as SD-WAN, SD-Access, ACI, and EVPN-VXLAN. 
 - Knowledge of endpoint profiling solutions such as Cisco ISE, Armis, or Forescout. 
 - Experience with Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Center). 
 - Experience with Terraform and NETCONF. 
 - Understanding of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and Network-as-Code principles. 
 - Experience with Ekahau. 
 - Exposure to IoT networks and multi-site network automation.

data.title: Sales Manager
data.description:
Who We Are?

We're GrowthSchool. And we built Outskill. 

GrowthSchool started with one belief: you learn a skill fastest from the person actually doing it. So we partnered with the top 1% of instructors to build high-impact, cohort-based courses in personal and professional growth for learners around the world and used AI to make that learning personal at a scale a classroom never could. 

Then AI changed what "upskilling" even means. Roles started getting rewritten faster than curriculums could keep up, and the real divide stopped being skilled versus unskilled. It became AI-ready versus not. 

So, we built  Outskill, our AI education arm, to close that gap, practical, implementation-first AI training for professionals, teams and enterprises. Today Outskill is one of the largest AI education companies in the world:   16M+ learners across 160+ countries, and programs running everywhere from individual upskilling to enterprise AI transformation. 

Our mission: Make 100 million people AI-ready by 2028. 

What that actually feels like day to day:   we're 300+ people, moving at a speed that surprises most people who join us. Products ship in weeks, not quarters. There's no thick layer of process between an idea and it going live. You'll own things visibly bigger than your title. Some experiments will fail publicly, and we'll talk about them openly on Monday. 

If you need a finished playbook before you start, this will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather write the playbook, you'll like it here. 

Why This Role Exists

We're looking for a  Sales Manager/Senior Sales Manager  to lead and scale a high-performing team of Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) and Senior SDRs. In this role, you'll be responsible for driving revenue growth, improving sales performance, coaching and developing talent, and building scalable sales processes that consistently deliver enrollment and revenue targets. 

You'll play a critical role in shaping our sales culture, enabling your team to succeed through coaching, data-driven decision-making, and operational excellence. 

What You'll Do

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of SDRs and Senior SDRs to consistently achieve sales goals. 

Conduct regular coaching sessions, call reviews, and performance feedback discussions. 

Foster a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative sales culture. 

Support hiring, onboarding, training, and career development of team members. 

Revenue & Pipeline Management

Own team-level revenue, enrollment, and conversion targets. 

Monitor pipeline health and ensure timely follow-ups and effective lead management. 

Identify bottlenecks in the sales funnel and implement strategies to improve conversion rates. 

Maintain CRM discipline and ensure accurate sales forecasting and reporting. 

Sales Excellence

Coach the team on consultative selling techniques, objection handling, and value-based conversations. 

Guide sales representatives in qualifying prospects based on career goals, learning needs, and program fit. 

Support strategic and high-value sales opportunities whenever required. 

Drive consistent execution of sales processes and best practices. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Marketing, Program Management, and Operations teams to improve lead quality and learner experience. 

Share customer insights, objections, and market feedback to strengthen messaging and sales strategies. 

Collaborate with leadership to optimize processes and scale successful sales initiatives. 

Performance Tracking & Optimization

Track and analyze key sales metrics including revenue, enrollments, conversion rates, pipeline health, and team productivity. 

Prepare performance reports and business insights for leadership. 

Drive continuous improvements to sales processes, productivity, and team effectiveness. 

Ensure the team consistently achieves weekly, monthly, and quarterly KPIs. 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a hands-on sales leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building high-performing teams. The ideal candidate combines strong coaching abilities with a deep understanding of consultative sales and is passionate about helping professionals make meaningful career decisions. 

Must-Have

3-5 years of experience in Sales, Inside Sales, Admissions, EdTech, SaaS, Learning & Development, or related industries. 

Minimum 1-2 years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing sales teams. 

Proven track record of consistently achieving and exceeding revenue and sales targets. 

Strong expertise in consultative selling, objection handling, and closing high-value sales. 

Experience managing CRM systems, sales reporting, and pipeline management. 

Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills. 

Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use data to improve sales performance. 

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

Experience managing SDRs, Admissions Counselors, or Inside Sales teams. 

Experience in professional education, AI, SaaS, EdTech, or Learning & Development. 

Strong understanding of learner personas, career transitions, and upskilling journeys. 

Experience building scalable sales processes and coaching frameworks.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. 

Toast is looking for a Staff Software Engineer, Android to join the Membership POS team in India. You'll play a key role in building the platform that manages subscriptions and memberships and tracks usage of member benefits for customers and guests-all within Toast's ecosystem. 

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

 - Experience shipping production services and balancing getting things done with platform stability and reliability

 - Enjoys working in a team environment with a shared code-base

We are hiring individuals with a wide range of experience so if you have more or less than these exact roles, please still apply!

Our Tech Stack

Toast's products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilises Apache Spark for large-scale data workloads, including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform, we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end. 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters' changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https: //careers. toasttab. com/toast-benefits.

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https: //careers. toasttab. com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https: //careers. toasttab. com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient-when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work-raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other. 

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab. com.

data.title: Project Lead
data.description:
Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QAQC) Manager - Civil Works

JLL Project and Development Services

Position Overview

The QAQC Manager for Civil Works ensures all civil construction activities within JLL's Project and Development Services portfolio meet specified quality standards, regulatory requirements, and client expectations through systematic inspection, testing, and documentation processes. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management & Compliance

Develop and implement comprehensive quality assurance and quality control plans for civil works projects including site development, earthworks, utilities, paving, drainage, and related infrastructure. Ensure all construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, building codes, and regulatory requirements. Conduct regular site inspections and audits to verify conformance with quality standards and identify non-conformities requiring corrective action. 

Inspection & Testing Coordination

Oversee field inspection activities for concrete works, soil compaction, underground utilities, asphalt paving, and other civil elements. Coordinate with third-party testing laboratories for materials testing including soil density tests, concrete cylinder breaks, aggregate gradation, and asphalt quality verification. Review and approve test results, ensuring they meet project specifications before authorizing work progression. 

Documentation & Reporting

Maintain comprehensive QAQC documentation including inspection reports, test results, material certifications, non-conformance reports, and corrective action records. Prepare regular quality reports for project managers, clients, and stakeholders summarizing inspection activities, test results, and quality metrics. Ensure all quality records are properly filed and readily accessible for audits and project closeout. 

Contractor Management

Review contractor submittals for materials, equipment, and construction methodologies to verify compliance with specifications. Conduct pre-construction meetings with contractors and subcontractors to communicate quality expectations and inspection requirements. Monitor contractor quality control activities and verify their internal QC processes are effective. 

Standards & Procedures Development

Develop and maintain QAQC procedures, checklists, and standards specific to civil works within JLL's Project and Development Services. Implement industry best practices and lessons learned from previous projects to continuously improve quality management processes. Train project teams on QAQC procedures and quality documentation requirements. 

Non-Conformance Management

Identify deficiencies and non-conforming work through systematic inspections and testing programs. Issue non-conformance reports and work with contractors to develop acceptable corrective action plans. Verify implementation of corrective actions and document resolution of quality issues. 

Stakeholder Communication

Serve as the primary point of contact for quality-related matters with clients, contractors, consultants, and regulatory authorities. Participate in project meetings to provide quality status updates and address quality concerns. Coordinate with design teams to resolve constructability issues or specification clarifications affecting quality. 

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related field required. Minimum 8-10 years of experience in quality assurance/quality control for civil construction projects. Prior experience with project and development services or construction management firms preferred. 

Technical Knowledge

Thorough understanding of civil construction methods, materials, and specifications for earthworks, concrete, asphalt, utilities, and site development. Knowledge of relevant building codes, standards (ACI, ASTM, AASHTO), and regulatory requirements. Familiarity with construction testing procedures and acceptance criteria for civil works materials. 

Professional Certifications

Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent professional certification preferred. QAQC-related certifications (CQM, CQA, or similar) highly desirable. Current knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems beneficial. 

Skills & Competencies

Strong analytical skills with attention to detail for reviewing technical documents and identifying quality issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills for preparing reports and interfacing with diverse stakeholders. Proficiency in quality management software, inspection tools, and Microsoft Office suite. Ability to read and interpret civil engineering drawings and specifications. 

Working Conditions

Position requires regular site visits to active construction sites with exposure to outdoor weather conditions and construction hazards. Must be able to walk construction sites, climb ladders, and access all areas requiring inspection. Some travel between multiple project sites may be required depending on portfolio assignments. 

This position supports JLL's commitment to delivering exceptional project outcomes through rigorous quality management and continuous improvement in civil works construction.

About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible for driving business excellence and organization transformation through continuous improvement initiatives, while ensuring compliance with IMS, DISHA, ABEM, and other quality frameworks through regular audits, training, and process management. Additionally, this role will also oversee equipment management strategies, optimize resource allocation, and maintain high standards of operational excellence in line with Six Sigma methodologies. 

Responsibilities

Deputy Manager - MTPOE (MIS&OE)

Integrated Management Systems (IMS) And Audits

Ensure adherence to the 9 standards as outlined in the IMS framework. 

Facilitate communication for internal audits, collate observations, ensure timely closure of findings and manage the recertification process. 

Organize and lead management review meetings to communicate audit findings and drive continuous improvement. 

Coordinate refresher trainings for new joiners on IMS and provide auditor training as needed. 

Oversee surveillance audits conducted by external auditors, such as TUV NORD, and ensure compliance with observations.

data.title: AME-End of Line Deployment Engineer
data.description:
Position Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

Vertiv is seeking a AME Manufacturing Development & Deployment Engineer. This role is the critical architect of our "Connected Factory, " responsible for the physical and digital realization of manufacturing processes on the plant floor. You will lead the deployment of advanced production lines for Power and Thermal products, ensuring that Discrete Event Simulation (DES) and Yamazumi models are executed with precision. This role requires a leader who can manage the convergence of physical equipment-such as Automation cells and DC Torque tools-with our OT digital stack, including Inductive Automation's Ignition, Power Apps, and mobile tablet integration, to ensure a seamless "Vertical Startup" with real-time data visibility

Responsibilities

- On-Site Process & OT Deployment: Lead the physical installation of manufacturing lines, integrating OT devices and Automation into a unified factory ecosystem. Orchestrate the rollout of Ignition Perspective HMI and Microsoft Power Apps to provide shop-floor operators with real-time digital work instructions and performance dashboards. 
 - Smart Tooling & IoT Integration: Direct the deployment and calibration of DC Torque tools and smart sensors. Ensure these devices are networked to capture granular assembly data (e. g. , torque curves, cycle times) to feed directly into the Digital Twin and Quality Management Systems. 
 - Factory-Level Yamazumi Execution: Validate and refine Yamazumi modeling on the shop floor. Utilize Tablets and mobile devices to conduct live work content graphing, ensuring the synchronization of manual labor with automated machine cycles to meet Takt time targets. 
 - Digital-to-Physical Validation: Use Discrete Event Simulation (DES) data to guide the layout of automation cells and material handling. Verify that the physical throughput and data latency of networked OT devices match simulation predictions, neutralizing bottlenecks during the deployment phase. 
 - Full Line Balancing & Tablet-Based SOPs: Synchronize all factory processes, deploying Tablets at each workstation to replace paper-based systems. Ensure a seamless data flow between automated cells and manual enclosure integration through integrated Power Automate workflows. 
 - Equipment & Automation Commissioning: Oversee the validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) of manufacturing equipment, including robotics, conveyors, and testing protocols. Ensure all OT infrastructure is robust, secure, and fully communicative with the broader MES/ERP environment. 
 - Digital Handoff & Hyper-care: Lead the creation of digital Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Act as the primary technical lead during the launch "hyper-care" period, troubleshooting both physical mechanical issues and digital logic gaps in the Ignition/Power App interface. 
 - Cross-Functional Factory Alignment: Collaborate with IT, Plant Managers, and Supply Chain to ensure the factory's network infrastructure supports high-density IoT and mobile tablet connectivity required for new deployments. 

Skills

- Deployment & Automation Expertise: Proven ability to manage large-scale equipment installations and PLC/Automation startups in an international environment. 
 - OT Stack Proficiency: Hands-on experience deploying Inductive Automation (Ignition), Microsoft Power Apps, and Power Automate within a manufacturing context. 
 - Smart Hardware Integration: Expert knowledge of integrating DC Torque tools, OT gateways, and Industrial Tablets into a production line. 
 - Operational Line Balancing: Advanced proficiency in Takt time optimization and Work Content Graphing using digital data collection tools. 
 - Simulation Application: Ability to use Discrete Event Simulation outputs to optimize the placement of automation and the configuration of digital workflows. 
 - Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English and Spanish to facilitate communication with regional engineering teams and local factory staff

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

- Degrees: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Mechanical/Electrical Engineering. 
 - Experience: Minimum of 15+ years of hands-on experience in manufacturing deployment or plant engineering, specifically with power products or high-complexity electronics. 
 - Proven Launch Track Record: Demonstrated success in "Vertical Startups" and the physical implementation of DFM/DFA principles on the factory floor. 
 - Software Proficiency: Experience with Advanced Simulation tools (e. g. , FlexSim, Arena) and CAD (SolidWorks/AutoCAD) for factory footprint and layout design. 
 - Certification: Six Sigma Black Belt or Lean Certification is highly desirable. 

Physical Requirements

No Special Physical Requirements

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

No Special Requirements

Travel Time Required

- 25%

Work Authorization

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

 - Write and review production-quality code in Python, Java, or Go, applying secure coding, testing, and maintainability practices

 - Implement Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and establish repeatable, reviewable, and compliant platform changes
 - Define and use service-level indicators and objectives for availability, latency, errors, capacity, and recovery, and build actionable observability with metrics, logs, traces, and alerts

 - Lead incident response for supported services, drive technical diagnosis and mitigation, and deliver blameless reviews with tracked engineering actions that reduce recurrence

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience

 - Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
 - Practical experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, state management, review practices, and deployment pipelines
 - Experience defining or operating monitoring, alerting, capacity signals, and recovery measures using service-level indicators and service-level objectives
 - Specialization in infrastructure areas such as distributed storage, databases, or operating at scale, with exposure to technologies from startups or large enterprises

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

- Experience with enterprise Git platforms and workflows, including GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket
 - Experience operating stateful platforms using PostgreSQL or Amazon Aurora, Redis, object storage, replication, and data recovery
 - Experience designing or operating multi-Availability Zone or multi-region architectures, including regional failover and recovery exercises
 - Familiarity with observability platforms and practices such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Dynatrace, or Splunk

data.title: Senior Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Manages team delivering scalable distributed systems and components on a 2-4 quarter horizon. Standardizes engineering practices and scalability requirements across teams; oversees optimization for high‐throughput, hyper‐scale workloads; and ensures effective use of distributed state tools and data plane platforms. Guides teams to design fault‐tolerant, in‐service‐upgradable systems, set SLO‐aligned durability/availability targets, and implement resiliency mechanisms (load‐shedding, throttling, rate‐limiting). Provides oversight for KPIs, telemetry, and moderately complex dashboards; directs design of functional/correctness requirements, fault‐injection tests, and replication/synchronization strategies. Ensures proactive incident management, operational readiness, and on‐call coverage; drives encryption/access control practices, remediation plans, and compliance documentation. Oversees development and maintenance of automation/IaC and partners with teams on change‐management plans enabling safe patching, updates, and rollbacks. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

- Manages the development and implementation of scalable distributed systems and components across multiple teams, including the effective use of distributed state management tools. 
 - Oversees code and/or system optimization efforts for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements within and across teams to support hyper-scale systems. 
 - Guides teams to define scalability requirements for owned components and ensures design and implementation requirements are met. 
 - Manages the use of data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 
 - Ensures team accurately designs performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

- Manages the strategy for building fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by guiding the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 
 - Develops design strategies for systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 
 - Leads implementation and optimization initiatives across teams for approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 
 - Guides teams to design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

- Provides oversight in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 
 - Oversees the building and customization of moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

- Oversees the design and implementation of functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 
 - Guides teams to design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 
 - Directs implementation strategies for data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

- Guides teams to be proactive when diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation. 
 - Ensures teams leverage expertise to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 
 - Oversees operational readiness protocol and ensures teams remain knowledgeable of owned components and systems to support effective troubleshooting and performance. 
 - Oversees and approves schedules for operational support rotations. 

Compliance & Security: 

- Oversees implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, ensuring team strategies incorporate encryption techniques and access controls. 
 - Directs execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, promoting continuous improvement of security measures. 
 - Ensures comprehensive documentation and cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

- Oversees the development and maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Works with teams to create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and guides development of components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets (when applicable) are monitored and met. 
 - Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. 
 - Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align on expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. 
 - Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. 
 - Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues, as well as guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. 
 - Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping teams to identify potential solutions. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. 
 - Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. 
 - Identifies skill gaps across teams and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge-sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to apply learnings to advance the organization. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Drives teams to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. 
 - Guides teams to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. 
 - Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. 
 - Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. B. Tech/M. Tech with Understanding of Avionics Systems/Software Architecture - Datalink, CNS, FMS, Displays.

Solid background in Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC): requirements, design, coding, integration, and verification with exposure to DO-178B/C.

Experience with software-software, hardware-software integration and debugging.

Hands-on with: VectorCast, PyATE, RapiTest, Git, subverion

Knowledge of DevSecops, Cybersecurity, Networking, AI/ML, ACDE pipeline tools

Acumen for Lean and Innovation.

data.title: Deputy Group Manager - Continuous Improvement
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting embraces long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that, accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process mining, and AI-powered workflows. 

You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including IBM Software and Red Hat. 

Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be supported by mentors and coaches who will encourage you to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and learning opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience. 

Function Introduction

We are a Continuous Improvement (CI) team supporting IBM CPS business globally. The primary objective of the CI team is to work with the delivery team and to drive continuous improvement and Transformation agenda build for clients based on client and IBM priorities. Some of the key deliverables for the team are to reduce the cost of operations by driving productivity improvement projects, projects to improve performance on other business outcome metrics, and build lean Six Sigma DNA through conducting training, mentoring, and certifying lean, YB and GB projects. CI team is also responsible for other initiatives like supporting new transitions to ensure performance management framework is created and operational, Visual Management on the floor, process operational risks assessment of critical processes by conducting FMEA or other process risks assessments and, propose required controls. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

Your Role and Responsibilities

- As a Continuous Improvement (CI)Lead, the person would be aligned to an account or cluster of accounts. 
 - Work with the delivery team, the rest of the CI/Automation team and the client to build and drive a Transformation agenda for that client involving a cluster of projects driving the cost of operations and other business outcomes through E2E process re-engineering/automation. 
 - Build Lean Six Sigma DNA by conducting lean/Six Sigma training, mentoring and certifying lean, YB and GB projects. 
 - Identifying and Leading impact Black Belt projects on various CTQs like Quality, Productivity etc and closing. 
 - Support new transitions from Quality to implementing a Business Process Management System (BPMS) to ensure process performance measurement framework is created and operational. 
 - Implement internal Quality Control Management Framework with the help of Quality Auditors and Quality Focal. Responsibilities include daily auditing of transactions. as per the agreed approach with the client, conducting RCA, and identifying and implementing CAPAs to ensure Quality scores are within SLA target. 
 - Effective Visual Management on the floor. 
 - Process operational risk assessment of critical processes by conducting FMEA or other process risk assessments and, propose required controls. 
 - Any short/medium-term project or initiative(s) linked to business priorities. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- 10-12 Years of relevant work experience in below mentioned areas: 

Ø Certified Lean / Six Sigma Black Belt / Master Black Belt from a recognized organization / Institute. 

- Identifying and Leading impact Black Belt projects on various CTQs like Quality, Productivity etc and closing. 
 - Ability to build and lead Transformation Roadmap involving different types of projects - process-related, Tech/automation, Target operating model etc. 
 - Identification of improvement opportunities by conducting E2E Value Stream Mapping (VSM) workshops involving cross-functional teams. 
 - Sound knowledge of Lean and Six Sigma and application of the same in F&A, R&C and T&T processes. 
 - Ability to work with cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience in managing change management on his/ her own without much support. 
 - Knowledge of various RPA solutions available in the market, handling of RPA/Desktop automation assessments and implementing E2E solutions. 
 - Conducting Lean and Six Sigma training for the operations team. 
 - Coaching / Mentoring lean, YB and GB projects. 
 - Innovative Visual Management on the floor. 
 - Strong client-facing and presentation skills. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Finance and Accounts background and knowledge of P2P /R2R /O2C, Banking, KYC, and AML. 
 - Working directly with executive-level leaders. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Good Interpersonal Skills. 
 - Business knowledge/acumen and quick ability to learn new things. 
 - Strong priority setting, initiative, and follow-through

data.title: Tech Specialist
data.description:
The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership

With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we're taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we're elevating the standards for an entire industry - and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership. 

At Kidde Global Solutions, you're joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you'll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We're committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You'll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way. 

Role description: -

- System Architecture: Architect scalable, highly deterministic firmware topologies spanning varied MCU architectures (ARM Cortex-M/R, RISC-V, proprietary 32-bit cores) using FreeRTOS or equivalent real-time operating systems. 
 - Advanced Protocol Engineering: Design resilient, error-tolerant communication frameworks over wired and wireless layers (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN-FD, Ethernet, BLE/Wi-Fi), ensuring robust handling, packet recovery, and low-latency throughput. 
 - Voice & Audio Architecture: Define architectural pipelines for voice and audio processing systems, managing DMA-driven audio links (I2S, SAI, PDM), audio codecs, and digital signal processing blocks. 
 - Advanced Debugging & Diagnostics: Conduct deep-dive analysis of complex runtime issues (race conditions, memory leaks, stack overflows) using advanced GDB scripting, hardware trace (ETM/ITM), logic analyzers, and high-bandwidth oscilloscopes. 
 - Test Architecture & TDD: Champion a rigorous TDD/BDD culture by architecting hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments and setting up advanced C/C++ test frameworks (GTest/GMock, CppUTest) within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Technical Leadership: Mentor mid-level engineers, establish embedded coding standards (MISRA C/C++), and align firmware development with hardware lifecycle strategies. 

🎓 Qualifications & Technical Skills

- Experience: 15+ years of hands-on experience in firmware engineering, with a history of leading projects from conceptual design through mass production. 
 - Languages: Expert-level knowledge of C and modern Embedded C++. 
 - Architectures: Deep, register-level understanding of multiple MCU vendor portfolios, memory maps, bootloaders, and low-power states. 
 - RTOS Internals: Expert understanding of RTOS scheduling algorithms, custom memory allocators, and priority inversion mitigation techniques. 
 - Testing & Tools: Proven track record of building automated unit-testing pipelines for target and off-target verification. 

World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety

Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

Job Description

As part of the Development Engineering team, the Control Software Designer designs, supports, and troubleshoots control systems for Injection Molding Machines(IMM) and Mold controllers. This role operates in a fast-paced, innovative environment and focuses on developing creative, high-quality solutions to complex technical challenges. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability: 

- Design control systems for IMM and Mold controller applications including servo drive and servo-hydraulic controls, injection molding process control. 
 - Provide functional, design specifications and validation plans for new IMM and Mold controller functionality. 
 - Software development of machine sequences (PLC IEC 61131-3), process control, human-machine interface(HMI) in Windows environment. 
 - Troubleshoot and debug real-time and non-real-time software. 
 - Document software changes using resources such as TFS/VSTS and Azure DevOps. 
 - Document development, design changes and production design activities. 
 - Communicate design with other design groups and businesses. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Electrical & Electronics/ECE/Instrumentation/Software Engineering preferred, or equivalent. 
 - Minimum 5 years hands-on experience in automated control system design and troubleshooting preferred. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - PLC structured text language design and programming using IEC 61131-3. 
 - Experience in programming using C, C++, C# or other high-level languages for HMI applications (Ruby). 
 - Strong knowledge of PC based control systems and embedded system. 
 - Strong Knowledge of control theory and model-based design principles. 
 - Knowledge of PLC's and motion controllers. 
 - Working knowledge of standard industrial communication networks and protocols such as RS232, RS485, Ethernet, CANOpen, Profibus, Profinet and EtherCAT.

Role Purpose

The team is responsible for performing quality analysis of the vouchers processed by the Accounts Payable team day before as well as check for the possible duplicate payments to stop the same from being paid to vendors again. Perform QA of the vouchers processed by the AP team day before, QA is done on sample bases in order to confirm that team covers entire population as well as major portion of value of invoices processed day before the QA is done.  - To perform QA on each of the samples based upon pre-defined QA criteria. 
 - To work on duplicate report on daily basis in order to identify the possible duplicates. 
 - To check & notify for actual duplicates identified with clear comments supporting the decision for deletion of such vouchers from the system. 
 - Sending daily QA reports to AP team leads
 - Sending daily duplicate analysis to AP Specialty teams.
