data.description:
Your role

The Lead / Senior Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer will serve as a technical expert for Steam Systems, Energy Conversion Technologies, Heat Recovery Solutions, Industrial Utilities, and Process Control Systems. The role will be responsible for delivering advanced Electrical & Instrumentation engineering solutions, supporting business growth initiatives, driving technical excellence, and strengthening organizational capability in this strategic domain. 

The position requires extensive experience in Electrical Power Systems, Instrumentation & Automation, Steam Applications, Industrial Heat Pumps, Process Utilities, and Energy Efficiency Solutions. The successful candidate is expected to independently handle complex engineering challenges, provide technical guidance to project teams, and support customer-facing activities. 

Your day-to-day

We are seeking a skilled Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer with 8-15 years of design and project execution experience in an engineering or product-based organization. The ideal candidate will have expertise in designing and estimating power, control, and instrumentation systems, particularly for engine/motor-driven compressors. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) engineering activities for Energy Conversion, Steam, and industrial automation projects. 
 - Develop and review engineering deliverables, including specifications, calculations, drawings, datasheets, and design documents. 
 - Design and estimate power distribution, control, and instrumentation systems in compliance with project requirements and applicable standards. 
 - Develop control philosophies, I/O architecture, instrumentation layouts, control system designs, and electrical system configurations. 
 - Perform sizing and selection of electrical equipment, switchgear, motors, instruments, cables, and associated components. 
 - Prepare and review panel layouts, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, and wire harness designs. 
 - Ensure compliance with international standards and regulations, including IEC, CSA, UL, and customer-specific requirements. 
 - Review vendor proposals, technical documents, and equipment specifications to ensure technical suitability and project compliance. 
 - Support the design, manufacturing, testing, commissioning, and optimization of control panels, starter panels, and electrical systems. 
 - Participate in customer meetings, technical reviews, site surveys, and engineering workshops to define and validate project requirements. 
 - Provide technical leadership during project execution, troubleshooting, commissioning, and performance improvement activities. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Mechanical, Process, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Service, and Project Management functions. 
 - Translate customer and technical requirements into clear engineering specifications and actionable design solutions. 
 - Coordinate engineering activities across multiple projects, ensuring on-time and high-quality deliverables. 
 - Take ownership of project planning, execution, resource coordination, and technical risk management. 
 - Drive standardization, digitalization, value engineering, and continuous improvement initiatives across engineering processes. 
 - Mentor and support engineers by sharing technical expertise and strengthening organizational competency in E&I systems. 
 - Provide technical guidance and support throughout the project lifecycle while maintaining close coordination with stakeholders and leadership teams. 

Qualifications

Your skills and experience

- Education: BE/B. Tech/M. Tech in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering
 - Experience: 8-12 years for Lead/Senior Engineer level. 
 - Proven experience in Process Industry, Energy, Utilities, Power, Oil & Gas, or Industrial Manufacturing sectors. 
 - Hands-on experience operational support of utility/process systems. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in Steam, Energy Recovery, and Electrical & Instrumentation Engineering. 

Technical Skills

Electrical Engineering

- Expertise in LV/MV power distribution systems, motor control systems, MCCs, starters, VFDs, soft starters, and LV/MV/HV motors. 
 - Experience in switchgear sizing and selection, panel layout design, wire harness design, and cable selection in accordance with IEC, UL, CSA, ATEX, and CE standards. 
 - Knowledge of electrical protection and coordination studies. 
 - Experience in cable engineering, routing, and cable schedule preparation. 
 - Proficiency in designing earthing, grounding, and lightning protection systems. 
 - Strong understanding of electrical system integration and control panel design. 

Instrumentation & Automation

- Experience in process instrument sizing, selection, and specification. 
 - Knowledge of PLC, SCADA, HMI, and industrial automation systems. 
 - Understanding of functional safety concepts, interlocks, HAZOP, SIL, and Cause & Effect (C&E) development. 
 - Experience in industrial communication networks and control system architecture. 
 - Well versed in hazardous area classification (ATEX/IECEx) and selection of instruments, junction boxes, and control panels for hazardous locations. 
 - Hands-on experience in FAT, SAT, commissioning, troubleshooting, and system validation activities. 

Steam & Energy Conversion Domain Knowledge

- Industrial Steam Systems and Utility Integration
 - Steam Compression Technologies
 - Mechanical Vapor Recompression (MVR)
 - Industrial Heat Pumps
 - Waste Heat Recovery Systems
 - Energy Recovery and Process Optimization
 - Boiler and Utility Integration
 - Process Heating Systems
 - Thermal Process Engineering
 - Industrial Utility Management
 - Decarbonization and Sustainability Projects

Standards & Compliance

- Thorough knowledge of international standards and codes, including IEC, ISA, UL, API, NFPA, ISO, CSA, ATEX, IECEx, and CE requirements. 

Your Compensation And Benefits

At Atlas Copco Group, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation is determined based on the position and its responsibilities, without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our compensation offering is designed to be locally relevant, competitive, and aligned with the expectations of current and future talent.

At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work.

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco, GECIA Office in Pune, Hinjewadi. 

Why it is great to work with us

Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‐term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act - we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. data.title: Principal Software Development Engineer (Backend Dev - C/DLP/Linux)
data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering in the Data Protection department. 

In this position, you will serve as a premier technical leader, defining architectural direction, designing high-performance systems-level subsystems, and driving the engineering execution of our next-generation inspection capabilities. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Architect and implement high-performance DLP engines, dictionary compilers, and distributed incident processing pipelines, setting the benchmark for clean, highly optimized systems-level C code running in production proxy runtimes
 - Own the technical direction and architectural roadmap for line-rate pattern matching, regular expression evaluators, custom dictionary compilers, exact data match (EDM), and indexed document matching (IDM)
 - Help develop next-generation Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions utilizing Machine Learning (ML) models, collaborating with data science teams to successfully deploy and integrate models in high-throughput data paths while balancing inspection capabilities against strict network latency and resource constraints
 - Establish and enforce exacting architectural standards for multi-threaded C daemons on FreeBSD/Linux, designing robust shared memory structures, high-performance Inter-Process Communication (IPC), lockless concurrency, and memory-safe subsystems
 - Serve as the technical escalation authority for critical production issues-leading hands-on post-mortem core dump analysis, deep system profiling, and leak detection

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You act like an owner with a bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level architectural strategy and hands-on execution. 
 - You are a high-trust collaborator who embraces open feedback, communicates with candor and respect, and champions the collective success of the engineering team. 
 - You are customer-obsessed, anchoring technical and design decisions in solving real-world challenges for both internal stakeholders and external users. 
 - You are driven by innovation and intellectual curiosity, continually seeking robust, secure, and scalable approaches to complex systems engineering challenges. 
 - You lead with integrity and high accountability, building trust through consistent, transparent action and technical stewardship. 

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
 - 10+ years of experience with systems software engineering, including a proven track record of technical leadership (e. g. , as a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer) driving the design and delivery of high-performance backend platforms
 - Advanced hands-on proficiency in C programming on Linux or FreeBSD runtime environments, with deep architectural expertise in Inter-Process Communication (IPC) and shared memory architectures
 - Expert-level proficiency in production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, including post-mortem core dump analysis, GDB/LLDB debugging, Valgrind, and system-level performance tracing
 - Proven track record of mentoring, guiding, and multiplying the impact of systems software engineers across the organization, championing engineering excellence, conducting rigorous design reviews, and fostering continuous technical growth

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
 - Strong familiarity with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies, including regex evaluation engines, custom dictionary compilers, and EDM (Exact Data Match) / IDM (Indexed Document Matching) profiles
 - Hands-on experience or familiarity with public cloud environments (specifically AWS and Azure), including deploying, optimizing, or maintaining performance-intensive cloud-native systems

data.title: HEAD – QUALITY ASSURANCE & MANAGEMENT REPRESENTATIVE
data.description:
To lead the organisation's Quality Assurance and Quality Control functions and take ownership of implementing, maintaining and continually improving the Integrated Management System (IMS), covering ISO 9001 - Quality Management, ISO 14001 - Environmental Management and ISO 45001 - Occupational Health and Safety. The role will ensure product and process conformity, customer satisfaction, audit readiness, compliance with applicable requirements and effective deployment of the management system across all departments and operating locations. 

3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - A. QUALITY ASSURANCE & QUALITY CONTROL

- Lead QA/QC activities for pole manufacturing, PEB structures, structural and sheet-metal fabrication, welding, surface treatment, painting, assembly, erection and dispatch. 
 - Establish quality plans, inspection and test plans, process controls, acceptance criteria and stage-wise inspection checkpoints. 
 - Ensure compliance with customer specifications, approved drawings, applicable codes and standards, and internal requirements. 
 - Oversee incoming, in-process, final and dispatch inspection; ensure proper control and disposition of non-conforming products. 
 - Drive right-first-time manufacturing and reduce rejection, rework, scrap and customer complaints. 

B. CUSTOMER & SUPPLIER QUALITY

- Act as the key quality interface for customers and coordinate customer audits, inspections, quality reviews and complaint resolution. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for customer complaints, field failures and warranty issues using 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D and other suitable tools. 
 - Evaluate and monitor supplier quality in coordination with Purchase; conduct supplier audits and drive supplier corrective actions and development. 
 - Monitor customer satisfaction, supplier performance and recurring quality issues. 

C. ISO / IMS IMPLEMENTATION & MAINTENANCE - MR ROLE

- Lead implementation, integration and ongoing maintenance of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 across the organisation. 
 - Develop, review and maintain IMS policies, objectives, procedures, SOPs, work instructions, process maps, registers and documented information. 
 - Ensure departments implement approved systems and that process owners understand their IMS responsibilities. 
 - Coordinate risk and opportunity assessments, environmental aspects and impacts, OH&S hazard identification and risk assessments, and monitoring of applicable compliance obligations. 
 - Monitor IMS objectives, compliance status, corrective actions and continual-improvement activities; report significant gaps to Management. 
 - Maintain document and record control, including revision, approval, availability, retention and withdrawal of obsolete documents. 

D. INTERNAL AUDITS, EXTERNAL AUDITS & MANAGEMENT REVIEW

- Prepare the annual internal audit programme and organise internal, process and compliance audits across relevant departments and locations. 
 - Ensure audits are conducted by competent auditors, findings are recorded, action owners and timelines are assigned, and corrective-action effectiveness is verified. 
 - Coordinate and actively participate in external certification, surveillance, recertification, customer and other applicable audits as the organisation's MR. 
 - Coordinate audit responses, submission of objective evidence and closure of external audit findings within agreed timelines. 
 - Organise Management Review Meetings, consolidate required inputs, present IMS and quality performance, record decisions and follow up action items to closure. 

E. QUALITY IMPROVEMENT, CALIBRATION & COST OF QUALITY

- Drive SPC, process capability, MSA/Gauge R&R, FMEA, RCA, 8D, Kaizen, Poka-Yoke and other relevant improvement methods. 
 - Ensure calibration and verification of measuring instruments, inspection equipment and testing devices, with traceable records. 
 - Monitor rejection, rework, scrap, warranty and other Cost of Poor Quality indicators; lead initiatives to reduce quality-related losses. 
 - Lead cross-functional improvement projects and verify the effectiveness and sustainability of implemented actions. F. TEAM LEADERSHIP, TRAINING & REPORTING

- Lead the Quality team, define responsibilities and targets, monitor performance and develop team competency. 
 - Identify and organise training on ISO requirements, quality tools, inspection methods, welding/fabrication quality, SPC, RCA and customer requirements. 
 - Prepare and present quality and IMS MIS, KPI trends, audit status, NCR/CAPA status, customer complaints, supplier performance and COPQ reports. 
 - Promote quality awareness, process discipline, accountability and continual improvement across the organisation. 

G. ERP & PROCESS COORDINATION

- Coordinate quality-related ERP processes and ensure inspection, non-conformance, supplier quality and traceability transactions are accurately recorded. 
 - Work with department process owners and the ERP service provider to resolve system issues, coordinate approved changes and support user training. 
 - Monitor quality-related ERP data, reports and process compliance; escalate recurring or significant issues to Management. 

4. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

- B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or an equivalent engineering discipline. 
 - A relevant postgraduate qualification or certification in Quality Management / Operations Management will be an added advantage. 
 - Preferred certifications: ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor; ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 auditor / implementation training; Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt. 

5. EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

- 12-20 years of overall experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control in manufacturing, fabrication, PEB, structural steel, pole manufacturing, sheet metal or engineering industries. 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior Quality leadership / managerial position. 
 - Hands-on experience in implementing and maintaining ISO 9001; practical working knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 implementation and maintenance. 
 - Experience in planning and organising internal audits and participating in external certification, surveillance and customer audits. 
 - Strong exposure to welding and fabrication quality, inspection and testing, customer complaint management, supplier quality and process improvement. 
 - Experience in leading a team and coordinating with multiple departments. Manufacturing ERP exposure is desirable. 
 - 6. TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

- Strong understanding of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements and Integrated Management Systems. 
 - Internal audit planning, audit execution, non-conformity reporting, corrective action and effectiveness verification. 
 - QA/QC practices for welding, fabrication, structural steel, PEB, poles, surface preparation, galvanising / coating and painting. 
 - Inspection and test plans, material traceability, inspection reports, calibration and measurement system control. 
 - SPC, process capability, MSA / Gauge R&R, FMEA, 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone and other quality tools. 
 - Customer and supplier quality management, root-cause analysis and Cost of Poor Quality analysis. 
 - Document control, process mapping, risk-based thinking, compliance obligation monitoring and Management Review. 
 - ERP process understanding, quality MIS, KPI monitoring, MS Excel and data analysis. 

7. BEHAVIOURAL & LEADERSHIP REQUIREMENTS

- Strong leadership, ownership and accountability for overall quality and IMS performance. 
 - High integrity, professional ethics, impartiality and commitment to compliance. 
 - Ability to influence Department Heads and drive implementation of systems across functions without relying only on authority. 
 - Strong communication, presentation, coordination and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Analytical thinking, structured problem-solving and data-based decision-making. 
 - Proactive approach, attention to detail and strong follow-up to ensure actions are completed on time. 
 - Customer-focused mindset and ability to handle customer complaints, audits and critical quality situations professionally. 
 - Ability to lead, coach and develop team members and build a culture of quality, safety, environmental responsibility and continual improvement. 
 - Ability to work under pressure, prioritise multiple activities and escalate significant risks appropriately.

data.title: Global Network & Telecom Services - Software Engineer
data.description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter. 

Job Description

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it's equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers. 

The Impact You'll Make in this Role

The person filling this role will join 3M's world-class Global Network & Telecom Services organization as a software engineer on the Network Automation team. You will build the enterprise applications and AI-powered services that keep 3M's global network reliable and efficient. 

This is a hands-on software development role. You will design, build and ship production applications where AI is part of the solution, such as generative AI features on AWS Bedrock, agent-driven workflows, tool calling and natural-language interfaces. You will use AI code assistants every day to speed up delivery. You will work across the full stack, from user interfaces and APIs to data integrations, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. You will work alongside experienced engineers in a globally distributed team. 

Network Automation Or Network Platform Experience Is a Plus, And The Team Will Help You Learn The Domain. This Position Requires Occasional Work Outside Normal Business Hours. Here, You Will Make An Impact By

- Design, develop, test and maintain applications and services using Python and/or TypeScript/Node. js, with modern front-end frameworks (for example React) for dashboards, visualizations and conversational interfaces. 
 - Build features that use generative AI on AWS Bedrock, including foundation model integration, Agents, Knowledge Bases/Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, tool/function calling and streaming responses. 
 - Develop Large Language Model (LLM) and agent-driven capabilities such as triage, summarization and natural-language query, and help test and monitor how well they perform and use AI code assistants (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Kiro) as a core part of daily development, following team practices for AI-assisted coding, code review and testing. 
 - Build and maintain Application programming interfaces (API), services and data integrations, reconciling data from sources such as Configuration management Database (CMDB), cloud inventory, Domain Name System (DNS)/IP Address Management (IPAM) and Information Technology Service Manager. 
 - Write and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, and deploy to AWS in a secure, repeatable way and use Git, GitHub Actions and continuous integration/continuous delivery/deployment (CI/CD) to build, test and release software with automated testing and code review. 
 - Follow enterprise engineering standards for secure coding, access control, logging and monitoring, documentation and translate business and operational requirements into technical solutions. Document workflows and runbooks, provide support escalation as needed, and collaborate with a globally distributed team using Agile/Scrum practices. 

Your Skills And Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline (completed and verified prior to start). 
 - Over all 10 years IT work experience, including 5 years of software development experience in Python and/or TypeScript/Node. js, including building web applications and APIs
 - Experience building applications that integrate AI or LLM services (for example AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI), or a strong aptitude to do so. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI code assistants in daily development. 
 - Working knowledge of Git, version control and CI/CD concepts, and comfort working with YAML. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and excellent written and verbal communication. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team in a fast-paced environment. 

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: 

- Experience building and shipping applications on AWS Bedrock, including agents, RAG, tool calling and streaming responses. 
 - Experience developing software in a large enterprise environment, with attention to security, compliance and change management & experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and Azure) & experience with SQL and relational databases, Graph QL, and designing/consuming APIs. 
 - Experience building dashboards, data-dense views or real-time/streaming UIs (for example WebSocket's), Front-end testing experience (for example Jest, Playwright or Cypress)
 - Experience with network automation, network platforms or network data & Familiarity with Agile frameworks. 

Location: Bangalore (Hebbal), Hybrid Mode

Supporting Your Well-being

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life - both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope. 

Chat with Max

For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M. com/careers. 

Learn more about 3M's creative solutions to the world's problems at www. 3M. com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M. 

Safety is a core value at 3M. All employees are expected to contribute to a strong Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) culture by following safety policies, identifying hazards, and engaging in continuous improvement. 

Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly. 

3M Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement

Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at 3M are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms. 

Please click on the following links and select the country where you are applying for employment to review the applicable Terms of Use (link here) and Privacy Policy (link here). Before submitting your application, you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.

We are looking for a . NET Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Engineering team. The team works across multiple Business Units and technology initiatives, supporting new product development, application enhancements, application modernization, and integrations. 

The role requires strong C# coding skills applied to test automation across UI, API, and database layers. Our environment includes both modern applications and long-running legacy systems, so the SDET must be comfortable building automation for new features as well as adding regression coverage to legacy . NET applications that are being modernized. 

The ideal candidate thinks like a developer and a tester, builds maintainable automation frameworks rather than one-off scripts, embeds quality into CI/CD pipelines, and uses AI-assisted tools to speed up test creation.

- Design, build, and maintain test automation frameworks in C# / . NET for UI, API, and integration testing.

 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines with quality gates and clear reporting. 
 - Build regression safety nets for legacy . NET applications before and during modernization. 
 - Review requirements and user stories for testability; define test strategy, test plans, and acceptance criteria with product and engineering. 
 - Perform exploratory and manual testing where automation is not cost-effective. 
 - Run basic performance and load tests, and help identify bottlenecks. 
 - Log, triage, and track defects; perform root cause analysis with developers. 
 - Manage test data and test environments. 
 - Track and report quality metrics (coverage, defect leakage, flaky test rate, pass rate). 
 - Participate in code reviews, including reviewing unit tests written by developers. 
 - Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and Business Unit stakeholders across multiple projects.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

Job summary

We are building the trust layer for the agentic future. As AI agents move from simple chatbots to autonomous workloads with access to sensitive enterprise data, the industry lacks a standard for Identity, Authentication, and Governance. 

This role will own the automation strategy that gives the team confidence to ship the AI Agent Trust without breaking critical trust and enforcement behavior. 

This is not a manual QA coordinator role. It is an engineering role focused on automated validation across backend, infrastructure, runtime, and end-to-end operator workflows. 

  

What you will do

- Build and maintain automated test coverage across control-plane services, API contracts, UI workflows, identity flows, policy enforcement, and deployment lifecycle paths. 
 - Develop integration and end-to-end tests for Kubernetes-based enforcement. 
 - Build test strategies for Agents based in cloud: Kubernetes and serverless, and agents running as SaaS. The tests will include identity exchange, attestation, hosted proxy or external policy flows, and negative-path enforcement cases. 
 - Improve CI pipelines so the right levels of testing run automatically for backend, frontend, and infrastructure-sensitive changes. 
 - Create repeatable test fixtures, seeded environments, mock services, and data setup patterns that reduce test brittleness and increase developer velocity. 
 - Partner with backend, frontend, and platform engineers to define testable interfaces, improve diagnosability, and prevent regressions before release. 
 - Contribute to non-functional validation such as resiliency checks, failure-path validation, and targeted performance regression tests where needed.   

What you will have

- Strong experience writing automated tests for APIs, distributed systems, or cloud-native platforms. 
 - Experience with integration and end-to-end testing for systems that involve multiple services, infrastructure dependencies, or asynchronous workflows. 
 - Comfort working in at least one strong automation language such as TypeScript, Python, Go, or Java. 
 - Practical knowledge of CI systems, test reporting, flaky test reduction, and debugging failures in complex pipelines. 
 - Experience testing security-sensitive or identity-sensitive flows is a strong advantage. 
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes-based test environments, containerized services, or infrastructure-assisted testing is highly valuable. 
 - A mindset focused on engineering quality, signal over noise, and building sustainable test coverage rather than check-box QA. 
 - Startup Mindset: Comfortable operating in ambiguity. Bias toward shipping and iterative improvement
 - Experience owning complete test infrastructure and toolsets.   

Benefits

- Generous time off policies
 - Top shelf benefits
 - Education, wellness and lifestyle support  

To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.

data.title: Director - SoC Verification
data.description:
Job Title: 

- Director - SoC Verification

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have built a career at the intersection of deep SoC verification expertise and organizational leadership. You have closed coverage on complex multi-protocol designs and know that scaling verification across a services organization requires clear structure, strong leaders, and a strategy that holds when customer scope, timelines, and design complexity move at once. The difference between a verification plan that delivers and one that collapses three months before tapeout is usually visible early, and you are the kind of leader who sees it and acts before it becomes an escalation. You operate at two levels simultaneously. One day you are reviewing a coverage closure strategy for an automotive SoC with safety requirements your team has never seen before. The next you are restructuring team assignments because two customer engagements just expanded scope and you need to rebalance without dropping quality. You build leaders, not just projects. You know how to develop a senior engineer into someone who can own customer signoff, and you know when to step into a room yourself because the technical or relationship stakes require it. At Synopsys, you will lead verification for the System Solutions Group and shape how we deliver complex SoC services to customers who depend on us to get it right. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead and grow a multi-team SoC verification organization delivering customer-facing services across automotive, aerospace, defense, and high-performance computing
 - Define and drive SSG verification strategy, including methodology standards, signoff criteria, VIP and tool deployment, and reusable testbench patterns adopted across projects
 - Own organizational planning including headcount, hiring, succession, performance management, and skill development to build scalable verification capability
 - Partner with sales and account teams to scope opportunities, assess technical and resource risk, prioritize work against capacity, and align delivery with customer and business objectives
 - Serve as executive-level technical authority on complex SoC verification challenges, escalations, and convergence across multi-protocol, multi-domain, and advanced-node designs
 - Establish clear accountability across verification managers and technical leads, and drive adoption of Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP based on customer project learnings
 - Build and maintain executive customer relationships that enable long-term engagement growth and position Synopsys as the verification partner of choice for complex SoC programs

The Impact You Will Have

- Your organization will enable customers to tape out complex SoCs on schedule, affecting product launches in AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing
 - The verification strategy and standards you define will scale across SSG projects, improving coverage quality, reducing cycle time, and compressing ramp time on new engagements
 - The leaders you develop will strengthen Synopsys capability to win and execute larger, more complex verification service engagements
 - Your capacity planning and executive customer engagement will shape how leading semiconductor companies adopt Synopsys EDA tools, VIP, and verification services
 - What you build will directly influence how SSG scales verification delivery, wins competitive pursuits, and expands into new customer segments and protocol domains
 - The organizational structure and accountability model you establish will become the foundation for how SSG verification grows over the next three to five years

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 20+ years of hands-on SoC, subsystem, or IP verification experience, including significant leadership scope
 - Expert-level knowledge of UVM-based verification, coverage-driven closure, verification planning, and complex multi-domain debug across processor-based SoC architectures
 - Proven experience leading large verification organizations or multi-project teams through planning, delivery, and customer signoff in a services or product development environment
 - Deep working knowledge of protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, DDR, and AMBA interconnects, and hands-on proficiency with Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP
 - Demonstrated ability to build organizational structures with clear accountability, develop managers and technical leads, and partner with sales and senior customer stakeholders on scoping and escalations
 - Experience with ARM-based SoC architectures, automotive functional safety verification, or emulation flows is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You translate vague customer requests into scoped plans, staffed organizations, and delivery models your teams can execute without losing quality
 - You see both the technical gap and the organizational failure behind a coverage miss or escalation, and you know how to fix both
 - You build leaders, not just projects, and you invest time developing managers and senior engineers into people who can own customer outcomes independently
 - You communicate effectively to engineers debugging a testbench, customer architects reviewing signoff criteria, sales executives scoping a new opportunity, and Synopsys senior leadership reviewing quarterly business performance
 - You make hard calls on resource allocation, project prioritization, and team structure when the right answer is not the easy one, and you explain the tradeoff clearly enough that people understand why
 - You know when to delegate and when to step in yourself, whether that means reviewing a verification plan before it goes to a customer or sitting in an escalation call with an executive stakeholder

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will lead verification within the System Solutions Group (SSG), which delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers across high-performance computing, automotive, aerospace, and defense. You will build and lead the verification organization and collaborate with SSG design and architecture peers, sales, application engineering, IP, and EDA teams to deliver customer engagements and scale Synopsys verification capability. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager - C#.NET Distributed Systems
data.description:
Software Engineering Manager, DryvIQ Team at Nasuni - C#. NET

Hyderabad, India | Hybrid - 3 days onsite

Role overview

Nasuni is expanding the DryvIQ engineering team in Hyderabad following our acquisition of DryvIQ, bringing intelligent content discovery, classification, sensitivity detection, and policy-driven governance into the Nasuni platform. 

We're looking for a hands-on Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of approximately 4-7 Software Engineers building primarily backend services using C#/. NET, microservices, and distributed systems, with some React-based frontend development. 

This is a technical people-leadership role. You'll stay close enough to the architecture and code to challenge designs, troubleshoot difficult problems, and raise engineering standards, while your primary accountability is building an effective engineering team and delivering reliable product outcomes. 

This role is well suited to an engineering leader who still enjoys getting into technical details but measures success through the capability and results of the team. 

Level and scope

You will own the engineering effectiveness, delivery, technical quality, and development of a product engineering team. You'll make and facilitate architecture and engineering decisions within your area, translate product priorities into executable technical plans, and partner closely with Product, SDET/QA Automation, Security, Operations, and global Nasuni engineering teams. 

You will directly manage Software Engineers and work closely with SDET/QA Automation resources through a dotted-line partnership. 

What you'll do

- Lead, coach, and develop 4-7 Software Engineers while creating clear expectations for ownership, quality, collaboration, and growth. 
 - Guide the design and evolution of C#/. NET backend microservices, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and distributed processing systems. 
 - Stay technically engaged through architecture and design reviews, code reviews, debugging, incident analysis, and selective hands-on development. 
 - Own team execution from planning through production, balancing roadmap delivery with reliability, maintainability, security, and technical debt. 
 - Establish strong engineering practices around automated testing, CI/CD, observability, performance, secure development, and production readiness. 
 - Partner with SDET/QA Automation to build quality into engineering workflows rather than treating testing as a downstream activity. 
 - Develop systems that operate safely through partial failures, retries, rate limits, concurrency, backpressure, and changing workloads. 
 - Partner across DryvIQ and Nasuni as the platforms become more deeply integrated, maintaining appropriate tenant isolation, permissions, auditability, and sensitive-data controls. 
 - Hire and onboard engineers, provide actionable feedback, manage performance, and create development opportunities for the team. 
 - Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools to improve areas such as development, testing, debugging, code review, incident analysis, and engineering workflows while ensuring outputs are appropriately validated for correctness, security, performance, and data sensitivity. 

What success looks like

Within your first 90 days, you'll understand the DryvIQ architecture, establish trust with the engineering team and partners, and take ownership of team execution. 

Within 6-12 months, the team should demonstrate stronger delivery predictability, engineering quality and production ownership while delivering meaningful DryvIQ/Nasuni integration outcomes. 

Qualifications

Must-Have

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful recent backend/product engineering depth. 
 - 3+ years of direct people management or comparable sustained engineering-team leadership. 
 - Strong hands-on background with C#/. NET and production backend services. 
 - Experience designing, building, and operating microservices, distributed systems, or event driven architecture. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of engineering delivery, architecture decisions, production quality, and technical tradeoffs. 
 - Experience coaching engineers through technical and professional growth. 
 - Strong collaboration across Product, QA/SDET, architecture, and geographically distributed engineering teams. 

Preferred

- B2B SaaS or enterprise software product experience. 
 - Cloud-native development, containers, Kubernetes, messaging/event-driven systems, CI/CD, and observability. 
 - Database experience including Posgres and Clickhouse 
 - Experience leading teams responsible for high-volume data processing or complex integrations. 
 - Working knowledge of React or modern frontend architecture. 
 - Practical use of AI-assisted engineering and AI-Automation with disciplined validation. 

Ideal

- Content management, data governance, data security, classification, DLP, storage, information management, or repository/connector platforms. 
 - Experience integrating an acquired technology or modernizing systems across platform boundaries. 
 - Experience building teams during periods of rapid product and organizational change. 

Experience guideline: Typically 10-15+ years overall, including 3-6+ years leading software engineers. Scope and demonstrated impact matter more than years alone. 

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is building a next-generation, AI-ready platform that turns massive file estates into secure, governed, actionable data for automation, analytics, and global collaboration. 

Why work here - Hyderabad

Join at an important product moment as DryvIQ's content intelligence and governance capabilities become part of Nasuni's broader platform. In Hyderabad, you'll lead engineers solving meaningful distributed-systems, cloud, security, content-intelligence, and data-governance challenges with global partners. 

Vista Equity Partners' backing connects our Hyderabad team to a broader software ecosystem, leadership programs, learning opportunities, and AI innovation communities-combining the pace of a growing product company with the reach of a global technology investor. 

Benefits

As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers competitive benefits designed to support every stage of your life and career, including competitive compensation programs, flexible time off and leave policies, comprehensive health and wellness coverage, hybrid and flexible work arrangements, employee referral and recognition programs, professional development and learning support, an inclusive and collaborative team culture, modern office spaces with team events and perks, and retirement and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations. 

To all recruitment agencies: Nasuni does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job boards, Nasuni employees, or any other company location. Nasuni is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment. 

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, "Nasuni") from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

The Experience

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

- Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 
 - AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up. 
 - Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm. 
 - Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months. 
 - Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration. 
 - Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies. 
 - Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value. 
 - Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- Advanced Technical Depth: 15+years of Technical background with recent deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments. 
 - You Have Proven Leadership: 3+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent. 
 - You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value. 
 - You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects. 
 - You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it. 

Even Better If. . . 

- Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails. 
 - Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines. 
 - Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist). 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. data.title: GPU Cluster Reliability Engineer
data.description:
About the Role

Ishan Technologies is looking for an experienced Cluster Reliability Engineer to manage and maintain the compute infrastructure of Saksham AI Services' 1000+ GPU cluster. 

The role involves managing GPU servers, Linux infrastructure, Slurm and Kubernetes environments, cluster reliability, automation and MLOps operations. The selected candidate will play a key role in ensuring high availability, performance, scalability and reliability of AI training and inference workloads. 

The position will also serve as an L2/L3 technical escalation point, working closely with the 24x7 NOC team, platform engineers, customers and technology partners. 

Key Responsibilities

1. GPU Infrastructure & Server Management

- Receive, rack, configure and maintain GPU servers. 
 - Manage BIOS, firmware, Linux OS images, GPU drivers and software libraries. 
 - Perform GPU server burn-in, hardware diagnostics and acceptance testing. 
 - Maintain consistent server configurations and manage firmware and security updates. 
 - Coordinate with OEM vendors for hardware faults, replacements and RMAs. 2. Cluster Management - Slurm & Kubernetes

- Administer and maintain Slurm and Kubernetes environments for AI training and inference workloads. 
 - Manage Slurm controllers, partitions, QoS, fairshare and resource allocation. 
 - Configure Kubernetes GPU Operator, device plugins, Helm and related operators. 
 - Manage cluster upgrades, patching, tenant onboarding and scheduling. 
 - Ensure stable and efficient multi-tenant GPU cluster operations. 3. Cluster Reliability & Monitoring

- Develop and maintain GPU and node health checks. 
 - Monitor GPU errors, ECC events, RAS events and hardware failures. 
 - Implement automated fault detection and remediation mechanisms. 
 - Develop monitoring dashboards and alerts using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki or ELK. 
 - Maintain cluster availability in line with the 99. 9% uptime commitment. 
 - Maintain operational logs and monitoring records in accordance with applicable compliance requirements. 4. MLOps & AI Workload Support

- Build and maintain optimized framework images for PyTorch, JAX and vLLM. 
 - Develop ready-to-use job templates for AI training and inference. 
 - Conduct workload benchmarks and GPU performance testing. 
 - Support distributed AI workloads, including data, tensor and pipeline parallelism. 
 - Provide technical assistance to customers and solution architects on workload performance and tooling. 5. Incident Management & Automation

- Handle L2/L3 technical escalations from the 24x7 NOC team. 
 - Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. 
 - Develop automation scripts using Python and Bash. 
 - Maintain operational runbooks and auto-remediation procedures. 
 - Track capacity, GPU utilisation, goodput and service-level performance. 
 - Identify recurring issues and implement long-term corrective actions. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in Linux System Administration. 
 - Experience managing GPU servers, GPU drivers, firmware, BIOS and kernel configurations. 
 - Hands-on experience with multi-GPU accelerator servers. 
 - Strong knowledge of Slurm administration and workload scheduling. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes administration for GPU workloads. 
 - Knowledge of GPU Operator, Helm, Kubeflow and KubeRay. 
 - Familiarity with GPU monitoring, ECC/RAS events and vendor diagnostic tools. 
 - Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki or ELK. 
 - Working knowledge of PyTorch, JAX, vLLM and GPU collective communication libraries. 
 - Experience with Docker, Apptainer and container image management. 
 - Automation experience using Python, Bash and Ansible or Terraform. 
 - Familiarity with bare-metal provisioning tools such as MAAS, Ironic, Metal3 or Warewulf. 

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology. 
 - Preferred specialisations: Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or related disciplines. 
 - Relevant certifications in Linux, Kubernetes or GPU computing will be an added advantage. 

Preferred Certifications: 

- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA). 
 - Red Hat RHCSA/RHCE or Linux Foundation Certified System Administrator (LFCS). 
 - GPU vendor training or certifications. 

Experience Requirements

- 4-8 years of overall IT infrastructure or engineering experience. 
 - Minimum 2+ years of relevant experience in GPU/HPC cluster operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or MLOps. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux GPU servers and Slurm and/or Kubernetes is essential. 
 - Experience supporting production environments with on-call and incident management responsibilities. 
 - Experience with multi-vendor data-centre GPU platforms will be an advantage. 
 - Exposure to distributed AI training and inference workloads is preferred. 

Preferred Additional Exposure

- NVIDIA GPU ecosystem and related management tools. 
 - ClusterMAX standards and CMAX audit tool. 
 - Public cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS. 
 - HPC infrastructure and large-scale AI compute environments. 

Key Competencies

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Hands-on technical ownership and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to handle critical production incidents under pressure. 
 - Strong communication and coordination skills. 
 - Willingness to participate in a 24x7 on-call support rotation. 
 - Ability to learn and adapt to evolving GPU, HPC and AI technologies.

data.title: Senior Staff Emulation Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. You are comfortable sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe, and walking out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. You ask the right questions, you push back when something does not make sense, and you move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best in class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
 - Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
 - Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
 - You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work, you read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
 - You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
 - You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
 - You are comfortable mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
 - You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

data.description:
About Wind River

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. 

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company's software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We've achieved recent 5G milestones including the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone. 

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world. 

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a skilled Validation and Testing Developer to join our team in developing the next generation Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). 

As a Member of Technical Staff for verification and validation testing, you will contribute to researching, evaluating, and selecting validation tooling, as well as designing and implementing the test framework used for both certified and non-certified software components. You will also be contributing to designing and implementing system testing and V&V test development. 

In your daily job you will: 

- Work with technical leads to evaluate next-generation validation and verification tools and recommend tools best suited for certification objectives (all Design Assurance Levels) for DO-178C and other standards
 - Assess tool qualification requirements per Software Tool Qualification Considerations
 - Participate in architecting and developing a scalable, maintainable test framework for the RTOS to support both certified (DO-178C) and non-certified testing workflows, such as requirements-based testing, structural coverage analysis, and traceability
 - Implement automation capabilities for continuous integration and regression testing
 - Develop system-level tests to validate RTOS functionality, performance, and timing behavior
 - Create and execute verification and validation (V&V) test cases traceable to system and software requirements
 - Collaborate with systems and software engineers to ensure complete requirements coverage
 - Take initiative to improve the RTOS product and processes
 - Collaborate and engage effectively with global software engineering teams. 
 - Work in an Agile Scrum Teams and follow Agile processes

How You Will Contribute

Key skills and competencies for succeeding in this role are: 

- BTech / MTech degree (Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree). 
 - 8+ years of experience in software testing, verification, or validation
 - Strong understanding of RTOS concepts (scheduling, concurrency, determinism, resource management)
 - Experience with DO-178C (or DO-178B) software lifecycle and verification objectives is a plus
 - Familiarity with DO-330 tool qualification processes is a plus
 - Proficiency in test automation and framework development (e. g. , Python, C, C++)
 - Experience with requirements-based testing and traceability
 - Experience with static analysis, model-based testing, or formal methods
 - Knowledge of structural coverage tools and techniques (MC/DC, branch, statement)
 - Experience with commercial or open-source RTOS platforms (e. g. , VxWorks, RTEMS, Zephyr, FreeRTOS) is a plus
 - Familiarity with verification tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, Parasoft, Rapita, or equivalent is a plus
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines
 - Experience with firmware bringup and boot up is a plus

WHY JOIN US?

In a world increasingly driven by software innovation, Wind River is pioneering the technologies that accelerate the digital transformation of our customers with a new generation of mission‐critical AI systems-built for an AI‐first world with the most exacting safety, security, performance, and reliability standards. Our success depends on our ability to innovate with velocity and deliver solutions that help customers solve their toughest challenges. 

Wind River is a global leader in mission‐critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, we have been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that demand the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. We support customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries as they build the next generation of intelligent machines. 

Wind River's technology has supported historic achievements-from NASA's Artemis I and the James Webb Space Telescope to multiple Mars rovers, as well as the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and one of the largest Open RAN networks with Vodafone. 

With industry recognition for innovation, leadership, and workplace excellence-including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten straight years-Wind River offers a culture built on growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging. 

Your Benefits At Wind River

- Named Top Workplace for the 10th year in a row
 - Wind River's strong commitment to DEIB
 - Birthday and Volunteer Time Off
 - Competitive Salary & Benefits Package
 - Extensive Learning Programs
 - Wellness benefits through Unmind

APPLY TODAY, AND TOGETHER LET'S CHANGE TOMORROW!
