data.title: Network Performance Engineer – GPU/HPC Infrastructure
data.description:
About the Role

Ishan Technologies is looking for an experienced Network Performance Engineer to build, operate, optimise and maintain the high-performance network infrastructure supporting Saksham AI Services' 1000+ GPU cluster. The role will focus on backend GPU networking, high-speed Ethernet/RoCE and InfiniBand fabrics, front-end connectivity, storage and management networks. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in data centre networking, network performance optimisation, RDMA technologies, congestion control and collective communication benchmarking. The selected candidate will also act as an L2/L3 escalation point for network and performance-related issues raised by Ishan Technologies' 24x7 NOC team. 

Key Responsibilities

1. GPU Network & Data Centre Infrastructure

- Install, configure and operate high-speed backend GPU networks using RoCEv2/Ethernet or InfiniBand. 
 - Manage front-end, storage and out-of-band management networks. 
 - Configure and maintain switches, network interface cards (NICs), transceivers and fibre connectivity. 
 - Work on rail-optimised leaf-spine network architecture. 
 - Maintain network topology, cable mapping and infrastructure documentation. 2. Network Performance & Optimisation

- Configure and optimise BGP, EVPN-VXLAN and leaf-spine network architecture. 
 - Implement congestion control mechanisms, including PFC, ECN/DCQCN, adaptive routing and QoS. 
 - Monitor network bandwidth, latency, packet loss, link flaps and congestion. 
 - Troubleshoot GPU-to-GPU communication and collective performance issues. 
 - Ensure full-bandwidth network performance across different workload and cluster sizes. 3. RoCE, InfiniBand & RDMA Networking

- Manage RoCEv2 and InfiniBand fabrics for GPU/HPC environments. 
 - Work with NVIDIA UFM and InfiniBand management tools. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot RDMA drivers, SR-IOV and GPUDirect RDMA. 
 - Work with NVIDIA ConnectX and AMD Pensando Pollara networking technologies. 
 - Maintain VLAN/VRF segmentation, PKeys and fabric-level tenant isolation. 4. AI Workload & Collective Communication

- Perform collective communication benchmarking using RCCL, NCCL, MPI and related testing tools. 
 - Conduct RDMA performance testing using perftest, ib_write_bw and ib_read_bw. 
 - Work with nccl-tests and rccl-tests to validate network performance. 
 - Understand how data, tensor and expert parallelism impact network utilisation. 
 - Investigate slow-running AI jobs, communication bottlenecks and straggler GPUs. 
 - Collaborate with compute and MLOps teams to optimise AI workload performance. 5. Network Monitoring & Automation

- Develop network monitoring dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana. 
 - Monitor switch health, link errors, optics performance and network congestion. 
 - Automate network configurations, health checks and compliance activities using Python and Ansible. 
 - Maintain network performance baselines and conduct acceptance testing after infrastructure changes. 
 - Support Kubernetes RDMA networking using Multus, SR-IOV device plugins and network operators. 6. Incident Management & Operations

- Handle L2/L3 network and performance escalations from the 24x7 NOC team. 
 - Lead network incident investigations and root cause analysis. 
 - Coordinate with customers, solution architects, vendors and internal engineering teams. 
 - Plan and execute switch, NIC and optics firmware upgrades under change management. 
 - Maintain network runbooks, technical documentation and operational standards. 
 - Support internet edge connectivity, peering and private customer network links. Required Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in Data Centre Networking. 
 - Experience with RoCEv2 or InfiniBand networking. 
 - Strong understanding of BGP, EVPN-VXLAN and leaf-spine architecture. 
 - Knowledge of PFC, ECN/DCQCN, QoS and adaptive routing. 
 - Experience with RDMA, GPUDirect RDMA and SR-IOV. 
 - Hands-on experience with NVIDIA ConnectX, Spectrum-X or AMD Pensando Pollara. 
 - Knowledge of RCCL, NCCL, MPI and collective communication benchmarking. 
 - Experience with NVIDIA UFM and InfiniBand management. 
 - Understanding of VLAN, VRF, PKeys and network tenant isolation. 
 - Experience with 400G/800G networking, optics and fibre connectivity. 
 - Working knowledge of Python, Ansible and network automation. 
 - Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, SNMP and streaming telemetry. Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology. 
 - Preferred specialisations: Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or related disciplines. 
 - Relevant data centre networking certifications will be an added advantage. Preferred Certifications: 

- Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center. 
 - Arista ACE. 
 - Juniper JNCIP-DC. 
 - NVIDIA Networking (InfiniBand/Spectrum-X) certifications. Experience Requirements

- 6-10 years of overall professional experience. 
 - Minimum 4+ years of relevant experience in Data Centre Networking for GPU, HPC or hyperscale environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with RoCEv2 or InfiniBand fabrics is essential. 
 - Experience with large-scale leaf-spine networks, cabling and optics is essential. 
 - Experience in RCCL/NCCL or MPI performance optimisation is preferred. 
 - Exposure to AMD Pensando, NVIDIA Spectrum-X or ConnectX networking is preferred. Key Competencies

- Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 - Hands-on approach to network engineering and performance optimisation. 
 - Ability to handle critical production incidents under pressure. 
 - Strong ownership and root cause analysis capabilities. 
 - Effective communication with customers, NOC teams and technical stakeholders. 
 - Willingness to participate in a 24x7 on-call support rotation. 
 - Ability to learn and adapt to evolving AI and GPU networking technologies. Key Success Outcomes

- Stable, high-performance GPU networking infrastructure. 
 - Full-bandwidth collective communication across cluster workloads. 
 - Verified network isolation between multiple customers and tenants. 
 - Improved network performance and reduced communication bottlenecks. 
 - Faster resolution of network incidents and performance escalations. 
 - Standardised, automated and well-documented network operations.

data.title: Lead/Staff AI/ML Validation Engineer
data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SMTS Software Quality Engineer to join the HIP Runtime Quality Engineering team within the ROCm ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on defect triage, root‐cause analysis, and scalable test automation for the HIP runtime, ensuring robustness, portability, and performance across AMD and NVIDIA GPU backends. 

The role sits at the intersection of runtime systems, GPU APIs, and CI-driven quality assurance, working closely with HIP runtime developers, compiler teams, and system software engineers to improve test coverage and accelerate issue resolution across a fast-evolving open‐source stack. 

HIP is a C++ runtime API and kernel language designed for CUDA portability and heterogeneous GPU programming in the ROCm platform. 

Key Responsibilities

Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis

- Own end-to-end triage of HIP runtime failures observed in CI, nightly, and release testing pipelines. 
 - Analyze failures across HIP runtime APIs, including memory management, streams, events, kernels, graphs, and device management. 
 - Perform log analysis, repro reduction, and backtrace debugging across Linux and Windows environments. 
 - Correlate failures across: 
 - ROCr system runtime
 - HIP runtime
 - Driver / firmware interfaces
 - Compiler (hipcc / clang) interactions
 - File high‐quality bug reports with clear reproduction steps, root cause hypotheses, and impact assessment. 

Test Automation & Framework Development

- Design, enhance, and maintain automated test frameworks for HIP runtime validation using existing HIP test infrastructure (Catch2-based and custom harnesses). 
 - Expand functional, negative, stress, and regression coverage for: 
 - HIP Runtime APIs
 - Graph APIs
 - Memory copy variants (1D/2D/3D, async/sync)
 - Multi-GPU and peer-to-peer use cases
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines with actionable failure reporting. 
 - Develop Python, C++, and shell-based automation for test execution, result aggregation, and trend analysis. 
 - Drive test flakiness reduction and improve signal-to-noise ratio in large-scale CI. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Partner with HIP runtime developers to: 
 - Review test gaps for new features and APIs
 - Validate bug fixes and performance-sensitive code paths
 - Collaborate with: 
 - Compiler and language runtime teams
 - ROCr system runtime teams
 - Release engineering and CI infrastructure teams
 - Contribute test fixes and enhancements upstream in open-source HIP/ROCm repositories. 

Quality Metrics & Continuous Improvement

- Define and track quality metrics such as failure escape rate, test coverage, and mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR). 
 - Identify systemic issues and propose data-driven quality improvements. 
 - Participate in release readiness assessments for HIP runtime drops. 

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

- Strong experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles. 
 - Solid proficiency in C++ with debugging experience (gdb/lldb). 
 - Working knowledge of HIP or CUDA runtime concepts, including kernels, streams, memory models, and device execution. 
 - Experience with Linux-based development and debugging. 
 - Familiarity with CI systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar). 
 - Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for low-level systems or runtime libraries. 

Debugging & Analysis Skills

- Ability to reason about runtime abstractions, concurrency, and asynchronous execution. 
 - Strong skills in failure reproduction, minimization, and log-driven debugging. 
 - Experience triaging issues across hardware-software boundaries is a plus. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with GPU programming models (HIP, CUDA, OpenCL). 
 - Familiarity with ROCm stack components (HIP, ROCr, compilers, drivers). 
 - Experience testing graph APIs, async execution models, or multi-GPU systems. 
 - Prior contributions to open-source system software or test frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of Python-based test orchestration and reporting tools. 
 - Knowledge and application of AI tools in validation and testing. 

What Success Looks Like

- Faster, higher-quality issue triage with actionable root cause insights. 
 - Improved automation coverage for HIP runtime APIs and edge cases. 
 - Reduced CI noise and faster feedback for developers. 
 - Strong collaboration with runtime and compiler engineers to ship stable, high-quality HIP releases. 

Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. 

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. 

AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD's "Responsible AI Policy" is available here.

Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company. 

This role can be based remotely or from an Atlassian office where eligible. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere . 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend storage solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for developing distributed storage systems, APIs, and backend services that power mission-critical applications, ensuring low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data storage. Your work will directly impact system reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

You will collaborate closely with principal engineers, architects, SREs, and product teams to define technical roadmaps, improve storage efficiency, and optimize access patterns. You will drive performance tuning, data modeling, caching strategies, and cost optimization across AWS storage services like S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier. Additionally, you will contribute to infrastructure automation, security best practices, and monitoring strategies using tools like Terraform, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry. 

In this role, you will also be responsible for troubleshooting and resolving production incidents related to data integrity, latency spikes, and storage failures, ensuring high availability and disaster recovery preparedness. You will mentor junior engineers, participate in design reviews and architectural discussions, and advocate for engineering best practices such as CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, and observability-driven development. Your contributions will directly impact the organization's ability to scale its storage infrastructure efficiently while maintaining security, reliability, and compliance with industry standards.

Security & Reliability

Hands-On with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps

Collaboration & Engineering Best Practices

data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health is Asia's leading health technology and analytics organisation, providing our customers with integrated solutions to make healthcare more accessible, affordable and effective across the region. 

We offer a unique B2B business model and integrated stack of SaaS-based products, PaaS-based HealthTech launchpad and DaaS-based on-demand data offerings to deliver impact to our customers across the healthcare value-chain. 

Our joint-venture partners, AIA and Discovery, have provided us with the foundations and a platform that truly differentiates us from our competitors and allows us to build and deploy products at a scale and quality that few can match. 

We aim to be the trusted custodian of Asia's largest repository of health data, unifying financial, clinical, operational and behavioural data to empower our customers with insights that highlight opportunities to deliver better value and care outcomes. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Summary

The Lead, Engineering is a senior technical leader responsible for driving the design, development, and evolution of Amplify Health's core product platforms. This role blends deep hands-on engineering capability with architectural leadership, mentoring, and strategic influence. 

As a Lead, Engineering, you will own complex technical domains, shape platform-level decisions, ensure engineering excellence, and act as a trusted partner to Product, Data, Cyber Security, and Infrastructure teams. You will set technical direction, reduce system-level risk, and raise the overall engineering bar across the organisation. 

Responsibilities

1) Technical Architecture & Platform Stewardship

- Lead the design and evolution of scalable, secure, and resilient architectures across core product and platform domains. 
 - Own complex system and solution designs, including data‐intensive, cloud‐native, and security‐sensitive use cases. 
 - Make and document high‐impact architectural decisions, balancing short‐term delivery with long‐term platform sustainability. 
 - Act as a recognised technical authority, guiding design choices across multiple engineering teams. 

2) Product Engineering Delivery & Execution

- Own development of critical product and platform components, contributing hands‐on where appropriate. 
 - Partner with Product leadership to shape the roadmap through technical insight, effort estimation, and delivery trade‐offs. 
 - Ensure teams are well prepared for sprint execution, with clear scope, priorities, and technical direction. 
 - Participate actively in agile ceremonies, driving clarity, momentum, and accountability. 

3) Engineering Excellence & Quality

- Champion best practices in software engineering, including code quality, automated testing, performance, reliability, and observability. 
 - Review pull requests, set engineering standards, and ensure consistent application of best practices across teams. 
 - Identify, prioritise, and lead the reduction of technical debt and systemic architectural risks. 
 - Promote strong operational discipline, including production readiness and incident learnings. 

4) Collaboration & Influence

- Work closely with Product, Data, Cloud Infrastructure, Cyber Security, and Technology Operations teams to deliver integrated solutions. 
 - Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for non‐technical stakeholders. 
 - Influence technical outcomes across teams and domains without direct line management. 

5) Security, Risk & Compliance

- Partner with security, privacy, and compliance stakeholders to ensure platforms meet regulatory and data protection requirements across markets. 
 - Drive adoption of secure-by-design principles, DevSecOps practices, and infrastructure‐as‐code standards. 
 - Proactively identify technical, operational, and delivery risks and lead mitigation strategies. 

6) Coaching, Mentorship & Capability Building

- Mentor and coach engineers at all levels, raising technical capability and engineering maturity across the organization. 
 - Act as a role model for strong engineering judgement, ownership, and resilience in complex environments. 
 - Contribute to building a high‐performance engineering culture grounded in learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Candidate Profile

Experience and Qualifications

- 10+ years of relevant engineering experience, including at least 3 years operating at a senior technical lead or principal level. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more of: Node. js, React. js, Java, Python. 
 - Proven experience designing and operating systems on Azure cloud, with strong knowledge of DevSecOps and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). 
 - Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated success delivering complex systems in regulated or high-availability environments would be highly advantageous. 
 - Proven experience leading technical design and delivery across multiple teams or domains. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; advanced degree preferred. 

Competencies & Core Characteristics: 

We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale-up environment: 

- Technical Domain Expertise: Demonstrated depth in modern software engineering, cloud‐native architectures, and platform design, with the ability to solve complex, ambiguous technical problems. Recognised as a technical authority who sets engineering standards and leads by example through high‐quality design and delivery. 
 - Strategic Architect: Able to design and evolve systems with long‐term scalability, resilience, security, and cost efficiency in mind. Consistently balances immediate product needs with future platform sustainability, making thoughtful architectural trade‐offs aligned to business strategy. 
 - Unifier & Cross-Functional Influencer: Builds strong, trust‐based relationships across Product, Data, Cyber Security, and Operations, aligning diverse stakeholders around shared outcomes. Communicates complex technical concepts clearly and influences decisions without relying on formal authority. 
 - Coach & Talent Multiplier: Acts as a mentor and role model, elevating the technical capability and judgement of engineers across teams. Invests in developing others through coaching, constructive feedback, and fostering a culture of learning and engineering excellence. 
 - Data-Driven Decisiveness: Uses data, metrics, and evidence to guide technical and delivery decisions, while remaining pragmatic in the face of uncertainty. Makes timely, well‐reasoned decisions and takes ownership of outcomes, adjusting course as new information emerges. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: STAFF, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
data.description:
We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help design, build, and evolve Walmart's next-generation International Pricing platforms. 

The International Pricing team enables Walmart's mission of Every Day Low Price (EDLP). At its core, the team is responsible for the systems that help set, manage, approve, and execute prices for first-party items across Walmart's international markets. 

The platforms you build will support multiple countries, each representing a multi-billion-dollar business. You will solve complex engineering and business problems involving large-scale data processing, pricing recommendations, rules and workflows, downstream price execution, resiliency, auditability, and market-specific requirements. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to write production-quality code, lead architecture and design, review critical technical decisions, and mentor engineers across the team. 

About the TeamWalmart International Technology enables our stores, eCommerce operations, associates, and customers across markets outside the United States. 

The International Pricing Engineering team builds and operates platforms that support the end-to-end price-setting lifecycle for first-party merchandise. These capabilities include pricing strategy and recommendations, business-rule evaluation, simulations, approval workflows, manual and automated price setting, markdown optimization, competitive pricing intelligence, and price execution through downstream systems. 

Our goal is to build a scalable, resilient, multi-market pricing platform that supports common global capabilities while accommodating the regulatory, operational, currency, hierarchy, and business-process requirements of individual markets. 

What You'll DoRemain hands-on and contribute production-quality code for critical platform capabilities, complex integrations, and technically challenging initiatives. 

Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for International Pricing platforms. 

Write high-quality design documents, including HLDs, LLDs, Architecture Decision Records, API contracts, data models, sequence diagrams, and operational readiness plans. 

Review architecture and technical designs produced by engineering teams and ensure alignment with platform standards, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. 

Design and build scalable, high-throughput, and low-latency Java- or Kotlin-based microservices deployed on cloud infrastructure. 

Build extensible pricing capabilities using domain-driven design, event-driven architecture, Kafka, API-first principles, and well-defined service boundaries. 

Design solutions for pricing recommendations, rule evaluation, approvals, simulations, publishing, execution, auditability, and downstream-system integration. 

Own data-modeling and persistence strategies across relational, NoSQL, and analytical data stores, with a strong focus on data accuracy, lineage, consistency, and traceability. 

Design resilient distributed workflows using appropriate patterns such as orchestration, outbox, retries, circuit breaking, idempotency, and dead-letter processing. 

Define REST and gRPC APIs with clear contracts, backward-compatibility guarantees, versioning strategies, and consumer-driven contract testing. 

Design for multi-market and multi-tenant use cases while balancing global platform consistency with market-specific business requirements. 

Identify and proactively address systemic risks, including scaling bottlenecks, single points of failure, data-integrity gaps, operational dependencies, and technical-debt accumulation. 

Drive architecture and integration alignment with shared platforms and downstream systems responsible for price calculation, price publishing, execution, catalog, analytics, and store operations. 

Represent International Pricing in cross-organizational architecture and engineering forums. 

Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, security validation, canary deployment, rollback, and production verification. 

Drive observability-first engineering through structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, actionable alerts, and business-flow monitoring. 

Ensure that services comply with enterprise security, privacy, infrastructure, and software-development standards. 

Lead production-readiness reviews, incident investigations, root-cause analyses, and reliability-improvement initiatives. 

Mentor junior, mid-level, and senior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, pairing, and structured feedback. 

Establish engineering standards for design quality, code quality, automated testing, performance, security, release readiness, and operational excellence. 

Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Business, Program, Quality Engineering, and other platform teams to translate complex pricing requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

Promote a platform-first mindset by creating reusable and configurable capabilities that enable multiple markets and engineering teams without duplicating solutions. 

Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, automate manual processes, improve developer productivity, and deliver measurable business value. 

Make sound technical decisions and solve complex problems efficiently in a high-impact, fast-moving environment. 

What You'll BringA bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

12+ years of relevant software-engineering experience, including experience building highly available, resilient, and scalable distributed systems. 

Strong hands-on programming experience with Java 17/21, Spring Boot or comparable frameworks, microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven systems. 

Expert-level understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, distributed-system fundamentals, design patterns, and software-engineering principles. 

Strong experience with Kafka or similar messaging platforms and asynchronous processing patterns. 

Experience designing and operating systems using relational and NoSQL databases. 

Advanced experience with cloud infrastructure such as Azure, GCP, or AWS. 

Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, service-to-service communication, autoscaling, resource management, and cloud-native deployment patterns. 

Experience designing systems that process large data volumes while maintaining strong consistency, traceability, performance, and availability. 

Demonstrated ability to author clear technical designs and influence architecture across multiple teams. 

Strong troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose complex production issues across applications, infrastructure, messaging, and data layers. 

Experience driving engineering excellence through automated testing, performance optimization, reliability improvements, operational readiness, and incident prevention. 

Experience integrating machine-learning inference APIs or model endpoints into production services. 

Familiarity with GenAI-assisted engineering tools and their responsible use across software-development workflows. 

Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and consensus-building skills. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and raise the technical capabilities of the broader team. 

Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term platform architecture and sustainability. 

Experience building or operating large-scale retail, eCommerce, pricing, promotion, markdown, or revenue-management platforms. 

Understanding of retail pricing concepts such as EDLP, competitive pricing, price rules, simulations, approvals, price execution, regional pricing, and markdown optimization. 

Experience building multi-tenant or multi-market platforms with shared global capabilities and configurable market-specific behavior. 

Experience integrating with complex upstream and downstream enterprise systems. 

A continuous drive to simplify, automate, improve, and optimize platforms, tools, development workflows, and operational processes. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

data.description:
About Us

JOB DESCRIPTION

Jefferies Financial Group Inc. (''Jefferies, '' ''we, '' ''us'' or ''our'') is a U. S. -headquartered global full service, integrated investment banking and securities firm. Our largest subsidiary, Jefferies LLC, a U. S. broker-dealer, was founded in the U. S. in 1962 and our first international operating subsidiary, Jefferies International Limited, a U. K. broker-dealer, was established in the U. K. in 1986. Innovation Hub Overview

Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies' growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We're scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate. 

IT Platform Reliability Engineering & Management

The PREM team is responsible for improving the stability, availability, and performance of Jefferies' core services and systems. The team provides day-to-day support for business-critical platforms across Equities, Fixed Income, Investment Banking, and Corporate functions, and builds tooling to strengthen observability (metrics/logs/dashboards), capacity, and performance management across distributed and cloud environments

C++ DevOps, Tooling & Test Automation Engineer

Equity Algorithmic Trading

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated C++ DevOps, Tooling & Test Automation Engineer to support our Equity Algorithmic Trading platform. 

This role sits at the intersection of C++ engineering, DevOps, test automation, and platform reliability. You will build and enhance the engineering tooling, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, simulation capabilities, observability, and deployment controls required to support a high-performance, mission-critical electronic trading environment. 

You will partner closely with algorithmic trading developers, quantitative researchers, QA, production support, infrastructure teams, and trading stakeholders to improve software quality, release velocity, production stability, and operational control. 

The ideal candidate combines strong C++ and Linux engineering skills with hands-on experience in CI/CD, automated testing, debugging, performance engineering, and production systems. Experience with electronic trading, equities, FIX, market data, order routing, or low-latency systems is highly desirable. 

Key Responsibilities

C++ DevOps & Release Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for C++ Equity Algo applications. 
 - Automate build, test, packaging, deployment, validation, and rollback workflows. 
 - Own and improve C++ build processes using tools such as CMake, Makeor equivalent. 
 - Maintain compiler toolchains, dependency versions, build profiles, release artifacts, and reproducible builds. 
 - Integrate static analysis, sanitizers, code coverage, automated testing, and performance benchmarks into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Develop automated deployment-readiness checks and post-deployment validation. 
 - Improve release repeatability, traceability, and governance while reducing manual intervention. 
 - Troubleshoot build failures, compiler and linking issues, dependency conflicts, and environment inconsistencies. 

Test Automation & Simulation

- Design and develop automated test frameworks for complex C++ trading applications. 
 - Build comprehensive unit, integration, regression, end-to-end, performance, latency, soak, failover, and recovery testing. 
 - Develop test automation using frameworks . 
 - Build mocks, simulators, test harnesses, and replay capabilities for market data feeds, order gateways, FIX connectivity, risk engines, exchange interfaces, and downstream systems. 
 - Develop deterministic replay capabilities using historical market data and order flow. 
 - Automate validation of expected versus actual algorithm behavior across trading scenarios. 
 - Improve test execution speed, coverage, reliability, reporting, and integration with CI/CD. 

Equity Algo Platform Engineering

- Support testing and deployment of equity execution algorithms, smart order routing, and associated trading services. 
 - Validate algo behavior across order types, venues, market conditions, and client configurations. 
 - Support simulation and certification for new algorithm functionality, exchange changes, and venue integrations. 
 - Validate pre-trade risk controls, throttles, kill switches, circuit breakers, and configuration controls. 
 - Partner with developers, quants, and trading stakeholders to translate trading behavior into automated tests and validation scenarios. 
 - Help ensure the platform meets demanding standards for reliability, resiliency, performance, latency, and operational control. 

Observability & Production Readiness

- Build and enhance monitoring and observability for C++ trading services. 
 - Develop tooling around structured logging, metrics, health checks, process heartbeats, and service availability. 
 - Create actionable dashboards covering system health, latency, message rates, order flow, market data quality, connectivity, build quality, and release readiness. 
 - Improve diagnostics for issues including order rejects, market-data gaps, connectivity failures, latency spikes, memory leaks, deadlocks, thread contention, and deployment failures. 
 - Develop tooling that improves incident investigation, root-cause analysis, and production support effectiveness. 
 - Enhance operational runbooks and automated health and readiness checks. 

Configuration & Environment Automation

- Improve configuration management across development, QA, simulation, UAT, certification, and production. 
 - Automate configuration validation, comparison, promotion, and deployment verification. 
 - Build schema validation and configuration-diff tooling to reduce configuration-related production risk. 
 - Support controlled rollout mechanisms, feature toggles, and safe deployment practices. 
 - Improve environment consistency and reduce manual release and validation activities. 

Engineering Collaboration

- Work across development, quantitative research, QA, infrastructure, production support, and trading teams. 
 - Identify engineering bottlenecks and build practical automation to improve developer productivity. 
 - Communicate clearly around release risk, testing gaps, production readiness, and operational issues. 
 - Promote engineering best practices around automation, testing, observability, resiliency, and controlled releases. 
 - Drive continuous improvement with a strong focus on ownership, reliability, and engineering quality.

data.title: Head of Engineering
data.description:
About Us: 

Fluent Health is a dynamic healthcare startup revolutionizing how you manage your healthcare and that of your family. We provide customers with high-quality, personalized options, credible information through trustworthy content, and absolute privacy. To assist us in our growth journey, we are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Head of Engineering to play a pivotal role in our future success. 

Company Website: https: //fluentinhealth. com/

The Role: 

Head of Engineering is a transformation mandate, not a maintenance hire. 

This role closes a leadership and execution gap on the engineering team by focusing on how software gets built: team quality, delivery velocity, and developer growth. It is distinct from a pure VP hire or a layer of middle management - it is a high-leverage, hands-on engineering leader embedded with the team. 

The clearest way to frame it: CTO and Principal Engineer apply system-design thinking to the technical system - the architecture, the data that feeds it. You apply that same system-design lens to the team - the people and processes that write the codebase, not primarily the architecture itself. Same rigor, different object. In the shorthand we've used in conversation: Principal Engineer sets the engineering bar, and your mandate is to train the team to reach it. 

The core problem this role solves. The gap isn't tooling, architecture, or AI-adoption rate - those are in reasonably good shape. The gap is quality: defect rate and delivery-on-target are both meaningfully off, and that costs the business in rework, delay, and dev motivation. It is the single largest bottleneck in the business today. 

Root cause is structural more than personnel: accountability currently sits with a separate QA function, so developers treat quality as something to hand off rather than something they own end to end. The fix is dev-level ownership of code and tests (not necessarily full TDD, but the person who wrote the code owns its test suite), paired with legibility (code and tests readable by both engineers and AI) and transparency (team-wide visibility into quality, per developer, through to production). This directly reshapes what the release management and QA team does and how it's structured, so this transition gets designed with that team as an active stakeholder, not decided around them and handed down. 

The role is built around two pillars: 

Delivery transformation. Designing and running an engineering operating model where quality is built in, not inspected out - covering sprint design, squad formation, SDLC ownership, execution discipline in how tickets are picked up and delivered, and cross-functional orchestration between engineering, product, QA, and customer success. 

GenAI adoption programme. Leading the team through the shift from traditional development to GenAI-first engineering practice, done hands-on rather than by mandate. Not just using AI tools - redesigning how engineers think about what they own when code is largely generated. AI-first adoption matters and should happen alongside the quality fix, but it is downstream of quality, not a substitute for it. 

Hands-On Expectation: Player-Coach

This is explicitly a player-coach role, not a coach-only role. 

- The bar is not "code like a traditional IC. " Nobody at Fluent codes without AI anymore. The bar is: use GenAI to produce real, shipped, working code often enough that you are a living example of the exact shift you are asking the team to make, from "I write code" to "I orchestrate and validate it. "
 - We're looking for someone who has already proven they can do this in a recent role, and this position asks you to keep doing it here, visibly, as part of the job, not to hit a quota of production commits. 
 - This isn't about holding the technical bar, that's Principal Engineer's lane. It's about staying close enough to the work, via AI-assisted building, that your coaching comes from lived practice, not theory. 

Responsibilities: 

Delivery operating cadence: 

- Sprint structure, squad formation, deploy unit methodology
 - Delivery health metrics and feedback loops
 - SDLC design: from requirements to shipped feature, inclusive of quality
 - Execution discipline: how tickets are picked up, thought through, implemented, and delivered back to the team
 - You own the policy layer for release and quality: what the cadence should be, the direction of the QA-to-dev-owned-testing transition, the metrics that prove it's working. The release management and QA function owns the operational layer within that model, running the actual calendar, the actual go/no-go call, the actual incident response. Partnership, not ownership of their day-to-day. 

GenAI adoption programme: 

- Phase-gated rollout of AI-assisted development across the engineering team, led hands-on
 - Per-team adoption metrics and sprint-specific targeting
 - Coaching engineers from "I use AI tools" to "I architect AI-first workflows"

Data and systems fluency: 

- Raise team competence in how data is interpreted, queried, harmonized, and safely handled across applications and the core system
 - Reduce quality issues that stem from fragmented thinking, inconsistent query logic, or weak system-level understanding of the data layer
 - Improve how engineers understand the broader system, including architecture implications and the downstream effects of moving and transforming data

Engineering people leadership: 

- Direct reports: the engineering team reports to you
 - Hiring: you own the bar, the process, and the decision
 - Performance and career development: 1: 1s, feedback, growth plans are yours to run. Ivan contributes a technical read on each engineer's code quality and growth as one input among others, since he sees that up close, but he does not co-own the review, the decision, or the process. 
 - Real authority as the target state, see "Where You're Stretching" below for how the first 90-180 days will actually work

Cross-functional orchestration: 

- Engineering ↔ product ↔ QA ↔ customer success alignment
 - Operating model for how teams coordinate across a cycle

Leadership Team interface: 

- Honest engineering voice to the leadership team
 - Engineering reality translated for non-technical stakeholders - without softening it

Working with Principal Engineer: 

Complementary, not overlapping, and explicitly peer-to-peer neither of you reports to the other, and both of you report to CTO: 

- Principal Engineer's Lane: sets the engineering bar, models strong coding and system design, focuses on the system/architecture itself. 
 - Your Lane: improves how the team builds software - delivery accountability, coaching, people and process design, raising engineering maturity across the team. 

You're both expected to operate hand in hand as part of a small engineering leadership group (with CTO, delivery, and QA) that regularly reviews team effectiveness, quality trends, and process changes - and both of you are expected to bring an independent, ongoing view on where the company's technology and process choices should evolve, not just execute within your own lane. 

Leadership Expectations: 

- Serve as a teacher, guide, and mentor to engineers - especially in systems thinking and data fluency. 
 - Help bridge communication and cultural gaps on the team where needed. 
 - Take accountability for improving engineering output in partnership with delivery and QA, with the long-term aim of shifting more quality responsibility left onto development. 
 - Support a flatter org design: a small set of strong technical leads rather than a layered management hierarchy. 

Success Measures: 

- Noticeable improvement in engineering velocity and quality, sprint over sprint, after onboarding. 
 - Better consistency in how engineers reason about data and system implications. 
 - Increased adoption of effective AI-assisted engineering workflows through role modeling and coaching, not mandate. 
 - Stronger day-to-day developer guidance without adding unnecessary hierarchy. 

What This Role Is Not: 

- Treating GenAI as a productivity tool rather than a platform shift
 - A layer of middle management added for its own sake - the org design stays flat
 - A pure coach who directs from the sidelines without writing code or doing the work personally

Where You're Stretching: 

- Worth naming plainly: for most candidates who fit this profile, formal engineering people-management - hiring decisions, performance conversations, career development from the manager's chair - is a genuine stretch rather than an established track record. That's fine, and expected, as long as it's a stretch you genuinely want to grow into, not just a title you're technically capable of holding. It's a real reach, not a formality, and success depends on wanting to guide and elevate people, not just being technically capable of it. 
 - Given that, the first 90-180 days work like this rather than assuming day-one authority produces day-one results: Alex partners with you as a backstop on early hiring decisions and performance conversations, with an explicit checkpoint at 90 days to assess how the people-leadership side is landing. The destination - real authority, from day one in spirit if not in fully-proven practice - doesn't change. How we get there does.

Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for driving the design, implementation, and management of scalable, secure, and highly available AI solutions that power AOT's portfolio of digital products for the public and private sectors. This role blends deep technical expertise with strategic thinking and hands-on leadership - setting architectural direction, championing AI-assisted engineering practices, and mentoring engineers to build the next generation of intelligent, cloud-native applications. - Lead the end-to-end design, architecture and delivery of scalable, secure and highly available AI-powered solutions across AOT's product portfolio. 
 - Define and evolve the technical vision for AI/ML platforms, including LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows and ML model lifecycle management.

Provide hands-on technical leadership - writing production-grade code, building proof-of-concepts and prototypes, reviewing pull requests and shaping critical design decisions across multiple teams.

Mentor and grow senior engineers, tech leads and architects through coaching, design reviews, technical deep-dives and structured feedback - building a strong engineering bench. 
 - Partner with the Head of Engineering, Product and Solutions teams to align technical strategy with business outcomes, customer needs and long-term product roadmaps. 
 - Lead cross-team architectural reviews and serve as the principal authority on technical trade-offs, build-vs-buy decisions and platform standardization. 
 - Define and guide DevOps, SRE and MLOps practices - including CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, model deployment, monitoring and continuous evaluation of AI systems. 
 - Stay at the forefront of emerging trends in Generative AI, LLMs, agentic systems, and applied ML - actively bringing innovation back into AOT's products and engineering culture. 
 - Represent AOT's engineering organization in technical forums, customer conversations, open-source communities, and industry events as needed.

Required Qualifications Education

Technical Skills

 - Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks and ecosystems: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock APIs, vector databases. 
 - Strong command of AI-assisted development tools and workflows (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or any other agentic coding agents) and ability to operationalize them across an engineering organization. 
 - Solid understanding of DevOps, SRE and MLOps practices: CI/CD, IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry) and model monitoring. 
 - Deep understanding of secure coding practices, identity and access management, data privacy, accessibility and compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise and public sector software. Experience with process orchestration and workflow tools (e. g. , M8Flow, Camunda, Airflow, Temporal) is a strong plus. Leadership & Communication
 - Proven ability to lead through influence - driving alignment across engineering teams, product, design and executive stakeholders without direct reporting authority. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong mentorship and coaching skills, with a track record of growing senior engineers and tech leads. 
 - Skilled in agile development methodologies and iterative, customer-centric delivery. 

Preferred Qualifications

Working Conditions

Living AOT's Values Our values guide how we work, collaborate, and grow as a team. Every role at AOT is expected to embody and promote these values:

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer / QA Lead with 10-12 years of experience in cloud-based network management solutions to join our engineering team. 

The role will focus on end-to-end quality engineering for a cloud-hosted network management platform, managing and monitoring networking devices such as Access Points, Switches and Routers. 

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in testing cloud-managed networking solutions, with a combination of networking, AWS/cloud, REST APIs, Python automation, TypeScript/Playwright and end-to-end system testing. 

This role requires someone who can understand and validate the complete solution across: 

Network Device → LAN/WAN → Internet → AWS Cloud → Cloud Services/APIs → Database → Web/Mobile Application

The candidate should be comfortable troubleshooting issues across both the networking and cloud/application layers. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Network Management Testing

- Own QA for a cloud-based network management platform from requirements through production. 
 - Test end-to-end workflows for cloud-managed Access Points, Switches, Routers and other network devices. 
 - Validate device onboarding, discovery, provisioning and configuration. 
 - Test device-to-cloud communication and cloud-to-device operations. 
 - Validate configuration synchronization between cloud and network devices. 
 - Test device monitoring, health status, statistics, alerts and notifications. 
 - Validate firmware/software upgrade workflows. 
 - Test remote configuration and management capabilities. 
 - Validate device connectivity, disconnect/reconnect and recovery scenarios. 
 - Test multi-device, multi-site and large-scale network management scenarios. 
 - Validate behavior under network failures, latency, packet loss and intermittent connectivity. 
 - Test cloud-managed networking workflows across different network topologies and environments. 

Test Planning & Quality Ownership

- Review requirements, user stories, functional specifications and technical designs. 
 - Review ERDs and data models to understand relationships, dependencies and data flows. 
 - Participate in architecture and design reviews from a QA perspective. 
 - Identify functional, integration, data, networking and cloud risks. 
 - Develop test strategy, test plans, test scenarios and test cases. 
 - Define test scope, coverage, environments, dependencies and execution timelines. 
 - Create positive, negative, boundary, failure-recovery and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Maintain requirements-to-test-case traceability. 
 - Review test cases and ensure adequate coverage. 

Test Execution

- Execute functional, integration, system, regression and end-to-end testing. 
 - Perform cloud-to-device and device-to-cloud testing. 
 - Test networking devices together with cloud services and applications. 
 - Validate APIs, backend services, database state and UI behavior as part of end-to-end workflows. 
 - Perform interoperability and compatibility testing. 
 - Execute testing across different network configurations and connectivity conditions. 
 - Analyze failures across device, network, cloud and application layers. 

API & Cloud Testing

- Strong hands-on experience with REST API testing and automation. 
 - Validate API request/response, authentication, authorization and business logic. 
 - Test APIs used for device provisioning, configuration, monitoring and management. 
 - Validate data consistency between APIs, cloud services, database and UI. 
 - Test asynchronous workflows, events, notifications and service-to-service communication. 
 - Test AWS-hosted cloud applications and services. 
 - Validate cloud services, microservices and distributed workflows. 
 - Analyze cloud logs, metrics, traces and application telemetry. 
 - Test reliability, availability, scalability and failure/recovery scenarios. 
 - Validate deployments across QA, staging and production environments. 

Networking Expertise

Strong hands-on knowledge of networking is essential. 

Experience With

- TCP/IP

 - DNS
 - ARP
 - ICMP
 - HTTP/HTTPS
 - TLS/SSL
 - NAT
 - Routing
 - Switching

 - QoS
 - Ethernet
 - WAN/LAN
 - Wi-Fi technologies
 - WPA2/WPA3

 - Network connectivity and troubleshooting

Experience with Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7 is highly desirable. 

Network Troubleshooting & Diagnostics

Hands-on Experience With Tools Such As

- Wireshark
 - tcpdump
 - ping
 - traceroute
 - iperf
 - nslookup/dig
 - Network packet capture and protocol analysis

Ability To Troubleshoot Issues Across

Device → LAN/WLAN → WAN/Internet → Cloud → API → Backend → Application

The candidate should be able to use packet captures, logs, API traces and cloud telemetry to determine the root cause of complex issues. 

Test Automation

Python

Job Title: Blue Yonder (JDA) WMS Technical Architect

Experience Level: Senior / Architect Level (7+ Years Total Experience)

Role Description

We are looking for a hands-on Blue Yonder (JDA / RedPrairie) Discrete WMS Technical Architect to lead technical design, custom development, and system integrations for our DSS delivery team across multiple concurrent client engagements. 

In this player-coach leadership role, you will own end-to-end technical architecture while remaining deeply hands-on in MOCA, Java, Oracle PL/SQL, and Blue Yonder WMS Integrator. Working within an Agile delivery model, you will translate complex warehouse functional specifications into high-performing, upgrade-safe customizations (MODs), set engineering and code-review standards, mentor developers, and safeguard production stability across mission-critical distribution centers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Architecture & Solution Design: Partner with functional consultants and client IT stakeholders to translate FDDs into scalable Technical Design Documents (TDDs), interface specifications, and accurate sprint effort estimates. 
 - Core WMS Customizations (MODs): Architect, build, and maintain server-side business logic using MOCA (custom commands, policy/command overrides, triggers, and local syntax), Java components, and Oracle PL/SQL stored procedures and functions. 
 - Enterprise System Integrations: Design and develop real-time and batch integrations connecting Blue Yonder Discrete WMS with ERP (SAP, Oracle), TMS, parcel carriers, labor systems, and WCS/MHE automation via BY WMS Integrator (events, transactions, IFD mappings, and host adapters), RESTful APIs, and XML/JSON payloads. 
 - Code Governance & Technical Mentorship: Establish and enforce coding conventions, unit-testing rigor, and documentation standards; conduct thorough peer code reviews and mentor mid-level and junior WMS developers. 
 - Performance Tuning & Production Escalations: Lead root-cause investigation for high-severity production incidents using MOCA trace logs, server diagnostics, and SQL execution plans; proactively optimize slow-running queries, wave/allocation bottlenecks, and MOCA processes within SLA targets. 
 - Release Management & Agile Execution: Manage source control branching, merging, and rollout packaging in Git/SVN; coordinate SIT, UAT, dry runs, and go-live deployments while driving sprint planning, stand-ups, and backlog execution in JIRA. 

Required Qualifications

- Overall Experience: 7+ years of software engineering and technical architecture experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in Blue Yonder (JDA / RedPrairie) Discrete WMS. (Note: Candidates with Dispatcher-only WMS backgrounds or generic Java/PL/SQL profiles without Blue Yonder Discrete experience will not be considered). 
 - The Four Core Technical Pillars (Mandatory): 
 - MOCA Development: Expert-level ability to write and debug MOCA commands, triggers, overrides, and local syntax, paired with deep proficiency in MOCA trace analysis. 
 - Java: Proven experience building, extending, and maintaining custom Java components integrated within the Blue Yonder WMS server framework. 
 - Oracle PL/SQL & Data Model Mastery: Strong command of writing complex PL/SQL procedures, functions, and performance-tuned queries, backed by intimate knowledge of the Blue Yonder Discrete schema (inventory, orders, waves, work queues, and policy tables). 
 - Blue Yonder WMS Integrator: Hands-on track record designing, building, and troubleshooting Integrator interfaces-configuring events, transactions, IFD mappings, and host communication flows. 
 - Secondary Database & Scripting Skills: Working proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL queries and stored procedures) and JavaScript (for WebUI / PageBuilder screen customizations). 
 - Integration & Engineering Standards: Practical experience integrating WMS with ERP, TMS, parcel, and MHE/WCS platforms, alongside disciplined daily use of Git or SVN, unit testing, and formal code reviews. 
 - Communication & Deployment Flexibility: Ability to articulate architectural trade-offs clearly to functional consultants and client IT leaders, balance priorities across multiple client projects, and support critical dry runs or go-live cutovers across client time zones as needed. 
Education & Leadership Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree (B. E. /B. Tech, MCA, or M. Sc. ) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Self-directed technical leader who takes end-to-end ownership of architectural quality, thrives in fast-paced Agile sprints, and elevates team output through constructive code reviews and clear documentation.

data.title: SDE II - Java
data.description:
Hiring for Swiggy - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

Swiggy is India's leading on-demand convenience platform, spanning food delivery, Instamart quick commerce, Dineout and more. Its engineering team builds the real-time systems behind millions of daily orders, with Java microservices at the core of the backend. Swiggy is adding experienced backend engineers in Bengaluru to keep these services fast, reliable and easy to evolve as the business scales. 

About the Role

As an SDE II on the backend team, you'll own Java and Spring Boot microservices used by millions of customers, restaurant partners and delivery executives. You'll design and ship APIs, find and fix performance bottlenecks, keep services healthy in production, and guide other engineers through code reviews. This is a hybrid role based in Bengaluru. 

What you'll do

- Build and own backend components and microservices in Java and Spring Boot
 - Design and implement RESTful APIs and integrations across Swiggy's services, with clear contracts and failure handling
 - Profile and tune Java services (JVM, multithreading, caching, queries) to cut latency and improve stability
 - Maintain, refactor and troubleshoot backend codebases for high availability and reliability
 - Take part in code reviews, deployments, service monitoring and backend infrastructure work
 - Work with engineering and cross-functional teams, and give technical guidance on Java-related improvements

What you bring

- 3-6 years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years of backend development in Java and Spring Boot
 - A strong grasp of REST APIs, microservices architecture and backend system design
 - Hands-on experience with performance tuning, multithreading and JVM optimisation
 - Good working knowledge of CI/CD, Git and cloud-native practices
 - You have built and run Spring Boot microservices in production, including monitoring, deployments and fixing live issues
 - You have improved a service's latency or throughput through profiling, caching, query tuning or concurrency changes
 - Clear communication about API behaviour, and comfort delivering quickly in a fast-moving environment

Nice to have

- Experience with Kafka or event-driven systems, Redis, SQL/NoSQL databases, AWS, Docker or Kubernetes
 - Backend work at a consumer-internet or high-traffic product company
 - Experience mentoring engineers or leading design reviews
 - Immediate availability or a short notice period

data.title: Backend Engineer, Banking
data.description:
About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better. 

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We're fixing it. And we're moving fast. 

We're an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers. 

We're backed by Walmart, the world's largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech's most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining. 

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don't have time to wait. . . and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we're looking for people who are: 

- Ready to run
 - Hungry and driven by urgency
 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
 - Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

Software Engineers at OnePay build the products & systems that serve our customers and run our company. Besides writing, reviewing, and shipping code, engineers collaborate with others across the company, from product, design, and data to, customer support, ops, and compliance. Software Engineers at OnePay are highly technical, communicative, and emotionally intelligent. 

This role is responsible for: 

- Working closely with other engineers to ship code. We enjoy collaboration and partnering on hard problems. 
 - Building and maintaining documentation. As a growing and remote organization, having the necessary docs are key to our success. 
 - Solving complex problems that arise at scale. We deal with real-world money movement, sensitive financial data at scale, and are creating novel financial mechanics with no real precedent. 

You Bring

- 4+ years professional experience building, shipping - and growing - non-trivial products & services. 
 - Professional experience building, shipping - and growing - non-trivial products & services. 
 - We are hiring at all levels of seniority for backend engineers. 
 - Passion for your craft and care for the people you work with. You value quality across code, communication, and culture. 
 - An act-like-an-owner mentality. We have a bias toward taking action. 
 - A desire to keep growing your skills, and an ability to learn quickly. We hope you'll be here for a while, and there's no better investment than in our people. 
 - The Triple H Factor: Hungry, Humble, Honest

Tools We Use

We use Typescript front to back, with node and NestJS frameworks for server code and React Native for our iOS, Android, and Web clients. We run on a highly distributed cloud-native stack with Kubernetes and AWS, and scale and resiliency are at the heart of everything we build. We also embrace agentic development, so engineers have their choice of a variety of models and agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly. 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary, stock options, and benefits from Day 1
 - Comprehensive health insurance coverage (health insurance, accident and disability insurance, term life insurance), including mental health support and wellness programs
 - Hybrid work model (Bengaluru office three days a week), various time off programs (vacation, sick, other paid leaves, and paid regional holidays)
 - Monthly transport and work-from-home allowances
 - A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Standard Interview Process

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through: 

- AI-assisted initial screen
 - Interview with Talent Partner
 - Technical or Hiring Manager Interview
 - Team Interview
 - Executive Interview
 - Offer!

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay. com.

data.description:
Job Purpose

We are on a mission as a team. We are problem solvers and partners, always starting with our customers to solve their challenges and create opportunities. Our start-up roots keep us nimble, flexible and fast moving. We take ownership and make decisions. We all work for one company and work together to drive growth across the business. We engage in robust debates to find the best path, and then we move forward as one team. We take pride in what we do, acting with integrity and passion, so that our customers can perform better. We are experts and enthusiasts - combining ever-expanding knowledge with leading technology to consistently deliver results, solutions and opportunities for our customers and stakeholders. Every day we work toward transforming global markets. 

The Senior ETL QA Analyst (Clearing Data Analytics) will work with Business Analysts, SQL Developers, ETL and Data Warehouse Engineers to review business/technical requirements and produce test strategies, test scenarios, test cases and queries to validate code that generates data in reports and dashboards. 

In this role you will develop a deep understanding of our Clearing Houses business processes. You will focus on understanding the data models and fields, complex data transformation logic, various integration points, and reporting dashboards. The right candidate has a unique mix of technical skills and business-process savvy and will proactively develop and maintain automation queries in sql and or python. 

Responsibilities

- Document, maintain and execute detailed test cases to validate system functionality, identify and document software defects, and track test case execution status. 
 - Create test plans for software releases to detail the overall strategy for testing complex systems, including defining resources and test scope for each test cycle, and identifying dependencies and risks. 
 - Deploy software release builds, maintain test environments, and perform troubleshooting software / hardware configuration problems. 
 - Work with technology team in building cutting edge Clearing Data Analytics and Reporting Systems. 
 - Test systems built in ETL, DWH and reporting based solutions
 - Gain experience with Iterative and Agile software development methodologies. 
 - Perform all aspects of verification, including functional, integration, automated regression and system testing. 

Knowledge And Experience

- B. S. or higher in Computer Science or related discipline; or equivalent work experience
 - 5+ years of experience in enterprise application testing (test case development and execution)
 - Strong SQL and or python scripting experience
 - Ability to set priorities and multi-task in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Prefer 3+ years of experience working in UNIX/Linux and SQL/Oracle environments. 
 - Experience in working with ETL systems and Reporting solutions such as Tableau and or business objects. 
 - 2+ years of experience with commodity markets, financial trading environment, or equity brokerage business and exposure to futures markets is preferred.

Making trade-off decisions between speed-to-market and long-term technical investment

Influencing peer SDMs and senior leadership on cross-org priorities

Thinking about how to measure and improve customer engagement, retention, and acquisition through technology

Job Description

Innovation Hub Overview

Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies' growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities.
