From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate IT Equities Technology

Jefferies' Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum-cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting. Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores-often developing new platforms from the ground up with clear ownership and impact. Role Overview

The Connectivity team is seeking a Vice President to lead the regional FIX Order and Execution Systems team based in Pune. This is a hands-on team leadership role with responsibility for setting priorities, allocating work, developing engineers, and coordinating the team's delivery and production support. The team lead must bring proven experience leading technical teams, deep equities trading and FIX connectivity expertise, and a collaborative, accountable working style. The team's technical scope includes FIX configuration, sell-side broker connectivity, messaging and system-performance analytics, automated testing, and CI/CD implementation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the local Pune regional team day to day: set priorities, allocate work, balance delivery and production-support demands, and maintain clear ownership and escalation paths within the team. 
 - Develop team capability through coaching, regular feedback, knowledge sharing, and delegation; build a supportive environment where engineers raise risks early and take ownership of outcomes. 
 - Represent the Pune team in global planning and incident coordination, communicating the local team's capacity, dependencies, risks, and commitments and coordinating handovers with peer teams in other regions. 
 - Lead the design, implementation, certification, and production support of FIX order and execution systems. 
 - Translate front-office trading requirements into FIX session configurations, message mappings, validation rules, and routing logic. 
 - Configure and support sell-side broker FIX connectivity, including new sessions, client migrations, and production changes. 
 - Analyze FIX messages and application behavior across the complete order lifecycle. 
 - Diagnose session management, sequence, validation, order-state, reject, routing, and downstream processing issues. 
 - Build or enhance tools for connectivity configuration, certification, monitoring, and operational support. 
 - Analyze message volumes, latency, throughput, burst patterns, queue behavior, and capacity. 
 - Develop AI-assisted models or tools for generating and prioritizing test scenarios for FIX order and execution systems. 
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines for configuration, code, testing, and deployment. 
 - Develop applications and automation using Java or Python. 
 - Define production-readiness criteria, monitoring requirements, support procedures, and rollback plans. 
 - Lead incident investigation and root-cause analysis for significant connectivity issues. 

Required Qualifications

- Generally, 10 years of FIX engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on hands-on engineering of FIX order and execution systems, together with demonstrated experience leading a technical team. 
 - Proven experience leading a local technical team, including work allocation, coaching, delivery oversight, and production-support coordination, while collaborating with peer teams in other locations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to achieve outcomes through others: delegate effectively, give constructive feedback, resolve competing priorities, and build team capability rather than rely on individual intervention. 
 - Extensive experience with electronic equities trading and front-office FIX order and execution systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of the FIX protocol, including session and application layers. 
 - Experience configuring and supporting sell-side broker FIX connectivity. 
 - Detailed understanding of equity order messages and order-state transitions. 
 - Experience diagnosing FIX rejects, session failures, sequence issues, mapping problems, and routing defects. 
 - Experience analyzing messaging performance, latency, throughput, and system behavior. 
 - Intermediate or stronger development skills in Java or Python. 
 - Experience with automated build, test, deployment, and CI/CD tooling. 
 - Strong production-support, incident-management, leadership, and communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with FIX Orchestra, FIX dictionaries, custom tags, and venue-specific extensions. 
 - Experience with QuickFIX/J, proprietary FIX platforms, ULLINK product suite, or comparable FIX technology; experience with Verifix or other FIX simulation tools. 
 - Experience with Solace, Kafka, or equivalent messaging platforms. 
 - Experience applying AI or machine learning to test generation, failure analysis, or operational analytics. 
 - Experience with Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic. 

About Us

Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments. 

At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. Spectro Cloud helps platform teams and cloud providers modernize and manage infrastructure for the AI era without adding more tools or operational complexity. 

With PaletteAI, enterprises, public sector organizations, neoclouds and sovereign clouds can build, govern and operate full-stack environments across VMs, Kubernetes, edge, regulated and air-gapped locations, and AI infrastructure. PaletteAI Launchpads help teams start quickly with urgent outcomes such as VMware migration, token cost control or edge modernization, then scale into enterprise-wide lifecycle management, governance and fleet operations on the same platform.

At Spectro Cloud, we are in search of a talented individual to become an integral part of our Engineering team, playing a pivotal role in shaping the future of our cutting-edge Palette platform. 

Collaboration is of utmost importance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to create scalable, dependable, and secure solutions that push boundaries. In this role, we encourage you to stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, thereby ensuring that our solutions remain innovative and ahead of the curve. By joining our team, you will become an influential driving force in shaping the future of Kubernetes at scale through Palette, the modern enterprise Kubernetes management platform offered by Spectro Cloud. 

What You'll Do

As a software engineer within our organization, you will be at the forefront of building an always-on, self-healing, and declarative platform specifically engineered for the management of both infrastructure and applications. You will have the opportunity to contribute significantly by designing, optimizing, and streamlining GoLang-based microservices that serve as the foundation of our platform. Proficiency in Kubernetes is required - it lies at the very heart of our contemporary cloud-native, data center and edge solutions. 

Your responsibilities will also include ensuring the seamless operation of our platform through a combination of automation, scripting, and rigorous testing. Our organization places a strong emphasis on code quality, and your commitment to producing clean and efficient code is highly regarded. 

As a Software Engineer at Spectro Cloud, you'll succeed by embracing adaptability, tackling complex challenges, and navigating dynamic environments with confidence. Success in this role depends on your ability to break down intricate challenges into manageable steps and deliver value through iterative, test-and-learn approaches. At Spectro Cloud, we champion innovation and collaboration, fostering a culture where shared ideas drive progress. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 
 - 4+ years of experience in software development (or 2+ years with a Master's degree). 
 - Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Go, Java, or equivalent.

data.description:
Description

Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems. 

We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too. 

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands - customer obsession is part of our company DNA. 

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business. 

We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges. 

If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us!

Work/Life Balance

RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. 

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal & Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e. g. , system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc. ). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You work on software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new members on how team's software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

data.title: Assistant Manager/Manager Airside Controls & Automation
data.description:
Role: Assistant Manager/Manager -Airside Controls

Location: Gurgaon, India

Full/ Part-time: Full time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. 

About The Role

This role involves in designing and developing electrical and control systems for AHU units. 

Job Responsibilities

- Design and develop electrical and control systems for Air Handling Units (AHUs) in accordance with project specifications, customer requirements, applicable codes, and engineering standards. 
 - Develop and design electrical control panels, including MCC/control panels, starter panels, VFD/VSD panels, DOL and star-delta starter systems, control transformers, power supplies, protection, switching, and control devices. 
 - Select, specify, and appropriately size electrical and control components, including motors, VFDs, contactors, overload relays, MCBs, MCCBs, fuses, relays, sensors, actuators, terminal blocks, and associated accessories. 
 - Prepare and review electrical schematics, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams (SLDs), panel layouts, and interconnection drawings. 
 - Develop AHU control philosophy and control logic for supply, return, and exhaust fans; fresh-air and return-air dampers; heating and cooling systems; chilled-water valves; electric heaters; humidifiers; filtration systems; and associated monitoring and protection functions. 
 - Develop, configure, program, and troubleshoot microprocessor-based controllers for HVAC and industrial automation applications. 
 - Configure, program, and troubleshoot temperature, pressure, humidity, airflow, and other process control systems used in HVAC applications. 
 - Select, configure, integrate, and troubleshoot field instrumentation and devices, including temperature, humidity, pressure, differential-pressure, airflow sensors, actuators, valves, and controllers. 
 - Develop and configure HMI/SCADA systems for equipment monitoring, control, alarm management, data visualization, and system diagnostics. 
 - Design and implement communication and interface requirements between AHU electrical/control systems and Building Management Systems (BMS) and other HVAC automation platforms. 
 - Perform system integration, functional testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning of electrical and automation systems. 
 - Diagnose, debug, and optimize existing electrical, control, and automation systems to improve system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Prepare electrical control panel designs using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical engineering design tools, with preference for hands-on experience in panel design documentation. 
 - Perform electrical engineering calculations, including connected load, operating load, cable sizing, protective device selection, breaker ratings, short-circuit ratings, control transformer sizing, and panel ratings. 
 - Ensure all electrical and automation designs comply with applicable IEC, IS, NFPA, NEC, and other relevant international/local standards, as well as customer and project-specific requirements. 
 - Review and interpret AHU mechanical drawings, equipment layouts, and technical specifications to ensure effective coordination and integration of electrical, mechanical, and control systems. 
 - Prepare and maintain Bills of Materials (BOMs), cable schedules, I/O lists, equipment/component specifications, terminal schedules, technical datasheets, and other engineering documentation. 
 - Review customer specifications, tender requirements, approved drawings, and technical submittals, and incorporate relevant requirements and engineering changes into the design. 
 - Coordinate closely with Mechanical Engineering, Controls/Automation, Production, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and Service teams to ensure timely and successful project execution. 
 - Provide technical support to the manufacturing and assembly teams during control panel fabrication, panel wiring, component installation, AHU assembly, and inspection activities. 
 - Provide technical support to the Service and Commissioning teams during site installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer handover. 
 - Conduct design verification, functional testing, electrical testing, and system validation to ensure compliance with design requirements and expected equipment performance. 
 - Investigate electrical, instrumentation, control, and automation-related issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Maintain and control engineering drawings, software programs, technical documentation, revisions, and as-built records for current and future projects. 
 - Support the development and implementation of engineering standards, design guidelines, standard control philosophies, and reusable design solutions for AHU applications. 
 - Identify opportunities for cost optimization, component standardization, design simplification, and product improvement without compromising safety, quality, reliability, or performance. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives related to AHU electrical systems, automation architecture, control logic, panel design, manufacturing processes, and field performance. 

Education Preferred

Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering / Electronics & Electrical engineering, having 7-11 years of work experience in Airside products

Experience Preferred

Design & development experience required as below: 

Ø Essential Competencies/ Primary Skill Set

- Electrical System & Control Panel Design: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in designing electrical systems, control panels, starter panels, MCC panels, and associated control and protection circuits. 
 - AHU/HVAC Electrical & Automation Systems: Sound understanding of electrical, controls, and automation systems used in Air Handling Units (AHUs) and HVAC applications. 
 - Motor Control & Protection: Proficiency in motor starting, control, protection, interlocking, and selection of appropriate protective devices for HVAC and industrial applications. 
 - VFD/VSD Applications: Practical knowledge of Variable Frequency Drives/Variable Speed Drives, including selection, configuration, parameterization, integration, and troubleshooting. 
 - Microprocessor/PLC/DDC-Based Controllers: Knowledge and experience in configuring, programming, integrating, and troubleshooting microprocessor-based, PLC, and DDC controllers used in HVAC and industrial automation applications. 
 - HVAC Instrumentation & Field Devices: Good understanding of HVAC sensors, transmitters, actuators, control valves, dampers, and other field devices, including their selection, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. 
 - HMI/SCADA Systems: Experience in configuring and troubleshooting HMI/SCADA systems for equipment monitoring, process visualization, alarm management, data acquisition, and operational control. 
 - BMS Integration & Communication Protocols: Understanding of BMS integration and industrial communication protocols for seamless communication between AHUs, controllers, field devices, and building automation systems. 
 - Electrical Load & Cable Sizing: Competence in electrical load calculations, cable sizing, voltage-drop calculations, protective device selection, short-circuit ratings, and control panel sizing. 
 - Electrical Schematics & Panel Documentation: Ability to develop and interpret electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, terminal schedules, and interconnection drawings. 
 - AutoCAD/EPLAN: Proficiency in using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical design software for developing and maintaining electrical drawings and control panel documentation. 
 - System Integration, Testing & Commissioning: Ability to integrate electrical, controls, instrumentation, and automation systems and conduct functional testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning activities. 
 - Electrical & Automation Troubleshooting: Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose electrical, instrumentation, control, communication, and automation-related issues and implement effective corrective actions. 
 - Electrical & HVAC Standards: Good working knowledge of relevant electrical and HVAC standards, including IEC, IS, NFPA, NEC, and applicable customer/project-specific standards and requirements. 
 - Ability to interpret customer specifications and deliver technically sound, compliant engineering solutions
 - Ability to drive cross-functional collaboration (Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Manufacturing, Sourcing) for project execution
 - Good communication skills to manage customer interactions, technical clarifications, and submittal approvals

Ø Desirable Competencies/ Secondary Skill Set

- Experience in handling customer-facing engineering discussions and approvals during project execution
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced ETO/project environment
 - Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment. 
 - Analytical thinking, Problem solving, adaptability and strong communication skills. 
 - Self-starter who can work on his/her own initiative, balance demand load & prioritize

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary. 

- Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave

 - Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation.
